title_en: Security access
abstract_en:
This invention consists of 2 main parts: 
     1. a smoke detector or fire/smoke alarm detection unit which includes a wireless transmitter. The wireless transmitter communicates with an electronic locking mechanism which is incorporated into each security bar assembly unit found at all the doors and windows in a building. The locking mechanism includes a receiver and actuator incorporated into the bar assembly unit. The wireless transmitter communicates with the receiver. The security bar assembly also includes spring hinges as well as a battery back up and low battery warning system featuring both a flashing light (for the hearing impaired) and a buzzer (for the visually impaired. There is also a manual release button. In the event that the smoke detection unit is activated, the wireless transmitter sends a signal to the receiver which in turn activates the electronic lock to the open position. Since smoke detectors and fire/smoke alarm detection units are interconnected, all the bars throughout the building would be activated regardless of where the fire originates thus allowing multiple exiting options for the occupants and multiple ingress options for emergency responders. The spring hinges then cause the bars to swing to the open position. The integrated battery provides power to activate the locking mechanism in case of loss of ac power. The low battery warning system provides a flashing light (for the hearing impaired) as well as a buzzer (for the visually impaired) to indicate that the battery needs replacing. The manual release button provides a means of egress in the event that both ac and battery power are non existent. 
     2. The electronic lock system also includes an actuator which allows for wireless communication via the internet using a mobile phone or computer app which would be installed on the devices of local emergency responders. 
     Each security bar assembly would be programmed with its own unique access code. This code would be provided to and filed with the local emergency dispatch center. The app would consist of a numeric key pad that when the user punches the correct code sends a signal to the actuator in the security bar assembly activating it into the open position. In the event of a 911 call, dispatch would provide the emergency responders with the access code and they would in turn use their mobile device to remotely activate the security bar assembly to the open position. The system would also include an integrated Knox type lock to provide a manual access option for emergency response personnel in the event of an electrical power outage and the battery has run dry or in the event of a more widespread loss of power.

title_en: Wireless neighborhood wildfire defense system network supporting proactive protection of life and property in a neighborhood through GPS-tracking and mapping of environmentally-clean anti-fire (AF) chemical liquid spray applied to the property before wild fires reach the neighborhood
abstract_en: A wireless wild fire defense system network supporting proactive protection of life and property in GPS-specified neighborhoods using GPS-managed delivery of environmentally-clean anti-fire (AF) chemical liquid spray to property before wild fire reaches the neighborhoods. The wireless system network includes a GPS system for providing GPS-location services to each system components in the wireless system network. A wireless communication network supports one or more network databases accessible by systems and devices deployed on the wireless communication network. A fleet of mobile GPS-tracked anti-fire liquid spraying systems are assigned to GPS-specified neighborhoods for spraying anti-fire chemical liquid on combustible property, buildings, and ground cover to inhibit fire ignition and flame spread wherever the anti-fire chemical liquid is sprayed. When allowed to dry, the anti-fire chemical liquid provides fire-protection status to sprayed property that is GPS-tracked and mapped within a network database maintained on the wireless communication network, recording wherever the environmentally-safe anti-fire chemical liquid has been spray applied. The system network includes mobile computing systems, each running a mobile application and deployed to a property owner, spray contractor or other stakeholder, such as firefighters and property insurance inspectors, for remotely monitoring the fire-protection status of property in any GPS-specified neighborhood, at any time on any specified date, along with the status of active wild fires surrounding the neighborhood. A command center deployed on the wireless system network transmits wild fire alerts and notifications and property spray orders, and supports microservices configured for monitoring and managing GPS-tracked spraying operations within GPS-specified neighborhoods. Through GPS-managed delivery of anti-fire chemical liquid spray on property surfaces before arrival of wild fire, fire ignition and flame spread are inhibited, and human and animal life and property are protected.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire hydrant hits monitoring devices that falls, including fire hydrant top cap and the monitor terminal box of setting in the fire hydrant top cap, be equipped with in the monitor terminal box and hit the sensor, hit the sensor and include interconnect's vibrations switch, power module and signal acquisition module, current data when signal acquisition module is used for acquireing the vibrations switch break-make, signal acquisition module is connected with the MCU controller, is connected with acousto-optic warning module and wireless communication module on the MCU controller, the MCU controller sends the detected signal of signal acquisition module for remote monitoring platform through the wireless communication module. The utility model discloses can real-time effectual detection go out the signal that the fire hydrant was hit down by the foreign object, in time send signal for remote monitoring platform, the relevant managers of remote monitoring platform can in time schedule maintenance personal after receiving the signal and go to the scene, in time maintain the fire hydrant who hits down, practice thrift a large amount of fresh water resources.
assignees: ZHEJIANG KELONG FIRE INTELLIGENT DEV CO LTD

title_en: A kind of Geological Hazards of debris monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Geological Hazards of debris monitoring system, is related to disaster monitoring system technical field, mainly including user terminal, reception system, early warning radar, multispectral monitoring system, for distribution subsystem and control communication subsystem.The Geological Hazards of debris monitor system performance stabilization of the present invention, the low, high sensitivity that consumes energy, in light weight, detection range is remote, the object that translational speed is 0.5 100s/m can be automatically detected, the generation of the disaster such as rainfall degree and mountain torrents, mud-rock flow can be accurately identified, while solves rainfall monitoring and mud-rock flow in modern saltant type Natural calamity monitoring technology and identifies two hang-ups；Further, monitoring system supports ad-hoc communication/mobile communication/satellite communication Three models, can adaptively switch between Three models, and user can match disparate modules according to the demand of oneself.

title_en: Schoolbus sensor
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A school bus for protecting children using a thermal sensor is provided to prevent an accident such as driving while the skirt of the children is caught in the vehicle door or driving without recognizing the presence of children in a blind spot. CONSTITUTION: A school bus for protecting children using a thermal sensor includes a thermal sensor sensing human bodies in every direction(1,2,3,4) of the school bus. When a child approaches the school bus, the sensor senses danger and rings a warning sound from an alarm device(5).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 어린이 통학차량에서 발생할 수 있는 안전사고를 예방하기 위한 시스템으로 어린이의 옷자락이 차문에 끼여 차량에 끌려가거나 운전자 시야 사각지대에 어린이가 있는 것을 발견하지 못해 소중한 목숨을 잃는 사고를 예방하기 위해 승합차의 전(1)후(2)좌(3)우(4)면에 인체를 인식하는 열 감지 센서를 설치하여 어린이가 차량에 접근한 상태이면 센서가 위험을 감지해 경보기(5)에서 경고음이 울려 운전자가 미쳐 발견하지못한 위험을 확인해 사고를 사전에 예방할 수 있다.

title_en: Communication Connector Equipment For Connecting Indoor Communication Cables
abstract_en: The present invention relates to communication connector equipment for connecting indoor communication cables, which comprises: a table (10); a connection mechanism (30); a communication device case (70); a fire detection sensor (80); a warning speaker (90) which outputs a warning sound to the surroundings when receiving a fire detection signal from the fire detection sensor (80); an oxygen measuring sensor (100) which outputs an oxygen warning signal when oxygen concentration is measured to be a reference value or less; a temperature measuring sensor (110) which outputs a temperature warning signal when the temperature inside the communication device case (70) is measured and the temperature is measured to be a reference value or greater; a humidity measuring sensor (120) which outputs a humidity warning signal when the humidity inside the communication device case (70) is measured and the humidity is measured to be a reference value or greater; a transmitter (130) which wirelessly transmits the oxygen warning signal from the oxygen measuring sensor (100), the temperature warning signal from the temperature measuring sensor (110), or the humidity warning signal from the humidity measuring sensor (120); a plurality of guiders (20); a door (50); and a foreign material removal mechanism (60). In the present invention, a communication device (71) can be accommodated in the communication device case (70), so that the communication device (71) can be protected from external impact.

title_en: The urgent suppression system that cools of the exothermic reactions such as diazotising
abstract_en: The urgent suppression system that cools of the exothermic reactions such as diazotising, belongs to the emergent suppression system equipment technical field of chemical reaction.It includes reactor, ice storage cabinet, ice machine, goes out ice spiral, ice storage bit detector, ice storage cabinet agitating device, temperature of reaction kettle pressure detecting warning system, automatic valve on the rocks, goes out ice pipeline, pipeline on the rocks, the stirring apparatus for reaction kettle with monitor, control room contact switch of monitoring etc. is run to ice machine.The utility model to the ice storage amount in ice storage cabinet by detecting and interlocking in time ice machine ice-making activity, and according to running state monitoring of the Central Control Room to reactor, directly realize that automatic throwing ice cooling suppresses the over-temp and over-pressure of exothermic reaction in blind controller system, prevent the generation of industrial accident, it is simple with reasonable in design, construction, realize automatic detection warning and the interlocking of full-automatic operation and over-temp and over-pressure, the full automatic working of ice making throwing ice Emergency Cooling System is unattended with scene, safe and practical.
assignees: ZHEJIANG TITAN DESIGN & ENG CO LTD

title_en: A kind of weather information hiding Chinese phonetic broadcasting terminals based on Beidou satellite communication
abstract_en: The utility model relates to weather aid fields, disclose a kind of weather information hiding Chinese phonetic broadcasting terminals based on Beidou satellite communication.It is created by the utility model, can provide it is a kind of be applicable to Tibetan area geographical environment and can voice broadcast weather information at any time terminal device, on the one hand the weather information from distal end can be obtained whenever and wherever possible using Big Dipper short message communication module, it gets rid of Tibetan area communication network and is laid out insufficient limitation, on the other hand weather information can be converted into hiding/Chinese phonetic information using existing text-to-speech program, and speech type casting is carried out by D class power amplifier module and loudspeaker, so that people do not have to special inquiry, weather forecast can also be known whenever and wherever possible, weather warning and burst fire-disaster, ensure Tibetan area the people's lives and property safety.In addition, not only saving human resources without configuring professional to carry out voice broadcast, the link for carrying out human translation to information is also reduced, the timeliness of weather forecast is improved.
assignees: CHENGDU RUNNET TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent internet-of-things heat-insulation fire-fighting well cover
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent Internet of things heat-preservation fire-fighting well cover which comprises a well cover and a detector, wherein the well cover comprises a first well cover body and a second well cover body; the detection device is arranged on the well cover; when the well lid is misoperated, the detector generates an alarm signal. This well lid can prevent that personnel or foreign matter from getting into the fire well at will and destroying the facility in fire well and the fire well, can also prevent rain and snow etc. to get into in the well. Thereby protecting and insulating the fire well. The detector is used for detecting whether the well lid is operated by mistake, and if yes, an alarm signal is generated. The alarm signal can be sent to the client or the monitoring terminal in a wireless or wired transmission mode to carry out early warning. Before operation, the well lid is opened after the identity is confirmed by the detector, otherwise, the system gives an alarm to prevent the misoperation of irrelevant personnel, and the well lid is automatically recovered when being covered again. The detector can also automatically inspect.

title_en: Apparatus for fire and gas leakage warning with movable installation
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 시각 또는 청각 장애인 화재경고장치에 관한 것으로, 화재발생시 시각장애인 또는 청각 장애인들은 대피할 수 없어 인명사고 발생률이 높은 원인은 인식과 대처방식이 미흡하기 때문이 이러한 문제점이 해결한 시각 또는 청각 장애인 화재경고장치를 얻기 위한 것인 바, 
화재발생시 연기를 감지하는 연기 감지센서와, 화재발생시 제어부의 경보발생신호를 공급받아 화재경보를 알리며 기입력 입력된 음성으로 경보음과 화재발생멘트와 피난방법인 "위층계단으로 대피하세요", "좌측통로로 대피하세요"를 구체적으로 음성으로 알려주는 음성경보부와, 강력한 빛을 발산하도록 엘이디점멸등;를 포함하는 메인본체(300);로 이루어져 상기와 같이 구성된 본 고안에 따른 시각 또는 청각 장애인 화재경고장치에 의하면, 화재발생시 시각장애인과 청각장애인 뿐만 아니라 어린이 및 일반인들도 인지가 쉬워 화재대피가 빨라질 수 있도록 한 매우 유용한 고안인 것이다.

title_en: Automatic recognition early warning method and system for road foreign matters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for automatically identifying and early warning road foreign matters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the data acquisition unit acquires image information by installing cameras at various disaster hidden danger points; processing the acquired image information, and extracting various features in the acquired image information by the image after enhancing the source image; identifying the difference of image information obtained in adjacent time periods through the structural similarity; simplifying the extracted characteristic information by adopting a mathematical morphology method; and detecting whether the foreign matters in the acquired image information are motor vehicles, non-motor vehicles and pedestrians by adopting a YOLOv2 multi-target detection and identification model. According to the invention, through comparing the difference in the space structure between the images and adopting the YOLOv2 multi-target detection recognition model, the rockfall and other geological disasters of the road surface are recognized and detected, the problems of automatic recognition, prediction and early warning of the geological disasters of the road surface and the side slope are solved, and the image recognition and target detection precision is improved.
assignees: CHINA TRANSP TELECOMMUNICATIONS AND INFORMATION CENTER;CTTIC INFORMATION TECH NATIONAL ENGINEERING LABORATORY CO LTD

title_en: Early warning method for image information recovery and lane keeping of severe foggy roads
abstract_en: A method for recovering road information in severe fog days and keeping lane early warning belongs to the technical field of intelligent vehicle safety auxiliary driving. The method comprises the steps of constructing a fog day image classifier, different fog concentration classifiers, a faint yellow fog image recovery model based on a three-primary-color superposition principle, a road information recovery model based on a color migration method, obtaining clear road information recovery images aiming at different fog day types in real time, realizing a visual enhancement effect, constructing a vehicle position detection model in a lane, and judging whether to provide visual and auditory early warning for a driver by utilizing the direction parameters of the vehicle in the lane and the position of the vehicle in the lane. The method can recover the road environment visual information under the condition of low visibility in the foggy days, and solves the problems that the existing automobile fog lamp has limited irradiation range and blind areas in the foggy days, and the driver has inaccurate judgment on the driving environment.

title_en: Alert broadcasting to a plurality of diverse communications devices
abstract_en: A system for the broadcast of alert messages to selected groups of recipients and their communications devices of a plurality of different types and communicating through a plurality of different communications means. Recipient profiles or characteristics are received variously from databases, directories, and communications nodes accessible by the system. These sources are queried for the identification of selectable groups which are then presented to a dispatcher for choosing the recipients. The alert message is then provided to delivery means which employ a plurality of included means each of which is particularly configured to communicate the alert message to a corresponding target device type. A response handler module then receives responses from the target devices for later reporting.

title_en: Three-dimensional power transmission corridor wildfire monitoring and control method and system
abstract_en: A three-dimensional power transmission corridor wildfire monitoring and control system and method. The system comprises: a wildfire trip risk assessment module (110), used to assess a wildfire trip risk in real time when a wildfire is monitored in a power transmission line corridor, and thereby determine whether to issue a wildfire warning; a wildfire online monitoring apparatus point distribution planning module (120), used to generate a deployment plan for wildfire online monitoring apparatuses for the power transmission line, according to the wildfire trip risk, a satellite monitoring blind spot, and an importance level of a power transmission line; and a three-dimensional power transmission corridor wildfire monitoring and warning module (130), which uses a multi-source satellite and unmanned aerial vehicle, and is used to implement three-dimensional power transmission corridor wildfire monitoring according to monitoring by the wildfire online monitoring apparatuses installed according to the deployment plan, monitoring by the multi-source satellite, and patrol by the unmanned aerial vehicle. By means of the described system, wildfire warning accuracy for a power transmission corridor can be improved; problems when deploying monitoring apparatuses, such as redundancy in apparatuses and low use efficiency, can be solved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Leveraging an embedded subscriber identity module and sensor data for near real-time event detection and alerting
abstract_en: Aspects herein capture methods, media, devices, and systems for a device having an embedded Subscriber Identity Module (eSIM), wherein the device can leverage sensors, networks, and machine learning capabilities to identify a behavioral pattern of a user of the device and to identify a deviation from that pattern based on a qualifying event. Based on identifying a deviation from that pattern, the device may initiate an action based on that deviation, and the action may include communicating an alert that the deviation might be associated with a hazardous condition or event. The device may alert a user of the hazardous condition or event by communicating the alert in a mode that is sensible to the user, based on the user preferences that define the accessibility setting that is specific to the physical characteristics of the user. Such modes may include audible, haptic, or optical presentations of the alert.

title_en: Vehicle security system, blind area monitoring method and device
abstract_en: Present disclose provides a kind of Vehicle security system, blind area monitoring method and device, belong to technical field of vehicle safety.The system includes：Follow-up steering camera device, induction installation, control device and alarming device；The follow-up steering camera device is configured at car body both sides, and the obstacle target for the blind area of the side-view mirror to vehicle carries out IMAQ；The induction installation is used to detect the environment of the blind area of the side-view mirror of the vehicle, is additionally operable to detect the relative position between the obstacle target and the vehicle；The control device is used for the testing result according to the induction installation, controls the follow-up steering camera device to carry out IMAQ to the obstacle target in the blind area；The alarming device is configured on the door handle of the vehicle, for sending pre-warning signal.The disclosure can make driver fully understand the running environment of the vehicle, and then can avoid, due to potential safety hazard caused by blind area, improving the security of vehicle.

title_en: Rental method of golf watch
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a golf watch rental method, capable of conveniently renting a golf watch at low costs, which comprises: a consumer terminal, capable of checking a score and ranking stored in a golf watch; a kiosk operated to rent the golf watch; a storage box provided by interlocking with the kiosk; a head office terminal for checking and managing information on the consumer terminal and the kiosk; and a server for storing and operating a variety of information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 골프 시계 대여 방법에 관한 것으로, 앱을 통하여 골프시계 대여에 대한 정보를 입출력할 수 있고, 상기 골프시계에 저장된 점수와 랭킹을 확인할 수 있는 소비자단말기, 골프장 별로 마련되며, 상기 골프시계를 대여할 수 있도록 동작하는 키오스크, 상기 키오스크와 연동되어 마련되며, 내부에 상기 골프시계가 충전, 반납, 고장반납이 가능한 보관함, 앱을 통해서 상기 소비자단말기 및 키오스크의 정보를 확인 및 관리하는 본사단말기, 상기 소비자단말기, 키오스크 및 본사단말기와 연동되어 각종 정보를 저장 및 연산처리하는 서버를 포함하고, 관리자가 상기 본사단말기의 앱을 통하여 골프장 위치와 상기 골프시계의 정보를 등록하는 제 1단계, 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 앱을 다운하여 상기 소비자의 성명, 주민번호, 전화번호, 계좌번호, 소속된 실내·외 골프 연습장을 입력하여 회원가입하고, 상기 소비자가 외국인인 경우 여권 및 신용카드 정보 중에 하나를 입력하여 회원가입하며, 지문, 얼굴, 홍채 중 하나를 포함하는 2차 인증수단을 등록하며, 회원가입 정보와 2차 인증수단 정보가 상기 서버에 저장되는 제 2단계, 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 로그인하는 제 3단계, 상기 소비자가 로그인 입력 횟수를 초과하는 경우 상기 소비자단말기에서 로그인 오류를 선택하면 상기 서버에서 상기 소비자단말기로 로그인할 수 있도록 설정하는 제 4단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 로그인하면, 잔여 이용권 횟수, 이전에 사용했던 상기 골프시계 종류, 골프장 랭킹, 소속된 실내·외 연습장 랭킹, 게임방 생성, 게임방 입장을 확인하는 제 5단계, 상기 제 5단계에서 잔여 이용권 횟수가 부족한 경우, 이용권 결제창을 선택하고 이용권을 결제하고 상기 서버에서 상기 소비자단말기로 이용권 횟수를 추가하는 6단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 상기 골프시계가 배치된 골프장 위치를 선택하는 제 7단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 사용법 및 대여방법 알림을 확인하는 제 8단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 상기 골프시계를 선택하는 제 9단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 예약신청하면, 상기 서버는 해당되는 상기 소비자단말기의 이용권 횟수를 차감하며, 대여정보를 저장하고 해당 골프장의 상기 키오스크로 대여정보를 전달하는 제 10단계, 대여시간 전에 상기 서버에서 상기 소비자단말기로 대여시간 알림과 대여정보를 전달하고, 사용법 및 반납방법을 전달하는 제 11단계, 상기 소비자가 해당 골프장의 상기 키오스크로 대여를 선택하고 2차 인증수단을 인식하는 제 12단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 키오스크로 골프장 위치와 상기 골프시계 정보를 확인하는 제 13단계, 상기 키오스크에 마련된 상기 보관함이 열리고, 상기 소비자가 상기 골프시계를 대여하는 제 14단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 골프시계를 테스트하여 이상여부를 확인하는 제 15단계, 상기 제 15단계에서 상기 골프시계에 이상이 발생하는 경우 상기 소비자가 상기 키오스크를 통해 고장반납을 선택하고 2차 인증수단을 인식하는 제 16단계, 상기 보관함이 열리고, 상기 소비자가 상기 키오스크를 통해 오염, 분실, 도난, 파손, 침수 중에 하나를 선택하여 상기 골프시계를 상기 보관함에 반납하는 제 17단계, 다른 상기 보관함이 열리고 상기 소비자가 대체기기를 대여하는 제 18단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 골프시계를 사용하는 제 19단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 골프시계를 사용하는 중에 상기 골프시계에서 이상이 발생하는 경우 상기 제 16단계로 돌아가는 제 20단계, 대여시간 종료 전에 상기 서버에서 상기 소비자단말기로 대여시간 종료 알림을 전달하는 제 21단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 골프시계를 테스트하여 이상여부를 확인하는 제 22단계, 상기 제 22단계에서 상기 골프시계가 이상이 없는 경우, 상기 소비자가 상기 키오스크로 반납을 선택하고 2차 인증수단을 인식하여 상기 보관함을 열고 상기 골프시계를 충전연결하여 상기 골프시계를 반납하는 제 23단계, 상기 제 22단계에서 상기 골프시계에 이상이 발생하는 경우 상기 제 16단계로 돌아가는 제 24단계, 상기 제 23단계에서 상기 골프시계가 미반납되는 경우 상기 서버에서 확인된 불출 시간 이후에 주기적으로 상기 소비자단말기로 미반납 알림을 전달하며, 이용권 횟수를 차감하는 제 25단계, 상기 제 25단계에서 보유 이용권 횟수가 부족한 경우 상기 서버에서 상기 소비자단말기로 비용을 청구하거나 이용권 구매를 요청하고 반납예정 및 분실 중 미반납 사유를 선택하도록 하는 제 26단계, 상기 제 26단계에서 상기 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 반납예정을 선택하는 경우, 반납될 때까지 이용권 횟수를 차감하고 상기 제 22단계로 돌아가는 제 27단계, 상기 제 26단계에서 상기 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 분실을 선택하는 경우 상기 서버에서 상기 소비자단말기로 분실 비용에 대한 알림을 전달하는 제 28단계, 상기 제 26단계에서 상기 소비자가 미반납 사유를 선택하지 않고 상기 골프시계가 미반납되는 경우, 상기 서버에서 회원가입된 정보를 바탕으로 도난처리 및 신고하는 제 29단계로 구성되며, 상기 제 23단계에서 상기 골프시계의 (대여횟수/제품수명사이클)*100의 값이 90 이상인 경우 상기 서버에서 상기 본사단말기로 배터리 교환의 알림을 전달하는 제 30단계로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: JEONG MIN WOO;JUNG IL GUON;SON HYEOK JIN

title_en: System for notificating sensor detection information for the deaf and hard of hearing
title_ko: 청각장애인과 난청인을 위한 센서 감지 정보 알림 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 청각장애인과 난청인을 위한 센서 감지 정보 알림 시스템에 관한 것으로, 해결하고자 하는 과제는 청각장애인이나 난청인이 댁내 또는 댁외에서 각종 알림이나 경고정보를 그 상황에 맞게 시각적 및 청각적으로 식별이 가능하도록 구분하여 보다 쉽고 직관적으로 알리는데 있다. 
일례로, 댁내 설치되고, 세대 호출, 출입 상태, 도어 상태, 화재, 가스 누출 및 장치 이상 감지 중 적어도 하나를 수행하는 적어도 하나의 센서를 포함하고, 각 센서식별정보를 포함하는 감지신호를 출력하는 센서부; 댁내 설치되고, 상기 감지신호에 따른 센서감지정보를 시각적신호 및 청각적 신호 중 적어도 하나로 출력하여 외부로 알리는 센서감지정보 알림부; 댁내 설치되고, 상기 센서부로부터 상기 감지신호를 입력 받아 외부 서버와 상기 센서감지정보 알림부 중 적어도 하나로 전송하는 센서 통신부; 및 휴대통신단말에 설치되고, 외부 서버를 통해 상기 감지신호를 수신하고, 수신된 상기 감지신호에 따른 센서감지정보를 제공 및 관리하는 센서감지정보 관리부를 포함하는 청각장애인과 난청인을 위한 센서 감지 정보 알림 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Pipeline natural gas leakage data acquisition device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipeline natural gas leakage data acquisition device, including the protection casing, protection casing rear is equipped with the gum, protection casing rear is equipped with the installation base, it has the arc recess to open on the installation base, it has fixed mounting groove to open in the arc recess, install the permanent magnet piece in the fixed mounting groove, it has a set of relative ventilation hole to open on the protection casing, a set of relative ventilation hole is located the protection casing left and right sides respectively, be equipped with touch display screen on the protection casing, be equipped with on the protection casing and reveal monitoring alarm mechanism. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that, the installation is simple and convenient, and the accessible gum is direct to be pasted on the wall, also can adsorb on natural gas line through installation base magnetic connection, and the warning is timely, and the reaction is sensitive, sends alarm signal to user's cell-phone through wireless communication module, in time reminds the user, avoids causing loss of property.

title_en: Intelligent switch cabinet foreign matter detection early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent switch cabinet foreign matter detection and early warning device, which comprises: the intelligent electronic device comprises a rectangular insulating shell, an information acquisition module, an information processing module, a power module, a wireless communication module, an audible and visual alarm module and a compensation illumination lamp, wherein the information processing module and the wireless communication module are integrated on a core circuit board, the core circuit board is arranged inside the rectangular insulating shell, and the information acquisition module, the power module, the audible and visual alarm module and the compensation illumination lamp are electrically connected to the core circuit board through wires. According to the intelligent switch cabinet foreign matter detection early warning device, foreign matters intruding into the switch cabinet can be automatically detected, detection data are uploaded to the service terminal through the wireless communication module, and an alarm is sent out through the audible and visual alarm module to remind a worker of processing when abnormality is detected, so that the operation reliability of the switch cabinet is improved. Meanwhile, the utility model considers the influence of the detection blind area, improves the efficiency of detecting the foreign matters of the switch cabinet, and reduces the workload of maintenance personnel.

title_en: Automobile driving safety assisting method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automobile driving safety auxiliary method and system, and the technical scheme is as follows: the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining the coming information of a coming vehicle behind and beside an automobile and behind the automobile closest to the automobile; the coming vehicle information comprises distance information of the coming vehicle behind and the vehicle, relative speed information of the coming vehicle behind and the vehicle, and transverse position information of the coming vehicle behind and the vehicle; acquiring image information in front of the automobile to obtain corresponding video information; determining the collision time of the rear coming vehicle and the automobile according to the coming vehicle information; if the collision time is less than the preset time, sending collision early warning, overlapping the incoming vehicle information on the video information to generate corresponding overlapped video information, and displaying and storing the overlapped video information; if the collision time is not less than the preset time, storing the video information; this application has the advantage that whether there is the barrier in the convenient detection car blind area within range.

title_en: Power transmission line external hidden danger early warning system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The power transmission line external hidden danger early warning system and method based on artificial intelligence comprise front-end equipment and a monitoring substation host which are installed on a high-voltage power transmission line tower pole, wherein the front-end equipment is connected with the monitoring substation host, the monitoring substation host is in communication connection with a remote background monitoring system, and the monitoring substation host and the background monitoring system are connected with a neural network module. And the foreign matter detection is carried out by utilizing the lightweight network deployed in the core processing operation module, and different warning information is sent to the mobile terminal, the monitoring substation host and the warning device of the front-end equipment according to the foreign matter detection condition of the background monitoring system. The core processing operation module and the video server in the background monitoring system are all provided with intelligent detection algorithms for intelligently detecting external hidden dangers, so that two defense lines for detecting the external hidden dangers are formed, the external hidden dangers can be timely and quickly found, meanwhile, the false detection and the missing detection caused by a single intelligent detection algorithm are effectively reduced, and the efficiency and the accuracy rate of automatic monitoring are improved.
assignees: SHANDONG HEDUI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent voice response system and method for weather disaster early warning information
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent voice response system and method for weather disaster early warning information, which relate to the technical field of the release of the weather disaster early warning information and currently propose the following scheme, wherein the intelligent voice response system comprises an intelligent voice response Web front end for early warning information and is used for being responsible for the interactive operation of users; the intelligent voice call Web back end of the early warning information is used for being responsible for audience user management, call result inquiry, call policy configuration and early warning information message generation and pushing; the intelligent voice call terminal is used for carrying out audio generation and multi-line Cheng Yuyin outbound according to the pre-alarm text content. Before the occurrence of disastrous weather, intelligent voice response of early warning information is carried out for government decision-making layers, emergency contacts of related departments and emergency responsibilities of enterprises, the problems that the traditional early warning information mobile phone short message has low accessibility for audience users, lacks interaction, is unknown in conveying effect, has poor effectiveness of manual telephone call and the like are solved, and the intelligent voice response method is beneficial to supporting the related departments to timely develop disaster defense.
assignees: NINGXIA HUI AUTONOMOUS REGION METEOROLOGICAL SERVICE CENTER NINGXIA PROFESSIONAL METEOROLOGICAL FILM

title_en: Wireless relay module for remote monitoring systems having alarm and display functionality
abstract_en: Wireless relay modules for enabling alarm recognition and alerts in networked communications between a series of medical devices and a remote monitoring device via wireless relay networks and/or internet-accessible wireless communications networks. The wireless relay module including a receiver, a first transmitter coupled to the wireless relay network, a second transmitter coupled to the internet-accessible wireless communication network, a controller and a display. The controller identifying if received medical device data from the medical device includes an alarm condition and causing the display to display an alert accordingly. The wireless relay module may additionally include a speaker alone or in combination with a microphone for providing an audible alert of the alarm condition and verbal communication between a local healthcare provider and a clinician at the remote monitoring device.

title_en: Emergency notification, activity notification, and suspicious movement detection for mobile devices
abstract_en: Foreign emergency notification, activity notification, and suspicious movement detection for mobile devices are disclosed. An application running on a mobile device of a user may be used to automatically detect when a call is made to emergency services in a foreign country, when an issue or unpermitted behavior may be occurring, when the mobile device has moved to an anomalous or unpermitted location and/or is moving with an unexpected speed, etc. The application then notifies family members and/or other contacts in the user's home country via a domestic carrier network. An over-the-top Internet Protocol (IP) message can be sent by the application on the mobile device back to the home network core.

title_en: Distributed healthcare communication system
abstract_en: A graphical audio station of a nurse call system is operable to permit a user to perform one or more of the following functions: establish a two-way voice communication link with another computer device in another patient and/or with a another computer device located in another staff work area and/or with a wireless communication device carried by caregiver and/or with a telephone of the healthcare facility; broadcast a voice page to a group of other selected computer devices; compose and send a text message to a portable device that is carried by a caregiver and that has wireless communication capability; browse web pages and/or view multimedia content, such as videos, hosted on servers of the healthcare facility and/or that are accessible via the Internet; view and/or acknowledge and/or answer and/or cancel alerts or nurse calls originating in a plurality of patient rooms.
assignees: SCHUMAN RICHARD J;GLIDEWELL PATRICIA A;ROEHL ERIK E;HILL ROM SERVICES INC

title_en: Signal processing system and methods for reliably detecting audible alarms
abstract_en: A signal processing system and associated methods are disclosed for reliably detecting audible alert signals, such as Temporal-3 (or Code-3) and Temporal-4 (or Code-4) alert signals generated by commercially available smoke, fire, and carbon monoxide detectors. The system and methods are capable of detecting audible alert signals of different intensities in the presence of dynamic background environment (e.g., television programming, music, noise, and the like). The system and methods are capable of detecting audible alert signals generated by far away smoke, fire, and carbon monoxide detectors. The signal processing system and methods may, in some embodiments, be incorporated into a bedside or other unit that generates a supplemental alert signal capable of alerting individuals who might not otherwise respond to the alarm condition, such as individuals who are asleep, children, hearing impaired, or intoxicated.

title_en: Intelligent steering wheel overtaking reminding method, device and equipment and reading and storing medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent steering wheel overtaking reminding method, device, equipment and a reading and storing medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting obstacles in a blind area behind the target vehicle; sending out an alarm signal according to the relative position between the obstacle and the target vehicle; according to the receipt relative position information among the alarm signal orders about the left side and/or the right side region of intelligent steering wheel send vibration and report an emergency and ask for help or increased vigilance to suggestion left side and/or right side direction incoming car, can survey the blind area of rear left and right sides at the in-process that target vehicle goes, in other vehicle entering target vehicle's blind area scope, send the warning suggestion through lamp area and the vibrator of installing on vehicle steering wheel, can solve the driver because of watching outer rear-view mirror, the sight breaks away from the road surface of driving, and then the problem of influence driver's attention, the effectual potential safety hazard of causing because of the attention is not concentrated of having avoided driving in-process.

title_en: Z-Wave-based air suction type smoke sensing detection early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Z-Wave-based air suction type smoke sensing detection early warning system which comprises a sampling detection unit, a dynamic analysis unit and a linkage execution unit, wherein the sampling detection unit is used for extracting air samples of a monitoring area through a multipath air suction pipeline, generating smoke particle concentration data through a laser scattering sensor, the dynamic analysis unit is used for receiving the smoke particle concentration data based on a Z-Wave protocol and generating early warning signals in a grading mode according to concentration gradient changes and a preset threshold value, and the linkage execution unit is used for mapping the early warning signals to Z-Wave network equipment and driving a ventilation system, a spraying device and an alarm to execute grading response actions. Through initiative inspiration sampling and Z-Wave wireless networking deployment, the early smog detection of a large scale non-blind area is realized, and the timeliness, the accuracy and the cooperativity of emergency treatment of fire disaster early warning are obviously improved by combining concentration gradient intelligent analysis and equipment grading linkage response.

title_en: Fire-warning band for hearing-impaired
abstract_en: Fire, one of the most common emergencies in a typical building, often makes a fire alarm bell ring to evacuate people in the entire building if it is not in a fire zone. In the case of a building that employs a hearing-impaired person, it is inevitable that the evacuation will be delayed because the hearing-impaired person cannot hear the sound of the fire alarm bell. When a fire signal is detected or a central control room activates a fire alarm, the signal is sent to a wirelessly connected band with the fire alarm to vibrate a band. Therefore, the present invention provides technology to announce an emergency situation through vibration of a band. A fire-warning band includes a wireless communication module, a smoke detection sensor, a vibration module, a flashing lamp and a band part.

title_en: Speech to Text System and Data Extraction for Emergency Responders
abstract_en: An emergency response communications system may identify verbal communications from a controller to first responders, then perform a speech to text conversion of the communications. From the speech to text conversion, certain parameters about the emergency situation may be extracted and used in several forms. One form may be to provide text-based alerts on signage, text-based messaging such as SMS or email messages, and to feed data into other computer-based systems, such as an incident management system. During the emergency, subsequent communications from the controller to the first responders may be captured and analyzed to identify changes to the situation, and those changes may be highlighted to the downstream consumers of the emergency information. A typical use case may be for airport emergency situations where an air traffic controller may dispatch ground-based emergency personnel in response to an inbound emergency aircraft.

title_en: Wearable system for detection of environmental hazards
abstract_en: The disclosed wearable device systems include several features for alerting and guiding persons who are approaching or near to potentially hazardous or high-risk conditions in their nearby environment. Sensor data from wearable devices (also referred to herein as “wearables”) are used to determine the presence of various unsafe environmental conditions and phenomenon, including dangerous terrain or other unusual conditions. The wearable would be used to warn a person, for example via auditory or haptic-based feedback, if the person is about to encounter an unsafe condition. In particular, the proposed systems can be of great benefit to the visually impaired, those persons with physical disabilities, or persons otherwise vulnerable to particular environmental conditions.

title_en: Mining wireless network processing method, communication device and base station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining network communication, in particular to a mining wireless network processing method, a communication device and a base station, wherein a communication link is established according to the priority of a plurality of accessible network protocol types by detecting and accessing the plurality of network protocol types, on one hand, the dual-wireless technology network processing of different wireless communication technologies can be realized, the availability and reliability of a redundant network and a wireless communication network with balanced load can also be realized, on the other hand, the transmission path of a data packet can be timely regulated and switched when the data packet is transmitted, so that the safety and the stability of the data packet in the data transmission and the transmission process are fully ensured, the data packet is further applied to the mining wireless network processing communication device and the base station, and in a mine operation scene, the information transmission in a mine and outside the mine can be met, the sustainable and stable interconnection and intercommunication capability can be established for safety comprehensive linkage early warning, and the potential safety hazard is reduced to the minimum or zero accident.

title_en: Soil body infiltration early warning device for geotechnical engineering

title_en: Voice fingerprinting system for detecting hoax emergency reports
abstract_en: The data capture system, coupled to the emergency response system, captures speech utterances from incoming callers and uses those utterances to construct embeddings representing the captured speech utterances, the embeddings collectively representing a latent vector space and being stored in a data store within computer readable media. The query system communicates with the data store and provides an interface accessible to the call center operators that alerts a call center operator—substantially while an incoming emergency call is being received—the number of times a voice print substantially matching that of the incoming caller has been heard by the emergency response system before, or other useful metadata such as dispositions of past calls with substantial matches of the caller's voice.

title_en: AI algorithm blind area early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an AI algorithm blind area early warning method. The invention comprises the following steps: s1, image acquisition and input: s2, detecting an image of a target object in a dead zone area of the road to be early-warned; s3, image tracking of the target object in the early warning area; s4, drawing a line parallel to the early warning area to determine a direction L1; s5, drawing an early warning area determining area m; s6, determining the moving direction L2 of the target object; s7, calculating an included angle theta between the L1 and the L2, and judging whether the included angle theta is larger than a threshold C or not; s8, if the target object passes through the early warning blind area, judging whether the target object is far away in the area m of the current early warning area or near to the target object in the area m of the current early warning area: the approach or the separation of the target object can be judged by comparing the position change of the target object in continuous frames; if the threshold value of the object approaching or separating in the early warning area reaches the early warning value, an early warning signal is sent; s9, outputting a result.

title_en: Transformer substation operation safety management and control system based on computer vision locating technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a transformer substation operation safety management and control system based on a computer vision locating technology. title_en: Collision early warning method, system and storage medium

title_ko: 청각장애인을 위한 실외 재난 알림 신호 전달 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for delivering outdoor disaster notification signals for hearing-impaired people. The method comprises: a step in which a disaster management server obtains surrounding state data of the disaster management server; a step in which the disaster management server determines whether a disaster has occurred in an outdoor space where the disaster management server is located based on the surrounding state data; a step in which the disaster management server generates, when it is determined that a disaster has occurred, a disaster occurrence signal indicating that a disaster has occurred; a step in which the disaster management server outputs the disaster occurrence signal; a step in which a user terminal located around the disaster management server detects the disaster occurrence signal; and a step in which the user terminal outputs, when the disaster occurrence signal is detected, a disaster notification signal to inform a user of the user terminal that a disaster has occurred. Here, the disaster occurrence signal is output as an audio signal, and the disaster notification signal is output as a vibration or text. Accordingly, it is possible to effectively notify hearing-impaired people that a disaster has occurred.
abstract_ko: 청각장애인을 위한 실외 재난알림 신호 전달 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로, 재난관리서버에서 재난관리서버의 주변 상태 데이터를 획득하고, 주변 상태 데이터에 기초하여 재난관리서버가 위치하는 실외공간에서 재난이 발생하였는지를 결정하고, 재난이 발생하였다고 결정한 경우 재난이 발생하였음을 나타내는 재난발생신호를 생성하고, 재난발생신호를 출력하고, 재난관리서버 주변에 위치하는 사용자 단말에서 재난발생신호를 감지하고, 재난발생신호를 감지한 경우 사용자 단말의 사용자에게 재난이 발생하였음을 알리는 재난알림신호를 출력하고, 여기에서 재난발생신호는 오디오 신호로 출력되고, 재난알림신호는 진동 또는 문자로 출력됨으로써, 청각장애인에게 재난이 발생하였음을 효과적으로 알릴 수 있다.

title_en: Information issuing system based on big-dipper satellite and short-distance wireless communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses the information issuing systems based on big-dipper satellite and short-distance wireless communication, including big-dipper satellite, warning information distribution platform, Beidou warning information receive central node, multiple Beidou warning information receive child node；The warning information distribution platform and Beidou satellite communication；Beidou warning information receives central node and Beidou satellite communication；Beidou warning information receives central node and multiple Beidou warning information receive child node and are connected in Small Area Wireless Communication Networks；Beidou warning information receives central node and Beidou warning information receives child node and forms tree network structure, wherein it is root node that Beidou warning information, which receives central node, receives child node by each Beidou warning information and extends tree network structure downwards.The warning information received by big-dipper satellite is forwarded by the present invention in residential area through wireless communication, and user not will increase excessive use cost while reducing communication blind district.

title_en: Device and method for monitoring mountain tourist attraction based on radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster early warning equipment, and provides equipment and a method for monitoring mountain tourist attractions based on radar, wherein the equipment comprises a support column, a spherical shell and related components; the support column is anchored in the slope bedrock and provided with a first blind hole, and a first negative pressure pipe and a negative pressure rod are connected inside the support column; the spherical shell consists of a hemispherical base and a cover body, and a sealing ring is arranged at the joint. The outer side of the base is provided with a limit column which is inserted into the first blind hole and is provided with a through hole and a one-way valve which are connected with the second negative pressure pipe; the equipment is internally provided with a lifting component, radar equipment, a GPS positioning module, a wireless communication module, a power supply and a central controller; the central controller is connected with each module to realize the monitoring function. The invention can monitor the condition of mountain tourist attractions by radar technology, and transmit data by wireless communication, and has higher reliability and stability.

title_en: Indicator device for guiding evacuation
title_ko: 화재 또는 비상시에 안전하게 피난할 수 있는 기능성 피난구 유도지시장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation guide indicating device capable of indicating an escape route in case of fire and emergency. An objective of the present invention is to provide a functional evacuation guide indicating device that can be installed to protrude from an installation wall at a crossing part, has excellent brightness in case of fire, forms an indicator light, and makes it easy to evacuate by displaying text and evacuation instruction display with voice and laser beam to indicate a doorway or an emergency exit in case of fire. The evacuation exit guide indicating light for indicating a guide sign that can enable people to escape in case of fire or emergency comprises: a main body part; an upper plate support frame having a guide rail groove capable of fixing a display panel on the upper part of the main body part; a lower plate support frame having a guide rail groove capable of fixing a display panel at the lower part of the main body part; a control unit controlling a power supply unit of an external power source or/and an internal rechargeable battery unit; an LED lamp providing light with the power source; a speaker providing notification of an announcement and an emergency state; and a wall fixing plate with a hook for fixing to a wall or pillar. The present invention has the effect of providing an efficient guide during emergency evacuation and evacuation to an evacuation exit. In addition, the present invention prioritizes evacuation in case of fire or emergency. In particular, the present invention is a very useful invention that provides a voice service that can guide people by voice when it is difficult to secure a visual field due to smoke, such as a blind person.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재시 비상시에 탈출경로를 알려주도록 한 피난유도지시장치에 관한 것으로 교차하는 부분에 설치 벽면으로부터 돌출되도록 설치할 수 있으면서 화재시에 휘도도 뛰어나 유도등의 형성하고, 화재시에 출입구나 비상구를 알리는 음성과, 레이저빔으로 문자, 피난지시표시를 나타나게 하여 대피가 용이하도록 한 기능성 피난유도 지시장치를 얻기 위한 것이 바, 화재 또는 비상시 탈출할 수 있는 안내표시가 나타내도록 한 피난구 유도지시등에 있어서, 본체부; 상기 본체부의 상부에는 표시판을 고정할 수 있는 가이드레일홈이 형성된 상판지지프레임; 상기 본체부의 하부에는 표시판을 고정할 수 있는 가이드레일홈이 형성된 하판지지프레임; 상기 외부전원의 전원공급부 또는/및 내부충전지부를 제어하는 제어부; 상기 전원으로 불빛을 제공하는 엘이디램프; 상기 안내멘트와 비상상태의 알림을 제공하는 스피커; 상기 벽체 또는 기둥에 고정하기 위한 걸이구가 형성된 벽체고정판;으로 이루어짐으로 서, 비상탈출과 피난구로 대피시에 효율적을 안내가 이루어지는 효과가 있으며, 또한, 화재시, 비상상태 등에서 피난을 최우선적으로 하도록 하고, 특히, 시각장애인 등, 연기로 인한 시야 확보가 어려운 경우에 음성으로 안내해줄 수 있는 음성서비스를 제공하는 매우 유용한 발명인 것이다.

title_en: Smartphone-based portable emergency pager equipped with emergency medicine storage box and emergency call method using the same
title_ko: 응급약보관함이 구비된 스마트폰 기반의 휴대용 응급비상호출기 및 그를 이용한 응급비상호출 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a smartphone-based portable emergency pager equipped with an emergency medicine storage box, and an emergency call method using the same, wherein the emergency pager is linked to a smartphone and allows users to request assistance through emergency calls to acquaintances, public officials in public institutions or fire stations through the smartphone without separate equipment like repeaters or gateways. Provided is a portable emergency pager (100), which includes: an emergency medicine storage box (180) which has upper and lower surfaces each formed in a semicircular shape, and is configured to store emergency medicine at the bottom thereof; a volume output unit (110) for producing a warning sound, a call button (120) for emergency calls, and a call cancel button (140) for call cancel which are configured to be exposed to a front cover (101) of the portable emergency pager (100); and a charging indication LED (160) for notifying the charging status and a charging port (170) which are configured to be located on the side of the portable emergency call device (100). The portable emergency call device (100) is paired with a smartphone via Bluetooth, and when the call button (120) for emergency calls is pressed, the device is configured to sound a warning sound through the volume output unit (110) and transmit the GPS information of the paired smartphone to a plurality of pre-set contacts to request rescue.

title_en: Battery interconnected alert device system with vibrational alert
abstract_en: Disclosed is a battery interconnected detection and alert device system with building structure vibrational alert. The system includes of one or more alert devices wired into a dedicated circuit with a single location housing a DC power backup source, such as a rechargeable DC battery. The DC power backup source may be replaceable or rechargeable with DC current from an AC-DC transformer-rectifier, a photovoltaic cell, or other means. An electrical relay within the system provides a current to the dedicated circuit by selecting between the line-voltage alternating current source and the DC power backup. When activated, the detection and alert device generates a distinctive pulsed vibrational alert transmitted through the building structure to beds and other furniture resting on the floor, and additionally transmitted through the air as pressure waves which are perceived by hearing-impaired and other persons alerting them to a possible emergency situation.

title_en: Intelligent control system and method of accumulator chamber intelligent ventilation device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent control system and a method of an accumulator chamber intelligent ventilation device. The system is characterized in that a double-position option switch, a power supply indicating lamp, an exhaust button, a fan closing button, an automatic operation indicating lamp, a fan starting indicating lamp, a firefighting indicating lamp and a firefighting warner arranged on a shell; and an intelligent auxiliary system main engine is arranged in the shell, and is respectively connected with the double-position option switch, the power supply indicating lamp, the exhaust button and the fan closing button. title_en: Thermal runaway early warning system for automobile power battery
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automobile power battery thermal runaway early warning system, including battery management system, battery management system includes temperature sensor, the temperature rise record appearance, voltage sensor, the voltage recorder, circuit fault module and insulation fault module, temperature sensor can monitor power battery's temperature and with the data transfer of monitoring to the temperature rise record appearance, voltage sensor can monitor the output voltage in the power battery and with the data transfer of monitoring to the voltage recorder, circuit fault module can carry out the self-checking to the car circuit, insulation fault module can carry out the self-checking to power battery's insulation fault, battery management system accessible circuit and vehicle control unit signal connection. The invention can monitor the temperature rise and the output voltage of the power battery during working through the battery management system, and monitor the line fault of the automobile and the insulation fault of the battery through the line fault module and the insulation fault module, thereby preventing the potential safety hazard caused by the thermal runaway of the power battery of the automobile.

title_en: Method for analyzing and early warning three-span line hidden danger based on dynamic video
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing and early warning three-span line hidden dangers based on dynamic videos, which comprises the steps of collecting video data of a power transmission line; deeply extracting all video monitoring data; the target data is subjected to conditional matching comparison; analyzing and fusing the source data for characteristic problems, formulating and constructing an analysis early warning scheme, and early warning; according to the invention, a dynamic video analysis method is introduced, deformation such as tiny cracks and damages, and spatial hidden dangers such as dynamic foreign matters and vehicles are identified and processed, the early warning is more accurately carried out on abnormal operation conditions, and the hidden dangers are eliminated and treated as early as possible, so that the risk is reduced; by the method, the working efficiency of troubleshooting of the hidden danger of the three-span line is improved, the time required by processing is shortened, and the accuracy of early warning and disposal of the hidden danger is improved; the invention uses a mode of analyzing the image data of the dynamic video frame by frame to replace the manual visual observation, and solves the defect that the data of the edge of the area is missed.

title_en: Earthquake early warning analysis system and method based on intelligent equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake monitoring and early warning, in particular to an earthquake early warning analysis system and method based on intelligent equipment. The system comprises a terminal sensing and initial judging module, a self-adaptive network transmission module, an edge aggregation and verification module, a cloud control fusion and calculation module, a high-precision positioning and shock level calculation module and a final early warning instruction issuing module, wherein the terminal sensing and initial judging module collects data through a sensor array, utilizes a dynamic weight adjustment model to identify P wave characteristics and generate encrypted initial alarms, the self-adaptive network transmission module is used for constructing a dynamic self-organizing network based on a D2D protocol, and realizing multi-hop relay transmission of the alarms through electing relay nodes, the edge aggregation and verification module is used for performing space-time matching and cross verification on a plurality of alarms in a specific area, judging event authenticity and generating hierarchical early warning information, and the cloud control fusion and calculation module is used for fusing the event data of the area and professional bench network data. According to the invention, a high-density sensing network is constructed by utilizing mass intelligent equipment, so that the early warning blind area is effectively eliminated, and the earthquake early warning with rapider, more accuracy and more robustness is realized.

abstract_en: The invention provides an energy blasting physical risk handling-public emotion regulation and control cooperative method and platform, which comprise the steps of preprocessing edge layer real-time data by utilizing a risk analysis and early warning prevention and control unit, establishing a gas blasting risk database, constructing a standardized cloud database by utilizing an online increment learning unit based on multi-source multi-mode data, realizing batch automatic preprocessing, storage and calling of data, achieving the purposes of improving calculation efficiency and reducing human operation amount, crawling related accident news and public opinion by utilizing an emotion learning and analysis unit, combining a digital twin body with an emotion analysis process based on emotion prediction and intervention, and realizing public emotion prediction, staged psychological support and resource scheduling. The method solves the technical problem that the emergency response has a decision blind area due to the fact that physical risk early warning and emotion evolution analysis cannot be dynamically associated.

title_en: Air conditioning outdoor unit clean notification device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cleaning notification device for an air conditioner outdoor unit, which is installed with a nozzle installation duct (30) having a plurality of injection nozzles (32) in a cooling pin seating plane of the air conditioner outdoor unit (20), wherein the nozzle installation duct (30) is connected to an air compressor (10) by a connection pipe (40) as an intermediation. Therefore, it is possible to prevent a foreign substance from being attached by ejecting compressed air generated in the air compressor (10) on the cooling pin of the outdoor unit (20). Therefore, the cooling performance degradation of the air-conditioner due to the adhesion of the foreign substance of the condenser cooling pin of the outdoor unit (20) can be prevented. The energy efficiency of the air-conditioner is improved.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른 에어컨과 관련된 화재는 주로 외부에 설치된 실외기에서 발생하고 있다. 주요 원인은 장시간 사용에 따른 실외기 내부 모터나 전자부품의 과부하, 실외기의 소음을 차단하기 위해 밀폐된 구조의 장소에 설치해 실외기 작동 시 발생한 열을 외부로 방출하지 못해 열이 축적된 경우, 에어컨 설치 시 연결배선의 접촉 또는 절연 불량에 의해서 발생하는 것으로 나타났다. 본 발명의 이러한 목적은 특히 영업집처럼 에어컨을 장시간 사용하는 업소는 점검을 해야 하다. 첫 번째 증상으로 에어컨 찬바람이 안 나오는 경우도 번째 에어컨이 다운되는 경우 세번재 실외기 가 과열이 되는 경우 등으로 에어컨실외기가 햇빛에 노출이 되어있다던가 1층 도로 번에 있는 경우 밀폐된 창고 나 여러 대 에어컨실외기가 함께 있는 경우는 점검하여 에에컨 실외기청소를 해주는 것이 좋다. 미리 점검하여 화재로부터 중용한 재산을 보호하자 
본 발명은 에어컨 실외기 청소 알림 장치에 관한 것으로, 에어컨 실외기(20)의 냉각핀 설치 면에 다수의 분사노즐(32)을 구비한 노즐설치 관(30)이 설치되고, 상기 노즐설치 관(30)은 연결관(40)을 매개로 공기압축기(10)에 연결된다. 
따라서, 상기 공기압축기(10)에서 생성된 압축공기를 실외기(20)의 냉각핀에 분사하여 이물질의 부착을 방지하고, 이미 부착된 이물질을 제거할 수 있다. 
따라서, 실외기(20)의 응축기 냉각핀의 이물질 부착으로 인한 에어컨의 냉방성능 저하를 방지할 수 있고, 에어컨의 에너지 효율이 향상된다. 
선풍기 화재는 모터가 가열돼 먼지에 불이 붙는 경우나 날개에 의류가 끼어 모터가 과부하 돼 발생하는 것이 대부분이다. 
냉방기 화재를 예방하기 위해선 청소와 점검이 필수다. 냉방기기를 사용하지 않을 때는 작동을 정지하고, 선풍기 모터 먼지 제거와 선풍기 날개가 헛도는 것을 확인해야 한다. 에어컨은 피복손상 여부를 확인하고 실외기 주변에 물건을 놓지 말아야 한다.  
소방안전본부 우재봉 본부장은 “에어컨의 장시간 사용 시 잠시 작동을 중단해 실외기에서 발생한 열을 식혀줄 수 있도록 해야 한다.”라며 “특히 전력 소비를 줄이는 것은 에어컨 화재예방과 함께 전력수급 비상사태에 대처하는 한 방법이 될 것”이라고 말했다.

title_en: Audio guiding device for the blind
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A sound induction device for the blind is provided to wirelessly transmit a guidance requesting signal according to the standard of the sound induction device for the blind in a fire, and to guide an evacuating method in the corresponding position. CONSTITUTION: A sound induction device for the blind is comprised of the followings: an operation table(112) which contains a control code for the blind guidance, a control code for a fire evacuation guidance, a control code for advertisement, and all kinds of predetermined values for the operation under the control code; a memory(110) which stores blind guidance sound source data, fire evacuation guidance sound source data, and advertisement guidance sound source data; a sound output unit; and a control unit which confirms whether the control code in the received wireless signal is the control code for the blind guidance, the control code for the fire evacuation guidance, or the control code for the advertisement in the operation table, plays the blind guidance sound source data, the fire evacuation guidance sound source data, or the advertisement sound source data according to the confirmation result, and outputs the data to a sound output unit. 본 발명은 화재 발생 시에 시각장애인용 음성유도기의 규격에 따라 시각장애인용 음성유도기에 안내 요청 신호를 무선으로 송출하고, 이에 응하여 시각장애인용 음성유도기가 해당 위치에서의 대피 방법 등을 음성으로 안내할 수 있도록 함으로써 시각장애인 음성유도기의 활용도를 극대화시킬 수 있도록 한 시각장애인 음성유도기용 무선 송신 장치 및 이에 사용되는 시각장애인 음성유도기에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 시각장애인 음성유도기용 무선 송신 장치는 시설물에 고정 설치되어 당해 시설물에 설치된 시각장애인용 음성유도기와 통신하되, 화재감지신호가 입력된 경우에 화재알림용 제어 코드를 발생시키는 명령 코딩부 및 상기 명령 코딩부에 의해 발생된 상기 화재알림용 제어 코드를 시각장애인용 음성유도기의 캐리어 주파수에 실어서 출력하는 RF 송신부를 포함하여 이루어진다. 
전술한 구성에서, 상기 화재감지신호는 시설물에 설치된 소화전의 경종에 공급되는 직류전원이거나 시설물에 설치된 화재 감지기로부터의 화재 감지 신호인 것을 특징으로 한다. 
화재를 감지하는 연 감지기 또는 열 감지기를 더 구비하고, 상기 화재감지신호는 상기 연 감지기 또는 상기 열 감지기로부터 입력될 수도 있다.

title_en: Intelligent testing and warning system for obstruction of air filtering case of large-scale air cooling generator
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent detection alarm system for the jam of the air filter box of large air-cooled generator. The present product has the defects that the filter box can be jammed by dust and foreign matters, so that the pressure difference between the inside and the outside is increased, the air supplement volume is decreased, and the cooling effect of the generator turns poor. The alarm system of the invention includes a dynamic sampling probe (1), which is connected with a negative pressure chamber of a micro differential pressure transmitter(5), the micro differential pressure transmitter is connected with a DC power supply (6). The micro differential pressure transmitter changes the differential pressure between a positive pressure chamber and the negative pressure chamber into a linear standard current signal, and inputs the standard current signal representing the amount of the differential pressure into an intelligent control unit (7) through a circuit. The intelligent control unit quantifies the standard current signal into a digital signal, compares the digital signal with a set value and sends off an alarm signal, and prompts a watcher to replace the filtering sponge and the desiccant material timely so as to avoid machine halt and other major accidents. The product of the invention is an intelligent jam detecting and alarming device used in the air filter box of large air-cooled generator.

title_en: Rubber vibration isolating and absorbing device for building
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rubber vibration isolating and absorbing device for a building, belonging to the field of anti-seismic facilities of buildings. The design consists of an inner supporting column, an outer guard body, an upper supporting seat, a lower supporting seat and a warning system, wherein the inner supporting column has an integrated structure consisting of special rubber and an elastic spring so as to meet the requirements of vertical bearing capacity and compression deformation of the building; when the supporting seats are subjected to large shearing and deformation force generated by earthquake, the arc end surface of the inner supporting column matched with the arc inner bottom surface of the supporting seat can generate corresponding displacement so as to release stress; the outer guard body plays a role in protection around the inner supporting column, so that strong earthquake impact force can be safely released and attenuated; the upper part structure of the building only has slight translational motion, after the earthquake force is eliminated, the inner supporting column returns to the original position, thus avoiding serious damage of the building structure and protecting the safety of human life and property; and the sensor is arranged in a central hole of the inner supporting column, and is connected with a ground display by a warning circuit so as to be capable of displaying the earthquake level.

title_en: Fireproof smoldering-proof temperature monitoring alarm for railway overhaul workshop
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of railway vehicle overhaul safety, in particular to a fireproof smoldering-proof temperature monitoring alarm for a railway overhaul workshop. The monitoring alarm is directly adsorbed on the welding repair part of the train body or the surface of the heating boiler body through the magnetic attraction part, and the heat conduction seat is utilized to rapidly conduct heat to the temperature sensor, so that the non-blind area, continuous and comprehensive temperature monitoring of railway maintenance workshop operation is realized, the dynamic change of the temperature is accurately captured, the early warning is sent out in the smoldering initial stage, the fire accident is effectively avoided, the treatment efficiency of fire hidden danger is improved, and the high-efficiency and reliable guarantee is provided for the maintenance safety of the railway train.

title_en: Motorcycle doubling auxiliary system, control method and motorcycle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a motorcycle doubling auxiliary system and a control method, comprising a host, a detection radar and a prompting device, wherein the host is in communication connection with the detection radar and the prompting device; the detection radar is arranged at the rear part of the motorcycle and is used for detecting obstacles in a preset diameter range behind the motorcycle; the host computer is connected with the detection radar and the prompting device in a communicating mode, and the host computer is used for controlling the prompting device to trigger corresponding warning according to the position of the obstacle detected by the detection radar. The invention can prompt the motorcycle driver in time through the prompting device when the obstacle influencing lane changing exists behind the motorcycle, thereby assisting the motorcycle driver to monitor the blind area, improving the driving safety and eliminating the potential safety hazard of the road. The invention also discloses a motorcycle.

title_en: Battery cell early warning method and device, cloud platform and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a battery cell early warning method and device, a cloud platform and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: respectively acquiring standing self-discharge rates of each cell in a single test cell and a battery to be detected before and after a preset standing time, wherein the single test cell comprises a foreign matter carrying cell and a foreign matter non-carrying cell; and determining the early warning result of the battery cell in the battery to be detected based on the standing self-discharge rate of each battery cell in the battery to be detected and the standing self-discharge rate of the single test battery cell. Through the technical scheme, before the battery flows into the market for use, the battery core of the battery is subjected to early warning analysis based on the standard data so as to obtain an accurate early warning result, the battery is further subjected to after-sale investigation according to the early warning result, and the situation that the battery brings safety hidden danger in the use process due to the introduction of foreign matters is avoided.

title_en: Fan control method, electronic device, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a control method of a fan, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program product, which relate to the technical field of intelligent control, and the control method comprises the steps of actively collecting a real-time capacitance value at a protective net and comparing the real-time capacitance value with a historical capacitance value by adding a capacitance sensing unit at the protective net, determining capacitance change information by combining a control period, further accurately judging the normal, dust early warning and emergency braking states of the fan and implementing corresponding control, realizing active monitoring and intervention prevention on the state of the protective net of the fan by a simple and low-cost structural design, effectively avoiding the problems that dust influences heat dissipation, safety accidents are caused by foreign matters and the like, and finally improving the safety and effectiveness of the operation of the fan and the overall stability and reliability of a system under application scenes such as a server.

title_en: criminal note
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a criminal note capable of solving a problem with the low provision of overall criminal information by enabling a user to conveniently acquire information about crimes and crime-ridden districts located near a residential district and information and positions of sex offenders. The present invention comprises: a server part forming a network system and configuring an exclusive server to transmit criminal information to a smartphone; an emergency module transmitting crime and help messages to acquaintances in an emergency contact list which is basically set; and an information providing part forming a customized information system and a network between the server part and each smartphone application.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 범죄노트 에 관한 것으로서 기존의 인지도가 부족한 관련기관의 범죄정보검색보다는 간편한 접근성으로 자기 주위나 거주지역에 위치한 우범지역과 범죄관련 정보 및 성범죄전과자 위치와 정보를 간편히 취득함으로서 범죄예방률을 높이고 각 개인의 범죄 대처 능률을 높일 수 있음하도록 함으로써 기존의 기존의 범죄정보제공사이트는 개별 정부기관마다 제각기 운영하여 정보의 접근성이 떨어지며 정보의 혼란이 올 수 있으며 종합적인 범죄정보 제공능력이 떨어지는 문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은,  범죄정보제공 사이트에 있어서 스마트폰 어플리케이션에 긴급문자 지역 경찰기관에  발송 및 개별 정부기관에 범죄 정보 수집 및 통합운용와 스마트폰에 범죄정보 발송 할 수 있게 전용서버 구성 및 네트워크 시스템 형성한 서버부, 범죄 위급상황시 비상경보사이렌 울림과 기본설정된 비상전화목록에 지인들에게 범죄및 구조문자 발송 스마트폰 어플리케이션으로 긴급모듈 구성한 긴급모듈, 각 정부기관에서 수집된 범죄 관련 정보 와 자기 거주 지역 주변 전과자 및 우범지역 과 범죄 발생률 그리고 범죄 전후와 관련하여 행동요령과 대처방안에 정보를 구축된 서버에서 각 스마트폰으로 개별 발송 할 수 있게 서버부와 각 스마트폰 어플리케이션 사이에 네트워크를 형성 및 개별 맞춤 정보 체계 구성한 정보제공으로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 기존의 인지도가 부족한 관련기관의 범죄정보검색보다는 간편한 접근성으로 자기 주위나 거주지역에 위치한 우범지역과 범죄관련 정보 및 성범죄전과자 위치와 정보를 간편히 취득함으로서 범죄예방률을 높이고 각 개인의 범죄 대처 능률을 높일 수 있음하도록 함으로써 기존의 기존의 범죄정보제공사이트는 개별 정부기관마다 제각기 운영하여 정보의 접근성이 떨어지며 정보의 혼란이 올 수 있으며 종합적인 범죄정보 제공능력이 떨어지는 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Single female safety guard door stopper
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety guard door stopper for a single female, which solves a breaking problem of an unspecified person using a CCTV blind spot, comprising: an infrared sensor; a beacon in a small chip shape; a circular alarm; an LED indicator including a bulb; and a door stopper formed of a solid bar.
