title_en: Wirelessly Activated Monitored Safety Temperature Sensing Alarm
abstract_en: This Wireless Safety Temperature Sensing Alarm is a thermally actuated alarm designed to send a wireless signal to a remote base which will turn on a buzzer, a visual light signal or an emergency alert system to alert anyone around that a child/person/pet/plant has been left in a confined environment that is experiencing extreme temperatures, whether hot or cold. It can also simply alert someone that a certain device or environment has reached the user defined set point temperature. It consists of 2 units: a base and a remote. The base is easily installed on any kind of carrier or as a standalone fixture, and it is designed to sense the temperature of the environment that the child/person/pet/plant is in and it can trigger a wireless signal on the remote to turn on the buzzer/alarm, and a flashing light for people who are hearing impaired or send an RF signal emergency alert. It's designed with a 10 minute turn-on delay to prevent false alarms upon startup. It also has a low-battery alert as an add-on safety precaution. The remote can be easily carried on or as a standalone device, or is easily installed on the exterior of the confined environment which the child/person/pet/plant is in. This makes it possible for anyone who is nearby to hear/see the alarm and take action. Many lives of children, beloved people, pets, and plants could be saved (and financial loss or wasted time could be prevented) using this easy to install invention. A future development of the product will be able to alert an emergency system in case that human lives are in danger of extreme temperatures.
assignees: TAVOC CLAUDIA ESTERA;Thompson Jason Lee;TAVOC JEREMIAH JESSE

title_en: Battery cell early warning method and device, cloud platform and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a battery cell early warning method, a battery cell early warning device, a cloud platform and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: respectively obtaining static self-discharge rates of all the battery cells in the single test battery cell and the battery to be detected before and after static preset time, wherein the single test battery cell comprises a battery cell carrying foreign matters and a battery cell not carrying the foreign matters; and determining an early warning result of the battery cells in the battery to be detected based on the static self-discharge rate of each battery cell in the battery to be detected and the static self-discharge rate of the battery cells in the single test. Through the technical scheme, before the battery flows into the market for use, the battery core of the battery is subjected to early warning analysis based on standard data so as to obtain an accurate early warning result, and further after-sales investigation is performed on the battery according to the early warning result, so that the potential safety hazard caused by the introduction of foreign matters into the battery in the use process of the battery is avoided.

title_en: Driving Device of Roll Screen with Alarm Device of Safty Connection Loop

abstract_en: Provided is an actuating device used for a roll screen and having an alarm unit for preventing safety accidents due to an actuating string, wherein the actuating device has a pair of roll screen rotation holders to rotate a rotary shaft by pulling the actuating string. The roll screen rotation holder has an actuating string guider with a micro switch of which the push switch is formed in the direction of the actuating string. The push switch and the actuating string have a rotatable push plate therebetween, wherein the push plate pushes the push switch of the micro switch by the pressure of the actuating string, so the micro switch is switched to allow an alarm unit to sound. According to the present invention, the actuating string moving the roll screen or a blind has the alarm unit, thereby preventing the safety accidents by sounding an alarm or in other words, a danger signal when a heavy load is applied to the actuating string.

title_en: Apparatus for calling information for helping the weak

abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency call device for providing position information. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the emergency call device for providing position information is to guide the position of a user by detecting an approach of a user with a lack of cognitive ability or a person who is visually impaired. According to the embodiment of the present invention, the emergency call device for providing position information includes: an RF card detecting unit detecting an RF card in accordance with the approach of the RF card by the user; a communication unit transmitting identification information on the RF card transmitted from the RF card detecting unit to a control center and receiving an authentication result of the RF card by the control center in accordance with the identification information on the RF card; a voice output unit outputting existence notification information on the emergency call device when the RF card is authenticated; and a controller controlling the existence notification information on the emergency call device to be output by the voice output unit in accordance with the authentication result of the RF card.

title_en: Strobe light alarm detection and alert system
abstract_en: A system is disclosed that detects an optical alarm signal, such as a strobe light signal generated by a building alarm system. Upon detecting such a signal, the system generates a supplemental alert signal capable of alerting an individual who might not otherwise respond to the alarm condition, such as an individual who is asleep, hearing impaired, and/or sight impaired. The system may, for example, be implemented as a patient-worn device, a bedside unit, or a personal computer coupled to a light-sensing peripheral device.

The speech synthesis module can covert text into speech, has a simple structure, is easy to connect, and ensures that a disaster early-warning system supports a short message early-warning function.

title_en: Intelligent testing and warning system for obstruction of air filtering case of large-scale air cooling generator
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent detection alarm system for the jam of the air filter box of large air-cooled generator. The present product has the defects that the filter box can be jammed by dust and foreign matters, so that the pressure difference between the inside and the outside is increased, the air supplement volume is decreased, and the cooling effect of the generator turns poor. The alarm system of the invention includes a dynamic sampling probe (1), which is connected with a negative pressure chamber of a micro differential pressure transmitter(5), the micro differential pressure transmitter is connected with a DC power supply (6). The micro differential pressure transmitter changes the differential pressure between a positive pressure chamber and the negative pressure chamber into a linear standard current signal, and inputs the standard current signal representing the amount of the differential pressure into an intelligent control unit (7) through a circuit. The intelligent control unit quantifies the standard current signal into a digital signal, compares the digital signal with a set value and sends off an alarm signal, and prompts a watcher to replace the filtering sponge and the desiccant material timely so as to avoid machine halt and other major accidents. The product of the invention is an intelligent jam detecting and alarming device used in the air filter box of large air-cooled generator.

title_en: Foreign trade is warning sign for commodity circulation vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a warning board for foreign trade logistics vehicles, which comprises a box body and a warning board arranged at the top end of the box body, wherein the top end of the box body is provided with a transversely distributed opening, one end of a rotating rod is fixed at the bottom end of the warning board, and the other end of the rotating rod penetrates through the opening and is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the rear end of the box body through an active rotating shaft; the box body is rotatably connected with the inner wall of the rear end of the box body and comprises a driven rotating shaft which is distributed in parallel with the driving rotating shaft. This foreign trade is warning sign for commodity circulation vehicle, thereby it is rotatory to drive first threaded rod through driving motor work, horizontal reciprocating motion is done to drive bulb and support under the screw thread effect, first threaded rod is rotatory simultaneously can drive the running gear, the intermittent type formula swing is done to initiative pivot and warning sign, thereby reach better striking effect, guarantee that the rear vehicle can in time perceive the place ahead vehicle and break down, the security of equipment when using has been promoted, avoid taking place the potential safety hazard that the vehicle collided each other.

title_en: Community monitoring video motion detection disaster early warning algorithm based on RAFT (reversible addition-fragmentation chain transfer) optical flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a community monitoring video motion detection disaster early warning algorithm based on RAFT optical flow, and belongs to the technical field of disaster early warning. A community surveillance video motion detection disaster early warning algorithm based on RAFT optical flow is characterized in that a surveillance camera video flow is obtained in real time, a RAFT optical flow algorithm is used for calculating motion vectors between two continuous frames in a surveillance video in real time, a RANSAC algorithm is used for filtering motion features inconsistent with a main motion direction to optimize the motion vectors and calculate a homography matrix, translational and rotational motion parameters between two frames of the video are calculated based on the homography matrix, then a Gaussian filter is used for denoising, the denoised motion parameters are accumulated and whether a set threshold value is exceeded or not is judged, and if the motion parameters exceed the set threshold value, a disaster early warning event is output; the dependence on manpower can be reduced, the disaster advance early warning of a certain degree is realized, the emergency plan of community property operation management is convenient to generate, and the life and property safety of residents is guaranteed.
assignees: ZHEJIANG LYUCHENG WEILAI SHUZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Antifreezing and draining drilling device and antifreezing method for side slope in cold region
abstract_en: The invention relates to an antifreezing and draining drilling device and an antifreezing method for a side slope in a cold region, wherein the antifreezing and draining drilling device comprises an anti-radiation layer, a heat preservation layer, a freeze thawing layer, an electric tracing band, a drain pipe, an osmometer, a temperature sensor, a water stop band and a control system, wherein the drain pipe or the plastic blind ditch is arranged in a draining drilling hole, the heat preservation layer is arranged on the lower surface of the anti-radiation layer, the electric tracing band is arranged between the lower surface of the heat preservation layer and the outer surface of the drain pipe, the water stop band is arranged at the interface between the drain pipe at the freeze thawing layer section and the drain pipe at the drain section, the osmometer is arranged on the outer surface of the tail end of the drain pipe at the drain section or the plastic blind ditch, the temperature sensor is arranged on the lower surface of the anti-radiation layer at the outer surface of the heat preservation layer, and a signal wire of the osmometer and a power supply line of the electric tracing band are connected to the control system. According to the invention, the freeze of the drain hole in winter is prevented, the drain hole is prevented from being invalid due to the freeze, the monitoring early warning threshold value is determined according to the sensitivity analysis of the underground water pressure to the slope stability state, and the landslide early warning is carried out.

title_en: Method and device for monitoring hidden danger sources of foreign matter hanging wire of power transmission channel
abstract_en: A method for monitoring hidden danger sources of foreign matter hanging lines in a power transmission channel includes collecting optical satellite remote sensing data of a monitoring area, constructing a sample library of hidden danger sources through marking, utilizing a preset improved GAN network to strengthen the data of the sample library to obtain an enhanced sample library, inputting samples in the enhanced sample library into a semantic segmentation network integrated with an edge information enhancement module for training to obtain a hidden danger source identification model, collecting historical foreign matter hanging line data, meteorological data and electric power information basic data of the monitoring area, constructing a hidden danger source risk assessment model through a semi-quantitative assessment method, extracting hidden danger sources from current optical satellite remote sensing data through the hidden danger source identification model, and carrying out dynamic monitoring and early warning on hidden danger of the foreign matter hanging lines in the power transmission channel through the risk assessment model according to extraction results, current meteorological data and current power transmission line geographic position information. The method can improve pertinence and accuracy of monitoring the hidden danger sources of the foreign matter hanging wire of the power transmission channel.

title_en: The apparatus recognition to operate a every conditions
abstract_en: A situation recognition apparatus for the deaf and persons who are hard of hearing is provided to enable the deaf to recognize the sound by vibration, words, or sign language and to be compatible with the internal devices of a vehicle at low cost. In a situation recognition apparatus for the deaf and persons who are hard of hearing, plural sound sensor units(10) are installed at the front and rear sides and the left and right sides of a vehicle to let the driver recognize the warning sound of a crossing gate, siren sound of the ambulance, and collision and sudden brake sound. A microcomputer(20) receives a sound signal transmitted to the sound sensor unit and controls a light emitting unit(30), a word and sign language display unit(40), and a vibration unit(50) in order to transmit both a display signal and a vibration signal to the driver at the same time according to each position of the vehicle. The light emitting unit has a detachable light emitting acryl rim installed along the front rim and periphery of an audio system, a navigation, a GPS(Global Positioning System), and a liquid crystal monitor television of a vehicle, and emits the light at the intervals of 0.5~3 seconds by the controls of the microcomputer. The word and sign language display unit converts the warning sound of a crossing gate, siren sound of the ambulance, and collision and sudden brake sound into words or sign language and then displays the words or sign language on the navigation, the GPS, and the liquid crystal monitor television. The vibration unit generates vibration by the controls of the microcomputer by installing vibrating elements at the front and rear sides and the left and right sides of a driver's seat.

title_en: Tail plate safety control system and method based on foreign matter monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tail plate safety control system based on foreign matter monitoring and a method thereof, wherein an infrared sensor arranged in a region where the height direction of the bottom of a carriage coincides with the front of a platform is used for monitoring whether foreign matters exceed the front of the tail plate platform and invade the region in the lifting process of the tail plate platform, if so, the lifting movement of the tail plate platform is automatically cut off, the safety accidents of extruding and shearing the foreign matters in the relative movement of the platform and the rear end of the carriage are avoided, and warning signals are sent out; in addition, the radar or ultrasonic or infrared monitoring sensor is arranged at the back of the tail plate lifting platform to monitor the conditions of personnel and foreign matters at the back of the platform, and if personnel or foreign matters invade the platform overturning area when the tail plate platform is operated to overturn vertically and horizontally, the system of the invention automatically cuts off the platform overturning movement, avoids the invasion of the personnel and the foreign matters at the back of the platform and sends out warning signals.

title_en: Emergency alert notification for the hearing impaired
abstract_en: An indication of an emergency alert message is provided to a user, potentially having a disability, via a networked enabled portable device. The emergency alert message is provided via sign language video images indicative of the emergency alert. A notification makes the user aware when broadcast emergency alerts are issued. In various embodiments, the portable device is enabled to receive information about an emergency alert broadcast of which the potentially disabled user should be aware, e.g., from the EAS, and to notify the user of the emergency alert. The user can be automatically taken to the emergency alert information by having the portable device automatically tune to the emergency broadcast information, the user can optionally retrieve the emergency information by tuning to the emergency broadcast channel, and/or the user can otherwise be presented with a reference to the emergency data, such as a link to the information.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted and mobile platform ground disaster multi-mode sensing, alarming and risk avoiding method and system
abstract_en: A vehicle-mounted and mobile platform ground disaster multi-mode sensing, alarming and risk avoiding method and system belong to the technical field of intelligent traffic and geological disaster monitoring. The technical scheme is that a multi-mode sensing data matrix under a unified space-time coordinate system is constructed by integrating multiple types of sensors such as vision, laser radar, millimeter wave radar, positioning navigation device and inertial measurement unit, so that timely, dynamic sensing and intelligent analysis of multiple types of geological disasters are realized, and the problems of coverage blind areas, sensing loss and information island of the traditional monitoring means are solved; the system comprises a functional module for environment sensing, disaster identification, risk assessment, collaborative early warning, active risk avoidance and the like, and is used for collecting multi-source environment data, identifying disaster types and positions, assessing risk grades and executing risk avoidance strategies. The method has the advantages of real-time sensing, high-precision identification, dynamic risk judgment and active risk avoidance, and is suitable for road and non-road scenes of various mobile platforms in geological disaster high-incidence areas.

The apparatus comprises: a speech recognition unit configured to recognize content spoken through a microphone by a user and convert the recognized speech into text; a message management unit configured to manage editing of the recognized text, schedule management such as setting a transmission time and retransmission, transmission and reception of text messages, reception confirmation and inquiry through a touchscreen, history management of emergency situation dissemination, message transmission/reception requests, expansion of additional functions (for example, situation dissemination when an emergency occurs through video monitoring, warning lamp notification during an emergency situation, etc.), and other functions; a message transmission/reception unit configured to manage transmission and reception of messages and processing of transmission/reception errors according to a request from the message management unit; and a speech synthesis unit configured to synthesize the received text into voice and output the synthesized voice through a speaker. In addition, the apparatus and method can minimize the amount of transmission and reception data by converting broadcast content, which is voice, into text and transmitting the text, and can eliminate dependence on Internet infrastructure by synthesizing the text back into voice at a receiving side for listening.

title_en: Constructor safety risk assessment early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a safety risk assessment and early warning method for constructors, which comprises the following steps: step one, identifying construction vehicles and constructors in video data; step two: comparing the recognition target with the database to obtain specific information of the recognized vehicle, and calculating the difference of the inner wheels of the vehicle; step three: determining the length of a visual field blind area at the front part of the vehicle and the area of a vehicle influence field according to the acquired data; step four: tracking the range of the influence field with the vehicle on the vehicle target, and tracking the influence field with the vehicle on constructors; step five: and detecting the overlapping degree of the construction vehicle influence field and the construction personnel influence field, and finally, judging the safety risk level. According to the invention, the safety risk degree of the constructors is judged based on the overlapping degree of the vehicle influence field, and the early warning of the corresponding degree is carried out, so that real-time monitoring and safety early warning can be provided for the construction field, safety accidents in the construction process are avoided, and the safety of the constructors and the construction efficiency of the whole construction field can be improved.

title_en: Coal flow multi-mode autonomous sensing monitoring method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal flow multi-mode autonomous sensing monitoring method, a system, equipment and a medium, which relate to the technical field of industrial intelligent monitoring and digital data processing, and comprise the steps of deploying equipment, collecting in real time and generating a multi-mode data set; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing multi-mode data and extracting features to obtain a joint characterization vector, generating abnormal probability based on cloud-edge cooperation, triggering an early warning signal by combining the abnormal probability with a grading threshold value, and improving coal flow sensing and monitoring precision by adjusting a dynamic distribution and optimization monitoring strategy by combining the early warning signal. The invention can find out various anomalies such as deviation, foreign matters, coal pile and the like and potential safety hazards in running in time, avoid production accidents caused by equipment faults and ensure production safety. And meanwhile, the abnormal information such as coal pile, foreign matters, deviation, carrier roller faults and the like in the running process is subjected to statistical analysis, so that the safety and the production efficiency in the coal flow transportation process are further improved.

title_en: Sleep safe alarm device
abstract_en: The technical development of the Sleep Safe product is intended to assist the hearing impaired to become aware of a smoke detector becoming active in their home. It will allow the person to wake safely and evacuate. It does this by detecting the smoke detector alert then providing auditory, visual and vibration alerts to wake the sleeping person. The Sleep Safe alarm system will be able to sense the house smoke detector siren wirelessly. The alarm detector listens to the smoke detector and communicates with the Base Unit. Once the smoke detector siren is sensed by the Sleep Safe unit, it will then switch on immediately and warn the sleeping person with a bright light, audible voice alarm announcing WARNING, FIRE, WAKE UP and also a vibrating pad directly wired from the Sleep Safe unit to the pillow or mattress pads. The Sleep Safe alarm system comprises of an Alarm Detector to this frequency band and has the advantage with longer wave-length and better wall penetration. The Alarm Detector includes an external microphone so that it can only detect the smoke alarm siren.

title_en: Intelligent early warning, prevention and control device for mechanical equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent early warning, prevention and control device for mechanical equipment, which comprises: the intelligent mechanical early warning system comprises an early warning monitoring device, an audible and visual alarm and a display, wherein the early warning monitoring device is arranged at the top of the cockpit, and the audible and visual alarm is arranged on the surface of a body of the crane. The intelligent mechanical early warning system is arranged on the crane body and consists of a BSD camera, a display and an audible and visual alarm, wherein the system can preset the working radius range, and the BSD camera is used for collecting personnel information in the working radius range; when personnel enter the working radius range, the audible and visual alarm warns to drive away the entering personnel, and the visual blind area of the driver is developed through the assistance of the display, the driver is prompted to operate carefully through the alarm, the safety of mechanical operation is improved through double warning, and the risk of mechanical injury is reduced.

title_en: Foreign matter early warning system for converter buggy ladle track
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of auxiliary equipment used in the metallurgical industry, and particularly discloses a converter buggy ladle track foreign matter early warning system which comprises an infrared emitter, an infrared receiver and an alarm device. The infrared emitter is installed and is located the track directly over near the converter end of buggy ladle, the infrared receiver is installed and is located the track directly over near the converter end of slag car, the infrared receiver corresponds and infrared receiver and infrared emitter electric connection each other, alarm device electric connection infrared receiver, send audible and visual alarm when infrared interrupt, through the combination of infrared detection and camera, whether there is the foreign matter on the buggy ladle track of system real-time supervision, send audible and visual alarm immediately in case discovery is unusual, the incident that leads to because of the track foreign matter has effectively been prevented, the security of production operation has been improved.

title_en: Open pit coal mine slope monitoring and early warning method and system by means of multimode satellite fusion AI
abstract_en: The invention discloses an open pit coal mine slope monitoring and early warning method and system by fusing multi-mode satellites with AI, belonging to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting multi-source data; S2, data transmission in real time, S3, data preprocessing and space-time registration, S4, multi-band InSAR phase reconstruction and deformation field extraction, S5, multi-source data depth fusion, S6, AI intelligent prediction and hierarchical early warning. By adopting the method and the system for monitoring and early warning the slope of the open pit coal mine by fusing the multimode satellite with the AI, the invention realizes the monitoring of the millimeter-level precision continuous deformation field of the whole area of the slope, reduces the vegetation topography shielding interference, expands the monitoring range, eliminates the monitoring blind area, improves the data processing efficiency, constructs the deformation field with high reliability, and reduces the early warning false alarm rate.

abstract_en: PURPOSE: An alarm apparatus for a hearing-impaired person is provided to respond the operational state of an electronic apparatus by converting the alarm signal of the electronic apparatus to vibration signal or visual signal and transmits the signal to a portable terminal. The vibration module(23) generates vibration based on the vibration signal from the signal conversion module. A display module(24) displays the visual signal from the signal conversion module.

title_ko: 화재경보기의 오작동 발생 방지를 위한 방충망
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an insect screen for preventing a malfunction of a fire alarm, which prevents a malfunction of the fire alarm from occurring by preventing foreign substances from penetrating into the inside of the fire alarm. The purpose of the present invention is to reduce inconvenience such as being surprised by a siren sound by reducing the malfunction of the fire alarm or consuming manpower due to the dispatch of a fire truck, and to reduce casualties by reducing people's safety insensitivity. It consists of an outer insect screen surrounding the outermost side, an inner insect screen inside the outer insect screen, a sticky sticky attached to the insect screen door, a ceiling and an invention, and a coupling part between the outer insect screen and the inner insect screen. Although it is used in lodging businesses and the like, it has the effect of reducing the damage to business owners and customers who suffer damage by reducing the malfunction of a photoelectric smoke detector that has a lot of malfunctions, and reducing the safety insensitivity of people by reducing the malfunction of sirens.

title_en: Earthquake early warning method of emergency early warning broadcasting system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster early warning, in particular to an earthquake early warning method of an emergency early warning broadcasting system, which comprises the steps of obtaining the longitude and latitude coordinates of a seismic source and earthquake monitoring data, determining the distribution area range of broadcasting sites according to the longitude and latitude coordinates of the seismic source, wherein the range is represented by longitude and latitude, constructing an earthquake risk topological space based on historical earthquake data, dividing earthquake risk grades in the topological space, determining corresponding broadcasting emergency degree parameters according to the earthquake risk grades, generating broadcasting message codes, transmitting the broadcasting message codes to broadcasting sites in the distribution area of the broadcasting sites through a power line carrier and a wireless communication network to trigger earthquake early warning broadcasting, combining geological structure data through a topological space mapping technology, accurately determining an early warning range, obviously reducing early warning blind areas and avoiding excessive early warning.

title_en: Indicator device for an emergency call position
abstract_en: A device for indicating the position of an emergency telephone is provided to enable both natives and foreigners to find out easily the emergency telephone by installing a body equipped with a plurality of LEDs(Light Emitting Diode), on the wall. A device for indicating the position of an emergency telephone is composed of a PCB(Printed Circuit Board) substrate(110); a plurality of LEDs(120,140) installed on the upper and lower sides of the PCB substrate; and a telephone-shaped body(100) for covering the PCB substrate including the LEDs. The body comprises a transmitting unit(100a), a receiving unit(100b), and plural LEDs additionally installed on the outer side of the receiving unit. The LED is packaged by at least one selected from a group comprising top view, side view, and lamp methods.

title_en: Bi-directional Blind Sight Illumination and Deflector Device
abstract_en: An optical device that reflects back some of the same light that been projected towards the reflector with more intensity when transmitting and going through the reflector such that the remaining light is dispersed and still can been seen. The light is concentrated and projected forward by the device such that the appearance of the intensified light may act as a warning of oncoming vehicles, emergency situations, stopped vehicles and pedestrians on a hill or curve where line of sight is inhibited. The Bi-directional Blind Sight Illumination and Deflector Device is comprised of at least one reflective, dispersive and transmitting lens having a front and a rear surface, side edges and unique features; a pole for affixing and placing the main lens to the ground; and a means to secure the lens to a pole.

title_en: Automatic recognition and early warning method and system for pavement foreign matters
abstract_en: The application discloses an automatic recognition and early warning method and system for pavement foreign matters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the data acquisition unit acquires image information through installing cameras at the hidden danger points of each ground disaster; processing the acquired image information, and extracting various features in the acquired image information after the source image is enhanced; identifying the difference of the image information acquired in adjacent time periods through the structural similarity; simplifying the extracted characteristic information by adopting a mathematical morphology method; and detecting whether the foreign matters in the acquired image information are motor vehicles, non-motor vehicles and pedestrians by adopting a YOLOv2 multi-target detection and identification model. According to the application, by comparing the differences of the images in the space structure and adopting the YOLOv2 multi-target detection and identification model, the road falling rocks and other geological disasters are identified and detected, the problems of automatic identification, prediction and early warning of the road and slope geological disasters are solved, and the image identification and target detection accuracy is improved.

title_en: Forest fire early warning method, system and equipment based on satellite Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of satellite Internet of things, in particular to a forest fire early warning method, a forest fire early warning system and forest fire early warning equipment based on the satellite Internet of things, which specifically comprise the steps of carrying out fusion processing on monitoring data of different monitoring devices in each target overlapping area according to a data fusion algorithm to generate a data fusion model; the monitoring data of the potential monitoring blind area is obtained through deduction through analyzing the monitoring data of the adjacent area of the potential monitoring blind area, the long-term change trend of the monitoring data of the potential monitoring blind area is predicted through a time sequence prediction algorithm, and the monitoring data of each monitoring device, the analysis result of the target overlapping area and the prediction result of the potential monitoring blind area are transmitted to a data center through the satellite Internet of things. The invention obviously improves the coverage and the data accuracy of the forest monitoring system and effectively reduces the problems caused by monitoring blind areas and data overlapping.

title_en: Investigation system for house earthquake disaster risk hidden danger treatment

title_en: Rail line multi-domain limit foreign matter intrusion event condition identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for identifying the condition of a rail line multi-domain limit foreign matter intrusion event, which belong to the technical field of railway disaster prevention risk early warning, and a rail surface state acquisition sensor device is selected to acquire rail surface state data according to the whole process monitoring requirement of the occurrence of the foreign matter intrusion event; dividing a rail surface limit area into a concerned domain, an early warning domain and a safety domain, and identifying, tracking and extracting characteristics of foreign matters which invade the limit; defining an intrusion event state description model; based on the intrusion event state characteristics, the identified intrusion foreign matter characteristic data is used as an intrusion event state description model dynamic characteristic parameter quantification risk value, and the intrusion foreign matter event detection rate of a rail surface limit safety domain, an early warning domain and a concerned domain is calculated. The invention realizes the monitoring, identification and analysis of the characteristics of the track line intrusion event and the event occurrence process, further improves the risk prevention and control capability of the track traffic system, and has good application and popularization values.

title_en: Equipment control method and device based on recognition and prediction of foreign matters of underground coal mine belt
abstract_en: The invention discloses an equipment control method and device based on recognition and prediction of foreign matters of a belt under a coal mine, wherein an image acquisition device arranged above the belt is utilized to acquire video images in the running process of the belt in real time, the image acquisition device comprises an industrial camera, an image processing algorithm and a deep learning algorithm are utilized to recognize and position the foreign matters in the video images, when the foreign matters are recognized, an early warning is triggered and the inspection equipment is controlled to go to an alarm point for confirmation and recheck, and if the foreign matters exist, the measures of adjusting the running speed of the belt, linking the broadcasting and broadcasting under the mine and pushing alarm information are executed according to the position and the property of the foreign matters. The method solves the problems of large calculation amount, low precision, insufficient adaptability and large potential safety hazard of the conventional underground coal mine belt foreign matter detection.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted and mobile platform ground disaster multi-mode sensing, alarming and risk avoiding method and system
abstract_en: A vehicle-mounted and mobile platform ground disaster multi-mode sensing, alarming and risk avoiding method and system belong to the technical field of intelligent traffic and geological disaster monitoring. The technical scheme is that a multi-mode sensing data matrix under a unified space-time coordinate system is constructed by integrating multiple types of sensors such as vision, laser radar, millimeter wave radar, positioning navigation device and inertial measurement unit, so that timely, dynamic sensing and intelligent analysis of multiple types of geological disasters are realized, and the problems of coverage blind areas, sensing loss and information island of the traditional monitoring means are solved; the system comprises a functional module for environment sensing, disaster identification, risk assessment, collaborative early warning, active risk avoidance and the like, and is used for collecting multi-source environment data, identifying disaster types and positions, assessing risk grades and executing risk avoidance strategies. The method has the advantages of real-time sensing, high-precision identification, dynamic risk judgment and active risk avoidance, and is suitable for road and non-road scenes of various mobile platforms in geological disaster high-incidence areas.
