title_en: A kind of vehicle blind zone monitoring and warning system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of vehicle blind zone monitoring and warning systems to remind blind area early warning with indicator light by the way that indicator light is added in inside rear-view mirror two sides；The indicator light on the left of interior rear mirror is lighted when there is early warning in left side blind area；The indicator light on the right side of interior rear mirror is lighted when there is early warning in right side blind area；When there is early warning in left and right blind area, while lighting the indicator light of interior rear mirror two sides.The utility model has the beneficial effects that in the case where driver can be allowed not have to wide-angle rotary head, while seeing that blind area monitors system two sides blind area warning information, Driving Decision-making is correctly made, safety accident is reduced.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning device with good protection effect
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster early warning device that protecting effect is good, including box, monitoring station pillar and control box, the rear side of control box fixed connection's monitoring station pillar, the opening has been seted up at the top of box, the monitoring station pillar is located the inner chamber of box, the blind hole has been seted up to the bottom of monitoring station pillar, the bottom of monitoring station pillar is equipped with first bevel gear, the first bearing of inner chamber bottom fixedly connected with of box, the inner chamber threaded connection of blind hole has the threaded rod, first bevel gear is run through to the bottom of threaded rod, and the plug is in the inner chamber of first bearing, the right side of first bevel gear is equipped with the second bevel gear, the right side of second bevel gear is equipped with the motor, the right side fixedly connected with dwang of second bevel gear, the utility model relates to a geological disaster early warning device that protecting effect is good has that protecting effect is good, the monitoring station, Saving resources and the like.

title_en: Rail track foreign matter detecting method and system based on radar and image analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of rail track foreign matter detecting method analyzed based on radar and high-definition image and systems, by the advantage for making full use of microwave radar detecting real-time moving target, reuse the real-time high-definition video stream that high-definition video equipment obtains moving target, moving target is analyzed then in conjunction with the two, judges whether it is the foreign matter target for needing to carry out early warning.And the early warning of different stage can be carried out, for size, the type of different foreign matter targets to improve detection accuracy and response speed to invasion foreign matter.Compared with prior art, the present invention, which can be realized, carries out timely, accurately detecting and early warning to the intrusion foreign matter in rail track, omission factor, rate of false alarm are effectively reduced, avoids due to foreign body intrusion and major accident occurs, is had a good application prospect in rail track security fields.
assignees: NANJING WEIDA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forest fire prevention monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire prevention monitoring and early warning device which comprises a box body, wherein through holes are formed in the left side and the right side of the inner wall of the box body, the bottom of a torsion spring is fixedly connected to the outer wall of a bent plate, a belt is fixedly connected to the outer side of the bent plate, the outer wall of the belt is in clearance fit with the inner wall of the through holes, the outer wall of the belt is rotatably connected with a grooved wheel, the grooved wheel is rotatably connected with the rear end face of the inner wall of the through hole through a connecting shaft, rod bodies are fixedly connected to the outer side of the belt, and the two rod bodies are respectively rotatably connected. This forest fire prevention control early warning device for smoke alarm accessible box and box cover's protection carries out stable work, and convenient to use person takes out smoke alarm, makes box cover and box can carry out stable laminating, and then makes box cover and box can carry out stable protection to smoke alarm, makes smoke alarm can carry out stable protection.

title_en: Forestry ecological environment real-time monitoring and managing method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large data-based forestry ecological environment real-time monitoring and management method, which belongs to the technical field of forestry ecological environment management and comprises the following steps of S1, multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition and sensor network deployment, S2, multi-mode data fusion and intelligent transmission, namely, developing a self-adaptive communication protocol dynamic switching module, automatically switching to a satellite communication link in a 4G/5G network blind area, S3, mass data storage and distributed computation, namely, constructing a hybrid cloud storage architecture, storing real-time monitoring data into a Redis cache queue, S4, intelligent extraction of ecological environment indexes, S5, dynamic assessment of ecological bearing capacity, S6, multi-level early warning and emergency response, S7, accurate forestry management decision, S8, system self-optimization and closed-loop management. The method and the system remarkably improve the comprehensiveness and instantaneity of forestry ecological environment perception by constructing the space-world integrated monitoring network, and complement multi-source data of unmanned aerial vehicles, satellite remote sensing and ground sensors.

title_en: Method and system for preventing campus from being overlooked by laser radar imaging technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of campus safety protection, in particular to a method and a system for preventing campus from being overlooked by utilizing a laser radar imaging technology, comprising the following steps of acquiring 3D point cloud data of an environment in a monitoring area in a preset monitoring area in a campus, and simultaneously acquiring sound data in the monitoring area; the method comprises the steps of processing 3D point cloud data to generate a three-dimensional environment image, extracting first behavior features, processing sound data to extract second behavior features, carrying out multi-mode fusion on the first behavior features and the second behavior features to generate unified behavior feature vectors, identifying whether a super-resolution behavior exists in a current scene based on the behavior feature vectors, calculating corresponding behavior risk scores, judging whether a preset alarm threshold is reached, triggering corresponding alarm and early warning operations if the super-resolution behavior reaches the preset alarm threshold, and achieving non-invasive active monitoring of hidden corners of campuses without appearance privacy leakage and overcoming privacy limit and blind area problems of traditional video monitoring.

title_en: Auto-discovery of diverse communications devices for alert broadcasting
abstract_en: Methods and systems for communicating messages to target communications devices in a target physical location are disclosed. Network sources are queried for logical locations accessible to the network source. A specification of a physical location associated with each logical location is received. Each logical location specification is stored in a data store in association with the associated physical location specification. A specification of the target physical location is received. Those logical location specifications associated with the target physical location are retrieved from the data store, thereby identifying target logical locations. For each target logical location, at least one of the network sources accessible to that logical location is queried for specifications of communications devices accessible to that logical location, thereby identifying the communications devices in the target physical location. The message is communicated to the target communications devices in the target physical location via at least one of the target logical locations.
assignees: ABU-HAKIMA SUHAYYA;GRIGG KENNETH E;MCFARLAND CONNIE;GUEVREMONT VINCE;PISKORZ OSKAR;CHRISTIE COLIN

title_en: System and method to communicate an emergency alert message
abstract_en: Various aspects of a system related to communication of emergency alert messages are disclosed herein. The system comprises one or more circuits in an electronic device communicatively coupled to a broadcast server. The one or more circuits are configured to register one or more output preferences based on one or more input parameters provided by a user. An emergency alert message and associated metadata of an emergency event is received from the broadcast server. The associated metadata includes time-sensitive information of the emergency event. Based on the associated metadata and the registered one or more output preferences, the received emergency alert message is modified to a user-accessible format. According to the registered one or more output preferences, the modified emergency alert message is communicated to the user.

title_en: Emergency data management and access system
abstract_en: Described herein are systems, servers, devices, methods, and media for providing and managing access to emergency data. In some embodiments, a method for managing access to emergency data for emergency service providers by an emergency management system includes the steps of: determining a first set of data categories to be made accessible to an emergency service provider (ESP), wherein the first set of data categories is selected from a second set of data categories; detecting an emergency alert from an electronic device; associating the ESP with the emergency alert; gathering emergency data associated with the emergency alert available for the first set of data categories; and securely transmitting, to the ESP, the emergency data associated with the emergency alert available for the first set of data categories.

title_en: Alert broadcasting to unconfigured communications devices
abstract_en: Methods and systems for communicating alert messages to target communications devices in a target physical location are disclosed. The target devices may not be preconfigured to be discovered or to receive the alert message. Network sources are queried to identify accessible logical locations, which are associated with physical locations in a database. The logical locations include an intelligent network source which, having received the alert message, detects nearby devices in the target physical location. The system prepares and communicates the alert message to the target device. The intelligent network source may be configured to prepare and communicate the alert message without any intermediate system step of formulating a list of recipients. Auto-discovery and message delivery methods employ protocol packet injection, network and access point spoofing, and Bluetooth signaling. Auto-discovery and unconfigured delivery methods can be used to reveal the presence of devices in an area.

title_en: Alarm bell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an alarm bell comprises control panel, face lid, drain pan, lamp shade, luminescent plate, piezoelectric buzzer, sealing strip and packing box, face lid connect on the drain pan, the lamp shade is connected and is covered at the face, piezoelectricity buzzer connection covers at the face, the control panel is connected on the drain pan, is provided with binding post on the control panel, the control panel passes through binding post and piezoelectricity buzzer connection, is provided with the address switch on the control panel, the luminescent plate is connected on the control panel, is provided with hi -lite LED luminotron on the luminescent plate, the sealing strip setting is covered at the face, the packing box have two respectively the connection on the drain pan. The utility model discloses a lamp shade has different shape and colour, can change corresponding lamp shade according to the environment of difference, and the warning tone that address switch selection is different is adjusted to the accessible, through the flashing rate of single chip microcomputer control lamp.
assignees: TAIZHOU KEPUNI COMM EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: Highway trackside early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an expressway roadside early warning device which comprises a fixed rod, wherein a positioning pipe is sleeved on the outer surface of the fixed rod, a connecting block is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the positioning pipe, a display screen is fixedly connected to the front side of the connecting block, an electric push rod is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the display screen, one end, far away from the display screen, of the electric push rod is fixedly connected with a guide rod, and one end of the guide rod is fixedly connected with a cleaning brush. This highway trackside early warning device, siren accessible sound transmission carries out the early warning to the driver, and the radar that tests the speed can test the speed to the vehicle, and show the information of illegal vehicle through the display screen, play the warning effect to the driver, the warning light can play the warning effect through the scintillation night, multiple warning is mutually supported, the warning effect has greatly been improved, electric putter starts, can drive the guide bar and remove, thereby make the brush cleaner clean the display screen, guarantee that the display screen is cleaner.
assignees: LIAONING ETTES INTELLIGENT TRAFFIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Beyond-visual-range blind area safety early warning system and beyond-visual-range blind area safety early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an over-the-horizon dead zone safety early warning system and an over-the-horizon dead zone safety early warning method. The system comprises intelligent road side sensing equipment, V2X intelligent road side equipment and a V2X intelligent vehicle-mounted terminal, wherein the V2X intelligent road side equipment is connected with the intelligent road side sensing equipment and the V2X intelligent vehicle-mounted terminal; the intelligent roadside sensing equipment is used for collecting roadside information in the visual blind area and transmitting the roadside information to the intelligent roadside equipment; the V2X intelligent road side equipment is used for converting the road side information into standard V2X information and broadcasting the V2X information to a V2X intelligent vehicle-mounted terminal in a preset range; the V2X intelligent vehicle-mounted terminal is used for intelligently analyzing the V2X message to determine early warning information and displaying the early warning information. The method can provide all-round early warning at the beyond visual range blind area in real time through the vehicle-road cooperation technology, and safety accidents caused by the beyond visual range blind area are reduced.
assignees: BEIJING NEBULA LINK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Early warning device for high-voltage near electricity and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power safety, in particular to an early warning device for high-voltage near electricity and a use method thereof, comprising a main control core module, a control module and a control module, wherein the main control core module is used for receiving input data of all modules, analyzing instructions, operating a core algorithm and issuing control instructions to each execution module so as to realize cooperative scheduling of a whole system; the intelligent early warning device has the advantages that systematic breakthrough is realized through multidimensional innovative design, and the intelligent early warning device has remarkable beneficial effects that on the environment adaptation surface, through a self-adaptive calibration mechanism of multi-sensor data acquisition and GIS information fusion, the device can dynamically counteract environmental interference and match regional line characteristics, early warning precision is improved compared with that of a traditional device, and on the cooperative protection surface, a regional early warning network is constructed by means of Mesh ad hoc network technology, multi-node linkage response is realized by combining UWB positioning, and the safety blind area of single-point early warning is effectively eliminated.

title_en: Enforcement system of illegal parking
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an illegal parking regulating system which can: obtain an accurate image without a blind spot while accurately sensing an illegal parking vehicle by vertically installing regulation equipment sensing an illegal parking vehicle and photographing the sensed illegal parking vehicle at an interval in a position near an illegal parking area (S); remarkably increase the accuracy and reliability of regulation by performing a photographing at various angles when an illegal parking vehicle is sensed by being formed so that a camera installed in the regulation equipment is capable of a PTZ control; increase the accuracy and reliability of regulation by accurately recognizing a vehicle number even when error is generated in the photographing of a certain camera by including a verification unit finally determining a vehicle number of the highest occupation rate among vehicle numbers recognized by a controller as a vehicle number of the corresponding vehicle when a vehicle number is recognized through a plurality of images; and give a warning about illegal parking to an illegal parking vehicle driver by setting a flickering speed to be faster while changing color in response to parking time (elapsed time) while flickering a warning light when an illegal parking vehicle is sensed. The illegal parking regulating system includes smart fence poles which respectively has a sensor of sensing a preset sensing area and a camera of photographing a vehicle.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 불법주정차 차량 감지 및 감지된 불법주정차 차량을 촬영하는 단속장비들이 주정차금지 구역(S)에 인접한 위치에 간격을 두고 수직으로 설치됨으로써 불법주정차 차량을 정확하게 감지함과 동시에 사각지대 없이 정확한 영상을 획득할 수 있고, 단속장비들 내부에 설치되는 카메라가 PTZ 제어가 가능하도록 구성되어 불법주정차 차량이 감지되면, 다양한 각도에서 촬영을 수행할 수 있어 단속의 정확성 및 신뢰도를 현저히 높일 수 있으며, 복수개의 영상들을 통해 차량번호가 인식되면, 컨트롤러가 인식된 차량번호들 중 점유율이 가장 높은 차량번호를 최종적으로 해당 차량의 차량번호로 결정하는 검증부를 포함함으로써 임의의 카메라의 촬영에 오류가 발생하더라도 차량번호를 정확하게 인식하여 단속의 정확성 및 신뢰도를 더욱 높일 수 있고, 불법주정차 차량이 감지되면 경고등을 점멸시키되, 주정차 시간(경과시간)에 대응하여 색상을 가변함과 동시에 점멸속도가 빨라지도록 설정함으로써 불법주정차 차량 운전자에게 불법주정차에 대한 경각심을 줄 수 있는 불법주정차 단속시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Distributed healthcare communication system
abstract_en: A graphical audio station of a nurse call system is operable to permit a user to perform one or more of the following functions: establish a two-way voice communication link with another computer device in another patient and/or with a another computer device located in another staff work area and/or with a wireless communication device carried by caregiver and/or with a telephone of the healthcare facility; broadcast a voice page to a group of other selected computer devices; compose and send a text message to a portable device that is carried by a caregiver and that has wireless communication capability; browse web pages and/or view multimedia content, such as videos, hosted on servers of the healthcare facility and/or that are accessible via the Internet; view and/or acknowledge and/or answer and/or cancel alerts or nurse calls originating in a plurality of patient rooms.

title_en: Method and system for actively providing information based on position
abstract_en: A method and system for providing indoor emergency alert is provided. An indoor emergency alert system obtains, from a user terminal, identification of an accessible beacon that is installed in a subspace of a building. The system recognizes identification of the subspace of the building corresponding to the identification of beacon obtained from the user terminal. Using the recognized identification of the subspace, the system maintains association between the subspace and the user terminal. When an emergency occurs at the building, the system can transmit a subspace-specific alert message to the user terminal based on the association between the subspace and the user terminal.

title_en: Communication Case For Connecting Indoor Cables
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a communication box dedicated to indoor communication cable connection, comprising: a table (10); a connector mechanism (30); a communication device case (70); a fire detection sensor (80); a warning speaker (90); a plurality of guiders (20); a door (50); and a foreign material removal mechanism (60). According to the present invention, foreign substances on the upper surface of the table (10) can be easily cleaned.

title_en: Railway factory positioning safety helmet based on ultra-wideband technology
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a railway factory positioning safety helmet based on an ultra-wideband technology, which relates to the technical field of railway safety equipment and comprises a safety helmet main body and a positioning label assembly, wherein the positioning label assembly is arranged outside the safety helmet main body and used for acquiring position information of equipment wearers in real time, the positioning label assembly comprises a shell, a man-machine interaction button and a distress alarm indicator lamp are arranged on the front surface of the shell, a UWB chip and a microprocessor are arranged inside the shell, the UWB chip is in communication connection with the microprocessor, and a battery module, an alarm module and a communication module are arranged inside the shell. The utility model can solve the problems of poor indoor precision, easy slow manual fortification, large blind area of operating mechanical equipment, incapability of timely early warning danger and the like of the traditional method, can acquire the position information of a wearer in real time and high precision, has early warning and alarming functions, and improves the safety and management efficiency of railway factory operation.

title_en: Isolating protector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an isolating protector. The isolating protector body is provided with a protecting pulling plate that can be pulled and inserted; the lower part of the isolating protector body is provided with a support member with the height adjustable so as to realize space isolation by adjusting the width of the protecting pulling plate and the height of the support member when in use. Besides, the isolating protector body is also provided with a pre-warning device which can give a prompt in such manners as sound, light and voice when persons are induced to be close to the working field and which can then inform the maintenance personnel, thereby overcoming the defect that the existing isolators are easy to move without ideal effect for special groups such as children and the blind. The utility model has reasonable structure, multiple functions and ideal using effect, and is suitable for being widely used in elevator maintenance.

title_en: Intelligent calling and alarming system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent calling and alarming system. The inner module connection relation is characterized in that: a wireless control module is connected with a system control unit, the system control unit is respectively connected with a speech unit, an information suggestion unit, an alarm lamp unit and a vibrator unit, and a smog warning unit is respectively connected with the speech unit, the information suggestion unit, the alarm lamp unit and the vibrator unit. The intelligent calling and alarming unit can automatically assist schools for deaf mutes and schools for the blind with the daily life management and the rapid alarming of sudden events and avoid situations that deaf-mutes and blind men can not deal with work and rest and calling in daily life and sudden event alarming due to deafness and blindness.

title_en: A kind of cell intelligent safety defense monitoring system based on Internet of Things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of cell intelligent safety defense monitoring system based on Internet of Things, including safety alarm system, application layer, Business Logic, Internet, Physical Links Layer, and be sequentially connected electrically between safety alarm system, application layer, Business Logic, Internet, Physical Links Layer, it is characterised in that：The application layer includes administrative center UI, and the Business Logic includes data analysis layer and protocol translation layer, and the Internet includes data transmit-receive layer, and the Physical Links Layer includes sensor node.The present invention combines technology of Internet of things and traditional cell security protection, the microchip for possessing perception, wireless communication ability and disposal ability is embedded among cell security protection, it can timely send alarm signal when a disaster occurs and timely respond, and Rapid Alarm when can go wrong again, it is with low cost and warning device is easy to use.
assignees: XI'AN TIANJI NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of destructiveness near earthquake non-blind area method for early warning
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of destructive near earthquake non-blind area method for early warning, by sensing module, seismic waveform identifies in real time, parameter acquisition module and warning information server-side composition, it is laid by measuring point sensor and measuring point surrounds the method laid by protection zone, necessary condition is provided for rapid and accurate determination focal shock parameter, it is identified in real time by seismic waveform and acquisition module carries out real time contrast's processing to the signal of each sensor, it can be obtained in 0.1 second after detecting P wave first motion and send basic source parameter, and it is transmitted to by real-time network on the server at regional early warning center, it is studied and judged by quick comparison and makes different early warning responses；The destructiveness near earthquake non-blind area method for early warning realizes effective quick early warning to 0Km -100Km destructiveness near earthquake, 1 second in advance -15 seconds sending warning information, i.e., at the time of secondary wave will reach, epicentral location, the depth of focus, earthquake magnitude preliminary study.
assignees: CHAI JIANYONG;WANG XIONGJIAN;HUANG HUI;CHEN XINGLIAN;LUO YUFEN;Ke Naichen

title_en: Tunnel risk avoidance early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel danger-avoiding early warning system and a tunnel danger-avoiding early warning method, wherein the system comprises a water level monitoring device, a control center, a tunnel early warning device and an emergency drainage device, wherein the water level monitoring device is used for monitoring tunnel water level data and sending the tunnel water level data to the control center; through setting up tunnel early warning device and urgent drainage device, can effectively drain off water to tunnel ponding to show early warning information, effectively remind the driver to be cautious current or forbid current, the driver can in time learn that traffic signal is current by detour in advance, reduce traffic jam, the driver can not blindly drive the tunnel that gets into ponding after learning traffic signal simultaneously, driving safety has reduced the emergence of traffic accident and has avoided the casualties, goes out for the public and provides the safety guarantee.
assignees: GUANGZHOU HIGHWAY IND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for identifying condition of foreign matter invasion event of multi-domain boundary of track line
abstract_en: The invention provides a rail line multi-domain limit foreign matter invasion event condition identification method and a rail line multi-domain limit foreign matter invasion event condition identification system, which belong to the technical field of railway disaster prevention risk early warning, and are characterized in that rail surface state acquisition sensor equipment is selected to acquire rail surface state data according to the monitoring requirement of the whole process of occurrence of a foreign matter invasion event; dividing a rail surface limit area into an attention area, an early warning area and a safety area, and identifying, tracking and extracting characteristics of the foreign matters invading the limit; defining a state description model of the violation event; and based on the state characteristics of the intrusion event, the identified intrusion foreign matter characteristic data is used as the quantitative risk value of the dynamic characteristic parameters of the intrusion event state description model, and the detection rates of the intrusion foreign matter event of the rail surface boundary security domain, the early warning domain and the attention domain are calculated. The invention realizes the monitoring, identification and analysis of the track line limit-invasion event characteristics and the event occurrence process, further improves the risk prevention and control capacity of the track traffic system, and has good application and popularization values.

title_en: Intelligent electric control cabinet
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power control cabinets, and relates to an intelligent power control cabinet. The invention is beneficial to operators to timely process faults of the target power control cabinet by acquiring and displaying basic information of corresponding circuits, protection devices and loads of the target power control cabinet, avoids the expansion of the faults, improves the efficiency and accuracy of maintenance work, provides convenience for the maintenance and management of the target power control cabinet by analyzing the safety coefficients of the corresponding circuits and the protection devices of the target power control cabinet and the safety coefficients and the matching coefficients of the loads, reduces blindness and complexity of the maintenance work, improves the maintenance efficiency and quality, and is beneficial to taking protective measures in a targeted manner by acquiring the dust concentration and the fire source existence of the environment of the target power control cabinet and carrying out early warning, thereby avoiding the damage or the safety accidents of the target power control cabinet caused by environmental factors.

title_en: Emergency warning device for road
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an emergency warning device for a road which is excellent in visibility from the remote place, and which is excellent in the maintenability in component exchange, packing, transport, and assembly or the like for warning the driver of a following car to enter a disaster region or the periphery when any disaster occurs on a blind road.  <P>SOLUTION: This warning device for road is provided with a smoke candle which burns and generates a coloring flame in order to improve visibility. The warning device for road is preferably provided with a warning part with the standing smoke candle in a box-shaped body whose inside is covered with a mirror. Also, this warning device for road is mounted with the plurality of warning devices on a strut, and the warning device for road is installed before a tunnel entrance or a curve entrance.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Methods and apparatuses for emergency notifications to the hearing impaired
abstract_en: Described are systems and methods for communicating emergency alerts to a hearing-impaired user. Queries are performed to one or more emergency alert databases to develop emergency alert notifications. At least some of the emergency alert notifications are filtered responsive to user selected criteria to select one or more filtered emergency alerts. An attention desired indicator is transmitted to a hearing-impaired user device that subscribes to a hearing-impaired relay service supported by the server if the one or more filtered emergency alerts are present. The filtered emergency alerts are transmitted to the hearing-impaired user device in response to a emergency information query from that user device.

title_en: A sensor-fitted ring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sensor-fitted ring protects individuals from dangerous situations such as fire due to forgetting the stove on in a possible case like individuals who are elderly, living alone, with Alzheimer's, with cognitive disorder, having reduced sense of smell or loss of smell or visually impaired lying on the sofa and falling asleep while cooking, ensures their safety, provides maximum independence in daily life activities, consisting of a mechanism (1) connecting with the smoke sensor, a sound alert mechanism (2), a visual alert display (3), a part (4) providing vibration, a part (5) covered with the waterproof material, a display (6) viewing the connection of sensor device with the ring/ smartphone, a sensor device on/off switch (7), a sensor device Bluetooth switch (8), a charge indicator (9), a charging socket (10), a part (11) where the smoke enters the mechanism and is detected, and a sound alert part (12) of the sensor device.
assignees: ISTANBUL MEDIPOL UNIV TEKNOLOJI TRANSFER OFISI ANONIM SIRKETI

title_en: Moving robot and control method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates a moving robot and a method for controlling thereof, and specifically, the moving robot and the method are configured to monitor a cleaning area by taking images while moving a plurality of areas based on a map of the cleaning area, and monitor in a plurality of areas or a dedicated specific area, and monitor overall areas by taking images while rotating at a monitoring location by dedicating the monitoring location in the area, and set a specific location in an area as a monitoring location, and cause taking of images to be performed at a specific angle by dedicating a monitoring direction in the monitoring location, and perform monitoring of a plurality of areas with minimal movement, and perform an effective monitoring because taking images in a blind spot may be performed by changing the monitoring location or adding a monitoring location based on information on an obstacle, and set a schedule to perform monitoring at a dedicated time, and detect invasion by recognizing the obstacle through analyzing of the images, and output an alert message or signal if the invasion is detected, and transmit a signal or message associated with the invasion detection, and thus a security function can be strengthened.

title_en: Control method and system for sensing blind area of automobile tire hub
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a control system for sensing a blind area of an automobile tire hub, which belong to the technical field of automobiles and comprise the following steps: step 1, dividing a vehicle running state, and presetting a wheel hub warning state according to the degree of association between the wheel hub damage probability and the vehicle running state; step 2, mounting the ultrasonic radar sensors at the positions of the hubs, mounting the ultrasonic radar sensors at intervals of ninety degrees from a preset position, namely mounting four ultrasonic radar sensors on one hub in total, and detecting the approach distance of the foreign matters through the ultrasonic radar sensors; and 3, presetting a response behavior library, and matching response behaviors in the response behavior library according to the detection result. The invention solves the problem that a user cannot distinguish the damage risk of the hub caused by the perception scene, reduces the potential safety hazard of hub damage, and greatly optimizes the user experience.

title_en: Diffusion lens for the visual alarm
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A diffusion lens for a visual alarm apparatus is provided to use a diffusion light source which is projected through a lens, thereby effectively transferring an alarm signal to a hearing-impaired person. CONSTITUTION: A lens(100) is installed in a visual alarm apparatus(150) in order to maximize diffusion of light projected to a front side. The visual alarm apparatus visually informs a disaster such as fire and etc. to a hearing-impaired person, residents, and fire fighting participants by repeating a flickering process according to a signal of an automatic fire detection facility. The lens is detachably combined in a housing(151) of the visual alarm apparatus. The lens comprises a dome shaped first lens condensing light projected from a light source The lens comprises a dome shaped second lens which transmits the condensed light to the front side by diffusing the light through an incidence part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 렌즈에 있어서, 광원과 마주하는 일면에 마련되어 광원으로부터 조사되는 빛을 집광하는 돔 형태의 제1렌즈; 및 상기 입사부를 통해 집광된 빛을 확산하여 전방으로 투과시키는 돔 형태의 제2렌즈;를 포함하며, 상기 제2렌즈는, 어느 일면에 음각의 형태로 마련되어 광원으로부터 직접 또는 간접으로 입사된 빛을 전방위적으로 굴절 및 반사하는 반사홈부;를 개시한다. 
이러한 본 발명은 본 발명은 제1렌즈에서 광원을 집광한 후, 제2렌즈를 통해 광원이 전방으로 확산되도록 하여 광원의 손실을 최소화고, 전방위적인 빛의 조사가 가능하며, 렌즈를 통해 조사되는 광원의 굴절, 투과 및 반사율을 최대화함으로써, 화재 또는 비상 사태가 발생할 경우, 확산 광원을 통해 청각 장애인으로 하여금 대피에 대한 신호 전달을 극대화시킬 수 있으며, 확산용 렌즈는 광원의 손실을 줄이고 조사율이 극대화가 이루어지도록 하여, 전방으로 확산되는 광원의 밝기를 최대화하여 원거리에서도 식별이 용이한 효과가 있다.  그리고 직진성이 강한 LED 광원을 이용하여 빛의 투과, 굴절 및 반사율을 극대화하여 광원의 손실을 최소화고, 빛의 효율을 극대화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Blind area Warning indicator for automobile outer rear-view mirror
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of blind area Warning indicator for automobile outer rear-view mirror, mirror supporting plate (5) is provided with the installation cavity (5.1) for housing light source assembly and light guide plate (3)；The multiple wedge shape boss arranged along axis y it are provided with side by side on light guide plate (3), and the side of each wedge shape boss is equipped with the straight end face (3.4) for matching with corresponding LED lamp bead (6), the upper surface of certain certain adjacent two wedge shape boss is the arc surface I that radius is R1 epirelief, the upper surface of outermost wedge shape boss is made up of flat face (3.5) and arc surface II that radius is R2 epirelief, and R2 > R1.The light source that the design of this utility model structure is the most reasonable, make LED penetrate is by light guide plate back reflection to the angle set, and satisfied in terms of driver's angle, this emergency warning lamp should be the brightest, should be enough dark in other angles, and alarming effect is more preferable.
assignees: NINGBO SMR HUAXIANG AUTOMOTIVE MIRRORS CO LTD

title_en: Emergency air supply life-saving device for fire danger
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergent air feed life saving equipment device of fire disaster, including small-size air-blower, the battery, main guide duct, the siren, small-size gas pitcher, the lifesaving helmet, the air guide hose, the hanging flower basket, the lifting rope, control circuit constitutes, provide the required clean air that lasts for the stranded personnel of fire disaster provide breathe, simultaneously, play the warning and make things convenient for the rescue personnel to confirm stranded person's position effect, can make stranded personnel avoid the harm that the blind flee and bring in smog poisoning and the fire disaster, extension rescue time promotes stranded personnel's survival probability greatly, moreover, the steam generator is simple in structure, convenient and practical.

title_en: Construction early warning device for oil extraction safety engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a construction early warning device for oil extraction safety engineering, which comprises a mounting plate, an electronic screen, an alarm, a camera, an illuminating lamp and a loudspeaker, wherein the mounting plate is provided with a plurality of mounting holes; the universal wheels are arranged, so that the device can be moved and mounted more easily and conveniently, the telescopic rod fixing device with the toothed nails can prevent toppling and can freely adjust the height, the device can be further stabilized by rotating the supporting rod at the rear part, and the knob and the fixing block can prevent the fixing equipment from being loosened easily; the camera is arranged, the real-time surrounding conditions can be known through the remote control end, the temperature measuring instrument can detect the real-time temperature, the illuminating lamp can provide a light source, and the electronic screen can be provided with reminding fonts, real-time information and the like; when the temperature measuring instrument detects that the temperature is too high or too low (or the camera monitors abnormal conditions), the processing signal passes through signal transmitter and reaches the remote control end, gives the siren simultaneously and makes the siren start, and staff's accessible control end shows warning information in the electronic screen to shout through the control end, pass to around by the megaphone.

title_en: Fire disaster and corona detection dual-purpose early warning system and method based on gallium oxide solar blind detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire and corona detection dual-purpose early warning system and method based on a gallium oxide solar blind detector. According to the invention, the device is placed at the position to be monitored, so that strong interference of sunlight on monitoring signals is not required to be considered, real-time remote monitoring can be carried out outdoors in all weather, and once fire or corona discharge occurs, the system can send out an alarm to timely inform related personnel to catch up with the place, thereby minimizing loss.
assignees: BEIJING JIAHE SEMICONDUCTOR CO LTD;GUANGZHOU HAICHUANG INDUSTRIAL TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Intelligent robot inspection management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent robot inspection management system which comprises a monitoring module, an identification module and a feedback prompt module, wherein the monitoring module comprises a multi-machine-position monitoring unit, a coal temperature monitoring unit and a loading weight monitoring unit, the monitoring module is used for monitoring railway loading, goods inspection and car inspection work, the identification module comprises a picture character identification unit and a car abnormality identification unit, the picture character identification unit is used for identifying carriage information, and the car abnormality identification unit is used for identifying whether the abnormal conditions of foreign matters at the bottom of a car, un-closing of a car door and un-entering of a carriage hasp exist or not through image information shot by the multi-machine-position monitoring unit. The invention can automatically monitor and manage abnormal conditions such as abnormal carriage coal temperature state, abnormal loading weight, foreign matters at the bottom of the carriage, non-closing of the carriage door, non-entering of the carriage hasp and the like through automatic identification and automatic early warning, does not need manual inspection, has high detection efficiency and small error, and avoids potential safety hazards caused by missed detection.
assignees: SHANGHAI LONGGANGTONG NEW MAT CO LTD

title_en: listening system comprising an alerting device and a listening device
abstract_en: A listening system that eases the acknowledgement of ‘alarm signals’, as e.g. issued by alarm indicators, in the environment of a user in difficult listening situations. The listening system is adapted to issue specific ALARM mode signals to the user corresponding to said external alarm signals, when said listening system is in an ALARM mode. An advantage of the present system is that a user is able to take notice of alarms from normal indicators even in case of a hearing impairment and/or when located in a noisy environment. The system may e.g. be used for the hearing instruments, ear protection devices, earphones, headsets or combinations thereof.
assignees: PETERSEN SVEND OSCAR;PEDERSEN METTE BOEL;ALDAZ GABRIEL;OTICON AS

title_en: Automatic switching from primary to secondary audio during emergency broadcast
abstract_en: An audio video display device (AVDD) includes a display, a processor controlling the display and a computer readable storage medium that is accessible to the processor. The computer readable storage medium bears instructions which when executed by the processor cause the processor to present, on the AVDD, AV content that is not associated with information pertaining to an emergency. The instructions cause the processor to receive, at the AVDD, data associated with an emergency alert and, responsive to receiving the data associated with the emergency alert, change audio presented on the AVDD from first audio presented on the AVDD and associated with the AV content to second audio associated the data to present the second audio. The second audio is presented on the AVDD automatically without receiving user input to change from the first audio to the second audio subsequent to receiving the data associated with the emergency alert.

title_en: Wireless neighborhood wildfire defense system network supporting proactive protection of life and property in a neighborhood through gps-tracking and mapping of environmentally-clean anti-fire (af) chemical liquid spray applied to the property before wild fires reach the neighborhood
abstract_en: A wireless wild fire defense system network supporting proactive protection of life and property in GPS-specified neighborhoods using GPS-managed delivery of environmentally-clean anti-fire (AF) chemical liquid spray to property before wild fire reaches the neighborhoods. The wireless system network includes a GPS system for providing GPS-location services to each system components in the wireless system network. A wireless communication network supports one or more network databases accessible by systems and devices deployed on the wireless communication network. A fleet of mobile GPS-tracked anti-fire liquid spraying systems are assigned to GPS-specified neighborhoods for spraying anti-fire chemical liquid on combustible property, buildings, and ground cover to inhibit fire ignition and flame spread wherever the anti-fire chemical liquid is sprayed. When allowed to dry, the anti-fire chemical liquid provides fire-protection status to sprayed property that is GPS-tracked and mapped within a network database maintained on the wireless communication network, recording wherever the environmentally-safe anti-fire chemical liquid has been spray applied. The system network includes mobile computing systems, each running a mobile application and deployed to a property owner, spray contractor or other stakeholder, such as firefighters and property insurance inspectors, for remotely monitoring the fire-protection status of property in any GPS-specified neighborhood, at any time on any specified date, along with the status of active wild fires surrounding the neighborhood. A command center deployed on the wireless system network transmits wild fire alerts and notifications and property spray orders, and supports microservices configured for monitoring and managing GPS-tracked spraying operations within GPS-specified neighborhoods. Through GPS-managed delivery of anti-fire chemical liquid spray on property surfaces before arrival of wild fire, fire ignition and flame spread are inhibited, and human and animal life and property are protected.

title_en: Integrated authorized public alert and artificial intelligence aided news and information aggregation, creation and distribution system and method for its use
abstract_en: An artificial Intelligence generated multilingual alerting and news creation and distribution system comprising a software and hardware system and method for their use, that act together to gather, aggregate, curate, verify, content, characterize, distribute and disseminate news content including follow-up i.e. for broadcast media distribution and wherein that system can generate and incorporate AI read news content optionally in multiple languages as a feature of the system. The invention relates to a fully integrated cloud-based broadcast system which has the ability to address and interact with external sources, including for example, Federal, State, and Local Emergency Operation Centers, including, EAS (Emergency Alert System), and IPAWS (Integrated Public Alert Warning System), as well as more local alert systems. The system is designed to provide safety protocols which include audio fingerprinting which the system uses for further authentication and verification of the audio files in an aspect of the invention.

title_en: Automobile safe driving control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile safe driving system, which comprises a driving state monitoring module: acquiring an image of a driver in a driving state and judging whether the driver is in dangerous driving; blind area radar monitoring module: judging whether potential safety hazards exist in the distance between the blind area barrier and the automobile or not; a lane departure control module: acquiring road condition information to judge whether a vehicle driving route deviates; the data recording and monitoring module: setting parameters to judge whether the automobile is in a safe driving state; safety early warning control module: after confirming that the driver is in a driving state with potential safety hazards, carrying out voice broadcast reminding on the driver; the central controller: the control system is used for controlling all modules in the automobile safe driving control system. Through the automobile safe driving system, a driver can feel potential safety hazards possibly existing in the driving process in real time, and the potential safety hazards are avoided in time, so that the driving safety is guaranteed.

title_en: A emergency bell-cctv integration system with enhanced event server
title_ko: 이벤트 서버가 구비되어 안정성을 높인 비상벨-cctv 통합 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency bell-CCTV integration system with enhanced stability by having an event server. The system comprises: an event monitoring device having an emergency bell device for generating a preset emergency bell signal as the emergency bell device is installed in a safety blind spot in a parking lot in a building to be operated by executing a user operation in an emergency situation, and a camera installed in the safety blind spot in the parking lot in the building to monitor and photograph a surrounding region and automatically connected to receive the emergency bell signal generated by the emergency bell device; a network video recorder (NVR) connected to the event monitoring device through a single network by using the network as a medium and provided to receive and display a monitoring image photographed by the camera of the event monitoring device and to process an emergency bell event for warning the emergency situation in response to the emergency bell signal generated by the emergency bell device of the event monitoring device and for performing an emergency call; and a central management system (CMS) installed in each security office to receive an emergency bell event signal including position information and image information according to emergency bell event generation from the NVR so as to quickly respond to the emergency situation as a guard moves to a region of the emergency bell device where the emergency call is generated.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 이벤트 서버가 구비되어 안정성을 높인 비상벨-CCTV 통합 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 이벤트 서버가 구비되어 안정성을 높인 비상벨-CCTV 통합 시스템으로서, 건물내주차장의 안전 사각지대에 설치되며, 위급상황 시에 사용자 조작 실행에 따라 구동되어 미리 설정된 비상벨 신호를 발생시키는 비상벨 장치와, 건물내주차장의 안전 사각지대에 설치되어 주변 지역을 감시 촬영하고, 상기 비상벨 장치에서 발생시키는 비상벨 신호를 수신하도록 자동 연결되는 카메라를 구비하는 이벤트 감시 장치; 상기 이벤트 감시 장치와 네트워크를 매개로 단일 망으로 연결 접속되며, 상기 이벤트 감시 장치의 카메라를 통해 촬영되는 감시 영상을 수신하여 디스플레이하고, 상기 이벤트 감시 장치의 비상벨 장치에서 발생시킨 비상벨 신호에 대응하여 비상상황 경고 및 비상 호출을 위한 비상벨 이벤트를 처리하기 위해 관제실에 구비되는 NVR(Network Video Recorder); 및 비상호출이 발생한 비상벨 장치의 해당 지역으로 경비원이 출동하여 위급상황에 신속한 대처가 가능하도록 상기 NVR로부터 비상벨 이벤트 발생에 따른 위치 정보와 영상 정보가 포함된 비상벨 이벤트 신호를 수신하기 위해 경비실에 각각 설치되는 CMS(Central Management System)를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 이벤트 서버가 구비되어 안정성을 높인 비상벨-CCTV 통합 시스템에 따르면, 양방향 통화 기능이 구비된 비상벨 장치를 카메라부의 오디오 보드에 연결하여 비상벨 신호를 수신하도록 하고, 단일 망으로 형성되는 네트워크를 매개로 NVR이 접속 연결되며, NVR에 연결되는 경비실에 구비되는 복수의 CMS를 포함하되, NVR에 이벤트 서버를 더 구성하여 N개의 이벤트 소스가 M개의 클라이언트에 동시 이벤트 전송이 가능하도록 구성함으로써, 비상벨 이벤트 발생이 손실 없이 안정적으로 전달되고, 그에 따른 비상벨-CCTV의 통합 운용 관리가 안전하게 관리 유지될 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 이벤트 서버에서 N개의 이벤트 소스가 M개의 클라이언트에 동시 이벤트 전송이 가능하도록 N:1:M으로 이벤트 송신 클라이언트와 이벤트 전송 처리부 및 이벤트 수신 클라이언트를 구성하되, 이벤트 전송 처리부의 입/출력단에 버퍼 큐를 구성하여 이벤트 손실 발생을 최소화하고, 셀프 와치 독 기능을 이벤트 전송 처리부에 구성함으로써, 프로그램 버그 시 자동으로 재시작 하도록 하여 동작의 연속성이 안정적으로 보장될 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명은, 범죄예방을 위한 안전 사각지대로 지목되는 건물내주차장에 설치되는 비상벨 장치와 카메라들의 배관/배선을 카메라 선로를 이용하여 시공 공정을 단순화하여 공정 원가를 절감하고, 또한 위급상황 시에 긴급호출을 통한 도움 요청과 함께 양방향 통화를 제공함으로써, 빈번하게 발생하는 안전 사각지대의 위험요소에 대한 신속하고 정확한 상황대처로 사고를 미연에 방지하며, 그에 따른 사용자의 불안감 해소와 안전한 생활공간 및 범죄를 사전에 예방할 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus for transmitting multilingual public arlt and method thereof
title_ko: 다국어 재난경보 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: An electronic device is disclosed. The electronic device comprises: a communication device for receiving a disaster alert message comprising a disaster code and a message; and a processor for controlling a communication device to generate a multilingual message, which translates a message included in the received disaster alert message into another language, and broadcast the message and the multilingual message.
abstract_ko: 전자 장치가 개시된다. 본 전자 장치는 재난 코드 및 메시지를 포함하는 재난 경보 메시지를 수신하는 통신 장치, 및 수신된 재난 경보 메시지에 포함된 메시지를 다른 언어로 번역한 다국어 메시지를 생성하고, 메시지 및 다국어 메시지가 방송되도록 통신 장치를 제어하는 프로세서를 포함한다.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for identifying external damage prevention of distribution overhead line
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-external-damage identification method, device, equipment and medium for a distribution overhead line. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an overhead line image to be identified; inputting the overhead line image to be identified into a pre-trained external damage prevention identification model to obtain an external damage area identification result and an external damage type; the method comprises the steps that a parallel segmentation subtask is added in a detection network by the anti-outward-breaking recognition model, an outward-breaking type is obtained through the detection network, an outward-breaking region recognition result is obtained through the parallel segmentation subtask, and the outward-breaking type comprises at least one of the following components: foreign matter short circuit, mechanical construction, violation construction, forest fire and smoke short circuit. According to the invention, the pre-trained external damage prevention recognition model is used for carrying out early warning and recognition on the external damage area of the distribution overhead line, so that the environment around the power grid is monitored in real time, abnormal conditions are rapidly found, the recognition accuracy is improved, and the input cost is reduced.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Deep mine rock burst risk grading early warning and active pressure relief system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep mine rock burst risk grading early warning and active pressure relief system and method, which relate to the technical field of rock burst risk early warning, and comprise multisource parameter sensing, risk grading early warning, active pressure relief execution, intelligent control centers and data storage and interaction modules, wherein real-time data interaction between the modules comprises a distributed sensor and a mobile inspection robot, the risk early warning is divided into four stages, sensitive characteristics are extracted after data are preprocessed, active pressure relief comprises fixed point and area pressure relief equipment, a control center uses a redundant framework, an automatic pressure relief scheme is matched, and data storage is reserved for more than or equal to 5 years so as to support multi-system butt joint. The method improves rock burst early warning accuracy and pressure relief pertinence, realizes multi-module closed loop coordination, has high emergency response efficiency, reduces false alarm omission and pressure relief blindness, ensures roadway stability and personnel safety, and provides support for safe and high-efficiency mining of deep mines.
assignees: SICHUAN CHUANYOU ENGINEERING TECH CONSULTING SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Warning system for hazard space in vessel and offshore facilities
title_ko: 선박 및 해양 설비 내의 위험지역 경고시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A dangerous area warning system is provided to effectively prevent a safety accident during a work in a vessel or a marine facility by warning that a corresponding area is dangerous to a boarder who approaches the dangerous area by using a sound or light. CONSTITUTION: A dangerous area warning system comprises an AP(140) which plays a role of a repeater which transmits a RFID tag(110) which is generated in a RFID wireless transceiver(120) to a situation room; and an administration computer(150) which receives RFID tag information. In case the RFID tag information which is attached to the safety helmet(100) of the boarder who approaches a dangerous area(S) is transmitted, the administration computer grasps the location information of the dangerous area which the information of the corresponding border approaches. In case whether the dangerous area is accessible or not is grasped and the border is not authorized, the warning system warns the access to the dangerous area by using a speaker(131) or a warning light(132) and prevents an accident by transmitting the corresponding information to a portable terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 선박 및 해양 설비 내의 위험지역 경고시스템에 관한 것으로, 그 목적은 미리 설정된 위험지역에 승선자가 접근할 때 해당 승선자에게 위험지역임을 소리나 빛 등을 이용하여 경고하여 줌으로써 안전사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있도록 한 선박 및 해양 설비 내의 위험지역 경고시스템을 제공함에 있다. 이를 위한 선박 및 해양 설비 내의 위험지역 경고시스템은 승선자의 안전모에 설치되며, 해당 승선자의 인적정보를 포함하는 RFID 태그; 선박 또는 해양 설비 내의 미리 설정된 위험지역에 설치되어 설정된 위험지역으로 승선자가 접근할 때, 승선자의 안전모에 설치된 상기 RFID 태그와 무선으로 송수신하는 기능을 수행하여 RFID 태그에 기록되어 있는 정보를 읽어 들이는 다수 개의 RFID 무선 송수신기; 및 상기 RFID 무선 송수신기와 RFID 태그에 의해 승선자가 위험지역으로 접근하는 것이 확인되면 소리 또는 빛을 발산하여 승선자에게 위험지역임을 경고하는 경고수단을 포함하는 것으로 구성된다.
assignees: HYUN DAI HEAVY IND CO LTD

title_en: Notification device for the deaf person
abstract_en: Disclosed is a notification device for a deaf person which notifies a type of a sensing sound through an identification media for a deaf person to enable the deaf person to recognize the sensing sound. The notification device for a deaf person comprises: a sound sensing unit for sensing a sound of the outside; a control unit for receiving a sound signal from the sound sensing unit, and outputting a notification signal based on the sound signal; and an output unit for outputting notification information corresponding to the sound of the outside according to the notification signal from the control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 청각장애인용 알림 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 청각장애인용 알림 장치는, 외부의 소리를 감지하는 소리감지부; 상기 소리감지부로부터 소리신호를 입력받아, 상기 소리신호에 기초하여 알림신호를 출력하는 제어부; 및 상기 제어부로부터의 알림신호에 따라 상기 외부의 소리에 대응하는 알림정보를 출력하는 출력부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Emergency disaster warning system using TTS
title_ko: 문자음성 변환을 이용한 재난 경보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster warning system using text-to-speech conversion. The disaster warning system of the present invention is the disaster warning system which notifies disaster information by sending a text message from a disaster management center to a user terminal. The system includes: a disaster information receiving unit for receiving disaster information by text message from the disaster management center; a user language analysis unit for analyzing the language used by the user in the user terminal from which disaster information is received; a text-to-speech conversion unit for converting the text of the disaster information received in the user terminal into a speech including the language analyzed by the user terminal; and a disaster information transmission unit for transmitting the disaster information voice converted by the text-to-speech conversion unit to the outside. The system is configured to notify the disaster information with a voice signal including a user language using the user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 문자음성 변환을 이용한 재난 경보 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 재난 경보 시스템은, 재난 관리 센터에서 사용자 단말기로 문자를 전송하여 재난정보를 알리는 재난 경보 시스템에 있어서, 상기 재난 관리 센터로부터 재난정보를 문자로 수신하는 재난정보 수신부, 재난정보가 수신되는 상기 사용자 단말기에서 사용자가 사용하는 언어를 분석하는 사용자 언어 분석부, 상기 사용자 단말기에 수신된 재난정보의 문자를 상기 사용자 단말기에서 분석된 언어를 포함하는 음성으로 변환하는 문자음성 변환부, 및, 상기 문자음성 변환부에서 변환된 재난정보 음성을 외부로 송출하는 재난정보 송출부를 포함하여, 상기 사용자 단말기를 사용하는 사용자 언어를 포함하는 음성 신호로 재난정보를 알리도록 구성된다.

title_en: Intelligent ducted unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent ducted unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a vision and control front end, a battery assembly, a power source upper part and an empennage guide tail part, wherein the intelligent ducted unmanned aerial vehicle uses a duct or a shaftless motor group to provide a power source, the control direction is controlled by 4 groups of guide vanes on the tail part in a matching way, the intelligent ducted unmanned aerial vehicle translates front and back, the intelligent ducted unmanned aerial vehicle rotates and reverses in situ, the direction control of the whole unmanned aerial vehicle takes a focus point of a binocular camera as an advancing direction, and the advancing direction is changed along with the change of the focus; the invention has no external screw propeller, has high safety factor, does not cause potential safety hazard to human bodies, can also be operated by contacting objects in close range, and does not cause damage to a rolling mill due to screw propeller collision; the whole machine is waterproof and sealed, and can work underwater; the user remotely operates and monitors, automatically sends a safety early warning to a user mobile terminal, and automatically patrols a preset path; and the built-in vision control panel can realize the family intelligent control interaction and can be used as a family robot pet.

title_en: Multilingual safety management broadcasting device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multilingual safety management broadcasting device for realizing more efficient site management, which comprises: an RF board having an RF module; a main board including a voice IC, an audio controller, an internal/external speaker amplifier, a CPU for performing a control operation, a mobile communication module, and an internal/external speaker for outputting a voice signal to the outside; and an emergency button for operating a warning light, and issuing an alarm for an emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 안전관리 방송장치에 관한 것으로서, 특히 마이크를 이용한 유선 또는 무전기 및 휴대폰을 이용한 무선에 의해 선택적으로 안전관리장치의 방송을 제어하고, 비상상황시 선택된 다국어로 안내방송을 출력함으로써, 보다 효율적인 현장관리를 구현하는 다국어 안전관리 방송장치에 관한 것이다.  이를 위해 본 발명은 외부의 무전기와 무선신호를 송·수신할 수 있도록 RF모듈이 구비된 알에프 보드(RF Board)와; 제어동작을 수행할 수 있도록 음성IC와, 오디오 콘트롤러와, 내·외부스피커 앰프와, 제어동작을 수행하는 CPU와, 이동통신모듈과, 음성신호를 외부로 출력하는 내·외부스피커가 구비된 메인 보드와; 경광등을 작동시키며 비상상황을 경보하는 비상버튼을 포함하여 구성되어, 스피커로 통해 안전관리 방송을 출력하고 경광등을 작동시키는 안전관리 방송장치에 있어서, 안전관리 방송장치에 구비된 비상버튼이 작동되는 경우 국가별 선택스위치에 의해 선택제어된 특정한 국가에 대한 국가별 안내방송을 순차적으로 내부스피커 및 외부스피커와 지정된 무전기로 출력하고, 지정된 휴대폰으로 긴급 안전문자를 발송하며, 무전기 또는 마이크 또는 휴대폰 중 어느 하나 이상에서 전달되는 음성신호에 의해 내부스피커 및 외부스피커와 지정된 무전기로 실시간 안전방송을 출력하되, 상기 안전관리방송장치에는 외부의 무전기를 안전관리 방송장치와 통신 가능한 상태로 등록하기 위한 주파수복사버튼이 구비되며, 외부의 무전기를 안전관리 방송장치(100)에 인접한 상태에서 송신을 하고, 안전관리 방송장치의 주파수복사버튼(108)을 작동하면, 상기 RF모듈이 주파수 스캔을 하여 무전기의 송신주파수를 검색하고, 그 주파수를 분석하여 안전관리 방송장치에 지정된 무전기로 저장하는 것을 특징으로 하는 다국어 안전관리 방송장치를 제안한다. 따라서, 본 발명은 유선 또는 무선에 의해 안전관리장치의 방송을 제어함에 있어서, 현재 발생된 비상상황에 따라 유선 또는 무선에 의해 효율적인 안전방송을 실현할 수 있고, 공사장이나 다중 이용 시설 등에 모여있는 다양한 국적의 사람들에게 모국어로 현재 상황을 인지할 수 있도록 방송함으로써, 안전사고의 피해를 최소화 할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Night alarm for senile dementia patient
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a night alarm for senile dementia patients, which comprises an induction belt and a signal emitter; one side of the signal emitter is connected with the induction belt through a wire, and the other side of the signal emitter is connected with the electric plug through a wire; the night alarm for the senile dementia patient has the advantages that the detection range is wide, the alarm is lagged and the missing report rate is low, and the harm caused by the missing report of the night alarm of the patient is effectively avoided; effectively avoid falling into of dust and foreign matter, improved the detectivity of long-time use, the warning is timely, and is effectual, can be applied to a plurality of positions in the patient room, and the application is good.

title_en: NM7000 type blind landing equipment FSK monitoring signal optical fiber transmission system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a NM7000 type blind landing equipment FSK monitoring signal optical fiber transmission system, including NM7000 equipment (1), FSK signal modem module, host system, TCP/IP network protocol communication module, network fiber transceiver, intelligence warning module (9) and NM7000 monitor (11), FSK signal modem module includes FSK signal modem module one (2) and FSK signal modem module two (10), host system includes host system one (3) and host system two (8), TCP/IP network protocol communication module includes TCP/IP network protocol communication module one (4) and TCP/IP network protocol communication module two (7), network fiber transceiver includes network fiber transceiver one (5) and network fiber transceiver two (6); the utility model can realize the conversion of analog signals into optical signals for transmission, avoid the influence of thunderstorm, and greatly improve the safety performance; and the running state of the equipment can be automatically judged, and the intelligent monitoring function is realized.

title_en: Building construction safety accident early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a construction safety accident early warning device, including casing and fixed plate, the equal fixedly connected with fixed plate in one side four corners department of casing, the one side top middle part fixedly connected with speaker of fixed plate is kept away from to the casing, the top middle part fixedly connected with warning light of casing, the equal sliding connection in both sides middle part of casing has a slide bar, two the equal fixedly connected with pull ring of one end of casing, two are kept away from to the slide bar the equal fixedly connected with trigger block of one end of pull ring is kept away from to the slide bar, the inside of casing and the corresponding fixedly connected with alarm switch of position department of trigger block. title_en: Alarm device of remote machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a remote mechanical alarm device, which belongs to the technical field of wireless control excavators and comprises a mounting plate, wherein a base is arranged above the mounting plate, an adjusting driving mechanism for driving the base to move up and down is arranged on the mounting plate, an alarm main body is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the base, a transparent shell is arranged at a position, opposite to the alarm main body, on the base, a protection frame is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the transparent shell, a first motor is fixedly arranged on the protection frame, and an output shaft of the first motor extends into the protection frame and is fixedly provided with a driving ring; through setting up the second motor, drive the screw rod and rotate when the second motor starts, drive the upward and downward movement of base when the screw rod rotates and realize the regulating action to alarm main part height, be convenient for use under multiple construction scene, accessible height-adjusting improves the warning effect, guarantees the timely processing of potential safety hazard, improves the security of job site.
assignees: LICHE SHANGHAI CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Mountain road sharp turn warning system based on photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of traffic safety, and particularly relates to a mountain road sharp turning warning system based on photovoltaic power generation, which comprises a detection device, a control system, a warning device and a photovoltaic energy supply system, wherein the detection device comprises two pairs of photoelectric switches respectively arranged at blind areas of visual fields at two sides of a corner of a mountain road; the warning device comprises an LCD display screen, a warning signal lamp and a sound warning module which are connected with the control system, and the photovoltaic energy supply system is used for converting solar energy into electric energy for storage and supplying power for other devices. The photoelectric switch converts signals of whether pedestrians or vehicles pass into voltage signals and transmits the voltage signals to the control system, and the control system controls the LCD display screen, the warning signal lamp and the sound alarm module to enter corresponding working states. According to the utility model, through comprehensive application of the photovoltaic technology, the photoelectric sensor technology and the singlechip technology, vehicles and pedestrians coming and going are timely and effectively warned, and the safety of mountain road turning is improved.

title_en: Intelligent workshop safety management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent workshop safety management system which comprises a personnel safety management subsystem, an equipment safety management subsystem, a video monitoring subsystem and a control center, wherein the personnel safety management subsystem comprises an intelligent safety helmet and AR glasses; the equipment safety management subsystem comprises a collision early warning component and an equipment fault warning component; the video monitoring subsystem comprises a workshop monitoring component, a foreign matter invasion monitoring component and a fire monitoring and early warning component; the control center comprises a control terminal and a cloud service platform. The intelligent workshop safety management system disclosed by the invention realizes the management functions of automatic monitoring, response, recording, analysis and the like of safety events such as workshop personnel, equipment, energy, disasters and the like, comprehensively and intelligently manages the workshop, ensures that the safety problem is effectively solved while the intelligent degree of the workshop is improved, and further improves the production efficiency of the workshop.

title_en: Mine dynamic disaster early warning method based on microseism monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine early warning, and particularly discloses a mine dynamic disaster early warning method based on microseism monitoring, wherein the mine dynamic disaster early warning device comprises a mounting base, a supporting frame is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting base, and a mounting mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the supporting frame; through adjusting the slide in the inboard slip of spout, slide inboard through the slide and slide into the spout, and then alright install the inboard of vertical guide rail with the microseism detector, the clamping spring resets and drives the fixture block and insert to the draw-in groove is inboard this moment, and then alright supplementary closure fixed slide, when the microseism detector needs to overhaul, the accessible pulling pull ring drives the even axle and draws the fixture block and contradicts clamping spring shrink, clamping spring shrink while the fixture block leaves the draw-in groove, the slide has lost the prescribing a limit this moment, alright be quick with the microseism detector follow vertical guide rail's inboard and take out for this equipment is wholly convenient for quick assembly disassembly overhauls.

title_en: Application method of intelligent zebra crossing early warning system for visual blind areas of construction channels
abstract_en: A method for using an intelligent zebra crossing early warning system for a visual blind area of a construction channel comprises the steps of carrying out deployment and use on an early warning system comprising a high-definition camera, an AI edge computing box, an integrated controller and an IP network loudspeaker, firstly installing the high-definition camera to fully cover the blind area range, installing the AI edge computing box, the integrated controller and the IP network loudspeaker at a proper position in an office area, establishing communication connection between the integrated controller and the AI edge computing box and between the integrated controller and the IP network loudspeaker, establishing data transmission connection between the AI edge computing box and the high-definition camera, training and optimizing collected engineering vehicle materials by the AI edge computing box, immediately generating a trigger signal when an engineering vehicle enters a designated area, transmitting the trigger signal to the integrated controller, and controlling the IP network loudspeaker to start and close a voice program. The application of the technology can be used for knowing the conditions of personnel and vehicles constructing the visual blind area of the channel in real time, and avoiding collision accidents caused by the response delay of the visual blind area or a driver.
assignees: GUANGXI ROAD CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Infrastructure based backup and exit aid
abstract_en: Infrastructure-based warning system having the ability to detect cross-traffic long before onboard vehicle sensors, and broadcast a basic safety message (BSM) including the vehicle's global position, velocity, heading, etc. over dedicated short-range communication (DSRC). A vehicle leaving a parking space is able to receive broadcast over DSRC from infrastructure and provide the driver with an HMI warning that it is unsafe to backup. A vehicle exiting from a blind alley way or parking garage may be positioned such that the driver of the vehicle may not see that there is a pedestrian about to cross and that there is cross-traffic. The infrastructure mounted sensor is able to detect the pedestrian and cross-traffic and broadcast their location, velocity, and headings. The vehicle receives the BSM from the infrastructure and provides the driver with an HMI warning that it is unsafe to move out into the crosswalk and road.

title_en: Baby car safe
abstract_en: The Baby Car Safe apparatus is comprised of a combination of a software application, a dongle for connection and integration with a motor vehicle, and / or a remote device with connectively attached controllable sensors assembled for these purposes: detecting the presence of a baby and / or another person occupying any seat within said motor vehicle; and exercising control over the door locks and electronically accessible systems of the vehicle to provide alerts issued as emanating from the vehicles lights, horn, or graphic display panels, or to communicate alerts issued from a wirelessly connected portable computing device capable of issuing any combination of visual, audio, and / or vibratory emanations therefrom, or to communicate alerts issued as automated phone alerts made to public safety response authorities to safely remove an unattended baby from the vehicle ensuring that no baby is left unattended in a motor vehicle.

title_en: Method for monitoring blind spot of cycle using smart helmet for cycle rider and blind spot monitoring device using them
title_ko: 바이크 라이더용 스마트 헬멧을 이용하여 바이크의 블라인드 스팟을 모니터링 하는 방법 및 이를 이용한 블라인드 스팟 모니터링 장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 바이크 라이더용 스마트 헬멧을 이용하여 블라인드 스팟(Blind Spot)을 모니터링하는 방법에 있어서, 블라인드 스팟 모니터링 장치는, (a) 스마트 헬멧에 대응되는 제1 블라인드 스팟의 영상 이미지(Video Image)가 획득되면, 객체 검출기로 하여금 영상 이미지 상의 객체를 검출하도록 하고, 제1 블라인드 스팟에 위치하는 제1 객체를 확인하는 단계; 및 (b) 스마트 헬멧에 설치된 GPS 센서, 가속력 센서, 및 지자기 센서(Geomagnetic Sensor) 중 일부로부터 획득되는 센서 정보를 참조하여 스마트 헬멧 방향 및 바이크 주행 방향을 판단하고, 스마트 헬멧 방향과 바이크 주행 방향을 참조하여 제1 객체 중 바이크에 대응되는 제2 블라인드 스팟에 위치하는 제2 객체를 확인하고, 제2 객체를 상기 스마트 헬멧에 설치된 헤드업 디스플레이(Head Up Display; HUD)를 통해 표시하거나, 제2 블라인드 스팟에 제2 객체가 위치하고 있음을 스피커를 통해 소리로 경보(Alarm)하는 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Accessible precaution device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of accessible precaution devices, and column is vertically connected on the mounting plate for be supported in bottom surface, are equipped with cabinet at the top of column, in the surrounding flashing light of cabinet, are equipped with radar inductor in the bottom of cabinet；Switching Power Supply, voice plate and loudspeaker are respectively equipped in the inside of cabinet, wherein Switching Power Supply is respectively that voice plate, loudspeaker, radar inductor and flashing light provide power supply, the output data line of radar inductor is connect with the signal input part of voice plate, and the speech output end of voice plate is connect by data line with loudspeaker and each flashing light.The accessible precaution device can detect that someone or vehicle pass through by radar sensor at any time, so that alarm is issued, to prompt vehicular traffic or pedestrian, to play the role of security warning.
