title_en: Warning protector for radiology department
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of warning and protecting devices, and particularly relates to a warning and protecting device for a radiology department; the electric translation door comprises a control center, a door body, a fixed wall body and a warning device, wherein the door body is of an electric translation door structure, the door body is made of lead, the door body is embedded into a fixed groove formed in the fixed wall body, and an electric driving device is arranged at the joint of the door body and the fixed groove; according to the invention, the external air source is started by the control center to supply air to the inside of the first air bag, so that the first air bag is pressurized to expand and extrudes the first plate to move to drive the extrusion block to extend out of the first hole, and at the moment, the surface of the warning block becomes uneven under the action of the extended extrusion block, so that a patient or a child lying on the surface of the door body feels uncomfortable, and the patient or the child is prevented from continuously lying on the surface of the door body, is prevented from being warned and leaves the door body, and the safety of people waiting outside is ensured.

title_en: Intelligent identification method, device and equipment for safety in building site
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of building safety identification, and relates to a method, a device and equipment for intelligently identifying safety in a building site, which comprises the following steps: identifying the area where the second image data is located, setting a risk coefficient for each area, marking the area as a dangerous area when the risk coefficient is greater than a preset risk coefficient threshold value, and obtaining the position of the dangerous area; calculating an actual danger range based on the position of the danger area; obtaining the real-time coordinate position of the human body image from the second image data to obtain a first coordinate value, and calculating the displacement according to the actual danger range and the first coordinate value; according to the invention, the effective working range of the building equipment is obtained through the big data network, the actual danger range is calculated, the safety assessment precision in the building site is higher, the closer the constructor is to the effective working range of the building equipment, the higher the danger level warning is sent out, and the safety accidents caused by the construction site noise and the synchronous influence of the visual field blind area in the construction process can be effectively avoided.
assignees: DONGYING GUSTELL BUILDING SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY

title_en: Vehicle blind area early warning method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle blind area early warning method, a vehicle blind area early warning system and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring vehicle running information of a target vehicle, and determining a vehicle running state of the target vehicle according to the vehicle running information; determining a target detection device for detecting a vehicle blind area of the target vehicle according to the vehicle running state, and acquiring target detection information of the vehicle blind area through the target detection device; generating a blind area early warning instruction according to the target detection information and the vehicle running information, and controlling target early warning equipment of the target vehicle to perform early warning according to the blind area early warning instruction. The method and the device realize accurate monitoring of the obstacles in the vehicle visual field blind spot area under the vehicle running state under the influence of different factors, and timely early warning is carried out aiming at the running states of the obstacles and the vehicle, so that potential traffic accident danger is avoided.

title_en: Electric power meteorological disaster is control platform for early warning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of meteorological disaster early warning, and discloses a control platform for electric meteorological disaster early warning, which comprises a main body mechanism, a supporting mechanism and a base mechanism, wherein the supporting mechanism is positioned below the main body mechanism, and the base mechanism is positioned below the supporting mechanism; the main part mechanism includes install bin, circuit board, gravity sensor, bears dish and monitor, circuit board fixed mounting is in the inside of install bin, gravity sensor fixed mounting is on the right side of install bin, bear dish fixed mounting in gravity sensor's upper end, bear dish and install bin activity laminating. This control platform is used in electric power meteorological disaster early warning has installed remote alarm structure in the circuit board, and alarm structure is automatic to the headquarters to report to the police when gravity sensor monitors that numerical value reaches a certain amount after, and headquarters personnel accessible monitor probe pipeline sees the disaster of installation department, has improved the supervision dynamics, and the instantaneity is stronger.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Fire control electrical control cabinet and early warning system with high temperature early warning function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting electrical control cabinet with a high-temperature early warning function and an early warning system, which comprise an electrical cabinet body and a component mounting rack arranged at the position close to the back inside the electrical cabinet body, wherein two groups of vertical fan assemblies are arranged in front of the electrical cabinet body, a positioning assembly capable of driving the fan assemblies to move relatively or oppositely is arranged below the inner part of the electrical cabinet body, threaded metal rods are arranged on two sides of the electrical cabinet body, and two groups of fan assemblies capable of being aligned to the component mounting rack in the front are arranged in the fire-fighting electrical control cabinet, so that the heat dissipation effect on electronic components is improved; temperature sensor, wireless transmitter and controller have been set up, and temperature sensor accessible controller and wireless transmitter carry out high temperature early warning to master control cabinet, and then the whole regulator cubicle main part outage of master control cabinet control, have set up the screw thread metal pole, and screw thread metal pole temperature is lower, and the air of damp and hot can condense into the water droplet on the screw thread metal pole to down along the screw thread, play the effect of dehumidification.
assignees: NANTONG EIDSON MACHINERY ELECTRONICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Highway construction safety accident early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway construction safety accident early warning system and a highway construction safety accident early warning method, which relate to the technical field of highway construction and comprise a monitoring center, wherein the monitoring center is in communication connection with a data detection module, a data processing module, a data analysis module, an early warning module and a feedback module, the environmental parameters of a construction highway field are acquired through setting the data detection unit, the light intensity of a construction highway area is judged through analyzing the environmental parameters of the construction highway field, and then personnel and vehicles entering at two ends of the construction highway are monitored through a ranging unit, so that the situation that non-construction personnel and vehicles cannot quickly find the construction field due to poor light intensity and enter the construction field by mistake is avoided, and potential safety hazards caused to the construction field and construction personnel on the construction field due to the fact that foreign personnel or vehicles enter the construction field by mistake are avoided.

title_en: Active earthquake early warning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses active earthquake early warning equipment, and relates to the field of earthquake early warning. The system comprises a built-in signal receiving module, a satellite positioning module, a data analysis module, an early warning signal output module and a dual-mode power supply module. The active earthquake early warning device integrates the analysis processing of earthquake information, the output of early warning information and the early warning emission, obtains the early warning information after the analysis processing of the information by receiving the earthquake information sent by the earthquake table network and combining with positioning data, and emits the early warning to an installation place, thereby realizing the active earthquake early warning. The active earthquake early warning device solves the defects that the construction difficulty of an earthquake early warning system is high, the cost is high, the coverage area is limited, early warning blind areas exist, early warning terminal equipment can work only by passively receiving early warning information sent by an earthquake early warning center and the like in the existing earthquake early warning mode by a ready-to-install and ready-to-use working mode and analysis processing capability of earthquake information, so that full-coverage earthquake early warning without blind areas can be realized, and popularization and application of earthquake early warning service are facilitated.

title_en: Stability monitoring method and system for offshore wind power pile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stability monitoring method and a system for an offshore wind power pile, which relate to the technical field of offshore wind power piles, the method comprises the steps of step one, wind farm stability data acquisition, step two, wind farm stability analysis, step three, wind farm stability monitoring and early warning. The working operation of each working condition of the offshore wind power pile is evaluated to accord with the index, each abnormal working condition of the offshore wind power pile is screened, the limitation of traditional experience judgment is broken, the accumulation of small hidden dangers into large faults is avoided, the safety of the offshore wind power plant is improved, the shutdown loss and the maintenance cost caused by structural failure are reduced, the stable state of the offshore wind power pile is analyzed, early warning prompt is carried out, the safety and the reliability of the operation of the wind power plant are improved, the pile body damage or the shutdown of the wind power plant caused by the abnormal working condition deterioration are avoided, the economic loss is reduced, and the blind inspection and ineffective operation are reduced.
assignees: HUANENG RUDONG BAXIANJIAO OFFSHORE WIND POWER GENERATION CO LTD;NANJING HYDRAULIC RES INST;HUANENG POWER INT JIANGSU ENERGY DEVELOPMENT CO LTD CLEAN ENERGY BRANCH

title_en: GIS switch monitoring and early warning method and system based on blind source separation
abstract_en: The application relates to a GIS switch monitoring and early warning method and system based on blind source separation, which belong to the technical field of power equipment state monitoring, and the method comprises the steps of collecting opening and closing vibration signals through a sensor array arranged on a GIS switch; the method comprises the steps of adopting a blind source separation algorithm to decompose a mixed vibration signal into a plurality of independent source signals which are strongly related to a specific physical action process, carrying out wavelet energy entropy calculation on each independent source signal, extracting characteristic quantities reflecting the states of corresponding mechanical parts, establishing a health state evolution model based on the characteristic quantities, and carrying out multistage early warning by tracking the change trend of the characteristic quantities. The application effectively solves the problems of mutual interference of vibration signals and easy inundation of fault characteristics in the traditional method, remarkably improves the monitoring sensitivity and early warning capability of micro faults, can accurately position fault components, and provides reliable technical support for realizing the predictive maintenance of the GIS switch.
assignees: FUZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

abstract_en: The present invention provides a hearing-impaired assistance system and a device thereof. The hearing-impaired assistance system according to an exemplary embodiment includes: a first user terminal that is wearable on a body of a hearing-impaired user and generates a notification according to pre-arrival notification information received from the outside; a second user terminal that transmits a pre-arrival notification request including destination information and transportation means information input by the user, transmits the user's location information, and receives pre-arrival notification information corresponding to the pre-arrival notification request from the outside and transmits the same to the first user terminal; and a service device that receives a pre-arrival notification request and the user's location information from the second user terminal, respectively, generates pre-arrival notification information based on the pre-arrival notification request and the user's location information, and transmits the pre-arrival notification information to the second user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 청각 장애인 보조 시스템 및 장치가 개시된다. 예시적인 실시예에 따른 청각 장애인 보조 시스템은, 청각 장애인인 사용자의 신체에 착용 가능하게 마련되고, 외부로부터 수신되는 도착 전 알림 정보에 따라 알림을 발생시키는  제1 사용자 단말기, 사용자로부터 입력되는 목적지 정보 및 교통 수단 정보를 포함하는 도착 전 알림 요청을 전송하고, 사용자의 위치 정보를 전송하며, 외부로부터 도착 전 알림 요청에 대응하는 도착 전 알림 정보를 수신하여 제1 사용자 단말기로 전송하는 제2 사용자 단말기, 및 제2 사용자 단말기로부터 도착 전 알림 요청 및 사용자의 위치 정보를 각각 수신하고, 도착 전 알림 요청 및 사용자의 위치 정보를 기반으로 도착 전 알림 정보를 생성하며, 도착 전 알림 정보를 제2 사용자 단말기로 전송하는 서비스 장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Emergency warning method and system for warning a caretaker
abstract_en: Emergency warning method and system for warning a caretaker. A position of a subject is determined by receiving an emergency message from a locator (20) upon actuation of an emergency button (21), the emergency message comprising location data and identification data. The identification data and location data are translated in a verbal message, and the verbal message is sent to a personal communication device (16) in the possession of the caretaker after reception of the emergency message from the locator (20).

title_en: Wearable device for collecting physiological health data
abstract_en: One or more techniques and/or systems are disclosed for collecting vital physiological health data from a user, using a wearable device, such as a watch. The data can comprise heart rate, blood oxygen, body temperature, blood pressure, and fall detection, amongst others. The collected data can be translated to information presented to the user on a local device, such as a smart phone, and/or provided to a remote device or service and integrated into an electronic medical record, be used by the user's clinicians, and can help detect alert situations of the user. Such a wearable device may also be used to detect user activity, and/or fall detection, and provide emergency alerts to medical and emergency personnel.

title_en: Warning light assembly
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a warning light assembly which visually warns a fire occurring state when a safety accident, especially a fire, occurs. More specifically, the present invention relates to a warning light assembly which comprises: a housing; a warning unit provided in the housing, and visually representing a warning signal; and a cover unit coupled to the housing to protect the warning unit. A packing member is provided in the housing to perform waterproof and dustproof functions by sealing a crack between the cover unit and the housing, thereby preventing water or a foreign material from being inserted inside the housing so as to continuously transmit the warning signal when the first occurs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 안전사고, 특히 화재 발생 시 화재의 발생여부를 시각적으로 경고하는 표시등 어셈블리 어셈블리에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 하우징과, 상기 하우징에 구비되어 경고신호를 시각적으로 나타내는 경보유닛 및 상기 경보유닛을 보호하도록 하우징에 결합되는 커버유닛을 포함하여 이루어지되, 상기 하우징에는 상기 커버유닛과 하우징 사이의 틈새를 막아 방수, 방진기능을 수행하는 패킹부재를 구비하여 화재 발생 시, 하우징 내부에 물이나 이물질이 투입되는 것을 방지하여 지속적으로 경보신호를 송출할 수 있는 표시등 어셈블리에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Emergency data management and access system
abstract_en: Described herein are systems, servers, devices, methods, and media for providing and managing access to emergency data. In some embodiments, a method for managing access to emergency data for emergency service providers by an emergency management system includes the steps of: determining a first set of data categories to be made accessible to an emergency service provider (ESP), wherein the first set of data categories is selected from a second set of data categories; detecting an emergency alert from an electronic device; associating the ESP with the emergency alert; gathering emergency data associated with the emergency alert available for the first set of data categories; and securely transmitting, to the ESP, the emergency data associated with the emergency alert available for the first set of data categories.

title_en: Road construction fence
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a road construction rail relates to town road construction technical field, and this road construction rail includes: two upright posts and a baffle plate; two the stand interval sets up, the baffle both sides respectively with two the stand is connected, just the upper portion of baffle is equipped with perspective window, perspective window is the network structure of hyaline tube cross formation, the embedded warning light that is equipped with of hyaline tube. The embodiment of the utility model provides an in the road construction rail, warning light remind passerby or driver should locate to be the turning crossing, and the perspective window can help passerby or driver to observe whether there is passerby or vehicle in the turning crossing that the rail sheltered from, has reduced passerby or driver's field of vision blind area, has reduced traffic safety accident's risk.

title_en: Multifunctional fire emergency rescue warning disposal vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-functional fire emergency rescue warning processing car, its technical scheme is: handle one side of car bed frame and install the direction bed frame, handle the top movable mounting of car bed frame and have flexible pull rod, the direction pull rod is installed to one side of flexible pull rod, the protection rubber sleeve is installed on the top of flexible pull rod. Through the disposition car bed frame that sets up, flexible pull rod and storage dish, can be used to carry the use to the warning awl to practice thrift the time when warning is kept apart greatly, the regional arrangement efficiency of warning that improves can contract folding use between flexible pull rod and the disposition car bed frame through setting up, can be used to carry out supporting use along with the fire engine, can be used to stabilize the warning awl and stack the use through the fixed cone frame of warning awl that sets up, the warning area storage dish that the accessible set up is used for installing the use to the warning area.

title_en: Intelligent alarm system based on human body gravitation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an alarm device technical field specifically is an intelligent alarm system based on human gravitation, including rail and box, the inside of rail is hollow structure, the human gravitation detector of AI is all installed with inboard bottom at the inboard top of rail, the inside of rail is provided with the vibrating cable, the below fixed mounting of the inside rear side of box has vibration cable collector, the one end of vibrating cable extends to the inside of box and with vibration cable collector connects, the inside rear side fixed mounting of box has the controller, one side fixed mounting of rail front below has the alarm. The utility model has the characteristics of can receive the harm back can inform the defence personnel fast to and defence personnel accessible speaker carries out speech warning to the intruder, improves the effect of deterring.

title_en: Engineering is managed and is used safety warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety warning device for engineering supervision, which relates to the technical field of engineering management and comprises a connecting shell, wherein assembly grooves are formed in two sides of the bottom end of the connecting shell, positioning shafts are arranged in the two assembly grooves, mounting frames are arranged on the two positioning shafts, and display panels are arranged on the opposite sides of the two mounting frames. This kind of engineering is managed and is used safety warning device installs two mounting brackets side by side in the bottom of connecting the casing, can realize being the splayed with two mounting brackets or be horizontal distribution, accessible support frame places ground when two mounting brackets are the splayed distribution, and warning through display panel demonstration relevant warning sign or picture, and cooperate the audible and visual warning of warning light area and speaker, play better safety warning effect, two solar cell panel sets up and can be used to charge when two mounting brackets are horizontal distribution, make this kind of engineering manage and use safety warning device's function more, the service scene is richer.

title_en: Intelligent building management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building intelligent management systems, and discloses a building intelligent management system which comprises a central control system, a wireless communication module, a cloud server, a client, an access control subsystem, a monitoring subsystem, a data acquisition subsystem and an early warning subsystem; the central control system is in communication connection with the wireless communication module, the wireless communication module is in communication connection with the cloud server, and the cloud server is in communication connection with the client; the data acquisition subsystem is in communication connection with the wireless communication module, and the early warning subsystem is in communication connection with the wireless communication module; and the entrance guard subsystem is in communication connection with the wireless communication module. The building management system is more intelligent and comprehensive, can improve better service, can identify the foreign personnel in the community in time, and well guarantees the safety of people.
assignees: SHAANXI TIANYUN XUANYUE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dangerous chemical leakage personnel evacuation management method, system, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, in particular to a dangerous chemical leakage personnel evacuation management method, a dangerous chemical leakage personnel evacuation management system, electronic equipment and a dangerous chemical leakage personnel evacuation management medium, wherein the dangerous chemical leakage personnel evacuation management method comprises the steps of dividing areas of a park, and carrying out corresponding numbering and position association on leakage monitoring modules in the divided areas; when monitoring data are obtained to judge leakage of dangerous chemicals, analyzing and obtaining the position of a target leakage area and an evacuation route; the method comprises the steps of sending a protection product scheduling instruction to a protection product scheduling module and early warning and evacuating information in each factory to a broadcast early warning and evacuating module in each internal and external area of each factory, obtaining monitoring data through automatic regional monitoring, planning a route avoiding a leakage area, carrying out path walking voice prompt along the evacuation route, simultaneously carrying out protection product scheduling on the leakage area, and carrying out on-line protection product or rapid evacuation on personnel according to the voice prompt, so that personnel can be prevented from blindly escaping, the optimal rescue and evacuating time can be missed, and the occurrence probability of major safety accidents can be reduced.
assignees: SICHUAN HONGHE SHUZHI GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Road safety machine vision detection system and method for sanitation operation vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for detecting the road safety machine vision of an environmental sanitation vehicle, wherein the system comprises a vision detection system body, the vision detection system body comprises a road detection platform, a vehicle self-detection platform, a vehicle management platform and a vision management platform, the road detection platform detects the road, the environment and the pedestrian behavior of the environmental sanitation vehicle in real time, the vehicle self-detection platform detects the condition of the environmental sanitation vehicle before driving in real time, the vision management platform is arranged to seamlessly splice the surrounding image of the vehicle body into a bird's eye view image, a real-time omnibearing visual angle is provided for a driver of the environmental sanitation vehicle, the phenomenon of incomplete cleaning and even safety accidents caused by visual blind areas is avoided, the real-time detection and early warning are respectively carried out on pedestrians, vehicles, road shapes and traffic conditions through the road detection platform, the threat brought by the visual blind areas is reduced, and the safety driving of the environmental sanitation vehicle is effectively ensured.
assignees: ZHS BEAUTIFUL URBAN AND RURAL AREAS SANITATION GROUP CO

title_en: Intelligent network-connected automobile vision blind area active deceleration control method and system based on dynamic safety distance
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent network-connected automobile vision blind area active deceleration control method and system based on a dynamic safety distance, comprising a sensing layer, a decision layer and an execution layer, wherein the sensing layer is used for collecting and fusing multi-source data in real time, constructing a dynamic blind area model and identifying potential barriers in the blind area; the decision layer is used for evaluating the risk level based on the perception data, calculating the dynamic safety distance and generating a deceleration instruction, and the execution layer is used for executing the deceleration instruction and realizing man-machine cooperative control. The intelligent network-connected automobile vision blind area active deceleration control method and system based on the dynamic safety distance break through the limitation that the traditional BSD system only performs early warning and does not control, realize multi-source data fusion sensing and quick response through a 'sensing-decision-executing' layered cooperative framework, actively decelerate and directly intervene in the running of the automobile, obviously reduce collision risk in the blind area and solve the potential safety hazard caused by the response delay of a driver.

title_en: Translating apparatus for fire fighting equipments
abstract_en: The present invention relates to relay equipment for firefighting equipment. The relay equipment includes: a main body installed in a fire hydrant; a circuit part installed inside the main body; a first terminal block electrically connected to the circuit part and connected to a first connection part exposed to one side of the main body by an R-type receiver and a first cable; a second terminal block electrically connected to the circuit part and connected to a second connection part exposed to one side of the main body by a sensing part, a notification part, and a second cable; and a first connector installed on one side of the main body and electrically connected to the circuit part, and having one side exposed to the outside of the main body, and a second connector having one end coupled to the first connector in a male and female form, and having a transmitter and a display part connected by a third cable.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방설비의 중계장치에 관한 것으로, 소화전에 설치되는 본체와, 상기 본체의 내부에 설치되는 회로부와, 상기 회로부에 전기적으로 연결되고, 상기 본체의 일측으로 노출된 제1접속부가 R형 수신기와 제1케이블에 의해 연결되는 제1단자대와, 상기 회로부에 전기적으로 연결되고, 상기 본체의 일측으로 노출된 제2접속부가 감지부와 알림부와 제2케이블에 의해 연결되는 제2단자대 및, 상기 본체의 일측에 설치되어 상기 회로부와 전기적으로 연결되고, 일측이 상기 본체의 외부로 노출되는 제1커넥터 및, 일측이 상기 제1커넥터와 암수로 결합되고, 발신부와 표시부가 제3케이블에 의해 연결되는 제2커넥터를 포함한다.

title_en: Security equipment, and security equipment arrangement method
abstract_en: Provided are a security equipment, which is enabled to exhibit high crime-preventing effects in the temporary scaffold of a jobsite or in the blind spot of a building, by threatening a trespasser in a manner to make the trespasser feel anxious or fear and by informing the presence of the trespasser to the circumference, and an arrangement structure for the security equipment.   The security equipment (10) activates a human sensor (18), in case the brightness of the circumference detected by a light sensor (16) is at or lower than a preset level, thereby to decide the presence/absence of the trespasser.  In case the presence of the trespasser is detected by the human sensor (18), a warning is issued by lighting or flashing an illumination light (12) and by generating an alarm sound.  Moreover, the security equipments (10) are so arranged in a predetermined region that at least one of them is activated in case the trespasser (40) trespasses on that predetermined region.

title_en: Moving robot and control method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates a moving robot and a method for controlling thereof, and specifically, the moving robot and the method are configured to monitor a cleaning area by taking images while moving a plurality of areas based on a map of the cleaning area, and monitor in a plurality of areas or a dedicated specific area, and monitor overall areas by taking images while rotating at a monitoring location by dedicating the monitoring location in the area, and set a specific location in an area as a monitoring location, and cause taking of images to be performed at a specific angle by dedicating a monitoring direction in the monitoring location, and perform monitoring of a plurality of areas with minimal movement, and perform an effective monitoring because taking images in a blind spot may be performed by changing the monitoring location or adding a monitoring location based on information on an obstacle, and set a schedule to perform monitoring at a dedicated time, and detect invasion by recognizing the obstacle through analyzing of the images, and output an alert message or signal if the invasion is detected, and transmit a signal or message associated with the invasion detection, and thus a security function can be strengthened.

title_en: For the wireless relay module with alarm and the remote monitoring system of display function
abstract_en: Alarm identification and warning are realized the invention discloses wireless relay module, in a series of be used to carry out between medical devices and long-distance monitorng device via wireless relay network and/or internet-accessible cordless communication network connected network communication.The wireless relay module includes receiver；First transmitter is connected to the wireless relay network；Second transmitter is connected to the internet-accessible cordless communication network；Controller；And display.Whether the medical device data that the controller identification is received from the medical device includes alarm condition and therefore makes the display display warning.Furthermore the wireless relay module can only include loudspeaker or include the loudspeaker with microphone combination, the microphone is used to provide the audible alert of alarm condition and provides verbal message between the clinician at local healthcare provider and the long-distance monitorng device.

title_en: V2X-based vehicle blind area pedestrian sensing and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle blind area pedestrian sensing and early warning method and system based on V2X, wherein a host vehicle obtains pedestrian motion state information in a blind area through an environment sensing system of a shielding vehicle and drive test equipment and a V2X communication module, and the probability of traffic accidents is reduced by combining the environment sensing system and the V2X module. The classical asymmetric cryptographic algorithm, namely RSA algorithm, is used for encrypting and decrypting the information, so that malicious network attack is prevented, and the normal communication and information safety of the host vehicle and the shielding workshop are ensured. Finally, respectively calculating the longitudinal TTCs and the transverse TTCs to judge collision risks, and when the collision is judged to be possible, sequentially starting an indicator lamp system, a driver warning system and an active braking system by the pedestrian protection system according to the collision time TTCs of the vehicles and the pedestrians and the time threshold value of no collision of the vehicles, so as to realize graded early warning. The invention can effectively predict the relative position between the pedestrians and the vehicles in the beyond-vision scene, reduce hidden danger caused by blind areas and realize the functions of early warning and active collision avoidance.

title_en: Early warning system and device for shield tunnel storage battery car
abstract_en: The application provides an early warning system and device for a shield tunnel storage battery car, wherein the early warning system comprises a monitoring sensor subsystem, a data transmission subsystem, a data processing subsystem, a safety early warning subsystem and an auxiliary support subsystem, the monitoring sensor subsystem is used for resolving the real-time position of the storage battery car, measuring the real-time speed and mileage of the storage battery car and acquiring a real-time image of a running environment, and the data processing subsystem is used for determining the real-time distance between the storage battery car and a hole based on the data acquired by the monitoring sensor subsystem, identifying whether barriers and/or pedestrians exist around the storage battery car based on the real-time image and controlling the safety early warning subsystem to display and early warn the running state of the storage battery car. The application can realize the positioning of the storage battery car, identify obstacles and pedestrians in the running environment of the storage battery car, prompt and early warn the running state of the storage battery car, reduce hidden danger of overspeed and vision blind areas of the storage battery car and improve the efficiency and safety of tunnel operation.

title_en: Petroleum well drilling engineering accidents early-warning system based on layered fuzzy system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an oil drilling engineering accident early warning system based on a hierarchy fuzzy system. First, a stimulant database for oil drilling engineering accident early warning is created; second, an input variable for oil drilling engineering accident early warning; third, the characteristic information of input signals is analyzed; fourth, a structural model of the hierarchy fuzzy system is created; fifth, an interval mapping and a hierarchy fuzzy reasoning of a unified model are done for the input variable in the third step; sixth, the output quantity of the oil drilling engineering accident early warning system is confirmed; seventh, the self-adjustment of the early warning result is done. The present invention has the advantages that the hierarchy fuzzy system is used to translate the excessive physical variable in the oil drilling engineering accident early warning system into a hierarchy system formed by connecting hierarchically with a reduced dimensionality fuzzy unit, and make the regular number of the fuzzy system increase with the number of the input variable linearly, thereby putting an end to the phenomenal of dimension calamity, and realizing the purpose of early warning for the oil drilling engineering accident accurately, efficiently and conveniently.

title_en: Device and method for monitoring mountain tourist attraction based on radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster early warning equipment, and provides equipment and a method for monitoring mountain tourist attractions based on radar, wherein the equipment comprises a support column, a spherical shell and related components; the support column is anchored in the slope bedrock and provided with a first blind hole, and a first negative pressure pipe and a negative pressure rod are connected inside the support column; the spherical shell consists of a hemispherical base and a cover body, and a sealing ring is arranged at the joint. The outer side of the base is provided with a limit column which is inserted into the first blind hole and is provided with a through hole and a one-way valve which are connected with the second negative pressure pipe; the equipment is internally provided with a lifting component, radar equipment, a GPS positioning module, a wireless communication module, a power supply and a central controller; the central controller is connected with each module to realize the monitoring function. The invention can monitor the condition of mountain tourist attractions by radar technology, and transmit data by wireless communication, and has higher reliability and stability.

title_en: Microwave radar blind spot monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of radar monitoring, in particular to a microwave radar blind spot monitoring system, which comprises a detection unit, a modeling unit, a data processing unit and a driving unit, wherein the detection unit is used for detecting the blind spot of a microwave radar: the driving unit is used for driving the running state of the vehicle and the steering wheel to deviate; the detection unit is used for detecting the running road condition of the vehicle and generating road condition information; the modeling unit determines road condition categories according to the road condition information; the data processing unit generates corresponding road condition indexes for the detection information according to different road condition categories, and correspondingly generates prompt information or early warning information, so that the occurrence probability of driving safety accidents caused by visual blind areas in driving can be reduced, and the driving safety is improved.

title_en: Excavator operation safety monitoring method based on visual assistance and laser radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing and provides an excavator operation safety monitoring method based on visual assistance and a laser radar, which comprises the steps of acquiring monitoring images of continuous frames in the excavator operation process through a vehicle-mounted camera and acquiring three-dimensional point cloud data at a plurality of moments through the laser radar; the method comprises the steps of obtaining target movement degrees of all areas, screening and obtaining a plurality of moving targets and obtaining moving sequences of the moving targets, obtaining target influence degrees of all the moving targets at all moments, obtaining comprehensive influence degrees of the moving targets, screening interference targets based on the comprehensive influence degrees, combining moving sequences corresponding to all the vehicle-mounted cameras to obtain interference sequences of the interference targets, and carrying out collision early warning through an audible and visual alarm according to the interference targets and the interference sequences of the interference targets to realize safety monitoring of excavator operation. The invention aims to solve the problem that the error recognition problem of the computer vision and the laser radar can interfere the accuracy of fusion results on blind areas and collision detection.

title_en: Abrasive material recycling system
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An abrasive material recycling system is provided to protect workers from an industrial accident by maintaining a clean work site and to improve the durability of the abrasive material recycling system by minimizing impact and overload which occurs in the separation process. CONSTITUTION: An abrasive material recycling system comprises a collection part (100), a separation part (200), and a storage part. The collection part removes dust and moisture included in the transferred waste abrasive material. The separation part separates iron and foreign substances included in the waste abrasive transferred from the collection part step-by-step. The storage part stores the recycled abrasive material. The collection part comprises a supply hopper (110), a waster abrasive material supply pipe (120), and a dust suction pipe (130). The waster abrasive material supply pipe transfers the waster abrasive material to the supply hopper with the vacuum of a vacuum generator (400). The dust suction pipe is connected between the vacuum generator and the supply hopper to suck the dust included in the transferred waste abrasive material.

title_en: Tactile and Visual Smoke Detector System
abstract_en: A multi-feedback fire alarm system incorporating a wearable signal notification article is provided. The system detects fire threats and notifies users of specific threat types, even when the user is not in proximity to a detection unit. The system includes one or more detection units and one or more wearable signal notification articles. When the detection unit perceives danger, it sends an activation signal and an alarm signal to the signal notification article to alert the user that a threat is present. The wearable signal notification article comprises a flexible bracelet-style housing, and an integrated alert circuit module with a sensor chip, an antenna, multiple light sources, a vibrator, and a battery. Different illumination and vibration patterns occur depending upon the type of threat present and the associated alarm signal received. In this way, the device provides specific threat type information to hearing impaired users.

title_en: Fire detection and alarm system for the blind and the deaf

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire detection and warning system for visually and hearing impaired persons. The fire detection and warning system for visually and hearing impaired persons of the present invention comprises: an audio-visual output unit for broadcasting an auditory emergency guide in accordance with a sound warning which guides an evacuation guide path from a sound input unit and for displaying a visual evacuation direction by using a data signal and power; a data signal generating unit for generating the data signal for controlling a guide direction display displayed through the audio-visual output unit; an oxygen supply equipment unit for supplying oxygen when oxygen is insufficient in a space due to smoke or gas leakage as a result of a fire occurrence; a PLC communications unit for synthesizing a sound signal, a data signal, and power to an evacuation guide signal and thereby transmitting to the audio-visual output unit and for transmitting an operation control signal to the oxygen supply equipment unit; and a control unit for monitoring a state of each component and for controlling an operation thereof. According to the present invention, when a fire occurs, a voice guide broadcast is performed to guide the visually and hearing impaired persons to an exit far away from the fire occurrence point, a letter, a sign and a specific pattern having an improved visibility are displayed through a blinking light having a variety of patterns, and oxygen is provided as needed. Therefore, it is possible to safely evacuate visually and hearing impaired persons.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 시각 및 청각 장애인을 위한 화재 감지 및 경보 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 시각 및 청각 장애인을 위한 화재 감지 및 경보 시스템은, 음향 입력부로부터의 대피 유도 경로를 안내하는 음향 신호에 따른 청각적 비상 안내 방송을 하고, 데이터 신호 및 전원을 이용하여 시각적 대피 유도 방향을 표시하는 시청각 출력부와, 시청각 출력부를 통해 표시되는 유도 방향 표시를 제어하는 상기 데이터 신호를 생성하는 데이터 신호 생성부와, 화재 발생에 따른 연기나 가스 누출로 인해 산소가 부족할 경우 해당 공간에 산소를 공급하는 산소 공급 설비부와, 음향 신호, 데이터 신호 및 전원을 대피 유도 신호로 합성하여 시청각 출력부로 전송하고, 산소 공급 설비부로 동작 제어 신호를 전송하는 PLC 통신부와, 제 구성요소의 상태 점검 및 동작을 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다. 이와 같은 본 발명에 의하면, 화재 발생시 화재 발생지점으로부터 멀어지는 쪽의 대피 비상구나 출입구 쪽으로 유도하는 음성 안내 방송을 수행하고, 다양한 패턴의 점멸 조명을 통해 시인성을 높인 문자, 기호, 특정 이미지를 표시하며, 필요에 따라서 산소를 함께 공급함으로써, 시각 및 청각 장애인이 안전하게 대피할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of intelligence community pipeline construction safety warning system of low-power consumption
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of intelligence community pipeline construction safety warning system of low-power consumption, inspection well cover control processor is connect with system wake-up turning circuit, water level logic processing module, gas logic processing module, switch module, voice broadcast module, voice broadcast memory, radiofrequency emitting module, inclination sensor module, water level sensor, gas sensor, electronic display module, GPS positioning module respectively；Power module is connect with system wake-up turning circuit and inclination sensor module respectively；System wake-up turning circuit is connect with inclination sensor module；Radiofrequency emitting module is wirelessly connect with inspection well cover administrative center.Ambient conditions in the utility model real-time monitoring inspection shaft, security risk that may be present in inspection shaft is judged by multiple sensor, and by way of voice broadcast and electronic display screen displays, construction personnel is allowed to understand situation in inspection shaft in time, it takes measures to carry out safety work, avoids that the situation that causes casualties of blindly going into the well occurs.
assignees: NEW CENTURY DEV GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Tower crane lifting infrared human body induction module early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tower crane lifting load infrared human body induction module early warning system which comprises a programmable controller, an infrared sensor, a wireless signal transmitter and a lifting load control circuit, wherein the infrared sensor is used for detecting whether a person exists in an induction range under a tower crane lifting hook; the programmable controller is arranged in a lifting electric control system capable of controlling deceleration and scram of a cab of the tower crane, the infrared sensor is arranged on the lifting hook, the wireless signal transmitter transmits an electric signal detected by the infrared sensor to the programmable controller, and the programmable controller is connected with a lifting control circuit. According to the utility model, the pyroelectric infrared sensor device is mainly added to avoid safety accidents caused by factors such as sight blind areas, and the like, so that whether the places around the lifting hook work can work safely or not is automatically detected and confirmed, and the detection risk caused by observation errors of personnel is avoided, thereby improving the safety of the lifting load of the tower crane.
assignees: FUSHUN YONGMAO CONSTRUCTION MACHINERY CO LTD

title_en: System and method for a security checkpoint using radio signals
abstract_en: A security device for monitoring the radio frequency signals generated by mobile phones and similar mobile computing and communication devices. The security device employs an antennae array and computer process that are configured to detect and provide a “fingerprint” for a mobile device based on the unique identifiers contained with the radio and other wireless signals utilized by such mobile device. The “fingerprint” that is obtained can be used to keep track of mobile devices as those devices enter and leave the area of the security device. Moreover, the security device can provide an alert when any new, foreign, or otherwise unrecognized device is within range of the security device and share “fingerprints” and alerts with other security devices in its network.
assignees: SELINGER DAVID LEE;YIP CHING WA;CHEN CHAOYING

title_en: Electric safety alarm method and system for the blind person and hearing-impaired person
title_ko: 시청각장애인용 전기안전 경보 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기설비에서 발생하는 전기재해 위험요소를 감지하여 시청각장애인에게 직접 경보를 알리고, 전기재해의 위험요소 및 정전으로 인한 불편사항을 신속히 제거하기 위해 제3자에게 유선통신을 통해 안내하는 시청각장애인용 전기안전 경보 방법 및 장치에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 시청각장애인용 전기안전 경보 방법은 전기설비에서 누전, 단락, 과전류 중 어느 하나가 발생시 누전차단기 2차측의 전원을 감지하는 단계와, 상기 전기설비의 이상 발생 또는 화재 발생시 시각장애인 또는 청각장애인에게 직접 경보 알림을 제공하는 단계와, 상기 직접 경보 알림과 동시에 무선통신을 통해 시청각장애인의 스마트폰에 설치된 어플리케이션을 이용하여 경보문구 표시 또는 경보음성이 재생되어 간접 경보 알림을 제공하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Blind guiding crutch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a blind guiding crutch which comprises a handle, a key operation panel and a crutch body; the handle is connected with the upper end of the key operation panel; a GPS (Global Position System) antenna used for receiving and sending GPS signals is arranged at the upper end of the handle; a battery module for providing system power source is arranged inside the handle; the crutch body is connected with the lower end of the key operation panel; a system circuit board used for processing data is arranged in the key operation panel; a key switch used for operating an embedded system is arranged on the key operation panel; and a strobe light used for warning is further arranged at the upper end of the crutch body. The technical scheme has the benefits that the use is simple, safety and convenience are ensured, multiple assistance functions such as a travel route guidance, information broadcast and emergency situation positioning can be provided for visually handicapped persons, the life of visually handicapped persons is optimized, equipment integrated on the blind guiding crutch does not affect the normal use of the blind guiding crutch, and the blind guiding crutch has the functions of rain prevention, shock resistance and the like.

title_en: Take alarming function's cubical switchboard
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a take alarming function's cubical switchboard, the internal portion of cabinet of cubical switchboard is including central control module, smoke detector, temperature detect ware, AD converting circuit, alarm module and wireless communication module, smoke detector's output and the output of temperature detect ware all link to each other with AD converting circuit's input, and AD converting circuit's output links to each other with central control module, central control module still with alarm module's input and wireless communication module's input link to each other, wireless communication module communicates through wireless network and mobile terminal and realizes reporting to the police, alarm module includes and is used for sending the buzzer siren of alarm and is used for going on artifical warning button of reporting to the police. The utility model discloses the internal gaseous and temperature information of cabinet be can gather in real time, on -the -spot warning and remote alarm are realized through central control module simultaneously, if meet accident in the cubical switchboard use, the further expansion of warning in order to avoid the disaster accessible time.
assignees: SANMING GREAT POWER SENDA ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Novel industrial flaw detection X-ray protective door
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel industrial inspection X ray protection door, including mounting bracket, two-way lead screw and track door, the internally mounted of mounting bracket has the two-way lead screw that extends to the install bin inside, two sets of track doors are installed through the spout to the bottom of mounting bracket, the gyro wheel is installed through the bolt in the bottom of track door, the track frame is installed through the cooperation of gyro wheel with the slide rail in the bottom of track door, the controller is installed through the bolt in the front of track door. The utility model discloses an install the status display screen in the front of mounting bracket, accessible status display screen can show X ray inspection operating condition when two sets of track doors are closed, and the staff of being convenient for knows the state of X ray inspection work to play suggestion staff's effect, avoid the staff mistake to go into, status display screen's setting can improve device's warning performance, and the effectual potential safety hazard of eliminating has guaranteed operational environment's security.
assignees: SHANDONG HENGXING NON DESTRUCTIVE TESTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Built-in well grate anti-falling warning alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an urban road anti-falling device especially relates to a warning alarm device is prevented weighing down by built-in well comb, and it belongs to the road administration well lid field. A built-in well comb anti-falling warning device comprises a well comb and a floating warning object, wherein the middle part of the well comb is provided with a U-shaped well comb cavity for storing the floating warning object, the floating warning object is connected with the well comb through an elastic rope, and the well comb is of a net-shaped hollow structure; when inlaying water, accessible well comb, float warning thing and stretch cord, warning coming and going pedestrian vehicle this department disappearance well lid, notice dodge, and well comb, float warning thing and stretch cord isotructure simple relatively, with low costs, the loss is few.

title_en: Anti-rollover and sudden obstacle monitoring and guiding system and method for wide-bridge-deck and narrow-support-beam bridge
abstract_en: The invention provides a monitoring and guiding system and method for preventing side turning and sudden obstacle of a wide bridge deck and a narrow supporting beam bridge, wherein video information of a vehicle running on the bridge deck is acquired through a monitoring camera; the bridge floor is automatically divided by the detection module, a normal driving area and heavy vehicle unbalance loading early warning areas on two sides are obtained, the number of heavy vehicles in the heavy vehicle unbalance loading early warning areas is identified, alarm information is generated according to the number of the heavy vehicles and an early warning threshold value, and the heavy vehicles are prompted to be guided to drive away from the heavy vehicle unbalance loading early warning areas in real time through the audible and visual alarms arranged on the two sides of the bridge floor. In a specific embodiment, the bridge deck emergency abnormal state recognition system can also recognize the bridge deck emergency abnormal state in the situations of fault parking on the bridge, foreign matter dropping of vehicles and the like according to the monitoring video information, and provides a targeted guiding driving route for the vehicles on the bridge by the audible and visual alarms arranged on two sides of the bridge deck. The invention can economically, conveniently, holographically and reliably identify the information of the unbalanced load and the sudden failure of the heavy vehicle on the bridge floor and carry out real-time early warning and guiding.

title_en: Monitoring system and method for right turn stop of intersection of large-sized vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for monitoring and controlling right turn stop of a large-scale vehicle intersection, comprising the following steps: collecting data required by right-turning parking of a large-sized vehicle intersection, wherein the data comprise the width of a right-turning lane, the distance between a laser radar and a stop line of the right-turning lane, the width of the right-turning lane, geometric characteristic data of vehicles in the right-turning lane, video data of vehicles in the right-turning lane, geometric characteristic data of vehicles in a right-turning area of the intersection and pedestrian and non-motor vehicle data in a right-turning blind area of the intersection, which are collected by a video device, and initializing a large-sized vehicle license plate set; the working states of the electronic police, the stroboscopic lamp and the voice prompt equipment are controlled according to the analysis result by data analysis; and analyzing video data acquired by the electronic police and sending the video data to the traffic command center. According to the invention, through arranging perfect detection, control, warning, propaganda and other equipment on the road side, the right turn non-stop behavior of the large-sized vehicle intersection is effectively monitored, so that the accident injury risk to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles is reduced.
assignees: NANJING LES INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for obtaining forest fire monitoring blind area based on stationary meteorological satellite
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for obtaining a forest fire monitoring blind area by a stationary meteorological satellite, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining DEM data, observation point longitude and latitude, stationary meteorological satellite orbit height and stationary meteorological satellite orbit longitude and latitude of an observation area; calculating a slope limit minimum angle theta according to DEM data and the orbit height of the stationary meteorological satellite to obtain a slope limit range [ theta, 90 DEG ]; calculating the distance between the static meteorological satellite and the observation point and the distance between the observation point and the equator according to the longitude and latitude of the observation point and the longitude and latitude of the orbit of the static meteorological satellite to obtain a slope direction limiting initial angle beta and obtain a slope direction limiting range [ beta, beta +180 degrees ]; and if the slope angle of the observation pixel is within the slope limiting range, and the elevation value of the observation pixel is greater than 0, judging that the observation pixel is a forest fire monitoring blind area of the observation area. The application can realize the extraction of the forest fire monitoring blind area of the observation area and reduce the warning of the forest fire leakage.

title_en: Evacuation Routes notification system for visually impaired
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation route notification system for a visually impaired person and, more specifically, to an evacuation route notification system which provides an evacuation direction for a visually impaired person by a plurality of vibrator units installed in a handrail or a guide foothold which guides the movement direction of the visually impaired person by being installed along the wall surface of a building. The vibrator units are driven by a phase difference vibrator circuit comprising: a control box which provides a direction signal by a fire signal received from a fire sensor; a forward/reverse shift register which generates a time difference vibration signal by the direction signal received from the control box; and a plurality of vibrators which vibrates by receiving the time difference vibration signal received from the forward/reverse shift register.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 시각 장애인을 위한 대피경로 알림시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 바람직하게는 건물의 벽면을 따라 설치되어 시각장애인의 이동방향을 안내하는 핸드레일의 내부 또는 안내발판에 설치되는 다수개의 진동자유닛에 의해 시각 장애인에게 대피방향을 제공하는 것으로써 상기 진동자유닛은 화재감지기로부터 수신한 화재신호에 의해 방향신호를 제공하는 컨트롤박스와 상기 컨트롤박스에서 수신한  방향신호에 의해 시간차 진동신호를 발생하는 정/역 시프트레지스터와 상기 정/역 시프트레지스터로부터 수신한 시간차 진동신호를 수신 받아 진동하는 다수개의 진동자로 구성된 위상차 진동자 회로에 의해 구동되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: MOKPO NAT UNIV IND ACAD COOP

title_en: Smart stick for blind
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 GPS를 기반으로 시각장애인에게 목적지를 안내하고, 보행 중 장애물을 검출하여 경고 알림 및 회피 보행을 제공하며, 보행 안내하는데 필요한 정보를 음성으로 변환하여 제공함으로써 안전사고를 방지할 수 있는 시각장애인용 스마트 지팡이에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 지팡이 부재; 상기 지팡이 부재에 구비되어 위치 정보를 제공하는 GPS 모듈; 상기 지팡이 부재에 구비되어 시각장애인 사용자의 음성을 인식하여 하기 네비게이션 모듈에 음성 명령을 전달하는 음성 인식 모듈; 상기 음성 인식 모듈에서 인식된 음성 명령을 전달받아 상기 GPS모듈과 연동하여 길 안내를 실행하는 네비게이션 모듈; 상기 네비게이션 모듈에서 제공되는 길안내 음성 정보를 사용자에게 전달하는 스피커 모듈; 상기 지팡이 부재에 구비되어 보행 중 장애물을 검출하도록 구성되는 장애물 검출 모듈; 상기 지팡이 부재에 구비되어 상기 각 모듈의 동작을 제어하도록 구성되는 제어 회로 모듈; 및 상기 지팡이 부재에 구비되어 각 모듈로 필요 전력을 공급하는 배터리;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 시각장애인용 스마트 지팡이가 제공된다.

title_en: A kind of live electric cable burglar alarm
abstract_en: A kind of live electric cable burglar alarm of the present utility model, including power on signal detection modulate circuit, level shifting circuit, triggers circuit, warning circuit, the voltage signal conditioning circuit connects level shifting circuit, level shifting circuit connects triggers circuit, triggers circuit connects warning circuit, effectively solves the problems, such as that existing cable anti-theft device cost is high, potential safety hazard be present.The utility model is simple in construction, stable performance, use contactless voltage transformer or current transformer by the voltage of live electric cable or curent change for accessible small signal or electric current, when cable is intact, when powered, small signal or electric current are sent into the trigger pulse that level shifting circuit is converted to determination, the alarm of triggers circuit work voice after amplifier buffering isolation, power amplification rear speaker sends alarm, until pushing button K1, cut off the electricity supply, alarm stops.

title_en: Dampproofing case of electronic component
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electronic element moisture-proof box, belongs to the technical field of electronic element moisture-proof boxes, and solves the problems that in the use of the electronic element moisture-proof box, core elements such as a humidity sensor or an MCU are aged/damaged, so that the monitoring precision is misaligned, the display humidity is normal but the actual humidity deviates from a set value and is false, the reading of the sensor is abnormal, and a dehumidification system is stopped prematurely or runs continuously and excessively. Comprises a dampproof box body of an electronic element. According to the utility model, the reference humidity sensor sealed in the constant drying environment is introduced to provide the reference signal with high stability, the deviation between the output signal of the main sensor and the reference signal is compared in real time, and the audible and visual alarm is immediately driven to give out a warning when the deviation exceeds the preset tolerance, so that a user can timely detect the drift fault of the sensor, and the problems of out-of-control humidity in the box or abnormal operation of the dehumidification system caused by blind trust of the misalignment sensor are effectively avoided.

title_en: Sitting posture reminding method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sitting posture reminding method, belongs to the technical field of sitting posture reminding, and aims to solve the problem that a reminder is seriously misreported when ultrasonic or infrared distance measurement is adopted in the prior art. The sitting posture reminding device comprises a sitting posture reminding instrument, wherein a laser ranging module is arranged in a shell of the sitting posture reminding instrument, and the laser ranging module adopts a TOF laser ranging module; during detection, the laser ranging module emits laser and forms a light cone, and transmits a detected distance signal to the MCU; if the micro processing unit MCU judges that foreign matters enter a light cone within a threshold range of a warning distance above the sitting posture reminder and the duration of the entering of the foreign matters exceeds a trigger duration threshold, triggering reminding and outputting an alarm signal; after the prompt module receives the alarm signal, the prompt module sends out a prompt, and the prompt mode comprises a voice prompt, a vibration prompt and/or a light prompt. The invention is not easy to cause false alarm and has higher reminding accuracy.

title_en: Combustible gas monitoring terminal
abstract_en: The underground pipe network environment is complex, risks are hidden, and due to factors such as pressure damage, corrosion and aging, imperfect overhaul system and the like of the pipeline buried deeply for a long time, gas is easy to leak, the blind area of pipe network patrol is difficult to solve by means of civil air defense, the gas patrol quality is difficult to guarantee, and the effective supervision of real-time discovery, real-time early warning and real-time response cannot be achieved on the potential safety hazard of the gas pipe network. Once leakage occurs, the leakage permeates into adjacent underground spaces of medium-high risk gas pipe networks such as underdrains, rain sewage pipelines and the like with other coupling hidden dangers, accidents are interlocked and the results are superposed, and serious casualties and economic losses are often caused. How to sense abnormality in real time, ensure that risks are found out in time and are disposed in the first time, and become urgent demands for safe operation of underground pipe networks.

title_en: Safety protection system for expressway construction
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of traffic control systems, in particular to a safety protection system for expressway construction, which comprises an isolation frame and an early warning frame, wherein the early warning frame is provided with a battery, a speed measuring probe, a voice broadcasting device and a controller which are electrically connected, the early warning frame is movably connected with a sign board, the early warning frame is provided with a power device for driving the sign board to move, the front surface of the early warning frame is provided with a flash lamp and a prompt slogan, the back surface of the early warning frame is provided with a display screen and a warning broadcasting device, and the controller transmits vehicles and vehicle speeds detected by the test probe to the display screen and the warning broadcasting device. On the one hand, the early warning frame monitors the vehicle and reminds the running vehicle. On the other hand, the early warning frame also sends the vehicle information that monitors to the isolation frame, and constructor accessible display screen and warning report ware know the vehicle condition on the safe buffering road to make safety protection measure in advance, thereby improve construction safety.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHENJIANG ROAD AND BRIDGE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Line surrounding environment monitoring and managing method based on hidden danger discharging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a line surrounding environment monitoring and managing method based on hidden danger discharge, relates to the technical field of hidden danger discharge identification, and solves the problems that the periodic development characteristics of tree barrier discharge cannot be identified and dynamic risk management and control can not be implemented according to the periodic development characteristics. The invention captures fingerprint characteristics (peak value, frequency spectrum, fractal dimension and the like) of discharge current through a broadband sensor, utilizes an AI model to accurately identify three stages of corona, spark and flashover, prolongs early warning period, combines a hit distance theory to construct a dynamic risk index R (x, y), fuses three elements of tree height, distance and discharge intensity in real time and automatically adjusts season weight, reduces risk misjudgment rate, finally forms a closed-loop management flow of 'monitoring early warning-work order dispatch-trimming verification-efficiency iteration', and realizes the fundamental transition from 'blind image type' passive rush-repair to 'dial cloud day type' accurate prevention.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Network type emergency evacuation guidance system
abstract_en: To provide a network type emergency evacuation guidance system which enables a hearing impaired user to visually obtain, without selecting the place, emergency information of a disaster prevention system such as a fire alarm through a wireless LAN facility (Wi-Fi, etc.) in an accommodation such as a hotel to a tablet terminal which is prepared by the accommodation, can be carried into a room that the hearing impaired user uses, and can be installed at a place to be easily noticed by the user and on which the emergency information can be visually recognized.SOLUTION: A network type emergency evacuation guidance system 1 comprises: an HTML server which converts emergency information from a fire facility 9, a J-Alert reception facility 10 or an earthquake detector within an accommodation such as a hotel into an HTTP protocol; an intra-accommodation network facility 6 which performs a push notification for forcedly transferring emergency information converted into the HTTP protocol of the HTML server; and a tablet terminal which is carried into a room inside of the accommodation that a hearing impaired user uses, and visually displays the emergency information as soon as the push notification is received.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Walk assistance apparatus for blind people
title_ko: 시각 장애인을 위한 보행 보조 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A walk assistant device for the blind is provided to automatically inform of the location of a user in an emergency situation. CONSTITUTION: A walk assistant system for the blind comprises a walk assistant device(100), a mobile radio communication network(200), and a server(400). The walk assistant device is equipped with a separation and emergency situation detection part, a walk assistant device top end part, a walk assistant device bottom end part, an internal device, a location information confirmation switch, a walk obstacle detection part, a foldable walk obstacle detection button, and an obstacle detection part.

title_en: Geological calamity rainfall monitoring prealarmer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a geological disaster rainfall monitoring early-warning instrument which is applied to the weather early-warning of geological disaster and can prevent dust and blocking with simple operation. The invention is characterized in that the geological disaster rainfall monitoring and the early-warning are organically combined together, and the early-warning of geological disaster is carried through according to the actual measured rainfall monitoring value. The value of the rainfall is observed via the reading of the liquid surface, and the rainfall intension is monitored via a triangular weir. Foreign matters are prevented to enter a rain bearing mouth to block the pipeline via a steel mesh, and the dust remnant can be prevented via a water discharging device. The instrument has the advantages of simple structure and easy maintenance, the invention is flexible and cheap. The instrument can be used for cluster monitoring and cluster preventing of geological disasters, thereby is suitable for generalization in large scale.
assignees: INST GEOLOGY & GEOPHYSICS CAS;XIAO LI;SHOUDING LI;YANHUI LIU

title_en: A kind of EPS cuttings have the warning device of LED flicker prompting functions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of EPS cuttings to have the warning device that LED flickers prompting function, including rectangular box, lower surface is equipped with electric rotating machine in the rectangular box, the outer upper surface of the rectangular box is machined with one group of through-hole, lower surface and it is machined with one group of blind hole positioned at being located at below through-hole in the rectangular box, it is fitted with rotary shaft respectively in one through-hole and a blind hole, fixing sleeve is equipped with belt pulley respectively at one group of rotating shaft center, the electric rotating machine round end fixing sleeve is equipped with belt pulley A, it is set with belt jointly on the belt pulley A and one group of belt pulley, one group of rotary shaft other end is installed with rectangular slab.The invention has the advantages that of simple structure and strong practicability.

title_en: Soil body infiltration early warning device for geotechnical engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil body seepage early warning device for geotechnical engineering, and belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering. The soil body infiltration early warning device for geotechnical engineering comprises a landslide, the top surface on landslide top layer is provided with the intercepting drain, the top surface on landslide top layer is provided with the escape canal, the inside of landslide all is provided with detection component, detection component is including setting up at shallow layer and the inside bleeder and the alarm mechanism of weathered mudstone sandstone interbedded. Through the cooperation of intercepting ditch, escape canal and drop groove to the landslide surface drainage, and because of falling the rainwater infiltration water or the interior itself of slope by force own groundwater that contains, the accessible bleeder is faster gathers and discharges fast, can effectually reduce the subsurface infiltration body to keep lower floor soil body intensity, dead weight, reduce the osmotic force, when the inside water content of the slope body reaches dangerous value, the inside water level of bleeder increases and drives alarm mechanism work and send out the police dispatch newspaper, alarm mechanism can accelerate the discharge of the inside ponding of bleeder simultaneously.

title_en: Detecting and early warning device for A-pillar vision blind area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detecting and early warning device for an A-pillar vision blind area. The device comprises an information acquisition unit, a sensor unit, a master control unit, an alarm module and a power supply, wherein the sensor unit is in coupling connection with the information acquisition unit, the sound and light alarm module is in coupling connection with the master control unit, the power supply is in coupling connection with the master control unit, and the information acquisition unit communicates with the master control unit through a CAN-BUS. According to the detecting and early warning device for the A-pillar vision blind area, when the device detects that the distance between a vehicle and a barrier is smaller than an early warming value, the sound and light alarm is started to remind a driver of braking/avoiding, if the device detects that the vehicle has no braking/avoiding behavior, a safety procedure is started, and braking control is started, so that vehicle damage and casualties caused after the vehicle collides with pedestrians and other barriers are prevented.

abstract_en: A kind of elevator early warning enclosing, comprise enclosing main body, described enclosing main body is provided with LED captions, sound broadcasting device and infrared human body induction pick-up, and described LED captions, sound broadcasting device and infrared human body induction pick-up be connection control device respectively.The utility model is lightweight, volume is little, carrying portable, time saving and energy saving, pedestrian or blind person can be facilitated to know front in advance and whether to construct, and available protecting blind person, there is the hommization of height.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a single ultraviolet optics fire detector of high performance, the blind type ultraviolet phototube of day passes through transition switching circuit and ultraviolet signal conditioning circuit and is connected with 32 position ARM treater of high performance, 32 position ARM treater of high performance are connected with temperature acquisition circuit, dial switch circuit, LED drive circuit, 4 ~ 20mA electric current loop circuit, fire alarm level signal output circuit, OC door output circuit, two sets of relay drive output circuit, two sets of fire extinguisher drive output circuit simultaneously. The utility model discloses in, fire detector can realize conflagration automatic detection and automatic alarm to possess intellectuality, information-based function, stopped the conflagration and leaked the warning potential safety hazard, and realized surveying fast and reporting to the police to the conflagration, improved fire alarm speed and degree of accuracy, can also be used to the fire monitoring under the military armored vehicle engine compartment high temperature environment of special type, also can be used to industry boiler burning and detect, be worth the power promotion.
