title_en: Protective helmet for blind person based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent helmets for blind persons, and discloses a protective helmet for blind persons based on big data, which comprises an AI model, wherein the protective helmet module comprises: sensor integration module: a microprocessor integrating a high-speed GPU and an environment sensor, and collecting environment and position data; and a language interaction module: a microphone array integrating noise suppression and echo cancellation technology captures user voice, and an AI model is used for voice recognition; and an intelligent planning module: combining GPS positioning data, a map AP I and an AI model, and dynamically planning a safe and convenient route; anti-tracking security module: the camera captures a rear image, the AI face recognition algorithm recognizes and analyzes the facial expression and the behavior mode of the follower, and judges whether tracking behaviors exist or not by combining the position and time data; an emergency alert and communication module.

title_en: Intelligent limited space monitor and risk linkage control system based on end Bian Yun cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent limited space monitor based on end Bian Yun cooperation and a risk linkage control system, and aims to solve the problems of monitoring blind areas, risk perception lag, multi-system isolated operation, slow emergency rescue response and the like in the existing limited space operation. The system consists of an intelligent limited space monitor, an edge computing gateway and a ' An Yu ' central safety management platform, and achieves global perception, advanced intelligent early warning, automatic emergency linkage closed loop and efficient transparent emergency rescue command on all elements of a limited space through real-time perception on the ' end ' side, intelligent analysis on the ' side, quick response, overall decision and linkage control on the ' cloud ' side, thereby remarkably improving the safety level of limited space operation and effectively avoiding group death group injury accidents such as poisoning, choking and explosion.

title_en: Alarm and display device based on fire sensing signal received wirelessly
title_ko: 무선으로 화재 감지신호를 수신하여 경보 및 표시하는 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an alarm and display device based on a fire sensing signal received wirelessly. For example, deaf and blind persons (user) staying in a vulnerable zone where a fire is hardly recognized, such as toilets and warehouses, wirelessly receive a fire detection signal through display and alarming. So, the user quickly recognizes the occurrence of the fire. The alarm and display device includes a sensor, a processor, a signal transmitting/receiving part, an alarm part, and a display part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선으로 화재 감지신호를 수신하여 경보 및 표시하는 장치에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은, 예를 들어 화장실, 창고 등 화재 발생을 인지하기 어려운 취약지대에 머무는 시청각 장애인들(사용자)에게 화재감지기로부터 전송되는 화재 감지신호를 무선으로 수신하여 경보 및 표시함으로써 사용자가 화재발생을 신속하게 인지토록 한다.

title_en: Fan control method, electronic device, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a control method of a fan, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program product, which relate to the technical field of intelligent control, and the control method comprises the steps of actively collecting a real-time capacitance value at a protective net and comparing the real-time capacitance value with a historical capacitance value by adding a capacitance sensing unit at the protective net, determining capacitance change information by combining a control period, further accurately judging the normal, dust early warning and emergency braking states of the fan and implementing corresponding control, realizing active monitoring and intervention prevention on the state of the protective net of the fan by a simple and low-cost structural design, effectively avoiding the problems that dust influences heat dissipation, safety accidents are caused by foreign matters and the like, and finally improving the safety and effectiveness of the operation of the fan and the overall stability and reliability of a system under application scenes such as a server.

title_en: Natural gas construction safety alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a natural gas construction safety alarm, including gas sensor, power cord, alarm main part, lid and couple, the both sides of alarm main part are provided with the speaker, and the one end of hanging the rope is provided with the couple, hangs and connects through the go-between rope and the couple, and one side of alarm main part is provided with the adhesion layer, and four inside coupling assembling that are provided with in one side of alarm main part. The utility model discloses a slipmat prevents that the latch closure from loosening, lead to the alarm main part to drop, the accessible couple is hung the alarm main part on constructor's waistband, saddlebag or clothes, thereby more timely warning, factor of safety is higher, the alarm main part is connected with the lid through adhesion layer and coupling assembling, increase the firm in connection nature of lid and alarm main part through the adhesion layer, the lid passes through in the spliced pole inserts the jack, prop open the mounting plate, prevent the spliced pole pine through the wearing layer, make the connection of coupling assembling and spliced pole more firm.

title_en: Acousto-optic alarm device for high-voltage distribution room
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sound-light alarm device for a high-voltage distribution room, which comprises a detection mechanism, a power supply device, an infrared human body sensor and a dust cover, wherein the detection mechanism comprises a door frame and the power supply device; prompt device constructs, including reputation detection mechanism, set up in the right side of power supply unit bottom, reputation detection mechanism includes controller, audible-visual alarm, speaker and down lamp. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: through power supply unit for install infrared human sensor and acoustic detection mechanism, can supply power to it simultaneously, make infrared human sensor and acoustic detection mechanism can normally function with this, through setting up infrared human sensor, be used for detecting the human body, and transmit the data signal who detects to the controller, control acousto-optic warning and down lamp with this accessible controller, and then can make the down lamp throw light on to the electricity distribution room.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA JINGDA POWER GENERATION LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Water regime early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water condition early warning device which comprises a tubular pile, wherein the upper end of the tubular pile is fixedly connected with a threaded block, the threaded block is connected with a floating plate in a threaded manner, the upper end of the threaded block is provided with a clamping block, a tube seat is arranged on the clamping block, the lower end of the tubular pile is provided with a balancing weight, the tubular pile is provided with a first liquid level meter and a second liquid level meter, the first liquid level meter and the second liquid level meter are arranged on the tubular pile one by one, and the outer sides of the first liquid level meter and the second liquid level meter are respectively provided with a buffer cover. According to the utility model, the balancing weight is arranged at the bottom of the pipe pile, when the device is used, the balancing weight can enable the early warning device to be vertical to water through gravity, the possibility of rollover of the early warning device when encountering rapid flow is reduced, and the device is provided with the buffer cover outside the liquid level meter, so that foreign matters can be blocked, meanwhile, the water flow can be buffered, the impact force when the liquid level meter is contacted with water is reduced, and the possibility of measuring misalignment of the liquid level meter is reduced.

title_en: Experimental device for testing impact damage and electromagnetic radiation effect of gas-containing coal rock
abstract_en: The invention relates to a testing experimental device for impact damage and electromagnetic radiation effect of coal rock containing gas, which comprises an electromagnet, a heavy hammer, a hammer barrel, a glass fiber heating belt, an impact generation sealed cabin, a nylon rod (PA-66), organic glass, a coal rock sample, an impact force sensor, a metal shielding net, a vacuum pump, a computer, a data acquisition system, a temperature probe, a temperature sensor, a strain gauge, an electromagnetic radiation receiving antenna, a gas tank, a fixing bolt, a harness cord bolt, an air inlet valve, an air outlet valve, an air inlet hole, an air outlet hole, a lead threading hole, a flange and a flange blind plate. The electromagnetic radiation signal is suitable for measuring the coal rock impact damage electromagnetic radiation signal in the gas-rich environment, is helpful for really researching the impact load and the influence rule between the structural characteristics of the coal body and the characteristics of the electromagnetic radiation signal such as amplitude, energy and frequency in the coal rock impact damage process in the gas-containing environment, provides theoretical basis for the prevention and early warning of the dynamic disaster of the coal rock of the gas-containing coal mine, and has strong practicability.

title_en: Intelligent walking stick for blind person
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent walking stick for blind people, wherein a walking stick handle and a walking stick body are both cylindrical, and are L-shaped after being connected; the SOS key, the LED warning lamp and the voice broadcasting module are arranged on the top surface of the crutch handle; the camera module is arranged at the front end of the crutch handle; the ultrasonic obstacle avoidance module is arranged at the bottom of the crutch body, an ultrasonic sensor is arranged in the ultrasonic obstacle avoidance module, and the ultrasonic sensor transmits detected ultrasonic reflection signals to the main controller; the GPS module is arranged in the crutch body and used for positioning the crutch body; the gesture detection module is arranged at the middle lower position in the crutch body and comprises a three-axis MEMS gyroscope and a three-axis MEMS accelerometer; the LED control key is arranged below the crutch handle. The intelligent blind person navigation system has the functions of emergency help seeking, tumble detection, communication positioning, navigation information broadcasting and the like, can provide guarantee for the personal safety of the blind person when the blind person goes out, and is simple and intelligent to operate and high in practicability.

title_en: Movable warning device and warning method for removing foreign matters in airport
abstract_en: The invention relates to a movable warning device and a warning method for removing foreign matters in an airport, and belongs to the technical field of civil aviation monitoring. The application provides a movable warning device and warning method for airport foreign matter is clear away, carry out airport foreign matter through movable attention device and detect, upload mobile terminal ipad to relevant data message and obtain the foreign matter coordinate after detecting the airport foreign matter, this movable attention device removes to the foreign matter position according to the foreign matter coordinate, and send voice prompt, return the coordinate of cleaing away the foreign matter to ipad and show, so that the foreign matter is clear away to the manual work, not only can very big shortening artifical naked eye search consumed time, and can improve the efficiency that the foreign matter was clear away.

title_en: Emergency management early warning issuing system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency management early warning release system based on big data, which relates to the technical field of information technology and public safety intersection, and comprises the following hierarchy structures connected in sequence: breaking through the limitation of the traditional system data island, integrating heterogeneous data sources such as meteorological sensors, social media and unit platforms through a multi-mode data fusion gateway, combining federal learning technology to realize anonymization processing and safety protection of user data, remarkably improving real-time performance and comprehensiveness of disaster situation awareness, and enabling a dynamic space-time feature extraction engine to capture space-time coupling rules of disaster propagation by using an attention mechanism so as to improve risk assessment precision to millimeter-level geographic resolution, thereby effectively eliminating monitoring blind areas existing in the traditional static model.
assignees: JIANGSU EMERGENCY WARNING INFORMATION PUBLISHING CENTER

title_en: System for providing location alerts relating to emergencies
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for generating alerts communicated to emergency responders and/or contacts indicating a location of an incident. The system comprises a housing, one or more light sources, and a computing processor. A switch is located in the housing and configured to be accessible to a user. When the switch is actuated by a user indicating an incident, the processor provides power to the at least one light source to output light from the housing thereby indicating the location of the system. The system may also control a speaker to output an audible signal and a transmitter to transmit an emergency signal with location information to a device of an emergency responder and/or an emergency contact. The present invention may also be embodied in a software application that is implemented on a mobile device to thereby leverage the components of the mobile device to send alerts.

title_en: Three-dimensional wildfire monitoring and control method and system for power transmission corridor
abstract_en: Disclosed are a three-dimensional wildfire monitoring and control system and method for a power transmission corridor. The system includes: a wildfire-induced trip risk assessment module, for assessing, when a wildfire is detected in a power transmission corridor, a wildfire-induced trip risk in real time so as to determine whether to issue a wildfire warning; an online wildfire monitoring device layout planning module, for generating an online wildfire monitoring device layout plan for transmission lines based on the wildfire-induced trip risk, a blind spot of satellite monitoring and importance levels of the transmission lines; and a three-dimensional power transmission corridor wildfire monitoring and warning module, adopting multi-source satellites and drones, and realizing three-dimensional wildfire monitoring of the power transmission corridor by monitoring through online wildfire monitoring devices provided according to the layout plan, the multi-source satellites and the drones.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power-off protective device for high speed rail earthquake emergency action
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power-off protective device for high speed rail earthquake emergency action, effective control of the earthquake pre-warning monitoring system to train can solve, while ensure that the normal operation for not influencing train under non-earthquake conditions as far as possible；The logic core of device uses CPLD, has good scalability, real-time, also more other implementations are higher for reliability and safety.Meanwhile independent UPS is integrated in device, it can be kept after losing dispatch from foreign news agency equipment work 168 hours or more；Also, by setting power-off monitoring relay, it will not cause to lead change system cut-off after battery exhausts, reduce the influence to change system is led as far as possible.Furthermore, by the way that long-range isolation signals are arranged, isolation can be remotely controlled in the warning algorithm of Commissioning field detection device, reduce the workload of people, be arranged be manually isolated switch can then shield control of the relay to change system is led completely, repair or replace component when will not be impacted to change system is led.

title_en: Movable online safety monitoring warning device with support

Including the control main part, the inner wall bottom fixedly connected with battery and the signal transmission ware of control main part, the top outer wall of control main part is provided with solar panel, the outer wall fixedly connected with camera of control main part, the bottom outer wall of control main part articulates there is the regulation support, adjust the support and keep away from the one end fixedly connected with antiskid stabilizer blade of control main part, the wiring end of camera and the wiring end electric connection of battery. This device utilizes AI intelligence video analysis technique, combines 360 degrees all-round real-time remote video monitoring, clears away the supervision blind spot to for the construction area or the area that the accident is sent out more provides initiative danger and surveys the warning, effectively improve the security of production operation, make the intelligent and high-efficient of site management, combine the cloud platform can really accomplish the information-based management of safe production.

title_en: Automatic rescue safety monitoring method and system for trapped elevator
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic rescue safety monitoring method and system for trapped people in an elevator, which belong to the technical field of elevators, and the method comprises the following steps: the elevator stopping instant auxiliary encoder obtains the position of the elevator car, and the controller drives the elevator car to a nearby leveling layer; if the car cannot reach the nearby leveling floor, the detecting head acquires a state image in the car; voice pacifying dialogue and prompt are carried out with trapped personnel through a human-computer interface operation device; when the detecting head collects that someone is raking or smashing the door, the alarm bell in the car acts, and the man-machine interface operating device expands voice conversation and warning prompt for trapped people. The system uses an automatic rescue safety monitoring method for elevator trapped people. When the phenomena of closing or trapping people and the like of the existing elevator are solved, maintenance personnel are required to enter the elevator field from the foreign place in an emergency mode, and trapped personnel are required to be rescued in a machine room by turning. And because the condition in the fault car is difficult to obtain, the trapped passengers can have anxiety or endanger personal safety.
assignees: FOSHAN HEZHONG ELEVATOR TECH CO LTD

title_en: Blind curve sight dead angle warning system
abstract_en: A blind curve sight dead angle warning system comprises a processor, at least one warning lamp, at least one cat eye lamp, at least one warning loudspeaker and a wireless communication frequency module. The processor calculates a start distance time by the speed measurement value of the first vehicle speed sensor and the speed measurement value of the second vehicle speed sensor, and the processor starts at least one of the at least one warning lamp, the at least one cat eye lamp, the at least one warning horn and the wireless communication frequency module.

title_en: Intelligent community public safety monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of community public safety monitoring, in particular to a smart community public safety monitoring system and a method, which are used for acquiring the total number of monitoring cameras in a community, sending an image acquisition command, continuously acquiring image frames by the monitoring cameras to form an image sequence of the monitoring cameras, carrying out image processing on each frame in the image sequence of the monitoring cameras, calculating a definition evaluation index and a sharpness evaluation index of the monitoring cameras corresponding to each frame image, screening out abnormal frame images of the monitoring cameras, carrying out depth analysis on the abnormal frame images marked as the monitoring cameras, extracting light parameters of the monitoring cameras, comprehensively judging the lens fouling index of the monitoring cameras, further generating corresponding cleaning early warning signals, effectively monitoring the lens state of the monitoring cameras, timely sending out cleaning early warning, ensuring the quality and safety of the monitoring images, and effectively reducing the risk of monitoring blind areas caused by lens fouling.

title_en: Foreign matter intrusion perimeter monitoring and early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foreign matter intrusion perimeter monitoring and early warning system and a method, wherein the system comprises a sensor sensing system, a data acquisition and transmission system and a power supply and energy storage system which are connected through a circuit, the sensor sensing system, the data acquisition and transmission system and the power supply and energy storage system are arranged in the vicinity of the foreign matter intrusion perimeter, the sensor sensing system comprises a plurality of monitoring upright posts, monitoring cross bars, a rain gauge and cameras, the plurality of monitoring upright posts are uniformly distributed along a horizontal plane, the monitoring cross bars are erected on two adjacent monitoring upright posts, the rain gauge is arranged on the left side of a first monitoring upright post, and the cameras are arranged between the monitoring upright posts and the rain gauge. The method can timely react to specific paragraphs, scales and the like of the slump, has low probability of false alarm, effectively solves the problem of monitoring and early warning of the intrusion of the foreign matters, can realize dynamic monitoring and early warning of the intrusion of the foreign matters, has higher reliability, and is worthy of popularization.

title_en: Responding to emergency-alert audio tone by abandoning dynamic content modification
abstract_en: A method and system for controlling dynamic content modification such as dynamic advertisement insertion. An example method includes detecting presence of an emergency-alert audio tone in a media stream accessible to a media client, and responsively causing the media client to abandon a dynamic content modification, such as to forgo a planned dynamic content modification or to discontinue an in-progress dynamic content modification. This method could occur while the media client is processing a given media stream for presentation, and the method could include detecting presence of the emergency-alert audio tone in the given media stream or alternatively in another media stream accessible to the media client. And in the latter case, the method could further involve causing the media client to switch from processing the given media stream for presentation to instead processing the other media stream for presentation, which could facilitate presenting of an associated emergency alert.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted safety protection system for automobile
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automobile-mounted safety precaution system, including GPS antenna and/or the big dipper antenna that is used for receiving the broadcast signal who is used for satellite positioning system, and one or several of 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G antenna, be used for the data interchange of network honeycomb data, still include camera group in the car, display screen, on-vehicle digital video terminal, panorama camera group, panorama host computer, ADAS unit, digital crashproof probe and crashproof early warning control terminal, action recognition device and data processing terminal, through installing millimeter wave/microwave digital probe and 4 super wide angle cameras perception vehicle obstacles all around at the automobile body; the driver is warned in a mode of sound and 360-degree full-view images, the driving blind area is eliminated, the blind area accidents are reduced, and the driving safety is improved. Furthermore, the technical scheme of the utility model the behavior recognition of driver's driving action has been introduced, combines the setting of ADAS function, can effectually avoid the accident hidden danger that driver fatigue brought.

title_en: A listening system comprising an alerting device and a listening device
abstract_en:
The application relates to: A listening system. The object of the present application is to provide a system that eases the acknowledgement of 'alarm signals', as e.g. issued by alarm indicators, in the environment of a user in difficult listening situations. The problem is solved in that the system comprises 
o a listening device adapted to be worn at or in an ear of a user, and 
● an alerting device adapted to detect or receive an external alarm signal, 
● wherein 
● the listening device and the alerting device each comprise at least one communication interface allowing to establish a communication link between them, 
● the alerting device is adapted to sense or receive information as to whether or not the listening device is in operational use, and 
● the listening system is adapted to operate in at least two modes, 
● a NORMAL mode, when said listening device is in operational use, 
and 
● an ALARM mode, when said listening device is NOT in operational 
use; and wherein 
said listening system is adapted to issue specific ALARM mode signals to the user corresponding to said external alarm signals, when said listening system is in an ALARM mode. An advantage of the present system is that a user is able to take notice of alarms from normal indicators even in case of a hearing impairment and/or when located in a noisy environment. The invention may e.g. be used for the hearing instruments, ear protection devices, earphones, headsets or combinations thereof.

title_en: Vehicle blind area pedestrian sensing and early warning method and system based on V2X
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle blind area pedestrian sensing and early warning method and system based on V2X.A main vehicle obtains the pedestrian motion state information in the blind area through an environment sensing system of a blocking vehicle and a road test device and a V2X communication module, and reduces the probability of the traffic accidents by combining the environment sensing system and a V2X module. The information is encrypted and decrypted by using a classical asymmetric cryptographic algorithm, namely an RSA algorithm, so that malicious network attack is prevented, and the normal communication and information safety of the main vehicle and the sheltered workshop are guaranteed. And finally, respectively calculating longitudinal TTCs and transverse TTCs to judge the collision risk, and when the collision is judged to be possible, the pedestrian protection system sequentially starts an indicator lamp system, a driver warning system and an active braking system according to the collision time TTCs of the vehicle and the pedestrians and the time threshold value when the vehicles and the pedestrians do not collide, so as to realize graded early warning. The invention can effectively predict the relative position between the pedestrian and the vehicle in the beyond visual range scene, reduce the hidden danger caused by the blind area and realize the functions of early warning and active collision avoidance.

title_en: Deaf person early warning method and device based on binocular camera relative speed measurement

The device comprises: the head-mounted device comprises a head-mounted device body, a front-view binocular camera, a rear-view binocular camera, a binding belt, an algorithm processor and a power supply. According to the invention, the speed relative to the user is calculated, so that the complex calculation of the actual speed and direction of the target object is reduced, the user is reminded of the vehicle coming from the rear, and the defect that the deaf cannot hear the sound of the rear vehicle is overcome.

abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and device for detecting a fire using smart glasses for a visually impaired person. According to a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the present invention performs machine learning for a fire scene using big data for the fire scene, receives a received photographed image from a smart glasses, determines whether being a fire situation or not by using the received photographed image, and transmits an alert to the smart glasses to indicate a fire situation when determined to be the fire situation. According to the present invention, the present invention has an advantage of enabling the visually impaired person to recognize whether a fire has occurred before recognizing the heat or smoke caused by the fire even if a fire breaks out in a situation where being alone and there are no other people around, and enabling the visually impaired person to be safe from the risk of fire due to the accuracy of fire detection being high.

title_en: Nowcast of Natural Resource and Calamity Warning
abstract_en: A method of forecasting naturally-occurring phenomena, such as seismic activity, includes taking localized measurements of the Earth's gravitational force change using MEM inertial motion units. Trends in the measurements are interpreted and related to a phenomenon of interest, a likelihood of occurrence is predicted based on the relationship, and the likelihood is reported to interested parties, preferably automatically to emergency bulletin sources. Measurements can be taken from above the Earth's atmosphere. The trends can be interpreted by determining blind source separation information directed to the region underneath the Earth's mantle crust to determine composition and/or movement.

title_en: Fire voice-alert controller for the blind and control method

abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire alarm control device for the invisible and a control method thereof are provided to evacuate the invisible to far away from a fire occurring position through an alarm. CONSTITUTION: A fire alarm control device(100) is composed of a signal receiver(110), controller(120), and an alarm controller(130). The signal receiver receives signals from a smoke sensor or a thermal sensor installed adjacent to an exit sign. The controller receives a fire signal from a fire fighting system, a signal from the signal receiver, and generates a control signal after combining the signals. The alarm controller receives the control signal from the controller and blocks the output of an alarm from the exit sign.
abstract_ko: 시각 장애인을 위한 화재 음성경보 제어장치가 개시된다. 상기 제어장치는, 유도등 장치에 인접하여 설치된 열 감지기 또는 연기 감지기로부터 출력되는 감지신호를 수신하는 감지신호 수신부; 소방시스템으로부터 화재신호를 수신하고 상기 감지신호 수신부로부터 상기 감지신호를 수신하여 이들을 조합하여 제어신호를 생성하는 제어부; 및 상기 제어부로부터의 제어신호를 수신하여 상기 유도등 장치의 유도안내 음성경보의 출력을 차단하는 음성경보 조절부를 포함한다.

title_en: Apparatus for deriving a dangerous section of a road based on noise generated from the road and method therefor
title_ko: 소리 분석 기반의 위급 상황을 인식하기 위한 장치 및 이를 위한 방법
abstract_en: A method for recognizing a dangerous situation of the present invention, which can recognize a dangerous situation even in a non-detected area such as a blind spot of a CCTV to quickly handle the situation, comprises: a step of receiving, by a signal processing unit, an audio signal collected by one or more sensor devices; a step of detecting, by the signal processing unit, an interested audio signal, which is an audio signal having a pre-set interested frequency band, from the received audio signal; a step of analyzing, by a situation recognition unit, the interested audio signal through a trained recognition model to check whether the received audio signal is a rescue request sound signal, which is a sound signal requesting rescue in a dangerous situation; and a step of sending, by a warning unit, a rescue request message requesting rescue to a pre-set contact number when the received audio signal is the rescue request sound signal as a checking result.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 위급 상황을 인식하기 위한 방법은 신호처리부가 하나 이상의 센서장치가 수집한 오디오 신호를 수신하는 단계와, 신호처리부가 상기 수신된 오디오 신호로부터 기 설정된 관심 주파수 대역을 가지는 오디오 신호인 관심 오디오 신호를 검출하는 단계와, 상황인식부가 학습된 인식모델을 통해 상기 관심 오디오 신호를 분석하여 상기 수신된 오디오 신호가 위급 상황에서 구조를 요청하는 음성 신호인 구조요청음성신호인지 여부를 확인하는 단계와, 상기 확인 결과, 상기 수신된 오디오 신호가 상기 구조요청음성신호이면, 경보부가 기 설정된 연락처로 구조를 요청하는 구조 요청 메시지를 전송하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Fire information notification method based on IoT
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an IoT-based fire information notification method, which can quickly notify the elderly or visually or hearing impaired having a lack of detection ability that a fire has occurred when an emergency situation such as a fire occurs and can evacuate the same. More specifically, the IoT-based fire information notification method comprises the steps of: 1) requesting access approval from a wireless terminal through a user terminal; 2) providing user information received in the wireless terminal to a relay server through an administrator terminal; 3) transmitting fire occurrence information to the relay server through the administrator terminal when an emergency situation due to a fire occurs; 4) enabling the relay server to transmit the fire occurrence information to the user terminal based on stored user information; and 5) enabling the user terminal receiving the fire occurrence information to execute a notification means provided in the user terminal so that a user confirms whether the emergency situation has occurred. The notification means is an alarm function including sound and vibration.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재와 같은 비상상황이 발생시에 감지 능력이 부족한 노약자나 시각 또는 청각장애인들에게 화재가 발생하였음을 신속하게 알리고 대피시킬 수 있는 사물인터넷을 기반으로 하는 화재정보 알림방법에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 1)사용자단말을 통해 무선단말부에 접속 승인을 요청하는 단계와, 2)상기 무선단말부에 수신된 사용자정보를 관리자단말에 의해 중계서버로 제공하는 단계와, 3)화재발생에 따른 비상상황이 발생시에 상기 관리자단말을 통해 상기 중계서버에 화재발생정보를 전송하는 단계와, 4)상기 중계서버는 저장된 사용자정보를 기반으로 상기 사용자단말에 화재발생정보를 송출하는 단계 및 5)화재발생정보를 수신한 상기 사용자단말은 상기 사용자단말에 구비된 알림수단을 실행하여 비상상황 발생 여부를 사용자에게 확인시키는 단계를 포함하되, 상기 알림수단은 음향과 진동을 포함하는 알람기능인 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: GYEONGBUK COLLEGE OF HEALTH IND ACADEMY COOPERATION GROUP

title_en: Floods alarm system in pit based on image and coal -winning machine monitoring facilities
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a floods alarm system in pit based on image and coal -winning machine monitoring facilities. Install the camera in the pit on the coal face hydraulic support in the colliery, the camera connection diagram like with coal -winning machine monitoring facilities and video server, image and coal -winning machine monitoring facilities simultaneous acquisition coal -winning machine data, image and coal -winning machine monitoring facilities monitoring live video and coal -winning machine data send floods warning data to monitor terminal according to monitoring results, NULL personnel accessible monitor terminal looks over the real -time and historical video in scene to make emergency treatment, this alarm system divides the characteristic characteristics of having considered colliery coal face floods, implements simply, in time takes corresponding measure automatically, but the very first time accurately report to the police to water inrush in mine, do not strive for the valuable relief of disaster and the time of fleing for taking place other on -the -spot regional personnels in the pit.
assignees: CHINA UNIV OF MINING AND TECH (BEIJING)

title_en: Safety device is used in construction of railway business line based on microwave response
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety device is used in construction of railway business line based on microwave response, including support column and the mounting panel of fixed connection in the support column upper end, the downside right-hand member fixedly connected with of mounting panel is used for listening the microwave inductor of driving distance speed, upside right-hand member fixedly connected with radio transmitter and audible-visual annunciator of mounting panel, the microwave inductor respectively with radio transmitter and audible-visual annunciator electric connection, radio transmitter matches and uses and has a plurality of warning terminals. The utility model discloses a set up microwave inductor, radio transmitter and alarm terminal, when detecting the driving a vehicle through the microwave inductor and be close to fast, the accessible radio in time transmits dangerous information to a plurality of alarm terminal, does not receive noisy environment and visibility's restriction, can effectively improve the safety protection effect.

title_en: A kind of marine monitoring and early warning terminal based on Beidou navigation communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of marine monitoring and early warning terminals based on Beidou navigation communication, including shell and setting and the main circuit board in shell, the main circuit board includes Beidou positioning module, processor, sensor module, 4G transmitting device, touch screen module, audio-frequency module and Big Dipper short message communication module, and the Beidou positioning module, processor, sensor module, 4G transmitting device, touch screen module and audio-frequency module are connect with processor respectively.The present invention, can be by being communicated in the case where mobile network communicates good situations between 4G transmitting device and server；Can solve the navigation and long-range control problem in mobile network blind area by Beidou positioning module and satellite communication when being in mobile network blind area；And it can be according to the warning information of remote monitoring center again planning path, escape from danger region, moreover it is possible to carry out dangerous situation alarm to remote monitoring center, can improve the safety of boat trip.

title_en: Service decision device and method based on environment elements
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a service decision device and method based on environmental elements, wherein the service decision device includes: the terminal support subsystem is configured to perform data interaction with the server-side equipment, acquire environment monitoring information, send the analyzed environment monitoring information to the server-side equipment, enable the server-side equipment to determine influence factors of a strategy pool corresponding to a service scene, corresponding to the environment monitoring information, and determine service decision information according to the environment monitoring information and the influence factors; and receiving service decision information fed back by the server side equipment. Through the embodiment of the disclosure, the pertinence and the reliability of the meteorological service of remote areas are improved, the method is widely applied to the work of guaranteeing local major activities by meteorological service organizations in various areas, the problem of blind areas of meteorological observation data of areas without meteorological observation stations is solved, and powerful support is provided for natural disaster early warning decision.
assignees: CMA PUBLIC METEOROLOGICAL SERVICE CENTRE NAT EARLY WARNING INFORMATION PUBLISHING CENTER

title_en: Evaluation method and device for vehicle blind area auxiliary system, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of vehicles, in particular to a method and a device for evaluating a blind area auxiliary system of a vehicle, the vehicle and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: controlling the vehicle to be evaluated and the target vehicle to run at a test speed corresponding to each test item in a preset traffic test scene; controlling a vehicle to be evaluated to enter a blind area auxiliary system, and acquiring early warning intensity information, early warning time information and early warning missing report information in the test process of the current test item; and generating an evaluation result of the blind area auxiliary system of the vehicle to be evaluated according to the early warning intensity information, the early warning time information and the early warning missing report information of one or more test items and by combining the score of the current test item. Therefore, the problem that potential safety hazards appear when a user drives a vehicle due to the fact that the comprehensive capacity of the vehicle blind area auxiliary system of the vehicle cannot be accurately evaluated in the correlation technology is solved, not only can the safety be effectively improved, but also guiding opinions can be provided for research, development and acceptance of the vehicle blind area auxiliary driving system.
assignees: CEREAL NEW ENERGY AUTOMOBILE CO LTD

title_en: Real-time monitoring and optimizing method for rare earth electrolysis production line based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial big data analysis, in particular to a real-time monitoring and optimizing method of a rare earth electrolysis production line based on multi-source data fusion, which is used for carrying out local preprocessing on real-time data through an edge computing gateway to obtain processed data, and carrying out real-time display on the processed data through a visual interface. The invention realizes millisecond response through edge calculation, and compared with the traditional system, the invention has the advantages that the response speed is improved by 3 times, and the production instantaneity is integrally improved by 30%. The multi-source data fusion and cluster analysis technology reduces false alarm, covers the blind area of the traditional system, and reduces the false alarm rate from 25% to below 5%. The worker can respond quickly without professional experience, and the manual adjustment time is shortened from several hours to a minute level. Harmful gas concentration is detected in real time, early warning is carried out in time, protection measures are triggered, and safety accidents such as molten salt leakage, overload shutdown and the like are avoided. Therefore, the problems that the efficiency of manually adjusting parameters is low, and the production state is easy to misjudge due to empirical decision are solved.
assignees: UNIV GUILIN ELECTRONIC TECH;GUILIN ZHIGONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: real time diaster information service system for the diaster weak
title_ko: 재난 약자를 위한 실시간 재난정보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates a real-time disaster information system for disaster-vulnerable individuals. In a disaster information service method, the system comprises: a service server (100) comprising a subscriber information storing part (110) for storing subscriber information storing information on whether a user who uses an application is a hard-of-hearing person or a foreigner, a disaster information collecting part (130) receiving disaster information including a disaster text message, a sign language video generating part (140, a sign language video processing part, a sign language video storing part) generating sign language video information (I1) to be transmitted to the hard-of-hearing person terminal based on the disaster information, a foreign language translation service part (150, a foreign language translation server) generating disaster information (I2) translated in foreign languages to be transmitted to foreigners based on the disaster information; and a user terminal (200) which receives sign language video information (I1) or the translated disaster information (I2) from the service server (100) and displays the same on a display, and has an application program (200a) installed to generate a user interface (UI) for interfacing with the service server (100). According to the present invention, provided is a real-time disaster information system for disaster-vulnerable individuals and a disaster information service method providing a sign language video to a hard-of-hearing person and an online disaster notification service based on a native language for each country to foreigners.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난정보 서비스 방법에 있어서, 애플리케이션을 사용하는 사용자의 청각 장애인 여부, 외국인 여부에 관한 정보를 저장하는 가입자 정보를 저장하는 가입자 정보 저장부(110)와, 재난문자를 포함하는 재난정보를 입력받는 재난 정보 수집부(130)와, 상기 재난 정보에 기초하여 청각 장애인 단말기에게 전송될 수어 영상 정보(I1)를 생성하는 수어 영상 생성부(140, 수어 영상 처리부, 수어 영상 저장부 )와, 상기 재난 정보에 기초하여 외국인에게 전송될 외국어로 번역된 재난 정보(I2)를 생성하는 외국어 번역 서비스부(150, 외국어 번역 서버)로 구성된 서비스 서버(100)와; 상기 서비스 서버(100)로부터 수어 영상 정보(I1) 또는 번역된 재난 정보(I2)를 수신하여 디스플레이에 표출하고 상기 서비스 서버(100)와 인터페이스 하기 위한 유저 인터페이스(UI)를 생성하는 애플리케이션 프로그램(200a)이 설치된 사용자 단말기(200);를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 재난 약자를 위한 실시간 재난정보 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: System for emergency safety warning and risk mitigation
abstract_en: Various embodiments relate to a system for activities of daily living (“ADL”) and instrumental activities of daily living (“IADL”) monitoring through electric current profile sensing, the system including an electric current profile sensing module configured to sense electricity usage and capture a current profile of a plurality of devices in a home using a plurality of current clamps, a device usage detection module configured to match the current profile for each of the plurality of devices to a referenced profile for each of the plurality of devices to determine a detected usage for each of the plurality of devices and an ADL and IADL module configured to translate the detected usage for each of the plurality of devices into ADLs and IADLs; wherein the ADL and IADL detection module determines whether a detected usage is a hazardous situation based on ADLs and IADLs.

title_en: Emergency notification, activity notification, and suspicious movement detection for mobile devices
abstract_en: Foreign emergency notification, activity notification, and suspicious movement detection for mobile devices are disclosed. An application running on a mobile device of a user may be used to automatically detect when a call is made to emergency services in a foreign country, when an issue or unpermitted behavior may be occurring, when the mobile device has moved to an anomalous or unpermitted location and/or is moving with an unexpected speed, etc. The application then notifies family members and/or other contacts in the user's home country via a domestic carrier network. An over-the-top Internet Protocol (IP) message can be sent by the application on the mobile device back to the home network core.

title_en: Patient vital sign monitoring and alarming device in wireless radiotherapy machine room
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wireless radiotherapy computer lab patient vital sign monitoring and alarm device wears the part by computer lab part, the control room part of warning and patient and constitutes, and the control room part structure of warning is the exact same with the computer lab part structure of warning, and patient wears the part and encircles on patient's wrist, and each part is through wireless microwave transmission and receipt realization transmission. The device combines active alarm and passive alarm, adopts a vital sign monitoring system and a pneumatic and button dual active alarm switch, and greatly enhances the accuracy and safety of sound and light alarm; the dragging and winding of the wire harness can be avoided by adopting a wireless data transmission mode. The utility model discloses effectively fill artificial control leak, be domestic and foreign radiotherapy computer lab alarm monitoring system's initiative, be applicable to the transmission of patient's biological information's real time monitoring and patient's information of seeking help between radiotherapy computer lab and the control room. Is very worthy of popularization and application in the clinical field of radiotherapy.

title_en: Parking warning device, warning subassembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a parking warning device, warning assembly and vehicle, including: the system comprises a ranging module, a control unit and an alarm assembly, wherein the alarm assembly comprises a warning board which can be opened or closed; the warning board is arranged outside the vehicle, the ranging module is connected with the control unit, and the control unit is connected with the warning component; the distance measuring module is used for detecting an obstacle in front of the vehicle and sending distance information of the obstacle to the control unit; the control unit is used for determining whether an obstacle meeting a set condition exists in front of the vehicle according to the distance information of the obstacle, and controlling the warning component to open the warning board under the condition that the obstacle meeting the set condition exists. Through setting up the warning sign outside the vehicle, confirm the place ahead barrier condition of vehicle and control warning subassembly and open the warning sign after confirming that there is the barrier through the control unit to remind left rear side vehicle parking information, avoid left rear side vehicle because of the potential safety hazard that the visual field blind area caused.

title_en: Blind guiding walking stick
abstract_en: A blind guiding walking stick is characterized in that an upper bolt hole and a concave groove are formed in one side of the walking stick, a movable joint is arranged at the lower portion of the walking stick, a tripod of a triangular trolley is connected with a movable sleeve, the other end of the triangular trolley is connected with a trolley wheel, a spring bolt is arranged on the movable sleeve, the movable sleeve can be limited not to turn when sliding on the walking stick, the movable sleeve can be conveniently and quickly and accurately moved to a lower bolt hole by a blind person, vibration and collision of the wheels can be judged through the triangular trolley when the triangular trolley moves forwards, road conditions of the front side, the left side and the right side can be judged, when any one side of the triangular trolley touches an obstacle, the walking stick can immediately arouse alertness, collision and falling injury are not prone to occur, a good blind guiding effect is achieved for reducing potential safety hazards, the whole.

title_en: Underground pressure monitoring device and method for petroleum production
abstract_en: The invention relates to an oil exploitation auxiliary system and method, in particular to an underground pressure monitoring device and method for oil exploitation. The technical scheme is as follows: the bottom of the process pipe column is provided with a monitoring early warning device, the upper part of the process pipe column is provided with a signal terminal receiver, the upper end of a system carrier of the monitoring early warning device is connected with the lower end of the blind plug, a pressure limiting carrier, an induction protection block and a sensor are sequentially arranged in an inner cavity of the system carrier, the lower end of the system carrier is provided with a limiting cover plate, the middle part of the induction protection block is provided with an induction contact and a sensing support spring, and the upper end of the induction contact is electrically connected with the sensor. The beneficial effects are that: the pressure signal and the blowout signal of the stratum are converted into electric signals by using the sensor, the stratum change in the well is transmitted to the ground in a wireless electromagnetic wave mode, and due to the fact that the transmission speed of the electromagnetic wave is high, personnel on the ground have time to rapidly start an emergency treatment scheme and rapidly evacuate and avoid risks, and casualties and partial property loss are reduced.
assignees: SHANDONG CHERIKESEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Long-distance diversion engineering operation and maintenance method and device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a long-distance diversion engineering operation and maintenance method, a device, electronic equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: building a BIM-GIS model base map, acquiring real-time monitoring data of the multi-source internet of things monitoring equipment, matching and correlating the real-time monitoring data with the BIM-GIS model base map, visually analyzing and displaying the real-time monitoring data, performing safety evaluation on the real-time monitoring data by adopting a long-distance diversion engineering safety evaluation model, outputting an overall safety state score, marking on the BIM-GIS model base map according to the overall safety state score, and triggering early warning. The method can integrate production, maintenance and security of diversion engineering, conduct multi-mode association mining on monitoring data such as production management, maintenance management and security management, automatically discover potential safety hazards, trigger pre-alarm on a BIM-GIS model base map, reduce safe operation and maintenance blind areas, improve risk prevention and control capability and improve comprehensive operation benefits.
assignees: GUANGZHOU BEIJIANG RAW WATER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Safety early warning pendant and alarm method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an alarm which is suitable for safety precaution pendants of blind persons. The safety precaution pendant comprises a main board, an alarm control circuit, a microphone, a vibration motor and an LED lamp. The microphone and the alarm control circuit are connected with the main board circuit, and the vibration motor and the LED lamp are connected with the alarm control circuit. The main board can identify the environment sound collected by the microphone, and if the identified sound type is alarm sound, a control signal is sent out to start the alarm control circuit, the alarm control circuit controls the vibration motor and the LED lamp to work and generate vibration and luminous flicker, and alarm sound signals are converted into vibration signals and light signals which can be perceived by a hearing loss person, so that the hearing loss person can timely perceive the alarm sound.

title_en: Apparatusand method for a warning system
abstract_en: A warning system having a plurality of components including a Lidar device, an adjustment means, an audio source, a light source, a controller, and a power source. The warning system produces at least one of the audible sound and the light signal when the one or more laser beams detects a foreign object. A method for providing a warning in the event a foreign object is detected.

title_en: Fire Voice-Alert Controller for the blind and Control Method
title_ko: 시각 장애인을 위한 화재 음성경보 제어장치와 제어방법
abstract_ko: 시각 장애인을 위한 화재 음성경보 제어장치가 개시된다. 상기 제어장치는, 유도등 장치에 인접하여 설치된 열 감지기 또는 연기 감지기로부터 출력되는 감지신호를 수신하는 감지신호 수신부; 소방시스템으로부터 화재신호를 수신하고 상기 감지신호 수신부로부터 상기 감지신호를 수신하여 이들을 조합하여 제어신호를 생성하는 제어부; 및 상기 제어부로부터의 제어신호를 수신하여 상기 유도등 장치의 유도안내 음성경보의 출력을 차단하는 음성경보 조절부를 포함한다.

title_en: Electronic bulletin board apparatus and the operating method thereof
title_ko: 전자 게시판 장치 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides an electronic bulletin board device capable of displaying a disaster notification message and enabling smooth communication between a hearing-impaired person and a manager in an emergency situation, and an operating method thereof, thereby supporting people to take measures for safety more quickly in an emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 알림 메시지를 표시할 수 있고, 비상 상황에서 청각 장애인과 관리자 간의 원활한 소통을 가능하게 하는 전자 게시판 장치 및 그 동작 방법을 제시함으로써 비상 상황에서 사람들이 안전을 위한 조치를 보다 빠르게 취할 수 있도록 지원할 수 있다.

title_en: Indoor intelligent monitoring and early warning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an indoor intelligent monitoring and early warning equipment that uses, include: the device comprises a main body, a plurality of clamping pieces and a plurality of clamping pieces, wherein a groove is formed in the main body; a spray head installed at one side of the body; the glass cover is arranged above the main body, a fixed seat is arranged above the glass cover, and a supporting rod is arranged above the fixed seat; and the fixing ring is arranged at one end of the supporting rod. This indoor intelligent monitoring early warning equipment that uses, can make indoor gas from solid fixed ring inside circulation through the exhaust fan, be favorable to solid fixed ring below smoke alarm to discover smog, when smoke alarm sent out the police dispatch newspaper, the camera can rotate through the pivot, can scan the interior space, can detect flame, when the burning things which may cause a fire disaster appears, main part accessible gyro wheel removes burning things which may cause a fire disaster department, the dry powder passes through pipeline and solenoid valve and from the shower nozzle blowout, can eliminate the burning things which may cause a fire disaster, control the burning things which may cause a fire disaster scope and enlarge.

title_en: Current-limiting gate for rail transit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a current-limiting gate for rail transit, which comprises a gate mechanism, a warning mechanism, a gate opening mechanism, a sensing mechanism and a blocking mechanism, wherein the warning mechanism is positioned at the rear side of the upper end of the gate mechanism, the gate opening mechanism is positioned at the front side of the upper end of the gate mechanism, the sensing mechanism is positioned in front of the inner end of the gate mechanism, and the blocking mechanism is positioned at the rear of the inner end of the gate mechanism. This track traffic current-limiting floodgate machine, inside each parts is mutually supported, the effectual holistic work efficiency of device that has improved, it is more reasonable to make the device, be provided with multistep safety structure in this floodgate machine, can warn some illegal and current actions, inform the guard personnel in time to handle, also accessible facial discernment contrast, the discovery has the record in time to send out the warning suggestion people to handle when the wanted personnel of case, this setting makes the traffic checkpoint safer, guarantee people's life safety, excellent in working effect.

title_en: Public fire control detects closed circuit supervisory equipment for early warning
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a public fire control detects closed circuit supervisory equipment for early warning in fire control technical field, including mounting panel and switch box, the bottom fixedly connected with camera of mounting panel one side, the bottom that camera one side was kept away from to the mounting panel sets up the master control box, and the bottom that master control box one side was kept away from to the mounting panel sets up the initiative shower head, and the bottom that initiative shower head one end was kept away from to the mounting panel sets up the smoke sensor, and the bottom that the mounting panel is located between smoke sensor and the initiative shower head sets up bee calling organ. Carry out video monitoring to site environment through the camera, make things convenient for managers in time to discover potential safety hazard and disaster situation source, and carry out rectification and reform, can carry out initiative early warning information's triggering through the switch box simultaneously, further improve the discovery time of disaster situation, when taking place emergency such as power failure, the accessible battery inserts stand-by power supply, continues to carry out the fire control and detects the early warning operation, when signal connection line breaks down, accessible wireless signal in time reports early warning information.
assignees: DALIAN DONG XU TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Guiding stick with safety warning performance
abstract_en: The invention relates to a guiding stick with a safety warning performance. According to the invention, vibration luminous zones are installed on a guiding stick body for illumination and a switch, which is arranged and is in match with a blind road, is utilized to start a voice guide; therefore, a user that is using the guiding stick is prompted for pedestrians passing by and vehicles passing and safety of the user is also ensured, so that a guiding stick with a safety warning performance is formed; besides, the guiding stick provided in the invention can be used by the old and people with poor eyesight.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring foreign matter invasion limit and early warning risk of track line
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for monitoring foreign matter intrusion and early warning risks of a track line, belongs to the technical field of railway disaster prevention and early warning risks, and acquires three-dimensional space point cloud data and track plane image data around a track; according to the point cloud data and the track plane image data, identifying and extracting the foreign matter features in the limited area; calculating risks with different characteristics by adopting an analytic hierarchy process and a risk matrix method according to the characteristics of the invasion limit foreign matters, and performing fusion calculation on the risks with different characteristics to obtain a comprehensive risk value of the invasion limit foreign matters; and carrying out early warning treatment and evidence obtaining and reporting according to risk classification of the invasion limit foreign matters. The invention realizes the monitoring, identification and analysis of the track line limit-invasion event characteristics and the event occurrence process, further improves the risk prevention and control capacity of the track traffic system, and has good application and popularization values.

title_en: Wearable intelligent blind-assisting sports shoulder strap and blind-assisting interaction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a wearable intelligent blind-assisting sports shoulder strap and a blind-assisting interaction method thereof, comprising the following steps: the system comprises an information acquisition module, a processor module, a voice feedback module and a vibration warning module. The information acquisition module sends acquired data information to the processor module for processing, the processor module sends processed information to the vibration warning module and the voice feedback module respectively, the voice feedback module converts the received information into audio frequency and transmits the audio frequency to the human ear in real time, and the vibration warning module carries out emergency reminding on visually impaired people through vibration. The intelligent shoulder strap is arranged in the intelligent shoulder strap and is worn on a human body. The invention processes the information by using the RGB-D camera to sense the external environment and by using the deep learning method, and navigates the visually impaired person by means of voice and vibration, thereby helping the visually impaired person to run on the sports ground and improving the sensing capability of the sports ground environment and the self action capability.
assignees: HEFEI COMPREHENSIVE NATIONAL SCIENCE CENTER ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE RES INSTITUTE ANHUI ARTIFICIAL I

title_en: Safety early warning equipment for coiled material feeder
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coiled material feeders and discloses safety early warning equipment for the coiled material feeders, which comprises a feeder shell and a feeding group, wherein the feeding group is arranged at the top of the feeder shell, the top of the feeder shell is provided with a safety component for preventing safety problems caused by short circuit of the equipment, an anti-jamming component for preventing the feeding group from causing safety accidents due to jamming is arranged above the safety component, a trigger component for matching with the anti-jamming component is arranged above the feeding group, and through the arrangement of the safety component, the anti-jamming component and the trigger component, the automatic power-off of the equipment under the condition that the short circuit and foreign matters jam occur in the coiled material feeder is achieved, and meanwhile, an alarm lamp is automatically extinguished.

title_en: Intelligent navigation system for blind person
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent blind person navigation system, which relates to the technical field of intelligent wearable blind person navigation and comprises a multi-mode sensing unit, A I decision centers, a two-way feedback module and an emergency response system, wherein the intelligent wearable blind person navigation system still keeps 94% obstacle detection rate under 5l ux low illumination through a three-layer sensing framework of a double-light fusion camera, a laser radar and an ultrasonic array, and the effective detection distance is 8 meters. The semantic segmentation algorithm enables the detection rate of suspended obstacles to be increased from 12% to 92%, and the recognition error of the glass door in the underground garage scene is only 2.1cm. The multi-sensor space-time alignment technology reduces the false alarm rate from 25% to 3.2% in a complex scene, and realizes the accurate perception of all-weather and full-height obstacles. The biological characteristics and environmental risk multi-level triggering mechanism automatically alarms and shares positioning within 2.1 seconds when a user falls, and the falling rescue success rate of the underground garage is improved from 62% to 100%. And (3) automatically recording environment video with positioning when no operation is overtime, and constructing a closed-loop safety net for 'prevention-early warning-rescue'.

title_en: LKJ train operation monitoring and intelligent lookout collision avoidance system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent identification, in particular to an LKJ train operation monitoring and intelligent observation anti-collision system, which comprises an LKJ train operation monitoring device and an LFK intelligent observation anti-collision device, wherein the LKJ train operation monitoring device and the LFK intelligent observation anti-collision device are in mutual cooperative work with each other in two-way information, the integrated system has the functions of train beyond-sight observation and anti-collision early warning, has the functions of identifying and alarming flood and debris flow disasters in front of a track line, can monitor train operation according to the information of the front line, can control automatic braking protection of the train in advance when foreign matter invasion occurs, and can automatically upload driving conditions, alarming conditions and obstacle conditions to a ground server. Therefore, the system can solve the technical problem that the train collision accident caused by foreign matter invasion and perimeter invasion is not provided with an auxiliary early warning device because the lookout of crews in the driving process is controlled by personnel.

title_en: Intersection early warning method, vehicle, electronic equipment and program product
abstract_en: The application provides an intersection early warning method, a vehicle, electronic equipment and a program product, relates to the technical field of intelligent driving, and aims to improve the traffic safety of vehicles at a target intersection. The method comprises the steps of determining a target early warning strategy based on traffic rule information of a target intersection in response to the fact that a vehicle is about to arrive at the target intersection, wherein the target intersection comprises a blind area intersection and/or a traffic light-free intersection, and executing the target early warning strategy.

title_en: Method of position-report and relief service by mobile communication device including gps
title_ko: Ｇｐｓ를 구비한 이동통신 단말기의 위치조회 및 안심 서비스 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A location searching and safe service method of a portable terminal including a GPS(Global Positioning Service) is provided to solve the inexactitude of a protecting target location information by using GPS information. CONSTITUTION: A protector terminal requests the location information of a ward terminal to a server. The server transmits UUSD(Unstructured Supplementary Service Data) messages to the protecting target terminal by using a (Wideband Code Division Multiple Access) wireless network. The protecting target terminal acquires the location information of the ward terminal through positioning operations. The protecting target terminal transmits the acquired location information to the protector terminal through the server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 GPS(Global Positioning System)를 구비하는 이동통신 단말기를 이용한 위치조회 및 안심 서비스 방법으로서, 상세하게는, 보호자 단말기가 서버에 보호대상 단말기의 위치정보 요청 시 상기 서버가 상기 보호대상 단말기의 실시간 위치 측위를 활성화시켜 위치정보를 획득하고, 획득한 위치정보를 보호자 단말기로 전송하여 보호자에게 현재 보호대상 단말기의 위치정보를 알려주는 서비스 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 GPS를 구비하는 이동통신 단말기를 이용하여 위치정보의 부정확성을 GPS 기반으로 개선하고 일반 보호자 휴대폰에 전용 애플리케이션을 제공함으로써 서비스에 대한 접근성과 사용성을 높일 수 있으며 WCDMA 통신망을 이용하여 USSD 방식을 적용함에 따라 SMS에 비해 전송속도가 빠르다. 또한 정확한 위치정보 제공, 비상 상황 경보음 작동, 자동 현장 사진 송출, 보호자와의 자동 영상 통화와 같은 기능을 제공함에 따라 빠른 출동을 통해 사고를 예방하고, 현장 상황을 명확하고 빠르게 파악할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: The manufacturing method of feed by using food waste device
title_ko: 음식물 처리기기를 이용한 사료 및 퇴비의 제조방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing feed and compost using a food treatment device, which efficiently removes harmful bacteria and moisture. The method of the present invention comprises: a step (B1) of inputting a food waste into a hopper; a step (B2) of separating foreign substances; a crushing and grinding step (B3); a step (B4) of separating a solid and waste liquid; a step (B5) of sterilizing harmful bacteria and removing moisture; a step (B6) of fermenting the solid; a step (B7) of mixing grains and basic chemicals with the fermented solid; a step (B8) of drying the mixed solid; and a step (B9) of packaging and shipping a molded and dried pellet.
abstract_ko:
발명은 음식물 쓰레기 내에 함유된 유해세균과 수분의 제거가 효율적으로 이루어지면서도, 비교적 저가인 열원을 사용함으로써 음식물 쓰레기 처리비용을 대폭 절감할 수 있도록 한, 저비용 고효율의 환경친화적 음식물 쓰레기 재활용방법에 관한 것이다. 
종래의 음식물 쓰레기를 이용한 사료제조공정은, 음식물 쓰레기 수거차량에 의하여 수거된 음식물 쓰레기를 호퍼에 투입하여(A1) 금속성 물질이나 비닐 등의 이물질을 분리하는 단계와(A2), 이를 잘게 부수는 파쇄 단계(A3), 보일러를 이용하여 고온·고압의 스팀자켓 내에서 살균하는 멸균 단계(A4), 고형물과 폐액을 분리하는 분리단계(A5), 분리된 고형물을 건조시키는 단계(A6), 건조된 고형물에 미생물을 첨가하여 발효시키는 단계(A7), 발효된 고형물에 곡물을 배합하는 단계(A8), 마지막으로 이를 펠릿(pellet)으로 성형하고 건조하여(A9) 일정 단위별로 포장 및 출하하는 단계(A10)로 이루어져 있다. 
그러나, 상기와 같은 종래의 처리방법에 있어서는, 멸균을 성공적으로 달성하기 위해서 일정하게 고온을 유지해 주면서 상당 시간 동안 계속 가열하여야 하므로 일정한 온도 유지에 따른 기술적인 어려움은 물론 저효율, 고비용의 경제적 부담에 따라 사업의 경제성이 거의 없는 문제점이 있었다. 
반면, 종래 방법에 따를 경우에는 상기와 같은 과다한 운영비용에도 불구하고, 멸균이나 수분의 제거가 만족할 만한 수준으로 이루어지지 못하고 따라서 완제품 사료의 수분함량이 과다하여 궁극적으로는 완제품 사료의 상품가치가 하락하고 제품의 변질로 인하여 보관기간이 짧아지는 단점이 있었다. 
아울러, 단위 시간 내에 처리할 수 있는 음식물 쓰레기의 양이 제한되고, 작업자가 화상이나 폭발 등의 재해 위험에 상시 노출되는 안전상의 문제가 내재하고 있었으며, 나아가 음식물 쓰레기를 재활용한다는 점에만 주안점을 둔 나머지, 
음식물 쓰레기의 처리시에 발생하는 폐액에 대해서는 별다른 처리공정 없이 방류하거나 해양에 투기함으로써 토양이나 수자원을 오염시켜 온 것이 동업계의 현실이었다. 
본 발명은 상기한 문제점을 해결하기 위하여 안출된 것으로서, 본 발명의 목적은 고난도의 기술로서 가능한 비교적 염가인 열원을 사용함으로써 2차 환경오염 없이 비용이 저렴하면서도 멸균이나 건조 및 발효가 완벽하게 이루어지는 저비용, 고효율의 음식물 쓰레기를 이용한 사료 또는 퇴비의 제조방법을 제공하는 것이다. 
본 발명의 다른 목적은, 음식물 쓰레기를 재활용함에 있어서 부수적으로 발생하는 폐액을 환경관련법 기준에 맞게 적절히 처리함으로써 환경보호 차원에서 완벽한 음식물 쓰레기의 재활용 방법을 제공하는 것이다. 
상기한 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명은, 음식물 쓰레기의 처리 단계에 소요되는 열원(熱源)으로서 대용량의 고주파를 사용함을 특징으로 한다. 
아울러, 열원으로서 고주파를 사용함에 따라 고형물의 멸균, 건조공정이 하나의 단계로 이루어질 수 있는 점을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명은 또한, 음식물 쓰레기 수거차량에 의하여 수거된 음식물 쓰레기를 처리하고 재활용함에 있어서, 고형물과 폐액을 분리하는 분리단계와 분리된 고형물을 멸균·건조시키는 단계가 순차적으로 포함되어 있는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: All-in-one fire alarm system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an all-in-one fire alarm system capable of being installed in a facility such as a refrigeration warehouse; sensing occurrence of fire through smoke sensing; improving a fire sensing performance by removing foreign substances such as dust or moisture of the facility. The all-in-one fire alarm system comprises: an enclosure unit; an air supplying line; a fire sensing device; a repeater; a cyclone hopper; an inline filter; and a water trap. The enclosure unit is installed in the refrigeration warehouse and forms an inner space to be opened and closed. The air supplying line supplies air of the refrigeration warehouse in which the enclosure unit is installed to the enclosure unit. The fire sensing device is installed in the enclosure unit, and senses smoke caused by fire in the air supplied through the air supplying line. The repeater receives sensing of the smoke from the fire sensing device and fire occurrence in the refrigeration warehouse to a control center or a manager terminal. The cyclone hopper is installed inside the enclosure unit, and removes dust included in the air while sucking the air to a direction of the enclosure unit through the air supplying line. The inline filter receives the air passing through the cyclone hopper, and removes the dust included in the air once more. The water trap collects moisture generated by condensation from the inside of the enclosure unit and drains the moisture to the outside of the enclosure unit.
