title_en: A device and method for guiding a visually impaired person who has stepped on a braille blocks at a bus stop to move to a safe area
title_ko: 버스 정류장에서 점자 블록을 밟은 시각 장애인에게 안전 구획으로 이동하도록 경고하는 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 버스 정류장에서 점자 블록을 밟은 시각 장애인에게 안전 구획으로 이동하도록 경고하는 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해, 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 버스 정류장에서 점자 블록을 밟은 탑승 대기자에게 안전 구획으로 이동하도록 경고하는 장치는 적어도 하나의 압력 센서 및 상기 적어도 하나의 압력 센서에 의해 감지된 압력 값을 경보 장치로 전송하는 무선 송신부를 포함하며, 상기 버스 정류장과 차도 사이에 배치된 점자 블록; 및 상기 무선 송신부로부터 상기 압력 값이 수신되면, 탑승 대기자에게 안전 구획으로 이동하도록 경고등 및 경고음을 출력하는 경보 장치를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: System and Method for Conveying Group Alerts Based on User Specified Information Access Codes
abstract_en: An improved system and method for defining an event based upon an object location and a user-defined zone and managing the conveyance of object location event information among computing devices where object location events are defined in terms of a condition based upon a relationship between user-defined zone information and object location information. One or more location information sources are associated with an object to provide the object location information. One or more user-defined zones are defined on a map and one or more object location events are defined. The occurrence of an object location event produces object location event information that is conveyed to users based on user identification codes. Accessibility to object location information, zone information, and object location event information is based upon an object location information access code, a zone information access code, and an object location event information access code, respectively.

title_en: High-rise building security rescue capsule marble network relay alarm system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marble network relay alarm system for a high-rise building security rescue capsule, which comprises a capsule body and a rescuer mobile phone APP; the cabin body comprises a marble module, an extravehicular environment sensor module, a control module, a display module, an input module, an image recognition module, a wireless local area network server module, a loudspeaker, a microphone, a camera, a video and audio coding and decoding module, an in-cabin environment sensor module and a power supply module; the marble module comprises an extravehicular camera, a marble cabin, marbles, springs, an ejection module and a three-dimensional holder. The wireless network is established to the cabin body, and the marble pops out, and every marble all is wireless network's relay, extension wireless network coverage, and marble audio alert reminds rescue personnel accessible wireless network and the interior personnel of cabin body to contact, and the cabin interior personnel can talk with rescue personnel's cell-phone APP video, send the inside and outside environmental data of cabin body and image. The invention enlarges the wireless network range and the alarm area, and is convenient for communicating with rescuers.

title_en: Intelligent early warning cable of integrated detection module
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent early warning cables and discloses an intelligent early warning cable integrated with a detection module, which comprises a cable conductor, wherein a cable core is fixedly connected inside the cable conductor, a connecting terminal is fixedly connected to the left side of the surface of the cable core, a monitoring optical fiber module is fixedly connected inside the cable conductor, an early warning fire extinguishing piece is arranged at the top of the cable conductor and used for early warning and extinguishing fire when the temperature of the cable core is abnormal, and the early warning fire extinguishing piece comprises a guide sleeve. According to the invention, through the transmission structure of the double-shaft motor linkage speed reducer, the sliding sleeve, the sliding rod and the concave plate, the powder spraying pipe, the temperature sensor and the flame sensor are driven to swing in a reciprocating manner, each cable core and the connecting terminal can be scanned, a monitoring blind area is avoided, the controller opens the miniature electromagnetic valve, so that fire extinguishing powder in the fire extinguishing tank is rapidly injected into the powder spraying pipe in a swinging state, the spraying range covers a plurality of installation positions, and the comprehensiveness of hidden danger detection is improved.

title_en: A kind of stand alone type detector for electric fire protection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of stand alone type detector for electric fire protection, power module, signal gathering unit, alarm module, keystroke handling unit, liquid crystal display, on-off model input/output control module and the communication module including the CPU being located in detector and electrically connected with described CPU, described signal gathering unit includes current signal collection module, residual current signal acquisition module and temperature signal collection module.This utility model can detect overload electric current and short circuit current and report to the police, the independent monitoring display of energy, save system cost, accessible temperature sensing cable carries out linear temperature-sensitive warning and connection fire-fighting link device carries out Function Extension, expansion is strong, additionally, this utility model uses nonpolarity double bus to carry out work of networking, stable performance, reliability is high.
assignees: SHENZHEN FORSAFE SYSTEM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Traffic blind area intelligence reminding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent traffic blind area reminding device, which comprises at least one group of intelligent reminding device, wherein the intelligent reminding device comprises a mounting frame and an intelligent reminding assembly, the intelligent reminding assembly comprises a monitoring module, an electric control module, a voice module and a warning module which are mutually and electrically connected, a camera or radar equipment is adopted to warn a vehicle in a blind area obstacle side of a road junction, and the vehicle is prevented from colliding because of the missing of the vision field of the road junction; this equipment pertinence is stronger, adapts to all abominable settings environment, and reminding device is provided with the mounting bracket, and whole warning subassembly that is used for the blind area warning all sets up on the mounting bracket, becomes an organic whole with the mounting bracket, breaks away from the environmental requirement to the installation with other equipment, as long as there is the blind area to lead to the vehicle field of vision to be lacked, the hidden danger that the solution blind area that this structure can both be intelligent comes satisfies L type circuit simultaneously, U type circuit, T type circuit etc. the installation adapts to all road blind area environment operation requirements.
assignees: NINGBO QUANHANG MACH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Safety warning indicator for power grid maintenance
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of power grid maintenance, and provides a safety warning indicator for power grid maintenance, which is shaped like a tablet and mainly comprises a near field communication module, an acousto-optic warning module and a controller, wherein the near field communication module is arranged on the front surface of the warning indicator, is electrically connected with the controller, and is used for acquiring user information through near field communication; the acousto-optic warning module is arranged on the front and/or the side of the warning device, is electrically connected with the controller and is used for making sound and emitting light; and the controller is arranged in the warning indicator and used for identifying the user information acquired by the near field communication module and controlling the working state of the acousto-optic warning module. The utility model discloses accessible near field communication module acquires user information to with this operating condition who controls reputation warning module, initiatively to staff's sound and light warning information, the suggestion staff is paid attention to the safety standard operation.

title_en: Wind-induced foreign matter short-circuit fault early warning method and system for power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-induced foreign matter short-circuit fault early warning method and a system for a power transmission line, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1: collecting historical wind-induced fault foreign matter short-circuit image information, and distinguishing and marking according to faults and non-faults; step 2: performing image processing on the historical image, extracting power grid foreign matter short-circuit characteristics from the processed historical image, and establishing a typical wire foreign matter comparison map library aiming at the power grid foreign matter short-circuit characteristics; and step 3: establishing a channel hidden danger distribution geographical map according to the line importance degree, the geographical characteristics and the grid wind area distribution map, and dividing hidden danger area types; and 4, step 4: acquiring real-time visual channel image information of the power transmission line, and identifying foreign matters in the real-time visual channel image; and 5: and early warning is carried out on the foreign matters of the power transmission line, and early warning information is pushed to a person responsible for the power transmission line. The invention realizes early warning and real-time warning of wind-induced foreign matter short circuit.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Intelligent sensing system and method for airport tractor
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless communication and machine vision, in particular to an intelligent sensing system of an airport tractor, which comprises an FOD detection unit, an RFID identification system, an operation control terminal and an audible and visual alarm, wherein the FOD detection unit is used for uninterruptedly detecting whether foreign matters exist around the tractor; the RFID identification system is used for identifying the equipment and judging whether to finish the corresponding steps; and the operation control terminal is used for image processing, displaying the currently executed step information and prompting the staff. The invention overcomes the defects of the tractor in the prior art, the whole process of towing the airplane is executed according to steps, the whole process is displayed on the touch display screen, whether barriers exist near the driving part or not is detected in the whole process, and safety early warning information is provided; the method greatly improves the safety and efficiency of the aircraft traction operation process, and greatly eliminates the danger caused by negligence of workers and emergencies.

title_en: Image equipment displacement abnormity early warning system and method based on feature point detection
abstract_en: The invention provides an image equipment displacement abnormity early warning system and method based on feature point detection, which belong to the technical field of abnormity early warning and specifically comprise the steps of carrying out feature point detection and descriptor calculation on a reference image and a current acquisition image, utilizing feature descriptors of the reference image and the current image to match to obtain image comparison image feature points, utilizing a distance function to determine feature point similarity coefficients of different comparison image feature points, utilizing the feature point similarity coefficients to carry out different comparison image feature points to match the feature points, constructing a homography matrix based on the matching feature points, extracting geometric transformation information based on the homography matrix to obtain a rotation angle, a scaling and a translation amount, and combining a preset threshold to determine whether the image equipment is deviated and send out early warning signals, thereby improving the reliability of monitoring processing.

title_en: Alerting system
abstract_en: A system for alerting a person with a hearing impairment participating in a game to a signal provided by a referee of the game is disclosed. The system comprising a referee module 10 to be worn by the referee during use and at least one player module 12 to be worn by a respective player during use. The referee module comprising a microphone, means for detecting a predetermined audio signal received through the microphone, and a transmitter responsive to detection of the predetermined audio signal to transmit an alert signal to a receiver of the or each player module. The player module further comprises means to alert the or each player to receipt of the alert signal.

title_en: Led lamp system equipped with a function of fire warning
title_ko: 계층 토폴로지 기반 화재 경보 기능 내장 led 조명 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an LED lamp which has a built-in fire alarm linking function. According to a preferred embodiment of the present invention, a master LED lamp included in a LED lamp system which has a built-in fire alarm linking function includes: a first LED module unit emitting light at a color temperature and brightness suitable for an installation space; a lighting control unit for turning the first LED module unit on or off; a fire sensing unit which monitors the fire occurrence in the installation space; and an alarm unit which provides an alarm when the fire sensing unit senses the fire occurrence. The master LED lamp also includes a communication unit for communicating with another master LED lamp of a different household while sharing the fire information between the households. The alarm unit can provide the fire alarm through various media to let users see and hear the fire alarm and recognize the situation regarding the fire. The LED lamp is used to provide the fire alarm. Households can exchange the fire alarm information, enabling all households in an apartment building to quickly respond to a fire. The fire alarm from the LED lamp is provided on an audio-based and visual manner to let visually impaired or hearing-impaired users recognize the fire easily.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 경보 연동 기능이 내장된 LED 조명에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 바람직한 일 실시예에 따른 화재 경보 기능 내장 LED 조명 시스템은 설치된 공간에 적합한 색온도와 조도로 발광하는 제 1 LED 모듈부, 제 1 LED 모듈부의 온/오프를 제어하는 조명 제어부, 설치된 공간에서의 화재 발생 여부를 모니터링하는 화재 감지부, 화재 감지부에 의해 화재 이벤트가 감지되면 경보를 제공하는 경보부를 구비한 마스터 LED 조명을 포함하고, 마스터 LED 조명은 다른 세대의 마스터 LED 조명과 통신을 제공하는 통신부를 더 포함하며, 통신부를 통해 세대 간 화재 정보를 공유할 수 있다. 이때, 경보부는 시각과 청각으로 화재 상황은 인지할 수 있게 다양한 매체를 통해 화재 경보를 제공할 수 있다. 본 발명은 LED 조명을 통해 화재 경보를 제공할 수 있다. 그리고, 세대 간 화재 경보 정보를 상호 교환할 수 있어 다가구/다세대 주택에서 모든 세대들이 화재에 신속하게 대응하도록 할 수 있다. 또한, LED 조명을 통해 시각과 청각으로 경보를 제공하는 것에 의해 청각 장애인 및 시각 장애인이 쉽게 화재 사실을 인지할 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus for judging earthquake-proof integrity for switch gear
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for determining earthquake resistance integrity for an incoming and distributing board, including: an arc sensor installed inside an enclosure of the incoming and distributing board, and configured to detect arc generation; a temperature sensor installed inside the enclosure, and configured to measure a temperature; a slope sensor installed inside the enclosure, and configured to measure a slope; a sensor elevator installed inside the enclosure, on which the arc sensor and the temperature sensor are installed, and configured to elevate the arc sensor and the temperature sensor to vary a sensing area; an integrity determination unit for determining the integrity of the incoming and distributing board according to whether detection results of the arc sensor, the temperature sensor, and the slope sensor satisfy integrity determination conditions; a communication unit for communicating with an external device; and a control unit for performing a control to provide a determination result obtained by the integrity determination unit to a predetermined terminal or system through the communication unit. According to the present invention, distortion, structural deformation, internal abnormal temperature determination, and an internal arc generation state are always diagnosed in the incoming and distributing board and internal devices, and a warning signal is transmitted to a nearby worker through a terminal such as a smartphone when an abnormal condition occurs, so that a failure of the incoming and distributing board is prevented so as to reduce maintenance and repair, and constant temperature measurement and deterioration state inspection are possible while removing a blind range of the sensors according to various components of the incoming and distributing board to detect the occurrence of the abnormal condition.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수배전반의 외함 내측에 설치되고, 아크 발생을 감지하는 아크센서; 상기 외함의 내측에 설치되고, 온도를 측정하는 온도센서; 상기 외함의 내측에 설치되고, 기울기를 측정하는 기울기센서; 상기 외함의 내측에 설치되어 상기 아크센서 및 상기 온도센서가 설치되고, 상기 아크센서 및 상기 온도센서를 감지 영역의 가변을 위해 승강시키는 센서승강기; 상기 아크센서, 상기 온도센서 및 상기 기울기센서의 감지 결과가 건전성 판단조건을 만족하는지 여부에 따라 수배전반의 건전성을 판단하는 건전성판단부; 외부 기기와의 통신을 수행하는 통신부; 및 상기 건전성판단부에 의한 판단 결과를 상기 통신부를 통해서 정해진 단말기 또는 시스템에 제공하도록 제어하는 포함하도록 한 수배전반용 내진 건전성 판단장치에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 수배전반 및 내부 기기에서 있어서 뒤틀림, 구조적 변형 및 내부의 이상온도 판단 및 내부의 아크 발생 상태를 상시 진단하고, 이상상태 발생시, 이를 스마트폰 등의 단말기를 통해서 주변 근무자 등에게 경고신호를 전송하도록 할 수 있고, 이로 인해 수배전반의 고장 예방 및 이를 통한 유지보수의 저감이 가능하며, 이상상태 발생을 감지하기 위한 수배전반의 여러 구성요소에 따른 센서의 사각 범위를 없애는 것과 동시에 상시적인 온도 측정 및 열화 상태에 대한 점검이 가능하도록 할 수 있다.
assignees: UJIN TECH CO LTD;DONG IL CO LTD

title_en: Hazard alert device and hazard alert system having the same
title_ko: 위험 알림 장치 및 이를 포함하는 사각지대 위험 경보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a blind spot hazard warning system including a hazard notifying device. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the hazard notifying device comprises: a support in which a lower part is laid under the ground; a plurality of arms connected to the support; a filming device fixed to the plurality of arms and acquiring an image of a dangerous section including surroundings of vehicles illegally parked along the road; and a control unit including at least one between a display and a speaker and transmitting an output signal to an output device to output information on the dangerous section when it is determined that a pedestrian is located in the dangerous section based on the image of the dangerous section acquired through the output device and filming device fixed to the plurality of arms.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 위험 알림 장치를 포함하는 사각지대 위험 경보 시스템을 제공한다.  
본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 위험 알림 장치는 하단이 지면 아래에 매설되는 지주와, 지주에 연결되는 복수의 암과, 복수의 암에 고정되고, 도로를 따라 불법주정차 된 차량들 주변을 포함하는 위험구간의 이미지를 획득하는 촬영 장치와, 디스플레이 및 스피커 중 적어도 하나를 포함하고, 복수의 암에 고정되는 출력 장치 및 촬영 장치를 통해 획득한 위험구간의 이미지에 기초하여 보행자가 위험구간 내에 위치한 것으로 판단되면 위험구간에 관한 정보를 출력하도록 출력 장치에 출력 신호를 송신하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Intelligent fire suppression system and method
abstract_en: A controller responds to an alert from a remote alert system and responds to an AI unit that detects a fire signature, and, in response, sends signals to fire suppression equipment to defend a structure against fire. A delivery device system may include delivery devices that are capable of spraying water and/or retardant at a structure or area to defend against fire. The system may act autonomously to defend against wildfires. The system includes a base station accessible by a user device to take control of the system. Alternatively, a central monitoring system may access the base station to control the system in addition to or instead of the user. In an embodiment, the system automatically sprays water or retardant prior to the outbreak of a fire. The system may optically detect embers landing on a structure or area being defended and sprays the embers with retard and/or water.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting prior-warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire-fighting prior-warning device, including casing, the casing is internally provided with battery, the upper end of the battery is provided with dividing plate, the upper end of the dividing plate is provided with PLC, the right-hand member of the PLC is provided with adapted transmission device, and the front end of the casing is provided with first manual alarm button, the upper end of the casing is provided with the first alarm, the first Smoke Sensor is provided with the right side of first alarm, the first temperature sensor is provided with the right side of first Smoke Sensor, the casing is connected by electric wire with warning box, the inside of the warning box is disposed with the second alarm from top to bottom, second Smoke Sensor, second temperature sensor and the second manual pull station, and blinds ventilating opening is provided with the side wall of the casing.Beneficial effect：The situation that fire occurs can timely be notified resident and fire-fighting, shorten the time of alarm, prevent the expansion and sprawling of fire.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHANBANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake rescue assistor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an earthquake rescue assistor, which is provided with a control chip MCU and a battery, wherein the control chip MCU is connected with a PIR human body movement sensor, a movement 3D sensor, a radio microphone, a WIFI module, an FM transceiver module, a loudspeaker and an LED lamp; therefore, the motion 3D sensor senses earthquake shaking and outputs an electronic signal to the control chip MCU, the control chip MCU detects a changed electric signal through the PIR human body motion sensor and detects human body sound through the radio microphone, and then the terminal equipment receives the signal through the WIFI module and the FM transceiver module; the control chip MCU controls the LED lamp to start to emit light and output Beep sound warning. The utility model discloses can in time learn the earthquake, active detection human body and send distress signal behind the earthquake to the accessible talkbacks and in time knows the current situation, and the site personnel high efficiency of being convenient for is searched for andd rescue and is carried out information statistics, realizes high efficiency rescue.

title_en: Safety monitoring alarm device for underground mobile equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety monitoring and alarming device for underground mobile equipment, which comprises an underground working vehicle, a multifunctional identification bracelet and an underground mobile equipment identification card which are used for underground workers to carry, a plurality of roadway wireless communication positioning base stations which are arranged at the turning, blind areas and rest chamber areas of the underground roadway and roadway warning lamps which are arranged in the underground roadway, cameras and wireless communication positioning base stations are arranged at the front end and the rear end of the underground working vehicle, and a video display and a roadway monitor are arranged in a cab of the underground working vehicle; the utility model can clear the relationship between the safety monitoring and the warning alarm of underground mobile equipment, people and roadways, carry out early warning when the distance is long, carry out alarm when the distance is short, and accurately identify and alarm at turning and blind area points of the roadways; the system effectively reminds a warning driver and other personnel to take reliable safe operation measures, and solves the problems of safety monitoring and warning alarm in the operation of underground mobile equipment.

title_en: Lighting warning lamp and fire-fighting vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an illumination warning lamp and a fire fighting vehicle, and relates to the technical field of illumination, wherein the illumination warning lamp comprises an illumination lamp panel and a polarized lens; one surface of the polarized lens is an incident surface which receives incident light from a lamp panel of the illuminating lamp; the incident surface is sequentially divided into a reflecting surface, a polarizing surface and a light equalizing surface, the reflecting surface is used for reflecting incident light to the polarizing surface and the light equalizing surface, and the polarizing surface inclines from the reflecting surface to the light equalizing surface in the direction close to the lamp panel of the illuminating lamp; the other side of the polarized lens is a light-emitting surface, and the light-emitting surface receives refracted light from the polarization surface and the light-equalizing surface and emits the refracted light to the outside. The fire fighting vehicle comprises an illuminating warning lamp. Through this illumination warning light, there is the technical problem of illumination blind area in its automobile body below week side scope when having alleviated the fire engine and having used current integrated form lamps and lanterns, develop the operation at night for the fire fighter and provide convenience.

title_en: Explosion-related dust early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dust explosion-related early warning device which comprises a cap body, wherein the lower side of the cap body is fixedly connected with a cap peak, dust-proof earplugs are arranged on two sides of the cap peak, a dust-proof mirror is arranged on the front surface of the cap peak, a vibration warning mechanism is arranged at the upper end of one side of the cap peak, a fan and an illuminating lamp are arranged on the outer side of the cap peak, a lamplight warning is further arranged on the outer surface of the cap peak, a cap hoop is arranged in the cap peak, a lithium battery is arranged on the upper side of the middle of the cap body, and a connecting clamping seat is fixedly connected with the end face of the upper end of the lithium battery. When dust concentration sensor detects that dust concentration exceeds standard, accessible PLC controller control light alarm twinkles to keep away from as soon as possible through light warning staff, still accessible PLC controller control alarm sends warning whistle, carries out the sound warning staff and keeps away from as soon as possible, beats the cap body through PLC control vibrations alarm mechanism at last, keeps away from as soon as possible through vibrations cap body warning staff.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YUDA SAFETY ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Blind area pedestrian acousto-optic prompter convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of road blind zone pedestrian warning, and discloses a blind zone pedestrian acousto-optic prompter convenient to adjust, which comprises a bottom plate, the top fixedly connected with stand of bottom plate, the inner chamber of stand is provided with adjusting part, and the surface and the right side of stand all are provided with audible and visual suggestion subassembly. According to the utility model, the adjusting assembly is arranged, so that the display screen and the camera can be driven to adjust the height, vehicles and pedestrians with different distances can be shot, the shooting angle can be enlarged, the arrangement of the acousto-optic prompting assembly can be used for shooting vehicles and pedestrians at two sides of a curve and displaying the vehicles and the pedestrians in the display screen, so that the vehicles and the pedestrians passing through the display screen can observe the conditions of opposite roads conveniently, the buzzer is arranged, an alarm can be driven when the vehicles and the pedestrians are found, the vehicles and the pedestrians are reminded of being safe, and the position of the device can be conveniently moved by a user through the arrangement of the movable wheels, so that the application range is enlarged, and the use convenience is improved.
assignees: CHENGDU BEIDOUXING WEITONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle and its driving prior-warning device and driving method for early warning
abstract_en: This application involves technical field of vehicle, a kind of vehicle and its drive a vehicle prior-warning device and driving method for early warning are provided, prior-warning device of driving a vehicle includes the first camera, second camera, controller and at least a display, first camera is for shooting the first road conditions, the second camera is for shooting the second road conditions, the controller is used to generate driving early warning information according to first road conditions and/or the second road conditions, the display is used to prompt the driving early warning information to second vehicle at least one orientation for travelling on first vehicle, to prompt the vehicular behavior of second vehicle.The application can in real time judge the position of preceding vehicle and distance, monitor and remind other vehicles that there are various emergency road conditions etc. simultaneously, unsafe condition is avoided to occur and can be by the visual field " sharings " of itself to other vehicles, prevent blind area safety accident from occurring, ensure road public safety, popularization and use, raising product competitiveness conducive to product.

title_en: Road early warning method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a road early warning method, a road early warning device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a detection feedback signal aiming at a target object under the condition that the target object is detected to exist in a target area of a front road; controlling a movable part in the road side unit to perform corresponding movement based on the detection feedback signal; wherein the moving movable part can reflect radio wave signals emitted by the vehicle to obtain early warning signals representing the road conditions ahead. Therefore, the problem that potential safety hazards exist due to the fact that the vehicle sensor has the detection blind area is solved, effective and quick early warning of the front road information in the detection blind area is achieved, and driving safety is improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG GEELY AUTOMOBILE RES INST CO LTD;GEELY HOLDING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Tramcar level crossing safety detection device and method based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tramcar level crossing safety detection device and method based on image recognition, wherein the device comprises sound-light alarm equipment, an image acquisition and processing device and a barrier gate system; the barrier gate system rises and falls the barrier rod according to the analysis result of the image acquisition and processing device, and sends out an alarm prompt through the sound-light alarm device, so that vehicles and pedestrians passing through the level crossing can pass through safely. The invention can send out warning information before the tramcar reaches the level crossing by adding the image acquisition and processing device and combining the improvement of the barrier gate mechanism, thereby preventing the tramcar from invading into the crossing protection area and simultaneously accurately identifying the foreign matters which are still positioned in the crossing protection area, and then controlling the rising and falling of the road bar according to the result, ensuring the driving safety when the tramcar passes through the crossing protection area, and greatly improving the safety when the tramcar passes through the crossing protection area.

title_en: Railway slope monitoring and early warning equipment
abstract_en: A railway slope early warning device fixes a differential reference station with differential resolving capability on a railway video pole, and a plurality of monitoring units are arranged on a railway slope to form a monitoring matrix, so that under the calibration of the differential reference station, the positioning precision of each monitoring terminal is greatly improved, and the distortion phenomenon generated by collapse and relaxation of the slope is accurately monitored in real time; in addition, the camera device additionally arranged on the video rod can detect, identify and classify external invasion by depending on a deep learning network model, and compared with a traditional foreign matter identification method, the recognition efficiency and accuracy are greatly improved on the basis of analysis of image characteristics such as foreign matter rectangles, aspect ratios, compactness and gradient and the like and the quality degree of characteristic extraction information by using a self-research image identification algorithm. Finally, when monitoring is abnormal, the early warning equipment sends warning information to the monitoring platform, and meanwhile, after the monitoring personnel confirm the warning information, the railway inspection maintenance personnel or driving personnel can be informed and take corresponding measures, so that major accidents are prevented.

title_en: System and method of communicating emergency alerts

title_en: Wheelchair with warning part
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wheelchair equipment and discloses a wheelchair with a warning component, which comprises a wheelchair frame, wherein a cushion is fixedly connected to the center of the upper part of the wheelchair frame, handrail frames are respectively welded to the left side and the right side of the wheelchair frame, arm supports are fixedly connected to the top ends of the handrail frames, small wheels are fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the bottom of the front end of the wheelchair frame, a large wheel is rotatably connected to the bottom of the rear end of the wheelchair frame, a lighting lamp is arranged, a detachable lighting lamp at the front end of the right handrail frame without blind areas is driven at night, a front path can be illuminated, a user can be prevented from colliding due to unclear vision, the side and the rear of the wheelchair can be prompted to come into contact with a vehicle or a pedestrian, the lighting lamp can be detached through a clamping seat, the handrail frames are not required to be detached during battery replacement or maintenance, the lighting lamp is internally provided with a vibration sensor and a light sensor, and the lighting lamp is bright in daytime, and electricity is saved.

title_en: High-voltage power cable partial discharge signal noise reduction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-voltage power cable partial discharge signal noise reduction method. The method comprises the following steps: collecting a first signal comprising noise, wherein the first signal is a partial discharge PD signal; carrying out blind equalization based on kurtosis criterion on the first signal to obtain a second signal; and carrying out automatic morphological threshold processing on the second signal. The method, by carrying out accurate extraction and analysis on the PD signal generated before insulation breakdown of a high-voltage cable in operation, judges the cable insulation state, thereby ensuring that early warning or forecast can be given accurately in advance in the earlier stage (the insulation breakdown state has not been reached yet) of insulation fault of a cable, and preventing insulation breakdown and fire, which causes generation of various safety accidents of multipoint earthing and the like, due to reduction of cable insulation; and the method can also judge fault branches and fault regions accurately, thereby greatly reducing troubleshooting time, and enabling cable maintenance and repairing to be changed from periodic maintenance to condition-based maintenance and from passive maintenance to active forewarning.

title_en: Protection method of guard post for military
abstract_en: A method and a system for protecting a garrison for a military guard post are used to enhance the reliability of garrison protection by recognizing the entry and exit status of security guards working at the military guard post and remotely monitoring the intrusion through a perimeter network. More specifically, the system for protecting a garrison for a military guard post comprises: a guard post (100) which includes a guard shift switch (120) for detecting the shift changes of the security guards stationed at the guard post (100), an emergency switch (130) for alerting unauthorized intrusion of foreigners according to the selection of the security guards stationed at the guard post (100), and a surveillance control device (110) installed to transmit signals detected through the guard shift switch (120) and the emergency switch (130) to a central control server (300) located remotely via a communication network; and a perimeter network (200) which includes intrusion detection sensors (210), each of which has an identification code to detect the unauthorized intrusion of a foreigner through the perimeter network (200) and transmit the detected results to either the central control server (300) or the guard post (100) located in remote place via the communication network, thereby enabling the monitoring of the entry and exit status of security guards doing shift work at the military guard post and remotely monitoring the intrusion through the perimeter network.

title_en: Intelligent safety guidance system for intelligent scenic spots
abstract_en: Compared with the prior art, the intelligent safety guidance system and the intelligent safety guidance method for the intelligent scenic spots aim at the problems that the safety consciousness of tourists in the intelligent scenic spots is insufficient and monitoring blind spots exist in the intelligent scenic spots, on the basis of comprehensively considering the design layout and actual requirements of the intelligent scenic spots, a scenic spot flow real-time monitoring unit is arranged at a necessary key position, a scenic spot forbidden monitoring unit is arranged in a corresponding monitoring range where accidents are easy to occur or potential safety hazards exist in the scenic spots, a scenic spot identification guidance control unit and a scenic spot warning line control unit are arranged along a sightseeing route, the integrated control of safety monitoring and guiding early warning is realized, the intelligent guidance is performed in a grading manner according to the flow state of the tourists, the potential safety hazards of the intelligent scenic spots are monitored to the greatest extent, and the personal safety of the tourists is ensured. The intelligent scenic spot intelligent navigation system not only reduces the safety risk of the intelligent scenic spot and prevents accidents from happening, but also accords with the concept of reasonably optimizing the tour route.

title_en: Warning method, device, equipment and storage medium for railway foreign matters
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for warning railway foreign matters, and relates to the technical field of image processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an image to be detected including a railway, determining a region to be detected including the railway in the image to be detected according to the image to be detected and a semantic segmentation model, judging whether target foreign matters exist in the region to be detected according to the image to be detected and a foreign matter classification model when the number of the regions to be detected is one, detecting a foreign matter of a preset type in the image to be detected, wherein the type of the target foreign matters is a type except a train in the preset type, and giving an alarm when the target foreign matters exist in the region to be detected. The method is used for improving the accuracy of railway foreign matter detection.

title_en: Microwave radar blind spot monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of radar monitoring, in particular to a microwave radar blind spot monitoring system, which comprises a detection unit, a modeling unit, a data processing unit and a driving unit, wherein the detection unit is used for detecting the blind spot of a microwave radar: the driving unit is used for driving the running state of the vehicle and the steering wheel to deviate; the detection unit is used for detecting the running road condition of the vehicle and generating road condition information; the modeling unit determines road condition categories according to the road condition information; the data processing unit generates corresponding road condition indexes for the detection information according to different road condition categories, and correspondingly generates prompt information or early warning information, so that the occurrence probability of driving safety accidents caused by visual blind areas in driving can be reduced, and the driving safety is improved.

title_en: New energy automobile control system application method with tire pressure monitoring function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application method of a new energy automobile control system with a tire pressure monitoring function, and relates to the technical field of new energy automobile control systems. The invention comprises a vehicle control system, wherein the vehicle control system comprises driver information, environment information and vehicle information; according to the invention, the situation of randomly starting the vehicle is prevented by the driver information, the vehicle information is remotely modified, and the operation convenience is high; the potential safety hazard caused by the visual angle blind area of the vehicle is avoided through the environment information, the wiper can be started in advance to heat so as to ensure the definition of the visual field, and the surrounding high-value vehicles can be automatically judged; the automatic early warning of manual confirmation can not be completed within a specified time after the vehicle is vibrated through the vehicle information, the whole vehicle body can be scanned, and whether the vehicle parts are complete or not is confirmed; the brake failure detection can be realized before the brake of the electric vehicle is started by the brake detection, and the tire surface of the electric vehicle can be scanned by utilizing the carcass detection to confirm whether the tire is complete.

title_en: Wireless power system with foreign object detection
abstract_en: A wireless power system has a wireless power transmitting device and a wireless power receiving device. The wireless power transmitting device may be a wireless charging mat or other device with a charging surface. The wireless power receiving device may be a portable electronic device receiving transmitted wireless power signals from the wireless power transmitting device while resting on the charging surface. During digital ping operations, low-power wireless power signals may be transmitted from the wireless power transmitting device. Information gathered during the digital ping such as wireless power transmission efficiency information, coupling coefficient information, Q-factor information, and coil inductance information may be used in determining whether a foreign object is present. Control circuitry in the transmitting device can cause the receiving device to present an alert for a user indicating that wireless power transfer operations are commencing in response to determining that no foreign object is present.

title_en: Signal processing system and methods for reliably detecting audible alarms
abstract_en: A signal processing system and associated methods are disclosed for reliably detecting audible alert signals, such as Temporal-3 (or Code-3) and Temporal-4 (or Code-4) alert signals generated by commercially available smoke, fire, and carbon monoxide detectors. The system and methods are capable of detecting audible alert signals of different intensities in the presence of dynamic background environment (e.g., television programming, music, noise, and the like). The system and methods are capable of detecting audible alert signals generated by far away smoke, fire, and carbon monoxide detectors. The signal processing system and methods may, in some embodiments, be incorporated into a bedside or other unit that generates a supplemental alert signal capable of alerting individuals who might not otherwise respond to the alarm condition, such as individuals who are asleep, children, hearing impaired, or intoxicated.

title_en: Road early warning method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a road early warning method, a road early warning device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a detection feedback signal aiming at a target object under the condition that the target object is detected to exist in a target area of a front road; controlling a movable part in the road side unit to perform corresponding movement based on the detection feedback signal; wherein the moving movable part can reflect radio wave signals emitted by the vehicle to obtain early warning signals representing the road conditions ahead. Therefore, the problem that potential safety hazards exist due to the fact that the vehicle sensor has the detection blind area is solved, effective and quick early warning of the front road information in the detection blind area is achieved, and driving safety is improved.

title_en: Switch gear with apparatus for judging earthquake-proof integrity
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a switchgear having an apparatus for determining earthquake-proof integrity, comprising: an enclosure having a device for a switchgear installed therein; an arc sensor installed inside the enclosure and sensing generation of arc; a temperature sensor installed inside the enclosure and measuring temperature; a tilt sensor installed inside the enclosure and measuring tilt; a sensor elevator installed inside the enclosure such that the arc sensor and the temperature sensor are installed therein, and elevating the arc sensor and the temperature sensor to vary a sensing area; an integrity determination unit for determining integrity of a switchgear depending on whether sensing results of the arc sensor, the temperature sensor and the tilt sensor satisfy integrity determination conditions; a communications unit for performing communications with an external device; and a control unit for controlling a determination result by the integrity determination unit to be provided to a predetermined terminal or system through the communications unit. According to the present invention, it is possible to determine warping, structural deformation and internal abnormal temperature and always diagnose an internal arc generation state in a switchgear and an internal device. If an abnormal state occurs, a warning signal can be transmitted to nearby workers or the like through a terminal such as a smartphone or the like. Thus, failure prevention of a switchgear and reduction of maintenance therethrough are possible, and temperature measurement at all times and inspection for a deterioration state are possible while simultaneously removing a blinding spot of sensors according to various components of a switchgear to sense occurrence of an abnormal state.

title_en: Listening system comprising an alerting device and a listening device
abstract_en: The application relates to: A listening system. The object of the present application is to provide a system that eases the acknowledgement of 'alarm signals', as e.g. issued by alarm indicators, in the environment of a user in difficult listening situations. The problem is solved in that the system comprises o a listening device adapted to be worn at or in an ear of a user, and an alerting device adapted to detect or receive an external alarm signal, wherein the listening device and the alerting device each comprise at least one communication interface allowing to establish a communication link between them, the alerting device is adapted to sense or receive information as to whether or not the listening device is in operational use, and the listening system is adapted to operate in at least two modes, a NORMAL mode, when said listening device is in operational use, and an ALARM mode, when said listening device is NOT in operational use; and wherein said listening system is adapted to issue specific ALARM mode signals to the user corresponding to said external alarm signals, when said listening system is in an ALARM mode. An advantage of the present system is that a user is able to take notice of alarms from normal indicators even in case of a hearing impairment and/or when located in a noisy environment. The invention may e.g. be used for the hearing instruments, ear protection devices, earphones, headsets or combinations thereof.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam monitoring analysis method and a dam monitoring analysis system based on a superconducting magnetic quantum sensor, which relate to the technical field of dam safety monitoring and intelligent analysis and comprise the steps of constructing by combining FOC-DFT signal processing with DPD cost function, realizing high-resolution positioning of an abnormal source, enhancing weak signal extraction and noise immunity, realizing independent extraction of stress, seepage and crack characteristics by combining spatial clustering with PICA blind source decomposition, and improving the resolution capability of multiple physical coupling effects; the inversion calculation of parameters such as stress, seepage and magnetic permeability is realized by combining the sparse Bayesian inversion and the compressed sensing through the multi-physical field coupling model, the accuracy of analysis of an abnormal mechanism is improved, the trend prediction and the risk assessment of hidden danger of the dykes are realized by combining the LSTM time sequence modeling and the comprehensive abnormal scoring mechanism, and the prospective and intelligent level of early warning are improved.
assignees: BEIJING AEROSPACE CENTURY SUPERCONDUCTING TECH CO LTD;NINGBO CIRUAN SOFTWARE DEV CO LTD

title_en: System and computer program product for coordinating and monitoring service providers
abstract_en: A system and computer program product for coordinating and monitoring service providers is disclosed which provides an electronic portal accessible by service requesters and service providers. Service requesters may request and hire service providers that are assigned to an event and location to provide services. The progress of services may be monitored remotely. In addition, a safety feature is included which transmits a polling signal to the computing device of the service provider requiring acknowledgment of the polling signal to ensure that an emergency situation has not occurred needing attention. Some embodiments will alert a third party if the service provider has not responded.

title_en: System and method for universal emergency notification and management
abstract_en: Systems and methods for triggering emergency mass notifications include an EMNS activation service, a plurality of activation premises devices, a plurality of EMNS provider services, and a plurality of event personnel devices. The EMNS activation service includes a universal translator module that receives an event trigger signal relating to an emergency event from one of the activation premises devices. The universal translator module translates the event trigger signal to event-specific EMNS protocols of the EMNS providers. The EMNS activation service communicates the event-specific EMNS protocols to the EMNS providers, and communicates event data to event personnel devices based on a list of event personnel devices to be notified of an emergency event. An activation premises device includes a housing event with trigger controls for creating the event trigger signal, wherein these event trigger controls are inaccessible to users in the absence of an authorized access or an emergency access.

title_en: Elasticity lets presses early warning stock
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an elasticity lets presses early warning stock, including first stock, spring, second stock, anchor dish, nut, steel wire and buckle, the one end of first stock and the one end fixed connection of spring, the other end of spring and the one end fixed connection of second stock, the other end of second stock is equipped with the anchor dish, and the anchor dish is fixed on the second stock through the nut, be equipped with the steel wire in first stock and the second stock, it is outside that the steel wire extends to the second stock, and the free end of steel wire is fixed with the buckle. The utility model discloses can effectually prevent mine calamities such as roadway deformation, pucking and rock burst, the device accessible steel wire monitoring stock warp simultaneously to play early warning function.

title_en: Intelligent thermos cup for blind person
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent thermos cup for blind people, which comprises a cup cover, a cup body and a cup bottom. The cup cover is provided with a touch screen switch, a buzzer, a central processing module and a temperature sensor; the cup body comprises a button switch, a liquid level sensor, an interlayer and an inner container; the cup bottom comprises an emergency switch, an intelligent control system, a positioning device, a battery holder and a charging socket. The cup cover and the cup body are of a double-layer structure, the inner part of the cup cover is a liner, the outer structure of the cup cover is a tinned sheet steel, and concave-convex blind characters are printed on the tinned sheet steel; the cup body is provided with a three-level liquid level sensor to realize the graded induction of the water level; the bottom of the cup is of a detachable structure, blind characters are printed on the emergency switch, the battery holder and a cover outside the charging socket, and emergency call and intelligent positioning functions are achieved through the intelligent control system and the positioning device. The utility model has the advantages of easy operation, convenient to use, temperature classification warning, hierarchical response of water level and intelligent location.

title_en: Shale gas informatization environment early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a shale gas informatization environment early warning system which comprises a plurality of integrated monitoring systems arranged at monitoring points of a shale gas exploitation area, wherein the integrated monitoring systems interact information with an informatization monitoring platform through a first wireless communication module, and the informatization monitoring platform is connected with a mobile monitoring terminal through a second wireless communication module. Through integration monitoring system with air monitoring and seismic monitoring combine monitoring facilities as an organic whole, accessible installation this equipment can be realistic air monitoring and seismic monitoring to the check point, in addition, through setting up shock insulation structure in seismic monitoring device's installation department, avoid it to receive its top structure's influence, simultaneously through being connected all integration monitoring systems with informationized monitor platform, can realize information interaction, and then utilize informationized monitor platform to handle the data that integration monitoring system was collected, and send the alarm when exceeding standard, realized the effect of comprehensive monitoring.
assignees: SINOPEC CHONGQING FULING SHALE GAS EXPLOR AND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multi-camera collaborative analysis dynamic locking vehicle safety early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine inclined shaft vehicle safety early warning system and a mine inclined shaft vehicle safety early warning method based on multi-camera collaborative analysis and dynamic locking mechanism. The system adopts a deep learning technology to detect the targets of the vehicle and personnel, extracts the appearance characteristics of the vehicle through ReID networks, and combines a Kalman filter to realize the tracking of the vehicle across cameras and the judgment of the movement direction. When the vehicle is detected to enter a specific road section, the system automatically updates the locking state of the area, starts the personnel detection module, immediately triggers an audible and visual alarm and reports to the monitoring platform once the personnel is found to enter the locking area. According to the technical scheme, curve monitoring blind areas are effectively eliminated, the accuracy and response instantaneity of collision early warning of people and vehicles are remarkably improved, reliable technical guarantee is provided for mine transportation safety, and good practicability and popularization value are achieved.

title_en: Tunnel disaster early warning system based on SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition) technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a tunnel disaster early warning system based on an SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition) technology, which comprises an on-site level data acquisition system, an on-site foreign matter protection system and an industrial area level monitoring system. And the analog signals acquired by the field level data acquisition system are transmitted to the work area level monitoring system for real-time display. Meanwhile, the method is compared with limit values of various parameters set by a control interface of the work area level monitoring system; and if the working area level monitoring system exceeds the limit value, the audio alarm module is driven by the working area level monitoring system, and the field foreign matter protection system is started to carry out active protection. The railway tunnel disaster prevention rescue equipment monitoring system is constructed by combining the conventional tunnel disaster prevention rescue equipment with a remote automatic control technology, so that the remote real-time monitoring of the railway tunnel construction area state is realized, the operation of related equipment can be remotely controlled while the automatic alarm of danger is found, and the emergency on-site rescue function is realized.

title_en: National provincial road traffic incident early warning gridding information release method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for issuing early warning gridding information of national provincial road traffic event, which comprises determining time type, determining issuing medium, dividing gridding area, making rules for issuing plans and generating management and control plans, and a system for issuing early warning gridding information of national provincial road traffic event, comprising a video traffic event detection system, an information board, a speed limit sign, an induction lamp and a directional loudspeaker, the operability and the effective accessibility of the early warning plan are enhanced, more early treatment time is obtained for road smoothness, the unified and standard and efficient management and control plan is established mainly aiming at typical traffic event prevention and short-term traffic control such as road occupation, congestion, bad weather and the like, and aiming at typical emergency events possibly happening on national provincial roads, the occurrence of secondary accidents is effectively prevented in time, casualties and property loss are avoided and reduced to the maximum extent, and road safety is guaranteed to be smooth.

title_en: Method of position-report and relief service by mobile communication device including gps
title_ko: Ｇｐｓ를 구비한 이동통신 단말기의 위치조회 및 안심 서비스 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 GPS(Global Positioning System)를 구비하는 이동통신 단말기를 이용한 위치조회 및 안심 서비스 방법으로서, 상세하게는, 보호자 단말기가 서버에 보호대상 단말기의 위치정보 요청 시 상기 서버가 상기 보호대상 단말기의 실시간 위치 측위를 활성화시켜 위치정보를 획득하고, 획득한 위치정보를 보호자 단말기로 전송하여 보호자에게 현재 보호대상 단말기의 위치정보를 알려주는 서비스 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 GPS를 구비하는 이동통신 단말기를 이용하여 위치정보의 부정확성을 GPS 기반으로 개선하고 일반 보호자 휴대폰에 전용 애플리케이션을 제공함으로써 서비스에 대한 접근성과 사용성을 높일 수 있으며 WCDMA 통신망을 이용하여 USSD 방식을 적용함에 따라 SMS에 비해 전송속도가 빠르다. 또한 정확한 위치정보 제공, 비상 상황 경보음 작동, 자동 현장 사진 송출, 보호자와의 자동 영상 통화와 같은 기능을 제공함에 따라 빠른 출동을 통해 사고를 예방하고, 현장 상황을 명확하고 빠르게 파악할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Prefabricated pump station of integration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated prefabricated pump station, which comprises a base, wherein a real-time monitoring mechanism, a harmful gas management mechanism and an automatic spraying cleaning mechanism are fixedly arranged inside a pump station body; the utility model discloses the inside of pump station body is provided with broken mechanism, real-time supervision mechanism, harmful gas management mechanism and automatic jet cleaning mechanism, the broken mechanism of accessible is smashed the back water pump and can smoothly discharge to the bold thing of getting into, stop the hidden danger of water pump jam, real-time supervision mechanism passes through high definition digtal camera simultaneously and can transmit the live video-information of each inside equipment work of pump station to the monitor, master the equipment behavior at any time, harmful gas management mechanism is when harmful gas concentration reaches the setting value, send warning signal, automatic jet cleaning mechanism hits the filth on through high pressure nozzle injection water column to inner wall, the impact force disturbance pond of water column simultaneously, form the rivers, prevent solid particle from deposiing.
assignees: HUZHOU HONGHE ENVIRONMENTAL PROT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Automobile safe driving control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile safe driving system, which comprises a driving state monitoring module: acquiring an image of a driver in a driving state and judging whether the driver is in dangerous driving; blind area radar monitoring module: judging whether potential safety hazards exist in the distance between the blind area barrier and the automobile or not; a lane departure control module: acquiring road condition information to judge whether a vehicle driving route deviates; the data recording and monitoring module: setting parameters to judge whether the automobile is in a safe driving state; safety early warning control module: after confirming that the driver is in a driving state with potential safety hazards, carrying out voice broadcast reminding on the driver; the central controller: the control system is used for controlling all modules in the automobile safe driving control system. Through the automobile safe driving system, a driver can feel potential safety hazards in real time in the driving process, and the potential safety hazards are avoided in time, so that the driving safety is ensured.
assignees: SHENZHEN BOUDLESS SENSOR TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent parking lot safety management system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent parking lots and discloses a safety management system and method of an intelligent parking lot, wherein the system comprises a gait recognition module, a track prediction module, an intelligent light projection module, a warning light control module, an environment perception module and a central control unit, wherein the gait recognition module acquires gait data of pedestrians and analyzes walking directions; the system comprises a track prediction module, an intelligent light projection module, a warning light control module, an environment sensing module, a central control unit, a central processing unit and a system, wherein the track prediction module predicts a future path of a pedestrian based on gait characteristics and historical tracks, the intelligent light projection module projects a real-time state of the pedestrian in a visual field range of a driver of the vehicle, the warning light control module adjusts a warning light signal according to a pedestrian risk level, the environment sensing module monitors illumination conditions and optimizes light display, the central control unit comprehensively processes data of each module and dynamically adjusts projection information and a warning mode, and the system is interacted with intelligent light through gait recognition, so that the visibility of the pedestrian is improved, the blind area risk is reduced, and the driving safety of an underground parking garage is improved.
assignees: GUANGXI DESIQI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: The left and the right side direction dangerous sense and warning device of automobile
title_ko: 자동차의 좌·우측 방향 위험 감지 및 경보장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An apparatus for alarming and detecting risks of left and right direction of a vehicle is provided to help a use to stably drive at night or in the rain by confirming information of the vehicle located in a blind spot as well as left and right information of the vehicle using sight and hearing. CONSTITUTION: An apparatus for alarming and detecting risks of left and right direction of a vehicle comprises: a movement sensor; an infrared ray distance meter(20); a monitoring camera(30); a controller(50) which generates warning sound and operates a monitoring camera when an adjacent driving vehicle is within an error range of an initial standard distance(5m) and operate direction indicator light to be changed to red color from yellow color; a monitor(40); and an on/off switch(60) which sanctions the power to the movement sensor, the infrared ray distance meter, the monitoring camera, the monitor, and the controller. It includes.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 좌측 또는 우측 방향으로 자동차의 주행 차로를 변경하고자 할 때 차로 변경을 위한 방향지시등 작동시 사각지대를 포함한 좌측 또는 우측 방향의 선택된 어느 한 방향에 대해 근접해 있는 자동차를 신속하게 감지하여 운전자는 물론, 차로 변경 방향에 있는 주행 자동차에 대해서도 시각(방향지시등) 및 청각(경보음)으로 알릴 수 있도록 함으로써 자기 차량은 물론 타 차량의 안전사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있도록 하는 자동차의 좌·우측 방향 위험 감지 및 경보장치에 관한 것으로,   
좌측 또는 우측으로 차선을 변경하고자 방향지시등(80) 작동용 레버(81)를 작동할 경우 레버(81)의 작동에 따른 차선 변경신호를 감지하고 감지한 차선변경신호를 제어부(50)에 전달하는 동작센서(10)와, 상기 동작센서(10)에서 감지된 차선 변경 신호에 따라 주행차량의 좌측 또는 우측 방향과, 각 사각지대에 위치한 인접 주행차량의 거리를 측정하여 제어부(50)에 전달하는 적외선 거리측정기(20)와, 상기 적외선 거리측정기에서 측정된 오차범위 이내의 인접 주행차량 정보를 촬영하여 차량의 실내에 구비된 모니터(40)에 표시되도록 하는 감시카메라(30)와, 상기 동작센서(10)에서 전달받은 신호를 적외선거리측정기(20)에 전달하여 거리를 측정하도록 하고, 적외선거리측정기에서 측정한 인접 차량의 거리정보 중 최초 입력된 기준거리(5m)의 오차 범위 이내에 인접 주행차량이 있을 경우 감시 카메라가(30)가 작동되도록 함과 동시에 경보기(70)로부터 경보음이 발생 되도록 하고, 방향지시등은 황색에서 적색으로 변경되도록 조작하는 제어부(50)와, 상기 감시카메라(30)에서 촬영된 인접 차량(2,3)의 정보를 주행차량(1)의 운전자에게 알 수 있도록 하는 모니터(40)와, 상기 동작센서(10), 적외선거리측정기(20), 감시카메라(30), 모니터(40), 제어부(50)에 전원을 인가 및 차단시키는 온/오프 스위치(60)를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for controlling synchronization of sleep cycle to support emergencyh alert service in wireless communication system
title_ko: 무선통신 시스템에서 긴급 경보 서비스를 위한 슬립 모드의 슬립 사이클 동기 제어 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A synchronization control apparatus between sleep modes and method are provided to maintain sleep mode synchronization by controlling state translation between a terminal and a base station through a sleep control signaling. CONSTITUTION: A modem(604) transmits a request message to a base station in case the modem does not receive a traffic indication message and uni-cast data. The request message is a message for requesting the location of a scheduled listing window. A control unit(606) receives a response message for the request message. The control unit synchronizes a sleep cycle by using synchronization information including the response message. The control unit determines the transmission of a message related to an emergency alarm service by using information related to the emergency alarm service including the response message.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 광대역 무선 접속 시스템에서 슬립 사이클 동기화에 관한 것으로, 단말의 동작 방법은, 리스닝 윈도우 동안 트래픽 지시 메시지(traffic indication message) 및 유니캐스트 데이터(unicast data)를 수신하지 못한 경우, 기지국으로 다음 스케줄된 리스닝 윈도우의 위치를 문의하기 위한 요청 메시지를 송신하는 과정과, 상기 요청 메시지에 대한 응답 메시지를 수신하면, 상기 응답 메시지에 포함된 동기화 정보를 이용하여 슬립 사이클에 대한 동기화를 수행하는 과정과, 상기 응답 메시지에 포함된 긴급 경보 서비스 관련 정보를 이용하여 긴급 경보 서비스 관련 메시지의 전송 여부를 판단하는 과정을 포함한다.

title_en: The apparatus of recognition a hadicapped person of heraing with sequence control
title_ko: 시퀀스 제어를 통한 청각장애인용 인식 장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 일상 생활에서 발생하는 중요한 가청음(일예 : 화재 통보기의 경보음，가스 누출 경보기의 경보음，휴대 전화기의 호출음, 팩시밀리 장치의 호출음, 전자레인지의 가열 종료 통보음，세탁기 그 밖의 전기 제품으로부터 발생한 통보음，방문자의 벨 소리)을 청각 장애인이 시퀀스 제어를 통해 시각적, 촉각적 또는 시각적 + 촉각적으로 동시에 인식할 수 있도록, 특정 생활음 검출 수단과, 청각장애인용 통보 수단으로 구성된 청각장애인용 인식장치를 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
       
     가청음, 청각장애인, 마이컴부, 인식 장치

title_en: Emergency vehicle access notification device and method for the deaf
title_ko: 청각 장애인을 위한 긴급차량 알림 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 청각장애인 또는 외부의 소리를 듣지 못한 운전자를 위하여 접근해오는 긴급차량을 알려주는 알림 장치에 관한 기술로서, 긴급차량의 종류를 알 수 있는 신호를 발생하는 긴급차량 알림신호발생부, 긴급차량에서 일반차량으로 신호를 송신하는 송신부, 일반차량에서 긴급차량의 신호를 받는 수신부, 수신한 긴급차량의 신호를 분석하는 긴급차량 신호분석부, 분석한 신호를 시각적으로 표현해주는 디스플레이부를 포함한다.

title_en: Intelligent Camera System capable of Video Translation
abstract_en: A camera system capable of video translation includes: an image information input unit for detecting visible light images, thermal images, and motion information in a preset photographing area; a sound recognition unit which collects sounds in each preset direction; an air component detection unit which detects air components; an alarm module unit which transmits an alarm using visual and auditory methods; and a control unit which displays the type of objects detected based on the information transmitted from the image information input unit on the image and detects a dangerous situation of each object based on the sound information transmitted from the sound recognition unit and the air component transmitted from the air component detection unit, and then controls the alarm module unit to perform warning.
abstract_ko: 영상번역 카메라 시스템은 미리 설정된 촬영영역의 가시광선 영상, 열화상 영상 및 움직임 정보를 검출하는 영상정보 입력부와, 미리 설정된 각각의 방향의 소리를 수집하는 소리 인식부와, 대기의 성분을 감지하는 대기성분 감지부와, 시각 및 청각방법을 이용하여 경보를 송출하는 경보 모듈부와, 상기 영상정보 입력부로부터 전송된 정보를 바탕으로 검출된 객체의 종류를 영상에 표시하되, 상기 소리 인식부에서 전송된 소리정보 및 상기 대기성분 감지부로부터 전송된 대기성분을 토대로 각 객체의 위험상황을 검출한 후 상기 경보 모듈부를 통해 경고하도록 처리하는 제어부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Personal emergency alert system, method and device
abstract_en: A system, method and device for notifying designated recipients about a personal emergency. An individual maintains a personal emergency alert device (PEAD) in accessible proximity. The PEAD is activated by onboard or remote sensor(s) in proximity to the PEAD. The sensor(s) monitor the occurrence of an emergency activation event. PEAD includes a controller. The controller, triggered by detection of an emergency event by a sensor, activates a geolocation module to obtain geolocation information, formulates an alert message, establishes a network connection, and transmits the message with geolocation information to a personal emergency alert notification service (PEANS). PEANS responds by sending a text, email or other emergency notification to designated notification recipient(s). Once activated, PEAD periodically tracks and transmits its geolocation until it runs out of power. Alternatively, PEAD can be deactivated by sending a deactivation code to the PEANS, which in turn instructs such PEAD to deactivate.

title_en: Emergency command vehicle with expansion function

title_en: Emergency alert notification for the hearing impaired
abstract_en: An indication of an emergency alert message is provided to a user, potentially having a disability, via a networked enabled portable device. The emergency alert message is provided via sign language video images indicative of the emergency alert. A notification makes the user aware when broadcast emergency alerts are issued. In various embodiments, the portable device is enabled to receive information about an emergency alert broadcast of which the potentially disabled user should be aware, e.g., from the EAS, and to notify the user of the emergency alert. The user can be automatically taken to the emergency alert information by having the portable device automatically tune to the emergency broadcast information, the user can optionally retrieve the emergency information by tuning to the emergency broadcast channel, and/or the user can otherwise be presented with a reference to the emergency data, such as a link to the information.

title_en: Wireless ranging card reading communication device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wireless range finding card reading communication device belongs to the card reader field. title_en: explosion-proof multi-directional intelligent lighting system for mining truck
abstract_en: The invention discloses an  explosion-proof multi-azimuth intelligent lighting system for mining trucks, which comprises a truck head part and a carriage part, wherein the truck head part is connected with a rearview mirror and comprises an intelligent headlamp lighting system, an intelligent matrix lamp lighting system and an intelligent side warning lamp lighting system, the  explosion-proof multi-azimuth intelligent lighting system for mining trucks can provide comprehensive lighting in front of a vehicle for the mining trucks by using the intelligent headlamp lighting system and the intelligent matrix lamp lighting system, can provide  specified lighting compensation according to ambient light and vehicle steering, is intelligently and automatically controlled, does not need a driver to carry out complex operation, can provide active early warning for a vision blind area by using an intelligent indicator lamp strip, can emit colored light different from other areas in a corresponding area when approaching an obstacle, can greatly reduce safety accidents caused by the vision blind area, and can reduce the driving burden of the driver.

title_en: Blind zone pedestrian detection method, system, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a blind area pedestrian detection method, a blind area pedestrian detection system, a vehicle and a storage medium, which are used for solving the defect that a driver cannot timely observe that pedestrians enter driving vision blind areas in the prior art, so that the occurrence probability of safety accidents is higher, and the situation of the driving vision blind areas can be observed by combining the predicted motion trail of the pedestrians, so that the occurrence probability of the safety accidents is reduced. In an embodiment of the present invention, the method comprises: acquiring an image to be processed, which is acquired by a camera, wherein the camera is arranged on a vehicle body corresponding to a driving view blind area; detecting the image to be processed to obtain the current position information of the target pedestrian; determining a predicted motion track corresponding to the target pedestrian according to the current position information based on Kalman filtering; and outputting early warning information under the condition that the target pedestrian is determined to be about to enter the driving view blind area according to the predicted motion track.
assignees: HANGZHOU HOPECHART IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Storage fire-fighting channel occupation-preventing warning device and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-occupation warning device for a storage fire-fighting channel and a use method thereof, and the anti-occupation warning device comprises a mounting frame, wherein a sliding rail device is fixed at the top of the mounting frame, a driving mechanism is arranged in the sliding rail device, a transmission mechanism is meshed with the driving mechanism, the top of the transmission mechanism is in threaded connection with an alarm assembly, a hinge seat is arranged on the outer surface of the alarm assembly, a monitoring device is hinged to the hinge seat, a second driving mechanism is arranged at the output end of the driving mechanism, the top of the second driving mechanism is rotationally connected with a connecting rod mechanism, one end of the connecting rod mechanism is connected with the monitoring device, and a timer is arranged on the outer surface of the driving mechanism. Realize lateral shifting through slide rail device, actuating mechanism and drive mechanism realize rotatory, and second actuating mechanism and link mechanism realize monitoring device every single move, and cooperation timer starts regularly, enlarges monitoring range by a wide margin, reduces the blind area, and when monitoring device caught the occupation condition, alarm subassembly in time warns, effectively solves current device in the limited, the untimely problem of warning of monitoring range in big space storage.

title_en: Fire alarm and emergency escaping system for the deaf and the senior

abstract_en: The present invention informs the senior or the deaf with a weak sensing ability who sleeps of a fire and escapes the senior or the deaf when the fire breaks out in a building. The losses of properties and casualties are prevented by the reduction of the escape time of rescuers and the quick fire response of firefighters, by vibrating a pillow, opening an entrance door by automatically unlocking a door lock, and reporting the occurrence of the fire to surrounding fire stations and police stations through a transmitter by comprising the vibration type pillow, the automatic open and close door lock, and the transmitter to wirelessly transmit and receive a signal to and from a fire reception board if the fire breaks out.

title_en: System and method for a security checkpoint using radio signals
abstract_en: A security device for monitoring the radio frequency signals generated by mobile phones and similar mobile computing and communication devices. The security device employs an antennae array and computer process that are configured to detect and provide a “fingerprint” for a mobile device based on the unique identifiers contained with the radio and other wireless signals utilized by such mobile device. The “fingerprint” that is obtained can be used to keep track of mobile devices as those devices enter and leave the area of the security device. Moreover, the security device can provide an alert when any new, foreign, or otherwise unrecognized device is within range of the security device and share “fingerprints” and alerts with other security devices in its network.
