title_en: Ad Hoc Network wireless intelligent public emergency broadcasting terminal
abstract_en: Provided is an Ad Hoc Network wireless intelligent public emergency broadcasting terminal, which comprises a CPU module, a memory module, a wireless transmitting-receiving module, an FM transmitting-receiving module, a digital voice processing module, an audio frequency amplifying module, a sensor data acquisition module, a video compression coding/decoding module, an Ethernet transmitting-receiving module and a power supply management module. The Ad Hoc Network wireless intelligent public emergency broadcasting terminal has the advantages that the terminal can replace the current centralized control type wired/wireless public emergency broadcasting systems to cope with different emergent natural/artificial disaster events; multiple terminals can compose a wireless emergency broadcasting network, wherein it is not required to arrange a central control node in the network, instead, multi-hop relays are used between the nodes to finish distributed control and information communication; by using the terminal, there is no blind area, thereby expanding covering range of the public emergency broadcasting system; and the terminal has intelligent automatic control capability, which improves the early warning efficiency and reduces loss caused by disasters.

title_en: Night early warning device for split gaps in highway bridge
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a night early warning device for a split gap in a highway bridge, which comprises a solid early warning module and a flashing lamp, wherein a pyroelectric infrared sensor is arranged on one side surface of a shell, a Fresnel lens is covered outside the pyroelectric infrared sensor, a solar power supply plate is adhered to the top of the shell, a photoresistor is arranged above the solar power supply plate, and an energy storage battery, the pyroelectric infrared sensor, the photoresistor and the solar power supply plate can be electrically connected with a single chip. The device can monitor pedestrians close to the split gap area in the high-speed bridge in real time, provide early warning information for the split gap position in the bridge at night, warn drivers and passengers who blindly cross the split gap position in the bridge, and achieve the effect of preventing and reducing the occurrence of bridge falling accidents; the early warning device has the advantages of small power consumption, good concealment, low price and strong practicability, and can have the effects of economy and practicability.

title_en: Excavator safety operation monitoring method considering visual angle blind area

Meanwhile, the safety operation monitoring result of the excavator is wirelessly transmitted to a remote monitoring management system, so that the subsequent analysis and the optimization of the working efficiency and the safety of the excavator are facilitated.

title_en: Location Tracking System With Interfaces For Setting Group Zones, Events And Alerts Based On Multiple Levels Of Administrative Privileges
abstract_en: An improved system and method for defining an event based upon an object location and a user-defined zone and managing the conveyance of object location event information among computing devices where object location events are defined in terms of a condition based upon a relationship between user-defined zone information and object location information. One or more location information sources are associated with an object to provide the object location information. One or more user-defined zones are defined on a map and one or more object location events are defined. The occurrence of an object location event produces object location event information that is conveyed to users based on user identification codes. Accessibility to object location information, zone information, and object location event information is based upon an object location information access code, a zone information access code, and an object location event information access code, respectively.

title_en: Emergency warning system
abstract_en: An emergency warning system for warning members of the public of an emergency situation comprises personal warning devices provided to members of the public and a cellular telecommunication system for transmitting coded cellular burst signals to the personal warning devices to elicit delivery of an emergency warning from the devices. The coded cellular burst warning signals contain emergency situation codes that the personal warning devices parse and translate into an emergency warning message displayed as text on a display screen of the personal warning device.

title_en: Tumble grading warning device based on piezoelectric signal monitoring and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tumble grading warning device based on piezoelectric signal monitoring and a working method thereof, wherein the tumble grading warning device comprises a detection module, a processing module and an alarm module; the detection module is used for collecting instantaneous pressure signals generated in the falling process of the human body; the processing module is provided with a grading standard threshold, compares and analyzes the acquired pressure value with the grading standard threshold, identifies the type and degree of tumble, and transmits a grading signal to the alarm module; the alarm module carries out grading alarm when receiving the grading signal; according to the invention, instantaneous pressure impact generated by a human body when falling on the piezoelectric sensor can be utilized to realize timely and effective warning when the person falls, the type and the degree of falling can be distinguished according to the difference of falling signals for warning, the hidden danger of falling of a monitoring blind area can be eliminated, when the person has a falling accident in the interval, warning with different modes and degrees can be timely provided for a guardian, and the guardian can timely give corresponding specific help and treatment to the falling person.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and early warning system for high-voltage power grid and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent monitoring and early warning system for a high-voltage power grid and a monitoring method thereof, wherein the intelligent monitoring and early warning system comprises a front-end monitoring device, a background server and a WeChat client, the front-end monitoring device is installed on an iron tower of the high-voltage power grid, the front-end monitoring device is wirelessly connected with the background server, the WeChat client is a software application installed on a client mobile phone, the WeChat client is connected with the background server through a mobile phone wireless signal, the front-end monitoring device monitors the personnel condition and the foreign matter condition around the high-voltage power grid in real time, the background server intelligently analyzes the site information sent by the front-end monitoring device, and a manager knows the site condition by receiving the site information through the WeChat client. The invention carries out 24-hour uninterrupted intelligent monitoring and early warning management on the high-voltage line region through the front-end monitoring device, and realizes the conversion from ' people ' defense ' to ' technical defense ' of the high-voltage line through the intelligent analysis and accurate judgment of the background server.

title_en: Fire control unit in intelligence building
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire fighting device in an intelligent building, which comprises an outer shell, wherein a manual button is movably arranged at the bottom end of the right side surface of the outer shell, an air inlet is arranged above the manual button, and a baffle is fixedly arranged at the upper part of the front surface of the outer shell; set up the upper cover and be glossy spherical curved surface, install miniature air pump and carry out the dust removal of regularly blowing to inductive probe, can avoid the dust to adhere to and pile up on inductive probe, make fire alarm device's response more sensitive, the early warning reaction is faster, strive for the quality time for relief and emergency rescue, set up three connecting rods of group and inductive probe simultaneously, reciprocating motion about connecting rod itself can make a round trip automatically, inductive probe can rotate around the connecting rod, very big promotion fire alarm device's response interval, inductive probe's field of vision blind area has been reduced, thereby reach the effect that utilizes fire alarm device still less to cover bigger monitoring range.

title_en: Roadside blind area early warning method and device based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roadside blind area early warning method and a roadside blind area early warning device based on machine vision, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s01, collecting images in a target monitoring range and carrying out target detection; s02, judging whether the pedestrian has the intention of crossing the road according to the moving direction of the pedestrian; s03, detecting the traffic flow state in the specified range of the current road, judging whether a first type of vehicle is positioned in front of a second type of vehicle or not, and judging whether the sight line of the second type of vehicle is blocked or not according to the distance and the included angle between the vehicles if the first type of vehicle is positioned in front of the second type of vehicle; s04, predicting whether the pedestrian has collision risk or not; and S05, when the collision risk of the pedestrian is predicted, warning information is sent to the pedestrian and each vehicle. The invention can effectively realize the early warning of the blind area on the road side, pre-judge the collision risk of the pedestrian needing to cross the road in time and avoid the potential safety hazard caused by the shielding of the sight of other vehicles by a large vehicle.
assignees: HUNAN XIANGJIANG ZHIXIN YUNTU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Inner wheel difference warning risk avoiding method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an inner wheel difference warning risk avoiding method and system, which belong to the field of inner wheel difference blind area risk avoiding, and the method comprises the following steps: when the vehicle starts to turn, starting a projection real-time display area blind area range, and detecting whether an object is positioned in an inner wheel difference blind area or not through an ultrasonic sensor; if yes, starting a primary alarm, and judging whether the object is a heat source entity by utilizing the infrared pyroelectric sensor; if yes, a secondary alarm is started, and whether the heat source entity is located within the dangerous distance limit is judged by the Beidou foundation enhancement system; if yes, starting an automatic emergency braking system of the vehicle-mounted terminal. The invention can display the blind area of the inner wheel difference in real time when the large truck turns right and can carry out multi-element and multi-level warning and danger avoidance aiming at each responsible party of traffic, solves the problem of hidden danger of traffic accident of each relevant party Shi Ce facing traffic and accurately 'perspective' the blind area of the inner wheel difference, and fundamentally solves the problem of hidden danger of traffic accident of the blind area of the inner wheel difference.

title_en: Intelligent building security monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent building security monitoring system, which relates to the technical field of building security monitoring, and comprises a main body selection module, a snapshot selection analysis module, a main body snapshot analysis module, an early warning terminal and a database, wherein the importance of the monitoring main body corresponding to each track of a building is obtained through analysis by analyzing the monitoring main body under the corresponding security of the building and based on the track of the industrial track of the monitoring main body corresponding to the building, and based on the obtained state image, the monitored snapshot quality is analyzed, so that the improvement of the snapshot quality is performed, the intelligent efficient monitoring of the building is achieved, the information capturing of building key data is achieved, timely discovery and prevention are conducted, the probability and the safety risk of safety accidents in the building are reduced, monitoring blind areas and omission in the building are effectively reduced and avoided, the effectiveness and the comprehensiveness of building security monitoring are guaranteed, and intelligent efficient security monitoring is achieved.

title_en: System with a companion device and a primary device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for a companion device to receive current service information from a primary device comprising: (a) said companion device receiving from said primary device an emergency alert message including at least one of: (i) an identifier of said emergency alert message that uniquely identifies said emergency alert message; (ii) a date when said emergency alert message was generated together with a time when said emergency alert message was generated; (iii) a content format defining a content type of an initial said emergency alert message; (iv) a content of said emergency alert message received given by initial content element; (v) a URL which provides initial emergency alert message content for accessibility; (vi) an additional URL which provides additional information about said emergency alert message; (vii) a phone number for obtaining additional information about said emergency alert message; (viii) an e-mail address for obtaining additional information about said emergency alert message; (ix) a received additional emergency alert containing a continuation of another said emergency alert message; (x) a received one of a new or a repeat said emergency alert message; (xi) a received said emergency alert message that is not repeated; (xii) an identifier of said primary device; (xiii) a version of said primary device.

title_en: Fire suppression system
abstract_en: A controller responds to an alert from a remote alert system and responds to an AI unit that detects a fire signature, and, in response, sends signals to fire suppression equipment to defend a structure against fire. A delivery device system may include delivery devices that are capable of spraying water and/or retardant at a structure or area to defend against fire. The system may act autonomously to defend against wildfires. The system includes a base station accessible by a user device to take control of the system. Alternatively, a central monitoring system may access the base station to control the system in addition to or instead of the user. In an embodiment, the system automatically sprays water or retardant prior to the outbreak of a fire. The system may optically detect embers landing on a structure or area being defended and sprays the embers with retard and/or water.

title_en: Universal configuration, control and monitoring of disparate devices via an saas interface and mobile application
abstract_en: A monitoring, control and configuration system that includes a local system, a mobile device application, and a server that is accessible by users via the mobile device application and a Software as a Service (SaaS) interface via a browser is disclosed. The local system contains a microprocessor, communications components and related software all of which enable communications with the server and external components coupled with the local system. The local system software and server software combine with the mobile application and website interface to enable a user to monitor, configure, and control external devices coupled with the local system and the local system itself via the server. The system replaces multiple disparate control devices with a single, configurable device and system. The system integrates multiple disparate devices and systems from multiple manufacturers. The system provides emergency alerts based on examination of information from external devices provided to the local system and the server.

title_en: Detecting Apparatus Capable of Detecting Foreign Materials for Extruder
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 일측 상단에 호퍼를 구비하고 다수개의 피드바렐이 수평으로 결합되어 형성되는 압출부와, 상기 압출부의 내부에 장착되어 모터(미도시)에 의해 구동되어 회전하면서 수지를 혼련하고 압출하기 위한 니딩블럭 및 스크류와, 상기 압출부의 일측에 형성되는 수지토출부와, 상기 압출부의 타측에 형성되는 씰박스로 이루어지는 압출기에 있어서, 상기 니딩블럭이 내장된 피드바렐에 인접한 스크류가 내장된 피드바렐의 몸체 하단에 진동감지센서를 장착하되 상기 진동감지센서로 부터 측정된 진동주파수가 미리 설정해둔 압출기 정상가동상태의 진동주파수보다 더 높은 경우 제어부에 의해 빛과 소리로 작업자에게 경보를 울리거나 압출기의 가동을 중지하도록 구성되는 압출기용 이물질 감지장치를 제공하기 위한 것으로, 압출기를 이용해 수지를 압출함에 있어  압출기의 내부에 수지와 함께 잘못 유입된 이물질을 가장 빨리, 그리고 가장 간단한 구조로 찾아내어 제거할 수 있도록 함으로써 압출기의 손상을 방지하고, 가동중단사태를 최소화할 수 있으며, 무엇보다 비교적 낮은 비용으로 이를 구현할 수 있는 매우 유용한 발명인 것이다.

title_en: Device convenient for blind person to walk at night and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of road traffic, and particularly relates to a device convenient for blind men to walk at night and a using method thereof. According to the invention, the sound wave with specific frequency is generated through the matching of the blind stick and the blind road, and the warning lamp is controlled through the sound wave with specific frequency, so that the blind stick can emit light only when the blind person makes the blind stick look for the way, and further common pedestrians and the blind person can be conveniently distinguished, and further the function of reminding surrounding pedestrians of paying attention to the blind person is realized.

title_en: Hand-screwed air exhaust valve cap with air pressure detection and abnormity alarm functions
abstract_en: The invention provides a hand-screwed exhaust valve cap with air pressure detection and abnormity warning functions, and relates to the technical field of air valve operating mechanisms. This hand that possesses atmospheric pressure and detect and unusual alarm function is twisted valve cap of bleeding, including the valve cap slide cartridge, the inside sliding connection of valve cap slide cartridge has the slide, the front end of bull stick runs through the middle part and the fixedly connected with pointer of dial plate, the rear end of first binding post runs through the rear side of instrument housing and is connected with alarm device through the second connecting wire, first binding post's the first wire of left side fixedly connected with, second binding post's left side is connected with the solenoid valve through first connecting wire. Through the scale on the directional dial plate of pointer, realized making things convenient for the staff to read the gas pressure value in the pipeline, through alarm device, accessible time report to the police, reduce the potential safety hazard, through setting up supplementary exhaust apparatus, realized accessible time the pressure release, avoided the emergence of accident.
assignees: JIANGSU RAPHAEL MOLDING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Auxiliary decision-making method, system, equipment and medium for mountain fire disaster prevention planning based on Beidou CORS cluster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain fire disaster prevention planning auxiliary decision-making method, system, equipment and medium based on Beidou CORS clusters, belongs to the technical field of mountain fire disaster prevention of power transmission lines, and aims to realize accurate dynamic evaluation of mountain fire risks and intelligent auxiliary decision-making of power transmission line planning by fusing high-precision positioning and global sensing capabilities of Beidou CORS clusters, multi-source environment data and intelligent algorithms, effectively overcome the defects of the traditional mountain fire prevention technology in aspects of large monitoring blind areas, early warning lag, passive prevention and control and the like, remarkably improve the identification precision of mountain fire hidden danger, updating timeliness of risk grades and scientificity of line avoidance and pole height design, thereby enhancing the capability of the power transmission lines in resisting the mountain fire disasters, reducing tripping and equipment damage risks and guaranteeing safe and stable operation of a power grid.

title_en: Fire alarm apparatus for blind individuals
abstract_en: A fire-warning device is provided, which enables a blind to easily approach the fire-warning device by equipping with a signal transmitter. A fire-warning device comprises: an alerter(30) for generating warning tone when a fire occurs; a signal transmitter(60) generating the tone to make the blind recognize clearly the location of the fire-warning device; a call button(70) for giving alarm to the fire station; a phone(90) for informing the fire station of occurrence of fire; and a Braille point display for recognizing a button and a call button.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 시각장애인용 화재경보장치에 관한 것으로서, 화재 발생시 경보음을 발생시키기 위한 경보기와, 상기 경보기를 작동시키기 위한 버튼을 구비하여 실내에 설치되는 화재경보장치에 있어서, 시각장애인이 상기 화재경보장치의 위치를 인식할 수 있도록, 시각장애인이 들을 수 있는 신호음을 발생시키는 신호발신기를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     본 발명에 따른 시각장애인용 화재경보장치는, 시각장애인이 들을 수 있는 신호음을 발생시키는 신호발신기를 포함하므로, 시각장애인이 화재경보장치의 위치를 용이하게 인식하여 화재경보장치 측으로 접근할 수 있는 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Braille block
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A raised block for subway sidewalk is provided to use the raised block for the person who is visually handicapped on usual days, and evacuate passengers to a safe place by switching off a light emitting diodes in case of a fire. CONSTITUTION: A raised block for subway sidewalk comprises a raised block(20), a fire alarm, and a control device. The raised block has a fire alarm, a control device, and a plurality of light emitting diodes(242) which display a guide direction. The fire alarm generates a loud bell and lighting in case of a fire. The control device connected with the fire alarm controls the light emitting diodes and characters shape installed in the raised block in case of a fire.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지하철 보도에 설치되는 점자블록에 관한 것으로서, 지하철 보도에 설치되는 점자블록에 있어서 소정의 높이와 면적을 가지며 상부에는 장착공간이 구비된 점자가 일정간격으로 돌출형성되는 커버 판을 폴리카보네이트를 이용해서 투명하게 형성하고 상기 커버 판의 하부에는 상면이 노란색으로 형성되며 상기 장착공간과 대응되는 위치에 다수의 발광다이오드가 장착된 회로기판을 장착하여 점자블록을 구성하고, 상기 점자블록은 화재발생에 따른 화재경보기의 작동시 이를 인지하고 작동신호를 회로기판에 전달하는 컨트롤 장치와 연결되어, 평상시에는 시각장애인의 점자보도로 이용되고 화재 발생이나 비상시에는 컨트롤 장치에서 전달되는 신호에 따라 회로기판에 장착되는 발광다이오드를 화살표나 진행방향으로 점멸시켜 승객들을 안전한 곳으로 이동할 수 있도록 한 것을 특징으로 한다.  
       
     점자블록, 커버 판, 점자, 회로기판, 발광다이오드, 화재경보기, 컨트롤 장치, 진동모터.

title_en: System for Alarm Broadcasting using UAS
title_ko: 무인 비행체를 이용한 경보 방송 시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, in the event of a disaster, an alarm broadcasting system using an unmanned aerial vehicle allows to rapidly spread situation of the disaster to shadow and blind spots of the alarm, such as disaster areas, inside buildings in major institutions and densely populated areas, and mountainous areas. Therefore, alarm situation may be transmitted to residents in the buildings and non-receivers of the alarm in the mountainous areas that existed as shaded areas of conventional alarm broadcasting system, thereby allowing proactive respond to the alarm situation to reduce or prevent personal injury and property loss.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 무인 비행체를 이용한 경보 방송 시스템에 따르면, 재난 상황 발생 시 미리 설정된 지역을 무인 비행하는 무인 비행체를 이용하여 신속하게 재난 지역, 주요 기관 및 인구 밀집 지역의 건물 내부와 산간 지역과 같은 경보 방송 음영 및 사각 지대로 재난 상황을 전파할 수 있도록 하여, 기존 방식의 경보 전파에 음영 지역으로 존재하던 건물 내 거주민들과 산간 지역의 경보 미 청취자들에게 경보 상황을 전달함으로써, 경보 상황에 대하여 능동적인 대처를 할 수 있도록 하여 인명 피해와 재산 손실을 줄이거나 방지할 수 있도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Control system to secure running vehicles turns right
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety assurance system in preparation for safety accidents involving right-turning vehicles and pedestrians on crosswalks, which is configured to allow a driver to check by flashing a red light on a control rod if a human body is detected when a vehicle turns right, and is configured to enable the pedestrians (visually impaired, smartphone users) to recognize the vehicle by vibrating sidewalk blocks or making sound notifications. According to the present invention, the system for assuring the safety of a vehicle which turns right comprises: a human body detection unit (10) which detects people or animals at a crosswalk; a vehicle detection unit (20) which detects a vehicle which turns right; a flashing unit (30) which flashes a colored light on a vehicle entry prevention rod (S) when the vehicle detection unit (20) detects the vehicle which turns right; and a vibration unit (40) which vibrates the sidewalk block when the human body detection unit (10) detects people or animals. The system alerts both the vehicle driver and the pedestrian to the risk of accidents.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 우회전 차량과 횡단보도 보행자의 안전사고에 대비한 안전 확보 시스템에 관한 것으로, 차량의 우회전 시 인체가 감지되는 경우 규제 봉에 적색등을 점멸시켜 운전자가 확인할 수 있도록 구성되고, 보도블록을 진동시키거나 음향 알림을 통해 보행자(시각 장애인, 스마트폰 사용자)가 인지할 수 있도록 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
본 발명에 따른 우회전 차량 안전 확보 시스템은, 횡단보도에서 사람 또는 동물을 감지하는 인체감지부(10); 우회전 차량을 감지하는 차량감지부(20); 상기 차량감지부(20)에서 우회전 차량을 감지한 경우, 차량 진입 방지봉(S)에 색등을 점멸시키는 점멸부(30); 상기 인체감지부(10)에서 사람 또는 동물을 감지한 경우, 보도블록을 진동시키는 진동부(40);를 포함하여 차량 운전자와 보행자 모두에게 사고 위험을 알리는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: SILLA UNIV INDUSTRY UNIV COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: System and method for universal emergency notification and management
abstract_en: Systems and methods for triggering emergency mass notifications include an EMNS activation service, a plurality of activation premises devices, a plurality of EMNS provider services, and a plurality of event personnel devices. The EMNS activation service includes a universal translator module that receives an event trigger signal relating to an emergency event from one of the activation premises devices. The universal translator module translates the event trigger signal to event-specific EMNS protocols of the EMNS providers. The EMNS activation service communicates the event-specific EMNS protocols to the EMNS providers, and communicates event data to event personnel devices based on a list of event personnel devices to be notified of an emergency event. An activation premises device includes a housing event with trigger controls for creating the event trigger signal, wherein these event trigger controls are inaccessible to users in the absence of an authorized access or an emergency access.

title_en: Systems and methods to parse message for providing alert at device
abstract_en: In one aspect, a device includes a processor and storage accessible to the processor. The storage bears instructions executable by the processor to parse content of a message and determine, based on the parsing of content of the message, whether to provide a notification using the device. The instructions are also executable by the processor to provide the notification responsive to a determination, based on the parsing of content of the message, to provide the notification using the device.

title_en: Detection method for near-ground detection blind area range of weather radar
abstract_en: The application relates to a detection method of a near-ground detection blind area range of a weather radar, belonging to the technical field of radar detection, comprising the following steps: acquiring radar site information and topographic data of the range of the radar site; calculating the altitude of a radar feed source, the altitude of each distance library, the longitude and latitude of each distance library and the terrain height of the position of each distance library; and judging the actual maximum detection distance of each azimuth angle of the radar by using the lowest elevation angle in the radar body scanning mode, and obtaining the shielding range close to the ground in the radar theoretical maximum detection range according to calculation. The application has guiding function for adjacent radar site selection and radar networking jigsaw work, and provides reference information for solving the problem of compensating detection blind areas in low altitude when constructing adjacent radars; the automatic rainfall station is distributed in the detection blind area to provide important information, the effect of certain blind supplement can be achieved, the accuracy of quantitative rainfall estimation is improved, and accordingly the response time of mountain torrent disaster early warning in mountain areas is prolonged.

title_en: Be applied to active safety precaution system of lead to coal pipe gallery
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active safety early warning system applied to a coal pipe gallery, which belongs to the technical field of safety early warning and solves the problems of low sensitivity, easy false alarm and a large number of monitoring blind areas of the detection system on the market at present, and comprises a sampling end distributed in a space to be detected and an early warning equipment end arranged on the inner wall of the space to be detected, wherein the early warning equipment end is connected with a remote general control end through a network, the sampling end comprises a sampling pipe and a distributed optical fiber line type temperature sensing detector fixed on the gas sampling pipe through a binding belt, the gas sampling tube is provided with an opening used for air intake, a distributed optical fiber temperature measuring host, a distributed gas detecting host and a signal transmission transfer machine are arranged in the early warning equipment end, the gas content can be detected through the combined use of the gas sampling tube and the distributed optical fiber linear temperature sensing detector, the temperature of each area position can be detected, and even potential safety hazards can be found.
assignees: HUNAN KEWO ELECTRONIC ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sanitation integrated intelligent highway sanitation management method, system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environmental sanitation integrated intelligent highway environmental sanitation management system which comprises a user side module, a monitoring module, a signal transmission module, a signal processing module, a control terminal, a garbage throwing point and an environmental sanitation site, wherein the user side module is used for feeding back highway environmental sanitation conditions and receiving and transmitting processing information by pedestrians, the monitoring module is used for collecting real-time images of a monitoring area, the signal transmission module is used for transmitting and transmitting signals, and screening processing is carried out through the signal processing module. The invention has reasonable structural design, can regularly clean the garbage throwing point and the road through the environmental sanitation station, can monitor the road in the management area and the garbage and the foreign matters in the garbage throwing point in real time through the monitoring module, and can enable pedestrians to press down the warning device or photograph the garbage and the foreign matters by themselves through the user terminal module to upload the garbage and the foreign matters to the management system, thereby enabling the control terminal to send instructions to the nearby environmental sanitation station to timely arrange to clean, and reducing the potential safety hazard.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering hidden danger intelligent inspection planning method and system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering hidden danger intelligent inspection planning method and system based on big data analysis, which relate to the field of path planning and comprise the steps of constructing a multi-source database which covers the full life cycle of hydraulic engineering and is highly structured; the method comprises the steps of utilizing big data analysis to mine internal relations among hidden danger characteristics, establishing a quantized hidden danger characteristic vector library and a four-level risk assessment model to form an intuitive risk space distribution diagram, comprehensively considering risk, accessibility and urgency factors, intelligently dividing the priority of a patrol area, formulating an efficient optimal patrol route through a path planning algorithm, accurately scheduling patrol resources according to task requirements, and realizing real-time identification and early warning of hidden danger and closed-loop feedback of data in execution. The method has the advantages that a full-flow closed-loop system is constructed by big data drive, and the accuracy, the high efficiency and the intellectualization of the hydraulic engineering inspection are realized through multi-source data integration, accurate risk assessment, intelligent path planning and real-time early warning iteration.
assignees: JIANGSU PROVINCE TAIZHOU RIVER MAN OFFICE

title_en: Multiple filter-type two-stage rainwater filter
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multi-layer filter type two-stage rainwater filter which rapidly removes foreign materials included in rainwater while the rainwater passes through a multi-layer filter, thereby allowing rainwater to be used in a wastewater reclamation and reusing system. The filter of the present invention, which filters rainwater using the filter, includes a filter box introduces and discharges rainwater; allows rainwater to be introduced to an upper portion of the filter box toward a tangent line direction; has a bottom plate installed on the inner lower portion of the filter box; has a ring-shaped coupling frame installed in the center of the bottom plate; and inserts the multi-layer filter, with which a plurality of filters are overlapped, into the coupling frame. The multi-layer filter: forms the diameter of a lower filter wider than that of an upper filter while forming pores, which gradually become smaller from the outside to the inside thereof; discharges rainwater, in which foreign materials are not filtered, at the upper portion of the bottom plate; and discharges rainwater, in which foreign materials are filtered, from a lower surface of the bottom plate to a side surface of the filter box.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 빗물에 포함된 이물질이 다중 필터를 통과하면서 빠른 시간에 제거되어 빗물을 중수도로 사용하는 다단 필터형 2단 빗물 여과기에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 빗물을 필터로 여과하는 여과기에서, 빗물의 유입과 배출이 이루어지는 여과통을 구비하되 상기 여과통의 상측으로 접선 방향을 향하여 빗물이 유입되게 하고, 상기 여과통의 내부 하측에는 바닥판을 설치하되 상기 바닥판의 중앙에 링 형상의 결합틀을 설치하며, 상기 결합틀에는 여러 개의 필터를 겹치게 되는 다중 필터를 끼워주되 상기 다중 필터는 외측에서 내측으로 갈수록 공극이 작게 하는 한편 하측의 필터 직경이 상측의 필터 직경보다 넓게 형성하고, 상기 바닥판의 상측에서 이물질이 걸러지지 않은 빗물이 배출되고, 상기 바닥판의 저면에서 여과통의 측면으로 이물질이 여과된 빗물이 배출되게 함으로써 이루어지진다.
assignees: UNIV DAEGU IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Multipurpose safety scissors for children/blindness
abstract_en: The present invention provides multipurpose safety scissors for children and visually impaired people. The multipurpose safety scissors comprise: a safety cap (1) that prevents a user from being injured by scissor blades; scissor blades (2) that can cut objects; a motion/heat detection sensor (3) that is attached to vertices of the scissor blades (2) and sounds an alarm when user's movement or heat is detected; a ruler (4) that is attached to an end surface of the scissor blades (2); and handles (5) that are made of silicon and positioned at upper parts of the scissor blades (2). When inexperienced users like children or the visually impaired people are at risk of injuring themselves while using the scissors, the sensors activate an alarm signal to alert the user of the danger, thereby reducing safety accidents. Additionally, the presence of the safety cap on the handles adds an extra layer of protection. In addition, the scissors provide convenience in use for primary users, and enhance usability for the primary users with various additional features. In particular, the present invention prioritizes user safety and convenience of the users, resulting in safer and more convenient scissor usage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사용자가 가위날에 의해 다치지 않도록 하는 안전캡(1), 물체를 자를 수 있는 가위날(2), 가위날(2)의 꼭짓점 부분에 부착되어 사용자의 움직임이나 열이 감지될경우 경보음을 울리는 움직임/열감지 센서(3), 가위날(2)의 단면부분에 부착되어있는 자(4), 가위날(2)의 윗부분에 있는 실리콘으로 만들어진 손잡이(5)가 마련되는 것을 특징으로 하는 어린이 및 시각장애인용 다용도 안전가위. 본 발명은 가위질이 서투른 어린이나 시각장애인이 가위를 사용할때 다칠위험이 생기면 센서가 작동해 신호음이 울리는것으로 사용자에게 위험을 알려주어 안전사고를 줄임과 동시에 손잡이 부분에 안전캡이 달려있어 더욱더 안전하게 사용할 수 있다. 그리고 가위를 사용하는 주 사용자가 이 가위를 편리하게 사용할 수 있도록 한다. 또한 여러가지 부가 기능으로 주 사용자가 더욱 편리하게 가위를 사용할 수 있도록 한다. 특히 본 발명은 사용자의 안전과 편리를 주목적으로 하여 사용자가 더욱 안전하고 편리하게 가위를 사용할 수 있는 효과를 갖는다.

title_en: Combination led lighting and danger detection lamp/fixture apparatus host, with a paired supporting satellite, including utility elements, and method therefore
abstract_en: The improved combination lighting-danger detection apparatus and system generally comprises a host device wirelessly paired with a network of remote sensing and utility satellites, where the host receives signals from the sensing satellites to extend its monitoring range, creates a distributed network by issuing commands to the utility satellites, includes audible and visual alarms, and transmits alerts across the network, and a base station that enables users to configure preferences, manage settings, test features and control operations through an application. With a series of such devices, networked throughout a building structure, provides a ‘whole-house’ complement to security, accessibility, and efficiency providing greater, danger protection, hazard warning, and utility operations, convenience functionality.

title_en: Forest fire prevention monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire prevention monitoring and early warning device which comprises a box body, wherein through holes are formed in the left side and the right side of the inner wall of the box body, the bottom of a torsion spring is fixedly connected to the outer wall of a bent plate, a belt is fixedly connected to the outer side of the bent plate, the outer wall of the belt is in clearance fit with the inner wall of the through holes, the outer wall of the belt is rotatably connected with a grooved wheel, the grooved wheel is rotatably connected with the rear end face of the inner wall of the through hole through a connecting shaft, rod bodies are fixedly connected to the outer side of the belt, and the two rod bodies are respectively rotatably connected with the left side and the right side of the outer wall of the box body. This forest fire prevention control early warning device for smoke alarm accessible box and box cover's protection carries out stable work, and convenient to use person takes out smoke alarm, makes box cover and box can carry out stable laminating, and then makes box cover and box can carry out stable protection to smoke alarm, makes smoke alarm can carry out stable protection.

title_en: Auxiliary reinforcing fence easy to distinguish and drop-proof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an easily-resolved anti-drop auxiliary reinforcement fence which comprises a placement mechanism, a light reflection protection mechanism and a warning resolution mechanism, wherein one side of the placement mechanism is provided with the light reflection protection mechanism, the top end of the light reflection protection mechanism is provided with the warning resolution mechanism, the warning resolution mechanism comprises a wiring groove, a warning frame, an LED lamp strip, a rotating seat and an LED lamp column, one side of the wiring groove is connected with the warning frame, and the two sides of the warning frame are distributed with the LED lamp strip. This easy supplementary reinforcement rail of distinguishing anti falling, under night environment, the LED lamp strip of accessible warning frame both sides keeps normal bright state to make things convenient for the peripheral personnel of pier to distinguish the pier boundary, with this promotion security, and the LED lamp pole that wiring groove top is connected, then can be when the passenger rolling ship berths or unloads, through the electric and carry out rotatory scintillation process, provide direction information and keep warning effect for the ship, further promote pier security, avoid personnel or goods to drop, reduce the potential safety hazard.

title_en: Vehicle main driving A pillar collision early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle main driving A pillar collision early warning system. The vehicle main driving A pillar collision early warning system comprises an ultrasonic radar probe and a light warning mainframe, wherein the ultrasonic radar probe is installed on a vehicle left front fender; the light warning mainframe is arranged beside an A pillar on the left side. The system is powered through a power source of a left steering lamp. The light warning mainframe comprises a warning lamp and a mainframe controller; the ultrasonic radar probe and the warning lamp are electrically connected with the mainframe controller; the mainframe controller is provided with a wire electrically connected with a power source of the left steering lamp of the vehicle; the warning lamp gives an alarm in a light flicker mode and comprises a red modulator tube and a yellow modulator tube; the red modulator tube and the yellow modulator tube emit red light and yellow light respectively when switched on, and the two modulator tubes are electrically connected with the mainframe controller in parallel. The vehicle main driving A pillar collision early warning system can effectively solve the driving safety hidden danger caused by the vehicle A pillar blind area.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting prior-warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire-fighting prior-warning device, including casing, the casing is internally provided with battery, the upper end of the battery is provided with dividing plate, the upper end of the dividing plate is provided with PLC, the right-hand member of the PLC is provided with adapted transmission device, and the front end of the casing is provided with first manual alarm button, the upper end of the casing is provided with the first alarm, the first Smoke Sensor is provided with the right side of first alarm, the first temperature sensor is provided with the right side of first Smoke Sensor, the casing is connected by electric wire with warning box, the inside of the warning box is disposed with the second alarm from top to bottom, second Smoke Sensor, second temperature sensor and the second manual pull station, and it is provided with blinds ventilating opening on the side wall of the casing.Beneficial effect：The situation for occurring fire can timely be notified resident and fire-fighting, shorten the time of alarm, prevent the expansion of fire and spread.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHANBANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Goods taking and distributing system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a goods taking cabinet and goods distribution system, wherein, the goods taking cabinet comprises a main body, a first monitoring device, a warning device and a first controller, the main body is provided with a front opening which is formed by enclosing a top wall, a bottom wall and two side walls and is used for taking goods and a rear opening for storing the goods; the first monitoring device is arranged on one side, close to the rear opening, of the inner wall of the main body and used for monitoring whether foreign matters pass through or not; the warning device is used for sending a first warning signal when foreign matters pass through; the first controller is respectively connected with the first monitoring device and the warning device so as to control the warning device according to the monitoring result of the first monitoring device. When the foreign matter passes through, can monitor and send alarm signal by monitoring devices, avoid touching the cargo transportation device because of the mistake and cause the potential safety hazard in getting the goods in-process.
assignees: BEIJING SANKUAI ONLINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Secondary starting and rolling accident early warning system and method for front dead zone of slag car
abstract_en: The invention relates to a secondary starting and rolling accident pre-warning system for a dead zone in front of a slag car, which comprises a dead zone automatic braking system, a sensing module and a control module; the sensing module is used for collecting real-time vehicle speed, identifying whether pedestrians or non-motor vehicles exist below the vehicle head, detecting whether the vehicle door is opened or not, detecting whether the hand brake is pulled up or not, and sending signals to the control module, and the control module is used for analyzing the signals sent by the sensing module and sending corresponding instructions; the blind area automatic braking system is used for receiving and executing the instruction sent by the controller and feeding back an execution signal to the controller. After the automatic braking system is triggered, the early warning system can identify whether a pedestrian or a non-motor vehicle exists at the bottom of the locomotive or not before secondary starting of the driver, remind the driver of carrying out safety inspection before secondary starting, and prevent the driver from secondary starting under the condition of potential safety hazards, so that rolling accidents are effectively prevented from occurring in a dead zone in front of the secondary starting of the muck vehicle.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHIHUI CHELIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Smart signal warning device that manages the pedestrian safety of smartphone users
title_ko: 스마트폰 사용자의 횡단보도 보행 안전을 관리하는 스마트 신호등 경보장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart traffic light alarm device for managing the pedestrian walking safety of a smartphone user and, more specifically, to a smart traffic light alarm device providing a smart traffic light alarm device around the pedestrian to prevent a traffic accident of a pedestrian due to excessive absorption in a smartphone, and helping walking of the visually impaired. Therefore, the smart traffic light alarm device provides a pedestrian walking safety service for all pedestrians that the general public but also the visually impaired can conveniently use the service.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 스마트폰 사용자의 횡단보도 보행 안전을 관리하는 스마트 신호등 경보장치에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 횡단보도 주변에 스마트 신호등 경보장치를 제공하여 스마트폰 과몰입에 따른 보행자의 교통 사고를 방지하며, 시각 장애인의 보행도 도움을 줄 수 있는 스마트폰 사용자의 횡단보도 보행 안전을 관리하는 스마트 신호등 경보장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 의하면, 횡단보도 주변에 스마트 신호등 경보장치를 제공하여 스마트폰 과몰입에 따른 보행자의 교통 사고를 방지하며, 시각 장애인의 보행도 도움을 줄 수 있는 스마트폰 사용자의 횡단보도 보행 안전을 관리하는 스마트 신호등 경보장치를 제공하게 된다. 
따라서, 일반인 뿐만 아니라, 장애인도 편리하게 이용할 수 있는 모든 보행자들을 위한 횡단보도 보행 안전서비스를 제공하게 된다.

title_en: Situational awareness and position location information interface system
abstract_en: An efficient and reliable way to send various information including position location information (PLI) and emergency messages (EM) using or within a mobile satellite system (MSS) using different message formats including short message (e.g., short burst data (SBD), etc.), between mobile users as provided. Embodiments also use global positioning systems (GPS) used in some cases with the PLI system. Various embodiments improve communications efficiency and reliability of message transmission through various types of MSS. Embodiments include a method or approach to interface SBD PLI messages from mobile end user terminals (EUT) to common operating picture (COP) application programs as provided. Exemplary methods interface and translate MSS short messages (e.g., SBD) to extensible markup language (XML) message format and communicate converted messages to COP application program within a computer using a TCP/IP interface.

title_en: Petroleum well drilling engineering accidents early-warning system based on layered fuzzy system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an oil drilling engineering accident early warning system based on a hierarchy fuzzy system. First, a stimulant database for oil drilling engineering accident early warning is created; second, an input variable for oil drilling engineering accident early warning; third, the characteristic information of input signals is analyzed; fourth, a structural model of the hierarchy fuzzy system is created; fifth, an interval mapping and a hierarchy fuzzy reasoning of a unified model are done for the input variable in the third step; sixth, the output quantity of the oil drilling engineering accident early warning system is confirmed; seventh, the self-adjustment of the early warning result is done. The present invention has the advantages that the hierarchy fuzzy system is used to translate the excessive physical variable in the oil drilling engineering accident early warning system into a hierarchy system formed by connecting hierarchically with a reduced dimensionality fuzzy unit, and make the regular number of the fuzzy system increase with the number of the input variable linearly, thereby putting an end to the phenomenal of dimension calamity, and realizing the purpose of early warning for the oil drilling engineering accident accurately, efficiently and conveniently.

title_en: Fire alarm device is used in operating room construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire alarm device is used in operating room construction relates to a fire alarm device technical field, including base and shell. The utility model discloses in, use through the cooperation between base and the double faced adhesive tape, can accomplish the installation work to this alarm device, avoid the operation of punching, easy operation installs fast, on the one hand, the on the other hand, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, the draw-in groove, and a housing, the activity groove, a riser, cooperation between fixture block and the spring is used, can easily dismantle this fire alarm device, be convenient for later stage overhaul and the going on of clearance metal filter screen work, on the other hand, the on the one hand, through the base, cooperation between shell and the metal filter screen is used, the invasion of winged insect and foreign object has effectively been blockked, thereby the normal operating of inside smoke sensor has been guaranteed, through warning loudspeaker, a processor module, cooperation between WIFI module and the smoke sensor is used, make the more timely transmission of conflagration alarm, thereby make withdraw and put out a fire work go on fast, and then fire loss and casualties have been reduced.

title_en: Violation reminding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reminding device violating regulations, include: the device comprises two guide rails arranged in parallel, a motion system moving along the guide direction of the guide rails, a reminding robot arranged on the motion system and an induction piece; the motion system drives the reminding robot to move along the guide direction of the guide rail; the motion system comprises a moving platform arranged on the guide rail, a driving mechanism for driving the moving platform to move along the guide direction of the guide rail, a control box arranged on the moving platform and a lithium battery; the reminding robot is arranged on the mobile platform and moves to the position of the illegal vehicle along with the mobile platform to collect information and recognize, remind and drive away; the sensing member includes a position detection switch and an ultrasonic sensor. The utility model discloses automatic move along way side guide rail and carry out automatic recognition, discernment of shooing to its license plate to the vehicle position of parking violating the regulations, the recognition of shooing is carried out warning, is driven away from vehicle violating the regulations with discernment result accessible robot machine-carried LED screen and voice broadcast.
assignees: HUNAN LINGXING MAGLEV TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of rearview mirror for reducing blind area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of rearview mirror for reducing blind area, including rearview mirror, bearing and camera, the right-hand member of the rearview mirror is provided with fix bar, installing arm is provided with below the fix bar, fan is provided with above the right side of the rearview mirror, the left side middle position of the rearview mirror is provided with warning lamp, and the preceding surface middle position of rearview mirror, which is provided with, looks squarely eyeglass；Round mirror is provided with rearview mirror, circle mirror is adhered on enlarging lens by the sucker installing ring in fixed plate, make to justify mirror easy for removal and installation, when human pilot prepares to start up the car, by observing circle mirror, the situation of automobile down either side can clearly be observed, make automobile when dispatching a car, it ensure that the safety of pedestrian, and reduce potential safety hazard, be provided with rearview mirror and look squarely eyeglass and enlarging lens, when vehicle under steam when, the distance between car and car can effectively be judged by viewing magnifier piece.

title_en: Dangerous sound reminding method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of communication, and discloses a danger sound reminding method, device and equipment and a readable storage medium. In the scheme of this application, after obtaining external sound, after hearing the barrier person and selecting dangerous sound warning system, the accessible acquires external real-time sound voluntarily, through judging external sound, explain external sound, acquire the type of sound according to the result of explanation, judge according to the sound type data that obtains, can obtain whether external sound is dangerous sound in the follow judgement, if judge this sound characteristic is dangerous sound according to the data of sound, then will send the instruction of reminding to the terminal, carry out appointed operation through control terminal, thereby be convenient for remind and hear the barrier person and meet danger and need carry out danger and dodge, thereby in order to solve the problem that hearing the barrier person among the prior art meets emergency and can't the perception dodge.
assignees: SHENZHEN WATER WORLD INFORMATION CO LTD

title_en: Communication system
abstract_en: To provide a communication system which can distribute emergency information of J-ALERT as character information, and reliably transmit information to even a hearing impaired person and a person resident in a place which voice is difficult to reach.SOLUTION: A communication system comprises a J-ALERT receiver 20 which receives emergency information of J-ALERT, and generates character data on the basis of the emergency information. In an information distribution server 10, a J-ALERT acquisition unit 30 attaches a specific registration number to the character data acquired from the J-ALERT receiver 20 to store the data in a database 130, and outputs the specific registration number. An information distribution unit 40 reads the character data from the database 130 on the basis of the registration number outputted from the J-ALERT acquisition unit 30, and outputs the data as character information for distribution.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Appratus for notifying a blind area for hearing impaired driver
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An alarming apparatus for a blind area is provided to warn the blind area according to the control condition of a drive lever and a direction-index lever, thereby being capable of reducing production cost. CONSTITUTION: An alarming apparatus for a blind area comprises an input driver(203), a vibrating unit(207), a control unit(201) and an output driver(205). The input driver input switching signals from a side mirror(231), a direction control switch(237) and a driver lever(233) for selecting operation state of a vehicle, and coverts into electric signals with a rated level. The vibrating unit directly or indirectly transfers vibrations to a steering wheel(235). A control unit detects the vehicle operation state from the driver level, receive a progress direction of a selected vehicle from a direction control switch(237), receives detection signal from an object selecting circuit of one side mirror, and outputs warning signals. The output driver responses to the warning signal, and supply a regular power for operating the vibrating. [Reference numerals] (201) Control unit; (203) Input driver; (205) Output driver; (207) Vibrating unit
abstract_ko:
본 발명에서 청각장애 운전자가 차량의 사각지대로 출현하는 물체를 용이하게 인지할 수 있는 사각지대 알림장치를 개시한다. 
본 발명에 따른 알림장치는, 차량의 사각지대에 출현 또는 존재하는 물체를 감지하기 위한 물체감지 회로가 미러의 후방에 장착된 각각의 사이드미러, 운전자가 차량의 진행방향을 외부로 통지하기 위한 방향조작 스위치 및 차량의 운행상태를 선택하기 위한 드라이버 레버로부터 각 스위칭 신호를 입력받아 정격 레벨의 전기적 신호로 변환 출력하는 입력 드라이버; 스티어링 휠(Steering wheel)에 직접 또는 간접적으로 진동을 전달하기 위한 진동수단; 상기 드라이버 레버로부터 차량 운행 상태를 인지한 후, 상기 방향조작 스위치로부터 선택된 차량의 진행방향을 접수하고, 상기 차량의 진행방향에 대응하는 어느 하나의 사이드미러의 물체감지 회로로부터 검출신호를 수신하되, 상기 검출신호에 의해 차량의 사각지대에 임의의 물체를 감지할 경우, 경고 신호를 출력하는 제어부; 및 상기 경고 신호에 응답하여 상기 진동수단을 동작시키기 위한 정격 전원을 공급하는 출력 드라이버로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 따라서, 본 발명은 노약자 또는 청각장애의 운전 시 사각지대에 진입한 근접 차량의 경적음을 청취하지 못하더라도, 운전자가 위험 상황을 충분히 인지할 수 있어 안전사고를 미연에 방지하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: An alert device, system and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an alert device (10), system and method for alerting a hearing-impaired person through a sensory means of a sound event and the location of such sound event. The invention extends further to the tracking of an object within a predefined perimeter, outside of which an alert is triggerable. The alert device (10) includes a wearable unit (12) having a plurality of differently colored LEDs (16.1, 16.2, 16.3, 16.4, 16.5) and a plurality of differently colored sound-detecting units (20.1, 20.2, 20.3, 20.4, 20.5), with each of the differently colored sound-detecting units (20.1, 20.2, 20.3, 20.4, 20.5) corresponding to the same colored LED (16.1, 16.2, 16.3, 16.4, 16.5) on the wearable unit thereby to color code the wearable unit to the sound-detecting units (20.1, 20.2, 20.3, 20.4, 20.5). In use, and in the event of a sound detected by one or more of the sound-detecting units (20.1, 20.2, 20.3, 20.4, 20.5) being higher than a predetermined threshold sound, a sound event signal is triggered on the wearable unit (12) activating a vibration thereof and the blinking of the LED (16.1, 16.2, 16.3, 16.4, 16.5) corresponding with the respective sound- detecting unit (20.1, 20.2, 20.3, 20.4, 20.5), consequentially alerting a user of the location at which that sound-detecting unit (20.1, 20.2, 20.3, 20.4, 20.5) was previously positioned within an environment.

title_en: Customer-controlled instant-response anti-fraud/anti-identity theft devices (with true-personal identity verification), methods and systems for secured global applications in personal/business e-banking, e-commerce, e-medical/health insurance checker, e-education/research/invention, e-disaster advisor, e-immigration, e-airport/aircraft security, e-military/e-law enforcement, with or without nfc component and system, with cellular/satellite phone/internet/multi-media functions
abstract_en: All-in-one wireless mobile telecommunication devices, methods and systems providing greater customer-control, instant-response anti-fraud/anti-identity theft protections with instant alarm, messaging and secured true-personal identity verifications for numerous registered customers/users, with biometrics and PIN security, operating with manual, touch-screen and/or voice-controlled commands, achieving secured rapid personal/business e-banking, e-commerce, accurate transactional monetary control and management, having interactive audio-visual alarm/reminder preventing fraudulent usage of legitimate physical and/or virtual credit/debit cards, with cheques anti-forgery means, curtailing medical/health/insurance frauds/identity thefts, having integrated cellular and/or satellite telephonic/internet and multi-media means, equipped with language translations, GPS navigation with transactions tagging, currency converters, with or without NFC components, minimizing potential airport risks/mishaps, providing instant aid against school bullying, kidnapping, car-napping and other crimes, applicable for secured military/immigration/law enforcements, providing guided warning/rescue during emergencies and disasters.

title_en: Wearable/Portable Device and Application Software for Alerting People When the Human Sound Reaches the Preset Threshold
abstract_en: The present invention relates generally to a portable/wearable device as well as application or a software program to be downloaded onto a mobile device or computer. The present invention is intended to measure sound intensity/level and provide an alert signal to remind user(s) or crowds (i.e groups of people) that they are speaking too loud or making too much noise. Furthermore, optionally, the device may play a pre-selected music or pre-recorded message when the sound level threshold is exceeded, which can encourage all of the users to use the bio-feedback of the present invention to relax when they see the visual que such as the light color changes, hear the music, message or produced from the device. Another object of the present invention is to help people to know whether his/her voice is loud enough to be heard by people who have hearing impairment.

title_en: Cane for the blind
title_ko: 높낮이 측정이 가능한 시각장애인용 지팡이 및 이를 이용한 안내방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a height-measurable stick for the blind and a guiding method using the same, the height-measurable stick being capable of making the blind recognize topography at places, such as a steps or pits, where the blind may encounter a rapid change in height and thus preventing negligent accidents, by providing a user with information on the height between the ground and the stick previously. The height-measurable stick according to the present invention comprises: a rod-shaped stick body having a grip part at one side thereof; a power supply part having an operating button on the grip part for supplying power; a distance detecting part mounted on the stick body; an angle detecting part mounted on the stick body; a calculation part which calculates the height from the ground to the lower end of the stick by using the measured values through the distance detecting part and the angle detecting part; a control part which makes a comparative determination between the real-time height information obtained from the calculation part and a predetermined reference danger value; and an alarming part which provides a user with information on the danger at the front which is determined through the control part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 높낮이측정이 가능한 시작장애인용 지팡이 및 이를 이용한 안내방법에 관한 것으로, 시각장애인이 계단이나 구덩이 등 급격한 높낮이변화가 이루어지는 지형에서 지팡이와 지면과의 높낮이 정보를 사용자에게 미리 전달하여 지형상태를 파악할 수 있고 안전사고를 예방할 수 있는 높낮이측정이 가능한 시각장애인용 지팡이 및 이를 이용한 안내방법에 관한 것이다. 
즉, 본 발명은 막대형으로 이루어지고 일측에 손잡이부가 형성된 지팡이몸체와,상기 손잡이부에 작동버튼이 구비되고 전원을 공급할 수 있도록 한 전원공급부와,상기 지팡이몸체에 설치되는 거리감지부와, 상기 지팡이몸체에 설치되는 각도감지부와, 상기 거리감지부와 각도감지부를 통해 측정된 값으로 지팡이의 하단부에서 지면까지 높낮이를 연산하는 연산부와, 상기 연산부를 통해 얻어진 실시간 높낮이정보와 미리 설정된 위험기준값을 비교 판단하는 제어부와, 상기 제어부를 통해 판단된 전방의 위험정보를 사용자에게 알려주는 경보부로 이루어진 것을 특징으로 하는 높낮이측정이 가능한 시각장애인용 지팡이.
assignees: NAT UNIV CHONBUK IND COOP FOUND

title_en: Network based system for predicting landslides and providing early warnings
abstract_en: A wireless node for monitoring landslide conditions has at least one tubular probe body deployed in a borehole in a landslide prone area and anchored to rock below soil, multiple sensors carried by and deployed within and or outside of the tubular probe body for measuring geologic motion, hydrologic saturation and pressure at three or more levels of soil above the rock, a data acquisition board in communication with the sensors carried by and or deployed within or outside of the probe body, and a wireless transceiver in communication with the data acquisition board and accessible to a local area wireless network (LAWN). Geologic and hydrologic data of layers of soil above the anchor rock is from the sensors deployed on or near the probe body, the data qualified against threshold readings to provide graduating levels of alerts culminating in a warning of a landslide.

title_en: Embedded air defense alarm
abstract_en: The utility model provides an embedded air defense alarm which is used for receiving and playing air defense warning and other alarms. An alarm receiving circuit and an alarm generating circuit of the air defense alarm use a large-scale integrated chip; a control circuit uses a monolithic microcomputer; the alarm receiving circuit and the alarm generating circuit are embedded in embedded machines such as a radio receiver, a television set, and the like and are electrically connected with the embedded machines; the alarm receiving circuit and the control circuit steer clear of the power source switch of the embedded machines and is connected with the power source of the embedded machines; when the alarm is not received, the embedded machines are connected according to the prior flow and work according to the prior functions; when the alarm is received, the alarm generating circuit outputs warning signals, and the control circuit ensures that a power amplifying circuit is connected with the power source and the warning signals to forcedly play the alarm. The utility model has the use functions of the embedded machine and solves the problems of the special aerial defense alarm system that the coverage is difficult, the blind spot is more, the warning type is uneasily differentiated, the dependency on commercial power is large, the maintenance workload is large, the special space is required, the availability is low, the invalidation is uneasily discovered, and the like.

title_en: Environment-friendly modified asphalt waterproof coiled material with heat sealing strips
abstract_en: The invention relates to an environment-friendly modified asphalt waterproof coiled material with a heat sealing strip. The technical scheme is as follows: the building block comprises a tire base reinforcing layer, an environment-friendly modified asphalt layer, an upper side isolation protective layer, a lower side isolation protective layer, a heat sealing strip, a thickness gradient area, a construction lap warning line and the like. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the production efficiency of the modified asphalt is improved, the emission of atmospheric pollutants such as carbon monoxide, sulfur dioxide, hydrogen sulfide and the like in the production process of the modified asphalt is reduced by more than 50 percent, and the pungent smell in the preparation process of the modified asphalt and the production process of the modified asphalt coiled material is greatly reduced; the problem of separation of the lap joint part of the coiled material is avoided through the ingenious structural design, and the water channeling hidden danger of the coiled material 'bonding blind space area' is effectively solved; the system viscosity of the modified asphalt is effectively reduced, and the smoothness of the surface of the coiled material are effectively improved. The production efficiency is greatly improved, the production cost is obviously reduced, and the lodging resistance of the coiled material in a high-temperature environment is improved.
assignees: SHENGLI OIL FIELD DYNAMIC NEW TYPE WATERPROOF BUILDING MAT CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle early warning method and device, computer equipment and medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a vehicle early warning method, a vehicle early warning device, a computer apparatus, and a computer readable medium, the method including: receiving a monitoring request sent by a first vehicle; generating early warning information in response to the fact that objects exist in the preset range around the second vehicle; and sending the early warning information to the first vehicle. And after the first vehicle receives the early warning information from the second vehicle, corresponding avoidance measures are taken. Through interaction among different vehicles, potential safety hazards caused by the fact that objects in the sight blind areas of drivers appear in the right front of the advancing routes of the vehicles suddenly are avoided.

title_en: Power channel foreign matter intelligent detection system and method based on multi-scale Retinex algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent detection system and method for foreign matters in a power channel based on a multi-scale Retinex algorithm, wherein the system comprises an image processing module, an intelligent detection module, a hidden danger risk assessment module and an early warning visualization module, wherein the image processing module is used for processing a real-time remote sensing image through the multi-scale Retinex algorithm to obtain an enhanced image, the intelligent detection module is used for detecting the enhanced image by using a foreign matter detection model and outputting the space coordinates of a target foreign matter and the corresponding hidden danger type, the hidden danger risk assessment module is used for generating a dynamic risk assessment value of the target foreign matter based on the space coordinates of the target foreign matter and the corresponding hidden danger type and the space-time distribution rule of electric potential safety hazards, and the early warning visualization module is used for carrying out visual early warning display on a risk foreign matter mark on the real-time remote sensing image when the dynamic risk assessment value is larger than or equal to a preset threshold. The collected power channel images are preprocessed through a multi-scale Retinex algorithm, the influence of uneven illumination is eliminated, the image quality is improved, and the accurate detection of the foreign matters in the power channel is realized by combining an intelligent recognition algorithm.
assignees: YICHUN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: device that displays information about the driver's blind spot
title_ko: 운전자의 사각지대에 대한 정보를 표시하는 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for displaying information on the blind spot of a driver. The present invention relates to a vehicle identification and warning system. More specifically, the system identifies an area out of sight of an approaching vehicle and a driver of the vehicle based on at least one of a camera and a sensor, and outputs information obtained based thereon.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 운전자의 사각지대에 대한 정보를 표시하는 장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 차량 식별 및 경고 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 카메라 및 센서 중 적어도 하나에 기초하여 접근 중인 차량 및 차량의 운전자의 시야가 닿지 않는 지역을 식별하고, 이에 기반하여 획득된 정보를 출력하는 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Stadium outdoor site emergency refuge instant use condition prediction control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a prediction control method for the emergency refuge instant use condition of an outdoor place of a stadium, which comprises the following steps: (a) accessing a database of a stadium monitoring center to a China earthquake platform network to acquire real-time earthquake information; (b) inputting a burst early warning parameter into a database of a monitoring center of a stadium, and setting an early warning threshold value of the burst early warning parameter; (d) acquiring the flow of evacuated people through a plurality of network cameras arranged outside the stadium, and displaying the flow on monitoring equipment of a monitoring center of the stadium; (e) people flow is guided to evacuate according to the evacuation route through broadcast broadcasting. The outdoor field utilization efficiency of the stadium is improved, and unnatural damage caused by blind crowding of people is avoided.

title_en: Warehouse alarm system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a warehouse alarm system, which relates to the technical field of electronics and comprises a temperature sensor and an alarm device, wherein the temperature sensor is in communication connection with the alarm device; the temperature sensor is arranged at a first position of the warehouse; the alarm device includes: a sound alarm device and/or a light alarm device; an alarm device is arranged at a second position of the warehouse; the alarm device sends out at least two kinds of signals to prompt different temperature states of the warehouse. This application sends two kinds of signals at least through alarm device, can indicate the different temperature state in warehouse. For current warehouse high temperature alarm device, the warehouse alarm system that this application provided can indicate the different temperature state in warehouse, enlarges the detection range of temperature, avoids appearing warning temperature blind area, and then alleviates because the great high temperature alarm device who leads to of high temperature alarm device's among the current warehouse management system temperature detection range limitation has the technical problem of warning temperature blind area.
assignees: BEIJING MEGVII TECH CO LTD;NINGBO KUANGSHIJINZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring and early warning instrument for mine geological disaster detection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mine geology calamity detects with monitoring and early warning appearance, including installing the monitoring and early warning appearance body on two beds, monitoring and early warning appearance body is including setting up the displacement meter between two beds, and wherein accessible displacement meter monitors the cracked condition, and when the testee produced the displacement, the sensor rope was spurted, and the sensor rope drives sensor slewing mechanism and the synchronous rotation of encoder. The utility model discloses be convenient for adjust the distance between two L shape fixed plates according to the crack width between two bedsteads to make the total length of connecting piece increase, make the crack condition that can be applicable to different widths, improve application scope, and can carry out the dismouting operation to the displacement meter fast alone, improve work efficiency, provide convenience for subsequent maintenance operation.
assignees: SOUTH SURVEYING & MAPPING TECH CO LTD;GUANGZHOU SOUTH SATELLITE NAVIGATION INSTR CO LTD

title_en: All-time dropping prevention device of three-dimensional mechanical parking equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an all-time dropping prevention device of three-dimensional mechanical parking equipment. The all-time dropping prevention device comprises a supporting frame, a lifting vehicle carrying board, a translational vehicle carrying board, a working rope chain, a first roller and a power system, wherein the first roller and the power system are arranged on the supporting frame. The upper end of the working rope chain is connected to the first roller. The supporting frame is provided with a protective roller. Protective rope chains which are lifted synchronously with the working rope chain are arranged beside the working rope chain. The lower ends of the protective rope chains are both installed on the lifting vehicle carrying board. The upper ends of the protective rope chains are both connected to the protective roller. The power system drives the first roller and the protective roller to rotate. When the parking equipment normally operates, the protective rope chains do not bear loads. When the working rope chain fails, the protective rope chains bear all the loads, and braking and warning are performed. The all-time dropping prevention device of the three-dimensional mechanical parking equipment can perform safety protection on the parking equipment during all working time, thereby greatly reducing potential safety hazards of the three-dimensional mechanical parking equipment.

title_en: A kind of road construction warning board device being not prone to tip over
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of road construction warning board device being not prone to tip over, including pillar, it is fixedly installed on the plug body of the lower rod end and is fixedly mounted on the warning sign on the pillar top, cavity is provided with the plug body, slide slot is symmetrically set with the cavity sidewalls, the slide slot medial extremity is provided with the connectivity slot for connecting the cavity, the slide slot outboard end is installed with baffle plate, and it is slidably fitted with sliding block in the slide slot, the sliding block outboard end is provided with the plate of flat, the slot for allowing the plate to stretch out is provided with the baffle plate, the cannelure extended up and down is provided with the pillar, the cannelure is provided with rotary shaft, the rotary shaft upper end is arranged in the cannelure by upper bearing (metal)；Apparatus of the present invention are simple in construction, easy to use, in the presence of plate, pillar is not easy to translate into and is rotated, so as to reduce potential safety hazard.
assignees: GUANGZHOU LINGZHAO TRAFFIC EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: The urgent mobile Internet of things system of earthquake pre-warning speed report
abstract_en: The present invention relates to earthquake pre-warning technical fields, more particularly to a kind of mobile Internet of things system of urgent earthquake pre-warning speed report, it is characterized in that, it is formed including monitoring and mobile communication unit and alarm signal receiving unit, wherein monitoring and mobile communication unit are made of inertia transmitter, remote ground mobile communication module and near-earth Wireless alarm module, and wherein mechanical quantity reception circuit is successively electrically connected with machine magnetic translation circuit and switching value output circuit in inertia transmitter；Implantation decoding APP in the alarm signal receiving unit, and log in mobile internet.Compared with prior art, beneficial effects of the present invention are as follows: 1) exporting switching value pulse at once with passive magnetic switch, progress seismic monitoring, early warning speed report priming speed are fast；2) Earthquake triggering grade can be roughly adjusted, avoids malfunctioning；3) a variety of wireless telecommunications means are used, realize urgent earthquake pre-warning speed report in specified range.

title_en: Beidou positioning system-based power transmission line fault hidden danger early warning system
