abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fault hidden danger early warning, in particular to a power transmission line fault hidden danger early warning system based on a Beidou positioning system, which solves the problems that the traditional power transmission line hidden danger early warning system mainly relies on manual inspection and focuses on monitoring parameters such as the temperature of a line by using a remote sensing technology or a sensor by arranging an unmanned aerial vehicle deployment scheme comparison module, a three-dimensional space model construction module, a power transmission line data set acquisition module and a fault hidden danger power transmission line early warning prompt module, but to the contact relation of branch and other outside barriers and wire be difficult to accurate monitoring, have the problem of blind area, the potential event hidden danger of more accurate discernment reduces the possibility of missing and false detection, improves the precision of early warning, and trouble hidden danger transmission line early warning suggestion module can show the risk position in real time, makes the managers can know the security condition of transmission line directly perceivedly, in time takes measures to reduce the possibility of accident emergence.
assignees: CHENGDE POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LTD

title_en: Emergency vehicle access notification device and method for the deaf
title_ko: 청각 장애인을 위한 긴급차량 알림 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to technology for a notification device for notifying an approaching emergency vehicle for a hearing-impaired person or a driver who has not heard an external sound. The notification device includes: an emergency vehicle notification signal generating unit which generates a signal to know the type of emergency vehicle; a transmission unit which transmits a signal from the emergency vehicle to a general vehicle; a reception unit which receives a signal of the emergency vehicle from the general vehicle; an emergency vehicle signal analysis unit which analyzes the received signal of the emergency vehicle; and a display unit which visually expresses the analyzed signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 청각장애인 또는 외부의 소리를 듣지 못한 운전자를 위하여 접근해오는 긴급차량을 알려주는 알림 장치에 관한 기술로서, 긴급차량의 종류를 알 수 있는 신호를 발생하는 긴급차량 알림신호발생부, 긴급차량에서 일반차량으로 신호를 송신하는 송신부, 일반차량에서 긴급차량의 신호를 받는 수신부, 수신한 긴급차량의 신호를 분석하는 긴급차량 신호분석부, 분석한 신호를 시각적으로 표현해주는 디스플레이부를 포함한다.

title_en: Railway foreign matter invasion safety sensing and identifying system based on distributed optical fiber sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway foreign matter invasion safety sensing and identifying system based on distributed optical fiber sensing, which is based on two distributed optical fiber sensing technologies and a video linkage technology: monitoring vibration intrusion signals generated when illegal personnel, vehicles and construction intrudes into a high-speed railway by using a phase optical time domain analysis technology, and giving information such as positions and events of the intrusion signals; when large-scale falling rocks and debris flows invade a high-speed railway, a brillouin optical time domain analysis technology is utilized to monitor a high-speed railway fence deformation signal generated, and information such as the position of the invasion signal is given; when any one of the two optical fiber sensing systems or the two optical fiber sensing systems generate an alarm, the two optical fiber sensing systems can be linked with cameras arranged on the high-speed railway tower pole to call a monitoring picture of an intrusion event. The three subsystems work synchronously, learn each other, monitor intrusion layer by layer, and jointly realize early warning and recognition of high-speed railway foreign matter intrusion.

title_en: Environment for the Hearing Impaired recognition method and apparatus of the state using the Mobile terminal device.
title_ko: 휴대단말장치를 이용한 청각장애인을 위한 주위환경 상태 인지 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 휴대단말장치를 이용한 청각장애인을 위한 주위환경 상태 인지방법 및 장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 청각장애인이 실내외에서 주변의 실생활 편의장치나 주위환경에 대해서 인지하기 위해, 각 장치가 작동때 나는 음향과 주변상황의 음향의 내용을 기록 및 저장해 두고 상기와 같은 유형의 장치와 상태에서의 실생활에서 일어나는 순간의 장치 및 상태 음향이 발생 되었을 시, 기록 및 저장하고 있는 음향과 대조하여, 동일한 유형일 때 그에 대한 표시 및 경고하는 휴대단말장치와 상기 휴대단말장치를 실내에서 충전과 상기 인지할 상황별 정보들을 표시하는 고정장치 및 상기 고정장치와 같은 역할로 청각장애인이 소지하는 휴대인식장치로 생활 편의장치의 작동상태와 기타 위험에 대한 상황별 음향으로 청각장애인이 인지할 수 있도록 경고 및 표시하는 장치와 방법이다.  
  이를 위한 본 발명의 구성품은 각종 편의장치가 작동하는 음향들을 일정한 분류로 패턴별로 기록저장하고, 상기 장치들이 작동되는 음향을 마이크부로 수집하여,  사전에 기록 저장하여 기록된 음향패턴과 일치하는 유사한 것을 찾아 분류된 유형에 맞는 정보로 경고 및 알림부로 통해 알려주는 휴대단말장치(10)와 상기 휴대단말장치를 실내에서 일정지역내 위치시켜 두고 사용할 시, 경고 표시를 위한 색상별로 구분된 표시장치와 실내에서 각종 음향을 수집하는 마이크부 및 휴대단말장치에 전원 충전을 위한 전원 충전부로 구성되는 표시전원공급장치(20) 및 실내에서 상시 휴대하여 상기 휴대단말장치가 인식한 여러 유형의 범주별 정보를 수신하여 경고 및 알림 기능이 있는 휴대인식장치(30)로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
  이로써 청각장애인들이 도움견(犬)과 같이 위급한 상황에서 일어나는 구분되지 않는 정도의 알림이에서 탈피하여 위급상황 또는 주변상황에서 동작하는 일상생활의 편의제품의 종류별 작동상태와 주변의 여러 응급상황에 대해서도 구분하여 인지할 수 있어, 각종 안전사고 예방에 크게 기여하여 청각장애인의 생활편의성이 높아질 것이다.

title_en: A kind of outdoor electric utility protective fence of protection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of outdoor electric utility protective fences of protection; including railing, pedestal and protection network; the railing bottom is equipped with pedestal; and it is rotatablely connected by rotation axis and universal wheel below pedestal; the railing side is welded with bolt hole; the railing other side is equipped with inlet/outlet, and inlet/outlet front surface centre position is equipped with controller.In the utility model; photoelectric beam detector first by being arranged on railing; when foreign body enters fence; it is triggered to photoelectric beam detector; warning lamp meeting flash caution simultaneously sounds the alarm; additionally by the monitoring camera of setting; the case where can monitoring electric utility periphery; these all play protection and protective effect very well; secondly by setting inlet/outlet and controller, staff, which need to only input password or fingerprint recognition, to be entered, and sound all clear simultaneously; not only facilitate the disengaging of staff, but also prevents staff's false triggering alarm device.
assignees: MIANYANG ZHONGKE LIANCHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tailboard safety control system based on foreign matter monitoring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tailboard safety control system based on foreign matter monitoring monitors whether foreign matter exceeds the front of a platform of the tailboard and invades the region in the rising process of the platform of the tailboard through an infrared sensor arranged in a coincidence region between the height direction of the bottom of the tail end of a carriage and the front of the platform, automatically cuts off the rising motion of the platform of the tailboard if the foreign matter exceeds the front of the platform of the tailboard, avoids safety accidents of extruding and shearing the foreign matter in the relative motion of the rear ends of the platform and the carriage, and sends out a warning; additionally the utility model discloses still through installing at tailboard lift platform back installation radar or ultrasonic wave or infrared monitoring sensor monitoring platform back personnel and the foreign matter condition, if personnel or foreign matter invade this platform upset region when operation tailboard platform is perpendicular to the horizontal upset, the utility model discloses a system avoids making the infringement to platform back personnel and foreign matter with automatic cutout platform upset motion to send alarm signal.
assignees: FUJIAN LONGMA ENVIRONMENTAL SANITATION EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Sound triggering early-warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voice triggered warning system used by the deaf, which comprises: the audio frequency amplifier, which enlarges received voice signal; the signal processing circuit, which filtering plastics the amplified signal outputted by the audio frequency amplifier; the trigger circuit, which decides whether to change output electrical-level according to the filtering plastic signal whether to exceed threshold value; the alarm device, which sends out alarm signals according to signals outputted by trigger circuit; the power, which supplies power to system. The voice triggered warning system can start to vibrate automatically when vehicles whistling, thus reminding timely the deaf to have vehicles near, not only reducing effectively the risk of traffic accidents, but also providing a convenient travel for the deaf.

title_en: Method for vehicle identification and communication between Transport Network Company (TNC) service users
abstract_en: A method for efficient vehicle identification and communication between a passenger of a Transport Network Company (TNC) and a vehicle assigned to the passenger. The system for performing the method of the present invention conveys the passenger's information on a display device on the passenger's designated vehicle to notify the passenger prior to entering the designated vehicle. The invention also assists the blind by transmitting an audio message, such as a pipe message or by giving their name. In addition, the present invention provides passengers with the ability to send emergency alerts, thereby ensuring safer riding. In addition, the present invention enables transport network companies to use display devices as an alternative platform for commercial appearances and other media advertisements.

title_en: Blind area detection method and blind area detection sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blind area detection method and a blind area detection sensor, which belong to the technical field of blind area detection and comprise the following steps: s1: collecting real-time data of vehicle blind area detection, processing the real-time data of vehicle blind area detection, and determining characteristic data of vehicle blind area detection; s2: determining an optimal blind area detection induction model; s3: based on an optimal blind area detection induction model, predicting and analyzing the detection characteristic data of the blind areas of the vehicle; s4: and (3) formulating a vehicle blind area detection induction early warning management and control scheme, and carrying out early warning management and control on the safety risk of the vehicle blind area detection induction. The invention solves the problems that the existing blind zone detection induction of the vehicle cannot be performed in real time, and timely early warning management and control cannot be provided, so that the blind zone detection induction effect is poor, and the occurrence of safety accidents cannot be effectively reduced.

title_en: Dangerous function identification method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a hazard function identification method, a hazard function identification device, a hazard function identification server, a hazard function identification computer readable storage medium and a hazard function identification computer program product. According to the method, functions which are possibly provided with potential safety hazards can be automatically screened out by means of massive knowledge of a large language model through matching inquiry of functions and vulnerabilities, the efficiency of dangerous function identification is remarkably improved through the automatic matching mode, the burden of manual examination is reduced, in addition, functions which are possibly caused by specific types of security vulnerabilities can be specifically identified through closely combining functions with specific vulnerability patterns through association analysis of component functions, blind inspection of the whole code library is avoided, and therefore functions which are actually provided with potential safety hazards can be more quickly and accurately located, in addition, irrelevant warnings or false positives can be effectively reduced, irrelevant functions are filtered out through definitely inquiring functions which are relevant to the vulnerability types, and the false alarm rate is reduced.
assignees: DU XIAOMAN TECHNOLOGY BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Method for monitoring wearing of safety helmet and safety helmet validity period indication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring the wearing of a safety helmet and a system for indicating the validity period of the safety helmet, which comprises a sensor unit for collecting the motion data of the safety helmet, and transmitting the motion data to a control unit, and analyzing the motion data by the control unit to judge whether the safety helmet is in a wearing state. The safety helmet wearing state is accurately judged and early-warned in real time through cooperation of the sensor and the control unit, the supervision blind area is eliminated, the safety distance grading accurate early-warning is realized by means of a positioning and distance algorithm, manual visual inspection is replaced, the operation safety is improved, the effective period is automatically managed by utilizing the timing and storage unit, the false judgment of manual missed detection is avoided, the protection performance is ensured, the multifunctional module performs data interaction and cooperative operation, the function fragmentation is broken, and the integrated safety supervision chain is constructed, so that the whole-flow management requirement is met.

title_en: Hydrogeology monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of hydrologic monitoring, in particular to a hydrologic geological monitoring method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of defining a hydrologic geological monitoring area, acquiring an early warning task, transmitting the early warning task to an unmanned aerial vehicle, acquiring video data of the monitoring area by utilizing video monitoring equipment which is pre-integrated in the unmanned aerial vehicle, judging whether trapped personnel exist in the monitoring area, if so, recording the real-time position of the trapped personnel, establishing a shouting tracking mechanism, starting a pre-integrated shouting device in the unmanned aerial vehicle, and playing evacuation voice; and activating the shouting tracking mechanism, selecting a safety area from the monitoring area, and generating emergency guiding information. According to the invention, by determining feedback information, rescue activities can be coordinated, blind search and rescue are avoided, distribution of trapped personnel is accurately mastered, a rescue scheme is optimized, invalid search can be reduced, a rescue path is optimized by generating rescue guidance, and early warning efficiency of hydrogeology monitoring is greatly improved.

title_en: fire alarm apparatus for hearing impaired person
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire alarm device. The fire alarm device according to the present invention comprises: an accommodation case accommodating a circuit board; a detachable case coupled with the accommodation case; a fixing case having one side formed to be detachable from the detachable case and other side formed to be fixable to a predetermined surface; a fire detection unit installed in the accommodation case and detecting a fire; a fire alarm output unit installed in the accommodation case and outputting an alarm signal through an LED module; and a control unit installed in the accommodation case and controlling operations of the fire detection unit and the fire alarm output unit. The control unit controls the output of the fire alarm output unit according to the fire detection by the fire detection unit. Accordingly, unexpected accidents caused by the fire to the hearing impaired can be prevented.

title_en: Rescue messaging system
abstract_en: Disclosed is a telephone accessible system that stores one or more messages for a subscriber. The subscriber is given a card with their subscriber number and an access code. In one embodiment, a first responder or other user needing to access the recorded messages, finds the card, calls the system and enters the subscriber number and access code to retrieve one or more of the messages. In one embodiment, the messages are digital audio recordings that contain medical information useful to a first responder before treating the subscriber. The messages can only be changed upon submission of a password that is unique to the subscriber. In one embodiment, the first responder can record an alert message that is transmitted to individuals or entities previously designed by a subscriber to receive an alert message.

title_en: Transformer station's hidden region early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of transformer station hidden region early warning system, early warning system comprise be arranged on hidden region monitoring unit and Control Room in Supervisory Unit, described Supervisory Unit and monitoring unit pass through network service, described monitoring unit comprises video camera, loudspeaker and light compensating lamp, and described Supervisory Unit comprises display and signal input device.The utility model has the advantage of and staff can be facilitated to monitor hidden region in real time, greatly reduce the labour intensity maked an inspection tour in hidden region of personnel and task difficulty, solve the original sled cover plate of tradition, bore the hidden danger that cable duct test mode has inspection dead angle, allow the inspection work that person on duty breaks away from frequently, repeats, save manpower, allow person on duty have the energy input people of needs to go the safety management task performed more, by issuing the detecting/warning of hidden region foreign body intrusion, prompting related personnel check targetedly, increases work efficiency.

title_en: Fire early warning device based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for a conflagration precaution device technical field provides a conflagration precaution device based on thing networking, including device shell and with wall fixed connection's mount pad, the mounting groove has been seted up to the inside of mount pad, the transmission chamber has been seted up to the inside of device shell. title_en: Sea condition early warning system of deep sea fan
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of offshore wind turbine safety equipment, and discloses a sea condition early warning system of a deep-sea wind turbine, which comprises a control device, an image acquisition device, a distance measurement device and an alarm device which are arranged on a supporting body, wherein the image acquisition device, the distance measurement device and the alarm device are all in communication connection with the control device, and the sea condition early warning system also comprises a power supply device which is electrically connected with the control device, the image acquisition device, the distance measurement device and the alarm device, wherein the control device is used for controlling the image acquisition device to acquire field images in real time to realize monitoring, and the control device is used for controlling the alarm device to alarm when the distance of an external object detected by the distance measurement device is smaller than a distance threshold value. The sea condition early warning system of the deep-open sea fan can monitor the running condition of the offshore wind farm in real time, monitor, early warn and drive foreign objects entering the offshore wind farm field and the submarine cable sea area, and improve the safety and reliability of the offshore wind farm.
assignees: YUNDA ENERGY TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Edge calculation optimization and compression algorithm based on distributed optical fiber sensing data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an edge calculation optimization and compression algorithm based on distributed optical fiber sensing data, according to the scheme, the distributed optical fiber network is buried in a layered mode along the axis of the embankment, continuous monitoring of the full section of the embankment is achieved, and the blind area of the traditional point type sensor is eliminated. And analyzing the strain data and the temperature data by utilizing Brillouin scattering and Raman scattering, analyzing time sequence characteristics by utilizing an LSTM neural network, and identifying piping and crack hidden danger. And (5) building a multiple regression model by fusing external environment parameters such as water level, rainfall and the like, and evaluating the seepage risk level. And combining BIM three-dimensional modeling and a seepage simulation algorithm, accurately positioning hidden danger and visualizing the spatial distribution of hidden danger. Based on edge calculation optimization, the data compression technology is adopted to reduce transmission requirements, a self-repairing material injection and high-pressure plugging scheme is triggered through a grading early warning system, closed-loop management from monitoring to repairing is formed, real-time performance and accuracy of hidden danger identification are improved, and efficient and reliable monitoring support is provided for the embankment engineering.
assignees: JIANGXI PROVINCE WATER CONSERVANCY ACADEMY JIANGXI PROVINCE DAM SAFETY MAN CENTER JIANGXI WATER RESO;UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Ship collision early warning method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a ship collision early warning method, a device and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of ship early warning, wherein the method comprises the steps of importing dynamic information of moving targets around a ship, acquiring an original ship environment image from a plurality of paths of video sensors arranged on the periphery of the ship, and acquiring original distance data from a laser radar; respectively carrying out fusion analysis on each original ship environment image and each original distance data to obtain a target panoramic video and preprocessed distance data; and performing collision analysis on the target panoramic video, the preprocessed distance data and the dynamic information to obtain collision data. The invention greatly improves the sensing, detecting and collision preventing early warning capabilities of the periphery of the ship, realizes full-view coverage, solves the problem of monitoring blind areas, simultaneously realizes the fusion of multi-source data, improves the target recognition precision, reduces the probability of misjudgment and missed judgment, and realizes the intellectualization of collision early warning.

title_en: Intelligent sensing and early warning method and system for security of high-speed rail operating environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-speed rail running environment safety intelligent perception early warning method and system, which are used for outputting kilometer-level and hour-level refined wind and rain prediction results based on a pre-trained strong wind prediction model and a precipitation prediction model after carrying out space-time alignment on wind speed and wind direction and precipitation data issued by a meteorological part and data acquired by equipment at a preset position of a railway perimeter based on reverse distance weight interpolation, and carrying out joint calibration on millimeter wave radar, laser radar and high-definition video under a unified world coordinate system, and detecting personnel and foreign matters by a target detection model so as to realize a second-level intrusion behavior recognition result. By means of remote sensing and aircraft inspection, hidden danger objects and the efficient identification of external environment anomalies and infrastructure anomalies are achieved. And combining the multi-element detection results related to the risks, and carrying out high-efficiency automatic and accurate analysis and early warning according to a preset grading early warning rule, so that the running risk of the high-speed rail is obviously reduced.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;Beijing jingwei information technology co ltd

title_en: Smart hub system for prevention of industrial accidents for the hearing impaired and control method thereof
title_ko: 청각 장애인의 산업재해 예방을 위한 스마트 허브 시스템 및 이의 동작방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart hub system for preventing industrial accidents of the hearing impaired and an operating method thereof. In addition, the present invention comprises: a collection unit for collecting sound generated in an industrial site to which the hearing impaired belong and an image obtained by photographing the industrial site; an analysis unit for applying the collected sound and image to an artificial intelligence model to analyze whether a dangerous situation causing a risk to the hearing impaired occurs; and a notification unit for transmitting a warning notification for notifying the dangerous situation to a notification terminal carried by the hearing impaired according to the analysis result of the analysis unit, thereby more effectively preventing safety accidents and industrial accidents that may occur to the hearing impaired.

title_en: Automobile blind area monitoring prompting method, mobile terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for monitoring and prompting a blind area of an automobile, a mobile terminal and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving detection data; judging whether the detection data meet a prompt alarm condition; when the detection data are judged to meet the prompt alarm condition, carrying out hidden danger analysis on the detection data to obtain the hidden danger type; when the hidden danger type is a blind area non-visual hidden danger, acquiring alarm parameters of hidden danger vehicles in detection data; carrying out blind area prompting alarm on the driver according to the alarm parameters; and when the hidden danger type is the visible hidden danger of the rearview mirror, sending an observation prompt to prompt a driver to check the rearview mirror. According to the blind area warning method and device, the design of obtaining the warning parameters guarantees the proceeding of follow-up blind area warning, and the design of blind area warning is carried out on the drivers, so that the information of hidden-trouble vehicles in the blind areas is effectively prompted to remind the drivers to avoid, and safety accidents caused by untimely avoidance among the vehicles due to the fact that the drivers cannot correctly calculate the distance are prevented.

title_en: Non-blind area remote warning radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a non-blind area remote warning radar, which comprises a main body, a warning device and a rotary lifting device, wherein the inside of the warning device is fixedly connected with a warning lamp, the bottom of the warning lamp is fixedly connected with a horn, the bottom of the horn is fixedly connected with a transducer, the inside of the transducer is fixedly connected with a ceramic crystal, the bottom of the ceramic crystal is fixedly connected with a power control box, the power control box converts electric energy into sound through the transducer, the sound is increased through the horn, finally, the warning lamp sounds to remind relevant personnel of emergency, the transducer is the most mature and reliable device which realizes mutual conversion between electric energy and sound energy through piezoelectric effect, the electro-acoustic conversion efficiency of the transducer is high, the service life is long, the economic benefit is improved, a first motor rotates a radar antenna through a rotating shaft to realize a receiving signal without dead angle in all aspects of three hundred sixty degrees, the device is enabled to be more alert, is suitable for the use of radar, and has wide development prospect in the future.

title_en: Road blind area vehicle anti-collision early warning system based on vehicle-road cooperation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a road blind area vehicle anticollision early warning system based on vehicle and road is in coordination, including vehicle identification unit, vehicle identification unit includes host system, communication module and a plurality of detection module, and is a plurality of detection module is netted distribution, and covers the intersection section, and is a plurality of detection module passes through communication module and host system communication connection respectively, and host system is used for judging road conditions information according to a plurality of detection module detected signal data, and host system passes through communication module and connects the warning unit, it includes vehicle and road communication treater, wireless transceiver and reputation reminding device to remind the unit. The utility model discloses be provided with and be used for responding to the car to judge road conditions information's vehicle identification unit and with the warning unit of vehicle identification unit linkage, utilize the car route in coordination with the technique and remind driver the place ahead driving to have the potential safety hazard, improved the security of driving a vehicle.

title_en: Railway network system for monitoring natural disasters and foreign invasion
abstract_en: The invention provides a railway network system for monitoring natural disasters and foreign invasion. The network system comprises a data processing center system, a terminal system and a base station, wherein the base station acquires original data of natural disasters and original data of foreign invasion, and uploads the collected data of the acquired data to the data processing center system; the data processing center system collects, processes, judges and stores the data of natural disasters and the data of foreign invasion, and generates corresponding disaster warnings and prewarning information according to a preset operating process; the terminal system is used for displaying and querying the disaster warnings and prewarning information generated by the data processing center system; the base station, the data processing center system and the terminal system respectively establish an independent local area network in dual network redundancy; the terminal system and the data processing center system adopt a point-to-point structure and a dual-network structure; the base station and the data processing center system adopt a dual-network structure and a point-to-multipoint Ethernet converging structure of MSTP.

title_en: Safety early warning method and device, computing equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of computers, and provides a safety early warning method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a first target image frame acquired by a predetermined first monitoring device; analyzing the image information by using a pre-trained deep learning model to obtain first identity information of the pedestrian to be identified; if the pedestrian to be identified is determined to be the target pedestrian based on the first identity information, acquiring second target image frames acquired by all second monitoring equipment; predicting a target route of the target pedestrian based on the second target image frame; and if the target route is determined to have the monitoring blind area, sending a safety early warning prompt to a predetermined terminal. The pedestrian to be identified is determined to be the target pedestrian, the target route of the target pedestrian is predicted according to the second image frames collected by all the second monitoring devices, and the safety early warning prompt is sent to the predetermined terminal under the condition that the target route is determined to have the monitoring blind area, so that the potential safety hazard caused by the monitoring blind area can be avoided.

title_en: Control method for automatic whistle of automobile steering and automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method for automatic whistle of automobile steering, which is used for judging whether whistle reminding is needed or not in real time based on the state of a vehicle after the vehicle starts running and carrying out whistle control based on a judgment result. The invention has the advantages that: the automatic warning device has the advantages that the warning device can automatically give out a warning of whistling under a turning state, ensures the warning of safe whistling under the turning, simultaneously identifies the environment in a mode of image identification, and can automatically whistle to give out the warning under the environment such as blind areas, vision shielding and the like, so that meeting safety accidents caused by the vision shielding are avoided.

title_en: Mine safety alarm method, device, system, equipment and medium based on multi-source heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The application provides a mine safety warning method, a device, a system, equipment and a medium based on multi-source heterogeneous data, which can acquire the multi-source heterogeneous data of a mine; extracting a plurality of abnormal data from the multi-source heterogeneous data, matching a plurality of potential safety hazard types from a preset potential safety hazard list according to the change amplitude of the plurality of abnormal data, calling a K-means algorithm to perform clustering processing on the multi-source heterogeneous data to obtain a plurality of heterogeneous categories, determining a target category corresponding to each potential safety hazard type from the plurality of heterogeneous categories, calling a preset BP early warning model to determine a risk grade value corresponding to each potential safety hazard type according to the data contained in the target category, and triggering safety warning processing according to the risk grade value. According to the application, multiple hidden dangers are evaluated simultaneously by combining multiple data, so that the monitoring range can be increased, the monitoring blind area and omission are reduced, the safety risk can be found early, the alarm delay is shortened, and the construction safety is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN TIANJING YUHONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle-mounted panoramic camera system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a vehicle mounted panoramic camera system, which relates to the field of vehicle imaging technology. The system includes a camera module, an image preprocessing module, an image stitching module, an intelligent analysis module, an early warning module, a display module, a power management module, a data storage module, a remote interaction module, and a fault self checking module. The camera module also integrates a night vision enhancement component and an angle adaptive adjustment mechanism. The early warning module also includes sound warning, visual warning, and tactile warning units. The present invention achieves 360 degree full coverage through multiple distributed cameras. Combined with night vision enhancement and angle adaptive adjustment, it completely eliminates blind spots in the field of view and can stably collect high-quality images in low light and complex road conditions. After pre-processing and optimizing the stitching algorithm, the panoramic image color is consistent, without misalignment or stuttering, and the stitching delay is low, Strong environmental adaptability, capable of stable output of high-quality images under different lighting and temperature conditions, and a multimodal grading warning system that can alert drivers in advance to avoid danger.

title_en: Intelligent inspection well cover device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligence inspection shaft lid device, relates to the inspection shaft lid field, including the well lid apron that is equipped with warning light and monitoring facilities. The monitoring device is provided with a battery, a buzzer, a first ultrasonic water level sensor, a second ultrasonic water level sensor, a water immersion sensor and a main control module. When the underground water level is within the range of the first ultrasonic water level sensor, the first ultrasonic water level sensor triggers monitoring, when the underground water level rises to the first ultrasonic water level sensor monitoring blind area, the second ultrasonic water level sensor triggers monitoring, and when the underground water level continues to rise to the second ultrasonic water level sensor monitoring blind area, the water immersion sensor triggers monitoring. When the water level is monitored to reach or be higher than the early warning water level, the warning lamp emits light, and the buzzer emits warning sound. The utility model discloses a three kinds of sensors can avoid only using an ultrasonic wave level sensor to have the problem of monitoring blind area, and warning light and warning sound enable the maintainer to find the inspection shaft lid device of super early warning water level sooner to and remind the personnel that are close to notice safety.

title_en: Early warning base station based on intelligent monitoring of geological disaster area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an early warning basic station based on geological disasters face territory intelligent monitoring, including face territory monitoring recognizer, face territory monitoring recognizer both sides are fixed with the mounting bracket jointly, and the upper end of mounting bracket is fixed with the support frame jointly, and the other end of support frame is fixed with the carriage, and the inboard symmetrical of two carriages slides and inserts and be equipped with the guide bar, is connected with solar panel and apron between the adjacent guide bar respectively, and the one end that the guide bar was kept away from to solar panel and apron articulates there is the axis of rotation. The geological disaster early warning basic station that this scheme provided is under mutually supporting of each part, through the setting of carriage, guide bar, axis of rotation, threaded sleeve and threaded rod for when basic station is in bad weather, mutually supporting of personnel's accessible motor and threaded rod, threaded sleeve, carriage makes solar panel and apron be close to each other, and the apron covers on the solar panel surface promptly, can effectively avoid solar panel impaired phenomenon in bad weather from this.

title_en: Safety control early warning device for construction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a safety control early warning device for construction, including the guardrail board, the support of preventing wind that can dismantle and pack up is installed to the lower extreme of guardrail board, turns right from a left side at the middle part of guardrail board and evenly is provided with the warning sign that can sway, and the upper end embedding of guardrail board has alarm module, and both ends are provided with docking mechanism about the guardrail board. title_en: Prompting device applied to road visual field blind area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a prompting device applied to a road visual field blind area, which relates to the technical field of traffic safety and comprises a first monitoring unit arranged on a first road section and a second monitoring unit arranged on a second road section, wherein the second monitoring unit is respectively used for monitoring moving targets on the first road section and the second road section; both are infrared shielding induction devices; the system also comprises a prompt module which is used for sending prompt information in preset prompt time; in the prompting module, a first prompting unit and a second prompting module are respectively arranged at the junction of a road intersection and a first road section and a second road section and are respectively used for sending prompting information to a moving target on the first road section or the second road section. The infrared shielding induction equipment can be used for rapidly identifying people or vehicles passing through and shielded by the department, then sending signals to the controller, and the control module invokes the prompting module to send prompting information so as to achieve the effect of causing the driver to be alert to drive and meet the vehicles, and the system is free from networking, quick in response, simple in logic and easy to maintain.

title_en: Intelligent earthquake early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent earthquake early warning device, which sends early warning to an installation place after receiving earthquake information sent by an earthquake table network or an earthquake early warning center (for an area where the earthquake early warning center is built), and relates to the field of earthquake early warning. The system is characterized by comprising a signal receiving module, a satellite positioning module, a seismic data analysis module, an early warning signal output module, a system setting module and a dual-mode power supply module. The intelligent earthquake early warning device solves the defects that the coverage area of an earthquake early warning system is limited, an early warning blind area exists, terminal equipment can work only after the earthquake early warning information sent by an earthquake early warning center is passively received in the existing earthquake early warning mode through a ready-to-install and ready-to-use installation mode and the capability of independent analysis and operation of the earthquake information, thereby realizing full-coverage non-blind area early warning and being beneficial to popularization and application of earthquake early warning service in all areas.

title_en: Laser early warning collision prevention control method for turning blind area of heavy truck
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser early warning collision prevention control method for a turning blind area of a heavy truck, which comprises the steps of avoiding accidents in an active early warning mode, firstly, obtaining a turning angle through a steering wheel angle sensor when a vehicle turns, calculating a dangerous area range by an ECU (electronic control unit) of the whole vehicle, dynamically illuminating the boundary of the dangerous area on the ground through a laser projector, and reminding surrounding pedestrians or vehicles to avoid; simultaneously starting a laser detector of the vehicle sideways, and when a person enters a dangerous area, the alarm can send alarm signals to a driver and the pedestrian at the same time so as to take emergency measures; the electronic camera outside the car body and the electronic display screen inside the car body can enable a driver to observe the abnormal position of the blind area without moving, so that potential safety hazards are eliminated in time, and the safety of the heavy truck is improved.

title_en: Distributed healthcare communication system
abstract_en: A graphical audio station of a nurse call system is operable to permit a user to perform one or more of the following functions: establish a two-way voice communication link with another computer device in another patient and/or with a another computer device located in another staff work area and/or with a wireless communication device carried by caregiver and/or with a telephone of the healthcare facility; broadcast a voice page to a group of other selected computer devices; compose and send a text message to a portable device that is carried by a caregiver and that has wireless communication capability; browse web pages and/or view multimedia content, such as videos, hosted on servers of the healthcare facility and/or that are accessible via the Internet; view and/or acknowledge and/or answer and/or cancel alerts or nurse calls originating in a plurality of patient rooms.

title_en: Dynamic public warning system for in-vehicle eNodeB
abstract_en: A method is disclosed, comprising: sending position information reflecting a current position of a base station to a coordinating server; receiving a warning request message from an operator core network containing an emergency area; calculating a geographic area corresponding to an emergency tracking area by translating the emergency area from a set of base stations to the geographic area; determining whether the base station may be outside of a threshold distance from the geographic boundary of the emergency tracking area; and sending the warning request message when the base station may be within the threshold distance from the geographic boundary of the emergency tracking area.

title_en: A kind of eliminating driving blind area early warning system based on thermal infrared imaging
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to field of road traffic safety, is related to a kind of eliminating driving blind area early warning system based on thermal infrared imaging, including being arranged on the pillar of vehicle blind zone, for the infrared detector of the infra-red radiation of goal seeking object；The infra-red radiation for the target object explored by infrared detector generates the thermal imaging sensor of realtime graphic；The realtime graphic that thermal imaging sensor generates is converted into the video frequency collection card of digital information；The data processing equipment for the digital information that analysis video frequency collection card is converted into, alarm system is connected on data processing equipment, the data that data processing equipment drives hidden danger to existing carry out pre-alarm by alarm system to driver, the system is in automobile a certain range to the people of motor vehicle environment, vehicle, road carries out imaging analysis, degree of danger is analyzed, accident early warning is carried out to driver in advance, driver is made to judge and take as early as possible avoiding measures, therefore the system can reduce the traffic accident caused by driving vision blind area.

title_en: Personnel anti-collision automatic early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a personal anti-collision automatic early warning device, which relates to the technical field of railway construction and comprises a road maintenance machine body, wherein four hollow assembly seats are uniformly arranged on the outer side of the road maintenance machine body, support shafts are respectively fixed on the inner side of one side, far away from the road maintenance machine body, of each hollow assembly seat, a first sleeve and a second sleeve are respectively connected with the outer sides of the upper end and the lower end of the support shafts in a rotating mode, carrying supports are respectively fixed on the outer sides of the upper end and the lower end of the first sleeve, carrying supports are respectively fixed on the outer sides of the lower end of the second sleeve, a laser ranging module is respectively fixed on one end, far away from the support shafts, of each carrying support frame, and an audible-visual alarm is respectively arranged on the outer sides of each hollow assembly seat. According to the personnel anti-collision automatic early warning device provided by the utility model, through the integral structure cooperation design, the comprehensive monitoring of the visual field blind area on the outer side of the road maintenance machine body is realized, the early warning is effectively carried out on the personnel close to the road maintenance machine body in any visual field blind area, and the safety performance is further improved, so that the potential safety hazard is reduced.

title_en: Control method and system for sensing blind area of automobile tire hub
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a control system for sensing a blind area of an automobile tire hub, which belong to the technical field of automobiles and comprise the following steps: step 1, dividing a vehicle running state, and presetting a wheel hub warning state according to the degree of association between the wheel hub damage probability and the vehicle running state; step 2, mounting the ultrasonic radar sensors at the positions of the hubs, mounting the ultrasonic radar sensors at intervals of ninety degrees from a preset position, namely mounting four ultrasonic radar sensors on one hub in total, and detecting the approach distance of the foreign matters through the ultrasonic radar sensors; and 3, presetting a response behavior library, and matching response behaviors in the response behavior library according to the detection result. The invention solves the problem that a user cannot distinguish the damage risk of the hub caused by the perception scene, reduces the potential safety hazard of hub damage, and greatly optimizes the user experience.

title_en: Notification device for disaster situation for the hearing impaired
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a notification device for each disaster situation for the hearing impaired. The notification device includes: a sensor which is mounted on an indoor fire hydrant and transmits a signal; a wearable band which is worn on a wrist of the hearing impaired and receives signals from the sensor to recognize disaster situations. The present invention installs a vibration detection sensor on the indoor fire hydrant, so that when a disaster such as an earthquake occurs, a wearable band worn on the wrist of the hearing impaired can quickly recognize the disaster and evacuate, thereby preventing safety accidents in advance.
assignees: UNIV INJE IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Automatic loudspeaker control device for blind persons or vehicles
abstract_en: An automatic control device on a warning loudspeaker of a blind person or a vehicle is used for automatically giving out a warning sound and caution light during walking of the blind person or running of the vehicle, so as to remind a user and others. The automatic loudspeaker control device for blind persons or vehicles does not need to control the loudspeaker to sound along with scenes for a long term, instead, the automatic control device perceiving passerby or running vehicles automatically blow horns; and when the automatic control device approaches the passerby or the running vehicle, analog sounds given by other running motor vehicles are used for warning at first, or a specific sound is used to remind the approached passerby of the types of the approaching vehicles.

title_en: Electronic sound and light alarm bell for bicycle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bicycle electron reputation warning bell has the shell of translucent form on this warning bell, installs one on the lug of its one end and presses pronunciation switch, and this switch is except that easy user's touching is pressed to send out the sound that imitates traditional formula bell work by the pronunciation export of one end, also can be by the light of sending the warning on the shell simultaneously. Therefore, the blind spot on the vision of the rider can be removed, and a safer and more modern warning bell is provided.

title_en: Coal rock instability destruction precursor information identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for judging the information of a coal rock instability destruction precursor, which comprises the following steps: carrying out real-time acoustic emission monitoring on the loaded coal rock mass, and acquiring the spatial coordinates and the seismic time of an acoustic emission event corresponding to the loaded coal rock mass to obtain an acoustic emission event sequence; establishing a single-key group structure of an acoustic emission event sequence; calculating a unit vector of each single key, translating the starting point of each unit vector to the sphere center of the unit sphere, and converting the direction characteristics of each single key into discrete points on the spherical surface of the unit sphere for representation; obtaining the distribution characteristics of discrete points on the spherical surface by adopting a spherical crown surface covering method, and obtaining the fractal dimension of the distribution characteristics in the single bond direction; and acquiring the precursor information of coal rock instability damage by analyzing the change rule of the fractal dimension of the single-bond direction distribution characteristics, and realizing the early warning of coal rock instability damage. The method for judging and identifying the coal rock instability damage precursor information is convenient to solve and reliable in result.
assignees: UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Medical alert and monitoring for the hearing impaired
abstract_en: An illustrative method includes receiving, by a processor of a computing device, a request to initiate a call from a portable electronic device. The call is a communication across a communication network. The method also includes initiating, by the processor of the computing device, the call. The call connects the portable electronic device to an emergency response service. The call also utilizes a relay service.

title_en: Alarm system for the deaf
abstract_en: The present invention provides an alarm system for the deaf. The disclosed alarm system according to an embodiment of the invention comprises: a plurality of first sensors which are distributed in a plurality of spaces and sense signal patterns generated in the spaces; an integrated processor which receives and stores specified signal patterns or standardized signal patterns in advance; and a portable terminal which provides users with an alarm signal by converting the signal patterns received from the integrated processor or from the spaces into the alarm signal. In the integrated processor, if the signal patterns sensed from a plurality of first sensors are identical to the stored signal patterns, the integrated processor transmits the signal patterns sensed from the first sensors.
abstract_ko: 청각장애인 등을 위한 알림 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 알림 시스템은, 복수개의 공간들에 각각 설치되고, 상기 복수개의 공간들에서 발생하는 신호 패턴들을 센싱하는 복수개의 제1센서들; 상기 복수개의 공간들에서 발생할 가능성이 있는 사용자에게 특화된 신호 패턴들 또는 규격화된 신호 패턴들을 사전에 입력받아 저장하고, 상기 복수개의 제1센서들이 센싱한 신호 패턴들이 상기 저장된 신호 패턴들과 일치하는 경우 상기 복수개의 제1센서들이 센싱한 신호 패턴들을 송신하는 통합 처리기; 및 상기 통합 처리기로부터 수신된 신호 패턴들을 알림 신호로 변환하여 사용자에게 제공하거나, 또는 상기 복수개의 공간들에서 발생하는 신호 패턴들을 수신하여 알림 신호로 변환하여 사용자에게 제공하는 휴대용 단말기를 구비한다.

title_en: Monitoring system and method for right turn stop of intersection of large-sized vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for monitoring and controlling right turn stop of a large-scale vehicle intersection, comprising the following steps: collecting data required by right-turning parking of a large-sized vehicle intersection, wherein the data comprise the width of a right-turning lane, the distance between a laser radar and a stop line of the right-turning lane, the width of the right-turning lane, geometric characteristic data of vehicles in the right-turning lane, video data of vehicles in the right-turning lane, geometric characteristic data of vehicles in a right-turning area of the intersection and pedestrian and non-motor vehicle data in a right-turning blind area of the intersection, which are collected by a video device, and initializing a large-sized vehicle license plate set; the working states of the electronic police, the stroboscopic lamp and the voice prompt equipment are controlled according to the analysis result by data analysis; and analyzing video data acquired by the electronic police and sending the video data to the traffic command center. According to the invention, through arranging perfect detection, control, warning, propaganda and other equipment on the road side, the right turn non-stop behavior of the large-sized vehicle intersection is effectively monitored, so that the accident injury risk to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles is reduced.

title_en: Complex high-order landslide risk dynamic identification system based on multisource InSAR cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, in particular to a complex high-level landslide risk dynamic identification system based on multi-source InSAR cooperation, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data analysis module and a data analysis module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for constructing normalized feature vectors representing states of all monitoring nodes; the method comprises the steps of determining a state prediction module, a risk assessment module and a hierarchical early warning module, wherein the state prediction module is used for quantifying the physical influence degree among heterogeneous nodes, the state prediction module is used for iteratively updating the hidden state of each heterogeneous node by adopting a space-time diagram neural network model and translating the hidden state into incremental displacement, the risk assessment module is used for calculating the risk precursor index of each heterogeneous node deviating from a normal evolution mode based on the hidden state and judging and issuing hierarchical early warning according to a preset threshold system, and the method effectively relieves the overfitting problem easily occurring when the data of a pure data driving model is sparse and remarkably improves the generalization capability and the physical interpretability of a prediction result.

title_en: System and method for universal emergency notification and management
abstract_en: Systems and methods for triggering emergency mass notifications include an EMNS activation service, a plurality of activation premises devices, a plurality of EMNS provider services, and a plurality of event personnel devices. The EMNS activation service includes a universal translator module that receives an event trigger signal relating to an emergency event from one of the activation premises devices. The universal translator module translates the event trigger signal to event-specific EMNS protocols of the EMNS providers. The EMNS activation service communicates the event-specific EMNS protocols to the EMNS providers, and communicates event data to event personnel devices based on a list of event personnel devices to be notified of an emergency event. An activation premises device includes a housing event with trigger controls for creating the event trigger signal, wherein these event trigger controls are inaccessible to users in the absence of an authorized access or an emergency access.

title_en: Floods alarm system in pit based on image and entry driving machine monitoring facilities
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a floods alarm system in pit based on image and entry driving machine monitoring facilities. Install the camera on face hydraulic bracket is tunneled in the pit in the colliery, the camera connection diagram like with entry driving machine monitoring facilities and video server, image and entry driving machine monitoring facilities simultaneous acquisition entry driving machine data, image and entry driving machine monitoring facilities monitoring live video and entry driving machine data send floods warning data to monitor terminal according to monitoring results, NULL personnel accessible monitor terminal looks over the real -time and historical video in scene to make emergency treatment, this alarm system divides the characteristic characteristics of having considered colliery headwork face floods, implements simply, in time takes corresponding measure automatically, but the very first time accurately report to the police to water inrush in mine, do not strive for the valuable relief of disaster and the time of fleing for taking place other on -the -spot regional personnels in the pit.
assignees: CHINA UNIV OF MINING AND TECH (BEIJING)

title_en: Warning device for automobile fault
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a warning device for automobile faults, which comprises a base, a metal soft rod, a sleeve and a warning pattern ground projection device, wherein the metal soft rod is fixedly arranged on the upper side of the base, the sleeve is fixedly arranged at the outer end of the metal soft rod, the warning pattern ground projection device is clamped in the sleeve, the outer end of the sleeve is screwed with a positioning ring, and the lower part of the base is clamped with a sucker; the sucking disc adsorbs at the roof, as the impetus of device, the utility model discloses an overcome current triangle warning sign and need carry one section distance and carry out the manual work and place, current triangle warning sign is not obvious to some special road conditions and natural factor effect, if at night, warning sign warning effect is not enough, or has the place of blind area at last road sharp bend etc. more strengthened the potential safety hazard, the utility model discloses these special circumstances of overcoming that can be fine to this equal effect that reaches warning back car.

title_en: Non-woven fabric coiled material equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a non-woven fabrics coiled material technical field just discloses a non-woven fabrics coiled material equipment, roll up curtain, upper rail, self tapping screw, locating piece, handle and drive assembly including lower rail, tripe, the bottom of tripe book curtain is connected with the top of lower rail, and the top of tripe book curtain is connected with the bottom of upper rail, and the top of upper rail is connected with the bottom of locating piece, and the inner wall of locating piece and self tapping screw's surface connection, the top of handle and drive assembly's end-to-end connection, drive assembly includes gear one, bearing frame, joint pole, gear two and stay cord. The utility model provides a because the used stay cord of adjustment is hung in the outside, very easily hung by the foreign object and bumped, external stay cord twines very easily moreover and ties a knot to hardly untie, bring a lot of inconveniences for the user, brought the potential safety hazard for the child in the room simultaneously, even hung safety warning on the stay cord and marked, the problem that also can not fundamentally solve.
assignees: ANHUI AOSEN SPUNLACED NONWOVEN CO LTD

title_en: A intrusion alert device for building is intelligent
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a building intelligent technology field discloses an intrusion alarm device for building is intelligent, including the protecting crust, the inboard of protecting crust is provided with the installation shell, the below of installation shell is provided with toughened glass, the top of protecting crust and installation shell is provided with the roof, one side of protecting crust is provided with the warning light, the opposite side of protecting crust is provided with bee calling organ, the inside of installation shell is provided with the baffle, the one end of baffle below is provided with infrared alarm, the other end of baffle below is provided with the connecting rod. The utility model discloses an other end in the baffle below is provided with connecting rod and surveillance camera head, and the top one end of baffle is provided with the motor, and the starter motor of being convenient for drives the surveillance camera head and rotates, realizes 360 degrees no dead angles control in the building, has improved the flexibility to the first turned angle of surveillance camera, has solved the problem that the blind area of reporting to the police appears easily in ordinary alarm device effectively.
assignees: SHENZHEN SANCOM ELECTONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an alarm device, relates to the technical field of communication, and is used for monitoring and reminding that a blind sidewalk is occupied. The warning device comprises a processing unit, a shooting unit, a communication unit and a warning unit; the processing unit is respectively connected with the shooting unit, the communication unit and the alarm unit; the shooting unit is used for collecting video data in a preset area; the preset area comprises a blind road; the communication unit is used for sending video data to the server and receiving an alarm instruction sent by the server; and the alarm unit is used for outputting an alarm signal.
assignees: China Unicom;CHINA INF TECHNOLOGY DESIGNING CONSULTING INST CO LTD

title_en: Loess landslide monitoring and early warning system and method based on wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a loess landslide monitoring and early warning system and method based on a wireless sensor network, and belongs to the technical field of landslide disaster monitoring and early warning. The system comprises a wireless sensor monitoring network layer, a GPRS gateway and a remote monitoring center. According to the method, the environment parameters are corrected by using a least square fitting method, so that the RSSI ranging precision is improved, the wireless sensor is accurately embedded, the non-blind-area full-coverage monitoring of mountain signals is realized, and the loess landslide disaster is accurately and efficiently positioned and monitored and early warned in real time.

title_en: Refuge early warning system in urban area
abstract_en: The invention provides a refuge early warning system in an urban area, which belongs to the technical field of disaster protection and comprises: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring population density data, refuge data, building data and earthquake magnitude distribution data; the building population number calculating module is used for calculating the population number of each building; the first evaluation result generation module is used for evaluating the refuge selection of refugees within the evacuation radius to generate a first evaluation result; the second evaluation result generation module is used for calculating the number of collapsed buildings and the number of refugees based on the refuge data, the building data and the earthquake magnitude distribution data, evaluating the accessibility of the refuge and the refuge capacity risk based on a GIS map and generating a second evaluation result; and the early warning module is used for sending the evaluation result to the mobile phone for early warning. The invention has the advantages that: the assessment and early warning of the capacity risk and accessibility of the refuge are realized, and the casualty number is further reduced.

title_en: Audio visual alarm
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an audio-visual alarm device comprises: a base including an internal receiving part opened upwards and an accommodating part formed to be recessed downward on the bottom of the receiving part; a sound generation means disposed in the accommodated part of the base; a light emitting means disposed in the receiving part of the base; a reflective plate disposed on the lower surface of the base; a light-transmitting cover coupled to the lower surface of the base in a form of surrounding the reflective plate; and a mounting unit coupled to the base in a form of covering the receiving part of the base to be mounted on a ceiling or wall. According to the present invention, in the event of an emergency such as fire, earthquake, or power outage, the audio-visual alarm device enables the visually impaired as well as normal persons to safely evacuate by a specific sound alarm. In addition, the audio-visual alarm device maximizes an identification effect for the visually impaired as well as normal persons by a flashing signal of a specific pattern.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 상방 개구(開口)된 내부 수용부 및 상기 수용부 바닥에 하방 요입되게 형성되는 수납부를 갖는 베이스; 상기 베이스의 수납부에 배치되는 음향발생수단; 상기 베이스의 수용부에 배치되는 발광수단; 상기 베이스의 하부면에 배치되는 반사플레이트; 상기 반사플레이트를 감싸는 형태로 상기 베이스의 하부면에 결합되는 투광성(透光性) 커버; 및 상기 베이스의 수용부를 덮는 형태로 상기 베이스에 결합되어 천장이나 벽체에 장착되는 마운팅유닛;으로 이루어지도록 구현함으로써, 화재, 지진 및 정전 등의 비상 시 특정 음향의 경보음을 통해 일반인은 물론 시각 장애인으로 하여금 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 유도하고, 또 특정 패턴의 점멸 신호를 통해 일반인은 물론 청각 장애인으로 하여금 식별효과를 극대화할 수 있도록 한 시청각 경보기에 관한 것이다.

title_ko: 지속성 피크전류 감시제어 기능을 구비한 수배전반 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 과전류 지속으로 인해 발열사고를 유발하는 불평형 지속성 피크전류에 의한 편중 위험 상태를 효과적으로 파악하고, 불평형 부하 재분배와 사고 예방조치를 취할 수 있도록 하는 수배전반 시스템을 제공하는 것으로, 전력부하에 입력되는 전원 개폐부(110)를 구비한 수배전반 시스템(100)에 있어서, 수배전반 시스템은 제어부(101)와, 부하전류를 검출하는 전류검출부(120), 검출된 전류를 디지털신호로 변환하는 전류 변환부(130) 상기 변환된 전류신호를 받아 지속성 피크전류를 검출하는 전류 특징 검출부(140), 검출된 특징데이터를 표시부 시그먼트 신호로 변환하는 번역부(160), 전류 특징 결과를 표시하는 표시부(170) 및 설정치에서 경보를 하고 전로를 차단하는 경보, 차단 출력부(173), 감시제어부의 조작전원용 전원부(180)를 포함하고, 상기 제어부(101)는 부하특성에 따라 탐색대역시간(T)을 설정하고, 상기 탐색대역시간(T)을 전류 특징분석을 위해 N등분하되, 등분한 1개의 미분대역시간( )에 상기 수배전반 시스템의 1사이클 (1주기) 이상의 전류 변화가 적용되도록 하고, 상기 등분된 미분대역시간( ) 동안 나타나는 전류값으로 부터 대표전류값를 산출하여 지속성 피크전류로 산정하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이로인해 불시정전사고예방, 과전류 발열사고와 불평형에 의한 편중과부하사고, 전로손실 및 설비이용 효율을 향상시킬수 있다.
assignees: WONBANG ENG CO LTD;SON MYOUNG HEE

title_en: On-vehicle traffic light assisting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-vehicle traffic light assisting device in the technical field of intelligent transportation, which comprises a traffic light map module, a global positioning system (GPS) module, an image sensor, a traffic light detection and identification module, a lane identification module and a traffic light state display and prompting early warning module. The on-vehicle traffic light assisting device solves the problems of safe driving of groups with visual disturbance such as color weakness, color blindness and the like, can reduce the probability of traffic accidents caused by the running of the red light of a driver under exceptional conditions, and improves transportation efficiency at crossings.

title_en: Electric power grinding machine early warning method and system based on radar detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of winch early warning, in particular to an electric winch early warning method and a system thereof based on radar detection, wherein the method realizes the early warning and prompting of the fault of a pair of winches by calculating the comprehensive operation abnormal value of the pair of winches and then carrying out the early warning and judgment of the fault, and simultaneously detects the obstacle information around the electric winch through a laser detector in a winch zone protection system of the pair of winches, when the laser detector detects that foreign matters enter the protection area, the protection safety early warning prompt is carried out on the wringing machine, the invention can reduce the false alarm phenomenon of the early warning system, can identify the factor causing the early warning to occur on the electric wringing machine in advance, is beneficial to reducing the accident rate of the electric wringing machine, and can simultaneously protect the safety of the front and rear monitoring areas of the wringing machine and carry out the alarm early warning, thereby eliminating the hidden danger of safety.

title_en: disaster and safety urgent alarm system for the hearing-impaired
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster and safety urgent alarm system for the hearing-impaired, which allows the hearing-impaired to recognize a current disaster situation in an easy and accurate manner even while asleep indoors at night by installing a smart pillow generating vibrations to a residential area of the hearing-impaired by wired and wireless communication, a plurality of multicolored lamps lit by disaster grade, and a smart display displaying a pictogram that enables instant recognition of various disaster information. The disaster and safety urgent alarm system for the hearing-impaired of the present invention comprises: a smart pillow which is provided in a bedroom of a house in which a hearing-impaired person lives to generate vibrations to notify a disaster alarm when the hearing-impaired person is asleep; a smart lamp which consists of lamps generating a plurality of light sources with different colors to display a currently occurring disaster situation by type or grade for the hearing-impaired person; a smart display which displays the currently occurring disaster situation through a pictogram or a sign language image that can be immediately recognized by the hearing-impaired person; and a house gateway which is installed in the house, in which the hearing-impaired person lives, to parse disaster information received from an external disaster and safety management server through a wired and wireless communication network and transmits disaster information according to a parsed result to the smart display, the smart lamp, and the smart pillow through the wired and wireless communication network.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 청각장애인의 주거지에 유/무선 통신에 의해 진동을 발생하는 스마트 베개, 재난 등급별로 점등되는 복수의 다색 램프 및 다양한 재난 정보를 즉각 인지할 수 있는 픽토그램을 표시하는 스마트 디스플레이를 설치하여 실내 야간 취침시에도 청각장애인이 쉽고도 정확하게 현재의 재난 상황을 인지할 수 있도록 한 청각장애인 재난안전 긴급 알림 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 청각장애인 재난안전 긴급 알림 시스템은 청각장애인이 거주하는 댁내의 침실에 구비되어 청각장애인이 수면시 진동을 발생시켜 재난 경보를 알려주는 스마트 베개; 서로 다른 복수 색상의 광원을 발생하는 램프로 이루어져서 청각장애인에게 현재 발생한 재난 상황을 종류 또는 등급별로 표시하는 스마트 램프; 현재 발생한 재난 상황을 청각장애인이 즉각적으로 인지할 수 있는 픽토그램이나 수화 영상으로 표시하는 스마트 디스플레이 및 청각장애인이 거주하는 댁내에 설치되어 유무선 통신 네트워크를 통해 외부의 재난안전 관리서버로부터 수신한 재난 정보를 파싱하고, 파싱한 결과에 따른 재난 정보를 스마트 디스플레이, 스마트 램프 및 스마트 베개에 유/무선 통신 네트워크를 통해 전달하는 댁내 게이트웨이를 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: Underground parking garage warehouse entry abrupt slope structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an underground parking garage warehouse entry abrupt slope structure. Belongs to the technical field of parking lots. The vehicle access and exit passageway mainly solves the problems that when a vehicle enters and exits a parking lot passageway, certain visual field blind areas exist, safety accidents easily occur, and meanwhile, the chassis of the vehicle entering the parking lot cannot be washed and cleaned. It is mainly characterized in that: the device comprises a channel consisting of an upper plane section, a steep slope section and a lower plane section, wherein a control switch is arranged in the channel; and the first induction broadcasting system and the second induction broadcasting system are electrically connected with the control switch. The utility model discloses can carry out the voice broadcast warning to the vehicle in business turn over parking area, reduce the occurence of failure, improve the factor of safety of driving to wash the vehicle below, prevent that the vehicle from bringing into a large amount of earth and getting into the parking area, make in the parking area cleaner.
assignees: THE 6TH ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY 11 BUREAU GROUP;China railway 11th bureau group co ltd

title_en: The sense warning device use led indication device
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 원터치에 의해서 엘이디 기판 및 커버의 조립이 가능토록하고, 또한 커버 내측에 빛 확산을 위한 볼록렌즈를 다수개 형성하여 빛을 고르게 확산시켜 정해진 조도를 유지 시킴으로서 멀리서도 화재 경보기의 위치를 쉽게 식별할 수 있도록 한 것을 특징으로 하는 시각경보 장치용 엘이디 표시장치에 관한 것으로, 본 고안은 시각 경보기 하우징(100)과;  상기 시각 경보기 하우징에 결합되는 엘이디 기판(200)과;  상기 시각 경보기 하우징의 엘이디 기판을 감싸서 결합되는 덮개용 커버(300)를 포함하여 이루어지되.  상기 덮개용 커버(300)는,  하부에 결합용 갈고리(300a)를 다수 형성하고, 외면은 터널형 돔 형태로 이루어지고, 내면은 전체적으로 " "형과 같이 다각형으로 형성하되, 내측 기판 중앙부에 설치된 LED(210)의 정면 위치와 대응되는 덮개용 커버(300) 내측에 볼록렌즈가 길이방향으로 다수개 반복 정렬되어 LED로부터 조사되는 빛을 확산시키는 제 1 볼록렌즈부(310)와;   상기 제 1 볼록렌즈부(310)의 테두면에 인접되도록 경사면으로 형성되고 이의 경사면에 볼록렌즈가 길이방향으로 다수개 반복 정렬되어 빛을 측면으로 확산시키는 제 2 볼록렌즈부(320)와;   상기 경사면에 형성된 제 2 볼록렌즈부(320)의 측면으로 연장 형성되며 LED(210)의 빛을 외부로 방출하며 사출시 금형 코어가 용이하게 이탈될 수 있도록 형성된 단차부(330)로 이루어진 구성이다. 이와 같이 구성된 본 고안은 일반인은 물론 시각장애가 있는 사람들도 본 고안의 시각경보장치의 조명등을 보고 비상상황을 인지하여 빠른 대응과 대피가 가능하게 할 수 있는 시각경보 장치용 엘이디 표시장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Vehicle blind zone early warning system, automobile, method and device thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of vehicle blind zone early warning system, automobile, method and device thereof, vehicle blind zone method for early warning includes the capacitance signal for receiving capacitance sensor and sending, wherein the capacitance sensor is arranged on vehicle blind zone；The distance between automobile and measured object are judged according to the capacitance signal；When the distance is less than threshold value, standby signal is sent.The capacitance signal that the embodiment of the present invention is sent by receiving capacitance sensor, judges the distance between automobile and measured object according to capacitance signal, when distance is less than threshold value, sends standby signal, reminds the user that.Therefore, the safety accident that vehicle blind zone is caused can be fundamentally solved, the safety of driving is substantially increased.

title_en: Tailboard safety control system and method based on foreign matter monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tailboard safety control system and a method based on foreign matter monitoring.A infrared sensor arranged in a coincidence region of the height direction of the bottom of the tail end of a carriage and the front of a platform monitors whether foreign matters exceed the front of the tailboard platform and invade the region in the lifting process of the tailboard platform, if so, the lifting motion of the tailboard platform is automatically cut off, the safety accidents of extruding and shearing the foreign matters in the relative motion of the platform and the rear end of the carriage are avoided, and a warning signal is sent; in addition, the system also monitors the conditions of personnel and foreign matters on the back of the platform by installing a radar or ultrasonic wave or infrared monitoring sensor on the back of the tail board lifting platform, and when the tail board platform is operated to vertically and horizontally overturn, if personnel or foreign matters invade the overturning area of the platform, the system can automatically cut off the overturning motion of the platform, avoid the invasion to the personnel and the foreign matters on the back of the platform and send out warning signals.
assignees: FUJIAN LONGMA ENVIRONMENTAL SANITATION EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Guidance lighting system equipped with emergency exit direction guiding function
title_ko: 비상구 방향 안내 기능을 가지는 유도등 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a guidance lighting system having a function of guiding the direction of an emergency exit. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a guidance lighting system having a function of guiding the direction of an emergency exit, which is normally used as an emotional lighting lamp and which detects emergency to provide a visual and audio guidance for the direction of emergency exit for safe evacuation in case of emergency such as a fire and a blackout, conducts tactile guidance through a heat generation of a luminescent device for visually and hearing-impaired users and performs an emotional guidance by changing the brightness and color of a luminescent device.
