For the above purpose, the guidance lighting system having a function of guiding the direction of an emergency exit of the present invention comprises: a sensor unit detecting an emergency and generating an emergency detection signal; a power supply unit normally supplying utility power and supplying charging power in case of emergency; a display unit normally used as a usual lighting and displaying the guidance of the predetermined direction of the closest emergency exit when the emergency detection signal is received; and a control unit controlling the luminescence, voice and alert of the display unit according to a normal state or an emergency state.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비상구 방향 안내 기능을 가지는 유도등 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 평상시에는 감성 조명등으로 활용하며, 화재 및 정전 등의 비상 상황시 안전하게 대피하기 위하여, 비상 상황을 감지하여 비상구 방향에 대한 시청각 안내를 수행하고, 시각 및 청각 장애인을 위하여 발광 소자 열 발생에 의한 촉각 안내를 수행하며, 발광 소자 밝기 및 색깔의 변화를 통한 감성 안내를 수행하는 비상구 방향 안내 기능을 가지는 유도등 시스템을 제공함에 그 목적이 있다.  
이러한 기술적 과제를 달성하기 위한 본 발명은 비상구 방향 안내 기능을 가지는 유도등 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 비상 상황을 감지하여, 비상 상황 감지신호를 생성하는 센서부; 평상시 상용전원을 공급하고, 비상 상황시 충전전원을 공급하는 전원 공급부; 평상시 일반 조명으로 사용되며, 비상 상황 감지신호가 전달된 경우, 기 설정된 최근접한 비상구 방향을 안내하도록 표시하는 표시부; 및 평상시 및 비상 상황에 따라 상기 표시부의 발광과, 음성 및 경보를 제어하는 제어부; 를 포함한다.

title_en: Method and system for notifying danger zone and social distancing
title_ko: 위험지역 및 사회적 거리 알림 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and system for notifying of dangerous zones and social distance. According to the present invention, a transmission/reception device carried by a user transmits a unique ID thereof at regular intervals, receives a unique ID sent from another transmission/reception device, and calculates a distance between the transmission/reception devices by using the strength of signals when the unique ID is received. The transmission/reception device determines a close contact state when the accumulated number of times of the calculated distances less than or equal to a critical distance is greater than or equal to a critical number of times and provides a social distancing notification to the user through at least one of vibration, sound, and display. Accordingly, the method provides an effect of enabling all people, including the visually impaired and hearing impaired, to effectively participate in a social distancing movement.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 위험지역 및 사회적 거리 알림 방법 및 시스템을 개시한다. 본 발명은 사용자가 휴대하는 송수신 장치가 일정한 시간 주기로 자신의 고유 아이디를 전송하고, 다른 송수신 장치에서 송신한 고유 아이디를 수신하며, 고유 아이디를 수신할 때의 신호의 세기를 이용하여 송수신 장치 간의 거리를 계산한다. 그리고, 송수신 장치는 계산된 거리가 임계 거리 이하인 누적 횟수가 임계 횟수 이상인 경우에는, 밀착 접촉 상태인 것으로 판단하고, 진동, 음향, 디스플레이 중 적어도 하나를 통해서 사용자에게 사회적 거리두기 알림을 제공한다. 이러한 과정을 통해서, 본 발명은 시각장애인 및 청각장애인을 포함한 모든 사람들이 사회적 거리 두기 운동에 효율적으로 참여할 수 있도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Wireless Relay Module For Remote Monitoring Systems Having Alarm And Display Functionality
abstract_en: Wireless relay modules for enabling alarm recognition and alerts in networked communications between a series of medical devices and a remote monitoring device via wireless relay networks and/or internet-accessible wireless communications networks. The wireless relay module including a receiver, a first transmitter coupled to the wireless relay network, a second transmitter coupled to the internet-accessible wireless communication network, a controller and a display. The controller identifying if received medical device data from the medical device includes an alarm condition and causing the display to display an alert accordingly. The wireless relay module may additionally include a speaker alone or in combination with a microphone for providing an audible alert of the alarm condition and verbal communication between a local healthcare provider and a clinician at the remote monitoring device.
assignees: WIESNER JOEL D;BREITWEISER KENNETH M;GAINES ROBERT B;TYCO HEALTHCARE

title_en: Fire alarm apparatus having transparent stick
abstract_en: A fire alarm having a transparent stick according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a body part detachably attached to a bracket installed on a ceiling; a fire detection part formed on one side of the body part to detect fire; a lighting part outputting predetermined light through a transparent stick having a predetermined length, which is detachably attached to the outside of the body part; a sound part formed on one side of the body part to output a preset sound; and a control part for outputting the predetermined light and sound when the fire is detected and providing a fire alarm. The hearing-impaired or general public can easily check the fire alarm.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 투광봉이 형성된 화재경보기는 천장에 설치된 브라켓에 탈부착되는 몸체부와, 상기 몸체부의 일측에 형성되어 화재를 감지하는 화재감지부와, 상기 몸체부의 외측에 탈부착되는 기 설정된 길이의 투광봉을 통해 기 설정된 조명을 출력하는 조명부와, 상기 몸체부의 일측에 형성되어 기 설정된 음향을 출력하는 음향부와, 화재가 감지되는 경우 기 설정된 조명 및 음향을 출력하여 화재경보를 하도록 하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Anticollision warning device for construction machinery
abstract_en: An anti-collision warning device for construction machinery comprises a fixing box, a collision buffer module and a U-shaped plate, wherein fixing legs are arranged on the left sides of the upper end and the lower end of the fixing box respectively, the middle parts of the fixing legs are in threaded connection with fastening nuts respectively, a rectangular through groove is formed in the upper side of the front end of the fixing box, a partition plate is arranged on the upper side in the fixing box, a winding rod is rotatably connected to the middle part of the upper end of the partition plate, the upper end of the winding rod penetrates through the fixing box and is connected with a crank, and the upper side and the lower side of the right end of the fixing box are connected with the U-shaped plate through the collision buffer module; this device accessible three kinds of fixed mode installation, it is wider to be suitable for mechanical scope, pulls out the reflection of light area around on construction machinery, and warning scope is wider, and LED lamp area is often bright and has guaranteed warning effect at night, can effectively prevent rubbing, when the external equipment accident is close, can carry out timely audible and visual alarm, in time reminds and avoids unexpected the emergence, when the striking takes place, cushions through buffer spring and gasbag, and the anticollision is effectual, reduces the loss.

title_en: Handrail band anti-clamping mechanism of escalator entrance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a handrail belt anti-clamping mechanism of an escalator entrance and exit, and relates to the technical field of escalators. The escalator comprises an escalator body and an anti-pinch device, wherein the anti-pinch device is arranged on the surface of the escalator body. According to the escalator, the buzzer and the warning lamp are arranged in the anti-clamping device, when foreign matters are clamped between the wall protecting plate and the hand strap, warning reminding is given out, so that workers can timely make response and can be matched with the escalator body, the phenomenon that fingers are clamped by a gap between the wall protecting plate and the hand strap when an infant plays in the escalator process is effectively prevented, safety accidents are avoided, and the protection performance and the safety of the escalator are greatly improved.

title_en: Intelligent vehicle-mounted millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent vehicle-mounted millimeter wave radar which comprises a millimeter wave radar main body, wherein the millimeter wave radar main body is connected with a left lamp interface, a right lamp interface and a radar warning lamp circuit, the radar warning lamp circuit is connected with a radar warning lamp, the left lamp interface and the right lamp interface are used for realizing signal interaction between the millimeter wave radar main body and a left and right blind area monitoring indicator lamp of a vehicle so as to remind a driver according to the coming condition of the left and right side areas of the vehicle, and the radar warning lamp circuit is used for controlling the operation of the radar warning lamp of the vehicle so as to remind the driver when the millimeter wave radar detects a potential obstacle. According to the application, the millimeter wave radar main body is respectively connected with the left and right blind area monitoring indicator lamps/RCW indicator lamps of the vehicle through the left lamp interface and the right lamp interface, and when the millimeter wave radar main body detects that an incoming vehicle exists in the left and right side areas of the vehicle, a driver can be reminded through the left and right blind area monitoring indicator lamps rapidly, so that potential safety hazards caused by blind areas are effectively avoided.

title_en: Safety monitoring method for waste slag field
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering safety monitoring, in particular to a safety monitoring method for a waste slag field. Aiming at the problems of more monitoring blind areas, weak data integration capability, early warning lag and the like in the prior art, the method constructs a set of multi-level monitoring system by systematically arranging displacement, stress strain and osmotic pressure sensor networks on the key positions of the surface, the inside, the side slope and the like of the waste slag field. By adopting a wired and wireless mixed transmission mode and configuring a redundant communication link and encryption measures, the monitoring data is efficiently, stably and safely transmitted to a cloud server, the server terminal performs fusion processing and trend analysis on the multi-source real-time data based on an intelligent algorithm, and the hierarchical early warning is automatically triggered through a multi-level threshold comparison mechanism. The invention effectively improves the perception precision, the monitoring efficiency and the early warning timeliness of the safety state of the waste slag field, and provides a reliable technical means for preventing and controlling geological disasters.

title_en: Deep Learning Sound Conversion Device for Deaf People
title_ko: 청각장애인을 위한 딥러닝 소리 변환 장치
abstract_en: A deep learning sound conversion device for a hearing-impaired person, in a sound notification device, is characterized in being configured with: (1) a jetson nano; (2) a microphone; (3) a pico w; (4) an OLED display; (5) a vibration sensor; and (6) a battery The present invention improves information providing efficiency by classifying/analyzing sounds of various situations through a central control device and a sensor and transmitting to a user in a visual/tactile manner.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 청각장애인을 위한 딥러닝 소리 변환 장치에 관한 것으로서 아기의 울음소리, 가전제품 종료음, 초인종 소리, 화재경보음 등 다양한 상황의 소리의 오디오 샘플 파일을 수집하여, 1500 여개의 오디오 샘플 파일을 딥러닝 하여 모델을 학습시키, 해당 딥러닝 AI 모델을 통해 음성인식 AI 웹사이트를 제작하고, 젯슨 나노에 의하여 중앙 제어 장치로서 다양한 상황의 소리를 분류 및 분석할 수 있게 하고, 마이크에 의하여 다양한 상황의 소리를 입력받을 수 있게 하고, 피코W에 의하여 중앙 제어 장치인 젯슨 나노로부터 신호를 전달받을 수 있게 하고, OLED 디스플레이에 의하여 분석 및 분류한 소리를 사용자에게 시각적으로 전달할 수 있게 하고, 진동센서에 의하여 분석 및 분류한 소리를 사용자에게 촉각적으로 전달할 수 있게 함으로써 비교적 특수한 상황에서 소리 발생 여부만을 기준으로 정보를 제공하는  문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 비교적 특수한 상황에서 소리 발생 여부만을 기준으로 정보를 제공하는  문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 소리 알림 장치에 있어서 중앙 제어 장치로서 다양한 상황의 소리를 분류 및 분석할 수 있게 소리입력장치에 설치한 젯슨 나노, 다양한 상황의 소리를 입력받을 수 있게 소리입력장치에 설치한 마이크, 중앙 제어 장치인 젯슨 나노로부터 신호를 전달받을 수 있게 사용자가 착용하고 있는 스마트 디바이스에 결합한 피코W, 분석 및 분류한 소리를 사용자에게 시각적으로 전달할 수 있게 사용자가 착용하고 있는 스마트 디바이스에 결합한 OLED 디스플레이, 분석 및 분류한 소리를 사용자에게 촉각적으로 전달할 수 있게 사용자가 착용하고 있는 스마트 디바이스에 결합한 진동센서, 여러 센서와 부품에 전력을 전달할 수 있게 사용자가 착용하고 있는 스마트 디바이스에 결합한 배터리로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 아기의 울음소리, 가전제품 종료음, 초인종 소리, 화재경보음 등 다양한 상황의 소리의 오디오 샘플 파일을 수집하여, 1500 여개의 오디오 샘플 파일을 딥러닝 하여 모델을 학습시키, 해당 딥러닝 AI 모델을 통해 음성인식 AI 웹사이트를 제작하고, 젯슨 나노에 의하여 중앙 제어 장치로서 다양한 상황의 소리를 분류 및 분석할 수 있게 하고, 마이크에 의하여 다양한 상황의 소리를 입력받을 수 있게 하고, 피코W에 의하여 중앙 제어 장치인 젯슨 나노로부터 신호를 전달받을 수 있게 하고, OLED 디스플레이에 의하여 분석 및 분류한 소리를 사용자에게 시각적으로 전달할 수 있게 하고, 진동센서에 의하여 분석 및 분류한 소리를 사용자에게 촉각적으로 전달할 수 있게 함으로써 비교적 특수한 상황에서 소리 발생 여부만을 기준으로 정보를 제공하는  문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 비교적 특수한 상황에서 소리 발생 여부만을 기준으로 정보를 제공하는  문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: System for a Monitored and Reconstructible Personal Rendezvous Session
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system that adapts a personally portable “smart” communications device to enhance a user's personal security by continuously monitoring an alert function of the device from a remote location during a user initiated “session.” The user device is in communications with a remote server, which monitors the alert function and provides: accurate preservation of session data; monitoring of user device ambient conditions; dispatch of emergency services; and notification of third parties. Server software (host application) on the remote server manages communications with user devices. The server collects, processes and stores data; dispenses data according to a rule set, and manages multiple user sessions. User software manages the initiation and conduct of a session and communications with the server. The user and server software in combination provide for establishing, maintaining operations of the system, and databases accessible by the remote server for storage/archiving of system data.

title_en: Emergency notification, activity notification, and suspicious movement detection for mobile devices
abstract_en: Foreign emergency notification, activity notification, and suspicious movement detection for mobile devices are disclosed. An application running on a mobile device of a user may be used to automatically detect when a call is made to emergency services in a foreign country, when an issue or unpermitted behavior may be occurring, when the mobile device has moved to an anomalous or unpermitted location and/or is moving with an unexpected speed, etc. The application then notifies family members and/or other contacts in the user's home country via a domestic carrier network. An over-the-top Internet Protocol (IP) message can be sent by the application on the mobile device back to the home network core.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring method and system based on big data cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster monitoring method and a geological disaster monitoring system based on a big data cloud platform, and relates to the technical field of disaster monitoring, and the method comprises the following steps of S1, browsing a three-dimensional live-action model and marking model data in real time: surrounding browsing of a three-dimensional live-action model and three-dimensional analysis are realized through the operation categories of zooming in, zooming out, translation, left rotation, right rotation and inclination, and a data labeling function is introduced in the browsing process, and S2, data acquisition and resource management of ground disaster prevention and control are carried out: disaster point and hidden danger point data of a geological environment and a geological disaster space are acquired through space data calculation, and the data are managed in a centralized mode. According to the invention, the ground water level drop depth, the ground accumulated settlement and the ground inclination are selected as the monitoring parameters of the ground settlement of the research area, so that the early warning grade is judged according to the monitoring parameters, and the insar is utilized to observe the observation results of various ground disaster data at intervals to obtain comprehensive monitoring information.

title_en: Debris flow monitoring and early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a debris flow monitoring and early warning method and device, and belongs to the field of geological disaster monitoring. The method comprises the steps of dividing a debris flow channel after investigation, acquiring geological basic information, deploying 'double fishbone' -shaped optical fiber monitoring networks along two sides of the channel, collecting environment parameters, presetting temperature difference and amplitude difference threshold values, judging whether debris flow is started at the i moment according to air temperature at the i moment, temperature of a temperature sensor and temperature difference threshold values, extracting the temperature of the temperature sensor at each level if the temperature sensor is started, searching an active sensor to determine a debris level height value and an elevation speed value, judging the position of an caving object, counting, calculating the change of the sound wave amplitude of an acoustic wave sensor from the i-1 moment to the i moment, comparing the change with the threshold values, judging whether foreign matters are intervened, if yes, collecting the sound wave characteristics of a first acoustic wave sensor at the left side and a first acoustic wave sensor at the right side, judging the occurrence of debris flow when the sound wave is matched, and calculating the flow speed and early warning. The invention improves the accuracy, stability and precision of the debris flow early warning.

title_en: A kind of high ferro wireless video transmission system
abstract_en: A kind of high ferro wireless video transmission system, comprises the video monitoring apparatus in high ferro train, by the wireless high-speed transmitting device of image information real-time Transmission, and the relay base station of downline distribution and station Surveillance center device.Video monitoring apparatus on high ferro train, realizes the collection to car epigraph, and wireless high-speed transmitting device realizes the real-time Transmission to image information and data message, by amplification and the forwarding of relay base station, is transferred to station Surveillance center.High ferro wireless video monitoring system together form the integral framework of perfect all standing non-blind area with the train scheduling communication system coordinated with it and high ferro video monitoring system along the line and surrounding area, can early warning and prevent the generation of cruelly probably case effectively, can early warning avoid the train operation safety because natural calamity causes.
assignees: SHENZHEN MINGSHENG COMM TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Acousto-optic alarm sensing device for acoustic warning
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of alarm equipment, and provides an acousto-optic alarm sensing device for acoustic warning, which comprises a fixed part, wherein an alarm mechanism is arranged at the upper part of the fixed part; the alarm mechanism comprises an illuminating lamp, a control screen and an audible and visual alarm, wherein the control screen is respectively and electrically connected with the illuminating lamp and the audible and visual alarm; the side edge of the fixing part is provided with an induction part, and the induction part and the fixing part are arranged at an included angle of ninety degrees; the induction part comprises a data line and a radar inductor, and two ends of the data line are respectively connected with the control screen and the radar inductor; the radar sensor is provided with threely, just the radar sensor is followed the fixed part is array setting in proper order. The utility model provides a pair of audible and visual alarm induction system for vigilance does benefit to and provides the warning at the sight blind area, and the sentry of being convenient for is timely makes corresponding processing.

title_en: Warning sign is used in municipal construction with anticollision buffer function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a warning sign is used in municipal construction with anticollision buffer function, including device body and water tank base, device body top surface has handle, flashing lamp, automatic rising telescopic solar panel and stereo set by a left side to the right side in proper order, automatic rising telescopic solar panel bilateral symmetry is equipped with solar battery, the inside top of device body is equipped with display panel through the fixed plate. Has the advantages that: the utility model discloses at inside anti-foreign matter filter cartridge that is equipped with in water tank base one side, prevent that foreign matter filter cartridge top is equipped with the water pipe, two-way pumping motor is connected to the water pipe top, extracts the inside water source of water tank base and then can wash body surface dust through two-way pumping motor.
assignees: HEBEI ZHENGTIAN ELECTRIC POWER EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Traffic early warning system based on tunnel patrol machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic warning control, and provides a traffic early warning system based on a tunnel patrol machine, which is used for solving the problem that accidents frequently occur due to the fact that a driver does not react in time due to road foreign matters in the current tunnel traffic, and comprises the following components: the system comprises a tunnel patrol machine, an acousto-optic early warning system, a fan control module, a light control module and a background server; the acousto-optic early warning system is used for receiving a preset acousto-optic early warning signal and carrying out corresponding preset sound early warning and preset light early warning; the fan control module is used for controlling the opening and closing of the fan according to the air quality concentration in the tunnel, and the light control module is used for receiving a preset light early warning signal and generating a preset light signal at a tunnel entrance to stop entering the tunnel. By adopting the system, the existence of foreign matters in the road can be accurately determined, early warning can be carried out through sound and light, and the occurrence rate of traffic accidents is greatly reduced.

title_en: Intelligent safety distance discriminating and warning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent safety distance discrimination warning, in particular to an intelligent safety distance discrimination warning device which comprises a model construction module, a space calibration module, a signal receiving module, a distance calculation module and an alarm judgment module, wherein the model construction module is used for constructing a three-dimensional virtual model consistent with a physical space through analyzing a two-dimensional engineering drawing and marking a dangerous area boundary, the space calibration module is used for establishing a virtual-real space coordinate mapping relation, the signal receiving module is used for obtaining the real-time position of personnel equipment through an ultra-wideband positioning technology, the distance calculation module is used for dynamically calculating the shortest distance between the current position and the dangerous boundary, the alarm judgment module is used for generating an early warning or alarm command according to a multi-stage safety threshold, and the signal sending module is used for transmitting the command to an audible and visual alarm device. According to the invention, through automatic space modeling, accurate positioning and real-time distance discrimination, the problems of visual blind areas and subjective errors existing in manual judgment are effectively solved, and the operation safety in a high-pressure environment is remarkably improved.
assignees: ULTRAHIGH PRESSURE BRANCH STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Rainwate catch filter
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A rainwater collecting filter is provided to remove and store foreign materials included in rainwater when the quantity of the rainwater is increased, and to prevent environmental contamination by clearly and conveniently managing and maintaining the filter. CONSTITUTION: A rainwater collecting filter comprises the following: a rainwater inflow pipe(23) receiving rainwater; a initial rainwater cut off bank(21) blocking inflow of the rainwater when the rainwater is flowed through the initial rainwater cut off bank; a first filtering net(18) filtering foreign materials included in the rainwater when a water level reaches the constant level; a second filtering net separating the foreign materials; a ceramic layer(25) rectifying the rainwater; and a storage tank storing the refined water.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 빗물 저장시설에서 빗물을 차 집 할 때 사용하는 방법으로서 더욱 상세하게는 빗물을 차 집 할 때 비가 적게 오거나 초기 빗물 속에는 이물질이 많아 이 초기 빗물을 버리고 이물질이 빗물과 같이 씻겨 내려가고 빗물의 양이 많아지면 수위센서가 감지하여 초기빗물차단문을 열어 빗물유입관으로 들어오는 빗물을 1차 거름망에서 이물질을 제거하고 차 집을 한 후 속 거름망에서 한번 더 거른 다음 이물질을 침전 실에서 최종 침전을 하고 저장탱크로 보내어 빗물을 저장할 때 사용하는 빗물 차 집 필터의 방법으로서 
빗물을 저장하여 사용하면 홍수를 예방하고 상수원을 공급할 때 사용하는 에너지를 절약하여 경제적인 파급효과는 물론 환경보전에서도 획기적인 파급효과가 있는 줄 알면서도 시설비가 많이 소요되고 유지관리가 어려워 지금까지 시설을 외면하여 왔다. 
그러나 세계적으로 홍수가 자주 발생하고 또한 우리나라는 유엔에서 정하는 물부족국가 이여서 최근에는 정부차원으로 빗물을 저장하여 사용하는데 많은 지원이 있어 많은 지방자치단체에서 빗물저장을 의무화하는 조례를 만드는 준비를 하고 있는 것으로 조사되었다. 
빗물저장시설에서는 가장 시급한 것이 빗물저장탱크로 이물질이 유입되는 것이다  이물질이 유입되면 아무리 좋은 시설을 하여도 그 시설은 무용지물이 되어 버리고 또한 유지관리 면에서도 많은 비용이 소요되어 빗물저장으로 인한 경제적인 효과가 없어 시설을 하였다 하더라도 경제적인 효과가 없으면 가동을 하지 않을 것이다.  
이에 본 발명의 빗물 차 집 필터를 개발하여 빗물 차 집 시에 이물질을 제거하고 빗물을 저장하면 유지관리 면에서는 물론 환경보전에서도 획기적인 파급효과가 있을 것이다.

title_en: Mobile personal security system
abstract_en: A mobile personal security device, system and method are disclosed. The personal security device and system may include a portable communication or computing device having a positioning device, and adapted to communicate with a server to provide location based information and alerts to an Emergency Call Center (ECC), operate an imaging system of the portable device to obtain images and send them to the server via a network, set an alarm and play a recorded notice when an indication of an emergency is received from a user. A method according to one embodiment comprises initiating a personal security application on the portable device, providing a fixed location of a user or locating a user and tracking the user's location via a positioning device, translating the received position or positions to an address or a route of the user, and upon indication of emergency, automatically call an ECC, initiate an alarm, play a recorded notice and/or obtain images, via a front and/or rear imagers of the portable computing or communication device and send the images to a remote server via a communication network.

title_en: Touch feedback floor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an  sense of touch feedback floor lays in VR experience place, including flat region, blind way region, luminous indicating device, the blind way region has buried the pressure sensing device underground, and the pressure sensing device is connected with control center communicational for detect the pressure information that applies on the pressure sensing device, and transmit the pressure information who detects to control center, control center still communicational coupling has detection device and feedback device, and detection device is used for detecting whether the user correctly wears VR equipment, control center receives the user correctly and wears the testing result of VR equipment, receives simultaneously behind the pressure information, control feedback device opens, otherwise, feedback device closes the utility model discloses a level land and blind way the most direct sense of touch of foot and warning sound's warning, divide safe experience district and dangerous warning district, and the user keeps operating at safe region all the time, has also guaranteed the safety in user, experience equipment and experience place simultaneously.

title_en: A thing networking block terminal for electric fire control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thing networking block terminal for electric fire control. Comprises three parts of an electric circuit, a control circuit and a detection circuit; the power utilization loop is connected between the inlet wire of the distribution box and the power utilization load, and the power utilization loop and the detection loop are both connected to the control loop; the power utilization loop comprises a protection module, an alternating current contactor, an auxiliary contact, a current transformer, a residual current transformer and a resistance type temperature sensor, the control loop comprises a main control circuit board, a communication module and a relay, and the detection loop comprises a temperature detector, a smoke detector and a temperature and humidity sensor. The utility model discloses a thing networking block terminal has functions such as conflagration automatic alarm, electric fire early warning, electric on-off control, but the exclusive use also can regard as execution end and other electric fire monitored control system cooperations to use, and electric fire hidden danger is eliminated to accessible early warning form when the conflagration does not take place, and the accessible cuts off the power consumption return circuit when the conflagration has taken place and falls to the loss minimum.

title_en: Tunnel disaster early warning system based on SCADA technologies
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of tunnel disaster early warning system based on SCADA technologies, including field level data collecting system, live foreign matter guard system and work area grade monitoring system.The collected analog signal of field level data collecting system is sent to work area grade monitoring system real-time display.The limit value with all kinds of parameters of work area grade monitoring system control interface setting is compared simultaneously；If the audio alarm module will be driven to start the live foreign matter guard system simultaneously more than work area grade monitoring system described in limit value carries out active defense.The invention builds railway tunnel Fire prevention equipment monitoring system using existing tunnel Fire prevention equipment combination remote automatic control technology, it realizes and remote real-time monitor is carried out to railway tunnel construction zone state, it was found that dangerous automatic alarm can be run simultaneously with remote control relevant device, emergency scene rescue function is realized.
assignees: HENAN HUIHUANG XINTONG SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: A kind of wisdom fire-fighting Internet of things system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wisdom fire-fighting Internet of things system, it includes LoRa communication networks, NB IoT communication networks and server, in the LoRa communication networks, the terminal device of setting includes Wireless Fire Alarm Controller, sensing equipment, warning device, input/output module and repeater；In the NB IoT communication networks, the terminal device of setting includes sensing equipment, warning device and input/output module, and the sensing equipment, the warning device and the input/output module are arranged on the blind area that the LoRa communication networks do not cover；The server, it is connected by the NB IoT communication networks with sensing equipment, warning device and the input/output module in the NB IoT communication networks, is connected by Ethernet with the Wireless Fire Alarm Controller.The wisdom fire-fighting Internet of things system of the present invention has the advantages of area coverage is wide and reliability is high.
assignees: SHENZHEN FORSAFE SYSTEM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent road safety early warning method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent road safety early warning method, which comprises the following steps: respectively detecting pedestrians who want to cross the road and vehicles who want to cross the zebra crossing; when detecting that a pedestrian is ready to cross the road, lighting the light-emitting early warning device to give an early warning; when the pedestrian crossing the road is detected, and the vehicle speed of the vehicle in the safe distance of the zebra crossing exceeds a threshold value, the light-emitting early warning device is lightened, and meanwhile, early warning information is sent to the mobile phone of the pedestrian on the zebra crossing and an early warning program is triggered. The invention prompts vehicles by controlling the LED luminous zebra stripes and the warning boards on the zebra stripes and simultaneously sends early warning information to pedestrians and drivers, thereby realizing information interaction and achieving double warning; the device has no detection blind area, can completely cover the intersection, has high sensitivity and is not influenced by the external environment, and can effectively reduce potential safety hazards caused by adverse factors such as driving blind areas, weather and the like; the cost is low, the road traffic system can be popularized and used in cities, can also be popularized to traffic roads in suburbs, villages and towns, rural areas and the like, and reduces potential traffic safety hazards.

title_en: Driving early warning method, system, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic driving early warning, and provides a driving early warning method, a driving early warning system, driving early warning equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the driving early warning method comprises the steps of obtaining the driving situation awareness degree of a driver and the blind area distance of a first vehicle; determining takeover time of the driver according to the driving situation awareness degree of the driver, and obtaining takeover time information, wherein the takeover time is the time required by the driver to recover from automatic driving to manual driving; calculating according to the takeover time information and the blind area distance of the first vehicle to obtain the warning area range of the first vehicle; judging whether the second vehicle enters the warning area range of the first vehicle or not to obtain a judging result; the method and the device for early warning the driver according to the judgment result determine different warning area ranges of the first vehicle according to different driving situation awareness degrees of the driver so as to ensure that the driver has enough time to recover the driving situation awareness, avoid the occurrence of safety accidents and ensure the personal safety of the driver.
assignees: CHONGQING SAILISI NEW ENERGY VEHICLE DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Fire control alarm device is used to office building safety for fire engineering based on internet platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire alarm device for building safety for fire engineering based on an Internet platform, and relates to the technical field of fire alarm. The fire-fighting alarm device for the office building safety based on the Internet platform comprises a fire-fighting alarm box, wherein a smoke sensor is arranged on the outer side of the fire-fighting alarm box, a controller is arranged in the fire-fighting alarm box, a servo motor is arranged in the fire-fighting alarm box, a rotating rod is connected to the bottom of the servo motor in a transmission mode, and an alarm assembly is arranged in the fire-fighting alarm box. This fire control alarm device is used to office building safety for fire engineering based on internet platform, when smoke transducer detects smog, accessible controller start servo motor, cooperation dwang, hydraulic pressure storehouse first, hydraulic pressure storehouse second, elastic expansion plate, sliding block, arc push rod, arc atress pole, baffle and elastic expansion rod for bee calling organ shifts out fire control alarm box, carries out corresponding alarm operation, the warning effect when improving the device and uses.
assignees: XUZHOU PURUIMA MACHINERY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-element intelligent safety monitoring and early warning method and system for overrun structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-element intelligent safety monitoring and early warning method and system for an overrun structure, and relates to the field of safety monitoring and early warning related of building structures; the method comprises the steps of carrying out pressure-bearing simulation analysis based on structural design and material properties, determining pressure-bearing simulation results, carrying out sensor point distribution analysis on the pressure-bearing simulation results according to a monitoring index set to generate a multi-element sensor network, obtaining multi-element data streams, transmitting the multi-element data streams to a risk analysis cloud platform for risk identification evaluation to obtain a risk region set and a region risk coefficient set, and carrying out grade evaluation and grade early warning based on a grade early warning mechanism. The technical problems that potential safety hazards cannot be found accurately due to blindness in data acquisition and rough risk judgment in the existing safety monitoring and early warning of the overrun structure are solved, and the technical effects of improving safety guarantee capability of the overrun structure through comprehensive and accurate data acquisition and accurate and timely risk judgment are achieved.

title_en: Underground coal mine anti-interference early warning method based on image key information identification
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-interference early warning method for coal mine underground based on image key information identification, which relates to the technical field of image identification, the invention constructs a foreign matter detection model through a sample image, acquires the image in real time to judge the foreign matter, forms a dust fog coefficient through the real-time object image and the pixel value range of the sample image, generates a omission factor according to manual sampling inspection, and the dust fog coefficient and the omission factor are continuously concerned, the interference intensity is formed according to the change process of the dust fog coefficient and the omission factor, the interference intensity is judged and the alarm is given, and the working environment of underground ore transportation and screening is comprehensively judged and given out an alarm through the dust fog condition in the foreign matter judging process and the manual sampling inspection result at the tail end, so that the potential safety hazard of dust fog accumulation is avoided.

title_en: An alert device, system and method
abstract_en: Alert device, system and method for alerting hearing-impaired persons through a sensory of a sound and the location of such sound. The device extends to the tracking of an object within a predefined perimeter, outside of which an alert is triggerable. The device includes a wearable unit having a plurality of differently colored LEDs and a plurality of differently colored sound-detecting units, with each of the differently colored sound-detecting units corresponding to the same colored LED's on the wearable unit thereby to color code the wearable unit to the sound-detecting units. When a sound is detected by one or more of the sound-detecting units being higher than a predetermined threshold sound, a sound event signal is triggered on the wearable unit activating a vibration and blinking of the LED's corresponding with the respective sound detecting unit, consequentially alerting a user of the location where the sound-detecting unit was previously positioned.

title_en: System for providing location alerts relating to emergencies
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for generating alerts communicated to emergency responders and/or contacts indicating a location of an incident. The system comprises a housing, one or more light sources, and a computing processor. A switch is located in the housing and configured to be accessible to a user. When the switch is actuated by a user indicating an incident, the processor provides power to the at least one light source to output light from the housing thereby indicating the location of the system. The system may also control a speaker to output an audible signal and a transmitter to transmit an emergency signal with location information to a device of an emergency responder and/or an emergency contact. The present invention may also be embodied in a software application that is implemented on a mobile device to thereby leverage the components of the mobile device to send alerts.

title_en: Sound triggering early-warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voice triggered warning system used by the deaf, which comprises: the audio frequency amplifier, which enlarges received voice signal; the signal processing circuit, which filtering plastics the amplified signal outputted by the audio frequency amplifier; the trigger circuit, which decides whether to change output electrical-level according to the filtering plastic signal whether to exceed threshold value; the alarm device, which sends out alarm signals according to signals outputted by trigger circuit; the power, which supplies power to system. The voice triggered warning system can start to vibrate automatically when vehicles whistling, thus reminding timely the deaf to have vehicles near, not only reducing effectively the risk of traffic accidents, but also providing a convenient travel for the deaf.

title_en: Ocean vessel safety monitoring and early warning system and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety monitoring and early warning system for ocean vessels and a working method thereof; the system comprises an infrared detector for detecting whether a person is in a certain range; the radio frequency tag is held by the inside personnel and used for uniquely identifying the inside personnel; the radio frequency identification antenna is connected with the radio frequency tag and the MPU and used for sending a wake-up signal to the radio frequency tag and acquiring the coded information of the radio frequency tag according to the control information of the MPU; an embedded controller; the embedded controllers are respectively arranged at different positions of the ship and each embedded controller comprises an FPGA and an MPU; connecting the communication nodes of the FPGA; a computer connected to the gateway; according to the invention, by combining the infrared detection technology and the radio frequency identification technology, internal personnel and strangers can be accurately distinguished, the problem of blind areas of a radar monitoring and early warning system can be solved, and meanwhile, the potential safety hazard of manual post standing at night is avoided.

title_en: Shoes for the blind having multi function
title_ko: 안전사고 방지와 길안내 기능을 갖는 시각장애인용 신발
abstract_en: The present invention relates to shoes for blind people having accident prevention and road guide functions and, more specifically, relates to shoes for blind people, capable of reporting obstacle information and road guide information, preventing accidents from happening to blind people through light automatically emitted when illuminance is lower than a predetermined value, and enabling blind people to easily go to a destination. According to the present invention, the shoes include: a sensor part including an infrared sensor for sensing an obstacle, and an illuminance sensor for sensing illuminance around a user; a control part controlling the operation of a notification part by receiving GPS information from a smartphone of the user and obstacle information and an illuminance value from the sensor part; an LED lamp part emitting light by being automatically turned on when the illuminance value received from the control part is lower than predetermined illuminance; and the notification part including a voice output part receiving the GPS information and the obstacle information from the control part and outputting the information by voice, and a vibration generating part outputting the information by vibration.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 안전사고 방지와 길안내 기능을 갖는 시각장애인용 신발에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 장애물 정보와 길안내 정보를 알려주고, 일정 조도 미만이 되면 자동으로 빛을 발광하여 시각 장애인의 안전사고를 사전에 예방하고, 용이하게 목적지로 이동 가능한 시각장애인용 신발에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 안전사고 방지와 길안내 기능을 갖는 시각장애인용 신발은 장애물을 센싱하기 위한 적외선 센서;와 사용자 주변부의 조도를 센싱하기 위한 조도 센서;를 포함하는 센서부와; 사용자의 스마트폰으로부터 GPS 정보와 상기 센서부로부터 장애물 정보 및 조도 값을 수신받아 알림부의 동작을 제어하기 위한 제어부와; 상기 제어부로부터 조도 값을 받아 기설정된 조도 미만일 경우 자동으로 작동(ON)되어 발광하는 LED 램프부와; 상기 제어부로부터 GPS 정보와 장애물 정보를 받아 음성으로 출력하기 위한 음성 출력부;와 진동으로 출력하기 위한 진동 발생부;를 포함하는 알림부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Smart Slope Grating System
abstract_en: The present invention provides a smart slope grating system which forms a slope-type water drain structure outside a grating, guides a local government log display and a flooding situation in a central portion of the grating to maintain foreign matter hanging as well as drainage performance, and efficiently display a smart information notification signal. The smart slope grating system comprises: an outer frame embedded in the ground and provided with a support step protruding from an inner circumferential surface; a water collection grating seated on and coupled to the support step of the outer frame, hinged to the outer frame to be rotatable, and forming a plurality of drain holes vertically penetrating up and down; a locking fastening unit corresponding to the outer frame to fasten and fix the water collection grating; and a smart output unit installed on the water collection grating and detecting overflow according to a backflow pressure in a log or a water collection port on an outer surface to output a notification signal. The water collection grating includes a slope guide extending in a downward inclined direction at both ends of the outer side of the drain hole arranged outside the drain hole to guide the inflow of rainwater or sewage toward the water collection port.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 그레이팅 외곽에 슬로프형 물 배수 구조를 이루며 그레이팅 중앙부에서 지자체 로그 표시 및 침수 상황을 안내하여 이물질 걸림은 물론 배수성능을 유지하고, 스마트한 정보 알림 신호를 효율적으로 표시함을 제공하도록, 지반에 매립 설치하고, 내주면 상에 돌출 형성된 지지단턱을 구비하는 외곽프레임과; 상기 외곽프레임의 지지단턱 상에 안착 결합하되 상기 외곽프레임 상에 회전 가능하게 힌지 결합하고, 상하 수직 관통된 복수 개의 배수공을 형성하는 집수그레이팅과; 상기 외곽프레임 상에 대응하여 상기 집수그레이팅을 체결 고정하는 잠금체결부와; 상기 집수그레이팅 상에 설치하고, 외부 표면에 로그 또는 집수구 내 역류 압력에 따른 오버플로우를 감지하여 알림신호를 출력하는 스마트출력부;를 포함하고, 상기 집수그레이팅에는, 상기 배수공 중 외곽에 배치된 배수공의 외측 양단에 하향 경사방향으로 연장 형성되어 집수구를 향한 우수 또는 오수의 유입을 안내하는 슬로프가이드를 포함하는 스마트 슬로프 그레이팅 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: THE KOREA STREET TREE CONSERVATION CO LTD

title_en: Electric line foreign matter intrusion intelligent video on-line monitoring assessment system
abstract_en: The utility model proposes electric line foreign matter intrusion intelligent video on-line monitoring assessment system, belong to intelligent power grid technology field.System includes video image acquisition module, Data Analysis Services module, communication module.Video image acquisition module gathers the video image of transmission line of electricity and is sent to Data Analysis Services module, foreign body, relative to the movement tendency of transmission line of electricity, is classified by analysis foreign body, accordingly invasion foreign body is carried out early warning or warning, concurrently form historical data, analysis and assessment electric line foreign matter invasion environment.Native system has electric line foreign matter attack early warning and warning function, assessment foreign body intrusion environment, effectively reduce the appearance of the transmission line of electricity potential safety hazard that foreign body intrusion causes, simultaneously eliminate icing snowberg, wave, sag change interference, improve the accuracy rate of monitoring result, there is the advantages such as intelligence degree is high, with low cost, convenient for installation and maintenance, can be widely applied to electric line foreign matter invasion intelligent online monitoring.

title_en: Road blind area pedestrian warning post
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a road blind area pedestrian warning post, belong to advanced manufacturing and automation, a road blind area pedestrian warning post, which comprises an outer shell, be equipped with ultrasonic sensor on the shell, a single-chip microcomputer, the LED illuminator, sound generating mechanism and power supply module, and ultrasonic sensor, the LED illuminator, sound generating mechanism and power supply unit all with singlechip electric connection, the appearance of shell is cylindricly, its material all adopts plastics, its surface colour is black, ultrasonic sensor fixed connection is in the outside of shell, its colour is black, singlechip fixed connection is on the shell, its colour is black, LED illuminator fixed connection is at the top of shell, its colour is red, power supply unit comprises solar cell and solar energy electroplax at least, solar cell installs the outside at the shell, it can realize, can guarantee pedestrian and the personal safety of vehicle personnel of traveling in road blind area department, very big personal safety guarantee has been brought for people.

title_en: High-voltage line branch growth early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser branch growth prevention early warning system for a high-voltage line, and relates to the technical field of power transmission line maintenance. The device comprises a laser band modulation signal transmitting part, a displacement detection unit, a foreign matter monitoring module, a scanning module, a display module, an alarm unit, a laser detection module, a storage module and a controller; the foreign matter monitoring module transmits a modulation light beam through the laser sensor to carry out line-by-line scanning on the high-voltage line field, monitors the foreign matter information on the periphery of the high-voltage line in real time, and transmits the monitored foreign matter information to the controller. The invention uses the laser sensor to emit modulated light beam to scan the high-voltage line on site line by line, compares and analyzes the newly scanned physical medium in 288 grids of the return receiving part, determines whether the new physical medium is a branch, measures the sag distance from the branch to the safety wire, and transmits back the picture of the foreign object point, thereby informing the relevant personnel in time, greatly reducing the working pressure of the mountain patrol personnel, improving the working efficiency and ensuring the safety of the high-voltage line.

title_en: Fire monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to fire monitoring system and method for monitoring a fire in real time by using a blind spot detection (BSD) camera. The system comprises: camera devices which are provided in fire monitoring areas, photograph the fire monitoring areas in real time and transmit the captured BSD image; a fire monitoring server which previously sets and stores information on a flame image in a memory, receives the BSD image transmitted from the camera devices, monitors occurrence of a fire by identifying whether the flame image stored in the memory is included in the BSD image, and generates and transmits a fire alarm signal when the fire occurs; and a plurality of fire receiving terminals which inform the occurrence of the fire by receiving the fire alarm signal transmitted from the fire monitoring server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 BSD(Blind Spot Detection) 카메라를 이용하여 실시간으로 화재를 감시할 수 있도록 구현한 화재 감시 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 카메라장치가 화재감시영역에 설치되어, 화재감시영역을 실시간으로 촬영하여 촬영된 BSD 영상을 전송하며; 메모리에 화염이미지에 대한 정보를 미리 설정하여 저장해 두었다가, 상기 카메라장치로부터 전송되는 BSD 영상을 수신받아, 메모리에 저장된 화염이미지가 BSD 영상에 포함되어 있는지를 식별하여 화재 발생 유무를 감시하며, 화재 발생 시에 화재알림신호를 생성시켜 전송하는 화재 감시 서버; 및 상기 화재 감시 서버로부터 전송되는 화재알림신호를 수신받아 화재 발생을 알려주는 복수 개의 화재수신단말을 포함하는 화재 감시 시스템을 포함한다.

title_en: Event communication system for providing user alerts
abstract_en: An event communication system involves facilitating entry by a user of one or more device addresses via a network accessible user interface of the event communication system. The device addresses are associated with alerts provided by the event communication system. Test alert messages targeted for the device addresses are sent via the user interface. The system sends alerts user devices corresponding to the one or more tested device addresses in response to predetermined events. The system may provide user access to historical copies of data relating to the alerts. Registration on the system involves storing a personal identity data of a student on a database and comparing the personal identity data to registration data entered via the user interface. Authentication is automatically provided based on the comparison.

title_en: Distributed healthcare communication system
abstract_en: A graphical audio station of a nurse call system is operable to permit a user to perform one or more of the following functions: establish a two-way voice communication link with another computer device in another patient and/or with a another computer device located in another staff work area and/or with a wireless communication device carried by caregiver and/or with a telephone of the healthcare facility; broadcast a voice page to a group of other selected computer devices; compose and send a text message to a portable device that is carried by a caregiver and that has wireless communication capability; browse web pages and/or view multimedia content, such as videos, hosted on servers of the healthcare facility and/or that are accessible via the Internet; view and/or acknowledge and/or answer and/or cancel alerts or nurse calls originating in a plurality of patient rooms.

title_en: Optical network sensor for monitoring roadbed equipment in real time and early warning field state in time
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a real-time supervision road bed equipment and timely early warning site state's optical network sensor. The optical fiber sensor is embedded in the composite material grating, the composite material grating adopts a plate-shaped glass fiber reinforced plastic molding grating which takes glass fiber as a framework and has a certain aperture ratio, the optical network sensor is arranged on roadbed equipment or a site of an object to be detected, and the normal state of the object to be detected, whether the object is invaded by foreign matters or not and the intensity level of the invasion of the foreign matters are judged by judging the intact state of the optical fiber sensor and the change characteristics of light in the optical fiber sensor, so that the real-time monitoring of the roadbed equipment and the timely early warning of the site state by the railway disaster prevention and foreign matter invasion early warning system are realized, the operation safety of the railway is effectively ensured, the practicability is strong, and the popularization and application values are high. In addition, the optical fiber sensor is provided with the optical fiber bending radius in the grid ground laying of the composite material, so that the weakening or the failure of light in the transmission process is effectively prevented.
assignees: JIANGSU ANRONG ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Goods taking and distributing system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a goods taking cabinet and goods distribution system, wherein the goods taking cabinet comprises a main body, a first monitoring device and a warning device, the main body is provided with a front opening which is formed by enclosing a top wall, a bottom wall and two side walls and is used for taking goods and a rear opening for storing the goods; the first monitoring device is arranged on one side, close to the rear opening, of the inner wall of the main body and used for monitoring whether foreign matters pass through or not; the warning device is connected with the first monitoring device and used for sending out a first warning signal when foreign matters pass through. When the foreign matter passes through, can monitor and send alarm signal by monitoring devices, avoid touching the cargo transportation device because of the mistake and cause the potential safety hazard in getting the goods in-process.
assignees: BEIJING SANKUAI ONLINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forest fire prevention warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a forest fire prevention warning device, which belongs to the technical field of warning devices and comprises a concrete layer, and four mounting plates on the upper surface of the concrete layer. This forest fire prevention warning device can provide the rest place for the pedestrian of passing through setting up the seat that links on concrete layer's upper surface, can sunshade and hide rain through the shielding plate, can promote the stability of forest fire prevention warning device structure through setting up four bracing pieces, when people sit on the seat of linking to arrange, the speaker of side about can carry out the continuous broadcast warning sign language simultaneously, people around the suggestion are fireproof, generate electricity through the photovoltaic board, and save to group battery's inside, then supply power to left and right sides speaker and two lights through group battery, promote energy-conservation, can throw light on through the light at night simultaneously, and then be convenient for provide the rest place to the pedestrian of passing, promote the practicality.
assignees: HUBEI CHANGLIN ECOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Community intelligent security system based on 5G communication network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent security system for communities based on a 5G communication network, belonging to the technical field of security; the invention has the beneficial effects that: monitoring the inside key region of community through the inside fixed monitoring device of monitoring module cooperation community, pass in and out personnel and vehicle to the community simultaneously and discern, patrol the control through unmanned aerial vehicle, establish aerial security protection patrol net, guarantee that the very first time discovers the hidden danger, and then handle the hidden danger of discovery through incident processing module, when discovering potential safety hazard or security protection accident, accessible audible and visual alarm sends the warning, the optional initiative is reported to the police to corresponding department simultaneously, when taking place the accident, can carry out the voice guide, avoid taking place secondary accident, carry out the route to patrolling personnel simultaneously and formulate, carry out artifical patrol to the key region, when patrolling, can overhaul equipment, accessible personal mobile terminal establishes real-time communication with control module simultaneously, further improve the security protection grade.
assignees: CHINA COMM CONSTR GROUP DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Development machine early warning linkage system and method based on thermal imaging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a development machine early warning linkage system and a development machine early warning linkage method based on thermal imaging, which relate to the technical field of underground intelligent monitoring of coal mines and comprise a data acquisition module, an edge calculation gateway module, an audible and visual alarm module and a terminal monitoring module; the data acquisition module is used for monitoring thermal imaging video streams and temperature data around the underground development machine in real time, the edge computing gateway module is used for identifying potential safety hazards, and once an abnormal situation is found, the data acquisition module immediately sends out an instruction to the audible and visual alarm module to enable the audible and visual alarm module to send out audible and visual alarm signals, and simultaneously controls the running state of the development machine; the terminal monitoring module is used for receiving the early warning information sent by the edge computing gateway module and displaying monitoring information on the surroundings of the heading machine on a monitoring interface in real time. The invention effectively solves the problem of sensing the working condition of the area near the heading machine, effectively reduces the visual field blind area of the staff when the heading operation is carried out, and ensures the safe and efficient production of the underground coal mine.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU HENGDA INTELLIGENT CONTROL TECH CO LTD;ZHENGZHOU COAL MACHINE INTELLIGENT CONTROL TECH INNOVATION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Wireless relay module for remote monitoring systems having alarm and display functionality
abstract_en: Wireless relay modules for enabling alarm recognition and alerts in networked communications between a series of medical devices and a remote monitoring device via wireless relay networks and/or internet-accessible wireless communications networks. The wireless relay module including a receiver, a first transmitter coupled to the wireless relay network, a second transmitter coupled to the internet-accessible wireless communication network, a controller and a display. The controller identifying if received medical device data from the medical device includes an alarm condition and causing the display to display an alert accordingly. The wireless relay module may additionally include a speaker alone or in combination with a microphone for providing an audible alert of the alarm condition and verbal communication between a local healthcare provider and a clinician at the remote monitoring device.

title_en: Responding to Emergency-Alert Audio Tone by Abandoning Dynamic Content Modification
abstract_en: A method and system for controlling dynamic content modification such as dynamic advertisement insertion. An example method includes detecting presence of an emergency-alert audio tone in a media stream accessible to a media client, and responsively causing the media client to abandon a dynamic content modification, such as to forgo a planned dynamic content modification or to discontinue an in-progress dynamic content modification. This method could occur while the media client is processing a given media stream for presentation, and the method could include detecting presence of the emergency-alert audio tone in the given media stream or alternatively in another media stream accessible to the media client. And in the latter case, the method could further involve causing the media client to switch from processing the given media stream for presentation to instead processing the other media stream for presentation, which could facilitate presenting of an associated emergency alert.

title_en: Methods and apparatuses for emergency notifications to the hearing impaired
abstract_en: Described are systems and methods for communicating emergency alerts to a hearing-impaired user. Queries are performed to one or more emergency alert databases to develop emergency alert notifications. At least some of the emergency alert notifications are filtered responsive to user selected criteria to select one or more filtered emergency alerts. An attention desired indicator is transmitted to a hearing-impaired user device that subscribes to a hearing-impaired relay service supported by the server if the one or more filtered emergency alerts are present. The filtered emergency alerts are transmitted to the hearing-impaired user device in response to a emergency information query from that user device.

title_en: Intelligent recognition's safe driving early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model aims at providing an intelligent recognition's safe driving early warning system. The technical scheme of the utility model is that: the intelligent pedestrian monitoring system comprises an advancing induction module, a signal transmission module and a data collection and analysis module, wherein the advancing induction module consists of a plurality of motor vehicles, each motor vehicle is provided with eight monitors, two pedestrian recognition devices and an automatic brake device, and each monitor consists of a shell, a sucking disc piece, a camera, a circuit board, a power supply, a data processor, a signal sending device and an indicator light; the whole system is provided with eight monitors on each motor vehicle, and by matching with the transmission of a wireless network and the data analysis and output of a server, the passing of pedestrians between two static vehicles can be monitored in real time, so that early warning signals are sent to driving drivers who find abnormal conditions, the automatic braking function is activated in time, the driving risks caused by visual blind areas and error areas are avoided, an emergency protection is performed on the pedestrians, and further traffic safety accidents are avoided.

title_en: Stadium outdoor site emergency refuge instant use condition prediction control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a prediction control method for the emergency refuge instant use condition of an outdoor place of a stadium, which comprises the following steps: (a) accessing a database of a stadium monitoring center to a China earthquake platform network to acquire real-time earthquake information; (b) inputting a burst early warning parameter into a database of a monitoring center of a stadium, and setting an early warning threshold value of the burst early warning parameter; (d) acquiring the flow of evacuated people through a plurality of network cameras arranged outside the stadium, and displaying the flow on monitoring equipment of a monitoring center of the stadium; (e) people flow is guided to evacuate according to the evacuation route through broadcast broadcasting. The outdoor field utilization efficiency of the stadium is improved, and unnatural damage caused by blind crowding of people is avoided.

title_en: Mountain torrent monitoring and early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of disaster early warning, in particular to a mountain torrent monitoring and early warning system and method. On the basis of the traditional Lora networking technology, an NB-IOT technology is added, so that an original 'end-cloud' network is changed into a 'cloud-fog-end' intelligent sensing network; through cloud computing of cloud layer with fog computing of fog layer realizes the unified maintenance and the management of system, alleviates the operational pressure of cloud layer reduces data throughput, solves the fortune dimension problem of basic unit's computer lab, network, system, reduces the fortune dimension pressure of basic unit, has increased the interactive ability with the terminal equipment layer of bottom, has reduced the communication blind area, has also alleviateed staff's work burden, has improved monitored control system's real-time efficiency, also very big improvement data monitoring's real-time and rate of accuracy.
assignees: DEYANG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: System for notificating sensor detection information for the deaf and hard of hearing
title_ko: 청각장애인과 난청인을 위한 센서 감지 정보 알림 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for notifying sensor-sensed information for the hearing-impaired and the hard of hearing. To this end, the system of the present invention is to enable the hearing-impaired and the hard of hearing to visually and aurally identify and distinguish various alarms or warning information to be suitable for a situation to be more easily and intuitively notified in a house or outside. The system of the present invention comprises: a sensor unit installed in a house, including at least one sensor for performing at least one of detections of a household call, an entry/exit status, a door status, fire, gas leakage and device abnormality, and outputting a sensing signal including each sensor identification information; a sensor-sensed information notification unit installed in a house, outputting sensor-sensed information in accordance with the sensing signal as at least one of visual and audio signals to notify the same to the outside; a sensor communication unit installed in a house, and receiving the sensing signal from the sensor unit to transmit the same to at least one of an external server and the sensor-sensed information notification unit; and a sensor-sensed information managing unit installed in a mobile communication terminal, receiving the sensing signal through the external server, and providing and managing the sensor-sensed information in accordance with the received sensing signal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 청각장애인과 난청인을 위한 센서 감지 정보 알림 시스템에 관한 것으로, 해결하고자 하는 과제는 청각장애인이나 난청인이 댁내 또는 댁외에서 각종 알림이나 경고정보를 그 상황에 맞게 시각적 및 청각적으로 식별이 가능하도록 구분하여 보다 쉽고 직관적으로 알리는데 있다. 
일례로, 댁내 설치되고, 세대 호출, 출입 상태, 도어 상태, 화재, 가스 누출 및 장치 이상 감지 중 적어도 하나를 수행하는 적어도 하나의 센서를 포함하고, 각 센서식별정보를 포함하는 감지신호를 출력하는 센서부; 댁내 설치되고, 상기 감지신호에 따른 센서감지정보를 시각적신호 및 청각적 신호 중 적어도 하나로 출력하여 외부로 알리는 센서감지정보 알림부; 댁내 설치되고, 상기 센서부로부터 상기 감지신호를 입력 받아 외부 서버와 상기 센서감지정보 알림부 중 적어도 하나로 전송하는 센서 통신부; 및 휴대통신단말에 설치되고, 외부 서버를 통해 상기 감지신호를 수신하고, 수신된 상기 감지신호에 따른 센서감지정보를 제공 및 관리하는 센서감지정보 관리부를 포함하는 청각장애인과 난청인을 위한 센서 감지 정보 알림 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Power transmission line external hidden danger early warning system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The power transmission line external hidden danger early warning system and method based on artificial intelligence comprise front-end equipment and a monitoring substation host which are installed on a high-voltage power transmission line tower pole, wherein the front-end equipment is connected with the monitoring substation host, the monitoring substation host is in communication connection with a remote background monitoring system, and the monitoring substation host and the background monitoring system are connected with a neural network module. And the foreign matter detection is carried out by utilizing the lightweight network deployed in the core processing operation module, and different warning information is sent to the mobile terminal, the monitoring substation host and the warning device of the front-end equipment according to the foreign matter detection condition of the background monitoring system. The core processing operation module and the video server in the background monitoring system are all provided with intelligent detection algorithms for intelligently detecting external hidden dangers, so that two defense lines for detecting the external hidden dangers are formed, the external hidden dangers can be timely and quickly found, meanwhile, the false detection and the missing detection caused by a single intelligent detection algorithm are effectively reduced, and the efficiency and the accuracy rate of automatic monitoring are improved.

title_en: Method for vehicle identification and communication between transportation network company (TNC) service users
abstract_en: A method for effective vehicle identification and communication between riders of transportation network companies (TNC), and the vehicles that are being designated to the riders. Accordingly, a system used to execute the method of the present invention conveys the information of the rider on a display device on the designated vehicle of the rider, so as to notify the rider before getting into the designated vehicle. Additionally, the present invention also helps assist blind people by conveying audio messages, such as pipe messages or announcing their names. Further, the present invention provides riders the ability to send an emergency alert, thereby ensuring a safer ride. Furthermore, the present invention enables TNCs to utilize the display device as a trade dress and as an optional platform for other media advertisements.

title_en: Life assisting system for deaf and hearing-impaired patients
abstract_en: The utility model provides a deaf and hearing decline patient life auxiliary system, including central control system, wireless transmission module, kettle water temperature reminds system, doorbell warning system, gas leakage alarm system, fire alarm reminds system, sound identification system and warning lamp, central control system includes control module, control module receives the signal of wireless transmission module transmission, kettle water temperature reminds system and is connected with control module through wireless transmission module, doorbell warning system passes through wireless transmission module and is connected with control module, gas leakage alarm system passes through wireless transmission module and is connected with control module, fire alarm reminds system and passes through wireless transmission module and is connected with control module, sound identification system passes through wireless transmission module and is connected with control module. The invention can provide life assistance for deaf and disabled people, and can convert external signals into vibration and character signals of the bracelet, thereby avoiding the problem of safety accidents caused by major potential safety hazards.

title_en: Satellite-ground cooperative power transmission channel foreign matter monitoring and early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power transmission line safety prevention and control, and particularly provides a satellite-ground cooperative power transmission channel foreign matter monitoring and early warning method and device, aiming at solving the technical problem of satellite-ground cooperative power transmission channel foreign matter monitoring and early warning. According to the scheme, risk grade assessment is carried out on the hidden danger of the easily-floating object by combining the satellite remote sensing image, the basic information of the hidden danger of the easily-floating object and the wind speed and wind direction forecast information, and then the power transmission line is monitored and early warned based on the risk grade corresponding to the hidden danger of the easily-floating object, satellite-ground cooperation of the power transmission line foreign object monitoring and early warning is realized, the intelligent routing inspection capability of the power transmission line is effectively improved, and burden reduction is carried out on inspection personnel at the same line.

title_en: Hydrogeology monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of hydrologic monitoring, in particular to a hydrologic geological monitoring method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of defining a hydrologic geological monitoring area, acquiring an early warning task, transmitting the early warning task to an unmanned aerial vehicle, acquiring video data of the monitoring area by utilizing video monitoring equipment which is pre-integrated in the unmanned aerial vehicle, judging whether trapped personnel exist in the monitoring area, if so, recording the real-time position of the trapped personnel, establishing a shouting tracking mechanism, starting a pre-integrated shouting device in the unmanned aerial vehicle, and playing evacuation voice; and activating the shouting tracking mechanism, selecting a safety area from the monitoring area, and generating emergency guiding information. According to the invention, by determining feedback information, rescue activities can be coordinated, blind search and rescue are avoided, distribution of trapped personnel is accurately mastered, a rescue scheme is optimized, invalid search can be reduced, a rescue path is optimized by generating rescue guidance, and early warning efficiency of hydrogeology monitoring is greatly improved.

title_en: Interactive electronic libretto/translation hd display interface apparatus and method
abstract_en: An addressable apparatus and method for simultaneous presentation of a performance script or other commentary, dialogue, and/or visual information available in the original language or one or more translations which can be selected by the user. Other visual information such as, sponsors, advertisements, and emergency alerts can be transmitted to each display in full color graphics or video. In one embodiment, a touch screen interface can allow point of sale applications pre-show, during intermissions, and/or post-show. Individual addressability allows direct messaging capabilities, seat- naming, anti direct-marketing media opportunities.

title_en: Laser early warning collision prevention control method for turning blind area of heavy truck
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser early warning collision prevention control method for a turning blind area of a heavy truck, which comprises the steps of avoiding accidents in an active early warning mode, firstly, obtaining a turning angle through a steering wheel angle sensor when the vehicle turns, calculating a dangerous area range by a whole vehicle ECU, dynamically illuminating the boundary of a ground dangerous area through a laser projector to remind surrounding pedestrians or vehicles to avoid, simultaneously starting a laser detector on the side of the vehicle, and simultaneously sending alarm signals to a driver and the pedestrians by an alarm when the personnel enter the dangerous area so as to take emergency measures, wherein an electronic camera outside the vehicle body and an electronic display screen inside the vehicle body can enable the driver to observe the abnormal position of the blind area without moving, so that potential safety hazards are eliminated in time, and the safety of the heavy truck is improved.

title_en: Photoelectric fire detector comprising a plurality of dark chamber
abstract_en: Disclosed is a photoelectric fire detector having a plurality of dark chambers. The photoelectric fire detector according to the present invention comprises: a first dark chamber and a second dark chamber surrounded by a base, a cover, and a plurality of outer walls protruding downward from the edge of the base and divided by an inner partition; a first light-emitting unit and a first light-receiving unit installed inside the first dark chamber; a first light-blocking wall installed between the first light-emitting unit and the first light-receiving unit; a second light-emitting unit and a second light-receiving unit installed inside the second dark chamber; a second light-blocking wall installed between the second light-emitting unit and the second light-receiving unit; and a control unit using the detection signals from the first and second light-receiving units to determine whether a fire has occurred. According to the present invention, since a fire detection signal is transmitted only when smoke is detected in the plurality of dark chambers, false fire warnings due to the inflow of foreign substances or temporary malfunctions can be prevented, thereby greatly increasing the detection accuracy of a fire detector. In addition, waste of firefighting manpower due to false fire warnings can be prevented and the reliability of firefighting facilities can be increased.
