title_en: Wearable system for detection of environmental hazards
abstract_en: The disclosed wearable device systems include several features for alerting and guiding persons who are approaching or near to potentially hazardous or high-risk conditions in their nearby environment. Sensor data from wearable devices (also referred to herein as “wearables”) are used to determine the presence of various unsafe environmental conditions and phenomenon, including dangerous terrain or other unusual conditions. The wearable would be used to warn a person, for example via auditory or haptic-based feedback, if the person is about to encounter an unsafe condition. In particular, the proposed systems can be of great benefit to the visually impaired, those persons with physical disabilities, or persons otherwise vulnerable to particular environmental conditions.

title_en: Storm avoiding buildings and structures
abstract_en: A building sheltering structure is configured to facilitate the shielding of domicile or building into an underground foundation before an emergency environmental condition arises. The foundation includes a cover plate and/or a second plate that translate horizontally to occlude the at least one domicile upon retraction into a secure cavity of the foundation by a lift assembly in the foundation cavity. The cover plate and second plate offer optimal protection to the domicile thereunder for various extreme conditions. Mounted atop the lift assembly, the at least one domicile can be fully retracted into the foundation cavity and completely shielded. The operation of the lift assembly is commanded and powered by a supply system, of which a processor facilitates emergency warnings and panic transmissions to signal for help. Further, a plurality of solar panels mounted atop the at least one domicile keeps the system charged for the use in emergency.

title_en: Fire scene rescue transfer vehicle

title_en: Fire engineering management sign
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting warning boards, and discloses a fire-fighting engineering management indication board, which comprises a base, a pillar, a fixed frame and a rotating device, wherein the pillar is fixedly arranged on the base; the rotating device is arranged at the top of the base, and the base is connected to the support column through the rotating device; the fixed frame comprises a left frame and a right frame. According to the utility model, the fire-fighting indication board is rotated by arranging the rotating device, the prohibition signs on the indication board can be noticed by people around more quickly by rotating, the existence of blind areas is avoided, and thus the warning effect is improved.

title_en: Artificial intelligence fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an artificial intelligence fire-fighting robot, including carrying on moving mechanism, intelligent control mechanism and pressure boost injection mechanism, the top of carrying on moving mechanism is provided with intelligent control mechanism, and intelligent control mechanism's right side is provided with pressure boost injection mechanism. This artificial intelligence fire-fighting robot, servo motor and power frame that connects the below through control assembly during the operation are controlled, the removal of carrying out whole robot through the procedure of settlement is patrol, user's accessible remote equipment cooperation monitor head is monitored and is mastered the site environment in the within range, when open fire appears in the scene, can be carried on the open fire detection sensor that frame one side set up by the robot and detect, transmit early warning information to control assembly simultaneously, the bee calling organ and the LED warning light on robot top can function simultaneously and initiate the alarm this moment, and the robot body then carries out the injection fire extinguishing process that hinders burning liquid through control assembly operation pressure boost injection mechanism to the open fire direction, promote intellectuality.

title_en: Urban intelligent flood prevention drainage early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban intelligent flood prevention drainage early warning and discloses an urban intelligent flood prevention drainage early warning method. The flood prevention early warning system integrates precipitation monitoring, rated drainage evaluation of a drainage well, accurate wellhead water flow detection and image recognition technologies. Through obtaining precipitation and drainage well rated data in real time, well head water flow distribution is carefully analyzed by combining a multi-water flow rate detector, and well head conditions are judged by utilizing a camera and image recognition. The system flexibly responds to complex situations such as rapid decrease of the water discharge, accompanying of foreign matters, stable rise of the water level reaching the rated amount and the like according to the water discharge change and wellhead situation, and establishes and executes a corresponding early warning strategy. In addition, the system can rapidly locate and inform people in the surrounding 1 km, and timely transmit flood information in a short message mode, so that the first time mastering condition of flood-related people is ensured, and the flood prevention efficiency and safety are effectively improved.
assignees: NUCLEAR IND JINHUA CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Debris flow monitoring and early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a debris flow monitoring and early warning method and device, and belongs to the field of geological disaster monitoring. The method comprises the steps of dividing a debris flow channel after investigation, acquiring geological basic information, deploying 'double fishbone' -shaped optical fiber monitoring networks along two sides of the channel, collecting environment parameters, presetting temperature difference and amplitude difference threshold values, judging whether debris flow is started at the i moment according to air temperature at the i moment, temperature of a temperature sensor and temperature difference threshold values, extracting the temperature of the temperature sensor at each level if the temperature sensor is started, searching an active sensor to determine a debris level height value and an elevation speed value, judging the position of an caving object, counting, calculating the change of the sound wave amplitude of an acoustic wave sensor from the i-1 moment to the i moment, comparing the change with the threshold values, judging whether foreign matters are intervened, if yes, collecting the sound wave characteristics of a first acoustic wave sensor at the left side and a first acoustic wave sensor at the right side, judging the occurrence of debris flow when the sound wave is matched, and calculating the flow speed and early warning. The invention improves the accuracy, stability and precision of the debris flow early warning.

title_en: Forward and Rear Safety Apparatus For Vehicle
abstract_en: Provided is a safety device for forward and backward collision warning for a vehicle. The safety device for forward and backward collision warning for a vehicle is a safety device mounted on a vehicle where a front wheel and a rear wheel are disposed respectively at the front side and the rear side, which comprises: an obstacle detection unit mounted on the front side or the rear side of the vehicle to detect an obstacle which comes closer or goes farther within a predetermined distance and transmit the detected data to a control unit; an image output unit mounted on one side of the vehicle to output the data received from the control unit as an image signal to a driver; a sound output unit mounted on one side of the vehicle to output the data received from the control unit as a sound signal to a driver; and a control unit for calculating a distance from the obstacle in real time, based on the data received from the obstacle detection unit, estimating chance of collision with the obstacle, based on the calculated data, and transmitting a warning signal to the image output unit and the sound output unit when the chance of collision exceeds a predetermined reference value. According to the present invention, the chance of collision with an obstacle is estimated to give a warning to a driver and a blind spot in driving can be eliminated to prevent an accident.

title_en: Earthquake protection warning system of nuclear reactor
abstract_en: The utility model provides an earthquake protection warning system of a nuclear reactor, which comprises a plurality of intelligent sensor modules and a main control unit that are connected into a data communication network through a twisted-pair cable. Each intelligent sensor module comprises a triaxial acceleration sensor, an A/D converter, a single chip microcomputer, a communication chip and a communication interface that are connected sequentially; and the main control unit comprises a main-control module, and a display, an audible-visual annunciator, a keyboard, a nuclear reactor emergency shutdown switching circuit and a communication interface circuit that are connected with the main-control module. The intelligent sensor modules are mounted on building supporting structure on the periphery of the nuclear reactor, so as to obtain the maximal monitoring area, and no detection blind zone or repeat detection zone appears; and after the information collected by each intelligent sensor module is calculated and compared by the main control unit, working personnel can judge whether an earthquake wave emerges and obtain the strength of the earthquake; in the case of a strong earthquake, the nuclear reactor is closed automatically and quickly, and the warning system gives an alarm to inform the working personnel to escape.

title_en: Vehicle safety system and blind area monitoring method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle safety system and a blind area monitoring method and device and belongs to the technical field of vehicle safety. The vehicle safety system comprises following-up steering photographic devices, an induction device, a control device and warning devices. The following-up steering photographic devices are arranged on the two sides of a vehicle body respectively and used for conducting image acquisition on obstacle objectives in view blind areas of side-view mirrors of a vehicle. The induction device is used for detecting the environment of the view blind areas of the side-view mirrors of the vehicle and further detecting the relative positions of the obstacle objectives and the vehicle. The control device is used for controlling the following-up steering photographic devices to conduct image acquisition on the obstacle objectives in the view blind areas according to the detection result of the induction device. The warning devices are arranged on door handles of the vehicle and used for giving early warning signals. According to the vehicle safety system and the blind area monitoring method and device, a driver can comprehensively know the driving environment of the vehicle, thus potential safety hazards caused by the view blind areas can be avoided, and the safety of the vehicle is improved.

title_en: Double Motion Type Vibration Generator and Driver's Warning Device Thereof
title_ko: 이중 모션 진동발생 장치를 이용한 운전자 경고 장치
abstract_en: A dual motion vibration generator (1) of a driver warning device (100) applied to a vehicle comprises: vibration units (30, 60) rotating with a predetermined phase difference from a motor shaft (11a) of a motor (11), and generating different translational movements by the phase difference; and vibration boxes (20-1, 20-2) housing the motor (11) and the vibration units (30, 60) in a receiving space (21), and allowing a portion of the vibration unit (30, 60) to move in and out of one side of the receiving space (21) at phase difference intervals. Therefore, during driving of a vehicle, translational movements of different phases suitable for relieving driver fatigue or emergency warnings can be generated as location-specific vibrations from a single motor. Specifically, the rotational motion of one motor can be converted into translational motion of a plurality of connectors by the linkage of multiple connectors, thereby allowing a plurality of vibration plates to generate location-specific vibrations. Therefore, the present invention can provide vibrations suitable for various driving environments of the vehicle and the emotional needs of the driver.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 차량에 적용된 운전자 경고 장치(100)의 이중 모션 진동발생 장치(1)는 모터(11)의 모터 축(11a)에서 소정의 위상차를 갖고 회전되며, 상기 위상차만큼 서로 다른 병진 운동이 발생되는 진동 유닛(30,60) 및 수용 공간(21)으로 상기 모터(11)와 상기 진동 유닛(30,60)을 내장하고, 상기 진동 유닛(30,60)의 일부 부위가 위상차 간격으로 상기 수용 공간(21)의 일측부에서 빠져 나오고 들어가도록 하는 진동 박스(20-1,20-2)를 포함함으로써 차량 주행 중 운전자의 피로 해소나 긴급 경고에 적합한 다른 위상의 병진 운동이 모터 한 개에서 위치별 진동으로 발생할 수 있고, 특히 하나의 모터의 회전운동을 복수의 연결부 연계에 의한 연결부 직선운동으로 복수의 진동판이 위치별 진동을 발생해 줌으로써 차량의 다양한 주행 환경 및 운전자의 감성적인 니즈(Needs)에 적합한 진동이 제공되는 특징을 갖는다.

title_en: Water proof fire transmitter equipped with cover
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a transmitter to sound an alarm when a user presses the transmitter if a fire occurs and, more specifically, to a waterproof transmitter equipped with a cover which includes: a pressing means for activating the alarm if a fire occurs; and a housing where the pressing means is coupled to expose the pressing means and where an openable cover is arranged for ease of use. The present invention provides a waterproof means to the cover or the housing or both of them to prevent foreign matter, water, and moisture which may hamper the alarm from going off. The waterproof transmitter for fire alarm equipped with a cover can further improve the waterproof effect by further arranging a locking means.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재가 발생하였을 경우 상용자가 눌러서 경보를 울리는 발신기에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 화재가 발생하였을 경우 경보를 작동시키기 위한 누름수단와, 누름수단이 노출되도록 결합되는 하우징을 구비하되, 하우징에 개폐가능한 커버를 구비하여 사용의 편의성을 향상시키되, 커버 또는 하우징 또는 이들모두에 방수수단을 구비함으로서 이물질, 물기, 습기등이 투입되는 것을 방지하여 합선등으로 경보가 울리지 않는 것을 방지할 수 있으며, 록킹수단을 더 구비하여 방수효과를 더욱 향상시킬 수 있는 커버가 부착된 방수형 발신기에 관한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of moveable air warning device of band signal reception device
abstract_en: A kind of moveable air warning device of band signal reception device, including remote control table, big-dipper satellite main frame, radio station transceiver, Portable electronic alarm and power supply；The remote control table signal connects the big-dipper satellite main frame；The radio station transceiver includes the big-dipper satellite transceiver and station transmitter being connected with each other successively, and the big-dipper satellite transceiver signal connects the big-dipper satellite main frame, and the power supply is connected to the radio station transceiver；Provided with the radio station receiver and alarm device being connected with each other in the Portable electronic alarm, the radio station receiver signal connects the station transmitter.Portable electronic alarm is connected by the utility model by big-dipper satellite with radio station, realize the region-wide interior seamless coverage of air defence warning information, do not limited simultaneously by ground disaster and environmental condition, 24h 24-hour services, no communication blind district can not only be realized, it is often more important that antijamming capability is very strong.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted intensity meter with earthquake early warning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicle-mounted spirit meter with earthquake early warning function, which comprises a microprocessor, a power circuit, a network module, an earthquake analysis module, an acceleration sensor, a light alarm and a sound alarm, wherein the spirit meter with the earthquake early warning function is carried by the vehicle, has small volume and can be easily installed in a cab and can be used as early warning equipment of a driver, the equipment has the functions of local earthquake detection and foreign earthquake early warning, when the acceleration sensor arranged in the spirit meter monitors the local earthquake condition in real time and calculates the acceleration value to automatically analyze the vibration signal, when the signal is generated by natural disaster earthquake and the spirit value reaches the preset spirit threshold value, the sound and light alarm is automatically carried out, the light flickers, the alarm bell sounds, and the spirit meter transmits the signal to a server to provide data support for emergency rescue command, meanwhile, the earthquake early warning platform can obtain the information of the earthquake at different places, so that the early warning is given in advance, and the time is won for the driver to avoid danger in advance.
assignees: YIN HAITAO;LI YANZHAO;YANG LE;WANG JIEMIN;LIU HAN;ZHANG TIAN

title_en: Construction vehicle vision blind area warning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a construction vehicle vision blind area warning device, which comprises a blind area identifier and an acousto-optic alarm voice reminding device, wherein the blind area identifier is arranged outside the vehicle; the blind area marker comprises a magnetic suction base, a framework, a laser pen, a reflector, a diffusion prism and a filter, wherein the number of the laser pen, the reflector and the diffusion prism is two, and the filter comprises a common filter and a lettering filter; the sound-light alarm voice reminding device is connected with a power supply system of a vehicle and comprises an infrared sensing device, an alarm and a voice reminding device, and the infrared sensing device comprises a sensing probe and an infrared sensing switch. The utility model provides a pair of construction vehicle vision blind area warning device can identify vehicle mechanical equipment's blind area when construction vehicle starts to remind the constructor who gets into vehicle equipment operative employee vision blind area, in time prevent operation violating the regulations and unsafe action, reduce the vehicle injury occurence of failure.

title_en: Intelligent road safety early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wisdom road safety precaution system, include: the pedestrian detection module is used for detecting pedestrians who want to cross the road; the vehicle speed detection module is used for detecting a vehicle to pass through the zebra crossing and the vehicle speed; the main controller sends out early warning control signals based on signals detected by the pedestrian detection module or the vehicle speed detection module; the early warning module is used for making early warning based on the control of the main controller; and the wireless communication module is connected with the main controller and sends the early warning information to the mobile equipment of pedestrians or drivers. The utility model can carry out double warning, and has high safety factor; the device has no detection blind area, can completely cover the intersection, has high sensitivity and is not influenced by the external environment, and can effectively reduce potential safety hazards caused by adverse factors such as driving blind areas, weather and the like; the cost is low, the road traffic system can be popularized and used in cities, can also be popularized to traffic roads in suburbs, villages and towns, rural areas and the like, and reduces potential traffic safety hazards.

title_en: Charging pile collision warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of charging piles, in particular to a charging pile collision warning device which comprises a mounting base, wherein a charging pile main body is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting base, a positioning clamping frame positioned in front of the charging pile main body is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting base, two groups of first guide rods are movably arranged on the positioning clamping frame, one end of each first guide rod is in threaded connection with a transmission clamping frame, and two groups of transmission rollers are movably arranged on the transmission clamping frame. This fill electric pile collision warning device, when the vehicle is backing a car the in-process, tire accessible driving roller promotes transmission card frame and guide bar first removal, until connecting contact first and connecting contact second contact back, circuit board and audible and visual alarm, the return circuit intercommunication between the buzzer, circuit board steerable audible and visual alarm, buzzer start and warn the driver, the driver of being convenient for in time control distance parks, the security is higher.

title_en: Wearable blind guiding auxiliary device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wearable blind guiding auxiliary device which comprises a helmet, wherein a power supply module, a loudspeaker module, an imaging module and a detection module are arranged outside the helmet, a central processing module and a plurality of uniformly arranged vibration modules are arranged inside the helmet, the imaging module is used for collecting, detecting and identifying obstacle information, blind road information and traffic light information in a road in real time, the detection module is used for detecting the distance between a user and obstacles in different directions, the central processing module is used for controlling the loudspeaker module to broadcast the obstacle information, the blind road information and the traffic light information in real time, and the central processing module is used for judging whether the distance between the user and the obstacles in the direction is a safe distance or not, if the direction is unsafe, the vibration module in the direction is controlled to vibrate, and meanwhile, the loudspeaker module is controlled to carry out voice warning. The device provides double feedback of touch sense and hearing sense for the user, so that the user can more intuitively and timely sense the direction and distance of the obstacle, and accurate blind guiding of the user is realized.

title_en: Turn inside diameter blind area induction installation
abstract_en: Turn inside diameter blind area induction installation, radar scanner [1] is set at vehicle blind zone, in fan-shaped 270 ° of sector scannings, realize scanning without dead angle, alarm device [2] is set, is wirelessly connected with radar scanner [1], when the vehicle is turning, whether radar scanner [1] has barrier by real-time monitoring blind area, if having, then self-starting alarm device [2] sends warning early warning；Radar scanner [1] can determine whether out the different barriers of scanning；Alarm device [2] can send different alarms according to the different barriers that radar scanner [1] scans, and judges for driver；Car member control apparatus [3] is set, when driver turns by force, can force to control car body and stop working；Loss can be reduced to a certain extent, reduce potential safety hazard.

title_en: Sensitivity analysis method of the network load to meteorologic factor under a kind of typhoon weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses network load under a kind of typhoon weather to the sensitivity analysis method of meteorologic factor, it is related to weather warning technical field.Sensitivity analysis method of the network load to meteorologic factor under described typhoon weather, assay matrix is set up by historical load characteristic index and influence factor, data normalization processing is carried out according to positive correlation type and negatively correlated type to each index in assay matrix；The extreme value uniformity of data is taken into full account during data normalization processing, the data representation after standardization has direction uniformity；Major influence factors are selected according to the size of degree of association index variation rate, avoid because of the calculation error that blindness selection influence factor is brought, the analysis precision of part throttle characteristics and meteorologic factor dependency relation is improved, can more definitely reflect fluctuation of the Load characteristics index before and after typhoon is mainly influenceed by which factor.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CORP ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Production safety management and control system based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention provides a production safety control system based on machine vision, which comprises a video monitoring system, a data processing center, a safety early warning system and a tracing management system, wherein the video monitoring system is used for acquiring images of a monitored area and sending the images of the monitored area to the data processing center, the data processing center identifies the images of the monitored area and sends identification results to the safety early warning system and the tracing management system, the safety early warning system sends out early warning according to the identification results and sends the early warning results to the tracing management system, and the tracing management system stores and queries the identification results and the early warning results. The invention realizes the real-time monitoring of the safety and the non-standard behavior of the product, and overcomes the defects of limited coverage area, management blind area and potential safety hazard of manual monitoring and routing inspection.
assignees: BEIJING YUANSHAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Expressway maintenance early warning method and device based on road event and readable medium
abstract_en: Expressway maintenance early warning method and device based on road events and readable medium. The method comprises the steps of responding to the detection of a road event, obtaining the occurrence time of the road event as a target time, executing maintenance early warning processing based on the target time, collecting expressway geological monitoring data and expressway traffic monitoring data corresponding to a preset expressway mark in a preset time period where the target time is located, generating expressway geological disaster early warning information, carrying out traffic abnormal event identification processing, carrying out highway maintenance cooperative early warning, responding to the expressway road environment monitoring data sent by a patrol equipment in the preset time period, determining the expressway road environment monitoring data as data to be detected of a road foreign matter road section, generating the road foreign matter road section information, and sending the road foreign matter road section information to a cleaning maintenance equipment. The embodiment reduces the resources consumed in the maintenance early warning process.
assignees: CHONGQING SHILI HIGHWAY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Subway shielding door safety monitoring method and monitoring system based on multi-source data analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a subway shielding door safety monitoring method and a monitoring system based on multi-source data analysis, which are characterized in that a multi-source data set of a target subway platform is obtained, the multi-source data set is subjected to space-time alignment processing to generate a multi-mode monitoring data set fused with space-time characteristics, foreign matter identification processing is performed based on the multi-mode monitoring data set to generate a foreign matter monitoring result and foreign matter position distribution information of a shielding door area, and carrying out density prediction processing according to the foreign matter monitoring result and the passenger flowing data sequence in the multi-source data set, generating a passenger linear density prediction result and density change trend information, generating a safety early warning strategy based on the foreign matter position distribution information and the density change trend information, and transmitting the safety early warning strategy to a subway platform control system to trigger emergency response operation. The invention effectively improves the emergency treatment efficiency and the passenger dredging accuracy of the subway platform in the sudden foreign matter blocking scene.
assignees: CHENGDU VOCATIONAL & TECHNICAL COLLEGE OF IND

title_en: Emergency alert systems and methods for differently abled persons
abstract_en: Emergency alert systems and methods for disabled and/or differently abled persons are disclosed. Upon receiving an alert message, the system translates the alert message to an audio message (text to speech) when the text to speech feature is enabled. In some implementations, the system waits for a threshold period of time (e.g., 30 seconds) to receive a user acknowledgment of the alert message, and translates the alert message to an audio message if no acknowledgment is received within this time. The user acknowledgment can be received via a selection of an option (e.g., by clicking an “OK” button) and/or via an audio option (e.g., by saying “Ok, received”) when the text to speech feature is enabled. The system then outputs (e.g., reads out loud) the translated message so that the disabled or differently abled persons can be informed of the emergency situation. After outputting the translated message, the system can further wait for a user acknowledgment of the translated audio message.

title_en: Wireless power system with foreign object detection
abstract_en: The wireless power system has a wireless power transmitting device and a wireless power receiving device. The wireless power transfer device may be a wireless charging pad or other device having a charging surface. The wireless power receiving device may be a portable electronic device that receives a transmitted wireless power signal from a wireless power transmitting device while resting on a charging surface. During a digital ping operation, a low power wireless power signal may be transmitted from the wireless power transfer device. Information collected during the digital ping, such as wireless power transfer efficiency information, coupling coefficient information, Q factor information, and coil inductance information, may be used to determine whether a foreign object is present. Control circuitry in the transmitting apparatus may cause the receiving apparatus to present an alert to a user indicating that a wireless power transfer operation is beginning in response to determining that no foreign object is present.

title_en: Urban flood prevention early warning and forecasting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a city flood prevention early warning forecasting device, including water yield detection part, radar rainfall detection part, host system and early warning module, water yield detection part sets up the water yield information in order to detect each drainage node in urban drainage system, radar rainfall detection part predicts future rainfall information, host system respectively with radar rainfall detection part, water yield detection part is connected in order to receive future rainfall information and water yield information and analysis processes, host system is connected with early warning module in order to forecast the flood situation according to treatment result control early warning module, this design is accessible prediction future rainfall information analysis flood situation before the flood situation takes place, and publish through early warning module, make the staff, citizen has enough time to react and emergency treatment, the influence of calamity has significantly reduced.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN AIKE APPLIED SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Blind-assisting cap
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of blind guiding devices, and provides a blind assisting cap, A forward ultrasonic sensor is added on the cap body to perform real-time distance measurement, and the forward ultrasonic sensor can measure the forward distance in real time so as to detect obstacles. The device can provide timely warning and obstacle avoidance guidance to help the blind avoid collision and accidents. The warning lamp is arranged, the warning lamp can flash when the warning is carried out, and especially under the night or low light condition, the warning lamp can attract the attention of others, so that the blind people can know that the blind people are approaching and need to avoid. This can improve the visibility of the blind in traffic and people.
assignees: SHANGHAI CITY YANGPU DISTR PINGLIANG ROAD NO 3 PRIMARY SCHOOL

title_en: Improved structure of indicator light
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an indicator light structural improvement belongs to the electromechanical class. It includes a body, a control circuit and a signal discriminating panel, wherein, the body is provided with a space for accommodating; the control circuit is arranged in the body, a detection element is arranged in the control circuit in an extending way, and a voice device capable of broadcasting and a flash device capable of flashing strongly are connected in the control circuit in an extending way; the signal panel is installed on one side of the body and is provided with a light emitting set for warning indication. Has the advantages that: the alarm indication can be carried out according to the spreading condition of the fire so as to reduce unnecessary casualties; the device can respectively broadcast voice and generate intense flash and flash to inform sleeping people, deaf-mute people and blind people of fire, and escape before disaster is formed, so that casualties of unnecessary people are effectively reduced.

title_en: Guidance information management device
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To quickly transmit information related with safety or life such as earthquake early warning while translating it into a language which is easily understood by various members including foreigners.  <P>SOLUTION: A delivery database 56 stores information showing a language which is understandable by a user, information for recognizing or estimating current location, and information showing a place to receive guidance information. An urgent earthquake information system reception device 30 receives an earthquake early warning based on detection by a seismometer arranged in each place. Complementary information required for a user to suppress any damage is added to the earthquake early warning by an editing processing part 34, and the edited information is translated into a language shown by the language information by a machine translation processing part 35, and delivered from a network 1 to a member by a delivery processing part 38.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Control device of earphone for hearing protection
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for preventing an auditory disorder (such as noise-induced hearing loss) caused by the use of an earphone for a long period of time, for reducing the use time by oneself to use an alarm or vibration, and for limiting an earphone function when a user disregards the alarm or vibration and keeps using the earphone. In order to achieve the objective, the earphone control device uses a time and alarm setting function in a setting part, generates an alarm or vibration in a warning part when the time set in the control part elapses, and allows a blocking part to cut off the sound of the earphone when a preset operating time elapses.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 장시간 이어폰 사용에 따른 청각장애(소음성 난청 등)를 예방하고 사용자 스스로 사용 시간을 줄이기 위한 것으로 알람이나 진동을 이용하여 경고하고, 이를 무시하고 지속적으로 이어폰 사용시 이어폰 기능을 제한하는 장치에 관한 것이다. 
이를 해결하기 위한 이어폰 제어장치는 설정부에 시간 및 알람 설정기능을 사용하여 제어부에서 설정된 시간이 경과되면 경고부에서 알람이나 진동을 발생시켜 경고하고, 일정 운영시간이 지나면 차단부에서 이어폰의 음량을 차단하는 과정으로 이루어짐을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Dynamic Public Warning System for In-Vehicle eNodeB
abstract_en: A method is disclosed, comprising: sending position information reflecting a current position of a base station to a coordinating server; receiving a warning request message from an operator core network containing an emergency area; calculating a geographic area corresponding to an emergency tracking area by translating the emergency area from a set of base stations to the geographic area; determining whether the base station may be outside of a threshold distance from the geographic boundary of the emergency tracking area; and sending the warning request message when the base station may be within the threshold distance from the geographic boundary of the emergency tracking area.

title_en: Stand-Alone Type Fire Alarm Having Light Part
abstract_en: Disclosed is a single alarm type fire alarm. The single alarm type fire alarm according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a main body part attached to a ceiling or a side wall of a room, and having a gas detection sensor, a control unit, and a power supply unit mounted therein; a lighting unit mounted on a lower surface of the main body part and emitting the light downward or sideways according to a control signal from the control unit; an alarm unit mounted inside or on one side of the main body part and outputting an audible signal according to a control signal of the control unit; and the control unit mounted inside the main body part and determining whether a fire has occurred based on data detected by the gas detection sensor, and then controlling operations of the lighting unit and the alarm unit. According to the present invention, the single alarm type fire alarm including a lighting unit has effects of: preventing casualties that may occur by difficulties in securing visibility for evacuation in the event of a fire; enabling a user to secure visibility for evacuation in the event of a fire; and performing visual alarm for a hearing-impaired person.
abstract_ko:
단독경보형 화재경보기가 개시된다.  본 발명의 실시예에 따른 단독경보형 화재경보기는, 실내의 천정 또는 측벽에 부착되고, 내부에 가스검출센서, 제어부 및 전원공급부를 탑재하는 본체부; 상기 본체부의 하부면에 장착되고, 제어부의 제어 신호에 의해 조명을 하방 또는 측방으로 조사하는 조명부; 상기 본체부의 내부 또는 일측에 장착되고, 제어부의 제어 신호에 의해 청각적 신호를 출력하는 알람부; 및 상기 본체부의 내부에 탑재되고, 가스검출센서로부터 검출된 데이터를 바탕으로 화재 발생 여부를 판단한 후, 조명부 및 알람부의 작동을 제어하는 제어부;를 포함하는 것을 구성의 요지로 한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 화재 발생 시 피난을 위한 시야확보가 어려워 발생할 수 있는 인명피해를 방지할 수 있도록, 화재 발생 시 피난을 위한 시야를 확보해 줄 수 있고, 청각장애인을 위한 시각경보를 수행할 수 있는 조명부를 포함하는 단독경보형 화재경보기를 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Vehicle detection and notification system approaching bind spot
title_ko: 사각지대 접근 차량 감지 및 알림시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for detecting and notifying a vehicle approaching a blind spot, which can quickly and accurately detect a vehicle, a person, and an animal rapidly entering a blind spot such as an intersection of a road or an alley without a traffic light, a circular intersection (rotation intersection), and a curved road, and provide a dangerous situation to a driver with lighting and guidance voice to prepare for an accident. According to the present invention, the system (100) comprises: a main body (110) having a photovoltaic module (150) on an upper portion; a sensing unit (130) sensing entry of a vehicle, an animal, a person, or the like to a front surface of the main body; a lighting unit (120) emitting lighting light by a signal sensed by the sensing unit (130) to provide the same to a driver; a voice guide unit (140) guiding the same by voice; and an installation member (170) installing the main body (110) in a post.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 신호등이 없는 도로나 골목의 교차로, 원형 교차로(회전 교차로) 및 커브길 등과 같은 사각지대에서 빠르게 진입하는 차량 또는 사람 및 동물을 빠르고 정확하게 감지하여 위험상황을 조명 및 안내음성으로 운전자에게 제공하여  안전사고를 대비할 수 있는, 사각지대 접근 차량 감지 및 알림시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이러한 본 발명의 알림시스템(100)은, 상부로 태양광(150) 모듈이 구비되는 본체(110)와, 상기 본체의 전면으로 차량, 동물, 사람 등의 진입을 감지하는 감지부(130)와, 상기 감지부(130)를 통해 감지된 신호에 의해 조명 빛을 발산하여 운전자에게 제공하는 조명부(120) 및 음성으로 안내하는 음성안내부(140)와, 상기 본체(110)를 지주에 설치하기 위한 설치부재(170)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Universal configuration, control and monitoring of disparate devices via an SaaS interface and mobile application
abstract_en: A monitoring, control and configuration system that includes a local system, a mobile device application, and a server that is accessible by users via the mobile device application and a Software as a Service (SaaS) interface via a browser is disclosed. The local system contains a microprocessor, communications components and related software all of which enable communications with the server and external components coupled with the local system. The local system software and server software combine with the mobile application and website interface to enable a user to monitor, configure, and control external devices coupled with the local system and the local system itself via the server. The system replaces multiple disparate control devices with a single, configurable device and system. The system integrates multiple disparate devices and systems from multiple manufacturers. The system provides emergency alerts based on examination of information from external devices provided to the local system and the server.

title_en: Vehicle early warning method, device, storage medium and processor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle early warning method, a vehicle early warning device, a storage medium and a processor. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring road condition data of a traffic road on which a vehicle runs; determining at least one influencing factor of the vehicle based on the road condition data, wherein the influencing factor is a factor influencing safe driving of the vehicle; determining a blind area danger coefficient of the vehicle based on the weight of the influence factors, wherein the weight is used for representing the importance degree of the influence factors on safe driving of the vehicle, and the blind area danger coefficient is used for representing the probability of safety accidents caused by the blind area of the vehicle; and sending early warning information to the vehicle based on the blind area danger coefficient, wherein the early warning information is used for indicating that collision risk exists in the blind area of the vehicle. The method solves the technical problem that the dead zone danger cannot be predicted in the related art.

title_en: Moving objects collision warning apparatus and method for large vehicle
title_ko: 대형 차량의 이동 객체 충돌 경고 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for warning a moving object collision of a large vehicle. The apparatus comprises: a rear camera module mounted on at least one side surface of a large vehicle, and photographing a photographed object toward the front of the large vehicle; an image receiving unit receiving an image photographed by the rear camera module; a moving object determining unit for recognizing an image received from the image receiving unit, extracting an object included in the image, and determining whether the extracted object is a moving object including a bicycle, a two-wheeled vehicle, and a pedestrian; a moving object collision possibility determining unit for determining whether the moving object determined by the moving object determining unit is located within a preset dangerous area, and outputting a collision risk signal; a warning unit for outputting a visual or auditory warning signal to a driver of the large vehicle; and a control unit for controlling the warning unit to operate the warning unit when the collision risk signal is outputted from the moving object collision possibility determining unit. According to the present invention, a moving object such as a bicycle, a two-wheeled vehicle, a pedestrian, or the like located within a radius of rotation during rotation of a large vehicle can be accurately identified to warn a driver or to perform emergency braking. Therefore, the present invention has an effect of preventing a coarse life accident occurring in side and rear blind zones of a large vehicle.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 대형 차량의 이동 객체 충돌 경고 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 대형 차량의 이동 객체 충돌 경고 장치는, 대형 차량의 적어도 일측면 후방에 장착되며 상기 대형 차량의 전방을 지향하여 피촬상물을 촬상하는 후방 카메라 모듈; 상기 후방 카메라 모듈에서 촬상된 영상을 수신하는 영상 수신부; 상기 영상 수신부에서 수신된 영상을 인식하여 영상 내에 포함된 객체를 추출하고 추출된 객체가 자전거, 이륜차, 및 보행자를 포함하는 이동 객체인지를 결정하는 이동 객체 결정부; 상기 이동 객체 결정부에서 결정된 상기 이동 객체가 미리 설정된 위험 구역 내에 위치하는지를 판단하여 충돌 위험신호를 출력하는 이동 객체 충돌 가능성 결정부; 상기 대형 차량의 운전자에게 시각적 또는 청각적 경고신호를 출력하는 경고부; 및 상기 이동 객체 충돌 가능성 결정부에서 충돌 위험신호가 출력되면 상기 경고부를 동작시키도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 대형 차량의 회전 시에 회전 반경 내 위치한 자전거, 이륜차, 보행자 등의 이동 객체를 정확하게 식별하여 운전자에게 이를 경고하거나 비상 제동을 실시할 수 있고, 이에 따라 대형 차량의 측후방 사각지대에서 발생되는 저속의 인명 피해 사고를 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Method for monitoring blind spot of cycle using smart helmet for cycle rider and blind spot monitoring device using them
title_ko: 바이크 라이더용 스마트 헬멧을 이용하여 바이크의 블라인드 스팟을 모니터링 하는 방법 및 이를 이용한 블라인드 스팟 모니터링 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for monitoring a blind spot of a bike using a smart helmet for a bike rider to enable the bike rider to recognize a situation around the bike during riding. According to the present invention, the method comprises the following steps of a blind spot monitoring device: (a) when a video image of a first blind spot corresponding to the smart helmet is detected, allowing an object to detect an object from the video image and checking a first object located at the first blind spot; and (b) referring to sensor information acquired from a part of a GPS sensor, an acceleration sensor, a geomagnetic sensor installed in the smart helmet, determining the direction of the smart helmet and a bike driving direction, referring to the direction of the smart helmet and the bike driving direction to check a second object located at a second blind spot corresponding to the bike among the first objects, and displaying the second object through a head-up display (HUD) installed in the smart helmet or warning the rider of that the second object is located at the second blind spot in sound through a speaker.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 바이크 라이더용 스마트 헬멧을 이용하여 블라인드 스팟(Blind Spot)을 모니터링하는 방법에 있어서, 블라인드 스팟 모니터링 장치는, (a) 스마트 헬멧에 대응되는 제1 블라인드 스팟의 영상 이미지(Video Image)가 획득되면, 객체 검출기로 하여금 영상 이미지 상의 객체를 검출하도록 하고, 제1 블라인드 스팟에 위치하는 제1 객체를 확인하는 단계; 및 (b) 스마트 헬멧에 설치된 GPS 센서, 가속력 센서, 및 지자기 센서(Geomagnetic Sensor) 중 일부로부터 획득되는 센서 정보를 참조하여 스마트 헬멧 방향 및 바이크 주행 방향을 판단하고, 스마트 헬멧 방향과 바이크 주행 방향을 참조하여 제1 객체 중 바이크에 대응되는 제2 블라인드 스팟에 위치하는 제2 객체를 확인하고, 제2 객체를 상기 스마트 헬멧에 설치된 헤드업 디스플레이(Head Up Display; HUD)를 통해 표시하거나, 제2 블라인드 스팟에 제2 객체가 위치하고 있음을 스피커를 통해 소리로 경보(Alarm)하는 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Instrument for detecting and alerting during an emergency situation
abstract_en: An alarm system with an integral high-intensity illumination means comprising reflective beads for increased visibility is intended to provide alarm notification for the hard-of-hearing or deaf individuals. title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for detecting falling in vehicle running
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for detecting falling in vehicle running. The method comprises the steps of extracting acceleration data and GPS track data of a vehicle based on a preset time interval when the vehicle enters a disaster early warning road section, judging whether a falling condition is met based on the acceleration data change characteristic, determining falling start time and falling end time based on the acceleration change time when the falling condition is met, stopping updating or enabling the vehicle speed to be zero based on the GPS track data in a falling start time-falling end time period, and judging that the vehicle falls. The application can still quickly find the falling behavior of the vehicle no matter in severe weather conditions or in environments with poor light, and fills the problem of road condition perception blind areas caused by video detection failure and portal flow feedback delay.

title_en: Control system of vehicle with a automatic breaking function based on observation result of blind spot
title_ko: 사각지대의 감시 결과에 기초한 자동 제동 기능을 가지는 차량 제어 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An automatic braking function based on a monitoring result of a blind spot is provided to prevent collision by using warning announcement. CONSTITUTION: An automatic braking function based on a monitoring result of a blind spot comprises a memory(101), a camera, an acceleration pedal sensor(103), an ECU(Engine Control Unit)(105), and an ABS(Anti-lock Brake System)(106). The cameras output captured image data of a blind spot. The gear reduction unit senses the location of a shift gear and outputs a first sensing signal. The acceleration pedal sensor senses the operation of the acceleration pedal. The second sensing signal is outputted. The ECU recognizes the operation state of the vehicles based on the first and the second sensing signal, compares the captured image data and reference image data, and then outputs a braking control signal in an emergency situation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 사각지대의 감시 결과에 기초한 자동 제동 기능을 가지는 차량 제어 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 차량 제어 시스템은 메모리, 복수의 촬영 장치들, 기어 감지부, 가속패달 감지부, ECU, 및 ABS부를 포함한다. 메모리는 기준 영상 데이터들을 저장한다. 복수의 촬영 장치들은 차량 외부의 전방, 후방, 및 양측에 각각 설치되어, 차량 주변의 사각지대들을 각각 촬영하고, 촬영 영상 데이터들을 각각 출력한다. 기어 감지부 변속 기어의 위치를 감지하고, 제1 감지 신호를 출력한다. 가속패달 감지부 가속 패달의 작동 상태를 감지하고, 제2 감지 신호를 출력한다. ECU는 차량의 점화 신호에 응답하여 동작하고, 제1 및 제2 감지 신호들에 기초하여 차량의 동작 상태를 인식하고, 촬영 영상 데이터들을 기준 영상 데이터들에 각각 비교하고, 그 비교 결과에 따라 위험 상황을 판단하고, 위험 상황일 때 차량의 동작 상태에 따라, 제동 제어 신호를 출력한다. ABS부는 제동 제어 신호에 응답하여, 복수의 휠 실린더가 차량의 복수의 차륜의 브레이크들을 각각 작동시키도록, 복수의 휠 실린더의 유압을 각각 증가시킨다. 본 발명에 따르면, 사각지대에서의 충돌 사고를 예방할 수 있다.

title_en: Smart twin bollard
abstract_en: The present invention provides a smart twin bollard that allows pedestrians to pass safely in a blind spot and vehicles to drive safely. The smart twin bollard includes: a first bollard that is installed in a blind spot and includes a first sensor unit that detects a vehicle, a first communication unit that transmits and receives data with the outside, and a first notification unit that outputs a notification when data is received; and a second bollard that is installed in a blind spot and includes a second sensor unit that detects a pedestrian, a second communication unit that transmits and receives data with the outside, and a second notification unit that outputs a notification when data is received. According to the present invention, pedestrians can pass safely in a blind spot and vehicles can drive safely.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 스마트 트윈 볼라드에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 안전 사각지대에 설치되어, 보행자에게는 차량을 감지하여 알려줄 수 있고, 차량 운전자에게는 보행자를 감지하여 알려줌으로써, 안전 사각지대에서 안전사고 발생을 예방할 수 있는 스마트 트윈 볼라드에 관한 것이다.  
이를 위해, 본 발명은 안전 사각지대에 설치되는 것으로, 차량을 감지하는 제1 센서부, 외부와 데이터를 송수신하는 제1 통신부, 및 데이터 수신 시 알림을 출력하는 제1 알림부를 포함하는 제1 볼라드와; 안전 사각지대에 설치되는 것으로, 보행자를 감지하는 제2 센서부, 외부와 데이터를 송수신하는 제2 통신부, 및 데이터 수신 시 알림을 출력하는 제2 알림부를 포함하는 제2 볼라드;를 포함하고, 상기 제1 볼라드에서 차량이 감지되면 해당 데이터를 상기 제2 볼라드로 전송하며, 상기 제2 볼라드에서 보행자가 감지되면 해당 데이터를 상기 제1 볼라드로 전송하고, 상기 제1 및 제2 볼라드 간 상호 데이터 송수신이 이루어지는 경우, 상기 제1 알림부는 보행자를 위한 알림을 출력하고, 상기 제2 알림부는 차량 운전자를 위한 알림을 출력하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Digital content distribution system for delivering location specific content to an ad hoc group of mobile subscribers
abstract_en: A digital content distribution system and method are disclosed for delivering location specific content to an ad hoc group of mobile subscribers and method of delivering subscriber-requested, location-based content directly to a mobile communication device, such as a cell phone or personal digital assistant (PDA) or other mobile communication device. The system consists of a downloadable application that runs on the subscribers mobile communication devices and communicates with the server-based content composer system. The content composer system manages outgoing content based upon the geographic location reported by the mobile communication device application and the demographic and preference data stored in a subscriber database. Using available messaging technology, such as Short Message Service (SMS) and Multimedia Messaging Service (MMS) messaging, relevant sponsored content, mobile emergency alerts, and the ability to facilitate 2-way text or voice based services utilizing Global Positioning System (GPS) mapping is provided to an ad hoc group of subscribers in designated geographic locations. In order to optimize the utility for deaf and hard of hearing subscribers, the mobile communication device may be placed in a low power sleep or hibernate mode instead of a no power mode when the device is turned off. In a hibernate mode, in response to emergency content, the mobile communication device will wake up to an alert even when it is hibernating. Moreover, the alerts take over the portable device no matter what other tasks are being executed. In accordance with another important aspect of the invention, in response to emergency content, the system will cause the mobile communication device to vibrate even if the mobile communication device has been configured with the vibrate feature turned off.

title_en: Voice recognition auto alarm system
abstract_en: An automatic alarm system through voice recognition is provided to protect valuable life and fortune by reporting an emergency status to a safety enterprise or a police station by generating an alarm through an alarm generating device. An automatic alarm system through voice recognition includes a mike(10) and a noise removing unit(115), a tone comparing unit(105), and a warning lighting(50). The mike receives a voice. The noise removing unit removes a noise of the voice received from the mike. The tone comparing unit checks whether or not a voice tone is changed by comparing a received voice tone with a normal voice tone. A user's voice tone is normally stored in a general recording and storing unit. When a voice tone inputted through the mike is suddenly changed to a high voice tone, an emergency signal is transmitted to an emergency operating unit. The warning lighting receives an output signal of the alarm unit and visually recognizes the output signal.

     상기 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 고안은, 유선 또는 무선으로 연결된 화재경보시스템으로부터 비상감지신호를 전송받아 그에 대응되는 신호를 출력하여 각 구성요소를 작동시키는 제어부와, 비상사태 및 비상구 음성안내 데이터가 사전 저장된 메모리와, 메모리에 사전 저장된 비상사태 및 비상구 안내 데이터를 음성신호로 변환출력하여 비상사태 발생시 시각장애인들의 대피를 돕는 청각유도수단과, 램프에서 발산되는 빛을 점멸 및 집광시킴으로써 램프 식별을 더욱 용이하게 하기 위한 시각유도수단, 및 평상시에 상용전원으로부터 전원을 공급받아 비상용 전원으로 충전하였다가, 비상사태 발생시 전원을 공급하여 청각유도수단 및 시각유도수단을 포함한 각 구성요소를 정상작동시키기 위한 비상전원부를 포함하는 전원공급수단으로 이루어진다.

title_en: A kind of belt conveyor skidding prior-warning device and detection method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to equipment early warning technology fields, and in particular to a kind of belt conveyor skidding prior-warning device and detection method.In apparatus of the present invention, code-disc wheel is mounted in support shaft by swivel bearing, and support shaft can not be driven, and code-disc wheel foreign steamer can make its circular support shaft rotation with external force；It is connect close to switch by data line with control box；Control box is mounted in support shaft.The method of the present invention includes the following steps: that the signal detected when Step 1: rotating code-disc wheel close to switch reaches control box, and control box acquisition Information Number is N；Step 2: obtaining equipment operating parameter lower limit value M: Step 3: N is compared with equipment operating parameter lower limit value M, if when N < 90%*M, then it is assumed that belt conveyor skids.The present invention is for detecting whether belt conveyor skids in process of production, to avoid causing adhesive tape tearing due to belt slippage, even result in feed blocking and seriously shut down and cause safety accident.
assignees: BEIJING XINCHANGZHENG TIANGAO INTELLIGENT MACHINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mountain area natural disasters monitoring early warning vibrations trigger formula ageing monitoring facilities
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vibration triggering type aging monitoring device for natural disaster monitoring and early warning in mountain areas, which comprises a placing outer shell, wherein the bottom of an inner cavity of the placing outer shell is fixedly connected with a protection adjusting mechanism, the middle position of the top of the protection adjusting mechanism is fixedly connected with a vibration triggering mechanism, the bottom of the inner cavity of a spherical protection shell is fixedly connected with an electromagnetic current trigger, the inner surface of the inner cavity of the spherical protection shell is provided with a metal coil, the bottom of the inner cavity of the protection inner ball is provided with a permanent magnet ball, and one side of a strut, far away from a limiting plate, is fixedly connected with an impact force detection plate. Overall structure is adjustable, carries out effective protection based on the end of the earth, avoids causing biological damage and disposable to equipment, and accessible electromagnetism intermittent type nature triggers, and length and width are long when the monitoring takes place to more accurate prediction, the safety of protection personnel and asset, and can monitor the natural disasters of multiple difference, promote application scope.

title_en: Intelligent traffic early warning system and method based on acousto-optic early warning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic warning control, and provides an intelligent traffic early warning system based on an acousto-optic early warning device, which is used for solving the problem that accidents frequently occur due to the fact that road foreign matters are not timely reacted by a driver in current road traffic; the acousto-optic early warning system is used for receiving a preset alarm signal and uploading the preset one-key alarm signal to the background server; and the background server is used for calculating the guardrail patrol machine which is closest to the acousto-optic early warning device uploading the preset warning signal according to the received preset one-key warning signal, scheduling the guardrail patrol machine to move to the acousto-optic early warning device and carrying out early warning and rechecking. By adopting the system, the existence of foreign matters in the road can be accurately determined, early warning can be carried out through sound and light, and the occurrence rate of traffic accidents is greatly reduced.

title_en: Protection early warning mechanism of flood bank for hydraulic engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a protection early warning mechanism of a flood bank for hydraulic engineering, which comprises a flood bank body and a water level monitor body, wherein the upper end of the water level monitor body is provided with a water level alarm body. According to the invention, the T-shaped pull rod is pulled to separate the cylindrical clamping block from the cylindrical clamping groove, the fixing plate is lifted to enable the lifting column to be matched with the connecting rod to lift along the first circular groove under the limiting action of the sliding groove and the sliding block, the cylindrical clamping block is matched with the pressure spring to be inserted into the cylindrical clamping groove arranged at the corresponding position after the T-shaped pull rod is loosened, the lifting column and the fixing plate are effectively limited and fixed, the height of the water level measuring head is conveniently adjusted according to actual requirements, the water level measuring rod and the water level measuring head are arranged by penetrating through the threaded through groove, external threads on the water level measuring rod are in threaded connection with the threaded through groove, the cylindrical protection block is matched with the filter screen to provide protection for the water level measuring head, and foreign matters in water are prevented from winding the water level measuring head.

title_en: Coal flow multi-mode autonomous sensing monitoring method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal flow multi-mode autonomous sensing monitoring method, a system, equipment and a medium, which relate to the technical field of industrial intelligent monitoring and digital data processing, and comprise the steps of deploying equipment, collecting in real time and generating a multi-mode data set; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing multi-mode data and extracting features to obtain a joint characterization vector, generating abnormal probability based on cloud-edge cooperation, triggering an early warning signal by combining the abnormal probability with a grading threshold value, and improving coal flow sensing and monitoring precision by adjusting a dynamic distribution and optimization monitoring strategy by combining the early warning signal. The invention can find out various anomalies such as deviation, foreign matters, coal pile and the like and potential safety hazards in running in time, avoid production accidents caused by equipment faults and ensure production safety. And meanwhile, the abnormal information such as coal pile, foreign matters, deviation, carrier roller faults and the like in the running process is subjected to statistical analysis, so that the safety and the production efficiency in the coal flow transportation process are further improved.

title_en: Intelligent control method of tunnel intelligent traffic guiding system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of road tunnel construction traffic control, and provides an intelligent control method of a tunnel intelligent traffic guiding system, which aims to solve the problems of low traffic efficiency, large potential safety hazard, incomplete information coverage and the like of an existing inclined shaft and a positive tunnel intersection, and the intelligent control method is used for acquiring target data of a vehicle in real time and judging the running direction of the vehicle through a direction identifier; and controlling a red-green lamp group in the tunnel intelligent traffic guiding system according to the optimal green lamp extension time, adjusting traffic light timing schemes in the direction of the positive tunnel and the direction of the inclined shaft, and simultaneously publishing multi-mode information based on the traffic light timing scheme. The application realizes the dynamic optimized dispatching of the traffic flow of the tunnel intersection, constructs a non-blind area safety early warning system, and remarkably improves the traffic efficiency and the safety level of the tunnel intersection.

title_en: System for notifying of disaster such as fire
abstract_en: To provide a solution to achieve flexible emergency broadcasting such as evacuation guidance by a foreign language while utilizing an existing automatic fire warning facility and an emergency broadcasting facility.SOLUTION: A system includes sensors for monitoring information transmission means to be operated when an automatic fire warning facility and an emergency broadcasting facility arranged in an installation are in an issuing state, and detects an issuing state of the automatic fire warning facility and the emergency broadcasting facility by detection of the sensors. Detection information of the sensors is transmitted to an external server via a network in response to detection of an issuing state. The server receives detection information from the sensors so as to transmit notification information for notifying of occurrence of a disaster to a predetermined network terminal inside the installation. The network terminal receives notification information from the server so as to notify of occurrence of a disaster by visually or acoustically outputting notification information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method and System for Providing Backup Messages to Wireless Devices During Outages
abstract_en: The method and system of the present invention provides an improved technique for providing email to a wireless device during an outage. Email messages are redirected from the primary email system to a secondary email system during an outage such as, for example, a natural disaster. Email messages are accessible from the secondary email system through a wireless device. A notification message is sent to the user's wireless device alerting them that their email messages are available on the secondary email system through their wireless device. After the termination of the outage, email messages received during the outage are synchronized into the users standard email application.

title_en: Public safety early warning method and system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of big data analysis, and discloses a public safety early warning method and a public safety early warning system based on big data analysis, wherein a thermal imaging module in an acquisition unit acquires thermal imaging image data of a public place and sends the thermal imaging image data to an analysis unit, the analysis unit calculates duty ratio data information ZB according to the received data, and a judgment unit receives the duty ratio data information ZB calculated by the analysis unit and compares the duty ratio data information with a dangerous threshold W and then sends a dangerous instruction to a processing unit; according to the application, the data information ZB, the sound information data SY and the people number information data RS are used for calculation, the people number information data RS can reflect the people number information in the public place in a future period of time to play a role in prediction, and the sound information data SY can reflect the order degree of the site, so that the calculated early warning value J can predict the situation in the public place to play a role in early warning, and can accommodate accessible people to the greatest extent.

title_en: Artificial intelligence auxiliary ship safety management system and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence auxiliary ship safety management system and an application method thereof, and relates to the technical field of ship safety management and artificial intelligence technology intersection. title_en: Method for vehicle identification and communication between transportation network company (tnc) service users
abstract_en: A method for effective vehicle identification and communication between riders of transportation network companies (TNC), and the vehicles that are being designated to the riders. Accordingly, a system used to execute the method of the present invention conveys the information of the rider on a display device on the designated vehicle of the rider, so as to notify the rider before getting into the designated vehicle. Additionally, the present invention also helps assist blind people by conveying audio messages, such as pipe messages or announcing their names. Further, the present invention provides riders the ability to send an emergency alert, thereby ensuring a safer ride. Furthermore, the present invention enables TNCs to utilize the display device as a trade dress and as an optional platform for other media advertisements.

title_en: Emergency alert systems and methods for differently abled persons
abstract_en: Emergency alert systems and methods for disabled and/or differently abled persons are disclosed. Upon receiving an alert message, the system translates the alert message to an audio message (text to speech) when the text to speech feature is enabled. In some implementations, the system waits fora threshold period of time (e.g., 30 seconds) to receive a user acknowledgment of the alert message, and translates the alert message to an audio message if no acknowledgment is received within this time. The user acknowledgment can be received via a selection of an option (e.g., by clicking an “OK” button) and/or via an audio option (e.g., by saying “Ok, received”) when the text to speech feature is enabled. The system then outputs (e.g., reads out loud) the translated message so that the disabled or differently abled persons can be informed of the emergency situation. After outputting the translated message, the system can further wait for a user acknowledgment of the translated audio message.

title_en: System and method for delivering mobile wireless broadcast messages in designated languages
abstract_en: A mobile wireless system and method are described for distributing emergency alert messages to mobile wireless devices in multiple languages. The emergency alert system receives an alert message including a geographic area identification, and a text alert. The emergency alert system renders one or more translations of the text alert from the text alert. The one or more translated versions of the text alert are provided in particular foreign languages based upon designated foreign languages corresponding to the geographic area identification. The emergency alert system transmits the text alert and one or more translated text alerts commercial mobile wireless service provider networks for broadcasting the text alert and the translated text alert(s) via mobile wireless transmitters having a coverage area falling within a region corresponding to the geographic area identification.

title_en: Tobacco leaf warehouse tobacco worm monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of deinsectization, and discloses a tobacco leaf storage tobacco insect monitoring and early warning system. The system comprises a high-definition intelligent camera, a tobacco insect trapping plate, a processor and an early warning device, wherein the tobacco insect trapping plate traps tobacco insect samples, the high-definition intelligent camera collects images of the tobacco insect samples on the tobacco insect trapping plate and sends the images to the processor, the processor is provided with an AI self-learning algorithm of vision technology, tobacco insects and other insect foreign matters are distinguished, the image samples are processed, tobacco insects are identified and counted, and the early warning device carries out early warning of different grades according to the tobacco insect numbers. The invention can timely and effectively reflect the pest situation in the reservoir area, early warning is carried out before the disaster is formed, economic loss caused by the pest can be effectively avoided, the system networking function can feed the pest situation back to the command center in real time, the monitoring result data is visually displayed through the system display board, and a data base is created for the establishment of pest control measures.
