title_en: Sign language translation and real-time communication system for special hearing-impaired people
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sign language translation and real-time communication system for special hearing impaired people, and particularly relates to the technical field of communication equipment for assisting hearing impaired people. Functionally, the sign language translation mode captures hand and limb actions through a binocular camera, key points are extracted through YOLOv positioning and MEDIAPIPE, xLSTM time sequence modeling is used for identifying dynamic gestures, spoken voice/words are output through a transducer recombinant language sequence, the lip language identification mode adopts ChLipNet models to convert lip images to texts in a layered mode and fuse voice signals to improve noise immunity, and the scene linkage module triggers intelligent warning such as medical calling and traffic danger avoidance based on environmental sound classification and GPS positioning. The system realizes high-precision motion capture by non-contact hardware, solves the problems of sign language-spoken language sequence difference and environmental interference, and achieves bidirectional barrier-free real-time communication.

title_en: Mobile Application for Real-Time Legal Guidance, Interaction Documentation, and Emergency Response during Law Enforcement Encounters
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a mobile application system designed to provide real-time legal guidance, secure documentation, and emergency response during encounters with law enforcement. The system incorporates artificial intelligence-based speech-to-text transcription, contextual legal analysis, and actionable advice tailored to user interactions and applicable laws. A recording module captures audio in real-time, while a context analysis module generates situationally appropriate “Do's” and “Don'ts” linked to relevant legal frameworks. The application features an emergency response module for immediate communication with predefined contacts, location sharing, and alert generation. Encrypted storage ensures secure handling of recordings and interaction logs for legal admissibility. Additionally, the application provides jurisdiction-specific legal insights, scenario-based guidance, and curated updates on user rights, empowering individuals to navigate interactions with confidence while fostering transparency and accountability.

title_en: System and method for broadcasting alarm using ai-based multilingual voice conversion function
title_ko: Ai 기반 다국어 음성변환기능을 이용한 경보방송시스템, 및 경보방송방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides an alert broadcasting system and alert broadcasting method utilizing AI-based multilingual voice conversion, which can quickly and accurately convey disaster or alert information to not only Koreans but also foreign residents and tourists by converting input voice data into multiple languages in real time to provide disaster safety-related information. Provided is an alert broadcasting system utilizing AI-based multilingual voice conversion comprising: a characterization information storage unit for storing characterization information for converting silent intervals into characters differently according to the lengths thereof; a voice recognition module configured to perform voice recognition on the input voice data and generate a text file obtained by characterizing the voice data; a multi-lingual translation module configured to translate the text file into at least one foreign language to generate a multi-lingual translation; a multi-lingual broadcasting module configured to convert the multi-lingual translation into voice streaming composed of at least one corresponding foreign language and output the same through a speaker unit; and an output control unit configured to control real-time output, through a display unit, of at least one of the text file generated by the voice recognition module and the multi-lingual translation generated by the multi-lingual translation module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 경보방송시스템은, 디스플레이부 및 스피커부를 구비하고, 상기 디스플레이부 및 상기 스피커부를 통해, 재난 또는 안전사고로 인한 경보상황 발생시 이를 알리기 위한 경보방송데이터를 출력하는 경보방송시스템에 있어서, 상기 경보상황을 알리기 위한 화자의 육성데이터가 입력되면, 상기 육성데이터에 대한 음성인식을 수행하여 상기 육성데이터를 문자화한 텍스트파일을 생성하는 음성인식모듈; 상기 텍스트파일을 적어도 하나의 다른 나라 언어로 번역하여 다국어번역문을 생성하는 다국어번역모듈; 상기 다국어번역문을 대응된 적어도 하나의 다른 나라의 언어로 구성된 음성스트리밍으로 변환하여 상기 스피커부를 통해 출력하는 다국어방송모듈; 및 상기 음성인식모듈에서 생성된 텍스트파일, 및 상기 다국어번역모듈에서 생성된 다국어번역문 중 적어도 하나를 상기 디스플레이부를 통해 실시간으로 출력하도록 제어하는 출력제어부를 포함함으로써, 재난안전에 관련된 정보를 제공하기 위해 입력되는 육성데이터를 실시간으로 다국어로 변환하여 제공할 수 있고, 이로 인해, 외국인 거주자 또는 외국인 관광객들에게도 재난 또는 경보상황을 신속하고 정확하게 전달하여, 외국인 거주자 또는 외국인 관광객들도 재난 또는 경보상황에 안전하게 대처할 수 있도록 하는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Safe deposit box storehouse detection dangerous material automatic alarm access sales counter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of safe deposit box storehouse detection dangerous material automatic alarm access sales counter,Including sales counter body,Translation machine,X-ray check device and autoalarm,X-ray check device includes X ray tester,Adopt as device,Image data base,System information processor and signal adapter,Described X ray tester and adopt as device is installed in sales counter,And described X ray tester and adopt as device be respectively correspondingly arranged in translation frame upper and lower side,The X-ray light source sent by X ray tester with adopt as device coordinates to carrying out safety inspection by the safe deposit box object on translation machine,Described autoalarm includes three alarm receivers and acoustic-optic alarm,Acoustic-optic alarm includes warning light,Loudspeaker and voice message software,With Full-automatic safe deposit box system support using the dangerous goods such as inflammable and explosive into the potential safety hazard brought in storeroom for safe deposit boxes can be prevented.
assignees: FOSHAN LEIYA BANK EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Safety warning device and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a safety warning device and vehicle, this safety warning device include folded cascade warning piece, actuating mechanism and movable base, and this folded cascade warning piece and actuating mechanism set up on movable base, and folded cascade warning piece has fold condition and expansion state, and actuating mechanism is used for switching folded cascade warning piece from fold condition to expansion state. Because folded cascade warning piece is installed on movable base, can remove along with movable base, consequently, accessible movable base replacement personnel, as required, place folded cascade warning piece accurate position, treat the troubleshooting back, rethread movable base withdraws folded cascade warning piece to avoid the manual potential safety hazard that exists when placing and retrieving safety warning device of personnel. In addition, through setting up actuating mechanism, can also promote the degree of automation of placing safety warning device simultaneously practicing thrift the time of launching folded cascade warning piece, convenience, safety.

title_en: Automobile spring forming machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automobile spring processing technology field especially relates to an automobile spring forming machine. The technical scheme comprises the following steps: the protection assembly is installed to inside both sides of box, and infrared induction plate is installed to installation shell one side, and the signal transmission seat is installed to inside one side of installation shell, and the circuit connecting seat is installed through the wire in signal transmission seat one side, and the install bin is installed to the bottom half, and install bin internally mounted has auxiliary assembly, and compound spring is installed at the electromagnetism guide rail top, and the counter of weighing is installed at the compound spring top. The utility model discloses an infrared induction board can respond to all around to processing platform, infrared induction board transmission signal to signal transmission seat when foreign matter or staff are close to the processing platform region, signal transmission seat transmission signal to control panel, through control panel with the device shutdown, utilize the warning light to warn the staff simultaneously, avoid taking place the potential safety hazard in the course of working.
assignees: JIANGSU ISRI SHUANGDI SPRING CO LTD

title_en: Large vehicle turns right blind area warning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a large vehicle turns right blind area warning device, belongs to the intelligent transportation field, and warning device includes: warning area marks arranged on the road surface; a plurality of ground lane lights arranged along the identification edge of the warning area; and a sound and light warning unit; the acousto-optic warning unit comprises: support body, camera, display screen, speaker and control mainboard, support the body setting and be close to warning area sign department by the road, camera, display screen, speaker and control mainboard all set up on supporting the body, and the collection end of camera is towards warning area sign, and ground way lamp, camera, display screen and speaker are connected with the control mainboard electricity respectively. The beneficial effects of the utility model reside in that, warning device can effectively realize pedestrian/non-motor vehicle's automated inspection and discernment in the danger area through AI pedestrian detection camera to the reputation warning unit that links reminds to get into the pedestrian/non-motor vehicle in the warning area to notice observing, initiatively dodge, thereby reduce the occurence of failure probability.
assignees: SHENZHEN BOYUAN TECH INNOVATION DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Guard bar patrol machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of inspection devices, and provides a guardrail patrol machine which is used for solving the problem that a large amount of manpower and material resources are needed to patrol and detect on a current road; the driving unit is used for receiving a preset driving signal and driving the guardrail patrol machine to move relatively along the guardrail; the illegal snapshot unit is used for snapshot of illegal vehicle information preset on a road; the foreign matter monitoring unit is used for detecting whether preset foreign matter information exists on a road; the sound and light warning unit is used for warning the road according to a preset sound and light warning mode; and the real-time monitoring unit is used for acquiring the current image information of the road. The guardrail patrol machine can monitor foreign matters on the road and give an alarm correspondingly, and improves the driving safety of the road.

title_en: Tunnel patrol machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic warning control, and provides a tunnel patrol machine, which comprises: the system comprises a control unit, and a driving unit, a networking transmission unit, an illegal snapshot unit, a foreign matter monitoring unit, a gas monitoring unit, an acousto-optic warning unit, a real-time monitoring unit and a position positioning unit which are respectively and electrically connected with the control unit; the illegal snapshot unit is used for snapshot of preset vehicle illegal information in the tunnel and snapshot of the preset vehicle illegal information; the foreign matter detection unit is used for detecting whether preset foreign matter information exists in the tunnel or not; the gas monitoring unit is used for monitoring the air mass concentration in the tunnel; the acousto-optic warning unit is used for carrying out tunnel warning according to a preset acousto-optic warning mode; the real-time monitoring unit is used for acquiring preset traffic image information within a preset distance range; the position locating unit is used for obtaining current position information. The tunnel patrol machine can actively identify the foreign matters and abnormal parking events of the current tunnel in time and perform early warning.

title_en: Vehicle early warning method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle early warning method and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring information of a blind area of a vehicle, and determining an obstacle positioned in the blind area according to the information of the blind area; determining a display area of the obstacle on the HUD according to a first relative position of the obstacle and the running direction of the vehicle; and if the distance between the obstacle or the curve around the vehicle and the vehicle is smaller than or equal to the first distance, displaying the image of the obstacle in a display area in a gradual change mode, wherein under the gradual change mode, the smaller the distance is, the larger the contrast between the parameter value of the image of the obstacle and the parameter value of the initial image displayed on the vehicle-mounted HUD is, so that the potential safety hazard of vehicle early warning is reduced.

title_en: Visual prison of high tension cable terminal claps device with real-time early warning function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring and discloses a high-voltage cable terminal visualization monitoring device with a real-time early warning function, which comprises a vertical rod main body, wherein a camera set, a solar photovoltaic panel and a power distribution cabinet are arranged at the top of the vertical rod main body, the camera set comprises a processor unit, a fixed focus unit, an execution unit and a camera, the camera comprises a visible light camera and an infrared light camera, a rolling transparent belt is arranged on the circumference of the outer side of the camera, and a driver drives the transparent belt to move when foreign matters are arranged on the transparent belt on a lens so that a new section of transparent belt is blocked in front of the lens. The external damage phenomenon with potential safety hazards can be eliminated in time through the mode of flashing shouting or dispatching personnel, so that the cost of on-site investigation of workers can be reduced, the labor intensity of electric workers is effectively reduced, the reliability is high, the practicability is high, and the pollution to lenses caused by dust, winged insects, rainwater, icing and the like can be reduced.
assignees: HANGZHOU JUQI INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Gallium oxide film double-array device group for flame detection and identification and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gallium oxide film double-array device group for flame detection and identification and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of semiconductor photoelectric devices and flame monitoring. The device group comprises two functionally complementary and structurally independent arrays, namely an array of Ga  2 O 3  ultraviolet detectors which are grown on the basis of a high-temperature annealed sapphire substrate and have consistent orientation and are used for rapidly detecting the solar blind ultraviolet radiation of flames with high signal to noise ratio, and an array of non-oriented Ga  2 O 3  photoelectric synapses which are deposited on an unannealed substrate, wherein the array of non-oriented Ga  2 O 3  photoelectric synapses utilizes the plasticity caused by defect capture to realize the learning and classification identification of the space-time characteristics of the flames. In the preparation process, the Ga  2 O 3  active layers with controlled orientation and no orientation are respectively obtained by controlling whether the sapphire substrate is subjected to high-temperature annealing treatment or not. The two arrays can form a "probe-recognition" integrated solution. The scheme has simple structure, low power consumption and easy expansion, and is suitable for industrial security, combustion monitoring, forest fire early warning and other scenes.

title_en: none
abstract_en: Conventionally, since scraps are attached on a windshield of a vehicle due to foreign matters or scratches remaining after an illegal parking sticker is removed, disadvantages of causing a traffic accident or being difficult to remove are aroused. To solve such problem, a street alarm device to prevent illegal parking of the present invention comprises: a distance sensor to measure a distance between a vehicle being illegally parked and the sensor; an alarm sound device to issue an alarm sound when the measured distance is less than one meter, and to transfer a report to a related institution; an information transfer communication device to transmit the report; and an information processing device to process information. Accordingly, provided are effects of: alerting illegal parking with a signal through the alarm sound, not an illegal parking sticker; providing a first opportunity to one person illegally parking a vehicle as a report is received when warning is given to the person twice; and using the distance sensor to allow a user to set a distance as much as a required distance (a reference distance is one meter).
abstract_ko: 이물질 이나 기스 때문에 그 자동차의 앞 유리 창에 딱지가 붙어 운전중 사고가 날수도 있는 경우도 있고 떼어내기 귀찮다는 단점이 있다. 본 발명은 앞서 본 목적을 달성하기 위하여 다음과 같은 구성을 가진다. 본 발명의 거리경보음 불법주차는, 거리 센서: 거리를 측정 해주며 그 자동차의 거리와 센서의 거리를 측정 할 수 있게 한다. 경보음: 거리가 1미터 이내에 들어오면 이 경보음이 울려 이 경보음이 반복이 되면 신고 접수가 될 수 있도록 하는 경보음을 포함한다. 그리고 신고를 할 수 있도록 하는 정보 전달 통신 장치도 더 포함한다. 그리고 정보를 처리 할 수 있도록 하는 정보 처리 장치도 포함 된다.본 발명에 따른, 경보음을 통해 불법 주차 딱지가 아닌 신호로 경로를 줄 수 있게 하는 효과가 있다. 또한 경고를 2번을 받게 되면 신고 접수가 되어서 첫 번째의 기회를 불법주정차를 한 사람에게 기회를 줄 수 있는 효과가 있다, 또한 그 거리 센서가 작동하여 그 거리에 필요한 정도(미터) 만큼 사용자가 설정 할 수 있도록(기준은 1미터) 하는 것도 가능하다.

title_en: Auto-discovery of diverse communications devices for alert broadcasting
abstract_en: Methods and systems for communicating messages to target communications devices in a target physical location are disclosed. Network sources are queried for logical locations accessible to the network source. A specification of a physical location associated with each logical location is received. Each logical location specification is stored in a data store in association with the associated physical location specification. A specification of the target physical location is received. Those logical location specifications associated with the target physical location are retrieved from the data store, thereby identifying target logical locations. For each target logical location, at least one of the network sources accessible to that logical location is queried for specifications of communications devices accessible to that logical location, thereby identifying the communications devices in the target physical location. The message is communicated to the target communications devices in the target physical location via at least one of the target logical locations.
assignees: ABU-HAKIMA SUHAYYA;GRIGG KENNETH E;MCFARLAND CONNIE;GUEVREMONT VINCE;PISKORZ OSKAR;CHRISTIE COLIN

title_en: Location tracking system with interfaces for setting group zones, events and alerts based on multiple levels of administrative privileges
abstract_en: An improved system and method for defining an event based upon an object location and a user-defined zone and managing the conveyance of object location event information among computing devices where object location events are defined in terms of a condition based upon a relationship between user-defined zone information and object location information. One or more location information sources are associated with an object to provide the object location information. One or more user-defined zones are defined on a map and one or more object location events are defined. The occurrence of an object location event produces object location event information that is conveyed to users based on user identification codes. Accessibility to object location information, zone information, and object location event information is based upon an object location information access code, a zone information access code, and an object location event information access code, respectively.
assignees: GEOFENCE DATA ACCESS CONTROLS LLC;PERDIEMCO LLC

title_en: Early warning formula natural gas valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an early warning formula natural gas valve, the water-cooled double-layer valve comprises a valve body, the air inlet has been seted up to one side of valve body, and one side of valve body has seted up the gas outlet, the surface mounting of valve body has stabilizing mean, and stabilizing mean's inside including the connecting plate, the inside fixedly connected with head rod of connecting plate. The utility model discloses in, under stabilizing mean's effect, rotate on the surface of second connecting rod through first arc and second arc, can remove first arc and second arc to the pipeline that is connected with air inlet and gas outlet, through butt joint piece and the being connected to the groove on first arc and the second arc, can be with its restriction on the surface of pipeline, prevent when having foreign object and pipeline collision, the phenomenon that leads to the junction of pipeline and air inlet and gas outlet to appear leaking gas prevents to produce the potential safety hazard.
assignees: SUZHOU MEIJIALE MACHINERY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Safety protection system based on automatic transformation of air compressor and noble liquid pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mine intelligent equipment, in particular to a safety protection system based on automatic reconstruction of an air compressor and a precious liquid pump, which comprises an upper computer, a display screen, a PLC (programmable logic controller) and an alarm mechanism, the alarm mechanism comprises an alarm unit I matched with the air compressor and an alarm unit II matched with the noble liquid pump, and the alarm unit I and the alarm unit II are respectively and electrically connected with the PLC controller. The utility model discloses can realize the safety protection to the core equipment air compressor machine and the noble liquid pump of mine enterprise, when realizing remote monitoring and remote control, the data acquisition of accessible sensor, further carry out early warning, fast processing and traceing back to the risk such as the axle damage, overheated, start and the human factor of air compressor room conflagration, the overheat, human factor and the noble liquid pump that probably take place to the mine enterprise to the level of safety control of mine enterprise has been improved.

title_en: Expressway traffic condition evaluation and early warning integrated system based on distributed optical fibers
abstract_en: The invention relates to an expressway traffic condition evaluation and early warning integrated system based on a distributed optical fiber, which comprises a sensing optical fiber, a sensor optical fiber and a sensor optical fiber, wherein the sensing optical fiber is paved along the extending direction of an expressway road to capture sound waves or vibration signals; the distributed optical fiber signal receiving assembly and the data processing module are used for receiving sound waves or vibration signals transmitted by the sensing optical fibers and processing the signals into practical information; the input end of the expressway traffic condition evaluation module receives the practical information transmitted by the distributed optical fiber signal receiving assembly and the data processing module, and the practical information is output as an expressway traffic condition evaluation result of each road section; and the expressway traffic early warning response module receives the evaluation result transmitted by the expressway traffic condition evaluation module and controls the alarm lamps on the expressway to display different colors and flashing frequencies or simultaneously give out alarm sounds according to the evaluation result. The invention is a monitoring mode which has low cost, is not influenced by external conditions such as weather and the like and has no blind area, and effectively monitors the traffic condition of the high-speed road section.
assignees: NINGBO DIGITAL TWIN DONGFANG INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Railway line multi-scene three-dimensional foreign matter intrusion monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scene three-dimensional foreign matter intrusion monitoring method and a system thereof along a railway, which belong to the technical field of railway safety detection, wherein a foreign matter intrusion composite sensing network is arranged on a protective structure of the railway along the whole line, real-time sensing positioning data are acquired, abnormal positioning positions of a protective net are acquired according to the real-time sensing positioning data, foreign matter intrusion detection data acquired at the same time by a corresponding arranged radar integrated machine at the same position are acquired, the category and track of a foreign matter intrusion target are acquired, a preset foreign matter intrusion early warning and inspection scheme is generated to a terminal according to a preset intrusion judgment rule, and the real-time monitoring and early warning of the railway foreign matter intrusion are realized by arranging a foreign matter intrusion composite sensing network consisting of sensing optical fibers and the radar integrated machine on the protective structure in a prevention and control maintenance area along the whole line railway.
assignees: NANJING PAI SMART PERCEPTION INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent blind guiding method, intelligent blind guiding equipment, computer readable storage medium and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of navigation, and particularly relates to an intelligent blind guiding method, intelligent blind guiding equipment, a computer readable storage medium and terminal equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring the current geographic position of a user; receiving a destination instruction, and acquiring all paths from the current geographical position of a user to the geographical position of a destination carried in the destination instruction; acquiring an optimal path in all the paths, and starting navigation according to the optimal path; detecting whether an obstacle exists in the optimal path in real time, and if so, sending an obstacle early warning signal to a user; and receiving a request signal sent by a user, and indicating the user to leave the obstacle according to the request signal. The invention can solve the problems that more help can not be provided for users, the use method is not convenient and efficient enough, and meanwhile, great potential safety hazard exists for the traveling of the blind.

title_en: A message circulation system for contingencyaccident/disaster
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for automatic text-to-speech/image conversion and transmission of a disaster notification message. According to the present invention, the system includes: a text-to-speech conversion module for converting a disaster notification message also called as a cell broadcasting service (CBS) transmitted from a state administration agency in a wired or wireless manner to a speech; and a speaker module which outputs the converted speech from the text-to-speech conversion module. The speaker module can output the converted speech sounds selectively in a low-frequency band region, a middle frequency band region, a high-frequency band region, or a combination thereof. In the event of a disaster such as a typhoon, flood, heavy rain, tsunami, flooding, snowfall, and earthquake, the system of the present invention can output the CBS transmitted from the state administration agency in the low-frequency band region, the middle frequency band region, the high-frequency band region, or the combination thereof as speech or images to each household, thereby enabling the public, hearing-impaired patients, and elderly people to actively cope with a disaster.
abstract_ko:
재난문자 음성화/시각화 자동 전송 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 재난문자 음성화/시각화 자동 전송 시스템은, 재난문자 음성화/시각화 자동 전송 시스템으로서, 국가행정기관으로부터 유선 또는 무선으로 전달받은 재난전달문자(CBS)를 음성으로 변환하는 문자음성변환모듈과, 상기 문자음성변환모듈로부터의 변환된 음성을 출력하는 스피커 모듈을 포함하여 이루어지되, 상기 스피커 모듈은 변환된 음성 신호를 선택적으로 또는 함께 저음대 영역, 중음대 영역 및 고음대 영역 또는 이의 조합 영역으로 출력되게 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에 따른 재난문자 음성화/시각화 자동 전송 시스템은 태풍, 홍수, 호우, 해일, 침수, 폭설, 지진 등과 같은 재난상황 발생 시 국가행정기관으로부터 전달받은 재난전달문자(CBS)를 저음대 영역, 중음대 영역 및 고음대 영역 또는 이의 조합 영역으로 음성화하여 출력하거나 또는 시각적으로 출력하여 각 가정에 전달함으로써 일반인이나 청각 장애가 있는 환자 및 노약자도 재난에 능동적으로 대처할 수 있는 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Distributed healthcare communication system
abstract_en: A graphical audio station of a nurse call system is operable to permit a user to perform one or more of the following functions: establish a two-way voice communication link with another computer device in another patient and/or with a another computer device located in another staff work area and/or with a wireless communication device carried by caregiver and/or with a telephone of the healthcare facility; broadcast a voice page to a group of other selected computer devices; compose and send a text message to a portable device that is carried by a caregiver and that has wireless communication capability; browse web pages and/or view multimedia content, such as videos, hosted on servers of the healthcare facility and/or that are accessible via the Internet; view and/or acknowledge and/or answer and/or cancel alerts or nurse calls originating in a plurality of patient rooms.

title_en: Household security monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a domestic security protection monitoring device belongs to domestic security protection technical field, including the base and install the vase on the base, the supervisory equipment has been cup jointed on the vase, is connected with charging device on the base, and the base includes supporting seat and sets up a plurality of supporting legs in the supporting seat bottom, and the vase includes the body, sets up at the bottleneck at body top and sets up at the bottom of the bottle of body bottom, and the top of bottleneck is equipped with a plurality of early warning lamps, and supervisory equipment is equipped with a plurality of cameras including cup jointing at the outside collar of body on the collar. The utility model discloses a place the vase of different styles on the base and put the house in, with fitment style collocation, can place the bouquet in the vase and improve the aesthetic property, a plurality of cameras monitor to the house to transmit the control picture for the cell-phone, detect indoor someone and remove and send the warning message to the cell-phone when the camera, accessible cell-phone operation starts the player and sends the early warning, and the early warning lamp twinkles the red light simultaneously.
assignees: ANHUI YINYUE ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent corner alarm
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of alarms, and particularly relates to an intelligent corner alarm which comprises a shell capable of being installed at a corner, wherein a PCB (printed circuit board) and a battery are fixedly connected inside the shell, equipment installation sides are arranged on two sides of the shell, radar sensor units are fixedly connected on the equipment installation sides, warning equipment is further arranged on the shell, the battery, the radar sensor units and the warning equipment are electrically connected with the radar sensor units, the warning equipment comprises a buzzer and two radar sensor units, the buzzer and the two radar sensor units are electrically connected with the PCB, the buzzer is fixedly connected on the shell, the two radar sensor units are respectively and fixedly connected on the two equipment installation sides, two connection sides are arranged on the rear side of the shell, and first magnetic attraction pieces are fixedly connected on the two connection sides. The utility model can reduce collision accidents caused by blind areas of sight at corners.

title_en: Multi-voltage-grade and multi-configuration power grid external-damage-prevention remote precise electricity testing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an external damage prevention remote accurate electricity testing device for a multi-voltage-class and multi-configuration power grid, which comprises an external damage prevention monitoring system and a remote electricity testing system, wherein the external damage prevention monitoring system comprises an ultrasonic ranging module, an early warning module and a remote monitoring module, the early warning module is used for sending an alarm to the remote monitoring module and starting the remote monitoring module to remotely monitor a target area when the ultrasonic ranging module detects that a foreign object exceeds the safety distance of the target area, the remote electricity testing system comprises non-contact handheld equipment and an electricity testing module arranged at the top end of the handheld equipment, and the remote monitoring module is provided with an image acquisition instrument. title_en: Crime prevention and call signal alarm system using sms service and method thereof

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for blocking a criminal sign and issuing a rescue signal and a method thereof. The method of the present invention comprises the steps of: wirelessly transmitting a sensing signal of a sensor or a rescue request signal including a personal identification code to a mobile communications alarm repeater installed in an adjacent safety blind spot with an RF signal when an emergency remote controller carrier simply operates a button; outputting, by the mobile communications alarm repeater, an alarm light, an alarm sound, or a rescue voice in response to the reception of the rescue request signal, and simultaneously transmitting a communications modem unique number of the mobile communications alarm repeater with the personal identification code to an emergency management server through a mobile communications network; confirming, by the emergency management server, customer information using the personal identification code, and then requesting a push server to transmit an SMS notification message including a name, an emergency contact phone number, and the like of a corresponding customer; and transmitting, by the push server, the SMS notification message to the emergency contact number by interworking with an application server, and allowing the SMS notification message to be popped-up in a receiver terminal by generating an alarm sound such as a siren and converting the screen into yellow.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 범죄 징후 차단 및 구조 신호 통보 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 감지센서의 감지신호나 비상 리모컨 휴대자가 간단하게 버튼을 조작하면 개인식별코드를 포함하는 구조요청신호가 근방의 안전사각지대에 설치된 이동통신 경보중계기에 RF신호로 무선 전송되고, 이동통신 경보중계기에서는 상기 구조요청신호의 수신에 따라 경광등, 경보음 또는 구조음성을 출력함과 동시에 상기 개인식별코드와 함께 이동통신 경보중계기 자신의 통신모뎀 고유번호를 위기관리서버로 이동통신망으로 전송하며, 위기관리서버에서는 상기 개인식별코드를 이용하여 고객정보를 확인한 후 푸시서버에 해당 고객의 성명, 긴급연락 전화번호, 비상연락 전화번호 등을 포함하는 SMS 알림 메시지를 전송하도록 요청하며, 푸시서버에서는 어플리케이션 서버와 연동하여 상기 긴급연락전화번호에 SMS 알림 메시지를 전송하되, 수신자 단말기에서는 싸이렌 소리와 같은 경고음 울리고 화면이 노란색으로 전환되면서 상기 SMS 알림 메시지가 팝업 되도록 이루어져 있다.

title_en: Charging safety device for eco-friendly vehicle and control method thereof
title_ko: 친환경 차량용 충전 안전장치 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a charging safety device for an eco-friendly vehicle mounted on a charging door module and an inlet of an eco-friendly vehicle including a plug-in hybrid vehicle and an electric vehicle, and a control method thereof. In addition, the present invention includes: a foreign substance inspection unit that inspects foreign substances including moisture present in an inlet terminal and a terminal hole provided in an inlet when a charging door of the inlet is opened in order to charge an eco-friendly vehicle; a foreign substance removal unit connected to the terminal hole of the inlet to discharge wind from the inside of the terminal hole to the outside thereof; and a control unit, when a foreign substance is identified, stopping a charging process due to a charging controller by sending a notification, notifying whether the foreign substance is present, to the charging controller of the eco-friendly vehicle and operating the foreign material removal unit to remove the foreign substances in the terminal and the terminal hole of the inlet, thereby identifying whether there exist, in the inlet, the foreign substances, including moisture, which cause a charging failure or an accident in a charging process of the eco-friendly vehicle and effectively removing the foreign substances including moisture present in the inlet.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 플러그인 하이브리드 차량 및 전기 차량을 포함하는 친환경 차량의 충전 도어 모듈과 인렛에 탑재되는 친환경 차량용 충전 안전장치 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것이다. 
또한, 본 발명은 친환경 차량의 충전을 위해 인렛의 충전 도어가 열리면, 인렛에 구비되는 인렛 단자와 단자홀에 존재하는 수분을 포함하는 이물질을 검사하는 이물질 검사부와, 인렛의 단자홀에 연결되어 단자홀 내측에서 외부로 바람을 토출하는 이물질 제거부와, 이물질이 확인되면, 친환경 차량의 충전 제어기에 이물질의 존재 여부를 알리는 알림을 전송하여 충전 제어기에 의한 충전 프로세스를 중지시키고, 이물질 제거부를 동작시켜서 인렛의 단자와 단자홀 내 이물질을 제거하는 제어부를 구비함으로써, 친환경 차량의 충전 과정에서 충전 불량이나 안전사고를 야기하는 수분을 포함하는 이물질이 인렛에 존재하는지 확인하고, 인렛에 존재하는 수분을 포함하는 이물질을 효과적으로 제거할 수 있다.

title_en: Wireless Power System With Foreign Object Detection
abstract_en: A wireless power system has a wireless power transmitting device and a wireless power receiving device. The wireless power transmitting device may be a wireless charging mat or other device with a charging surface. The wireless power receiving device may be a portable electronic device receiving transmitted wireless power signals from the wireless power transmitting device while resting on the charging surface. During digital ping operations, low-power wireless power signals may be transmitted from the wireless power transmitting device. Information gathered during the digital ping such as wireless power transmission efficiency information, coupling coefficient information, Q-factor information, and coil inductance information may be used in determining whether a foreign object is present. Control circuitry in the transmitting device can cause the receiving device to present an alert for a user indicating that wireless power transfer operations are commencing in response to determining that no foreign object is present.

title_en: Alert device, system and method
abstract_en: Alert device, system and method for alerting hearing-impaired persons through a sensory of a sound and the location of such sound. The device extends to the tracking of an object within a predefined perimeter, outside of which an alert is triggerable. The device includes a wearable unit having a plurality of differently colored LEDs and a plurality of differently colored sound-detecting units, with each of the differently colored sound-detecting units corresponding to the same colored LED's on the wearable unit thereby to color code the wearable unit to the sound-detecting units. When a sound is detected by one or more of the sound-detecting units being higher than a predetermined threshold sound, a sound event signal is triggered on the wearable unit activating a vibration and blinking of the LED's corresponding with the respective sound detecting unit, consequentially alerting a user of the location where the sound-detecting unit was previously positioned.

title_en: System and method for a security checkpoint using radio signals
abstract_en: A security device for monitoring the radio frequency signals generated by mobile phones and similar mobile computing and communication devices. The security device employs an antennae array and computer process that are configured to detect and provide a “fingerprint” for a mobile device based on the unique identifiers contained with the radio and other wireless signals utilized by such mobile device. The “fingerprint” that is obtained can be used to keep track of mobile devices as those devices enter and leave the area of the security device. Moreover, the security device can provide an alert when any new, foreign, or otherwise unrecognized device is within range of the security device and share “fingerprints” and alerts with other security devices in its network.

title_en: Rain and flood drainage road risk early warning method and device

title_en: Safety monitoring method and system for translation of disc buckle type full framing

title_en: Emergency notification system for hearing-impaired persons and the like
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an emergency notification system for hearing-impaired persons and the like in which, wherever a hearing-impaired person or the like who is disable to utter, can make an emergency notification at ease and surely and can receive the result thereof, and a notification method.SOLUTION: The emergency notification system comprises: a notification application for transmitting positional information and emergency information to a notification server; the notification server in which a present position is transferred to the positional information server together with member information and artificially converted into voices by a voice synthesis section and a telephone set at the side of a call center is called; and the call center in which an operator receives the emergency information via a display of the positional information server and the telephone set and then requires a dispatch to an emergency agency. Dial buttons of the telephone set corresponding to several kinds of message patterns encoded beforehand are pressed, one response message selected from among a plurality of encoded response messages is transmitted and the message is displayed in the notification application, thereby contacting a person who made the notification.

title_en: Emergency alert systems and methods for differently abled persons
abstract_en: Emergency alert systems and methods for disabled and/or differently abled persons are disclosed. Upon receiving an alert message, the system translates the alert message to an audio message (text to speech) when the text to speech feature is enabled. In some implementations, the system waits for a threshold period of time (e.g., 30 seconds) to receive a user acknowledgment of the alert message, and translates the alert message to an audio message if no acknowledgment is received within this time. The user acknowledgment can be received via a selection of an option (e.g., by clicking an “OK” button) and/or via an audio option (e.g., by saying “Ok, received”) when the text to speech feature is enabled. The system then outputs (e.g., reads out loud) the translated message so that the disabled or differently abled persons can be informed of the emergency situation. After outputting the translated message, the system can further wait for a user acknowledgment of the translated audio message.

title_en: Railway disaster prevention safety monitoring system

The railway disaster prevention safety monitoring system carries out real-time monitoring, acquisition, summarizing, alerting, early warning and emergency treatment on natural disasters like gale, rainfall, snowfall, earthquake and the like, foreign matter invasion and accidents to realize the distributive acquisition, the centralized management and the comprehensive utilization of monitoring information. The system adopts a corresponding emergency treatment measure according to the order of severity of the disasters and provides the technical support for regulating an operation plan and transmitting traffic control, recovering traffic, rescuing, inspecting and maintaining and the like so as to avoid or relieve the loss caused by the disasters and secondary disasters to the maximum limit.

The fire safety warning device based on the Internet of things comprises a fire-fighting lamp plate and a beam-splitting screen assembly, wherein the beam-splitting screen assembly is arranged inside the fire-fighting lamp plate, the fire-fighting lamp plates are connected through a pipeline channel, and the pipeline channel is connected with the fire-fighting lamp plate through a clamping groove. title_en: Method, system, device and storage medium for preventing and controlling fire-fighting risk of stadium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for preventing and controlling fire risks of a stadium, and relates to the field of building fire risk prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of monitoring and collecting environmental data in a stadium, judging whether the environment is abnormal or not according to the distribution condition of the environmental data in real time, determining abnormal environmental data according to the abnormal condition appearing in the environmental data, and further determining a risk coefficient based on the abnormal environmental data through a pre-trained risk identification model to serve as a reference index of risk early warning. Under the condition that the risk coefficient reaches a certain emergency degree, the possible flowing condition of the staff in the stadium is predicted by further combining the risk coefficient, the predicted flowing condition is used as reference information for staff evacuation, managers are assisted to find possible staff congestion or staff blind areas, reference is provided for fast and orderly evacuation of the staff, and better safety guarantee is provided for the staff in the stadium.

title_en: Road geological disaster monitoring and early warning method integrating road segmentation and visual detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway geological disaster monitoring and early warning method integrating road segmentation and visual detection, which comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring data through real-time monitoring video of a highway or tunnel portal, reading real-time data flow by corresponding edge computing equipment, configuring a visual large model algorithm, S2, running the visual large model algorithm by the edge computing equipment to realize road pavement segmentation and acquire pavement segmentation results, S3, running the image processing algorithm by the edge computing equipment to detect foreign matters on the pavement segmentation results and sending the detection results to a cloud server, and S4, identifying the road disaster results and sending dangerous information to early warn by the cloud server according to the detection results. The method integrates advanced AI algorithm, high-performance hardware equipment and flexible cloud service, and constructs a highway geological disaster monitoring and early warning system with high efficiency, intelligence and sustainable development.
assignees: ANHUI TRANSPORT CONSULTING & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Heavy-load all-link collaborative monitoring and controlling system and method for national provincial road bridge
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for cooperatively monitoring and controlling heavy-load full links of national provincial bridges, wherein the system comprises a heavy-load source butt joint and prediction module, a dynamic distribution control module, a multi-source data fusion and damage assessment module and a cooperative management closed loop module which are sequentially connected, wherein the system accurately monitors by butt joint enterprise transportation data and predicting a time window of a vehicle reaching a bridge, and accordingly actively schedules sensing equipment, calculates damage degree caused by overload based on highway bridge engineering specification logic quantization by fusing vehicle load and bridge structure response data, carries out targeted risk assessment on special bridges such as single piers and low ratings, and finally automatically generates a grading early warning and repairing scheme according to an assessment result, and forms a treatment closed loop in parallel with multiple departments such as traffic, maintenance, emergency and the like. The invention realizes the full-link coordination from the source to the management, solves the problems of monitoring blind areas, damage attribution and response dislocation, and remarkably improves the heavy load safety prevention and control capability of the bridge.
assignees: INST OF HIGHWAY SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY OF YUNNAN PROVINCE

title_en: Voice signal-vibration signal conversion device for the hearing impaired person
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a voice signal-vibration signal conversion device for a hearing-impaired person and, more specifically, to a voice signal-vibration signal conversion device for a hearing-impaired person, which converts information provided by various voices into a digital code, and converts the converted digital code into vibration at a level that the hearing-impaired person can detect, so that the hearing-impaired person can recognize voice information. According to the present invention, the voice signal-vibration signal conversion device for the hearing-impaired person enables the hearing-impaired person to equally recognize voice information with the general public in real time, thereby promoting convenience of life and, in particular, actively coping with public transportation and disaster warning. In addition, the voice signal-vibration signal conversion device for the hearing-impaired person according to the present invention utilizes vibration that can be detected by the skin of the hearing impaired person, thereby improving information recognition ability that can be easily missed by sight, and contributing to popularization with optimal expenses by using a personal smart device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 청각장애자를 위한 음성신호-진동신호 변환장치에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 각종 음성으로 제공되는 정보들을 디지털 코드로 변환하고, 변환된 디지털 코드를 청각장애자가 감지할 수 있는 수준의 진동으로 변환하여 시정착 장애자가 음성 정보를 인식할 수 있도록 하는 청각장애자를 위한 음성신호-진동신호 변환장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 청각장애자를 위한 음성신호-진동신호 변환장치는 청각장애자들이 음성정보를 일반인과 대등하게 실시간으로 인식할 수 있어 생활의 편리함 도모할 수 있고, 특히, 대중교통 및 재난 경보에도 능동적인 대처가 가능하다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따른 청각장애자를 위한 음성신호-진동신호 변환장치는 청각장애자들의 피부로 감지 가능한 진동을 활용함으로서 시각에 의한 놓치기 쉬운 정보인지능력을 개선하고, 개인 소지의 스마트기기를 활용함으로 최적의 경비로 대중화에 기여할 수 있다.
assignees: IND ACADEMIC COOPERATION SUNCHEON FIRST COLLEGE

title_en: Blind area detection method and blind area detection sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blind area detection method and a blind area detection sensor, which belong to the technical field of blind area detection and comprise the following steps of S1, collecting real-time data of vehicle blind area detection, processing the real-time data of the vehicle blind area detection to determine characteristic data of the vehicle blind area detection, S2, determining an optimal blind area detection induction model, S3, carrying out predictive analysis on the characteristic data of the vehicle blind area detection based on the optimal blind area detection induction model, and S4, making a vehicle blind area detection induction early warning management and control scheme, and carrying out early warning management and control on safety risks of vehicle blind area detection induction. The invention solves the problems that the existing blind zone detection induction of the vehicle cannot be performed in real time, and timely early warning management and control cannot be provided, so that the blind zone detection induction effect is poor, and the occurrence of safety accidents cannot be effectively reduced.

title_en: The apparatus recognition to operate a every conditions
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 청각장애 및 난청인용 상황별 인식장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 청각장애 및 난청이 있는 운전자가 운전중 철도건널목 차단기의 경보음이나, 응급차량(일예 : 응급차, 소방차, 경찰차, 렉카)의 사이렌 소리, 충돌 및 급브레이크 소리를 차량 내부 장치와 호환되면서 운전자의 눈(시각)과 몸(촉각)을 통해 동시에 인식할 수 있도록 음향센서부, 마이컴, 발광부, 문자·수화표시부, 진동부로 구성됨으로서, 저렴한 비용으로 기존의 차량 내부 장치와 호환이 잘 되고, 빠른 반응속도로 인해 운전자가 안전운전을 할 수 있는 청각장애 및 난청인용 상황별 인식장치를 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: Entrance guard attendance machine with epidemic prevention function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an entrance guard's attendance machine with epidemic prevention function in attendance equipment field, including fixed casing with set up the main control circuit board in fixed casing, one side of fixed casing is provided with the display screen module, button module and fingerprint identification module, the upper end of fixed casing is provided with infrared temperature probe and face identification camera side by side, before using, need to type staff's face information and fingerprint information respectively through face identification camera and fingerprint identification module storage module department in the main control circuit board, when using, just accessible face identification camera and fingerprint identification module carry out identity identification to the user, in order to carry out the attendance and punch the card, when carrying out the attendance and punch the card, detect user's body temperature through infrared temperature probe, when the temperature is normal, the LED lamp area sends the green glow, the loudspeaker module sends through the suggestion, when the temperature is abnormal, the LED lamp sends dazzling ruddiness glow, the loudspeaker module sends the thorn ear warning, in order to make epidemic prevention and remind.
assignees: SHENZHEN SHANKANG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Blind guiding auxiliary system and helmet
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of electronic circuits, and particularly discloses a blind guiding auxiliary system and a helmet, the intelligent remote control system comprises a main control chip, a sound detection module, a light detection module, a camera module, an ultrasonic ranging module, a vibration module, a voice module, a light warning module and a help-seeking key module which are electrically connected with the main control chip. The utility model can realize the blind guiding assistance of the visually impaired in different scenes through effective environment detection, improves the blind guiding efficiency, and improves the safety and reliability of blind guiding; the blind guiding prompt requirements in different scenes can be met through the sound and vibration prompt function, so that visually impaired people can receive prompt information effectively; the acousto-optic help seeking information can be rapidly sent out under emergency through the help seeking key and the acousto-optic warning function, so that visually impaired people can obtain help in time.
assignees: CHENGDU GUOXINAN INFORMATION IND BASE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and early warning method and system for forest fire prevention
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of forest fire prevention early warning, and provides an intelligent monitoring early warning method and system for forest fire prevention. The method comprises the steps of dividing a plurality of monitoring subareas, calculating risk indexes of the plurality of subareas, carrying out hierarchical analysis, selecting the plurality of risk subareas, determining corresponding risk levels, matching a plurality of monitoring densities and monitoring shooting frequencies, carrying out unmanned aerial vehicle flight and monitoring shooting control on the plurality of monitoring subareas, and carrying out calculation and comparison of fire judgment according to RGB three-color channels. The method has the advantages that the method can divide a plurality of monitoring subareas to monitor, calculate a plurality of subarea risk indexes, select a plurality of risk subareas, determine corresponding risk levels, match different monitoring densities and monitoring beat frequencies to carry out unmanned aerial vehicle flight and monitoring beat, further carry out calculation comparison of fire judgment according to RGB three-color channels, effectively reduce the influence of blind areas of forest fire prevention monitoring, improve the comprehensiveness of monitoring, and have high accuracy, and can meet the requirements of intellectualization and low cost.
assignees: SHENZHEN KUNYUAN ECOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode barrier-free interaction system for safety medication management of visually impaired patients
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent medical treatment, and discloses a multi-mode barrier-free interaction system for safety medication management of visually impaired patients. In the process of medication management, the central control and decision module is used for dispatching multi-mode interaction of touch sense, hearing sense and voice to realize guiding user operation, the safety rule engine is used for carrying out dose check and incompatibility judgment, the state feedback and fusion module is used for encoding the system state into a cross-mode signal to provide consistent feedback, the safety and emergency module is used for monitoring abnormal operation, the fusion mechanism is started for locking an interface and giving out a warning, and the whole system follows the closed-loop principle of guiding-operation-confirmation-feedback and replaces visual functions through multi-mode cooperation. The invention improves the accuracy and the operation reliability of medication management and enhances the safety of the whole process.
assignees: SHENZHEN LONGGANG DISTR NO 8 PEOPLES HOSPITAL

title_en: The apparatus of recognition a hadicapped person of heraing with sequence control
title_ko: 시퀀스 제어를 통한 청각장애인용 인식 장치
abstract_en: A sound recognition apparatus for a hearing-impaired person is provided to notify a message accurately by registering predetermined sounds and notifying the sounds according to the priority. A sound recognition apparatus for a hearing-impaired person includes a specific sound detector(100) and a notifying unit. The specific sound detector includes a micro sensor unit(110), an amplifier circuit unit(120), a first microcomputer unit(130), and an RF(Radio Frequency) transmitter(140), which are integrated in one module. The specific sound detector detects the specific sound and transmits the detected sound to the notifying unit by using an RF transmission scheme. The sound is converted to an electrical signal. A BLM(Boundary Layer Microphone) reproduces the electrical signal as a sound signal having a frequency within an audible frequency range.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 일상 생활에서 발생하는 중요한 가청음(일예 : 화재 통보기의 경보음，가스 누출 경보기의 경보음，휴대 전화기의 호출음, 팩시밀리 장치의 호출음, 전자레인지의 가열 종료 통보음，세탁기 그 밖의 전기 제품으로부터 발생한 통보음，방문자의 벨 소리)을 청각 장애인이 시퀀스 제어를 통해 시각적, 촉각적 또는 시각적 + 촉각적으로 동시에 인식할 수 있도록, 특정 생활음 검출 수단과, 청각장애인용 통보 수단으로 구성된 청각장애인용 인식장치를 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
       
     가청음, 청각장애인, 마이컴부, 인식 장치

title_en: Storm Avoiding Buildings and Structures
abstract_en: A building sheltering structure is configured to facilitate the shielding of at least one domicile or building into an underground foundation before an emergency environmental condition arises. The foundation includes a cover plate that translates horizontally to occlude the at least one domicile upon retraction into a secure cavity of the foundation by a lift assembly positioned at the bottom of the foundation cavity. Mounted atop the lift assembly, the at least one domicile can be fully retracted into the foundation cavity and completely shielded by the cover plate. The operation of the lift assembly is commanded and powered by a supply system. A processor of the supply system facilitates emergency warnings and panic transmissions to signal for help. Further, the supply system accommodates a plurality of solar panels mounted atop the at least one domicile to keep the system charged for the use in emergency.

title_en: Services for protection of a user's legal rights in a legal emergency accessible from a provider via world wide web
abstract_en: Methods and computer program are disclosed for enabling the use of an individual's wireless personal communication device, such as a cellular telephone, e.g. IPhone™, to acquire the information vital to the preservation of the individual's personal and property legal rights in legal emergency situations. A user can activate services for protection of the user's legal rights in a legal emergency situation accessible from a provider via the Internet. A set of instructions for actions to be taken by the user is provided, accessible via the Internet by said communication device. The user can predetermine a time-out period for commencing recording audio/video and transmitting an emergency message to a user-predetermined contact if dialog is interrupted before end of the time-out period. The user's activation location can be detected, and attorneys in the user's activation location can be notified of the user's emergency situation.

title_en: Strobe light alarm detection and alert system
abstract_en: An alert system includes a detection device (14) that detects an optical alarm signal, such as a light pattern generated by a strobe light (12) of a building alarm system. Upon detecting the optical alarm signal, the alert system generates a supplemental alert signal capable of alerting an individual who might not otherwise respond to the alarm condition, such as an individual who is asleep, hearing impaired, and/or sight impaired. For example, the system may activate a tactile vibrator (22), a low frequency audio generator (26), and/or a liquid sprayer (28). The system may, for example, be implemented as a patient-worn device, a bedside unit, or a personal computer coupled to a light-sensing peripheral device.

title_en: Notification system and service method for pedestrian crossing signals for the visually impaired
title_ko: 시각 장애인을 위한 횡단 보도 신호 알림 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a crosswalk signal notification system for the visually impaired comprising: a signal light for a crosswalk; a traffic signal controller controlling a lighting signal of the signal light for a crosswalk; and a speaker and a beacon receiver mounted on an installation object in a crosswalk area. If a device equipped with a beacon transmitter approaches within a communicable distance with the beacon receiver, a crosswalk signal information voice or a sound is outputted through the speaker. The present invention provides a system and a notification service method allowing a visually impaired person to easily and accurately recognize signal information if the visually impaired person enters a crosswalk to prevent accidents.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 시각 장애인을 위한 횡단 보도 신호 알림 시스템에 관한 것으로, 횡단 보도용 신호등; 상기 횡단 보도용 신호등의 점등 신호를 제어하는 교통신호 제어기; 및 횡단 보도 구역의 설치물에 장착된 스피커 및 비콘 수신기를 포함하여 구성하되, 비콘(Beacon) 송신기가 장착된 디바이스가 상기 비콘(Beacon) 수신기와 통신 가능한 거리 내에 접근하는 경우, 상기 스피커를 통해 횡단 보도 신호 정보 음성 또는 음향을 출력하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이와 같은 본 발명은 시각 장애인이 횡단 보도에 진입하는 경우 용이하고 정확하게 신호 정보를 인지시켜 안전사고를 예방할 수 있는 시스템 및 알림 서비스 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Personal emergency alert system, method, and device
abstract_en: A system, method and device for notifying designated recipients about a personal emergency. An individual maintains a personal emergency alert device (PEAD) in accessible proximity. The PEAD is activated by onboard or remote sensor(s) in proximity to the PEAD. The sensor(s) monitor the occurrence of an emergency activation event. PEAD includes a controller. The controller, triggered by detection of an emergency event by a sensor, activates a geolocation module to obtain geolocation information, formulates an alert message, establishes a network connection, and transmits the message with geolocation information to a personal emergency alert notification service (PEANS). PEANS responds by sending a text, email or other emergency notification to designated notification recipient(s). Once activated, PEAD periodically tracks and transmits its geolocation until it runs out of power. Alternatively, PEAD can be deactivated by sending a deactivation code to the PEANS, which in turn instructs such PEAD to deactivate.

title_en: Customer-controlled instant-response anti-fraud/anti-identity theft devices (with true-personal identity verification), method and systems for secured global applications in personal/business e-banking, e-commerce, e-medical/health insurance checker, e-education/research/invention, e-disaster advisor, e-immigration, e-airport/aircraft security, e-military/e-law enforcement, with or without NFC component and system, with cellular/satellite phone/internet/multi-media functions
abstract_en: All-in-one wireless mobile telecommunication devices, methods and systems providing greater customer-control, instant-response anti-fraud/anti-identity theft protections with instant alarm, messaging and secured true-personal identity verifications for numerous registered customers/users, with biometrics and PIN security, operating with manual, touch-screen and/or voice-controlled commands, achieving secured rapid personal/business e-banking, e-commerce, accurate transactional monetary control and management, having interactive audio-visual alarm/reminder preventing fraudulent usage of legitimate physical and/or virtual credit/debit cards, with checks anti-forgery means, curtailing medical/health/insurance frauds/identity thefts, having integrated cellular and/or satellite telephonic/internet and multi-media means, equipped with language translations, GPS navigation with transactions tagging, currency converters, with or without NFC components, minimizing potential airport risks/mishaps, providing instant aid against school bullying, kidnapping, car-napping and other crimes, applicable for secured military/immigration/law enforcements, providing guided warning/rescue during emergencies and disasters.

title_en: Special vacuum cup for the blind
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vacuum cup, in particular a special vacuum cup for the blind, the special vacuum cup having separate air inlet and air exhaust hole and being provided with vibration and buzzing warning signals. The special vacuum cup comprises an air inlet, an air inlet rubber plug, an air exhaust valve, an air valve composed of a valve a ball-shaped object and an air valve rubber plug, a contact carriage arranged in a cup body, a contact in the contact carriage, a circuit spring contact sheet, an upper sleeve, a lower carriage, a spring, a battery box, a vibrator sleeve and a nut. A buzzer is arranged in a hole on a cup wall and is in sleeve joint with a spiral wiring sleeve through a sealing ring, a cup body seal and a buzzer wiring pin, which facilitates mounting and dismounting of the contact carriage. Vacuum sucking force varies during cupping, and the contact moves up and down in the carriage to power on and off the circuit through the circuit spring contact sheet. And, a blind operator can know the vacuum force based on the signals sent out by a vibrator and the buzzer when the circuit is powered on or off.

title_en: Portable instrument for warning deaf people of objects moving at back sides
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a portable instrument for warning deaf people of objects moving at back sides, and is characterized in that the portable instrument comprises a detector and a hand ring, wherein a detector power supply, an ultrasonic detector module, a detector master controller and a wireless transmitting module are disposed in the detector, and a hand ring power supply, a wireless receiving module, a hand ring master controller and a lighting vibration module are disposed in the hand ring; the detector power supply is individually connected with the ultrasonic detector module, the detector master controller and the wireless transmitting module, the ultrasonic detector module is connected with the detector master controller, the detector master controller is connected with the wireless transmitting module, and the wireless transmitting module is in wireless connection with the wireless receiving module; and the wireless receiving module is connected with the hand ring master controller, the hand ring master controller is connected with the lighting vibration module, and the hand ring power supply is individually connected with the wireless receiving module, the hand ring master controller and the lighting vibration module. The portable instrument is simple in structure, convenient in usage and small in size.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting detection system for tunnel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tunnel intelligence fire control detecting system, including box, audible-visual annunciator and smoke alarm, the internally mounted of box has the controller, audible-visual annunciator is installed to one side of box, install the mount pad in the audible-visual annunciator, the internally mounted of mount pad has loudspeaker, the warning light is installed at the top of mount pad, gas detection ware is installed to the opposite side of box, smoke alarm is installed to the bottom of box. The utility model discloses an install the audible-visual annunciator in one side of box, through the alarming function of the multiplicable device of audible-visual annunciator, make it when detecting out smog content and surpassing the safe value, what in the accessible controller control audible-visual annunciator had loudspeaker and warning light to send audible-visual annunciator, warn the passerby personnel in the very first time, for the passerby personnel strives for the best time of withdrawing, guaranteed passerby personnel's security, increased the security performance of device, improved the practicality of device.
assignees: GUANGDONG FEIDA TRAFFIC ENG CO LTD

title_en: Tool for unlocking high-voltage switch cabinet grounding knife switch
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a technical field of high tension switchgear especially relates to an instrument that high tension switchgear ground connection switch shutting was relieved. Including the short slab department of unblock instrument panel and unblock backplate through rotating hinged joint, be equipped with ground connection switch lockoff hole on the long slab of unblock instrument panel, be equipped with the locking groove on the short slab of unblock instrument panel, on the unblock backplate, be equipped with the spread groove on the board not being connected with unblock instrument panel, a threaded hole's of fixed connection rotating pin in the spread groove, the one end through the threaded connection dwang on the rotating pin, the other end of dwang passes through the connecting pin and is connected with the locking knot. Through fixing it at cabinet body rear cabinet unblock position, audible-visual annunciator trigger switch action, audible-visual annunciator sends the warning and is used for reminding operating personnel rear cabinet door not to close and has installed the foreign matter. After the installation, two operators can pull the grounding knife switch open to the front cabinet, so that one operator does not need to pull the grounding knife switch open in front of the other operator, and the monitoring requirement of the electric power operation specification is met.
assignees: JIANGSU HUADIAN QISHUYAN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent limit intrusion monitoring system and monitoring center database
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent limit intrusion monitoring system and a monitoring center database. The intelligent limit intrusion monitoring system comprises a data acquisition system, a monitoring center, an integrated management platform and an intelligent alarming device. The data acquisition system is used for acquiring state monitoring data in a monitoring region. The monitoring center is in communication connection with the data acquisition system and is used for analyzing the state of a monitoring objective in the monitoring region and determining an alarming objective and the danger level of the alarming objective in real time according to the state monitoring data and triggering corresponding guard signals according to the danger level. The integrated management platform is connected with the data acquisition system and the monitoring center and used for monitoring and managing on-site monitoring equipment of the monitoring region in a centralized manner. The intelligent alarming device is in communication connection with the monitoring center to achieve linkage and is used for giving out an early warning or an alarm according to the guard signals. Thus, by means of the intelligent limit intrusion monitoring system and the monitoring center database, natural disasters, unexpected accidents, unlawful entry and other foreign body limit intrusion events endangering safety operation of a railway can be accurately monitored, pre-warned and alarmed in time.
assignees: BEIJING GTV TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional intellectual kitchen
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multifunctional intellectual kitchen, it includes vegetable processing unit, raw material storage element, raw material dispatching and finished product output unit, and the vegetable processing unit includes more than two hearths, and auto dish frying is both provided on each hearth and is cooked machine；The raw material storage element includes raw material frame, is arranged at intervals with compartment in the raw material frame, food materials or condiment are placed in the compartment；The raw material dispatching and finished product output unit include translation track and pedestal, are provided with turntable, arm and finger on the pedestal, pressure sensor and video camera are provided on the finger；Exhaust gas treatment unit is provided with above the hearth, treatment unit for waste water is provided with below the hearth, fire-fighting early warning processing unit is provided in kitchen.The present invention solves the material distribution in automatic kitchen and the transportation problem of finished product, realizes scale processing, meets the demand that the food in large-scale dining room is processed automatically well, accomplishes manless production, become unmanned kitchen.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU QIANZHENG AUTOMATION SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus for guiding into emergency exit without man and control method therefor
abstract_en: An unmanned guide device for an emergency exit is provided to switch on and off a high-brightness lamp installed at an emergency guide lamp and concentrate the light to guide the emergency exit effectively. An unmanned guide device for an emergency exit connected to a fire alarm system(20) detecting a fire and outputting alarm sound is composed of an interface unit(30) receiving an emergency sensing signal transmitted from the fire alarm system; a memory(200) storing voice guidance data about the emergency state and the emergency exit; an auditory guiding unit(300), converting voice guidance data about the emergency state and the emergency exit stored in the memory, into a voice signal if the emergency sensing signal is transmitted through the interface unit and then outputting the voice signal; a visual guiding unit(400) turning on and off a lamp(410) if the emergency sensing signal is transmitted through the interface unit; a control unit(100) detecting data in the memory by receiving the emergency sensing signal transmitted through the interface unit, transmitting the data to the auditory guiding unit, transmitting a control signal for switching on and off the lamp to the visual guiding unit, and carrying out operations for driving each component; and a power supply unit(500) having an emergency power unit charged with power supplied from a power source to supply the charged power to the visual and auditory guiding units.
abstract_ko:

title_en: User device and method for displaying disaster alarm message and server for providing disaster alarm message
title_ko: 재난 경보 메시지를 출력하는 사용자 단말, 방법 및 재난 경보 메시지를 제공하는 서버
abstract_en: A user terminal for outputting a disaster alarm message comprises: a message receiving unit receiving a disaster alarm message from a disaster alarm message provision server; an extraction unit extracting, from the received disaster alarm message, at least one character included in a zero-padding area; a detection unit detecting, from the extracted at least one character, a recognized character and a keyword located next to the recognized character; a reconstruction unit determining specific display information corresponding to the keyword among predetermined display information, based on the recognized character, and performing reconstruction so that the determined specific display information is to be included in the disaster alarm message; and an output unit outputting the reconstructed disaster alarm message. Therefore, the user terminal enables vulnerable groups such as foreigners and illiterate people who are not familiar with the character of a corresponding country to recognize the text of a disaster text message.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted autonomous disaster prevention early warning protection system based on Beidou short message

title_en: Emergency data management and access system

A small-sized inexpensive instrument which is suitable for various occasions such as families, schools, earthquake monitoring stations and the like is provided. The earthquake monitoring, analyzing and alarm equipment can intelligently analyze and record seismic data, promptly discovers and sends out imminent earthquake exceptional warning and earthquake warning, can be connected with a computer, sends the monitoring data and analysis result into the computer for the further processing so as to realize mathematization and networking. title_en: Potential safety hazard early warning system for cargo hold of automobile roll-on/roll-off ship and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a potential safety hazard early warning system for a cargo hold of an automobile roll-on/roll-off ship and a use method thereof, wherein the system comprises a plurality of multifunctional intelligent terminals, a plurality of point type edge sensing terminals, a local area network server and a monitoring computer, and the multifunctional intelligent terminals and the monitoring computer are connected to the local area network server; every two adjacent point type edge sensing terminals and every two adjacent multifunctional intelligent terminals are in wireless communication through an ad hoc network. The early warning system provided by the invention combines the global temperature field with the temperature measurement data of the key positions through the multifunctional intelligent terminal and the point type edge sensing terminal, so that the blind spot of fire monitoring of the infrared temperature field is solved, early warning of fire is realized, and the wireless communication problem of a metal structure and a narrow space is solved by utilizing the self-adaptive networking.
