title_en: System and method for geo-targeted automated emergency alerting through analog radio broadcast
abstract_en: A system and method for automatic broadcasting alert messages is disclosed. The disclosed system and method are based on interworking devices operatively coupled with analog radio transmitters; and an emergency alerting engine configured to receive data packets comprising audio data associated with the alert messages, and a target geographical area data associated with a target geographical area; and identify at least one of the analog radio transmitters having a broadcasting coverage area that corresponds to the target geographical area. The emergency alerting engine translates the audio data into audio alert messages; and transmit audio alert messages to at least one of the interworking devices associated with the identified analog radio transmitter. The interworking device converts the audio alert messages to analog audio alert messages signals; and transmit the converted analog audio alert messages signals to the identified analog radio transmitter to broadcast the converted analog audio alert messages to devices.

title_en: System with a companion device and a primary device

title_en: Online monitoring system for partial discharge of outdoor electrical equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an online monitoring system for partial discharge of outdoor electrical equipment, and belongs to the technical field of electrical equipment monitoring. The system comprises a data acquisition unit, a data processing unit, a local discharge transient processing unit and a local discharge transient processing unit, wherein the data acquisition unit acquires an electric pulse current signal, an internal environment parameter and an external environment parameter of the electric equipment, the data processing unit converts an analog signal after signal processing into a digital signal, an early warning threshold value and an alarm threshold value are set, a control signal is triggered when the discharge intensity or frequency exceeds the threshold value, and the local discharge transient processing unit controls the operation state of each environment adjusting module according to the received control signal and combines the internal environment parameter and the external environment parameter of the electric equipment to inhibit the local discharge of the electric equipment. And collecting partial discharge core signals, integrating environmental and equipment state data such as temperature, humidity, weather, internal and external foreign matters and the like, positioning the cause of partial discharge through multi-parameter correlation analysis, improving the accuracy of partial discharge detection, taking corresponding measures, and reducing potential safety hazards.

title_en: Separate fire detection device for the disabled
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a separate alarm type fire detector to which a universal design is applied. The fire detector detects the occurrence of a fire independently without going through a fire receiver and notifies a non-disabled person as well as the visually or hearing impaired of the occurrence of a fire. The separate alarm type fire detector to which a universal design is applied according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a detection body installed and fixed to the ceiling; a detection sensor installed inside the detection body to detect one or two or more of heat, smoke, or gas together and generate a fire signal; a warning sound output unit audibly notifying occurrence of a fire through sound when the fire signal is generated from the detection sensor; and a flashing output unit visually notifying the occurrence of a fire through light when the fire signal is generated from the detection sensor. In addition, the warning sound output unit includes: a first speaker installed on one side of the detection body to output a first sound; and a second speaker installed on the other side of the detection body and installed on a straight line with the first speaker to output a second sound. As the first sound and the second sound are sequentially output, an escape direction for the hearing-impaired person is induced. Therefore, people with disabilities, non-disabled people, and the elderly can easily know the occurrence of a fire and can evacuate quickly.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재수신기를 통하지 않고 단독으로 화재의 발생을 감지하여 시각 또는 청각 장애인뿐만 아니라 비장애인에게 화재의 발생을 알리는 유니버설디자인을 적용한 단독경보형 화재감지기에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 유니버설디자인을 적용한 단독경보형 화재감지기는 천정에 고정설치되는 감지본체, 상기 감지본체의 내부에 설치되어 열, 연기, 또는 가스 중 어느 하나 또는 둘 이상을 함께 감지하여 화재신호를 발생하는 감지센서, 상기 감지센서에서 화재신호가 발생되면 소리를 통해 청각적으로 화재의 발생을 알리는 경고음출력부, 및 상기 감지센서에서 화재신호가 발생되면 빛을 통해 시각적으로 화재의 발생을 알리는 섬광출력부를 포함하고, 상기 경고음출력부는 상기 감지본체의 일측에 설치되어 상기 제1 소리를 출력하는 제1 스피커, 및 상기 감지본체의 타측에 설치되고 상기 제1 스피커와 일직선상에 설치되어 상기 제2 소리를 출력하는 제2 스피커를 포함하여, 상기 제1 소리와 제2 소리를 순차적으로 출력함에 따라 청각 장애인의 탈출방향을 유도한다. 따라서, 장애인, 비장애인, 노약자들이 화재발생을 용이하게 알 수 있어 신속하게 대피할 수 있다.

title_en: Enhanced initiation and routing for emergency sessions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for enhanced initiation and/or routing of an emergency call in a packet switched communication system, wherein a public safety answering point is part of or accessible by the packet switched communication system, the emergency call originating from or being initiated by a mobile communication device in or connected to the packet switched communication system, the method comprising the steps of: -determining or defining personal communication capability information and/or personal health information of a user of the mobile communication device by or by means of the mobile communication device, and-initiating an emergency call by using the mobile communication device, wherein initiating the emergency call comprises sending an emergency message to the packet switched communication system via a packet switched connection of the mobile communication device, wherein the personal communication capability information and/or the personal health information is part of the emergency message.

title_en: Earthquake early warning analysis system and method based on intelligent equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake monitoring and early warning, in particular to an earthquake early warning analysis system and method based on intelligent equipment. The system comprises a terminal sensing and initial judging module, a self-adaptive network transmission module, an edge aggregation and verification module, a cloud control fusion and calculation module, a high-precision positioning and shock level calculation module and a final early warning instruction issuing module, wherein the terminal sensing and initial judging module collects data through a sensor array, utilizes a dynamic weight adjustment model to identify P wave characteristics and generate encrypted initial alarms, the self-adaptive network transmission module is used for constructing a dynamic self-organizing network based on a D2D protocol, and realizing multi-hop relay transmission of the alarms through electing relay nodes, the edge aggregation and verification module is used for performing space-time matching and cross verification on a plurality of alarms in a specific area, judging event authenticity and generating hierarchical early warning information, and the cloud control fusion and calculation module is used for fusing the event data of the area and professional bench network data. According to the invention, a high-density sensing network is constructed by utilizing mass intelligent equipment, so that the early warning blind area is effectively eliminated, and the earthquake early warning with rapider, more accuracy and more robustness is realized.

title_en: Evacuation guiding apparatus for visually handicapped person
abstract_en: An evacuation guiding apparatus for a visually handicapped person according to a first aspect of the present invention comprises: a fire sensing unit arranged in a facility to sense an occurrence of a fire; a plurality of smoke sensing units arranged in the facility to sense an amount of smoke generated by the fire after the occurrence of the fire is sensed by the fire sensing unit; a plurality of units for sensing the number of persons arranged in corridors connected to a fire exit of the facility to sense the number of persons passing the corridors; a transmission unit wirelessly outputting signals corresponding to sensing results by the fire sensing unit, the smoke sensing unit and the person sensing units; a main body worn on a wrist of the visually handicapped person by a band; a receiving unit arranged in the main body to receive signals from the transmission unit; a warning unit, if the receiving unit receives a fire situation, informing the visually handicapped person of the fire situation; and a path guiding unit arranged in the main body to inform the visually handicapped person of an evacuation path. The present invention is able to sense the occurrence of the fire and inform the handicapped person of the evacuation path where the amount of smoke is small and the number of moving persons is small, is configured in a smart watch, which is a type to be worn on the wrist of the visually handicapped person to inform the visually handicapped person of fire through sound signals, band pressure, and vibration when the fire occurs, and is able to inform the visually handicapped person of a safe evacuation path through the sound signals and tactile signals on the evacuation path when the fire occurs.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 제1 측면에 의하면, 본 발명은, 시설물에 배치되어 화재 발생을 감지하는 화재 감지부; 상기 시설물에 복수로 배치되어 상기 화재 감지부에 의해 화재 발생이 감지된 후, 화재에 의해 발생된 연기의 양을 감지하는 연기 감지부; 상기 시설물의 비상구로 연결되는 복도에 복수로 배치되어 상기 복도를 지나는 인원의 수를 감지하는 인원 감지부; 상기 화재 감지부, 상기 연기 감지부 및 상기 인원 감지부에서 감지 결과에해당하는 신호를 무선으로 출력하는 송신부; 시각장애인의 손목에 밴드에 의해 착용되는 본체; 상시 본체에 배치되어 상기 송신부가 송신하는 신호를 수신하는 수신부; 상기 수신부에 의해 화재 상황이 수신되면, 이를 시각장애인에게 알려주는 경보부; 및 상기 본체에 배치되어 상기 시각장애인의 피난 경로를 알려주는 경로 안내부를 포함하는 시각장애인을 위한 피난 유도 장치를 제공한다.  
본 발명은, 화재 발생 시 이를 감지하여 연기 발생량이 적고 이동 인원수가 적은 대피 경로를 장애인에게 알려줄 수 있고, 시각장애인의 손목에 채워지는 스마트 워치 형태로 이루어져 화재 발생 시 음향 신호, 밴드 압박, 진동을 통해 시각장애인에게 화재를 알려주고 안전한 대피 경로를 알려줄 수 있으며, 화재 발생 시 대피 경로상에서 음향 신호 및 촉각 신호를 통해 시각 장애인에게 안전한 대피 경로를 알려줄 수 있다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for detecting fire by using smart glasses for blind
title_ko: 시각 장애인을 위한 스마트 안경을 이용한 화재 감지 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko:
시각 장애인을 위한 스마트 안경을 이용한 화재 감지 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 바람직한 일 실시예에 따르면, 화재 장면에 대한 빅데이터를 이용하여 화재 장면에 대한 머신 러닝을 수행하고, 스마트 안경으로부터 수신된 촬상 영상을 수신하여, 수신된 촬상 영상을 이용하여 화재 상황인지 여부를 판단하고, 화재 상황으로 판단되는 경우 스마트 안경으로 화재 상황임을 알리는 알림을 전송한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 주변에 다른 사람이 없이 혼자 있는 상황에서 화재가 발생하는 경우에도 화재로 인한 열이나 연기를 인식하기 전에 화재의 발생 여부를 시각 장애인이 인지할 수 있게 하고, 화재 감지 정확도가 높아 시각 장애인이 화재 위험으로부터 안전할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Event communication system for providing user alerts
abstract_en: An event communication system involves facilitating entry by a user of one or more device addresses via a network accessible user interface of the event communication system. The device addresses are associated with alerts provided by the event communication system. Test alert messages targeted for the device addresses are sent via the user interface. The system sends alerts user devices corresponding to the one or more tested device addresses in response to predetermined events. The system may provide user access to historical copies of data relating to the alerts. Registration on the system involves storing a personal identity data of a student on a database and comparing the personal identity data to registration data entered via the user interface. Authentication is automatically provided based on the comparison.

title_en: Bidirectional infrared alarm integrated attachment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bidirectional infrared alarm integrated attachment device, which comprises two attachment device units which are movably connected and fixed; the attachment device unit comprises a device shell with a semi-annular side surface, and an infrared alarm device is arranged on the outer side of the device shell; the top of the device shell is rotatably connected through a hinge, the bottom of the device shell is respectively and correspondingly provided with a fastening bolt, one fastening bolt is rotatably provided with a bolt connection limiting sheet, the other end of the bolt connection limiting sheet is provided with a limiting groove matched with the fastening bolt and can be clamped into another fastening bolt. Use the utility model discloses accessible the device's two-way audible-visual alarm warns facing inside and outside both sides approach personnel in limit entrance, and faces the limit protection and enclose fender personnel formation warning effect to violating regulations and climb.

title_en: Electrical cabinet monitoring and fire extinguishing equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to electrical cabinet monitoring and fire extinguishing equipment which comprises an infrared area temperature sensor, an ultraviolet light sensor, an infrared light sensor, a fire extinguishing device and a controller. The infrared area temperature sensor is used for scanning the temperature field of the inner area of the cabinet in real time, the area monitoring replaces a point type probe, the covering capacity and the early warning precision are improved, and the blind area and the missing detection probability are reduced. When the temperature of a certain area exceeds a preset temperature threshold, the controller judges that the temperature is abnormal, at the moment, the ultraviolet band spectrum and the infrared band spectrum in the gas holder are acquired through the ultraviolet light sensor and the infrared light sensor, the characteristic spectrum of the real flame can be identified, false alarm caused by non-fire factors is avoided, and accurate identification of fire is enhanced. When a fire source appears in the electrical cabinet, the controller can complete accurate decision under no intervention, and is linked with automatic fire extinguishing equipment, so that the intervention is completed at the initial stage of fire, and the accident loss and the diffusion risk are obviously reduced.

title_en: Power-transmission-line foreign-matter-invasion intelligent-video on-line monitoring evaluation system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power-transmission-line foreign-matter-invasion intelligent-video on-line monitoring evaluation system and belongs to the intelligent power grid technology field. The system comprises a video image acquisition module, a data analysis processing module and a communication module. The video image acquisition module collects video images of a power transmission line and sends to the data analysis processing module so as to analyze a motion trend of a foreign matter relative to the power transmission line and classify the foreign matter. Based on that, early warning or alarm is performed on the invasive foreign matter. Simultaneously, historical data is formed and a power-transmission-line foreign-matter invasion environment is evaluated and analyzed. The system possesses power transmission line foreign matter invasion early warning and alarm functions; the foreign-matter invasion environment is evaluated and generation of power transmission line potential safety hazards caused by the foreign matter invasion is effectively reduced; simultaneously interferences of icing and snow coating, waving and sag changes are eliminated and accuracy of a monitoring result is increased. The system possesses advantages that an intelligent degree is high; cost is low; installation and maintenance are convenient and so on. The system can be widely applied to power-transmission-line foreign-matter-invasion intelligent on-line monitoring.

title_en: A kind of underground parking storage abrupt slope structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of underground parkings to be put in storage abrupt slope structure.Belong to parking lot technical field.It is mainly solved at vehicles while passing parking lot channel, and there are certain blind areas, the problem of being easy to appear safety accident, while can not carry out flush clean to the chassis of the vehicle in entrance parking lot.Being mainly characterized by comprising: for it includes the channel being made of upper planar section, steep slope section and lower plane section, and control switch is equipped in the channel, and the first induction broadcasting system is equipped in the upper planar section, the second induction broadcasting system is equipped in the lower plane section；The first induction broadcasting system and the second induction broadcasting system are electrically connected with control switch.The present invention can carry out voice broadcast warning to the vehicle in disengaging parking lot, reduce accident, improve the safety coefficient of driving, and to being rinsed below vehicle, prevent vehicle from bringing a large amount of soil into and enter parking lot, so that more clean in parking lot.
assignees: THE 6TH ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY 11 BUREAU GROUP;China railway 11th bureau group co ltd

title_en: Take sediment stuff pump of intelligent wearing and tearing monitoring warning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of slurry pumps, in particular to a slurry pump with an intelligent wear monitoring alarm function; the slurry pump comprises a slurry pump body, a wear monitoring system and a control system, wherein the slurry pump body comprises a base, a motor and a pump body on the base, and the wear monitoring system comprises a monitoring device, a sensor, a repeater, a cloud platform and terminal equipment; the monitoring device comprises a monitoring probe and a two-core wire; a blind hole is formed in the outer wall of a rear pump shell of the pump body, the monitoring probe is arranged in the blind hole, one end of the two-core wire is connected with the monitoring probe, and the other end of the two-core wire is connected with the sensor; the sensor, the repeater and the cloud platform terminal equipment are sequentially in communication connection. The abrasion monitoring system is arranged on the pump, so that the abrasion degree of the shell is accurately monitored, and the slurry pump is replaced in time after abrasion, thereby avoiding leakage of internal fluid, major accidents and the like; the shell is provided with a blind hole with a certain depth and a monitoring probe, internal fluid flows out of the blind hole after the shell is worn, and the monitoring probe detects that a signal is sent to a wear monitoring system to timely master the information of shell wear.

title_en: Blind crutch capable of emitting light through body
abstract_en: The invention relates to a blind crutch capable of emitting light through a whole body, which comprises a blind crutch main body, a warning component, a control module and a battery. The whole crutch body of the blind crutch provided by the invention can emit light, and can transmit audible prompts to other people by using the loudspeaker, thereby obviously improving the visibility of the blind person to the blind person user, and further greatly improving the travel safety of the blind person. The lamp strip used by the invention can emit light with various colors, and has the applicability in daytime and at night, so that the blind can travel in all weather.
assignees: SUZHOU XINXINLIAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster safety information management apparatus
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To much and quickly confirm whether many users including foreigners speaking different languages and affected by an earthquake, are safe, and to provide safe information in various languages in response to inquiries about safety.  <P>SOLUTION: When a safety confirmation processing section 22 receives an emergency earthquake news flash from a weather warning server apparatus 10, safety inquiry notices for inquiring the safety of the users having member terminal apparatuses 3 are edited, and transmitted to the member terminal apparatuses 3. When the user enters an input to the member terminal apparatus 3 in response to the notice and transmits a returned notice, a safety information providing/processing section 23 receives the returned notice, and stores information on the safety of user in the safety database 62 based on a content of the returned notice.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Performance with the discharge of the high-pressure and high-speed axial flow pump
title_ko: 고압 및 고속의 토출 성능을 갖는 축류펌프
abstract_en: An axial flow pump with high pressure and high speed discharge performance of the present invention comprises: a pipe-shaped casing, which has a pipe shape and has a curved section in the orthogonal direction from an inlet to be formed long in the axial direction from the inlet, and which has a high pressure generating unit, a spiral vortex generating unit, and a high pressure generating unit in order from the inlet by being formed as steps getting smaller in the inner diameter toward an outlet formed to have a small diameter in a neck unit; a rotation axis, which is installed in the axial direction in order to be located in the center inside the casing, and which is connected to an operating device by penetrating toward the outside in the curved section in one end; a first impeller, which is located in the high pressure generating unit and is installed in the rotation axis; multiple spiral guide flags, which are formed to protrude in the inner wall of the pipe of the spiral vortex generating unit; and a second impeller, which is installed in the rotation axis by being located in the high pressure generating unit, and which has a smaller outer diameter than the outer diameter of the first impeller. Accordingly, the axial flow pump with high pressure and high speed discharge performance minimizes the change in the amount of discharge by absorbing the large amount of fluids and can be used as an alternative to a traditional expensive fire pump by spraying fluids at high pressure and high speed from the outlet. Also, the axial flow pump can remove impurities or foreign substances contained in fluids, using a filtering member, so the axial flow pump can be prevented from being damaged. In addition, the rotation direction and speed of the first impeller and the second impeller can be controlled as required, so the discharge pressure and amount are easily variable according to a target fluid or a pumping environment.
abstract_ko:
본 발명 고압 및 고속의 토출 성능을 갖는 축류펌프는 관 형상으로 이루어져 흡입구로부터 직각방향으로 곡선구간이 형성되고, 이로부터 축 방향으로 길게 이루어지되, 목 부분 내경이 작게 형성된 토출구쪽으로 갈수록 내경이 점차적으로 작아지는 계단형으로 이루어져서 흡입구로부터 고압발생부, 나선형와류발생부 및 고압발생부가 순차적으로 형성되어 이루어진 관 형상의 케이싱; 상기 케이싱 내부 정중앙에 위치되게 축 방향으로 설치되고, 일단부는 곡선구간에서 외측으로 관통되어 구동장치와 연결되어 있는 회전축; 상기 고압발생부에 위치되어 상기 회전축에 설치되는 제1임펠러; 상기 나선형와류발생부의 관 내벽에 돌출 형성되는 다수의 나선형안내깃; 상기 고압발생부에 위치되어 상기 회전축에 설치되고 상기 제1임펠러의 외경보다 작은 외경을 가지는 제2임펠러;로 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이에 따라 유체를 대량으로 흡입하여 토출 유량의 변화를 최소화시키면서도 토출구에서는 고압 및 고속으로 유체가 분사되므로서 기존의 고가의 소방펌프를 대체하여 사용할 수 있게 된다. 그리고, 유체에 함유된 불순물이나 이물질을 필터부재에 의해 제거할 수 있기 때문에 고압 및 고속의 성능을 발휘하는 본 발명의 축류펌프의 파손을 방지할 수 있게 되며, 필요에 따라 제1임펠러와 제2임펠러의 회전방향 및 회전 속도를 제어할 수 있으므로 토출압력과 토출량을 대상 유체에 따라 또는 펌핑 환경에 따라 용이하게 가변시킬 수 있는 고압 및 고속의 토출 성능을 갖는 축류펌프.를 제공할 수 있는 탁월한 효과를 발휘하게 되는 것이다.

title_en: Large-scale vehicle blind area bidirectional early warning system
abstract_en: The bidirectional early warning system for the blind area of the large vehicle comprises a front-end detection early warning unit and a rear-end remote management device, wherein the front-end detection early warning unit is used for detecting and early warning the driving blind area of the large vehicle to obtain detection early warning data and uploading the detection early warning data to the rear-end remote management device; the front-end detection early warning unit comprises a large-scale vehicle detection component, a large-scale vehicle early warning component, a blind area pedestrian and non-motor vehicle detection component, a blind area pedestrian and non-motor vehicle early warning component, a wireless transmission component, a power supply component and a controller; the large-scale vehicle detection assembly comprises an analysis processor and a high-precision radar, and the large-scale vehicle early warning assembly comprises a red and blue warning lamp, an LED self-luminous board and a tweeter to prompt the blind area in the front right turn of the large-scale vehicle.
assignees: SANSHI SHANDONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Auxiliary blind area display system for automobile safety
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automobile safety auxiliary blind area display system which comprises a controller, a left camera, a right camera, a left display, a right display, a processor and an ultrasonic ranging sensor, wherein the controller is connected with the left camera and the right camera; the left camera, the right camera, the left display, the right display and the processor are respectively electrically connected with the controller; the ultrasonic ranging sensor is electrically connected with the processor; the left side camera sets up in vehicle A post left side outside position, the right side camera sets up in vehicle A post right side outside position. The invention is also provided with the alarm device with the early warning function, so that a driver can observe the left and right external conditions without blind areas, and safety accidents are avoided to the maximum extent. When the original driver changes lane left and right, habitually observing the left and right rearview mirrors is changed into observing the left and right displays, so that the external conditions of the left and right sides can be known in real time, no blind area exists, and the automobile rearview mirror is an important facility for automobile driving safety.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and early warning system for high-voltage power grid and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent monitoring and early warning system for a high-voltage power grid and a monitoring method thereof, wherein the intelligent monitoring and early warning system comprises a front-end monitoring device, a background server and a WeChat client, the front-end monitoring device is installed on an iron tower of the high-voltage power grid, the front-end monitoring device is wirelessly connected with the background server, the WeChat client is a software application installed on a client mobile phone, the WeChat client is connected with the background server through a mobile phone wireless signal, the front-end monitoring device monitors the personnel condition and the foreign matter condition around the high-voltage power grid in real time, the background server intelligently analyzes the site information sent by the front-end monitoring device, and a manager knows the site condition by receiving the site information through. The invention carries out 24-hour uninterrupted intelligent monitoring and early warning management on the high-voltage line region through the front-end monitoring device, and realizes the conversion from ' people ' defense ' to ' technical defense ' of the high-voltage line through the intelligent analysis and accurate judgment of the background server.

title_en: National provincial road traffic incident early warning gridding information release method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for issuing early warning gridding information of national provincial road traffic event, which comprises determining time type, determining issuing medium, dividing gridding area, making rules for issuing plans and generating management and control plans, and a system for issuing early warning gridding information of national provincial road traffic event, comprising a video traffic event detection system, an information board, a speed limit sign, an induction lamp and a directional loudspeaker, the operability and the effective accessibility of the early warning plan are enhanced, more early treatment time is obtained for road smoothness, the unified and standard and efficient management and control plan is established mainly aiming at typical traffic event prevention and short-term traffic control such as road occupation, congestion, bad weather and the like, and aiming at typical emergency events possibly happening on national provincial roads, the occurrence of secondary accidents is effectively prevented in time, casualties and property loss are avoided and reduced to the maximum extent, and road safety is guaranteed to be smooth.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF TRANSP

title_en: Apparatus for detecting and alarming fire
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for detecting a fire and initiating an alarm which can effectively inform hearing-impaired persons of the occurrence of a fire. According to the present invention, the apparatus for detecting a fire and initiating an alarm comprises: a detecting sensor which generates a fire detection signal by detecting the occurrence of a fire; an alarming part which is equipped with a light emitting measure to emit light for informing hearing-impaired persons of the occurrence of a fire; and a control circuit part which outputs an alarm operating signal to operate the alarming part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 목적은 청각장애인에게 화재 발생을 효과적으로 알려줄 수 있는 화재 감지 경보기에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 의하면, 화재 발생을 검출하여 화재감지신호를 발생시키는 감지센서; 화재발생을 알리는 빛을 내는 발광수단을 구비하는 경보부; 및 상기 화재감지신호을 입력받아서 상기 경보부를 작동시키는 경보작동신호를 출력하는 제어회로부를 포함하는 화재 감지 경보기가 제공된다.

title_en: Method and System for crosswalk safety walking support for visually impaired using Vehicle to Everything
title_ko: V2x 기술을 응용한 시각장애인용 횡단보도 안전보행 지원 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Provided are a method and a system for supporting crosswalk safety walking for the visually impaired by using V2X technology, which can comprehensively determine traffic guidance information and information about approaching vehicles for the visually impaired at a crosswalk by using V2X technology, thereby preventing vehicle accidents of pedestrians at the crosswalk. In accordance with an embodiment of the present invention, a system for supporting crosswalk safety walking comprises: a communication unit which receives GPS location information, receives signal information from a signal controller of a traffic light, and receives vehicle condition information from an on-board unit (OBU); and a processor which collects the GPS location information, the signal information, and the vehicle condition information, predicts the stopping position of a vehicle, and outputs a warning message to warn pedestrians of a dangerous situation or a walking message to guide walking of the pedestrians in accordance with prediction results. Therefore, the system can comprehensively determine the stopping position (stop sight distance) of the vehicle in accordance with vehicle positions and vehicle speeds before walking at a crosswalk, and warn pedestrians (the visually impaired) of an accident risk when there is the accident risk, thereby preventing vehicle accidents of the visually impaired at the crosswalk. In addition, when a walking signal or a traffic light blinks, the system can transmit the pedestrian information (BSM) of the visually impaired to the OBU to notify that there is a pedestrian at the crosswalk, thereby preventing pedestrian collision accidents due to blind spots, poor visibility, drowsy driving, and non-observance of forward gaze.
abstract_ko: V2X 기술을 응용하여 횡단보도에서 시각장애인에게 교통안내정보 및 접근하는 차량에 대한 정보를 종합 판단하고, 이를 통해 횡단보도 보행자의 차량안전사고를 방지할 수 있는 시각장애인용 횡단보도 안전보행 지원 방법 및 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 횡단보도 안전보행 지원 시스템은, GPS 위치 정보를 수신하며, 신호등의 신호제어기로부터 신호 정보를 수신하고, 차량단말기(OBU)로부터 차량 상태 정보를 수신하는 통신부; 및 GPS 위치 정보, 신호 정보 및 차량 상태 정보를 취합하여, 차량의 정지 위치를 예측하고, 예측 결과에 따라 보행자에게 위험 상황을 경고하는 경고 메시지 또는 보행자에게 보행 안내를 유도하는 보행 메시지가 출력되도록 하는 프로세서;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 횡단보도의 보행 전 차량 위치 및 차량속도에 따른 차량 정지위치(정지시거)를 종합적으로 판단하고, 이를 통해, 사고 위험 시, 보행자(시각장애인)에게 경고를 함으로써, 시각장애인의 횡단보도 사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있다. 또한, 보행신호 혹은 신호등 점멸 시 시각장애인의 보행자 정보(BSM)를 차량단말기(OBU)로 전달하여, 횡단보도 내 보행자가 존재함을 알려 주며, 사각지대 및 시거불량, 졸음운전, 전방 주시 미 준수 등에 의한 보행자 추돌 사고를 예방할 수 있다.

title_en: Medical informational kit for emergency responders
abstract_en: The need for medical information to explain a potential patient's medical condition is greatly desired by emergency medical responders. Often the patient is unconscious or confused and therefore unable to communicate clearly with the emergency responder. Thus there is a need for this information in a location most likely accessible to an emergency responder. The medical information kit has the patient's medical information and comprises at least a triplicate form, two sealed containers, one magnet sign, one adhesive label sign and optionally one key-chain fob sign. One copy of the form is placed in a container and placed in the refrigerator/medicine cabinet, to alert an emergency responder. Another copy of the form is placed is the second sealed container and placed in the glove compartment of the auto of the patient. Lastly, the last sheet of the triplicate form is placed in the patient's wallet, next to the driver's license.

title_en: Underground pressure monitoring device and method for petroleum production
abstract_en: The invention relates to an oil exploitation auxiliary system and method, in particular to an underground pressure monitoring device and method for oil exploitation. The technical scheme is as follows: the bottom of the process pipe column is provided with a monitoring early warning device, the upper part of the process pipe column is provided with a signal terminal receiver, the upper end of a system carrier of the monitoring early warning device is connected with the lower end of the blind plug, a pressure limiting carrier, an induction protection block and a sensor are sequentially arranged in an inner cavity of the system carrier, the lower end of the system carrier is provided with a limiting cover plate, the middle part of the induction protection block is provided with an induction contact and a sensing support spring, and the upper end of the induction contact is electrically connected with the sensor. The beneficial effects are that: the pressure signal and the blowout signal of the stratum are converted into electric signals by using the sensor, the stratum change in the well is transmitted to the ground in a wireless electromagnetic wave mode, and due to the fact that the transmission speed of the electromagnetic wave is high, personnel on the ground have time to rapidly start an emergency treatment scheme and rapidly evacuate and avoid risks, and casualties and partial property loss are reduced.

title_en: Geotechnical engineering slope stability real-time monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a geotechnical engineering slope stability real-time monitoring method and system, which are characterized in that an original displacement time sequence and an environment temperature time sequence of a plurality of GNSS measuring points are regarded as multichannel mixed signals by introducing a blind source separation technology combining independent component analysis and physical constraint, periodic environment noise, instrument random noise and drift and a real slope deformation signal are effectively separated from a mixed observation signal by utilizing statistical independence among signal sources, and then, the separated source signals are automatically calibrated through correlation verification of physical quantities such as field environment temperature, and the like, and temperature effect source signals with physical labels and long-term creep source signals are accurately identified and extracted, so that accurate rejection of noise components and high-fidelity reconstruction of pure deformation signals are realized. Therefore, the accuracy of monitoring the stability of the geotechnical engineering slope in real time can be effectively improved, and a solid data basis and a decision basis are provided for early warning and prevention and control of the slope disaster.

title_en: Early warning system and method for preventing tourists from being lost by tourist group
abstract_en: The invention provides a tourist group tourist loss prevention early warning system and a tourist group tourist loss prevention early warning method. The tourist group prevents that visitor loses early warning system includes tour guide end and visitor end, tour guide end reaches visitor end all includes CPU treater and rather than wireless transceiver module, alarm module and the power module who connects, power module supplies power for each module, tour guide end with visitor end accessible wireless transceiver module communication connection, wireless transceiver module includes wireless transmitting module and wireless receiving module, wireless transmitting module uses the PT2262 chip to carry out wireless signal transmission, wireless receiving module uses the PT2272 chip to carry out wireless signal reception. The invention realizes the communication function through the PT2262 wireless transmitting module and the PT2272 wireless receiving module, is not influenced by dense buildings and mobile phone signals, and realizes the prevention of tourist groups from being lost and early warning.
assignees: HUNAN GREATWALL GALAXY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Visual field blind area warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a visual field blind area warning system and a method, comprising a first camera unit, a second camera unit, a data processing unit and an alarm unit; the first camera unit is used for acquiring first road condition information, and the first road condition information is a road image within a preset distance range from a reference position on a first road section; the second camera unit is used for acquiring second road condition information, the second road condition information is a road image in a preset distance range from a reference position on a second road section, and the reference position is a junction position of the first road and the second road; the data processing unit is used for identifying a first target obstacle on the first road section according to the first road condition information and identifying a second target obstacle on the second road section according to the second road condition information; the alarm unit issues alarm information based on the first target obstacle and/or the second target obstacle. The system and the method for warning the visual field blind area are used for helping a user to master the situation of the visual field blind area.
assignees: SHANGHAI PATEO YUEZHEN NETWORKING TECHNOLOGY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Self-cleaning dining table residual food rancidity prevention early warning collecting box
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-cleaning dining table residual food anti-rancidity early warning collection box, wherein an audible and visual alarm is fixedly arranged on one side surface of the collection box, an oxygen concentration detection device is fixedly arranged below the audible and visual alarm, and a detection end of the oxygen concentration detection device extends into the collection box. When the device is used, the oxygen is consumed when the remaining food on the dining table is rancid, when the oxygen concentration is reduced to be below 5%, the rancid can be warned, the oxygen concentration detection device sends a signal to the controller, and the controller starts the audible and visual alarm to give an audible and visual alarm after receiving the signal, so that a worker is reminded of needing to process the food in time. After the dining table residual food inside the collecting box is cleaned, the water inside the water tank is pumped out by the accessible starting water pumping mechanism, the water is conveyed to the inside of the sprinkling plate through the first conveying pipe, and finally the water is outwards sprinkled through the through hole at the bottom of the sprinkling plate, so that the inside of the collecting box is cleaned automatically.

title_en: Blind spot warning lamp capable of realizing two brightness levels according to external illumination conditions and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle warning lamps, in particular to a blind spot warning lamp for realizing two brightness levels according to external illumination conditions and a control method, wherein the blind spot warning lamp comprises an upper lamp shell and a lower lamp shell, and the upper lamp shell and the lower lamp shell are connected by adopting ultrasonic welding; the upper lamp housing is provided with a plurality of groups of indicator lamps, and the upper lamp housing is also provided with a transparent mask for protecting the indicator lamps. The blind spot warning lamp can realize IP65 level waterproof without coating pouring sealant, has more stable waterproof performance, is directly integrated on the lamp housing, has no problem that the wire-to-wire connector needs to be fixed, is stable in plugging and good in shock resistance, provides two brightness levels, ensures that the indicator lamp is still clearly visible under the condition of strong illumination, avoids overlarge stimulation to human eyes under the condition of low illumination, and reduces uncomfortable feeling.
assignees: WUHAN YOULAIYI AUTOMOTIVE ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Charging safety device for eco-friendly vehicle and control method thereof
title_ko: 친환경 차량용 충전 안전장치 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a charging door module of an eco-friendly vehicle including a plug-in hybrid vehicle and an electric vehicle, a charging safety device for an eco-friendly vehicle embedded in an inlet, and a control method thereof. In addition, the charging safety device for an eco-friendly vehicle comprises: a foreign substance inspection unit which detects a foreign substance containing moisture existing in an inlet terminal provided in an inlet and a terminal hole when a charging door of the inlet is opened for charging an eco-friendly vehicle; a foreign substance removal unit which is connected to the terminal hole of the inlet to emit wind outward from an inside of the terminal hole; and a control unit which stops a charging process by a charging controller by transmitting a notification for notifying existence of foreign substances to the charging controller of the eco-friendly vehicle and operates the foreign substance removal unit to remove foreign substances in the terminal of the inlet and the terminal hole. Accordingly, the present invention may check whether foreign substances containing moisture exist in the inlet, which causes defective charging or accidents during a charging process, and effectively remove foreign substances containing moisture existing in the inlet.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 플러그인 하이브리드 차량 및 전기 차량을 포함하는 친환경 차량의 충전 도어 모듈과 인렛에 탑재되는 친환경 차량용 충전 안전장치 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of equipment attrition state wireless monitoring device based on Internet of Things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of equipment attrition state wireless monitoring device based on Internet of Things, comprise wireless monitor transport module and wireless monitor system module, wireless monitor transport module comprises connected successively sensor, signal amplifier, analog-digital converter, microprocessor and wireless launcher, and described wireless monitor system module comprises connected successively wireless receiver, level translator and PC. The present invention is by detecting the tired contact of traction sheave grooving Lun village Surface Contact, abrasive wear state and oxidative wear degree etc., diagnose out in advance the traction sheave grooving Lun village that reaches wearing and tearing critical value, and with wireless transmission method by gather state of wear information, transfer to enterprise management platform or related management personnel, go into the well again and make regular check on eliminating potential safety hazard without staff, realize in real time, exactly, intelligently mining traction sheave rope sheave village abrasion condition is carried out to early warning, thereby greatly improved the operating safety coefficient of traction sheave in mine.

title_en: Traffic safety warning device for deaf-mutes
abstract_en: The utility model provides a deaf-mutes are with traffic safety warning device, the waistband that the front portion has the buckle is the carrier, its characterized in that, is provided with the fuselage of the anti-light strip of taking of arc structure in the rear portion central point rigidity of waistband, is provided with warning device towards the rear on the fuselage, warning device sets up the arc top central point at the fuselage and puts, the built-in lithium cell of fuselage, warning device includes LED flash of light module, the lithium cell is connected the power supply with LED flash of light module, and is provided with key switch on the power supply line, key switch sets up side or the front portion at the waistband. The invention can prompt the motor vehicle driver that a pedestrian is in front of the motor vehicle driver, further can warn the user, and can dynamically trigger a warning signal when the user encounters potential traffic danger, thereby achieving the purpose of effectively avoiding traffic accidents.

title_en: Warning device is used in landscape garden
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a warning device is used in landscape garden, including the mount, the bottom fixed mounting of mount inner chamber has the motor, the output shaft fixed mounting of motor has the supporting disk, the top of supporting disk is provided with the support column, the outside fixed mounting that the mount was run through and extended to the mount in the upper end of support column has the backup pad, warning board has been placed at the top of backup pad, the center department at warning board top is connected with the speaker through external power supply electricity, and the both sides at warning board top all have the shielding cover through pillar fixed mounting. The utility model discloses a motor and supporting disk can move the support column and rotate with the warning board and carry out all-round warning, can make things convenient for people to watch, and speaker accessible speech function carries out pronunciation warning to people around to effectual increase people's safety consciousness has solved the visitor simultaneously and can't watch the warning slogan from other angles, leads to having the problem of potential safety hazard.

title_en: WEB site instant monitoring device with warning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a WEB instant monitoring device with a warning function, which comprises a front plate, a case and side plates, wherein dust-proof nets are arranged on one sides of the front plate, a dehumidifying structure is arranged at the bottom end of one side of the front plate, a wiring board is arranged at the top end of one side of the front plate, a protective structure is arranged on one side of the wiring board, the case is arranged on the outer side of the front plate, a warning mechanism is arranged on one side of the top end of the case, the side plates are arranged on one side of the case, and a single chip microcomputer is arranged in the case. According to the utility model, the baffle is pulled to rotate around the mounting base, so that the first magnet block is moved to the front of the data transmission interface, foreign matters are prevented from entering the data transmission interface, the second magnet block is adsorbed by the first magnet block, the baffle is firmly placed, the shielding and protecting functions of the device are realized, the data transmission interface of the device is isolated and protected, the data transmission interface is prevented from entering the foreign matters to cause poor contact, and the protection performance of the device is improved.

title_en: Railway platform pedestrian gets over line monitoring method, device, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: A kind of railway platform pedestrian gets over line monitoring method, comprising: obtains the first object image in the default first object region on waiting station platform；Judge that whether there is or not pedestrians in the first object image；When determining has pedestrian in the first object image, the second target image in default second target area on train rail is obtained；Judge that whether there is or not trains in second target image；When determining has train in second target image and the train is not currently in dead ship condition, the result that output has pedestrian that cross-lane occurs.The present invention also provides a kind of railway platform pedestrians to get over line monitoring device, terminal and storage medium.The present invention is with the computer vision and the sense of hearing of artificial intelligence deep learning; the artificial 7*24 hours strict intelligence warning free of discontinuities on duty of substitution; protect the routine safety of passenger safety and train operation, the initiative blind zone problem for solving safety management " last rice " by video monitoring and image processing techniques.
assignees: PING AN TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring and early warning device for subsidence deformation of karst area foundation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of application of a monitoring and early warning device for collapse deformation of a karst area foundation, and particularly discloses a monitoring and early warning device for collapse deformation of a karst area foundation, which comprises a walking component, a rotating component, an extending component, a translation component, a lifting component, a monitoring component and a pressing component, wherein a base is arranged on the walking component, a slotted hole is formed in the top of the base, and the angle, the front and back position, the left and right position and the height of the pressing component are adjusted through the rotating component, the extending component, the translation component and the lifting component, so that the movement area of the pressing component is wider, the monitoring and early warning device is favorable for accurately feeding back a safety area around the collapse of the foundation, timely transmitting information that the foundation is easy to collapse secondarily to a worker and warning the worker, the worker can conveniently rescue the foundation collapse of the foundation subsequently, the time for monitoring the collapse area by manpower is saved, and the monitoring and early warning efficiency of the collapse area by the monitoring and early warning device is improved.
assignees: SHANDONG GEO MINERAL PROSPECTING DEVELOPMENT BUREAU 5TH GEO MINERAL PROSPECTING INST

title_en: Bend blind area vehicle meeting warning system and method combining vehicle meeting warning and linear induction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-crossing warning system and method for a curve blind zone combining vehicle-crossing warning and linear induction, comprising a vehicle-crossing warning unit, a linear induction unit and a cloud platform, wherein the vehicle-crossing warning unit and the linear induction unit are connected with the cloud platform in a wireless mode for data interaction, the vehicle-crossing warning unit is responsible for collecting vehicle-crossing information, and the linear induction unit can receive a control instruction sent by the cloud platform and the vehicle-crossing information collected by the vehicle-crossing warning unit. The invention changes the outline mark from uncontrolled to controlled state, combines the controlled double-sided outline mark with the road meeting warning device, combines the audible and visual warning and the vehicle track warning in advance, has more sustainable warning effect, and can effectively reduce the occurrence of vehicle accidents.
assignees: JIANGSU POLICE INST;NANJING RUIMIN TRANSP TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Municipal construction machinery safety precaution protector
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of municipal construction, and particularly discloses a safety pre-warning protection device for municipal construction machinery, which comprises a moving vehicle mechanism, a workbench mechanism, a construction board assembly and a standing platform assembly, wherein the moving vehicle mechanism comprises a moving vehicle assembly and a buffer assembly arranged on one side of the moving vehicle assembly, the workbench mechanism comprises a workbench assembly arranged on one side of the moving vehicle assembly, the construction board assembly is rotationally clamped on the workbench assembly, the standing platform assembly is slidingly clamped on the workbench assembly, the construction is carried out by standing on a standing platform body, a series of mechanical linkage reactions are triggered by the descending of the standing platform body, the personnel construction board body is finally enabled to rotate to a conspicuous position, the personnel behind or around are effectively reminded, the safety accidents caused by sight blind areas or negligence are avoided, the constructor does not need to manually operate warning equipment, the condition of dispersing attention caused by operating the warning equipment is reduced, and therefore the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Sickroom patient out-of-bed behavior monitoring and falling early warning method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical care, and provides a ward patient out-of-bed behavior monitoring and fall early warning method based on millimeter wave radar, which comprises the following steps of driving the millimeter wave radar to release radar signals and receiving rebound signals; the method comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out a first step of detecting the position of a patient on a sickbed, secondly, carrying out gesture anchoring on the state of the patient at regular time, carrying out continuous monitoring on the position and the action gesture of the patient through a rebound signal, setting forbidden regions and removing abnormal values based on the position of a rebound reinforcement signal received by a millimeter wave radar and based on the direction of the reinforcement signal, and dividing the regions to confirm the region positions of the sickbeds. The patient position and the action posture can be continuously monitored, the dynamic real-time monitoring of the patient is realized, the monitoring blind area existing in the traditional manual inspection and patient autonomous calling mode is avoided, the monitoring timeliness and the monitoring accuracy are improved, the falling risk of the patient after leaving the bed is effectively reduced, and the safety of the patient is ensured.

title_en: System for alerting to a threat to personal safety
abstract_en: The invention relates to technology allowing a person to inform certain parties that they (the person) are experiencing an emergency situation. The present system for alerting to a threat to personal safety or to health comprises programmable computerised communication means which can be worn by users and are equipped with a unit for wirelessly transmitting a signal when a physical or touch-sensitive button on said means or a touch-sensitive button in a corresponding application on said computerised means is pressed in the event of signs of a threat to personal safety or a medical problem, said signal being an alert signal and being wirelessly transmitted to a remotely accessible centralised help structure designed to receive signals from such computerised communication means worn by users.

title_en: Emergency data management and access system
abstract_en: Described herein are systems, servers, devices, methods, and media for providing and managing access to emergency data. In some embodiments, a method for managing access to emergency data for emergency service providers by an emergency management system includes the steps of: determining a first set of data categories to be made accessible to an emergency service provider (ESP), wherein the first set of data categories is selected from a second set of data categories; detecting an emergency alert from an electronic device; associating the ESP with the emergency alert; gathering emergency data associated with the emergency alert available for the first set of data categories; and securely transmitting, to the ESP, the emergency data associated with the emergency alert available for the first set of data categories.

title_en: Blind area early warning system based on upper and lower binocular vision analysis range finding
abstract_en: The invention provides a blind area early warning system based on upper and lower binocular vision analysis and distance measurement, which comprises a central processing unit, a binocular image acquisition module, a CVBS screen, a warning device, a storage module, a communication module and an operation platform, wherein the warning device comprises an external audible and visual alarm and an internal alarm, the CVBS screen, the external audible and visual alarm and the internal alarm are all connected with the central processing unit, the binocular image acquisition module is used for acquiring image information and transmitting the image information to the central processing unit, the central processing unit processes the image information, then transmits the image information to the storage module and transmits the image information to the operation platform through the communication module, and the storage module records a video and generates an alarm accessory after receiving a signal; the central processing unit comprises a target detection unit, a target filtering unit, a binocular distance estimation unit, a target alarm decision unit and an alarm control unit.

title_en: Pn beta-Ga based on polar two-dimensional material quantum well 2 O 3 Solar blind deep ultraviolet photoelectric detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pn beta-Ga based on a polar two-dimensional material quantum well  2  O  3  The solar blind deep ultraviolet photoelectric detector mainly solves the problem that the internal gain of the existing pn junction type photoelectric detector is insufficient. Which is provided with a substrate (1) and beta-Ga from bottom to top  2  O  3  A layer (2), a multiple quantum well layer (3) and a NiO layer (4), wherein the multiple quantum well layer (3) is formed by alpha-In  2  Se  3  Two-dimensional lamellar polar materials with MoSSe, which are positioned in beta-Ga  2  O  3  An upper portion of one end of the layer; beta-Ga  2  O  3  The other end of the layer is provided with a negative electrode (6), and the upper part of the NiO layer is provided with a positive electrode (5). The invention is characterized in that the beta-Ga  2  O  3  The multi-quantum well layer is additionally arranged between the layer and the NiO layer, the effects of the quantum limiting Stark effect and unipolar carrier transport are utilized, the light guide gain of the device is increased, the quantum efficiency and the responsivity of the device are improved, and the device can be used for fire disaster early warning, target identification and information communication.

title_en: Urban intelligent flood prevention drainage early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban intelligent flood prevention drainage early warning and discloses an urban intelligent flood prevention drainage early warning method. The flood prevention early warning system integrates precipitation monitoring, rated drainage evaluation of a drainage well, accurate wellhead water flow detection and image recognition technologies. Through obtaining precipitation and drainage well rated data in real time, well head water flow distribution is carefully analyzed by combining a multi-water flow rate detector, and well head conditions are judged by utilizing a camera and image recognition. The system flexibly responds to complex situations such as rapid decrease of the water discharge, accompanying of foreign matters, stable rise of the water level reaching the rated amount and the like according to the water discharge change and wellhead situation, and establishes and executes a corresponding early warning strategy. In addition, the system can rapidly locate and inform people in the surrounding 1 km, and timely transmit flood information in a short message mode, so that the first time mastering condition of flood-related people is ensured, and the flood prevention efficiency and safety are effectively improved.

title_en: Inclined to one side magnetic vibration monitoring devices of transformer direct current based on iron core amplitude

title_en: Wireless relay module for remote monitoring systems having alarm and display functionality

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based supporting structure top deformation monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supporting structure top deformation monitoring and early warning method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps of setting a monitoring datum point; burying monitoring identification points at the top of the supporting structure; acquiring the position and the height difference of the monitoring identification point by using an unmanned plane in combination with the datum point; acquiring coordinate information of the monitoring identification points again by taking different datum points as references; judging whether the coordinate recognition error meets the requirement; comparing and calculating to obtain deformation of the monitoring point; judging the safety of the foundation pit according to the standard or the early warning threshold value; the unmanned aerial vehicle starts an early warning signal lamp and notifies the command part; emergency rescue treatment; alarm release; and returning to the take-off position after the deformation monitoring is finished. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for monitoring and early warning of the deformation of the top of the supporting structure, and is combined with an emergency treatment process to realize automation and remote monitoring, so that management personnel are helped to carry out risk assessment emergency command after an emergency situation occurs, the remote emergency rescue and command requirements are met, and the blindness and hysteresis defects of emergency management after the emergency situation occurs are overcome.

title_en: Long tunnel fire control pipeline multi-risk early warning system based on optical fiber sensing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of tunnel pipeline monitoring, and aims to solve the problems that a traditional fire-fighting pipeline detection system cannot acquire various risk information on a fire-fighting pipeline and a detection blind area exists. The multi-risk early warning system for the long tunnel fire-fighting pipeline based on optical fiber sensing is provided, the brillouin light and Rayleigh light detection unit is used for realizing combined detection of the brillouin light and the Rayleigh light on an optical fiber group based on a dual-wavelength laser, and the common detection of the strain, vibration and temperature signals is realized by combining an optical and electric modulation device; the optical fiber group is tightly attached to the fire-fighting pipeline and comprises a tight optical fiber and a loose optical fiber, wherein the tight optical fiber is used for detecting a strain signal at the fire-fighting pipeline, and the loose optical fiber is used for detecting a temperature and a vibration signal at the fire-fighting pipeline; the fault judging unit judges the fault type of the fire-fighting pipeline based on the output signals of the optical fiber groups. The invention can realize the common detection of deformation, vibration and temperature of the fire-fighting pipeline and has high detection precision and efficiency.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electric safety alarm method and device for the visually impaired person and hearing-impaired person which detects risk factors for electrical disasters occurring in electrical facilities, directly alerts the visually impaired person and hearing-impaired person, and guides a third party through wired communication in order to quickly remove the risk factors of electrical disasters and inconveniences caused by power outages. title_en: Alert broadcasting to unconfigured communications devices
abstract_en: Methods and systems for communicating alert messages to target communications devices in a target physical location are disclosed. The target devices may not be preconfigured to be discovered or to receive the alert message. Network sources are queried to identify accessible logical locations, which are associated with physical locations in a database. The logical locations include an intelligent network source which, having received the alert message, detects nearby devices in the target physical location. The system prepares and communicates the alert message to the target device. The intelligent network source may be configured to prepare and communicate the alert message without any intermediate system step of formulating a list of recipients. Auto-discovery and message delivery methods employ protocol packet injection, network and access point spoofing, and Bluetooth signaling. Auto-discovery and unconfigured delivery methods can be used to reveal the presence of devices in an area.

title_en: Portable prompt device for sentinels against attack

The prompt device consists of two parts that: in the first part, an infrared detector and a signal generator combine to form a separate unit on which a parallel interface is arranged; and in the second part, a signal receiver and a mini vibration alarm combine to form a receiving unit. The infrared detector captures the signal of a foreign body, the signal generator sends the signal out, and the signal receiver converts the received signal to an output warning in a mechanical vibration way by the mini vibration alarm. The utility model has the advantages of effectively preventing the sentinels, security guards or night watchmen and the like from being attacked on guard in a fixed position, reminding by adopting a vibration mode, ensuring that the alert personnel can prepare in advance for conveniently and timely responding to an emergency incident and avoiding the casualties caused by being attacked when warning without alerting intruders particularly when the view is limited in the night.
