title_en: Leak detection device for air suction pipe of compressor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a leak detection device for an air suction pipe of a compressor, and relates to the technical field of vehicle air conditioners. Including fixed body, fixed body inside cavity just is provided with the moving structure, and moving structure is including inserting the moving pipe of locating fixed body both ends, and the outside one end of moving pipe is provided with the jam structure, and fixed body outside is provided with detection structure, and detection structure is including the slip lantern ring of cover locating the fixed body outside, and slip lantern ring one side is fixed with the handle, and opposite one side is fixed with the connecting block. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the detection structure, the detection ring is sleeved outside the air suction pipe to be detected during detection and is used for moving detection along the air suction pipe, so that the whole air suction pipe can be detected to leak, when the air flow sensor detects leakage air, the warning lamp blinks and the voice broadcasting device generates larger sound, so that the air leakage position is convenient to determine, the problem of leak detection blind areas is not easy to exist, and the usability of the device is better improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI SENPU AUTO AIR CONDITIONER CO LTD

title_en: LNG hose mount of unloading
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of LNG unloading hose placement, in particular to an LNG unloading hose fixing frame, which comprises the following technical scheme: the anti-collision fence comprises an anti-collision fence body, wherein sliding grooves are formed in the anti-collision fence body at equal intervals, warning lamp bodies are movably inserted into two ends of the anti-collision fence body respectively, and the anti-collision fence further comprises a sliding ring; the slip ring is slidably arranged in the chute; wherein, both ends are fixed mounting rack and holding ring respectively about the sliding ring. The utility model solves the problems that the existing situation is messy in site because the unloading hose is not fixed in placement position, the unloading port sequence of each tank car is different, and the hidden trouble that the hose is not installed at the corresponding unloading port exists; after the unloading operation is completed, in the link of disassembling the car hose, residual liquid occasionally exists in the hose, and the residual liquid flows back and splashes out when the blind plate is installed, so that the problem of potential safety hazard exists.

title_en: Brake Anti-mis-stepping confirmation of synchronization warning light
abstract_en: This patent brake Anti-mis-stepping confirmation of synchronization warning light belongs to automotive field brake light system, the technical solution feature be exactly in order to solve the problems, such as existing motor vehicle because brake with existing for throttle position it is blind step on defect and again because distance too closely by blind step on due to cause the dangerous defect accidentally stepped on and loophole to make more and more drivers that phenomenon of taking throttle as brake accidentally be taken to step on event frequently occur, lead to bitterness tragic outcome.The technical solution be on existing brake of motor-driven vehicle lamp wiring it is in parallel go out a confirmation of synchronization warning light device that driver can be allowed to see while touching on the brake to solve the problems, such as to make up blind step on accidentally step on defect loophole.The device has the function of that driver is helped to promote judgement rapidly, and be multiplied safety driving tips coefficient, to reduce accidentally fault ratio that phenomenon of taking throttle as brake is stepped on, play the role of reduction and mitigate casualties and property loss do not continue to it is widened.

title_en: Cold chain logistics environment intelligent monitoring system based on thing networking
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent monitoring system for a cold chain logistics environment based on the Internet of things, which comprises a vehicle-mounted monitoring terminal, a cloud management platform, an environment sensing module, a data preprocessing module, a wireless communication module and a cargo quality evaluation module, wherein the vehicle-mounted monitoring terminal is arranged in a transportation carrier and is used for collecting, processing and uploading cold chain environment and cargo state data in real time, the cloud management platform is connected with the vehicle-mounted monitoring terminal and is used for gathering, processing, storing and displaying the real-time data, so that key influencing factors such as attitude change, gas components and the like in the cargo transportation process can be captured in real time, monitoring blind areas are effectively filled, the real environment state of the cold chain transportation is comprehensively reflected by the monitoring data, in addition, the residual shelf life of the cargo can be predicted in real time, quality early warning can be sent out in advance, and management personnel can take intervention measures in time, and economic losses caused by cargo deterioration are effectively avoided.
assignees: BEIJING DAHEHENG GRAIN AND OIL TRADE CO LTD

title_en: Method to provide fire information for hearing-impaired person
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for identifying a hearing-impaired person based on an image photographed by a cctv when a fire occurs, and providing fire information to the hearing-impaired person. according to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for providing fire information to a hearing-impaired person comprises the steps of: obtaining a sensing value from a fire detection sensor to determine whether a fire occurs; identifying a hearing-impaired person based on an image photographed by a cctv when it is determined that a fire occurs; and outputting a warning signal to a terminal of the hearing-impaired person.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재발생 시 CCTV에 촬영된 영상에 기초하여 청각장애인을 식별하고, 청각장애인에게 화재정보를 제공하는 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 청각장애인에게 화재정보를 제공하는 방법은 화재 감지 센서로부터 센싱값을 획득하여 화재 발생여부를 판단하는 단계, 화재가 발생하였다고 판단되면, CCTV에서 촬영된 영상에 기초하여 청각장애인을 식별하는 단계, 상기 청각장애인 단말에 경고신호를 출력하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: FOUND RES & BUSINESS SEOUL NAT UNIV SCI & TECH

title_en: Universal configuration, control and monitoring of disparate devices via an saas interface and mobile application
abstract_en: A monitoring, control and configuration system that includes a local system, a mobile device application, and a server that is accessible by users via the mobile device application and a Software as a Service (SaaS) interface via a browser is disclosed. The local system contains a microprocessor, communications components and related software all of which enable communications with the server and external components coupled with the local system. The local system software and server software combine with the mobile application and website interface to enable a user to monitor, configure, and control external devices coupled with the local system and the local system itself via the server. The system replaces multiple disparate control devices with a single, configurable device and system. The system integrates multiple disparate devices and systems from multiple manufacturers. The system provides emergency alerts based on examination of information from external devices provided to the local system and the server.

title_en: Indoor and outdoor integration planing method for emergency management and rescue optimal path computation
abstract_en: The present invention is a kind of indoor and outdoor integration planing method for emergency management and rescue optimal path computation, the following steps are included: the three-dimensional navigation network that building is coupled to each other, to construct high-rise, super high-rise building interior three-dimensional Navigation Data Model INDM, and the three-dimensional navigation network of building interior is coupled with urban traffic network；Car speed is obtained by intelligent transportation system, and based on car speed, determine the transportation accessibility coefficient of urban traffic network, escape speed high-rise, inside super high-rise building is obtained by the intelligence building system, calculate high-rise, super high-rise building three-dimensional navigation network transportation accessibility coefficient, accident point confirmation is carried out according to warning message, optimum route analysis is carried out using dynamic dijkstra's algorithm, obtains the optimal path of rescue.Make high-rise rescue from extensive rescue to the transformation finely rescued, has important theoretical significance and practical application value.

title_en: The disaster broadcasting PA in public facility, the remotely functioning A/V smart broadcasting device, a closed network system
title_ko: 공공 다중이용시설 재난재해 동보방송 구내방송장치(PA)와 원격 협업기능 A/V(Audio/Video) 스마트 방송장치 및 폐쇄자가망 시스템
abstract_en: When a civil defense alarm terminal which can be remotely controlled by the Korea Air and Space Operations Center (KAOC) or a multi-use facility control server receives emergency broadcast broadcasting data (disaster alert, disaster risk, air strike, CTRN, text to speech (TTS) data) for inside/outside public buildings such as schools, public institutions, or the like including the Article 33 (3) of the Framework Act on Civil Defense, and the Article 55-2 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act (propagation of civil defense alerts) of buildings subject to alarm propagation, emergency broadcast is made through a multi-use facility alert terminal.
abstract_ko: 한국항공우주작전본부(KAOC: Korea Air and space Operations Center)에서 원격제어가 가능한 민방위 경보단말기 또는 민방위기본법 제33조 제3항, 동법 시행령 제55조의2(민방위 경보의 전파) "경보전파 대상 건축물"을 포함하는 학교, 관공서 등 공공 건축물 내/외부에 대해 비상방송 방송데이터(재난경계, 재난위험, 공습, 화생방, TTS(Text To Speech) 데이터)를 다중이용시설 통제서버가 수신하면, 다중이용시설 경보단말기를 통해 비상방송을 한다.

title_en: Device for monitoring running state of double-Y type wiring high-voltage power capacitor in real time
abstract_en: The utility model discloses device for monitoring the running state of a double-Y type wiring high-voltage power capacitor in real time. The device adopts a voltage transformer to acquire a voltage between neutral points of the capacitor and inputs into a voltage changing module, output signals of the voltage changing module are input into a filtering module, output signals of the filtering module are respectively input into an A/D ( analogue-to-digital) converting module and a measuring and displaying module, output signals of the A/D converting module are input into a data transmission module, output signals of the data transmission module are input into a data processing module, and output signals of the data processing module are input into a data managing and pre-warning module. The device can monitor failures or failure hidden dangers caused by breakdown of small capacitor during running of high-voltage power capacitor set in real time, improve the running reliability of capacitor bank, lower blindness of power failure tests and maintenance, and reduce the breakdown time of production equipment as well as the production cost.

title_en: Disaster prevention and safety monitoring system
abstract_en: A disaster prevention monitoring system comprises a strong wind, rainfall, earthquake and foreign body invasion monitoring subsystem and is characterized in that the subsystem consists of display alarm equipment, logical judgment generation equipment, data acquisition processing equipment, field monitoring equipment, a train control center and power supply equipment, wherein the logical judgment generation equipment is respectively connected with the display alarm equipment and the data acquisition processing equipment; and the field monitoring equipment is connected with the data acquisition processing equipment, the train control center and the power supply equipment. As a civil high-speed running passenger special line, the disaster prevention and safety monitoring system can ensure the safety of the trains under various disasters and sudden disasters, and a railway strong wind monitoring and early warning system is established to ensure the running safety of the train, improve the railway transportation efficiency of the train as far as possible and timely take emergency measures for disasters.

title_en: Bridge expansion joint alarm device for road engineering
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bridge expansion joint alarm device for road engineering. Bridge expansion joint alarm device for road engineering includes: the bridge comprises a bridge body, an expansion joint and a fixed plate; the bottom of the thread block is fixed to the top of the fixing plate, and a lead screw is connected to the inner thread of the thread block. The utility model provides a bridge expansion joint alarm device for road engineering, through the starter motor, start through the motor can indirectly drive first belt pulley and rotate, when first belt pulley is rotatory, can indirectly drive the threaded rod rotation through the second belt pulley, can indirectly drive two movable box back movements through the sliding plate through the screw thread drive effect, be convenient for measure the width at expansion joint, and, when the expansion joint width is less than the standard value, the accessible is according to the touch switch of pressing the board touch, can indirectly control the warning through touch switch and rumble the lamp warning, can make things convenient for the staff in time to maintain it.

title_en: Personnel positioning and overtemperature early warning bracelet for high-temperature area of metallurgical workshop
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of metallurgical safety, and discloses a personnel positioning and overtemperature early warning bracelet for a high-temperature area of a metallurgical workshop. The personnel positioning and overtemperature early warning bracelet for the high-temperature area of the metallurgical workshop has the advantages of good warning effect, convenience in crisis management and the like, and solves the problems that once high-temperature dangerous situations or other emergency situations occur, the environment temperature of the personnel cannot be monitored in real time, all operation time periods are difficult to cover by regular inspection, monitoring blind areas exist, the personnel position is difficult to be mastered in time by management personnel, the rescue efficiency is low, and the optimal rescue opportunity is delayed.

title_en: Super long auxiliary system of entry that road was used
abstract_en: The invention discloses an entrance overlength auxiliary system for a road, which comprises a monitoring system, a warning system and a control switch, wherein the monitoring system comprises a monitoring camera arranged on a monitoring rod of a toll plaza, a front-end switch and a hard disk video recorder are sequentially connected to a camera connecting circuit, and finally the monitoring camera is connected to a desktop display of a toll window, the warning system comprises two LED display screens which are arranged on the toll plaza and are separated by 20m, the LED display screens are arranged by adopting round iron pipes, meanwhile, 2 iron pipes are welded with side guardrails of the toll site, the sight blind area of toll staff can be compensated by the monitoring system, and the loading condition of vehicle cargoes, in particular whether overlength is ensured or not, can be timely found when the vehicle enters the toll plaza. The method ensures that the toll collector can intervene in advance, changes the passive situation that the problem is found when the vehicle passes through the window, greatly simplifies the later operation flow and improves the overall management efficiency.

title_en: System and method for alerting a user
abstract_en: An alerting system control server (121) in a set of servers (120) and a method (200) therein, for alerting a user, in particular a hearing impaired user, of an incoming signal for a service associated with the user. The method (200) comprises: receiving (202) information that an internet service server (110) is receiving an incoming signal for the service; generating (203) a control signal for triggering an alerting system controller (130) to alert the user of the incoming signal for the service by activating an alerting device (140); identifying (204) the alerting system controller (130) and extract the address of the alerting system controller (130); and sending (205) the generated (203) control signal to the identified (204) alerting system controller (130), for activating the alerting device (140) and thereby alerting the user; wherein the communication between the alerting system controller (130) and the alerting device (140) is made over a communication protocol based on the Internet Protocol.

title_en: Battery interconnected alert device system with vibrational alert
abstract_en: Disclosed is a battery interconnected detection and alert device system with building structure vibrational alert. The system includes of one or more alert devices wired into a dedicated circuit with a single location housing a DC power backup source, such as a rechargeable DC battery. The DC power backup source may be replaceable or rechargeable with DC current from an AC-DC transformer-rectifier, a photovoltaic cell, or other means. An electrical relay within the system provides a current to the dedicated circuit by selecting between the line-voltage alternating current source and the DC power backup. When activated, the detection and alert device generates a distinctive pulsed vibrational alert transmitted through the building structure to beds and other furniture resting on the floor, and additionally transmitted through the air as pressure waves which are perceived by hearing-impaired and other persons alerting them to a possible emergency situation.

title_en: Rain and flood drainage road risk early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic flood early warning, in particular to a method and a device for early warning of risk of a rainfall flood drainage road. The method for warning the risk of the rain and flood drainage road is applied to a risk warning device and comprises the following steps of obtaining a water depth value, judging whether the water depth value is larger than a first water depth value or not, if so, obtaining a water flow speed, determining a risk grade according to the water depth value and the water flow speed, and carrying out grading risk warning according to the risk grade, so that monitoring of the water condition of the rain and flood drainage road and corresponding warning of different risk grades are achieved, and the problem that pedestrians cannot accurately judge the water condition and blind wading brings risks to self safety is avoided.

title_en: Intelligent geological disaster early warning method and system for 5G high-speed rail
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 5G high-speed rail oriented intelligent geological disaster early warning method, which comprises the following steps: s1: arranging sensing monitoring equipment along the railway, collecting seismic waveform time domain signals by the equipment and uploading the signals to an edge server; s2: the edge server preprocesses the data acquired by the sensing monitoring equipment in real time, and the preprocessed data is input into the pre-training model to obtain a prediction result; s3: the railway early warning control center acquires a landslide area displacement time sequence based on a synthetic aperture radar of an interferometry technology, judges a landslide distribution area, performs early warning judgment according to a prediction result, and immediately controls the running state of the high-speed rail; the invention also discloses an intelligent geological disaster early warning system for the 5G high-speed rail, which comprises sensing detection equipment, an edge server and a railway early warning control center, and can reliably detect longitudinal waves and transverse waves of extremely small to extremely large earthquakes without a definite waveform template, thereby realizing comprehensive geological monitoring and timely early warning without blind areas.
assignees: NANJING TICOM TECH CO LTD;UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Smart stick for blind
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart cane for the visually impaired, which is possible to guide the visually impaired to a destination on the basis of GPS, detect obstacles during walking to provide warning notification and avoidance gait, and convert information necessary for gait guidance into voice to prevent accidents. According to the present invention, the smart cane for the visually impaired comprises: a cane member; a GPS module provided on the cane member to provide location information; a voice recognition module provided on the cane member to recognize the voice of a visually impaired user and transmit a voice command to a navigation module; the navigation module receiving the voice command recognized by the voice recognition module and interworking with the GPS module to guide a route; a speaker module delivering voice guidance information provided from the navigation module to the user; an obstacle detection module provided on the cane member and configured to detect obstacles during walking; a control circuit module provided on the cane member and configured to control the operation of each of the modules; and a battery provided in the cane member to supply required power to each of the modules.

title_en: Semi-trailer train blind area track early warning method and device aiming at external environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for early warning of a blind area track of a semitrailer train aiming at an external environment, and relates to the technical field of vehicle driving safety, wherein the method and the device are provided with four inner wheel differential coverage area mapping point positions on the left side of a tractor, the left side of a semitrailer, the right side of the tractor and the right side of the semitrailer, each point position is provided with a front linear laser lamp and a rear linear laser lamp, the formed early warning device can greatly increase the turning early warning area, and can early warn pedestrians or non-motor vehicles in advance without passing a path when the semitrailer train turns, so that the reaction time of the pedestrians or the non-motor vehicles is increased, and the potential safety hazard is greatly reduced; the early warning area of the device is based on the real-time calculation of the wheel difference in the turning, and the early warning area is dynamically adjusted along with the running state of the vehicle, so that the early warning area is more accurate.

title_en: Be used for thermal power plant's safety warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety warning device for a thermal power plant, which comprises a first square pipe, wherein a box body penetrates through and is fixed at the middle part of the first square pipe, a rocker is rotatably sleeved at one side of the box body, an opening is formed in one side of the box body, one end of the rocker penetrates through the opening, one end of the rocker is rotatably connected with a lifting mechanism, and a threaded rod is fixedly sleeved on the lifting mechanism. The novel warning board has the advantages that the warning content can be observed in multiple directions, visual blind spots are reduced, the warning effect can be effectively improved, the newly added bottom roller enables the novel potential safety hazard position in a factory to be easily moved to a proper position, workers can be warned in time, the safety of operators is effectively protected, the lifting mechanism of the equipment realizes double warning functions, and the latest safety notice is prompted on the display board, so that the full warning function is realized.

title_en: Fire Alarm System Using TTS
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 TTS를 이용한 화재 경보 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 고안은, 화재감지 시스템으로부터 화재발생 위치정보를 포함하는 화재발생신호를 수신하는 수신부; 텍스트로 구성되고 편집 가능한 화재방송 시나리오를 적어도 하나 이상 포함하는 시나리오 데이터베이스를 저장하는 저장부; 상기 화재발생 위치정보에 따른 대피경로를 획득하고, 상기 화재발생 위치정보와 상기 획득된 대피경로를 상기 화재발생 시나리오에 반영함으로써 화재방송용 텍스트를 구성하는 화재방송용 텍스트 구성부; TTS 엔진을 이용하여 텍스트를 음성으로 변환하는 음성 변환부; 상기 음성 변환부에서 변환된 음성을 구내 방송 시스템으로 전송하는 제1 전송부; 화재발생 정보를 소방서로 전송하는 제2 전송부; 및 상기 화재감지 시스템으로부터 상기 화재발생신호를 수신한 경우, 상기 시나리오 데이터베이스를 참조하여 상기 수신된 화재발생신호에 포함된 화재발생 위치정보에 부합하는 화재방송 시나리오를 검색하고, 상기 화재방송용 텍스트 구성부를 제어하여 상기 수신된 화재발생신호에 포함된 화재발생 위치정보에 따라 화재방송용 텍스트를 구성하고, 상기 음성 변환부를 제어하여 상기 구성된 화재방송용 텍스트를 음성으로 변환하여 상기 제1 전송부를 통해 상기 구내 방송 시스템으로 전송하고, 상기 제2 전송부를 통해 상기 화재발생 정보를 상기 소방서로 전송하는 제어부를 포함하는 TTS를 이용한 화재 경보 시스템을 제공한다. 
     
     화재 감지, 화재방송 시나리오, 화재방송용 텍스트, TTS, 구내 방송, 화재발생 정보, 다국어

title_en: Landslide, avalanche method for early warning
abstract_en: The present invention relates to disaster alarm field, discloses a kind of landslide, avalanche method for early warning.This method comprises the following steps：A, massif is observed, the position for selecting that landslip easily occurs is punched into massif；B, after the completion of punching, by the patchhole of monitoring unit, the shotcrete into hole, blind；C, capstan head in signal is set up, monitoring unit is established with warning center and communicates to connect；D, communication connection is established between warning center and local household.Early warning effectively can be realized to landslide, avalanche by this method.

title_en: Intelligent recognition safe driving early warning system and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide an intelligent recognition safe driving early warning system and a working method thereof. The technical scheme of the invention is as follows: the intelligent pedestrian monitoring system comprises an advancing induction module, a signal transmission module and a data collection and analysis module, wherein the advancing induction module consists of a plurality of motor vehicles, each motor vehicle is provided with eight monitors, two pedestrian recognition devices and an automatic brake device, and each monitor consists of a shell, a sucking disc piece, a camera, a circuit board, a power supply, a data processor, a signal sending device and an indicator light; the whole system is provided with eight monitors on each motor vehicle, and by matching with the transmission of a wireless network and the data analysis and output of a server, the passing of pedestrians between two static vehicles can be monitored in real time, so that early warning signals are sent to driving drivers who find abnormal conditions, the automatic braking function is activated in time, the driving risks caused by visual blind areas and error areas are avoided, an emergency protection is performed on the pedestrians, and further traffic safety accidents are avoided.

title_en: Landslide hidden danger early warning and monitoring device
abstract_en: The application provides landslide hidden danger early warning monitoring devices belongs to landslide early warning technical field, and this landslide hidden danger early warning monitoring devices includes that the landslide buries ground subassembly and landslide early warning subassembly. The compression restriction of directional spring is relieved to directional cylinder, when the hidden danger appears in the other landslide of mountain road, under the effect of slide bed drilling rod on the slide bed, bury ground barrel holder and keep spacing fixed, the displacement extrusion of glide body buries the phase place guide pin bushing of ground barrel holder lower extreme, under directional spring force effect, the displacement of multidirectional slide is slided on multidirectional sliding tray, the first universal joint and the second universal joint that are close to glide body displacement extrusion direction are close to gradually, jacking spring pressurized can be with the jack-up of the last jack-up of second universal joint, thereby drive the warning device on the early warning vaulting pole and rise, the colour height of driver's accessible roadside warning device of passing carries out in time prejudgement to place landslide hidden danger. The early warning method is suitable for early warning of landslide hidden dangers of mountain roads, and reduces landslide accidents of the mountain roads.
assignees: SHENZHEN INVESTIGATION & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: On-duty voice early warning system and method based on text-to-speech
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-duty voice early warning system and method based on text-to-speech, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, setting corresponding early warning text information according to different fault types of a power distribution network; s2, converting each early warning text message into an initial warning voice by adopting a TTS text-to-voice technology; s3, intercepting and selecting keywords of the early warning text information; s4, setting different early warning voice broadcast volumes and broadcast light colors according to different keywords; and S5, judging the processing priority level of the early warning text information by the user according to different broadcast volumes and broadcast light colors. According to the method, the voice is further rendered by converting the text information of the power distribution network fault into the voice by adopting a TTS text-to-voice technology and simultaneously adopting early warning grade division, so that the abnormal early warning information is actively reminded more specifically.
assignees: NANJING RUIYUAN ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Combined control type exhaust valve with early warning function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined control type exhaust valve with an early warning function, which comprises a first valve body, wherein a bottom sealing pipe is arranged above the first valve body in a sealing way, a positioning net is arranged in an inner groove of the first valve body, a floating ball is arranged in an inner groove of the positioning net, and the combined control type exhaust valve further comprises: the valve seat is arranged above the first valve body in a sealing way, and the second valve body is arranged above the valve seat in a sealing way through the sealing ring. This ally oneself with accuse formula discharge valve with early warning function possesses functions such as equipment self-checking, on-line monitoring, and accessible analysis valve current pressure state judges whether there is hidden danger and trouble, and real-time transmission alarm signal, signal transmission is reliable and stable simultaneously, when the negative pressure appears in the accident such as taking place to have a power failure, stopping the pump, in time inhales the gas intraductal and prevents pipeline vibrations or rupture, also can pass through the unusual fluctuation of intraductal pressure signal in the water hammer accident, sends alarm signal and control signal, ally controls other wisdom water service series products, maintains equipment safety.

title_en: Fusion perception-based safety early warning system and method for operators under shore bridge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety early warning system and method for operators under a shore bridge based on fusion perception, the system comprises a multimode sensing terminal, a UWB positioning base station, an intelligent vision assembly, an acoustic ranging unit, a data fusion processing server and an early warning executing device. And respectively acquiring multi-source position information of the personnel in the operation area through UWB positioning, visual identification and acoustic ranging, dynamically selecting a fusion strategy based on signal quality, and resolving the position of the personnel in real time. On the basis, a dynamic electronic fence taking the lifting appliance as the center is constructed, the behavior of an operator entering a dangerous area or a forbidden area is judged in a level mode, and a multi-level response mechanism such as audible and visual alarm, terminal reminding or quayside bridge action control is triggered, so that high-precision, non-blind area, all-weather safety perception and closed-loop early warning intervention of the operator are realized. The invention can obviously improve the safety guarantee capability of personnel below the operation of the quay crane and has good engineering applicability and popularization value.

title_en: Warning system comprising wristband embodiment
abstract_en: The present invention is related to warning systems(S) that enable the people to detect various electrical warning signals around by means of vibration and light, to inform the third persons in the emergencies and to provide the electricity and gas where they are present, to be cut automatically in case of emergencies. The present invention is especially related to a warning device that enables the hearing impaired people, the elderly, children and patients to transform the various electrical signals into vibration and/or light, the people to detect said sound warnings, the two users that are using wristband (41) to contact with each other, all the users to be warned, and only one user to be called/warned; and to the warning method of said device.

title_en: Emergency data management and access system
abstract_en: Described herein are systems, servers, devices, methods, and media for providing and managing access to emergency data. In some embodiments, a method for managing access to emergency data for emergency service providers by an emergency management system includes the steps of: determining a first set of data categories to be made accessible to an emergency service provider (ESP), wherein the first set of data categories is selected from a second set of data categories; detecting an emergency alert from an electronic device; associating the ESP with the emergency alert; gathering emergency data associated with the emergency alert available for the first set of data categories; and securely transmitting, to the ESP, the emergency data associated with the emergency alert available for the first set of data categories.

title_en: System and method of communicating emergency alerts
abstract_en: A set-top box device is disclosed. The set-top box device includes a processor and a memory device accessible to the processor. The memory device includes instructions to communicate with a multi-cast alert server to receive a multicast emergency alert message. The multicast emergency alert message includes data related to a location code and data related to a set-top box action. The memory device stores location information and includes instructions to execute the set-top box action when the location code matches the location information.

title_en: Emergency message relay
abstract_en: A wireless device receives a first emergency message in a first communication protocol via a first wireless interface of the plurality of wireless interfaces from a transmitting wireless device, translates the first emergency message in the first communication protocol to a second emergency message in a second communication protocol, and transmits the second emergency message via a second wireless interface of the plurality of wireless interfaces to a network infrastructure. A wireless device requesting emergency service prepares one or more emergency messages based upon an emergency message direction received from a user, repeatedly transmits the at least one emergency message via one or more available wireless interfaces. Upon meeting a termination criteria, the wireless device ceases repeatedly transmitting the at least one emergency message via the at least one wireless interface.

title_en: Safety barrier capable of rapidly identifying front and back sides
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety barrier for rapidly identifying the front and the back, which comprises a barrier frame, wherein an isolation rod frame and a warning board are arranged on the barrier frame, an installation interlayer is arranged in the barrier frame, a fluorescence identification component is arranged in the installation interlayer, fluorescent strips with two colors are respectively arranged on the front surface and the back surface of the barrier frame, the length of the fluorescent strips is longer, and erecting personnel can know the erecting direction at the first time during erecting so as to avoid the condition that the working efficiency is influenced because the worker finds out that the assembly is mistakenly installed and needs to be reinstalled when installing the barrier to half; if the user is when discovering the dress mistake, its accessible rotates and adjusts the rotation worm and makes branch installation cover and vice installation cover rotate simultaneously to change the front and back position of fluorescent layer, make the maintainer still can know safe working range the very first time, thereby very big reduction the potential safety hazard during production.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Quick translation of beam-pumping unit motor, belt lax warning and pretension device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of motor equipment, and provides a motor rapid translation, belt relaxation alarming and pre-tightening device of an oil pumping unit. The motor rapid translation, belt looseness alarming and pre-tightening device of the oil pumping unit comprises a base, a translation mechanism, a motor, a pressure detection mechanism and an alarming mechanism. According to the rapid translation, belt loosening alarming and pre-tightening device for the oil pumping machine motor, radial rapid translation of the motor can be realized through the arranged translation mechanism, the belt can be quickly loosened or pre-tightened, belt replacement of belt transmission equipment is quicker and more labor-saving, radial rapid movement at any position can be realized on the basis of not disassembling foundation bolts, the belt can be conveniently kept in a proper state of tightness at any time without stopping equipment, the service life of the belt is prolonged, the steps of poking the motor by using crowbars and tightening the loosened foundation bolts are avoided, a belt pulley is not required to be coiled, and the operation is safer.
assignees: SONGYUAN XINCHUANG MACHINERY EQUIPMENT REPAIR CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin evacuation early warning method for barrier-free channel of booster station
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twin evacuation early warning method for a barrier-free channel of a booster station, which effectively solves the problem of path planning misalignment caused by insufficient fusion of multisource perception data. Through the spatial data integration of the digital twin model, the usable state and disaster influence range of the barrier-free facilities can be accurately identified. The dynamic path planning algorithm continuously optimizes the evacuation route in the disaster evolution process, and prevents personnel from entering the affected dangerous area. The multi-mode instruction generation mechanism ensures that people with different physiological characteristics can obtain adaptive evacuation guidance, the detention risk caused by single information transmission mode is reduced, the real-time state monitoring and path updating function further improves the response speed and reliability of the emergency evacuation system, the geometric dimension and the space coordinates of facilities are acquired excessively accurately, the consistency of a virtual model and an actual environment is ensured, and the data support is provided for evaluating the availability of the facilities in a disaster environment by configuring material characteristics and accessibility parameters.

title_en: High-precision rapid screening and alarming method for hidden danger of foreign matters in power transmission channel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of foreign matter identification of a power transmission channel, and discloses a high-precision rapid screening and alarming method for hidden danger of foreign matter in the power transmission channel, which comprises the steps of carrying out irregular foreign matter target feature extraction on video stream image data, carrying out feature matching based on an extracted irregular foreign matter target feature map, and executing foreign matter detection; and (3) implementing foreign matter state change trend sensing on the irregular foreign matter detection result, estimating the approximate distance of the foreign matters, and implementing grading alarm to obtain a foreign matter grading alarm result. The method solves the problem that the traditional algorithm is poor in detection of the long-distance small target and irregular foreign matters, improves the warning effectiveness of the foreign matters, effectively reduces the risk of external damage by accurately identifying the initial floating foreign matters of hidden danger, and improves the operation safety of the power grid.
assignees: LIANYUNGANG ZHIYUAN POWER DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Module of alert for disasters and accidents
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An automatic voice notification module for disaster forecasts and alerts is provided to convert disaster data, delivered as a phone call, a text message, or a packet by using a CDMA(Code Division Multiple Access) module, into a voice and outputted by voice. CONSTITUTION: A TTS(Text To Speech) control part(2100) extracts text data from a disaster data and converts the text data into a voice data. A driving information storage part(2200) stores operating system data driving the TTS control part. A memory part(2300) temporarily stores the text data extracted from the TTS control part and the voice data converted from the TTS control part. A voice database part(2400) stores the corresponding data to the voice conversion of the text data and voice data by a phoneme unit or syllable. [Reference numerals] (2100) TTS(Text To Speech) control part; (2200) Driving information storage part; (2300) Memory part; (2400) Voice database part; (2500) Data communication part; (2600) Power management part

title_en: Light switch apparatus for fire alarm
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology which provides a fire alarm and, more specifically, to a technology which visually provides a fire alarm to a hearing-impaired person. According to the present invention, an automatic flickering circuit for an indoor lamp is included in a lamp switch located on a wall surface to easily notify a hearing-impaired person of fire occurrence by only simple operation.

title_en: Strobe light alarm detection and alert system
abstract_en: A system is disclosed that detects an optical alarm signal, such as a strobe light signal generated by a building alarm system. Upon detecting such a signal, the system generates a supplemental alert signal capable of alerting an individual who might not otherwise respond to the alarm condition, such as an individual who is asleep, hearing impaired, and/or sight impaired. The system may, for example, be implemented as a patient-worn device, a bedside unit, or a personal computer coupled to a light-sensing peripheral device.

title_en: Safety early warning method and device, computing equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of computers, and provides a safety early warning method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a first target image frame acquired by a predetermined first monitoring device; analyzing the image information by using a pre-trained deep learning model to obtain first identity information of the pedestrian to be identified; if the pedestrian to be identified is determined to be the target pedestrian based on the first identity information, acquiring second target image frames acquired by all second monitoring equipment; predicting a target route of the target pedestrian based on the second target image frame; and if the target route is determined to have the monitoring blind area, sending a safety early warning prompt to a predetermined terminal. The pedestrian to be identified is determined to be the target pedestrian, the target route of the target pedestrian is predicted according to the second image frames collected by all the second monitoring devices, and the safety early warning prompt is sent to the predetermined terminal under the condition that the target route is determined to have the monitoring blind area, so that the potential safety hazard caused by the monitoring blind area can be avoided.

title_en: Server cabinet with intelligent protection alarm function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a server cabinet with an intelligent protection alarm function, which belongs to the field of server cabinets, and comprises a main cabinet body, wherein a plurality of partition plates which are uniformly distributed are arranged in the main cabinet body, and a sub-frame is arranged between two adjacent partition plates; the sub-frame comprises a pair of vertical supports, a plurality of supporting plates are arranged between the pair of vertical supports, and heat exchange tubes are arranged in the supporting plates in a penetrating manner; the server main body is arranged on the supporting plate; the division board includes the main baffle, installs a pair of water conservancy diversion pipeline in the main baffle, and the closing frame is installed to the lower extreme of main baffle, and the closing frame includes the C type roof beam with a pair of perpendicular support sliding connection, and fluid regulation and control portion is installed to the bottom of the main cabinet body, through real-time supervision, realizes the comprehensive control and the warning to server main part and operational environment in the rack, and when detecting server work abnormality or operational environment abnormality, all accessible closing frame seals the server of this subregion, realizes the isolation protection of local server.

title_en: Satellite image super-resolution-based change monitoring algorithm and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an algorithm and a system for high-efficiency super-resolution processing and accurate change monitoring based on satellite images. The system combines a blind image super-resolution model and a change monitoring model based on a transducer architecture, and aims to solve the problems of insufficient satellite image resolution and low change monitoring precision in the prior art. Experimental verification results show that the method is excellent in super-resolution reconstruction and change monitoring, and can remarkably improve image resolution and change monitoring precision. The system has wide application prospect in the fields of urban planning, environmental protection, disaster early warning and the like, and provides powerful technical support for the related fields.

title_en: Foreign trade is warning sign for commodity circulation vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a warning board for a foreign trade logistics vehicle, which comprises a box body and a warning board arranged at the top end of the box body, wherein a transversely distributed opening is formed in the top end of the box body, one end of a rotating rod is fixed at the bottom end of the warning board, and the other end of the rotating rod penetrates through the opening and is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the rear end of the box body through an active rotating shaft; the box body is rotatably connected with the inner wall of the rear end of the box body and comprises a driven rotating shaft which is distributed in parallel with the driving rotating shaft. This foreign trade is warning sign for commodity circulation vehicle, thereby it is rotatory to drive first threaded rod through driving motor work, horizontal reciprocating motion is done to drive bulb and support under the screw thread effect, first threaded rod is rotatory simultaneously can drive the running gear, the intermittent type formula swing is done to initiative pivot and warning sign, thereby reach better striking effect, guarantee that the rear vehicle can in time perceive the place ahead vehicle and break down, the security of equipment when using has been promoted, avoid taking place the potential safety hazard that the vehicle collided each other.

title_en: Roll blind apparatus having a safety cord
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A roll blind with a safety cord is provided to prevent safety accidents by separately arranging ascending and descending cords and returning the ascending and descending cords to the original positions thereof after using. CONSTITUTION: A roll blind(100) with a safety cord comprises a winding unit, a descending unit(150), an ascending unit(170), and a cord return unit(200). A blind fabric is wound around the winding unit. The winding unit has a main gear. When a descending cord(S1) is pulled, the descending unit descends the blind fabric by rotating the main gear and a winding bar in a direction. When an ascending cord(S2) is pulled, the ascending unit ascends the blind fabric by rotating the main gear and the winding bar in the other direction. The cord return unit returns the descending and ascending cords to the original positions thereof.

본 발명은 블라인드 원단을 승하강시키는 코드를 상승 코드 및 하강 코드로 분리하고, 하강 코드의 당김시에는 기어비의 가속작동을 통해 빠른 속도의 블라인드 원단의 하강이 이루어지고, 상승 코드의 당김시에는 기어비의 감속작동을 통해 블라인드 원단의 무게감을 줄여서 쉽게 상승시킬 수 있음은 물론, 코드 길이를 짧게 하여 어린 아이들의 손이 닿지 않는 높은 위치에 위치시킴으로써 어린 아이들의 목 감김과 같은 안전사고를 사전에 효과적으로 예방할 수 있고, 안전 코드의 일측이 일단 하부측으로 당겨진 다음에는 자동으로 안전 코드의 원위치 복귀작동이 이루어짐으로써 연속하여 쉽게 블라인드 원단을 승하강시킬 수 있는 안전 코드를 갖는 롤 블라인드를 제공한다. 
본 발명에 따른 안전 코드를 갖는 롤 블라인드는 하강 작동부의 제1 기어 직경이 주기어의 직경보다 크게 형성되어 하강 코드의 당김 작동으로 상기 주기어의 회전수를 제1 기어의 회전수보다 크게 증속(增速)시킬 수 있음으로써 상기 블라인드 원단의 하강 속도를 빠르게 하강시킬 수 있고, 상승 작동부의 제3 기어 직경이 주기어의 직경보다 작게 형성되어 상승 코드의 당김 작동으로 상기 주기어의 회전수를 제3 기어의 회전수보다 감속(減速)시킬 수 있음으로써 상승 코드의 당김력을 크게 줄여서 상기 블라인드 원단을 상승시킬 수 있게 된다.

title_en: VANET Warning Message Propagation Method for Electric Wave Blind Area
title_ko: 전파 음영지역에서의 vanet 경고 메시지 전달 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전파 음영지역에서의 VANET 경고 메시지 전달 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 라우팅 정보를 이용하면서 노드의 상태를 다이렉트 모드와 리다이렉트 모드로 이원화하여 동작하게 하는 VANET 경고 메세지 전달 기술에 관한 것이다. 
	본 발명에 따른 전파 음영지역에서의 VANET 경고 메시지 전달 방법은 긴급 상황 발생 노드로부터 최초 경고 메시지를 수신하는 단계; 교차로 가중치가 1인지 확인하여 상기 노드가 교차로 영역에 있는지 확인하는 단계; 교차로 가중치가 1이 아닐 경우 리다이렉트 모드로 진행하는 단계; 교차로 가중치가 1인 경우에 한 개의 노드만 존재하는지 확인하는 단계; 노드가 한 개만 존재하는 경우, 경고 메시지를 전달하는 단계; 노드가 한 개만 존재하지 않는 경우, 높은 전달 우선순위인지 확인하는 단계; 높은 전달 순위로 확인되면 경고 메시지 전달 과정을 수행하고 높은 전달 순위가 아니면 대기하는 단계;로 진행되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Road vehicle passage monitoring warning device
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for traffic control equipment technical field, provides a kind of road vehicle passage monitoring warning device, including frame, upright bar, radar, display device, warning device and processor；The side of one end connection framework of upright bar, radar and warning device are installed in the side of frame, and display device is mounted on the inside of frame, and display device is surrounded by frame；Radar, display device and warning device are all connected with processor, radar is used to acquire the information of vehicles on main road, and display device is for showing that information of vehicles, processor receive information of vehicles, when there is the hidden danger that traffic accident occurs, processor control warning device is alarmed；Road vehicle passes through monitoring warning device mounted on the intersection of main road and branch.It can ensure that the vehicle of branch road is not influenced safety by intersection blind area and enters main road by such design, reduce traffic accident.
assignees: HEBEI JITONG HUIDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent transfer trolley for ward articles
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of transfer vehicles, and discloses an intelligent transfer vehicle for ward articles, which comprises a transfer vehicle, wherein the top of the transfer vehicle is provided with a universal wheel for driving the transfer vehicle to move, the outer wall surface of the transfer vehicle is provided with a storage chamber for placing articles, the opening of the storage chamber is movably connected with a matched movable door, four corners of the outer wall surface of the storage chamber are respectively provided with a first movable groove, an infrared sensor and an alarm lamp, when medical personnel pushes the transfer vehicle to move in a hospital aisle, when the front half section of the transfer vehicle is pushed to the corners of the aisle, the infrared sensors in the first two movable grooves at the front side of the transfer vehicle can sense whether other personnel approach, when other people approach the transfer vehicle, the alarm lamp can give out alarm sound and twinkle light for warning the approaching personnel and the medical personnel pushing the transfer vehicle, the medical personnel to the propelling movement transfer car (buggy) play intelligent warning in the turning blind area.
assignees: SHENZHEN HUJIANG MEDICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Rear warning device for deaf-mute
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rear warning device for the deaf-mute, which belongs to the technical field of warning devices and comprises a main body, wherein the main body is arc-shaped, two ends of the main body are connected with elastic rods, one end of each elastic rod is connected with a mounting block, and a vibrating groove is formed in each mounting block. According to the utility model, the outside of the main body is connected with the radio, the radio is used for collecting sound at the rear, the higher position is connected with the radio on the main body, the radio is prevented from being shielded by clothes, when the sound collected by the radio exceeds eighty decibels of sound emitted by a common loudspeaker, the control equipment enables the vibrating motors at the two ends to rotate, the output ends of the vibrating motors drive the semicircular vibrating blocks to rotate so as to generate vibration, meanwhile, the eccentric holes on the vibrating blocks drive the touch pad to eccentrically rotate, the touch pad is contacted with a user, vibration generated by the vibrating motors and the eccentrically and reciprocally rotated touch pad vibrate and touch the alarm, and the touch pad performs body-sensing contact alarm, so that an alarm blind area does not exist, and the alarm effect is good.

title_en: Tumble grading warning device based on piezoelectric signal monitoring and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tumble grading warning device based on piezoelectric signal monitoring and a working method thereof, wherein the tumble grading warning device comprises a detection module, a processing module and an alarm module; the detection module is used for collecting instantaneous pressure signals generated in the falling process of the human body; the processing module is provided with a grading standard threshold, compares and analyzes the acquired pressure value with the grading standard threshold, identifies the type and degree of tumble, and transmits a grading signal to the alarm module; the alarm module carries out grading alarm when receiving the grading signal; according to the invention, instantaneous pressure impact generated by a human body when falling on the piezoelectric sensor can be utilized to realize timely and effective warning when the person falls, the type and the degree of falling can be distinguished according to the difference of falling signals for warning, the hidden danger of falling of a monitoring blind area can be eliminated, when the person has a falling accident in the interval, warning with different modes and degrees can be timely provided for a guardian, and the guardian can timely give corresponding specific help and treatment to the falling person.
assignees: BEIJING TIANTAN HOSPITAL CAPITAL MEDICAL UNIV

title_en: Online monitoring and early warning system based on liquid level sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online monitoring and early warning system based on a liquid level sensor, which comprises a control system, wherein the control system comprises a liquid level monitoring unit, a central processing unit, a data processing unit, a numerical value generating unit, a contrast value setting unit, a numerical value comparing unit, a difference value generating unit, a data feedback unit, an alarm unit, a data storage unit and a liquid level display unit, wherein the output end of the liquid level monitoring unit is electrically connected with the input end of the central processing unit. This on-line monitoring early warning system based on level sensor, accessible one-level alarm module, second grade alarm module, tertiary alarm module and first difference module, second difference module, the cooperation of third difference module for when monitoring the water level, can surpass the alarm of three kinds of different grade types after the warning value according to the water level, with this water level particular case of differentiateing more easily, can carry out the hierarchical monitoring to the water level, the monitoring limitation is little.

title_en: Driving safety early warning method, driving safety early warning system, storage medium and driving safety early warning equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a driving safety early warning method, a driving safety early warning system, a storage medium and driving safety early warning equipment, wherein the driving safety early warning method comprises the following steps: acquiring vehicle state data of a vehicle in a current running environment, wherein the vehicle state data comprises vehicle running data and road surface state data; combining a pre-trained deep learning model, carrying out data fusion and feature data extraction on vehicle running data and road surface state data, and carrying out dimension reduction processing on the data after feature extraction to obtain running early warning information; and acquiring and responding to the driving early warning information, and sending the driving early warning information to the vehicle-mounted unit so that the vehicle-mounted unit provides driving safety early warning for the driving of the vehicle. According to the driving safety early warning method, the driving safety early warning system, the storage medium and the driving safety early warning equipment, the vehicle-mounted unit and the road side unit are arranged to acquire data in the driving process of the vehicle, so that the data assistance is conveniently provided for the driving of the vehicle, and the situation that safety accidents are caused by the fact that a driver cannot take safe driving operation in time due to vision blind areas is avoided.

title_en: Emergency notification, activity notification, and suspicious movement detection for mobile devices
abstract_en: Foreign emergency notification, activity notification, and suspicious movement detection for mobile devices are disclosed. An application running on a mobile device of a user may be used to automatically detect when a call is made to emergency services in a foreign country, when an issue or unpermitted behavior may be occurring, when the mobile device has moved to an anomalous or unpermitted location and/or is moving with an unexpected speed, etc. The application then notifies family members and/or other contacts in the user's home country via a domestic carrier network. An over-the-top Internet Protocol (IP) message can be sent by the application on the mobile device back to the home network core.

title_en: Intelligent calling and warning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent calling and warning system. A computer center control unit is connected with an intelligent system control unit, the intelligent system control unit is respectively connected with a speech unit, an information prompting unit, a warning lamp unit and a vibrator unit, the intelligent system control unit is formed by sequentially connecting an RS485 communication module to a microcomputer control module and a switch control module, and the information prompting unit is formed by sequentially connecting a single chip processing module to a buffer memory module and a display module. The information prompting unit receives a switch control instruction from the intelligent system control unit, and selects information segments to be displayed, and the selected information segments are processed by a single chip and are output by the display module. The utility model can help the daily life management of school for deaf-mute people and schools for blind people in a full automatic way, can realize the fast warning of emergency events, and avoids the conditions that the work and rest, the calling and the emergency event warning in daily life can not be realized because of the hearing disturbance of deaf-mute people and the seeing disturbance of the blind people.

title_en: A kind of road prior-warning device
abstract_en: A kind of road prior-warning device, comprising: vehicle detecting sensor detects and the vehicle for acquiring this lane drives into the running data in the section；Huang dodges warning lamp, starts flashing light warning when opposite lane has vehicle to drive into the section；First display screen shows the velocity information of its vehicle when opposite lane has vehicle to drive into the section；Second display screen, for showing preset different text prompt information respectively when there is vehicle in opposite lane or drives into the section without vehicle；Loudspeaker, for issuing preset language information when opposite lane has vehicle to drive into the section；Communication module, for the road prior-warning device in this lane and opposite lane to be carried out communication connection, the road prior-warning device of the utility model makes information mutual communication of the vehicle by two-way lane in bend section, and use a variety of early warnings, solves the problems, such as zig zag blind area road meeting, to enhance the reliability of zig zag landform safety meeting, reduce a possibility that accident occurs.
assignees: SHENZHEN STARLIGHT ROAD TECH CO LTD

title_en: Transmission tower ground wire bracket angle steel buckling monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission tower ground wire bracket angle steel buckling monitoring method and system. The system comprises a strain gage, a stress tester, wireless transmission equipment and a remote server, wherein the strain gage is connected to the stress tester by virtue of a wire; and the stress tester is connected to the remote server by virtue of the wireless transmission equipment. The method comprises the following steps: calculating the result of a to-be-monitored transmission tower ground wire bracket according to transmission tower design software and steel structure calculation software, finding angle steel with the highest pressure, mounting an optical strain gage on the angle steel according to a specified method, and combining the strain gage, the stress tester, the wireless transmission equipment and the remote server into a transmission tower ground wire bracket angle steel buckling monitoring system. In addition to a creative angle steel tensile strength calculation method and an angle steel stress early warning value calculation method, the operating state of the monitored tower ground wire bracket can be safely and reliably monitored and early warned in real time, blindness of transmission line de-icing and emergency rescue is reduced, and the scientificity and reliability of the decision are improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Tree obstacle hidden danger early warning method based on laser point cloud modeling
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of distribution network fault early warning, and particularly relates to a tree obstacle hidden danger early warning method based on laser point cloud modeling. Firstly, acquiring electric power corridor point cloud data by using an airborne laser radar of an unmanned aerial vehicle, then extracting ground points, power line points and vegetation points based on the preprocessed point cloud data, drawing an electric power corridor line curve according to the ground points, establishing a three-dimensional laser model, and analyzing electric power corridor tree obstacle risk points based on the three-dimensional laser model. The application is different from the current on-site inspection, can perform early warning more advanced, reduces the power failure times of line faults, avoids periodic and purposeless blind type whole-domain inspection, accurately matches inspection in two dimensions of time and place, and improves inspection quality.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY JINGXING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;SHIJIAZHUANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Geotechnical engineering slope stability real-time monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a geotechnical engineering slope stability real-time monitoring method and system, which are characterized in that an original displacement time sequence and an environment temperature time sequence of a plurality of GNSS measuring points are regarded as multichannel mixed signals by introducing a blind source separation technology combining independent component analysis and physical constraint, periodic environment noise, instrument random noise and drift and a real slope deformation signal are effectively separated from a mixed observation signal by utilizing statistical independence among signal sources, and then, the separated source signals are automatically calibrated through correlation verification of physical quantities such as field environment temperature, and the like, and temperature effect source signals with physical labels and long-term creep source signals are accurately identified and extracted, so that accurate rejection of noise components and high-fidelity reconstruction of pure deformation signals are realized. Therefore, the accuracy of monitoring the stability of the geotechnical engineering slope in real time can be effectively improved, and a solid data basis and a decision basis are provided for early warning and prevention and control of the slope disaster.
assignees: SHANDONG SANJIAN ENG TESTING CO LTD

title_en: Emergency exit guide and guidance broadcast speaker
abstract_en: A speaker for emergency guidance includes: a front case (10) in which a speaker unit (20), a transformer (30), and a circuit board (17) are mounted, and in which a plurality of sound emission holes (11) are formed; and an emergency light (40) which is mounted on the outer surface of the front case (10) and is operated to blink by the control of the circuit board (17) in the event of an emergency. The present invention can effectively deal with evacuation by providing guidance and evacuation broadcasts through the speaker.

title_en: Method, apparatus and computer program for providing hazard detection notification service to people with hearing impairments
title_ko: 청각 장애인에게 위험 감지 알림 서비스를 제공하기 위한 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: According to the present disclosure, disclosed is a method for providing a dangerous situation detection notification, which comprises the steps of: receiving an auditory notification generated from the outside; identifying a situation corresponding to the auditory notification by analyzing the auditory notification; and outputting a visual notification and a tactile notification corresponding to the identified situation.
abstract_ko: 본 개시에 따르면, 위험 상황 감지 알림을 제공하는 방법으로서: 외부에서 발생하는 청각적 알림을 수신하는 단계; 상기 청각적 알림을 분석하여 상기 청각적 알림에 대응하는 상황을 식별하는 단계; 상기 식별된 상황에 대응하는 시각적 알림 및 촉각적 알림을 출력하는 단계를 포함하는, 위험 상황 감지 알림을 제공하는 방법이 개시된다.

title_en: Interactive electronic libretto/translation hd display interface apparatus and method
abstract_en: An addressable apparatus and method for simultaneous presentation of a performance script or other commentary, dialogue, and/or visual information available in the original language or one or more translations which can be selected by the user. Other visual information such as, sponsors, advertisements, and emergency alerts can be transmitted to each display in full color graphics or video. In one embodiment, a touch screen interface can allow point of sale applications pre-show, during intermissions, and/or post-show. Individual addressability allows direct messaging capabilities, seat- naming, anti direct-marketing media opportunities.

title_en: Emergency alert notification for the hearing impaired
abstract_en: An indication of an emergency alert message is provided to a user, potentially having a disability, via a networked enabled portable device. The emergency alert message is provided via sign language video images indicative of the emergency alert. A notification makes the user aware when broadcast emergency alerts are issued. In various embodiments, the portable device is enabled to receive information about an emergency alert broadcast of which the potentially disabled user should be aware, e.g., from the EAS, and to notify the user of the emergency alert. The user can be automatically taken to the emergency alert information by having the portable device automatically tune to the emergency broadcast information, the user can optionally retrieve the emergency information by tuning to the emergency broadcast channel, and/or the user can otherwise be presented with a reference to the emergency data, such as a link to the information.

title_en: Forest fire prevention early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forest fire prevention early warning system, which comprises a front-end monitoring device, a communication and control server, an intelligent fire searching or fire judging server, a monitoring client and a geographic information system GIS. The communication and control server is respectively in signal connection with the front-end monitoring device and the intelligent fire searching or fire judging server, and the monitoring client is respectively in signal connection with the communication and control server, the intelligent fire searching or fire judging server and the geographic information system GIS. The early warning system is wide in monitoring range and more accurate in fire judgment, has no blind spot during station switching, can perform all-weather continuous monitoring, realizes real observation of dynamic conditions of forests, can perform fire monitoring in visible light fire identification and infrared flame identification ways, and is accurate in fire site positioning.
assignees: JILIN FORESTRY INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional video access control device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-functional video entrance guard device, including the entrance guard main part, the inside middle part that is located the entrance guard main part of entrance guard main part is equipped with electronic slide rail, slidable mounting has the screen main part on the electronic slide rail, the screen main part is equipped with the slip with electronic slide rail sliding connection department, the inside of electronic slide rail is equipped with traction spring, traction spring's one end is connected with screen main part top, the inside below that is located the screen main part of electronic slide rail is equipped with the telescopic link. The utility model discloses in, at first, be equipped with over-and-under type structure, send control signal to wireless receiving module through mobile terminal, wireless receiving module is with signal transmission to controller analysis processes back, realizes the lift of screen main part through electronic slide rail, the visual field blind area of being convenient for keep watch on, secondly, adopts wireless suggestion structure, passes through wireless transmission module with control information through mobile terminal and transmits to controller analysis processes back, starts the reputation warning light, has realized remote prompt facility.

title_en: Right-angle induction precaution device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of early warning devices, in particular to a right-angle induction early warning device. The novel intelligent early warning device comprises an early warning device body, wherein a V-shaped groove is formed in one side of the early warning device body, a rear shell is arranged on the other side of the early warning device body, a rear cover is arranged on one side, far away from the early warning device body, of the rear shell, human body movement sensors are arranged on two sides of the early warning device body, an audible-visual alarm is arranged on the early warning device body, and a power supply assembly and a control main board are arranged in the early warning device body. According to the utility model, the early warning device main body is arranged at the right angle, so that the human body movement sensors at the two sides of the early warning device main body sense the two right angle positions, when the two groups of human body movement sensors sense the movement of the human body at the same time, the audible and visual alarm gives out audible and visual alarm, and people or vehicles in the process of traveling in the blind area of the video line are early warned in advance, so that the people or vehicles are not easy to collide, accidents are reduced, personnel are not easy to be injured, potential safety hazards are reduced, and the safety of the personnel is improved.
assignees: FOSHAN XINRUILAI LIGHTING ELECTRICAL APPLIANCE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and early warning system for foreign matters on locomotive roof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent monitoring and early warning system for locomotive roof foreign matters, and belongs to the technical field of railway safety monitoring. The system comprises an image acquisition assembly, an embedded processor case, a spatial registration module, a heterogeneous calculation module, a chip acceleration card, an alarm execution terminal and a mobile communication module, wherein the image acquisition assembly comprises at least two high-definition cameras, each camera is internally provided with a protocol coding chip and outputs compressed video streams, the embedded processor case is connected with the cameras through an industrial Ethernet switch, a physical storage module is integrated in the case, the vehicle type standard image data are pre-stored, the spatial registration module is used for realizing a coordinate mapping circuit by the chip, inputting real-time video streams and outputting registration image signals, the heterogeneous calculation module is provided with the chip acceleration card, the registration image signals are input and foreign body position digital signals are output, and the alarm execution terminal comprises an audible and visual alarm and a field triggering alarm and a mobile communication module, and converts the foreign body position digital signals into wireless network data packets. The utility model constructs a scheme with high robustness, high efficiency and high expansibility, and replaces the manual inspection and the traditional low-efficiency mode of static detection.
assignees: BEIJING LINGHANG HUIZHI TECH CO LTD;FENGTAI LOCOMOTIVE DEPOT CHINA RAILWAY BEIJING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: A kind of reservoir spillway warning information dissemination method, apparatus and system
abstract_en: A kind of reservoir spillway warning information dissemination method includes：The watermark protocol information and reservoir safety parameter information of Riverine area where obtaining the reservoir；The flood discharge time of the reservoir is speculated according to the watermark protocol information and reservoir safety parameter information；According to the flood discharge time speculated, the Forewarning Terminal of Riverine area sends warning message where to the reservoir, and the warning message includes text information and acoustic information either text information and image information or text information, acoustic information and image information.Be conducive to improve the promptness of flood discharge warning information publication so that the masses can more comprehensively obtain flood discharge warning information, reduce the blind area of flood discharge early warning publication.

abstract_en: A kind of intelligent fire emergency lighting control device of the present invention, by power supply unit, power supply unit is battery and fire-fighting power supply, and the moment guarantees the normal work of each unit.Data command include adjust photographic device position checked in detail with this environmental aspect, the position for adjusting current lamps and lanterns, the brightness for adjusting current lamps and lanterns and warning lamp, whether starting of phonation unit, whether the starting of fire protection alarm system；And the position control of monitoring unit and lamp unit passes through first position unit, second position unit shift position；Captured in real-time information, air concentration data α, temperature data β are sent to mobile phone, computer terminal by processing unit；Processor controls lamp unit and current lamp brightness is increased to maximum, the brightness of transit passage when guaranteeing fire；Processor controls lamp controller, so that lamp controller is controlled the first slide unit and allows the continuous moving in rotation of current lamps and lanterns, thus eliminate fire occur due to the visual field it is unclear caused by blind area the problem of.
