title_en: Signal transmission method, system and device of warning lamp and computer equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a warning light technical field discloses a signal transmission method, system, device and computer equipment of warning light, obtain the environmental characteristic that waits to search regional correspondence, accessible environmental characteristic knows local topography feature like this, thereby can set for a plurality of first search points according to different environmental characteristics, again according to the characteristic of every first search point, for this point equipment warning light, in order to make can carry out signal transmission between the warning light, be equipped with radio communication module on every warning light, when the warning light searches first search point, can transmit the search result to dispatch platform in real time, thereby be convenient for dispatch platform comprehensively, objectively master holistic search and rescue condition, reduce the rescue degree of difficulty, shorten the rescue time.

title_en: A lawn mower blade having a blade guide
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a foldable grass eliminator blade formed as multiple cutting blades are connected to be folded and rotate to a rotation disk rotating by receiving power at an end of a work table of the foldable grass. The foldable grass eliminator blade can prevent an accident by having a guide blade pushing foreign substances between the cutting blades of the rotation disk. Also, the grass eliminator blade includes the guide blade to protect the cutting blade. The foldable grass eliminator blade comprises the guide blade pushing the foreign substances between the cutting blades of the rotation disk. So, a rotation radius in which the guide blade maximally protrudes from the rotation disk is smaller than the rotation radius in which the cutting blade maximally protrudes from the rotation disk. The guide blade is lighter than the cutting blade.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 예초기의 작업대 끝단에 동력을 전달받아 회전하도록 구성하는 회전원판에 다수의 절단날을 절첩회동 하도록 결합하여 구성한 절첩식 예초기 칼날에 있어서 상기 회전원판의 절단날과 절단날 사이에 이물질을 밀어내는 가이드블레이드를 구성하여 안전사고 방지는 물론, 절단날을 보호하도록 한 가이드블레이드를 구비한 예초기 칼날에 관한 것으로, 회전원판의 절단날과 절단날 사이에 이물질을 밀어내는 가이드블레이드를 구성하되, 상기 가이드블레이드는 회전원판으로부터 최대돌출 된 회전 반경이 절단날이 회전원판으로부터 최대돌출 된 회전 반경보다 작게 하며, 가이드블레이드의 중량이 절단날의 중량보다 가볍게 구성하여 가이드블레이드를 구비한 예초기 칼날을 완성한다.

title_en: disaster and safety urgent alarm method for the hearing-impaired
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a disaster safety emergency notification method for a hearing-impaired person that enables the hearing-impaired person to easily and accurately recognize a current disaster situation during the day as well as at night while sleeping indoors. The disaster safety emergency notification method for the hearing-impaired person comprises: a step of transmitting, by a home gateway installed in a home wherein the hearing-impaired person resides, to a smart display installed in the home of the hearing impaired person, a smart lamp with multiple colors, and a smart pillow that generates vibrations, after parsing disaster information received from an external disaster safety management server through a wired or wireless communication network; a step of displaying a pictogram corresponding to a disaster content and disaster level included in the disaster information when the smart display that normally functions as a digital photo album receives the disaster information; a step of driving, by the smart lamp, a lamp of a color corresponding to a disaster level included in the disaster information; and a step of generating, by the smart pillow, a vibration.

본 발명은 각종 재난 발생시 청각장애인의 주거지에 설치된 댁내 게이트웨이를 통해 이와 유/무선 통신으로 연결되어 진동을 발생하는 스마트 베개, 재난 등급별로 점등되는 복수의 다색 램프 및 다양한 재난 정보를 즉각 인지할 수 있는 픽토그램을 표시하는 스마트 디스플레이를 적절히 동작시킴으로써 주간은 물론 실내 야간 취침시에도 청각장애인이 쉽고도 정확하게 현재의 재난 상황을 인지할 수 있도록 한 청각장애인 재난안전 긴급 알림 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 청각장애인 재난안전 긴급 알림 방법은 청각장애인이 거주하는 댁내에 설치된 댁내 게이트웨이가 유무선 통신 네트워크를 통해 외부의 재난안전 관리서버로부터 수신하여 파싱한 재난 정보를 청각장애인이 거주하는 댁내에 설치된 스마트 디스플레이, 복수 색상으로 이루어진 스마트 램프 및 진동을 발생하는 스마트 베개에 전송하는 단계; 평상시 디지털 포토 앨범으로 동작하는 스마트 디스플레이가 재난 정보를 수신한 경우 재난 정보에 포함된 재난 내용 및 재난 등급에 대응하는 픽토그램을 디스플레이하는 단계; 스마트 램프가 재난 정보에 포함된 재난 등급에 대응하는 색상의 램프를 구동하는 단계 및 스마트 베개가 진동을 발생시키는 단계를 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: Moving robot and control method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates a moving robot and a method for controlling thereof, and specifically, the moving robot and the method are configured to monitor a cleaning area by taking images while moving a plurality of areas based on a map of the cleaning area, and monitor in a plurality of areas or a dedicated specific area, and monitor overall areas by taking images while rotating at a monitoring location by dedicating the monitoring location in the area, and set a specific location in an area as a monitoring location, and cause taking of images to be performed at a specific angle by dedicating a monitoring direction in the monitoring location, and perform monitoring of a plurality of areas with minimal movement, and perform an effective monitoring because taking images in a blind spot may be performed by changing the monitoring location or adding a monitoring location based on information on an obstacle, and set a schedule to perform monitoring at a dedicated time, and detect invasion by recognizing the obstacle through analyzing of the images, and output an alert message or signal if the invasion is detected, and transmit a signal or message associated with the invasion detection, and thus a security function can be strengthened.

title_en: Ghost probe accident early warning system based on information interaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ghost probe accident early warning system based on information interaction, which consists of a vehicle front detection module, an arduino development board, a position positioning module, a communication module, an in-vehicle voice alarm module, an out-vehicle voice alarm module and an in-vehicle display, wherein the vehicle front detection module consists of two ultrasonic radars which are respectively installed in the left side and the right side of a vehicle head, the output ends of the two ultrasonic radars and the output end of the position positioning module are electrically connected with the signal input end of the arduino development board, the control end of the arduino development board is respectively in control connection with the input end of the in-vehicle voice alarm module, the input end of the out-vehicle voice alarm module and the input end of the in-vehicle display, and the communication module is in bidirectional connection with the arduino development board. Compared with the prior art, the system can realize the bidirectional early warning of pedestrians and vehicles, eliminate the potential safety hazard of blind areas of pedestrians, effectively avoid ghost probe accidents, has high safety system, and expands the perception range of vehicles.

title_en: Light switch apparatus for fire alarm
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 경보를 제공하는 기술에 관한 것이다. 더욱 상세하게는, 청각장애인에게 시각적으로 화재 경보를 제공하는 기술에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 벽면에 위치하는 조명스위치에 실내조명등에 대한 자동 점멸 회로를 포함시켜 간단한 조작만으로 쉽게 화재발생을 청각장애인에게 전파할 수 있도록 하고 있다.

title_en: Distributed healthcare communication system
abstract_en: A graphical audio station of a nurse call system is operable to permit a user to perform one or more of the following functions: establish a two-way voice communication link with another computer device in another patient and/or with a another computer device located in another staff work area and/or with a wireless communication device carried by caregiver and/or with a telephone of the healthcare facility; broadcast a voice page to a group of other selected computer devices; compose and send a text message to a portable device that is carried by a caregiver and that has wireless communication capability; browse web pages and/or view multimedia content, such as videos, hosted on servers of the healthcare facility and/or that are accessible via the Internet; view and/or acknowledge and/or answer and/or cancel alerts or nurse calls originating in a plurality of patient rooms.

title_en: Nowcast of natural resource and calamity warning
abstract_en: A method of forecasting naturally-occurring phenomena, such as seismic activity, includes taking localized measurements of the Earth's gravitational force change using MEM inertial motion units. Trends in the measurements are interpreted and related to a phenomenon of interest, a likelihood of occurrence is predicted based on the relationship, and the likelihood is reported to interested parties, preferably automatically to emergency bulletin sources. Measurements can be taken from above the Earth's atmosphere. The trends can be interpreted by determining blind source separation information directed to the region underneath the Earth's mantle crust to determine composition and/or movement.

title_en: Dangerous chemical equipment fault diagnosis method and system based on explosion-proof vibration detector
abstract_en: The invention provides a dangerous chemical equipment fault diagnosis method and system based on an explosion-proof vibration detector, which are characterized in that an explosion-proof vibration detector is arranged at a vibration detection point to acquire signals, an initial vibration signal is obtained, potential safety hazards in the signal acquisition process are avoided, time alignment and feature extraction analysis are carried out on the initial vibration signal, a normal vibration signal and a suspected fault signal are obtained, the problem of fault positioning deviation of multi-measuring-point data caused by acquisition time difference is solved, emergency risk data are ensured to be processed preferentially, the normal vibration signal and the suspected fault signal are received and acquired, the normal vibration signal is stored, fault diagnosis information is obtained, a diagnosis algorithm is started only for the suspected signal, the consumption of calculation resources is greatly reduced, and the probability of sudden accidents of dangerous chemical equipment is reduced and the loss caused by blind shutdown maintenance is avoided by generating early warning information and maintenance strategies based on the fault diagnosis information.

title_en: Induction blind road brick, trigger type blind stick and blind road cooperative system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic equipment, in particular to an induction blind road brick, a trigger type blind stick and a blind road cooperative system. The induction blind road brick comprises a blind road brick body, a triggering device, an induction device and a signal connection device, wherein a cavity is formed in the blind road brick body, the triggering device is arranged on the blind road brick body and used for receiving a triggering signal triggered by short-distance wireless induction, the induction device is arranged in the cavity and connected with the triggering device in a signal connection mode, the induction device sends out a warning signal after receiving the triggering signal, the triggering device is a blind stick triggering device, and the triggering signal triggered by the short-distance wireless induction is sent out by the blind stick. In the invention, a point-to-point identification relationship is established by using short-distance induction (magnetic, metal and radio frequency), so that 'only a visually impaired person carrying a blind crutch arrives, the brick responds', and broadcasting inundation caused by scene noise (raindrops, steps, baby carriages and the like) is restrained by the selective triggering, thereby avoiding information fatigue and urban noise pollution.

title_en: Atmospheric pollutant concentration monitoring and early warning method and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an atmospheric pollutant concentration monitoring and early warning method and a system thereof, belonging to the technical field of environmental protection informatization and environmental pollution prevention and control, comprising a multi-element data acquisition module, an analysis early warning module, a linkage control module and a remote monitoring platform, the multi-element data acquisition module comprises an infrared spectrum absorption type gas sensor, an electrochemical gas sensor, a temperature and humidity sensor and a wind speed and wind direction sensor, and is distributed in a monitoring area and used for acquiring pollutant concentration and environmental data. According to the invention, comprehensive and accurate monitoring can be realized, the limitation of a single sensor is overcome through cooperation of the multi-principle sensor and fusion of dynamic weights, accurate and reliable monitoring of various pollutants in a full concentration range is realized, monitoring blind areas are remarkably reduced, advanced early warning and efficient closed-loop management and control can be realized, and the speed and accurate management and control capability of environmental pollution emergency response are greatly improved.

title_en: Real time monitoring system for prevention of crime and violence
title_ko: 폭력 및 범죄예방 위한 실시간 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: It is difficult to install, in terms of privacy protection, CCTVs or the like which can obtain spot information in order to cope with violence or crime which occurs or is expected to occur at a blind spot (an enclosed space, a secluded space, a restroom, a vacant lot, and a playground) or the like, thereby resulting in the violence or crime being left as it is. The present invention relates to a system which recognizes, determines, and processes the occurrence of violence or crime, and which is capable of obtaining spot information that occurs or is expected to occur at the blind spot while protecting the privacy. The system for recognizing, determining, and processing the occurrence of violence or crime, according to the present invention, determines, while processing voice or other information generated at the spot of the violence or the crime such that identity with respect to the information is hidden, an emergency situation by comparing information received in real time, on the basis of a value for a violence or crime-related contour-extracted video and a similar behavior video, and a violence or crime-related voice information determining reference value. The violence or crime-related video and voice is obtained, such that violence or crime situation can be determined, through much repeated trial and error for video, acquired by a contour extraction method, about movement in a spot, and is stored in a database; induces, when the emergency situation is confirmed, stopping an act of violence or crime by performing a warning broadcasting using content which is extracted from the database and has spot situation-matched content and voice tone; stores the emergency situation content (the violence or crime-related contour-extracted video and the violence or crime-related voice information) in the database; and enables a manager and a jurisdiction department to be dispatched to the spot and cope with a crisis in addition to transmitting the content to the manager and the jurisdiction department so as to determine the emergency situation.
abstract_ko:
사각지대(밀폐된 공간, 인적이 드문 공간, 화장실, 공터, 놀이터) 등에서 발생되거나, 발생이 예상되는 폭력이나 범죄에 대처하기 위해 현장정보 입수가 가능한 CCTV등을 사생활 보호 측면에서 설치하지 못해 폭력 및 범죄를 방치하고 있는 것이 현실이다. 
 본 발명은 사각지대에서 발생되거나, 발생이 예상되는 현장정보를 사생활을 보호 하면서 입수가 가능한 특징을 지닌 폭력 및 범죄발생 인지, 판별, 처리관련 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
 본 발명에서는 폭력 및 범죄현장에서 발생되는 음성정보 및 누군지를 알 수 없게 처리하되, 폭력 및 범죄 상황을 판별할 수 있도록 현장의 움직임을 윤곽선 추출방법으로 동영상을 확보하여 수많은 시행착오를 통해 확보되어 데이터베이스에 저장되어 있는 폭력 및 범죄행위관련 윤곽선 추출 동영상 및 유사행위 동영상 값과 음성정보 판별 기준값을 기준으로 실시간으로 입수되는 정보를 비교하여 위급상황을 판별하고, 위급상황으로 판별되면 현장상황에 맞는 내용 및 목소리 톤으로 저장된 내용을 저장장치로부터 추출하여 경고방송을 하게 하여 폭력 및 범죄행위 중지를 유도하고, 위급상황 내용(폭력 및 범죄관련 윤곽선 추출 동영상 및 음성정보)을 저장장치에 저장하며, 상기 내용을 관리자 및 관할부서로 전송하여 위급상황을 판단하게 함은 물론, 발생 현장에 출동하여 위급상황에 대처하도록 하는 것을 특징으로 하는 폭력 및 범죄발생 인지, 판별, 처리관련 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Customer-controlled instant-response anti-fraud/anti-identity theft devices (with true- personal identity verification), method and systems for secured global applications in personal/business e-banking, e-commerce, e-medical/health insurance checker, e-education/research/invention, e-disaster advisor, e-immigration, e-airport/aircraft security, e-military/e-law enforcement, with or without NFC component and system, with cellular/satellite phone/internet/multi-media functions
abstract_en: All-in-one wireless mobile telecommunication devices, methods and systems providing greater customer-control, instant-response anti-fraud/anti-identity theft protections with instant alarm, messaging and secured true-personal identity verifications for numerous registered customers/users, with biometrics and PIN security, operating with manual, touch-screen and/or voice-controlled commands, achieving secured rapid personal/business e-banking, e-commerce, accurate transactional monetary control and management, having interactive audio-visual alarm/reminder preventing fraudulent usage of legitimate physical and/or virtual credit/debit cards, with cheques anti-forgery means, curtailing medical/health/insurance frauds/identity thefts, having integrated cellular and/or satellite telephonic/internet and multi-media means, equipped with language translations, GPS navigation with transactions tagging, currency converters, with or without NFC components, minimizing potential airport risks/mishaps, providing instant aid against school bullying, kidnapping, car-napping and other crimes, applicable for secured military/immigration/law enforcements, providing guided warning/rescue during emergencies and disasters.

title_en: Intelligent identification method, device and equipment for safety in building site
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of building safety identification, and relates to a method, a device and equipment for intelligently identifying safety in a building site, which comprises the following steps: identifying the area where the second image data is located, setting a danger coefficient for each area, marking the area as a dangerous area when the danger coefficient is larger than a preset danger coefficient threshold value, and obtaining the position of the dangerous area; calculating an actual danger range based on the position of the danger area; obtaining the real-time coordinate position of the human body image from the second image data to obtain a first coordinate value, and calculating the displacement according to the actual danger range and the first coordinate value; according to the invention, the effective working range of the building equipment is obtained through the big data network, the actual danger range is calculated, the safety assessment precision in the building site is higher, the closer the constructor is to the effective working range of the building equipment, the higher the danger level warning is sent out, and the safety accidents caused by the construction site noise and the synchronous influence of the visual field blind area in the construction process can be effectively avoided.

title_en: Server cabinet with intelligent protection alarm function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a server cabinet with an intelligent protection alarm function, which belongs to the field of server cabinets, and comprises a main cabinet body, wherein a plurality of partition plates which are uniformly distributed are arranged in the main cabinet body, and a sub-frame is arranged between two adjacent partition plates; the sub-frame comprises a pair of vertical supports, a plurality of supporting plates are arranged between the pair of vertical supports, and heat exchange tubes are arranged in the supporting plates in a penetrating manner; the server main body is arranged on the supporting plate; the division board includes the main baffle, installs a pair of water conservancy diversion pipeline in the main baffle, and the closing frame is installed to the lower extreme of main baffle, and the closing frame includes the C type roof beam with a pair of perpendicular support sliding connection, and fluid regulation and control portion is installed to the bottom of the main cabinet body, through real-time supervision, realizes the comprehensive control and the warning to server main part and operational environment in the rack, and when detecting server work abnormality or operational environment abnormality, all accessible closing frame seals the server of this subregion, realizes the isolation protection of local server.

title_en: Fire transmitter equipped with cover
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a waterproof transmitter which is pressed by a user when a fire occurs to sound an alarm. More specifically, the waterproof transmitter comprises: a push unit to operate an alarm when the fire occurs; and a housing mounted to expose the push unit. The housing has a cover which can be opened and closed to improve user convenience. A waterproof unit is disposed on the cover and/or the housing to prevent a foreign substance, moisture, etc. from entering to prevent the non-sounding of an alarm by a short circuit. The waterproof transmitter further comprises a locking unit to further improve a waterproof effect.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재가 발생하였을 경우 상용자가 눌러서 경보를 울리는 발신기에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 화재가 발생하였을 경우 경보를 작동시키기 위한 푸쉬유닛과, 푸쉬유닛이 노출되도록 결합되는 하우징을 구비하되, 하우징에 개폐가능한 커버를 구비하여 사용의 편의성을 향상시키되, 커버 또는 하우징 또는 이들 모두에 방수유닛을 구비함으로서 이물질, 물기, 습기등이 투입되는 것을 방지하여 합선등으로 경보가 울리지 않는 것을 방지할 수 있으며, 록킹유닛을 더 구비하여 방수효과를 더욱 향상시킬 수 있는 방수형 발신기에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Intelligent voice broadcasting terminal for disaster early warning
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a terminal, in particular to an intelligent voice broadcasting terminal for disaster early warning. The intelligent voice broadcasting terminal for disaster early warning comprises a central processing unit, a text to speech (TTS) voice module, an amplitude modulation/frequency modulation (AM/FM) receiving module, a digital power amplifier module, a loudspeaker, a direct-current power supply module and an alternating-current to direct-current power supply conversion module, wherein the alternating-current to direct-current power supply conversion module converts alternating current into direct current and then transmits the direct current to the central processing unit; the AM/FM receiving module transmits received disaster early warning data to the central processing unit through an antenna; the central processing unit transmits the received disaster early warning data to the TTS voice module; the TTS voice module converts the disaster early warning data into disaster voice information; and the disaster early warning voice information is amplified by the digital power amplifier module and then is transmitted to the loudspeaker. The intelligent voice broadcasting terminal for disaster early warning can quickly, timely and accurately broadcast all types of information, particularly disaster early warning information to the social general public.
assignees: NANJING HANZHIXIAN ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring and alarming device for hidden danger of power transmission cable external damage
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hidden danger monitoring and alarming device for external damage of a power transmission cable, which comprises a bracket, a solar panel, a main machine box, a laser ranging sensor, a radar sensor and a loudspeaker, wherein the solar panel, the main machine box, the laser ranging sensor, the radar sensor and the loudspeaker are respectively arranged on the bracket, the laser ranging sensor is respectively arranged on two sides of the radar sensor, a control panel and a storage battery are arranged in the main machine box, the control panel is respectively electrically connected with the storage battery, the solar panel, the laser ranging sensor, the radar sensor and the loudspeaker, an MCU module and a wireless communication module are arranged on the control panel, and the wireless communication module is used for communicating with an external terminal. Only when foreign objects are detected by the radar sensor and the laser ranging sensor in sequence, the loudspeaker can send out warning sound, so that the problem of high false alarm rate of a single radar monitoring system is solved, namely the foreign object invasion condition can be reflected more truly by the power transmission cable foreign damage hidden danger monitoring alarm device, waste of electric quantity of the foreign damage hidden danger monitoring alarm device is reduced, and reliability and accuracy of the foreign damage hidden danger monitoring alarm device are improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN NEW UNITE INNOVATE DEV LTD CO

title_en: Fire Alarm System Using TTS
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 TTS를 이용한 화재 경보 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 고안은, 화재 감지 시스템으로부터 화재발생 위치정보를 포함하는 화재발생신호를 수신하는 수신부; 텍스트로 구성되고 편집 가능한 화재방송 시나리오를 적어도 하나 이상 포함하는 시나리오 데이터베이스를 저장하는 저장부; 상기 화재발생 위치정보에 따른 대피경로를 획득하고, 상기 화재발생 위치정보와 상기 획득된 대피경로를 상기 화재방송 시나리오에 반영함으로써 화재방송용 텍스트를 구성하는 화재방송용 텍스트 구성부; TTS 엔진을 이용하여 텍스트를 음성으로 변환하는 음성 변환부; 상기 음성 변환부에서 변환된 음성을 구내 방송 시스템으로 전송하는 전송부; 및 상기 화재 감지 시스템으로부터 상기 화재발생신호를 수신한 경우, 상기 시나리오 데이터베이스를 참조하여 상기 수신된 화재발생신호에 포함된 화재발생 위치정보에 부합하는 화재방송 시나리오를 검색하고, 상기 화재방송용 텍스트 구성부를 제어하여 상기 수신된 화재발생신호에 포함된 화재발생 위치정보에 따라 화재방송용 텍스트를 구성하고, 상기 음성 변환부를 제어하여 상기 구성된 화재방송용 텍스트를 음성으로 변환하여 상기 전송부를 통해 상기 구내 방송 시스템으로 전송하는 제어부를 포함하는 TTS를 이용한 화재 경보 시스템을 제공한다. 
     
      화재 감지, 화재방송 시나리오, 화재방송용 텍스트, TTS, 구내 방송

title_en: All-round intelligent security early warning system of car
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile omnibearing intelligent safety early warning system, which comprises a foreign matter sensing system, a speed sensing module, a weather inducing system, a distance detection device, an omnibearing camera system and an alarm display module, wherein the foreign matter sensing system is used for sensing foreign matters around a vehicle, the speed sensing module is used for monitoring the speed of the vehicle, and the weather inducing system is used for sensing the weather during the running of the vehicle; the omnibearing intelligent safety early warning system for the automobile has various early warning types, is intelligent, and can reduce accidents caused by reaction and consideration of a driver, the foreign matter sensing module can sense foreign matters around the automobile under normal conditions and can also sense foreign matters such as falling rocks in natural disasters, the automobile speed control system is matched to avoid damage to the safety of the automobile and the driver caused by the falling rocks and the like, the weather induction system can also automatically turn on and off the light and the automobile window in time and automatically control the automobile speed, and the accidents caused by sudden weather are reduced.
assignees: PIZHOU LUYA AUTO PARTS CO LTD

title_en: Underground personnel state sensing system based on head posture monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a head posture monitoring-based underground personnel state sensing system which is used for monitoring the fatigue state of workers in a working site such as a coal mine underground in real time. The system mainly comprises an inertia measurement unit, a data processing unit, an acousto-optic early warning unit, a wireless communication unit and the like; the system acquires inertial data related to the head posture through an inertial measurement unit arranged on the safety helmet, processes the data through a data processing unit to obtain the fatigue state of personnel, and performs early warning when the conditions are met. Because the working sites such as underground coal mines and the like must be worn with safety helmets, the invention can realize the blind-corner-free comprehensive sensing detection of personnel states; the invention has the characteristics and advantages of easy implementation, good safety, accuracy, reliability and the like, and can be widely applied to the field of safety production monitoring in the industries of mines, capital construction, traffic and the like.

title_en: Personnel situation sensing and safety monitoring method for hoisting machinery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personnel situation awareness and safety monitoring method for hoisting machinery, which comprises the following modules, namely, a module 1, an object dynamic monitoring and early warning module; the invention is characterized by comprising a module 2, a personnel operation monitoring and registering module 3, a personnel situation sensing module 4, a vehicle working condition management and man-machine interaction module, a final test shows that the invention can identify the size of a hoisting object in real time, dynamically set a warning area, supervise and early warn a vehicle vision blind area and a working area under a suspension arm, have higher hardware cost performance, richer functions and higher automation degree, realize scientific management and safe construction, greatly reduce potential safety hazards in the construction process, strengthen a hoisting machinery construction early warning mechanism and provide multiple guarantees for the safety of the hoisting machinery during working.

title_en: System for a monitored and reconstructible personal rendezvous session
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system that adapts a personally portable “smart” communications device to enhance a user's personal security by continuously monitoring an alert function of the device from a remote location during a user initiated “session.” The user device is in communications with a remote server, which monitors the alert function and provides: accurate preservation of session data; monitoring of user device ambient conditions; dispatch of emergency services; and notification of third parties. Server software (host application) on the remote server manages communications with user devices. The server collects, processes and stores data; dispenses data according to a rule set, and manages multiple user sessions. User software manages the initiation and conduct of a session and communications with the server. The user and server software in combination provide for establishing, maintaining operations of the system, and databases accessible by the remote server for storage/archiving of system data.

title_en: Railway foreign matter invasion safety sensing and identification system based on distributed optical fiber sensing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a railway foreign matter invasion safety perception and identification system based on distributed optical fiber sensing is based on two kinds of distributed optical fiber sensing technologies and video linkage technology: monitoring a vibration invasion signal generated when illegal personnel, vehicles and construction invade a high-speed railway by utilizing a phase optical time domain analysis technology, and giving information such as the position, the event and the like of the invasion signal; monitoring a fence deformation signal of the high-speed railway generated when large-scale rockfall and debris flow invade the high-speed railway by utilizing a Brillouin optical time domain analysis technology, and giving information such as the position of the invasion signal; when any one or two of the two optical fiber sensing systems gives an alarm, the optical fiber sensing systems can be linked with cameras arranged on a high-speed railway tower pole to call monitoring pictures of the intrusion event. The three subsystems work synchronously, study mutually, monitor invasion layer by layer, and realize early warning and identification of foreign matter invasion of the high-speed railway together.
assignees: NINGBO ZHENGYE AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automobile accident safety auxiliary device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a car accident safety auxiliary device, acquire unit, alarm unit including main control unit, flame detecting element, collision detecting element, the detecting element that soaks, inclination detecting element, longitude and latitude acquire the unit connection main control unit, and the main control unit links to each other with alarm unit, irritability gas switch, broken window ware switch respectively. The utility model discloses be equipped with flame detecting element, collision detecting element, the detecting element that soaks, inclination detecting element, longitude and latitude acquisition element, alarm unit, when the car conflagration, collision, intake, the accident of turning on one's side, accessible longitude and latitude acquisition element sends the position of occurence of failure ground to the host computer and carries out remote alarm, also can carry out the acousto-optic warning or report to the police through the SMS through alarm unit, can improve the security behind the car occurence of failure greatly.

title_en: Traffic road surface leveling and rolling assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a traffic road surface levels roll-in subassembly, including the road roller main part, the left side of road roller main part is fixed with the backup pad, the lower fixed surface of backup pad has the cylinder, the outside of cylinder output shaft is fixed with the fixed plate, the lower fixed surface of fixed plate has the compression roller, the lower surface of backup pad is equipped with the warning mechanism that is used for warning the place ahead blind area situation, the lower surface of fixed plate is equipped with the fixed establishment who is used for conveniently changing the inductor, warning mechanism is including fixing the protective housing at the backup pad lower surface. This traffic road surface levels roll-in subassembly discovers the situation in equipment the place ahead in advance through infrared inductor under the effect of warning mechanism to in time remind driver the place ahead to have abnormal situation to park and handle, and then prevent to lead to injuring the dead major accident of people even that causes because of the situation that the driver does not in time discover the blind area, also avoided the compression roller to strike the damage to the compression roller on the great stone simultaneously.

title_en: Combustible gas early warning device based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combustible gas early-warning device based on the Internet of things, which is connected with a thing networking for data transmission, can feed back gas leakage information to personnel, can give an alarm for prompting, timely controls the on-off of gas and can form back pumping to the leaked gas, and is characterized by comprising a gas sensor, a detection box, an electromagnetic valve, an emergency control unit, a gas suction pipe and a gas collecting tank, wherein the gas sensors are in signal connection with the detection box through data transmission lines, the emergency control unit is in signal connection with the detection box through the data transmission lines, the emergency control unit is communicated with the gas collecting tank through the gas suction pipe, the electromagnetic valve is in signal connection with the detection box through wireless transmission, the gas leakage information can be directly sent to a middle moving end, a householder can conveniently master the gas leakage condition in time and take measures to perform multi-point high concentration detection, avoiding detection blind areas.

title_en: Railway line geological disaster early warning system adopting pressure and buoyancy omnibearing monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway line geological disaster early warning system adopting pressure and buoyancy omnibearing monitoring, which comprises a disaster monitoring module, a disaster occurrence judging module, a signal processing and converting module and a disaster judging module; the disaster monitoring module comprises a flood disaster monitoring device and an omnibearing debris flow disaster monitoring device and is used for monitoring the track water accumulation condition and the invasion of foreign matters; the disaster occurrence judging module is used for judging whether a disaster occurs or not by using a rail disaster warning platform and signal mechanism hardware equipment; the signal processing and converting module is used for modulating, demodulating and analog-to-digital converting analog signals and judging the types and position signals of the sent alarm signals through the signals; the disaster distinguishing module is used for distinguishing the occurrence condition of the disaster and sending out an alarm signal to deal with the two disasters. The invention realizes the early warning of the torrential flood and the debris flow on the road sections with multiple accidents, such as tunnels or tunnel mouths, solves the problems of single monitoring function and limited monitoring direction, and ensures the safe operation of railways in the sections with multiple accidents.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for warning railway foreign matter and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for warning railway foreign matters, and relates to the technical field of image processing. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be detected including a railway; determining a to-be-detected area including a railway in the to-be-detected image according to the to-be-detected image and the semantic segmentation model; under the condition that the number of the areas to be detected is one, judging whether target foreign matters exist in the areas to be detected or not according to the images to be detected and the foreign matter classification model; the foreign matter classification model is used for detecting foreign matters of preset types in the image to be detected, and the type of the target foreign matters is the type except for a train in the preset types; and alarming under the condition that the target foreign matter exists in the area to be detected. The method and the device are used for improving the accuracy of railway foreign matter detection.
assignees: China Unicom;CHINA UNICOM DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Environment for the Hearing Impaired recognition method and apparatus of the state using the Mobile terminal device.
title_ko: 휴대단말장치를 이용한 청각장애인을 위한 주위환경 상태 인지 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A method for recognizing environment state and a device using thereof are provided to enable an auditory disabled person to easily recognize the information from a portable terminal. CONSTITUTION: A device for recognizing environment state comprises a portable terminal device(10), a charging device(20), and a portable recognition device(30). The portable terminal device comprises a microphone part for collecting sounds, a storage part for recording the collected sounds, a verification part for verifying the collected sounds, a display part, a transmission part, an input part, and a connection part. The charging device comprises a power supply part, an illumination display part, a microphone part, and a connection part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 휴대단말장치를 이용한 청각장애인을 위한 주위환경 상태 인지방법 및 장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 청각장애인이 실내외에서 주변의 실생활 편의장치나 주위환경에 대해서 인지하기 위해, 각 장치가 작동때 나는 음향과 주변상황의 음향의 내용을 기록 및 저장해 두고 상기와 같은 유형의 장치와 상태에서의 실생활에서 일어나는 순간의 장치 및 상태 음향이 발생 되었을 시, 기록 및 저장하고 있는 음향과 대조하여, 동일한 유형일 때 그에 대한 표시 및 경고하는 휴대단말장치와 상기 휴대단말장치를 실내에서 충전과 상기 인지할 상황별 정보들을 표시하는 고정장치 및 상기 고정장치와 같은 역할로 청각장애인이 소지하는 휴대인식장치로 생활 편의장치의 작동상태와 기타 위험에 대한 상황별 음향으로 청각장애인이 인지할 수 있도록 경고 및 표시하는 장치와 방법이다.  
  이를 위한 본 발명의 구성품은 각종 편의장치가 작동하는 음향들을 일정한 분류로 패턴별로 기록저장하고, 상기 장치들이 작동되는 음향을 마이크부로 수집하여,  사전에 기록 저장하여 기록된 음향패턴과 일치하는 유사한 것을 찾아 분류된 유형에 맞는 정보로 경고 및 알림부로 통해 알려주는 휴대단말장치(10)와 상기 휴대단말장치를 실내에서 일정지역내 위치시켜 두고 사용할 시, 경고 표시를 위한 색상별로 구분된 표시장치와 실내에서 각종 음향을 수집하는 마이크부 및 휴대단말장치에 전원 충전을 위한 전원 충전부로 구성되는 표시전원공급장치(20) 및 실내에서 상시 휴대하여 상기 휴대단말장치가 인식한 여러 유형의 범주별 정보를 수신하여 경고 및 알림 기능이 있는 휴대인식장치(30)로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
  이로써 청각장애인들이 도움견(犬)과 같이 위급한 상황에서 일어나는 구분되지 않는 정도의 알림이에서 탈피하여 위급상황 또는 주변상황에서 동작하는 일상생활의 편의제품의 종류별 작동상태와 주변의 여러 응급상황에 대해서도 구분하여 인지할 수 있어, 각종 안전사고 예방에 크게 기여하여 청각장애인의 생활편의성이 높아질 것이다.

title_en: Flame detectors viewing all directions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a flame detector. The present invention comprises: a case main body which is installed to be attached to a ceiling and has a communication module, an alarm module, and a power module mounted on one side; a sensor module which includes a plurality of flame sensors sensing a flame by being installed in a lower end of the case main body while being arranged and installed in a radial direction along a circumference of the case main body and transmits the sensing information of the flame sensors to a control unit; and the control unit which is provided in the case main body to integrally control the communication module, the alarm module, and the power module while calculating, analyzing, and storing the sensing information transmitted through the sensor module. In the provided multi-directional flame detector provided by the present invention, the sensor module comprises: an FPCB which has flexibility to be closely attached along an inner side circumference of the case main body; and the plurality of flame sensors which are arranged at intervals on one surface of the FPCB to correspond to a sensor insertion hole formed in the case main body. The present invention has an effect of: quickly dealing with fire risk by sensing flame in all directions without a blind spot through the sensor module having the plurality of flame sensors; minimizing operation error capable of being generated by hiding a sensor exposing unit by various foreign matters, dust, and insects capable of existing in a place where the present invention is installed; minimizing damage of scene of the installation place through light weight and small size; and securing safety of people from fire risk by promoting popularization through cheap price.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 불꽃감지기에 관한 것으로, 천장에 부착 설치됨과 아울러, 통신모듈, 경보모듈, 전원모듈이 일측에 내장된 케이스본체와; 상기 케이스본체의 둘레를 따라 방사 방향으로 배열 설치됨과 동시에, 상기 케이스본체의 하단에 설치되어 불꽃을 감지하는 복수의 불꽃센서를 포함하며, 이 불꽃센서의 감지정보를 제어부에 전달하는 센서모듈과; 상기 케이스본체의 내부에 구비되어 상기 센서모듈을 통해 전달된 감지정보를 연산, 분석, 저장함과 아울러, 상기 통신모듈, 경보모듈, 전원모듈을 통합적으로 제어하는 제어부로 구성되며, 상기 센서모듈은 상기 케이스본체의 내측면 둘레를 따라 밀착되도록 유연성을 갖는 FPCB와; 상기 케이스본체에 형성된 센서삽입공에 대응하여 상기 FPCB의 일면에 간격을 두고 배열 형성되는 복수의 불꽃센서로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 다방향 불꽃감지기를 제공함으로써, 복수의 불꽃센서를 갖는 센서모듈을 통해 사각지대 없이 전방위로 불꽃을 감지할 수 있어 화재 위험으로부터 신속하게 대처할 수 있으며, 본 발명이 설치된 공간에서 있을 수 있는 다양한 이물질, 먼지, 벌레 등에 의하여 센서 노출부를 가리면서 발생할 수 있는 작동 오류를 최소화하고, 경량화, 소형화를 통해 설치장소의 경관 훼손을 최소화할 수 있는 것은 물론, 저렴화를 통해 보급화를 촉진할 수 있어 누구나 화재 위험으로부터 안전을 보장 받을 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: ADAS system blind area lane change integrated early warning system and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ADAS system blind area lane changing integrated early warning system and an ADAS system blind area lane changing integrated early warning method, which relate to the technical field of vehicle blind area monitoring, wherein the system comprises: the invention can realize that an ADAS early warning system can be activated autonomously when a vehicle turns on a lane change steering lamp or a steering wheel turns, the ADAS early warning system is used for automatically collecting and monitoring the vehicle conditions on two sides of the vehicle and in blind areas, judging whether the vehicle exists in the side blind areas or not, and further reminding a driver whether lane change operation can be carried out by voice through graphic display and calculation and analysis of the distance between the side vehicles, so that the problem that the driver cannot be actively reminded of the existence of the vehicle in the side blind areas and potential safety hazards exist in lane change steering when the traditional driver turns on the lane change is solved.

title_en: System of Display Board For Outputting Information
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an information output electronic display system comprising: a disaster message broadcast service server connected to a plurality of base stations to transmit a first message through the base station; a first communication unit connected to the plurality of base stations to receive the first message from the disaster message broadcast service server; a display unit outputting the first message received by the first communication unit in the form of letters; and an electronic display module having a text-to-voice conversion output unit connected with the display unit to convert and output the letters displayed on the display unit into a voice.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 정보출력 전광판 시스템은, 복수 개의 기지국과 연결되어 기지국을 통해 제1메시지를 송신하는 재난문자방송서비스서버, 복수 개의 기지국에 연결되어 재난문자방송서비스서버에서 송신하는 제1메시지를 수신하는 제1통신부, 제1통신부가 수신한 제1메시지를 문자로 출력하는 표시부, 표시부와 연결되어 표시부에 표시되는 문자를 음성으로 변환하여 출력하는 문자음성변환출력부를 구비한 전광판모듈을 포함한다.

title_en: Situational awareness and position information for satellite communication terminals
abstract_en: An efficient and reliable way to send various information including position location information (PLI) and emergency messages (EM) using or within a mobile satellite system (MSS) using different message formats including short message (e.g., short burst data (SBD), etc.), between mobile users as provided. Embodiments also use global positioning systems (GPS) used in some cases with the PLI system. Various embodiments improve communications efficiency and reliability of message transmission through various types of MSS. Embodiments include a method or approach to interface SBD PLI messages from mobile end user terminals (EUT) to common operating picture (COP) application programs as provided. Exemplary methods interface and translate MSS short messages (e.g., SBD) to extensible markup language (XML) message format and communicate converted messages to COP application program within a computer using a TCP/IP interface.

abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety monitoring and early warning of power equipment, in particular to a system and a method for monitoring and early warning of potential electrical fire hazards of a high-voltage cabinet. The early warning system comprises an active sampling unit, a nano particle detection unit, a characteristic gas detection unit, an environment parameter detection unit, a data acquisition and processing unit, an algorithm and diagnosis unit, a communication and man-machine interaction unit and a power management and anti-interference unit. The early warning method solves the problems of passivity, hysteresis, monitoring blind areas and intelligent deficiency existing in the existing high-voltage cabinet electric fire hidden danger monitoring through multi-parameter synchronous detection, fusion diagnosis, trend analysis and multi-stage alarm judgment, and achieves the ultra-early and integrated on-line monitoring and early warning of insulation and heat hidden danger.

title_en: Signal processing system and methods for reliably detecting audible alarms
abstract_en: A signal processing system and associated methods are disclosed for reliably detecting audible alert signals, such as Temporal-3 (or Code-3) and Temporal-4 (or Code-4) alert signals generated by commercially available smoke, fire, and carbon monoxide detectors. The system and methods are capable of detecting audible alert signals of different intensities in the presence of dynamic background environment (e.g., television programming, music, noise, and the like). The system and methods are capable of detecting audible alert signals generated by far away smoke, fire, and carbon monoxide detectors. The signal processing system and methods may, in some embodiments, be incorporated into a bedside or other unit that generates a supplemental alert signal capable of alerting individuals who might not otherwise respond to the alarm condition, such as individuals who are asleep, children, hearing impaired, or intoxicated.

title_en: System and method for delivering mobile wireless broadcast messages in designated languages
abstract_en: A mobile wireless system and method are described for distributing emergency alert messages to mobile wireless devices in multiple languages. The emergency alert system receives an alert message including a geographic area identification, and a text alert. The emergency alert system renders one or more translations of the text alert from the text alert. The one or more translated versions of the text alert are provided in particular foreign languages based upon designated foreign languages corresponding to the geographic area identification. The emergency alert system transmits the text alert and one or more translated text alerts commercial mobile wireless service provider networks for broadcasting the text alert and the translated text alert(s) via mobile wireless transmitters having a coverage area falling within a region corresponding to the geographic area identification.

title_en: System and method to communicate an emergency alert message

The system comprises one or more circuits in an electronic device communicatively coupled to a broadcast server. The one or more circuits are configured to register one or more output preferences based on one or more input parameters provided by a user. An emergency alert message and associated metadata of an emergency event is received from the broadcast server. The associated metadata includes time-sensitive information of the emergency event. Based on the associated metadata and the registered one or more output preferences, the received emergency alert message is modified to a user-accessible format. According to the registered one or more output preferences, the modified emergency alert message is communicated to the user.

title_en: Disaster chain monitoring and early warning method and system based on Internet of things-InSAR cooperation
abstract_en: The application provides an Internet of things-I nSAR collaborative disaster chain monitoring and early warning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out quality assessment on acquired Internet of things data to obtain a situation assessment matrix, identifying and extracting abnormal nodes according to the situation assessment matrix to obtain normal node data, calculating a partition data integrity rate based on the normal node data, determining a region with the data integrity rate lower than a preset threshold value as a monitoring blind region, acquiring I nSAR data of the monitoring blind region, extracting ground surface deformation data, fusing the ground surface deformation data with the normal node data to generate a global continuous deformation dataset, carrying out space-time feature analysis on the global continuous deformation dataset to obtain a fused feature vector, and inputting the fused feature vector into a pre-trained disaster chain prediction model to generate a disaster risk thermodynamic diagram. By adopting the method, the prediction precision of disaster chain evolution can be improved.

title_en: System and method for alerting a user
abstract_en: An alerting system control server (121) in a set of servers (120) and a method (200) therein, for alerting a user, in particular a hearing impaired user, of an incoming signal for a service associated with the user. The method (200) comprises: receiving (202) information that an internet service server (110) is receiving an incoming signal for the service; generating (203) a control signal for triggering an alerting system controller (130) to alert the user of the incoming signal for the service by activating an alerting device (140); identifying (204) the alerting system controller (130) and extract the address of the alerting system controller (130); and sending (205) the generated (203) control signal to the identified (204) alerting system controller (130), for activating the alerting device (140) and thereby alerting the user; wherein the communication between the alerting system controller (130) and the alerting device (140) is made over a communication protocol based on the Internet Protocol.

title_en: Distributed healthcare communication system
abstract_en: A graphical audio station of a nurse call system is operable to permit a user to perform one or more of the following functions: establish a two-way voice communication link with another computer device in another patient and/or with a another computer device located in another staff work area and/or with a wireless communication device carried by caregiver and/or with a telephone of the healthcare facility; broadcast a voice page to a group of other selected computer devices; compose and send a text message to a portable device that is carried by a caregiver and that has wireless communication capability; browse web pages and/or view multimedia content, such as videos, hosted on servers of the healthcare facility and/or that are accessible via the Internet; view and/or acknowledge and/or answer and/or cancel alerts or nurse calls originating in a plurality of patient rooms.

title_en: Method and system for generating and guiding indoor evacuation route for blind people
title_ko: 시각장애인을 위한 실내 대피 경로를 생성하고 안내하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for generating and guiding an indoor evacuation route for a visually impaired person. The method includes: a step of receiving a disaster alert signal indicating the occurrence of a disaster in an indoor space; a step of collecting current location data on the current location of a user terminal from the user terminal; a step of acquiring indoor map data indicating the indoor space where the user terminal is located and data on a facility for a visually impaired person related to the indoor space based on the current location data on the user terminal; a step of generating an evacuation route for the visually impaired person based on the current location data, the indoor map data, and the visually impaired person-related facility data; and a step of transmitting the evacuation route for the visually impaired person to the user terminal. With the present invention, visually impaired persons can quickly and safely escape to a shelter in the event of a disaster in the indoor space.

title_en: Automatic positioning hook and unhooking early warning device of bridge type metallurgical casting crane
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic positioning hook and unhooking early warning device of a bridge type metallurgical casting crane, and belongs to the technical field of metallurgical casting cranes. The utility model comprises a tension sensor, an audible and visual alarm, a camera, a display, a PLC control system, a proximity switch and a ranging sensor; the tension sensor, the audible and visual alarm, the proximity switch and the ranging sensor are arranged at relevant positions and are electrically connected with the PLC control system, the cameras are arranged at two sides of the lifting hook and aim at vision blind areas of the lifting hook operation, the display is arranged on a wall body of the cab, and the display is electrically connected with the cameras; the utility model adopts the modes of accurate positioning, sensor and alarm and real-time monitoring, so that an operator confirms, eliminates and processes the feedback of related information and an online video monitoring system, thereby ensuring more accurate and convenient operation and effectively preventing the safety accidents caused by unhooking of the bridge metallurgy casting crane.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring method and system based on big data cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster monitoring method and a geological disaster monitoring system based on a big data cloud platform, and relates to the technical field of disaster monitoring, and the method comprises the following steps of S1, browsing a three-dimensional live-action model and marking model data in real time: surrounding browsing of a three-dimensional live-action model and three-dimensional analysis are realized through the operation categories of zooming in, zooming out, translation, left rotation, right rotation and inclination, and a data labeling function is introduced in the browsing process, and S2, data acquisition and resource management of ground disaster prevention and control are carried out: disaster point and hidden danger point data of a geological environment and a geological disaster space are acquired through space data calculation, and the data are managed in a centralized mode. title_en: Method for vehicle identification and communication between transportation network company (tnc) service users

Additionally, the present invention also helps assist blind people by conveying audio messages, such as pipe messages or announcing their names. Further, the present invention provides riders the ability to send an emergency alert, thereby ensuring a safer ride. Furthermore, the present invention enables TNCs to utilize the display device as a trade dress and as an optional platform for other media advertisements.

abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an emergency call system, emergency call method and number registration processing system used for an emergency call in which emergency calling to the hearing-impaired person can be performed promptly.  <P>SOLUTION: A telephone directory data storage section of a portable terminal 30 records a display name of "fire warning" in association with an extension number of an auto dial device 13. title_en: Automatic switching from main voice to sub voice in emergency broadcast
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a critical alert for visual impairment to a consumer electronic (CE) device.SOLUTION: An audio/video display device (AVDD) includes a display, a processor controlling the display, and a computer readable storage medium accessible for the processor. The computer-readable storage medium includes an instruction for the processor to present AV contents which are not associated with information relating to emergency on the AVDD when the instruction is to be executed by the processor. The instruction causes the processor receive data relating to the critical alert on the AVDD, switch voices to be presented on the AVDD in response to the reception of the data relating to the critical alert from a first voice presented on the AVDD and relating to the AV contents to a second voice relating to data, and present the second voice. The second voice is automatically presented on the AVDD without receiving user input for switching from the first voice to the second voice after the data relating to the critical alert are received.

title_en: Worker safety management system and method for each work environment using deep learning

abstract_en: Provided is a worker safety management system for each work environment using deep learning. The worker safety management system for each work environment using deep learning comprises: a work environment sensing module (100) including a plurality of first to n^th monitoring means (110) composed of a camera and a sensor, an alarm means (120), a power supply means (130), a communication means (140), and a control means (150) to photograph an image of a site, and installed in a workplace (10) to sense temperature and humidity and various gases; an artificial intelligence server (200) for automatically detecting a toxic gas exposure area and a sealed area work environment in which oxygen may be insufficient, automatically detecting compliance with wearing of personal protective equipment, and operating an alarm in conjunction with the toxic gas as soon as the toxic gas is detected; and a monitoring module (300) for supporting a UI that enables quick response to a field situation, and a chatbot mode ui that supports a search related to safety accidents by workplace type, work type, and worker and risk questions and answers. According to the present invention, safety management is performed from the perspective of a worker working in a workplace with risk factors such as a construction site, a logging business, a manufacturing industry, and the like, thereby minimizing a safety blind spot that occurs when a manager manages the safety blind spot.
abstract_ko:

본 발명은 영상데이터기반 AI융합분석을 통해 작업장 유형과 작업자의 위험상태에 대한 딥러닝하고, 작업환경별로 위험요인들을 자동탐지 및 예측할 수 있도록 하며, 비공개된 안전관리계획이니 안전사고 사례 원인 등 정형데이터를 융합처리하는 새로운 형태의 RAG기반 챗봇AI를 이용하여 안전관리자와 작업자가 질문하는 작업장 유형별로 위험종류와 위험도에 대하여 근거기반 신뢰성 있는 답변을 지원하는 기능을 지원한다.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of road construction warning board erecting device, including pillar, it is fixedly installed on the plug body of the lower rod end and is fixedly mounted on the warning sign on the pillar top, cavity is provided with the plug body, slide slot is symmetrically set with the cavity sidewalls, the slide slot medial extremity is provided with the connectivity slot for connecting the cavity, the slide slot outboard end is installed with baffle plate, and it is slidably fitted with sliding block in the slide slot, the sliding block outboard end is provided with the plate of flat, the slot for allowing the plate to stretch out is provided with the baffle plate, the cannelure extended up and down is provided with the pillar；Apparatus of the present invention are simple in construction, easy to use, in the presence of plate, pillar is not easy to translate into and is rotated, so as to reduce potential safety hazard.

title_en: Deceleration strip capable of judging direction of vehicle coming and road turning blind area early warning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of pavement facilities, in particular to a deceleration strip capable of judging the direction of a vehicle coming and a road turning blind area early warning device. The speed-reducing belt comprises a speed-reducing belt and a warning device linked with the speed-reducing belt, wherein the speed-reducing belt is of a combined structure and comprises a base, a front pedal, a rear pedal and a plurality of pedal linkage assemblies; the rear pedal is lapped above the front pedal; the bottoms of the front pedal and the rear pedal are both supported on the base through spring telescopic rods or hydraulic springs; the pedal linkage assembly comprises a first sliding block, a second sliding block, two vertical sliding blocks, a horizontal sliding block, a first push rod and a second push rod; the first and second sliding blocks are respectively provided with a guide rail which can be pushed by a first and second push rods. And the sliding block, the push rod and the base are respectively provided with a driving gear, a driving rack, an energy storage gear and an energy storage rack. Through the linkage of the sliding block and the push rod, when a vehicle entering the intersection presses the deceleration strip, the warning device is started through the driving gear, and the vehicle is charged through the energy storage gear.

title_en: Ground monitoring device and method for multi-base-point friction type overburden rock migration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground monitoring device and method for multi-base point friction type overburden rock migration, and belongs to the technical field of ground monitoring. According to the invention, the steel wire rope can drag the tool cavity to move through the movement of the rock stratum, and the second spring drives the piston to slowly reset due to the small caliber of the air outlet, so that the sliding seat drives the writing pen to perform translational movement through the magnetic attraction of the second magnet and the first magnet, so that the writing pen can perform linear marking on the carrier plate, the rock stratum migration track can be accurately described, the monitoring of the movement track of the rock stratum is ensured, the monitoring device can operate and run on the ground, the operation is simple, the safety and reliability are realized, the cost is reduced, the difficulty of rock stratum migration volume and the separation layer position before and after the mining can be effectively and dynamically monitored in real time, and technicians can be helped to obtain the time-space evolution law of the rock stratum migration under the influence of the mining, so that data support is provided for subsequent actual production and disaster early warning.
assignees: HUANGYUCHUAN COAL MINE OF GUONENG YILI ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster prevention monitoring method and system for old wind turbine based on wireless temperature measurement technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire hazard prevention monitoring method and a fire hazard prevention monitoring system for an old wind turbine based on a wireless temperature measurement technology, and relates to the technical field of automatic monitoring. Through real-time monitoring and dynamic analysis of temperature and current data, the invention can rapidly and accurately identify potential fire risks, and obviously reduce accidents caused by equipment overheating or current abnormality. And secondly, the real-time performance of data acquisition and the maintenance convenience of the system are improved by utilizing a wireless technology, monitoring blind spots caused by equipment aging are reduced, and the integrity and real-time updating of monitoring data are ensured. In addition, the dynamic threshold adjustment and abnormal mode recognition functions in the invention further enhance the adaptability of the system to environmental changes and the prospective of early warning, and effectively avoid false alarm and missing report.
assignees: HUANENG JIUQUAN WIND POWER CO LTD

title_en: Fire piping structure for building
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting piping installation structure, which connects pipes for piping discharged to a building. The firefighting piping installation structure comprises: a pipe with a first O-ring and a first stopper ring joined at each end by an outer circumferential surface; a connection pipe which allows the ends of the pipes inserted from both sides to be spaced apart by a certain length, and allows the pipes to be movably coupled to a certain length while preventing the pipes from both sides from deviating to the outside; a heat dissipation sheet which surrounds the outer peripheral surface of the connection pipe to block heat transfer to the pipe through the connection pipe; a heat-resistant pipe made of heat-resistant material to block heat transfer to the heat dissipation sheet; a buffer member which prevents moisture from flowing into the connection pipe from the outside and absorbs shock from the outside; and a pair of pipe caps in which a seal ring is inserted between flange surfaces on both sides and are pressed together by fastening nuts and bolts between the flange surfaces. According to the present invention, the firefighting piping installation structure ensures a tight connection between pipes, prevents the inflow of any foreign substances from the outside, provides buffering against earthquakes or shocks generated from the outside, prevents heat transfer to the pipe by the heat dissipation sheet and heat-resistant pipe even if high temperature heat is applied due to a fire, and prevents damage to pipes and poor connections due to pipe deformation, contraction, or expansion.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방 배관 설치구조에 관한 것으로서, 건물에 배설되는 배관용 파이프들간을 연결하는 구성에 있어서, 각 단부에는 외주면으로 제1 오링과 제1 스토퍼 링이 결합되는 파이프; 내주면의 길이 중간부에는 상기 파이프의 외경보다 작은 내경으로 일정 길이의 걸림돌기가 형성되도록 하여 양측으로부터 각각 삽입되는 파이프들간의 단부가 일정 길이로 이격되도록 하고, 양측단부의 내주면에는 파이프들의 외주면에 밀착되도록 하는 제2 오링과 함께 상기 제1 스토퍼 링의 외경보다 작은 내경을 갖는 제2 스토퍼 링이 결합되도록 하여 양측으로부터 파이프들이 외측으로 이탈되지 않도록 하면서 일정 길이가 이동 가능하게 결합되도록 하는 연결 파이프; 상기 연결 파이프의 외주면을 감싸도록 하여 상기 연결 파이프를 통해 파이프로의 열전달이 차단되도록 하는 방열 시트; 상기 연결 파이프의 길이와 동일한 길이로 형성하고, 상기 방열시트의 외주면을 감싸면서 밀착되도록 하여 방열시트로의 열전달이 차단되도록 내열성 소재로 형성하는 내열 파이프; 반원형으로 분할되도록 하여 단면간 맞춤돌기와 맞춤홈간 맞춤결합에 의해 상기 내열 파이프의 외주면과 동시에 양측단면에 밀착되게 하면서 양측단부의 내주면은 상기 연결 파이프의 양측으로 삽입되는 각 파이프들의 외주면에 밀착되도록 하여 외부로부터 상기 연결 파이프의 내부로 물기가 유입되지 않도록 하고, 외부로부터의 충격에 대해 흡수할 수 있도록 하는 완충부재; 상기 완충부재의 양측으로부터 각각 상호 마주보는 방향으로 상기 완충부재의 외주면과 양측단면을 감싸도록 하면서 상호 마주보는 단부에는 각각 플랜지면을 형성하고, 양측의 플랜지면 사이에는 시일 링이 삽입되도록 하여 플랜지면간 너트와 볼트 체결에 의해 압착 결합되도록 하는 한 쌍의 파이프 캡의 결합으로 이루어지는 구성이다.

title_en: Distributed healthcare communication system
abstract_en: A graphical audio station of a nurse call system is operable to permit a user to perform one or more of the following functions: establish a two-way voice communication link with another computer device in another patient and/or with a another computer device located in another staff work area and/or with a wireless communication device carried by caregiver and/or with a telephone of the healthcare facility; broadcast a voice page to a group of other selected computer devices; compose and send a text message to a portable device that is carried by a caregiver and that has wireless communication capability; browse web pages and/or view multimedia content, such as videos, hosted on servers of the healthcare facility and/or that are accessible via the Internet; view and/or acknowledge and/or answer and/or cancel alerts or nurse calls originating in a plurality of patient rooms.

title_en: A kind of power distribution cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of power distribution cabinet, comprise distributing box, fire extinguishing system, ventilating fan, warning light and electric leakage signal lamp, described distributing box both sides are respectively equipped with fire extinguishing system, described fire extinguishing system comprises rotation blinds, touching switch, electromagnetically operated valve and fire extinguisher, the linkage piece of described rotation blinds coordinates with touching switch installs, and described touching switch is by solenoid control fire fighting with fire extinguisher; Be symmetrical arranged 4 cover ventilating fans on rear side of described distributing box, on rear side of described distributing box, middle part arranges row's shutter; Described warning light is arranged on distributing box top; The double door of described distributing box is respectively arranged with electric leakage signal lamp.Adopt 4 cover ventilating fans and shutter can have thermal diffusivity good, fire alarm lamp is provided with at distributing box, there is fire alarm function, distributing box door has electric leakage prompt facility, when preventing electric leakage, the naked hand touching of people, and be provided with repairing lighting device at night, when night, distributing box broke down maintenance, convenient for maintaining.

title_en: Forest inspection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a forest inspection device, relates to the forest management and protection field, including upper portion open-ended box, the articulated electric switch's in box upper portion chamber door sets up battery, control box and the interface that charges respectively in the box, sets up in the box and patrols and examines unmanned aerial vehicle and put out a fire unmanned aerial vehicle, and the interface that charges can charge for patrolling and examining unmanned aerial vehicle and putting out a fire unmanned aerial vehicle, patrols and examines unmanned aerial vehicle and all set up the camera on the unmanned aerial vehicle with putting out a fire, puts out a fire the unmanned aerial vehicle lower part installation. The utility model can replace the manual patrol mode of the traditional patrol personnel, has no personal safety risk, improves the efficiency of patrol work, and reduces the labor cost; by unmanned aerial vehicle non-blind area patrol, full-coverage management can be realized for forest management and maintenance work; the system realizes automatic identification and early warning treatment of smoke and flame characteristics of forest fires, and can effectively deal with timeliness and sudden work.

title_en: Intelligent warning device for detecting and automatically alarming mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mining intelligent warning device with automatic detection alarm, which relates to the technical field of mining warning equipment, in particular to a mining intelligent warning device which can send out sound and light signals, has the function of recording and broadcasting warning prompts in real time, reminds operators by voice that the operators can not enter dangerous operation areas of any type, and can read the information of the mine personnel positioning card through an independent personnel positioning card signal transmitting and receiving device compatible with a mine personnel positioning system, can automatic recording personnel's information violating the regulations, the recording broadcasts personnel's image violating the regulations, and the equipment of information such as accessible display screen display personnel's image, locator card information, electric quantity, operation interface, the primary structure includes four cavities, including cavity one, cavity two, cavity three and cavity four, solves traditional warning and lays the technical problem that the device has the use drawback in coal mine safety production.
