title_en: Safety coefficient data model construction method and early warning device based on AI (Artificial Intelligence)
abstract_en: The invention provides an AI-based early warning device for monitoring the safety state of a building, which comprises: the device comprises a data acquisition unit, an alarm unit and an AI processing platform; the data acquisition unit is used for detecting shaking data, three-dimensional deformation data, noise data and foreign matter invasion data of the building; the data acquisition unit is connected with the AI processing platform and transmits the acquired data to the AI processing platform; the AI processing platform compares and analyzes data with a preset safety factor based on a safety factor data model, performs early warning and fault warning on the unnatural regular shaking, displacement and abnormal sound of the building, provides event warning and severity evaluation for three-dimensional deformation and foreign object intrusion, and simultaneously evaluates the safety state of the building. The AI-based early warning device provided by the invention can monitor the safety state of a building in real time based on the safety coefficient data model, realize disaster prevention and early warning, and further reduce the hazard of accidents.
assignees: SHENZHEN SUIRUI CLOUD NETWORK TECH CO LTD;SUIRUI TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission cable sag monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for monitoring sag of a power transmission cable, wherein the system is arranged as a hardware module and a software module; the hardware module is provided with a data acquisition module and a data transmission module; the data acquisition module acquires cable tension data; the data transmission module transmits cable tension data to a system data background; the software module is provided with a data processing module, a data storage module and a data visualization module; the data processing module preprocesses the data in the background of the system data; the data storage module stores the preprocessed data; the data visualization module creates a chart to realize visual monitoring. The beneficial effects are that: automatic monitoring is realized, the potential safety hazard of manual inspection is eliminated, and the monitoring efficiency and the accuracy are improved. The monitoring blind area is eliminated, the omnibearing monitoring is realized, and the overall state of the circuit is mastered in time. The data acquisition and transmission speed is improved, the instantaneity is improved, the remote real-time monitoring and early warning are realized, the intelligent analysis and management are realized, and the abnormal situation is responded rapidly.

title_en: Moving Robot and controlling method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile robot and a mobile robot control method. The mobile robot monitors a cleaning region by capturing an image while moving in a plurality of regions based on a map of the cleaning region. With the present invention, monitoring can be performed with a plurality of regions or a specific region designated. It is possible to monitor the entire region by capturing an image while rotating at a monitoring position by designating the monitoring position in the region. It is possible to set a specific position as the monitoring position in the region and perform imaging at a specific imaging angle with a monitoring direction designated at the monitoring position. Monitoring can be performed on a plurality of regions with a minimum movement. It is possible to capture an image of a blind spot by changing or adding the monitoring position based on obstacle information, and thus effective monitoring can be performed. A schedule can be set for monitoring at a specified time, and intrusion can be detected based on image analysis-based obstacle recognition. In the event of intrusion, a warning is output and an intrusion detection signal is transmitted, and thus security can be enhanced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 이동 로봇 및 그 제어방법은, 청소영역에 대한 지도를 바탕으로 복수의 영역을 이동하면서 영상을 촬영하여 청소영역을 감시하는 것으로, 복수의 영역 또는 특정 영역을 지정하여 감시를 수행할 수 있고, 영역 내에서 감시위치를 지정하여 감시위치에서 회전하면서 영상을 촬영하여 영역 전반에 대한 감시가 가능하고, 영역 내에서 특정 위치를 감시위치로 설정할 수 있고, 감시위치에서 감시방향을 지정하여 특정 촬영각도로 영상이 촬영되도록 할 수 있고, 최소한의 이동으로 복수의 영역에 대한 감시를 수행할 수 있으며, 장애물 정보를 바탕으로 감시위치를 변경하거나 추가하여 사각지대에 대한 영상을 촬영할 수 있어 효과적인 감시가 가능하며 지정된 시간에 감시를 수행하도록 스케줄을 설정할 수 있고, 영상을 분석하여 장애물을 인식함으로써 침입 여부를 감지할 수 있고, 침입감지시 경고를 출력하고, 침입감지에 대한 신호를 전송하여 보안기능이 강화되는 효과가 있다.

title_en: IP Emergency Call Station with Mass Notification Voice Alerting
abstract_en: An emergency call station provides emergency communication services for a user to contact an emergency responder. The call station includes an integrated IP video camera, an integrated security console, and at least one processor configured to provide network supervision status monitoring and notification, status message escalations, logging voice and video, text-to-speech conversion, multilevel forwarding, remote management of endpoints, pre-recorded messages, InformaCast® Compatibility; and mass emergency notification to multiple responders.

title_en: Method and apparatus for emergency dialing in mobile communication terminal
title_ko: 이동 통신 단말의 긴급 발신 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: A method for sending an emergency call in a mobile communication terminal and an apparatus thereof are provided to enable a user of the mobile communication terminal to send a help request message to neighbors even in any place if an emergency occurs. A method for sending an emergency call in a mobile communication terminal comprises the following several steps. A controller checks whether there exists an emergency call request from a user(101). If so, the controller detects a current position coordinate by using a GPS signal received from a GPS receiver according to the emergency call request(103). The controller checks a place where the mobile communication is located by using the detected current position coordinate(105). The controller detects an emergency call number matched with the checked place and an emergency message made according to a language used in the place(107). The controller outputs the detected emergency message and current position coordinate to a TTS(Text To Speech) module and generates a current position coordinate voice message and an emergency message(109). The controller attempts to make a call connection to the detected emergency call number(111). The controller checks whether a call connection is made(113). If so, the controller sends the generated current position coordinate voice message and emergency message to the detected emergency call number(117). Otherwise, the controller makes a call connection to the emergency call number repeatedly(115).

title_en: Fire safety guidance system for apartment houses
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety guiding device for firefighting of an apartment house comprising: a sensing unit; a controlling unit; a display unit; a visibility securing unit; and an interlocking unit. The sensing unit measures temperatures of a plurality of front doors, each household, stairs from a front door to a household, and an elevator; and transmits a temperature signal. The controlling unit calculates a fire generating area and a fire diffusion expecting area through the temperature signal received from the sensing unit, and determines an evacuation path. The display unit allows an evacuee to confirm the evacuation path depending on a driving signal transmitted from the controlling unit, and is provided in a common area among the household, the stairs, and the elevator. The visibility securing unit secures visibility to allow the evacuee to confirm the evacuation path by discharging foreign substances accumulated in the display unit or smoke generated during fire to a far direction from the display unit. The interlocking unit bypasses firewater to drive the visibility securing unit by hydraulic pressure of the firewater when the firewater is supplied to a sprinkler by outputting a fire alarm. The present invention can reduce time and a cost required to install the safety guiding device for firefighting.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 공동주택에 구비되는 복수 개의 현관, 각각의 세대, 상기 현관으로부터 상기 세대까지 연결되는 계단, 및 엘리베이터의 온도를 측정하여 온도신호를 송신하는 센싱부; 상기 센싱부로부터 수신되는 온도신호를 통하여 화재 발생 구역 및 화재 확산 예정 구역을 계산하고, 대피로를 판단하는 제어부; 상기 제어부로부터 송신되는 구동신호에 따라 대피자가 대피로를 확인할 수 있도록 출력하고, 상기 세대, 상기 계단, 상기 엘리베이터 사이의 공동구역에 구비되는 디스플레이부; 상기 디스플레이부에 누적되는 이물질 또는 화재 발생 시에 생성되는 연기를 상기 디스플레이부로부터 먼 방향으로 배출시켜 대피자가 대피방향을 확인할 수 있도록 시인성을 확보하는 시인성확보부; 및 화재 경보가 출력되어 스프링클러에 소방수가 공급될 때에 소방수의 유압에 의해 상기 시인성확보부가 구동되도록 소방수를 우회시키는 연동부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Bi-directional blind sight illumination and deflector device
abstract_en: An optical device that reflects back some of the same light that been projected towards the reflector with more intensity when transmitting through the reflector such that the remaining light is dispersed and still can been seen. The light is concentrated and projected forward by the device such that the appearance of the intensified light may act as a warning of oncoming vehicles, emergency situations, stopped vehicles and pedestrians on a hill or curve where line of sight is inhibited. The device is comprised of at least one reflective, dispersive and transmitting lens having a front and a rear surface and side edges; a frame that encircles the transmitting lens; a pole for affixing and placing the transmitting lens and frame to the ground; and a means to secure the frame of the transmitting lens to the pole.

title_en: Three-dimensional wildfire monitoring and control method and system for power transmission corridor
abstract_en: Disclosed are a three-dimensional wildfire monitoring and control system and method for a power transmission corridor. The system includes: a wildfire-induced trip risk assessment module, for assessing, when a wildfire is detected in a power transmission corridor, a wildfire-induced trip risk in real time so as to determine whether to issue a wildfire warning; an online wildfire monitoring device layout planning module, for generating an online wildfire monitoring device layout plan for transmission lines based on the wildfire-induced trip risk, a blind spot of satellite monitoring and importance levels of the transmission lines; and a three-dimensional power transmission corridor wildfire monitoring and warning module, adopting multi-source satellites and drones, and realizing three-dimensional wildfire monitoring of the power transmission corridor by monitoring through online wildfire monitoring devices provided according to the layout plan, the multi-source satellites and the drones.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Zebra crossing system and wearable equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a zebra crossing system and wearable equipment, zebra crossing system includes: a zebra crossing body; the camera module is used for shooting to obtain the vehicle information of the intersection where the zebra crossing body is located, the delay condition of the green light and the walking condition of pedestrians on the zebra crossing body; the control pile is used for delaying the green light under the operation of the disabled; the warning information module is used for sending warning information under the condition that a person falls down on the zebra crossing body; blind bricks arranged on two sides of the zebra crossing body; and the radio frequency identification tags are arranged on the blind bricks, and each blind brick is provided with one radio frequency identification tag.

title_en: Early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an early warning device which comprises a clock body and a hanging piece, wherein the hanging piece is fixed on a wall surface, the lower end of the hanging piece is connected with a vertical plate, the upper end of the clock body is connected with a connecting rod, the connecting rod penetrates through the vertical plate to hang the clock body on the vertical plate, a first spring is connected with a first ball body, a second ball body is placed on a table top, the first ball body and the second ball body are positioned right above a groove, a transverse plate is connected with a vertical rod, two ends of the second spring are respectively connected with the transverse plate and the bottom of the groove, a first contact piece is arranged on the side surface of a blind hole, when the second ball body falls on the transverse plate, a second contact piece arranged at the lower end of the vertical rod is contacted with the first contact piece, and a buzzer is connected with the second contact piece and the first contact piece. When an earthquake and the like occur, the clock body swings around the connecting rod so as to drive the first spring to move, so that a second sphere positioned on the first sphere falls on the transverse plate in the groove, and the vertical rod moves downwards so that the first contact piece and the second contact piece are in contact, and the buzzer buzzes.

title_en: Blind area early warning system based on upper and lower binocular vision analysis range finding
abstract_en: The invention provides a blind area early warning system based on upper and lower binocular vision analysis and ranging, which comprises a central processing unit, a binocular image acquisition module, a CVBS screen, an alarm, a storage module, a communication module and an operation platform, wherein the alarm comprises an external audible and visual alarm and an internal alarm, the CVBS screen, the external audible and visual alarm and the internal alarm are all connected with the central processing unit, the binocular image acquisition module is used for acquiring image information and transmitting the image information to the central processing unit, the central processing unit processes the image information, transmits the image information to the storage module and transmits the image information to the operation platform through the communication module, and the storage module records videos and generates alarm accessories after receiving signals; the central processing unit comprises a target detection unit, a target filtering unit, a binocular distance estimation unit, a target alarm decision unit and an alarm control unit.
assignees: SHENZHEN RUIWEI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Railway line early warning method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-source data fusion railway line early warning method which comprises the following steps of A, inputting a railway line to be inspected and a ramp map into an unmanned aerial vehicle management platform, making an inspection route, setting a flight task including time and inspection route sequence, B, controlling unmanned aerial vehicle to fly and inspect by the unmanned aerial vehicle management platform, carrying out image acquisition through a high-definition camera on the unmanned aerial vehicle during inspection, C, carrying out image algorithm analysis on the acquired image by the unmanned aerial vehicle management platform, determining the real-time position of inspection, marking an object when an early warning object is found, automatically generating early warning information, D, carrying out inspection on a discharge train at a parking platform, checking whether a left object of loading and unloading is left, and E, popping up early warning reminding by a control terminal based on each early warning information. The invention can realize unmanned aerial vehicle timing inspection on whether the railway line has barriers, personnel and animals, whether the station stock road empty car has foreign matters left, whether the side slope has landslide and the like.

title_en: Real-time fracture characteristic parameter estimation method based on active fault data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time fracture characteristic parameter estimation method based on active fault data, and belongs to the technical field of earthquake early warning. The method comprises the steps of real-time receiving processing of strong vibration data, identification and binarization processing of a near field area of fracture of an observed earthquake dynamic field, construction of a general fault fracture template library, real-time dynamic generation of a specific fault fracture template library, introduction of a virtual station in a sparse area and an edge area of a station network, complement of an observation blind area through weighting fusion of an actual observation value and a GMPE prediction value, correlation matching of the real-time strong vibration observation data and a fault fracture template, searching of an optimal template, and outputting of current fault fracture characteristic parameters based on the optimal matching template. The invention adopts the existing active fault database to dynamically generate the fracture template to process the known fault fracture caused by the active fault, and utilizes the general template to process the unknown and hidden fault fracture, thereby remarkably improving the accuracy of real-time estimation of the earthquake dynamic field in the process of large earthquake fracture.

title_en: A jamming accident detection and prevention system using image(or video) analysis technology
title_ko: 영상분석기술을 이용한 끼임사고 감지 및 예방 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system for detecting and preventing a jamming accident using image analysis technology. The system for detecting and preventing a jamming accident using image analysis technology comprises: a first step of setting a plurality of areas to be analyzed as areas in which a worker can generate a jamming accident and areas for distinguishing a color of a tower lamp capable of determining whether a facility is in operation; a second step of collecting image information from the set areas; a third step of determining a dangerous state based on the collected image information; and a fourth step of performing a warning alarm or interlock when it is determined that there is the dangerous state. A combination of a hardware combination and a fusion algorithm using object recognition and dynamic characteristic analysis solves a problem of a data blind spot occurring in a process of upgrading a smart factory, thereby minimizing additional processes and preventing real-time automatic performance aggregation, defect detection, and safety accidents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 영상을 분석하고자 하는 영역을 작업자가 끼임사고가 발생할 수 있는 영역과, 설비가 가동 중인지 판단할 수 있는 타워램프의 색상을 구분하기 위한 영역으로 복수로 설정하는 제1단계와; 설정된 영역에서 영상정보를 수집하는 제2단계와; 수집된 상기 영상정보를 바탕으로 위험상태를 판단하는 제3단계와; 위험상태라고 판단시 경고 알람 또는 인터락을 수행하는 제4단계를; 포함한 영상분석기술을 이용한 끼임사고 감지 및 예방 시스템을 제공함으로써, 하드웨어 조합과 객체인식과 동특성 분석을 활용한 융합 알고리즘의 조합으로 스마트공장 고도화 과정에서 발생하는 데이터 사각지대의 문제를 해결함으로써 추가 공정을 최소화하고 실시간 자동 실적집계와 불량 검출 및 안전사고를 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of light-operated photoacoustic dual-controlled alarm
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of light-operated photoacoustic dual-controlled alarm, belongs to warning device technical field.Second control end of speech IC therein is connected with the emitter stage of the second triode, 3rd control end of speech IC is connected with the base stage of the 3rd triode, 4th control end of speech IC is connected with the first end of photo resistance and the emitter stage of the 3rd triode, the base stage of the second triode is connected with the emitter stage of the first triode, the base stage of the first triode is connected with the second end of potentiometer and the second end of photo resistance, and the colelctor electrode of the 3rd triode is connected with second end at the second end of loudspeaker and light emitting diode.The utility model is by adopting composite amplifier; improve induction sensitivity; with flash of light while chimes of doom sounds; dual-alarm function can remind owner to improve warning; the people that ear can be made to become deaf or be in noisy environment are warned; recognizing has uninvited guest to invade and harass, and protects the safety of people's daily life.

title_en: A kind of elevator Internet of Things safety monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of elevator Internet of Things safety monitoring system, including device, five side's verbal systems, fault warning equipment, data translation processor and cloud platform monitoring modular, described device is located at the inside of elevator body, one end of language device is connected with each other when the five sides verbal system is with Ji, the fault warning equipment is located at the lower section of device, the data translation processor is located at the inside of device, and it is connected to radio transmitting device, information storing device and mobile terminal module, the cloud platform monitoring modular is connected with each other with radio transmitting device.The elevator Internet of Things safety monitoring system, signal is strong, it is noiseless, without distance limitation, it is ensured that keep constant communication with the external world, it can be ensured that elevator trapped personnel is surely in external world's communication, it is one-touch calling, it is convenient and swift, voice call clear sound, can be achieved to network with elevator maintenance company, the very first time finds elevator faults.

title_en: A kind of water conservancy flood situation automatic on-line monitoring alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of water conservancy flood situation automatic on-line monitoring alarm,Its structure includes water level message meter,Flood situation video monitoring machine,Information acquisition device,Fixed strut,Lightning rod,Flood situation information audible-visual annunciator,Automatic monitoring warning host,Flood situation EW system,Upright bar,Base,Rain gauge,Solar panels adjusting bracket,Solar power system,Upright bar is equipped with extension fixed link and support reinforcing block,Extend fixed link to weld with rod end,Upright bar,Extension fixed link is mutually perpendicular to,The utility model passes through the cooperation between automatic monitoring warning host and flood situation information audible-visual annunciator,Work as rain condition,When regimen changes or water level goes up,The noise that surrounding environment can be avoided to produce,Carry out the accessible sounding of multi-angle,And the resident near giving reminds with passerby,Effectively improve awareness of safety,And alarm signal is remotely sent to monitoring center,To reduce casualties and property loss to greatest extent.

title_en: Alarm combination device of railway disaster prevention foreign matter intrusion monitoring subsystem
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a limit monitoring subsystem warning composite set is invaded to railway disaster prevention foreign matter relates to the railway disaster prevention field, the utility model discloses a composite set box, composite set box side board and top panel are equipped with the louvre, composite set box front panel is equipped with power indicator and status indicator, composite set box backplate is equipped with 2 and connects monitoring unit owner controller interface, 1 and connect row accuse/electric wire netting interface, seven groove PCB integrated circuit boards are openly equipped with to composite set box inside, six groove PCB integrated circuit boards are equipped with to the composite set box back, 7 relays are openly equipped with to the composite set box inside, 2 relays are equipped with to the composite set box back, four ways power is equipped with at the composite set box back. title_en: Industrial underwater camera monitoring and early warning system and method based on foreign matter detection
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underwater monitoring and alarming, in particular to an industrial underwater camera monitoring and early warning system and method based on foreign matter detection, wherein the system comprises an underwater camera module, an underwater auxiliary lighting module, a multi-beam forward-looking sonar module, an underwater wireless communication module, an abnormal detection and identification output module and a ground monitoring center; according to the invention, the industrial underwater environment is imaged in real time through the underwater camera module, the multi-beam forward-looking sonar module performs auxiliary imaging detection under low visibility, underwater foreign matter identification is performed based on the underwater image and sonar data, so that the underwater environment is covered in all directions, the underwater potential safety hazards can be found and processed in time, the operation control condition of the underwater inspection robot is analyzed, reasonable regulation and control treatment measures are timely made for the underwater inspection robot, the safe and stable operation of the underwater inspection robot is ensured, and the supervision difficulty of ground management staff is remarkably reduced.

title_en: Mine exploitation safety monitoring system and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine monitoring, in particular to a mine exploitation safety monitoring system and a monitoring method, the system comprises an environment detection module, a threshold value determination module, a travel determination module, a position determination module, a judgment module, an information determination module and an early warning module. According to the invention, the communication distance can be adjusted according to complex and changeable underground environment conditions by detecting the air humidity and the concentration of dust in the mine, the adaptability of the system is improved, the communication security risks of the target objects in different roadways can be comprehensively and deeply analyzed by comprehensively considering the positions of the target objects, the distribution of the relays and the environment parameters, and when the potential communication risks are detected, the early warning module can timely send out security prompts to the target objects, so that potential safety hazards possibly brought by communication blind areas are effectively reduced, the accuracy of security monitoring is remarkably improved, and the security and reliability of mine operation are improved.

title_en: Highway dangerous situation early warning telephone notification system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway dangerous situation early warning telephone notification system, which relates to the technical field of highway dangerous situation early warning and comprises a dangerous situation information acquisition module, a feature extraction unit, an early warning information generation module, a telephone notification distribution module, an intelligent voice interaction module and a feedback verification module. The system collects multi-source data through the mobile terminal of the patrol personnel, identifies the dangerous situation type and severity degree through a deep learning algorithm, predicts the influence range by combining a traffic flow simulation model, plans an optimal notification path based on an improved Dijkstra algorithm, and initiates intelligent voice early warning to the affected vehicle through an operator network. The system supports multilingual interaction, multimodal feedback verification and blockchain storage, realizes quick discovery, accurate evaluation and efficient notification of highway dangerous situations, and remarkably improves the safety and emergency response capability of highway traffic.
assignees: GUANGXI TRANSP SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: System and method to communicate an emergency alert message
abstract_en: Various aspects of a system related to communication of emergency alert messages are disclosed herein. The system comprises one or more circuits in an electronic device communicatively coupled to a broadcast server. The one or more circuits are configured to register one or more output preferences based on one or more input parameters provided by a user. An emergency alert message and associated metadata of an emergency event is received from the broadcast server. The associated metadata includes time-sensitive information of the emergency event. Based on the associated metadata and the registered one or more output preferences, the received emergency alert message is modified to a user-accessible format. According to the registered one or more output preferences, the modified emergency alert message is communicated to the user.

title_en: A system for emergency safety warning and risk mitigation
abstract_en: Various embodiments relate to a system for activities of daily living (“ADL”) and instrumental activities of daily living (“IADL”) monitoring through electric current profile sensing, the system including an electric current profile sensing module configured to sense electricity usage and capture a current profile of a plurality of devices in a home using a plurality of current clamps, a device usage detection module configured to match the current profile for each of the plurality of devices to a referenced profile for each of the plurality of devices to determine a detected usage for each of the plurality of devices and an ADL and IADL module configured to translate the detected usage for each of the plurality of devices into ADLs and IADLs; wherein the ADL and IADL detection module determines whether a detected usage is a hazardous situation based on ADLs and IADLs.

title_en: Translating apparatus for fire fighting equipments
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방설비의 중계장치에 관한 것으로, 소화전에 설치되는 본체와, 상기 본체의 내부에 설치되는 회로부와, 상기 회로부에 전기적으로 연결되고, 상기 본체의 일측으로 노출된 제1접속부가 R형 수신기와 제1케이블에 의해 연결되는 제1단자대와, 상기 회로부에 전기적으로 연결되고, 상기 본체의 일측으로 노출된 제2접속부가 감지부와 알림부와 제2케이블에 의해 연결되는 제2단자대 및, 상기 본체의 일측에 설치되어 상기 회로부와 전기적으로 연결되고, 일측이 상기 본체의 외부로 노출되는 제1커넥터 및, 일측이 상기 제1커넥터와 암수로 결합되고, 발신부와 표시부가 제3케이블에 의해 연결되는 제2커넥터를 포함한다.

title_en: Alert broadcasting to unconfigured communications devices
abstract_en: Methods and systems for communicating alert messages to target communications devices in a target physical location are disclosed. The target devices may not be preconfigured to be discovered or to receive the alert message. Network sources are queried to identify accessible logical locations, which are associated with physical locations in a database. The logical locations include an intelligent network source which, having received the alert message, detects nearby devices in the target physical location. The system prepares and communicates the alert message to the target device. The intelligent network source may be configured to prepare and communicate the alert message without any intermediate system step of formulating a list of recipients. Auto-discovery and message delivery methods employ protocol packet injection, network and access point spoofing, and Bluetooth signaling. Auto-discovery and unconfigured delivery methods can be used to reveal the presence of devices in an area.
assignees: ABU-HAKIMA SUHAYYA;GRIGG KENNETH E;GUEVREMONT VINCE;PISKORZ OSKAR;MCFARLAND CONNIE;CHRISTIE COLIN

title_en: AGV goods detection device that targets in place
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a AGV goods detection device that targets in place, including laser rangefinder sensor, installing support and flexible cable, the installing support joint is in the bottom of fork support body, and the laser rangefinder sensor is installed on the installing support, and the laser rangefinder sensor is connected with the controller through the flexible cable, and controller and fork body all set up on the AGV automobile body; the utility model discloses a laser rangefinder sensor realizes that high accuracy goods distance detects, laser rangefinder sensor passes through the installing support and installs on the fork support body, the installation is simple and convenient with the investigation, can adjust from top to bottom and back, avoid the rangefinder sensor blind area to make the goods reference point simultaneously easily, the goods state that the goods in-process was unloaded in the realization is got, improve the security that AGV got the goods and unload the in-process, the vehicle will stop action and acousto-optic warning when the object surpassed the setting value relative to the automobile body distance value, because of the goods hidden danger of inclined to one side falling when effectively preventing AGV fork from getting the goods, and the goods takes place the safety problem that displacement etc. caused in the goods marcing.

title_en: Driving blind area reminding system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of road surface warning equipment, in particular to a traveling blind area reminding system which comprises a road, a first support and a second support, wherein the first support and the second support are arranged at two ends of a corner of the road, a control box is arranged at the lower ends of the first support and the second support, a single chip microcomputer PLC or a raspberry pie is arranged in the control box, suspension brackets are arranged at the heads of the first support and the second support, an auxiliary frame is rotatably arranged at the lower end of each suspension bracket, a vehicle identification component and a warning component are fixedly arranged on each auxiliary frame, the first support and the second support are arranged at two ends of the corner of the road, and then the suspension brackets, the auxiliary frame, the vehicle identification component and the warning component are respectively supported and arranged through the first support and the second support, so that when a vehicle travels to one side, whether a traveling vehicle exists at the other side can be observed through the vehicle identification component at the other side.

title_en: Safety redundancy architecture and control method under manual vehicle control mode of unmanned vehicle
abstract_en: A safety redundancy architecture in a manual vehicle control mode of an unmanned vehicle, comprising: the collision early warning system comprises an automatic driving controller, a collision early warning module, an alarm module and a sensing module, wherein communication connection is established between the collision early warning module and the automatic driving controller, communication connection is established between the sensing module and the automatic driving controller, communication connection is established between the collision early warning module and the alarm module, and the collision early warning module comprises a binocular camera and an ultrasonic radar. The invention can solve the safety accidents caused by misoperation, negligence or blind areas of vision of a safety worker when the safety worker manually controls the unmanned vehicle to run; the risk that the vehicle collides with surrounding obstacles or pedestrians due to the fact that a safer touches the handle or is not familiar with the operation method of the handle, the blind area of the field of vision of the safer and the like in the development and trial operation stage when the safer operates the vehicle manually can be avoided.
assignees: DONGFENG PLEASURE SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Parking lot vehicle management method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle management method for a parking lot, which is characterized by comprising the steps of identifying license plates and vehicle types of vehicles, carrying out risk assessment on the vehicles according to the vehicle types, determining the risk level of the vehicles according to the risk level, determining an optimal parking space for the vehicles by adopting a greedy algorithm based on the risk level of the vehicles, generating a moving path, pasting a patrol device on the vehicles, guiding the vehicles to run along the moving path, collecting environmental information around the vehicles, and sending the environmental information to a main control system, wherein the main control system judges whether fire disasters occur in the parking lot according to the received environmental information. The invention solves the problems that when a new energy automobile in the prior art breaks out a fire, fire information cannot be timely transmitted to the outside, meanwhile, a certain blind area exists in manual inspection and video early warning, a fire vehicle cannot be timely and effectively found in the early stage of the fire, and fire protection measures are started.

title_en: An unauthorized dumping prevention system to detect dumping in blind spots
title_ko: 사각지대에서 투기하는 행위를 적발할 수 있는 쓰레기 무단투기 방지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an unauthorized garbage dumping prevention system capable of detecting a dumping action in a blind spot. The unauthorized garbage dumping prevention system comprises: a camera unit formed in a unauthorized dumping prohibition area or a garbage discharge area to photograph a monitoring area and store an image when a dumper carrying a dumped object is detected; a sensor unit formed in the camera unit to recognize an approach state of the dumper and formed to measure and collect surrounding environment information; a control unit extracting a basic background image including only a fixed object that does not move among the images photographed by the camera unit, and comparing the extracted background image with a real-time image photographed in real time by the camera unit to detect a dumped state of the dumped object to determine whether unauthorized dumping has occurred; and a warning unit operating at least one of a warning sound output, a warning light output, and a photographed unauthorized dumping action output when unauthorized dumping is determined by the control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사각지대에서 투기하는 행위를 적발할 수 있는 쓰레기 무단투기 방지 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 무단투기금지구역 또는 쓰레기 배출장소에 형성되어 투기물을 소지한 투기자가 감지되면 감시구역을 촬영하여 영상을 저장하도록 형성되는 카메라부와, 상기 카메라부에 형성되어 투기자의 접근 상태를 인식할 수 있도록 형성되고, 주변 환경정보를 측정 및 수집할 수 있도록 형성되어 센서부와, 상기 카메라부에서 촬영된 영상 중 움직이지 않는 고정된 객체만 포함된 기본배경영상을 추출하고, 상기 카메라부에서 실시간으로 촬영되고 있는 실시간 영상과 비교하여 상기 투기물이 투기된 상태를 감지하여 무단투기 발생여부를 판단하는 제어부와, 상기 제어부에 의해 무단투기가 판단되면 경고음성 출력, 경고등 출력, 촬영된 무단투기 행위 출력 중 어느 하나 이상이 동작되는 경고부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A system and method for delivering aggregated animal care services through a computing platform
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system (100) and method (200) for delivering aggregated animal care services. The system (100) comprises a user interface (10) accessible via web or mobile platforms, a login module (20) for user authentication and role-based access, a data collection module (30) to store animal profiles, user data, and service provider details, and a repository (40) for maintaining structured records of pets, incidents, and services. An aggregation module (50) analyses data to generate case updates, alerts, and recommendations. A communication module (60) enables messaging, group interaction, forums, and feedback. A services module (70) provides access to emergency response, adoption, rescue, medical services, donations, volunteer coordination, and lifecycle tracking. The system (100) supports integrated animal welfare management by enabling real-time collaboration and streamlined access to services for all stakeholders through a unified platform, enhancing coordination and continuity in animal care efforts.

title_en: Combustible gas early warning device based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combustible gas early-warning device based on the Internet of things, which is connected with a thing networking for data transmission, can feed back gas leakage information to personnel, can give an alarm for prompting, timely controls the on-off of gas and can form back pumping to the leaked gas, and is characterized by comprising a gas sensor, a detection box, an electromagnetic valve, an emergency control unit, a gas suction pipe and a gas collecting tank, wherein the gas sensors are in signal connection with the detection box through data transmission lines, the emergency control unit is in signal connection with the detection box through the data transmission lines, the emergency control unit is communicated with the gas collecting tank through the gas suction pipe, the electromagnetic valve is in signal connection with the detection box through wireless transmission, the gas leakage information can be directly sent to a middle moving end, a householder can conveniently master the gas leakage condition in time and take measures to perform multi-point high concentration detection, avoiding detection blind areas.

title_en: Collision early warning method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a collision early warning method, a system and a storage medium, which comprise the steps of constructing a target detection area in an electronic map based on target vehicle action information of a target vehicle, defining at least one auxiliary vehicle in the target detection area, determining an auxiliary vehicle blind area for each auxiliary vehicle, acquiring road side perception data of the auxiliary vehicle blind area through road side perception equipment, calculating a target vehicle action track of the target vehicle when the road side perception data of the blind area contains early warning target action information, calculating an early warning target action track of the early warning target, and generating collision early warning information corresponding to the early warning target according to the target vehicle action track and the early warning target action track. The road side sensing equipment on two sides of the road can acquire global visual field information of the blind area, effectively predicts whether a target vehicle collides with an early-warning target, sends collision early-warning information to remind the target vehicle before predicting collision, and helps the target vehicle to avoid collision events in advance.

title_en: Sound type side-walk block
abstract_en: A sidewalk block capable of making a sound is provided to alert a blind person of a starting point, waiting point, transfer point and destination point, as well as to carry electric and communication cables within the sidewalk block by disposing a sounding room within the sidewalk block and conduit lines below the sounding room, thereby assisting blind persons as well as beautifying the city. In a sidewalk block(1) having Braille letters embossed, an empty sounding room(3) is provided inside the block. The sidewalk block can make distinguishing noises depending on the width of the block and thickness of upper surface of the block. Conduit lines are disposed below the sounding room. On each conduit lines, an electric cable and communication cable are separately accommodated. The sounds made from the sounding room are transfer point, waiting point, starting point, and destination point. Each sound is unique. The sidewalk block and the conduit lines are made from materials containing 80 to 85% of polycarbonate by weight, 10 to 15% of rubber by weight, 2 to 5% of Acrylic impact modifier, 1% of UV stabilizer, 0.5% of heat stabilizer, and 0.5% of lubricant by weight.

title_en: System and method for a security checkpoint using radio signals
abstract_en: A security device for monitoring the radio frequency signals generated by mobile phones and similar mobile computing and communication devices. The security device employs an antennae array and computer process that are configured to detect and provide a “fingerprint” for a mobile device based on the unique identifiers contained with the radio and other wireless signals utilized by such mobile device. The “fingerprint” that is obtained can be used to keep track of mobile devices as those devices enter and leave the area of the security device. Moreover, the security device can provide an alert when any new, foreign, or otherwise unrecognized device is within range of the security device and share “fingerprints” and alerts with other security devices in its network.

title_en: Blind spot inertia detection warning system
abstract_en: A blind spot inertia detection warning system comprises a blind spot detection unit, an inertia detection unit, a warning unit and a processing unit. The blind spot detection unit is used for sensing and generating at least one mobile object speed information corresponding to at least one mobile object. The inertia detection unit is used for sensing and generating body angular velocity information, body velocity information and body acceleration information corresponding to the riding vehicle. The processing unit is used for generating collision notification information according to the at least one mobile object speed information, the body angular speed information, the body speed information and the body acceleration information, and driving the warning unit to generate at least one of emergency warning audio and emergency warning light according to the collision notification information so as to remind surrounding people at first time, thereby striving for precious rescue time.

title_en: Photovoltaic area intelligent monitoring and warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring and alarming system and method for a photovoltaic area, which can be used for automatically collecting the illumination intensity of a photovoltaic panel, the generating capacity of the photovoltaic panel, the object detection signal of the photovoltaic panel surface and the detection signal of a photovoltaic panel distance measuring sensor in real time during operation, analyzing and processing the signals to obtain the expected generating efficiency and the maximum and minimum distances of the photovoltaic panel to the ground, and setting the operation limit value according to the expected data. title_en: Visual-based falling stone impact structure risk assessment and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a visual-based falling stone impact structure risk assessment and control method and system. According to the visual falling stone impact structure risk assessment and control method, a camera and a stereoscopic vision sensor are used for capturing a moving video, a three-dimensional form and a dynamic position of falling stone in real time, first hand data can be timely obtained, the camera and the stereoscopic vision sensor can cover a large-range area, comprehensive falling stone activity monitoring is provided, the blind area of a traditional monitoring method is made up, further, calculation of falling stone impact force and falling stone movement tracks is facilitated timely and more accurately, then falling stone risk assessment is carried out by using the falling stone impact force and the falling stone movement tracks, a risk map is generated, assessment accuracy is higher, an early warning system is built according to the risk map, a protective measure arrangement scheme is built, and falling stone risks can be prevented more safely.

title_en: Compact local operation pannel
abstract_en: Although a conventional industrial site operating panel is intermittently operated, installation costs are too high and installation spaces are too big, thereby a space usability and safety are compromised and the conventional site operating panel is limited in terms of a kind of operator information, availabilities, and distances. To solve the above-mentioned problems, circuits are miniaturized, the size of the site operating panel is reduced, and operator information is diversified. A main frame (41) is added in a motor control panel (20) and information for the site operating panel and an alarm lamp (60) is transmitted to and received from the site operating panel (10) in a digital format via a dedicated cable. Therefore, the motor control panel (20), site operating panel (10), and alarm lamp (60) are integrated in one system. A specialized system, which is 100% compatible with specific sites without modifying conventional circuits and configured to be 1:1 matched with loads, is thus provided according to the present invention, such that construction and maintenance costs are reduced. A machinery room is provided to improve accessibility of operators. The site operating panel is installed in various ways such as on walls or ceilings as well as on grounds, such that installation convenience is improved and negligent accidents are prevented. A voice alarm and the alarm lamp are installed, such that a remote status monitoring is enabled. title_en: Method for Vehicle Identification and Communication Between Transportation Network Company (TNC) Service Users
abstract_en: A method for effective vehicle identification and communication between riders of transportation network companies (TNC), and the vehicles that are being designated to the riders. Accordingly, a system used to execute the method of the present invention conveys the information of the rider on a display device on the designated vehicle of the rider, so as to notify the rider before getting into the designated vehicle. Additionally, the present invention also helps assist blind people by conveying audio messages, such as pipe messages or announcing their names. Further, the present invention provides riders the ability to send an emergency alert, thereby ensuring a safer ride. Furthermore, the present invention enables TNCs to utilize the display device as a trade dress and as an optional platform for other media advertisements.

title_en: Ad hoc network wireless intelligent public emergency broadcast terminal
abstract_en: An ad hoc network wireless intelligent public emergency broadcast terminal comprises a CPU (central processing unit) module, a memory module, a wireless transceiving module, a frequency modulation transceiving module, a digital voice processing module, an audio amplifying module, a sensor data acquisition module, a video compressed encoding/decoding module, an Ethernet transceiving module and a power management module. The ad hoc network wireless intelligent public emergency broadcast terminal has the advantages that the terminal can be used for coping with various sudden natural and man-made disasters to take the place of current centralized control type wired/wireless public emergency broadcast systems; multiple terminals can form a wireless emergency broadcast network with no need of arrangement of a central control node, and distributed control and information communication among nodes are completed through a multi-tripping relay; blind areas are avoided, and the coverage area of the public emergency broadcast system is widened; and the terminal has an intelligent automatic control capability, early warning efficiency is improved, and various losses caused by disasters are lowered.
assignees: HUNAN DEHAI COMM EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD

title_en: Automobile blind area early warning system, automobile, method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automobile blind area early warning system, an automobile, a method and a device thereof, wherein the automobile blind area early warning method comprises the steps of receiving a capacitance signal sent by a capacitance sensor, wherein the capacitance sensor is arranged on an automobile blind area; judging the distance between the automobile and the measured object according to the capacitance signal; and when the distance is smaller than the threshold value, sending a prompt signal. According to the embodiment of the invention, the capacitance signal sent by the capacitance sensor is received, the distance between the automobile and the measured object is judged according to the capacitance signal, and when the distance is smaller than the threshold value, the prompt signal is sent, so that the user is reminded. Therefore, the safety accident caused by the dead zone of the automobile can be fundamentally solved, and the driving safety is greatly improved.

title_en: Safety anti-collision early warning device for construction vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of construction safety protection, in particular to a safety anti-collision early warning device for a construction vehicle, which comprises four mounting pieces, wherein the front sides of the upper parts of the mounting pieces are respectively provided with a fixing piece, the fixing pieces are rotatably provided with back buckles, the back sides of the back buckles are provided with bumps, the back buckles are convenient for operators to toggle, torsion springs are connected between the back buckles and the fixing pieces, and a mounting frame is arranged between the fixing pieces and used for further fixing the mounting frame. title_en: Intelligent natural disaster alarm system
abstract_en: An intelligent natural disaster alarm system comprises a central controller and an alarm machine. The central controller is placed in an agricultural bureau, a weather station or other places and used for collecting early warning information such as weather, geological disasters and the like through a special data channel or a network; an alarm machine station: carrying out data communication through a GPRS channel in a place where GPRS signals are popularized, and carrying out communication through a satellite data chain in a GPRS covered blind spot area; the central controller collects, summarizes, arranges and distributes the early warning information, and sends the early warning information to the required alarm machine station in a short message mode after processing, and the alarm machine station warns people in the area in a GPRS short message forwarding or loudspeaker broadcasting mode after receiving the early warning information. The intelligent natural disaster alarm system fully utilizes the complementary characteristics of GPRS and satellite communication technologies, comprehensively covers communication, ensures that alarm information reaches a blind spot-free area, and flexibly arranges intelligent alarm machines without being influenced by terrain.

abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of vehicle blind zone monitoring reminding method, mobile terminal and storage mediums, this method comprises: receiving detection data；Judge whether the detection data meets prompt alert if；When determining detection data satisfaction prompt alert if, Analysis of Potential is carried out to detection data, obtains hidden danger type；When hidden danger type visual hidden danger non-for blind area, the alarm parameters of hidden danger vehicle in detection data are obtained；Blind area prompt alarm is carried out to driver according to alarm parameters；When hidden danger type hidden danger visual for rearview mirror, observation prompt is issued, to prompt driver to check rearview mirror.The design that the present invention passes through acquisition alarm parameters, the progress of subsequent blind area prompt alarm is ensured, by the design for carrying out blind area prompt alarm to driver, effectively the information of hidden danger vehicle in blind area is prompted, to remind driver to avoid, it is therefore prevented that make safety accident caused by avoiding not in time between vehicle since driver can not be computed correctly distance.

title_en: Portable signal recognition equipment for hearing disorder
abstract_en: A potable alarming device for a hearing impaired person is provided to rapidly cope with a situation by immediately recognizing a situation generated regardless of places. A potable alarming device for a hearing impaired person includes a body(10), a display(20), two connection lines(33,34), and a reset pushing part(40). The body includes a signal receiving part, a control part, a vibration generating part, a character generating part, an illumination generating part, and a power supply part. The signal receiving part receives a sound signal generated according to a situation. The control part controls a signal received through the signal receiving part. The vibration generating part, the character generating part, and the illumination generating part display a signal sensed by the control part into vibration, character, and illumination. The power supply part supplies a power source to the control part. The display is formed on a surface of the body. The display displays the character and the illumination delivered by the character generating part and the illumination generating part into outside. The connection line is formed on both sides corresponding to the body. A female Velcro tape(31) and a male Velcro tape(32) are formed in an end of the connection line. The reset pushing part is exposed on one surface of the body. The reset pushing part is connected to the control part, and resets the control part.

title_en: Safety barrier for quickly identifying front and back surfaces
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety barrier for rapidly identifying front and back surfaces, which comprises a barrier frame, wherein a separation rod frame and a warning board are arranged on the barrier frame, an installation interlayer is arranged in the barrier frame, a fluorescent identification component is arranged in the installation interlayer, fluorescent strips with two colors are respectively arranged on the front surface and the rear surface of the barrier frame, the length of each fluorescent strip is long, and an erector can know the erection direction at the first time when erecting the barrier, so that the condition that the working efficiency is influenced because workers find that the barrier is required to be reinstalled when the worker installs the barrier to half of the barrier is avoided; if the user is when finding the dress mistake, it accessible rotates the regulation and rotates worm and makes score installation cover and vice installation cover rotate simultaneously to change the front and back position of fluorescent layer, make maintainer can still know safe working range in the first time, thereby very big reduction the potential safety hazard when producing.

title_en: Fire alarm bell and connecting rod for the same
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire alarm bell and a connecting rod of the fire alarm bell are provided to increase a strike sound by vibrating a crank with the elastic force of a spring. CONSTITUTION: A frame(120) is installed in the inside or outside of a fire alarm and mounts a spring(160) and a connecting rod(150). One side of the spring is comprised of a free end. The other side of the spring is fixed to the frame. A hammer(170) is mounted on the spring and translates according to the vibration of the spring. A motor(130) is formed in the frame and rotate with power when a fire occurs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 경보음이 보다 크며 내구성을 향상시킬 수 있는 하재경보종 및 화재경보종의 커넥팅 로드에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 일 형태에 따르면, 경종, 프레임, 일측방향으로 길이방향을 가지도록 배치되고 일측단은 자유단이며 타측단은 고정되어 탄성에 의해 자유단이 병진운동하는 스프링, 상기 스프링에 구비되어 상기 스프링의 탄성에 의해 상기 경종을 타격하는 해머, 회전력을 제공하는 모터, 일측단이 상기 모터의 회전축에 결합되며 타측단은 상기 모터의 회전축으로부터 일정거리 이격되어 상사점과 제일 먼 하사점 사이를 회전하는 크랭크, 일측단은 상기 스프링의 일측단에 결합되고 타측단은 상기 크랭크의 타측단에 결합되어 상기 크랭크의 회전에 따라 병진운동하면서 상기 스프링을 당기도록 구비되며, 상기 스프링의 모터를 향하는 면의 대향된 면과 접촉하여 상기 크랭크가 하사점으로 회전될 때 상기 스프링의 일측단을 모터측으로 당겨 스프링을 탄성변형되게 하고, 상기 스프링의 일측단의 모터를 향하는 면과는 접촉되지 않도록 개방되어 크랭크가 상사저으로 회전될 때에는 상기 스프링의 탄성력으로서 탄성복원되도록 이루어지는 커넥팅 로드를 포함하여 이루어지는 화재경보종이 개시된다.
