title_en: Width-indicating protection device for AGV
abstract_en: The utility model provides a show wide protector for AGV dolly, protector includes detector and relay KA, be connected with the power after detector and relay KA are established ties, the normally open contact KA.1 of relay KA inserts in the alarm circuit of AGV dolly, and according to the barrier information control normally open contact KA.1 closure back that the detector detected, realize alarm start-up warning under the alarm circuit on-state, the normally open contact KA.2 of relay KA is established ties with the former safe operation return circuit that is used for controlling AGV dolly normal operating, and according to the original safe operation return circuit disconnection of barrier information control that the detector detected. The utility model discloses a set up on the AGV dolly with former safe operation loop connection's protector with show wide device, improve the fail safe nature of AGV dolly at the operation in-process, there is the blind area in the safety protection system of solving the AGV dolly and to the potential safety hazard that the field operation personnel brought, guarantee operation personnel's personal safety, stop when exceeding the safe distance of predetermineeing and report to the police, reduced the safety risk.
assignees: CHINA TOBACCO SHAANXI IND CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent card certificate control system based on domestic credit and trauma environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a smart card certificate control system, a smart card certificate control method and a computer readable storage medium based on a domestic credit and debit environment, and belongs to the technical field of smart card certificates. The embodiment of the application is on-site certification equipment integrating the functions of data acquisition, chip data information writing, data information printing, anti-counterfeiting film covering, data verification and the like, adopts a modularized design, has flexible and simple structural design, and is easy to install and maintain; the electrical performance is stable, and the anti-interference capability is strong; the industrial personal computer adopts a series of visual graphical interfaces, so that a user can grasp the working flow of the whole functional module more clearly and clearly, and the whole certification making process can be carried out more smoothly; early warning is timely made on the condition of the whole system equipment, so that the system is more stable and efficient to operate. All modules of the industrial personal computer adopt a domestic kylin operating system and a domestic marine light CPU, so that the potential safety hazard problem of information leakage existing in foreign systems can be effectively avoided.

title_en: A wearable safety device system to deter rape
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wearable safety system (100) designed to enhance personal security through integrated biometric authentication, real-time location tracking, and multi-sensor monitoring. The system comprises a wearable vest (102) with a plastic waistband and a triangular plastic plate, featuring an adjustable elastic belt mechanism for variable girth. A fingerprint sensor (106) for authorized activation and deactivation, a motion sensor (110) and infrared thermometer sensor for detecting wearer presence and unauthorized removal, and a GSM/GPRS module (112) configured to transmit alerts and GPS location data to pre-stored emergency contacts. The system further includes an audio alarm unit (114) emitting sirens and distress messages, a multi-color LED module (116) for visual alerts, an emergency push button (108), and a rechargeable lithium-ion battery (118) with a charging slot. A microcontroller-based control unit (117) processes sensor inputs and manages communications, enabling energy-efficient operation and timely alerts. The device also preserves foreign fingerprints on its plastic surface for forensic use.

title_en: Methods and apparatuses for emergency notifications to the hearing impaired
abstract_en: Systems and methods for communicating emergency alerts to a hearing-impaired user are disclosed. Queries are performed to one or more emergency alert databases to develop emergency alert notifications. At least some of the emergency alert notifications are filtered responsive to user selected criteria to select one or more filtered emergency alerts. An attention desired indicator is transmitted to a hearing-impaired user device that subscribes to a hearing-impaired relay service supported by the server if the one or more filtered emergency alerts are present. The filtered emergency alerts are transmitted to the hearing-impaired user device in response to a emergency information query from that user device.

title_en: Automobile driving safety assisting method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automobile driving safety auxiliary method and system, and the technical scheme is as follows: the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining the coming information of a coming vehicle behind and beside an automobile and behind the automobile closest to the automobile; the coming vehicle information comprises distance information of the coming vehicle behind and the vehicle, relative speed information of the coming vehicle behind and the vehicle, and transverse position information of the coming vehicle behind and the vehicle; acquiring image information in front of the automobile to obtain corresponding video information; determining the collision time of the rear coming vehicle and the automobile according to the coming vehicle information; if the collision time is less than the preset time, sending collision early warning, overlapping the incoming vehicle information on the video information to generate corresponding overlapped video information, and displaying and storing the overlapped video information; if the collision time is not less than the preset time, storing the video information; this application has the advantage that whether there is the barrier in the convenient detection car blind area within range.

title_en: Methods and apparatuses for emergency notifications to the hearing impaired
abstract_en: Systems and methods for communicating emergency alerts to a hearing-impaired user are disclosed. Queries are performed to one or more emergency alert databases to develop emergency alert notifications. At least some of the emergency alert notifications are filtered responsive to user selected criteria to select one or more filtered emergency alerts. An attention desired indicator is transmitted to a hearing-impaired user device that subscribes to a hearing-impaired relay service supported by the server if the one or more filtered emergency alerts are present. The filtered emergency alerts are transmitted to the hearing-impaired user device in response to a emergency information query from that user device.

title_en: Interactive electronic libretto/translation HD display interface apparatus and method
abstract_en: An addressable apparatus and method for simultaneous presentation of a performance script or other commentary, dialogue, and/or visual information available in the original language or one or more translations which can be selected by the user. Other visual information such as, sponsors, advertisements, and emergency alerts can be transmitted to each display in full color graphics or video. In one embodiment, a touch screen interface can allow point of sale applications pre-show, during intermissions, and/or post-show. Individual addressability allows direct messaging capabilities, seat-naming, anti direct-marketing media opportunities.

title_en: Event communication system for providing user alerts
abstract_en: An event communication system involves facilitating entry by a user of one or more device addresses via a network accessible user interface of the event communication system. The device addresses are associated with alerts provided by the event communication system. Test alert messages targeted for the device addresses are sent via the user interface. The system sends alerts user devices corresponding to the one or more tested device addresses in response to predetermined events. The system may provide user access to historical copies of data relating to the alerts. Registration on the system involves storing a personal identity data of a student on a database and comparing the personal identity data to registration data entered via the user interface. Authentication is automatically provided based on the comparison.

title_en: Distribution room environment monitoring device
abstract_en: The application provides a power distribution room environment monitoring device which comprises a temperature sensing module, a data processing and analyzing module, an environment adjusting module and a user interaction and display module. The intelligent power distribution room monitoring system comprises a temperature sensing module, a data processing and analyzing module, a power distribution room monitoring module and a user interaction and display module, wherein the temperature sensing module can collect environmental temperature data of all areas in the power distribution room in real time so as to eliminate monitoring blind areas, the data processing and analyzing module can generate or correct a load model and a history curve of the power distribution room based on the environmental temperature data so as to generate an intelligent adjustment instruction, so that the intellectualization of the power distribution room is improved, the response speed is improved, the environment adjustment module can automatically adjust corresponding auxiliary equipment in time according to the intelligent adjustment instruction to realize lean management of the power distribution room, and in addition, the user interaction and display module can display data generated in real time in all modules in real time and perform early warning when data abnormality exists, so that related personnel can take preventive measures in advance to effectively cope with sudden faults or potential safety hazards.

title_en: Evacuation guidance apparatus for the blind that can be evacuated by self in case of fire and method thereof
title_ko: 피난경로를 제공하기 위한 사용자 단말기 및 그의 피난경로 제공 방법
abstract_ko: 피난경로를 제공하기 위한 사용자 단말기 및 그의 피난경로 제공 방법이 제공된다.  하나 이상의 피난층과 하나 이상의 일반층을 포함하는 건물에서 사용자에게 피난경로서비스를 제공하는 사용자 단말기는, 건물 내에 구비된 실내측위비콘들로부터 측위 신호를 수신하고, 건물 각 층의 피난 랜드마크들마다 설치된 서브 경로안내비콘들로부터 서브 신호를 수신하는 통신부와, 대기모드에서 건물에서 발생하는 화재경보를 자동인지하고, 활성화모드에서 사용자에게 피난 경로를 제공하는 피난유도 프로그램을 저장하는 메모리와, 화재경보가 자동인지되면 피난유도 프로그램을 활성화모드로 전환하고, 실내측위 비콘들과 통신하여 사용자의 현재 위치를 실시간으로 측위하고, 측위된 현재 위치를 기초로 사전에 설정된 메인 피난 경로와, 서브 경로안내비콘들로부터 수신되는 피난 랜드마크로의 진입 여부를 포함하는 서브 피난 경로 중 적어도 하나를 포함하는 피난 경로를 제공하는 프로세서와, 사용자에게 피난 경로를 음성으로 제공하는 스피커를 포함한다.

title_en: Resetting device for fire-fighting overhaul
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a reset device for fire control maintenance, it has a reset ware and a light sensor to have automatic advantages and efficiency such as relieving the police dispatch newspaper and improving the security. When fire-fighting maintenance is carried out, the resetting device is electrically connected to a fire-fighting signal receiving switchboard, and the light sensor is used for sensing a warning lamp number of the fire-fighting signal receiving switchboard; when the warning light signal of the fire-fighting signal receiving switchboard is on, the optical sensor continuously transmits the sensed optical signal to the reset device for calculation processing, and when the calculation result reaches a condition value, the reset device controls the fire-fighting signal receiving switchboard to enter the automatic monitoring state again and the warning light signal is turned off. The utility model discloses accessible resetting ware and light sensor and can reach automatically when the fire control overhauls the test.

title_en: Emergency danger-avoiding signal system for fire-fighting rescue scene
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency danger-avoiding signal system for fire-fighting and rescue site, which comprises an audible and visual alarm and a remote controller, wherein the audible and visual alarm also comprises a mobile audible and visual alarm and a high-power vehicle-mounted audible and visual alarm; the remote controller also comprises a remote controller held by a safety observer and a fighting group emergency signal controller. The utility model has strong applicability, and can be used for rescue sites of various disaster accidents; remote control networking can effectively solve the problems of insufficient warning range, incapability of linkage control and incapability of grouping in different areas in a large-area rescue site; the automatic falling triggering remote control has obvious effect in vehicle traffic accident handling, particularly vehicle accident rescue, and is the most common accident category of daily rescue tasks of fire rescue teams in various places; the combat group is also provided with a controller, so that the fire extinguishing rescue site risk factors can be monitored in an all-around manner, and no dead angle or blind spot is leaked; the vehicle-mounted automatic alarm function effectively solves the problem of insufficient sound.

title_en: Escalator blind sidewalk front edge plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a front edge plate of an escalator blind sidewalk, which comprises a support frame (1) and a blind spot plate (9), wherein the support frame (1) comprises a connecting edge (2), a buffer strip notch (3), a support edge (4), a lower connecting strip notch (5), an upper connecting strip notch (6), a male tab (7), a female tab (8) and an upper edge (12), the support frame (1) is longitudinally and respectively fixedly connected with the upper connecting strip notch (6) and the lower connecting strip notch (5) of the support frame (1) through connecting strips, the male tabs (7) and the female tabs (11) of two transversely adjacent support frames (1) are in lap joint, the support frame (1) is arranged below, the blind spot plate (9) is arranged above the blind spot plate, and the blind spot plate are tightly fixed together through screws. The escalator has the advantages of scientific and reasonable design, simple structure, material saving, manufacturing cost saving, convenient installation and use, firm support framework, no deformation and damage, capability of giving warning to the blind who wants to mistakenly enter the escalator, and no safety accident.
assignees: DANYANG JIMMOU ELEVATOR COMPONENT LTD COMPANY

title_en: Communication base station data acquisition device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a communication base station data acquisition device, including the chassis, the chassis lower extreme passes through concrete and ground fixed connection. The utility model discloses, the chassis passes through concrete and ground fixed connection, outer box passes through the fixture block card on the joint groove of kelly outer wall, wholly do not adopt the screw fixation, greatly increased the dismantlement degree of difficulty, during the maintenance, insert two sets of trigger holes of participating in through control switch and be connected battery package and electric telescopic handle electricity, rethread control switch control electric telescopic handle drives the fixture block and breaks away from with the kelly, can separate outer box from the fixed plate, pyroelectric sensor detects whether personnel are close to in the periphery at any time, send alarm sound and alarm light through bee calling organ and warning light, the personnel that the warning is close to leave as early as possible, the theftproof effect has been reinforceed, camera collection personnel image information, send information to control center through communication module, built-in battery package, still accessible battery package carries out interim power supply when making external power supply destroyed.
assignees: GUANGDONG QIANBAIDU ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Steel structure box type modular fire station
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a box modularization fire station of steel construction in modular structure room technical field, including first layer body, second layer body and third layer body, first layer body is including two garage modules, the equipment module that is used for placing fire-fighting equipment, the module on duty, communication module and the module of on duty, two garage modules are located the middle part of first layer body, connect through the stair module between first layer body, second layer body and the third layer body, the garage module is connected with second layer body through the speed reducer, adopt the mode of steel construction module integration, make things convenient for the dismouting, satisfy the requirement of energy-concerving and environment-protective; and the function integrated level is high, does benefit to going on smoothly of fire control work, and when the alert feelings appeared, the fire fighter accessible speed-reducing steel pipe that is located the second layer body passes the speed-reducing through-hole landing to accepting the cask on, reduces decurrent impulsive force through the spring to reach the arrival position that guarantees that the fire fighter can be quick safe, in order to avoid delaying alert feelings.
assignees: NANNING SHILAN HANGXIAO STEEL STRUCTURE CO LTD

title_en: Wearing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wearing device, which comprises a shell, a processing system arranged on the shell, a camera module, a sensor module and a loudspeaker module, wherein the camera module is connected with the processing system; the camera module is used for picking up the environment image and sending the environment image to the processing system; the sensor module is used for detecting the gesture information of a wearer and the distance information between the wearing device and an object in the environment and sending the gesture information to the processing system; the processing system is used for determining action guidance and early warning according to the environment images, the gesture information and the distance information, and sending the action guidance and the early warning to a wearer through the loudspeaker module. By utilizing the utility model, accurate navigation can be provided for the blind and the use comfort of the user is improved.

title_en: Remote control detecting and warning system for preventing closing on grounding-wire
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a remote control detecting and warning system for preventing closing on grounding-wire, comprising a wireless remote-control launching device and at least one wireless receiving detector. The wireless remote-control launching device is arranged for sending a grounding-wire detecting command signal to the wireless receiving detector. The wireless receiving detector is arranged for detecting the grounding status of grounding-wire after receiving the grounding-wire detecting command signal from the wireless remote-control launching device. If the grounding-wire is notremoved, the system will warn. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages of small volume, convenient use, wide coverage, strict detection, blind angle free, etc. The utility model can effectively avoid the serious failure caused by closing on grounding wire and can be applied to various power substations or converting stations without an integrated automatic monitor systemfor electrical operation.

title_en: Transmission line anti-contact and anti-external-force warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission line anti-contact and anti-external-force warning system which comprises a storage battery, an infrared monitoring module, a logic judging module, a warning loudspeaker and a warning lamp. Whether a foreign object invading the line safety distance exists in the transmission line protection area or not is monitored and judged by transmitting and receiving infrared rays at the high frequency. The installation position and height of the transmission line anti-contact and anti-external-force warning system are set according to the line safety distance, and warning is conducted before the foreign object enters the transmission line protection area. By means of the transmission line anti-contact and anti-external-force warning system, voice and light warning can be given before a large machine such as a crane or a controllable foreign object enters or gets close to the transmission line protection area, the problem that the safety distance of the transmission line is invaded is fundamentally solved, the phenomenon that vehicles and other machines flow frequently or the phenomenon that the contact accident occurs in the constructed transmission line protection area is avoided, the effect of protecting the transmission line against external force is improved, personal safety of personnel and safe and reliable running of the transmission line are better guaranteed.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting management system and method for small and micro-place based on 5G technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a small micro-place intelligent fire-fighting management system and method based on a 5G technology, which can effectively solve the problems of low equipment intelligence degree, poor safety and supervision blind spots and dew points which are easily caused when the early warning is not carried out or the early warning is not timely carried out; the invention effectively improves the automation, digitalization, visualization and intellectualization levels of the fire control management of the small and micro-place, reduces the life and property loss caused by fire to the maximum extent, and is an innovation on the fire control management system and method.
assignees: HENAN CNSECLOUD INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Personnel situation perception and safety monitoring method for hoisting machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personnel situation perception and safety monitoring method for a hoisting machine, which specifically comprises the following modules: the method comprises the following steps that 1, an object dynamic monitoring and early warning are carried out; module 2, monitoring and registering personnel operation; module 3, sensing the situation of the personnel; the module 4 is used for vehicle working condition management and man-machine interaction; by adopting the invention, final tests show that the invention can identify the size of a hoisted object in real time, dynamically set a warning region, and supervise and early warn a vehicle vision blind area and a working region under the suspension arm; the system has the advantages of high hardware cost performance, richer functions, higher automation degree, scientific management and safe construction, great reduction of potential safety hazards in the construction process, sound construction early warning mechanism of the hoisting machinery, and multiple guarantee for the safety of the hoisting machinery during working.

title_en: Solar blind ultraviolet early warning monitoring method, management system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solar blind ultraviolet early warning monitoring method, a management system, a device and a storage medium, which are applied to the management system, wherein the management system comprises at least one area detection module, each area detection module comprises a plurality of solar blind ultraviolet sensors, each solar blind ultraviolet sensor is used for detecting ultraviolet intensity, the solar blind ultraviolet early warning monitoring method comprises the steps of continuously obtaining the ultraviolet intensity detected by each solar blind ultraviolet sensor in the area detection module, calculating an ultraviolet average value, wherein the ultraviolet average value is obtained by dividing the sum of the ultraviolet intensities detected by each solar blind ultraviolet sensor in the area detection module by the number of the solar blind ultraviolet sensors in the area detection module, and outputting an alarm signal when the difference between the ultraviolet intensity detected by any one solar blind ultraviolet sensor in the area detection module and the ultraviolet average value exceeds a warning threshold value, so that the fire disaster judgment accuracy is improved, and the workload of workers is reduced.

title_en: Deformation monitoring system for foundation pit vertical supporting body of hydraulic reclamation area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deformation monitoring system for a foundation pit vertical support body in a hydraulic reclamation area, which relates to the technical field of deformation monitoring and comprises a multi-source signal acquisition module, a dynamic environment acquisition module, a fusion identification module, a dynamic analysis module and a dynamic early warning module, wherein a distributed fiber grating sensor is cooperated with an MEMS inclination sensor to realize millisecond deformation signal capture, and simultaneously acquire 5 key parameters of axial strain, lateral displacement, earth pressure, pore water pressure and water level, so that the problem of blind area of single index monitoring is solved, the comprehensive deformation value Q is calculated, then the pore water pressure change rate U3 and the water level change rate W3 are introduced to correct a safety coefficient K, the data fusion efficiency is improved, the problem of data island is solved, multi-stage response is triggered according to the K value, the early warning response efficiency is improved, and the engineering defense value of the deformation monitoring system under the complex working condition of the hydraulic reclamation area is improved.

title_en: Early warning method for image information recovery and lane keeping of severe foggy roads
abstract_en: A method for recovering road information in severe fog days and keeping lane early warning belongs to the technical field of intelligent vehicle safety auxiliary driving. The method comprises the steps of constructing a fog day image classifier, different fog concentration classifiers, a faint yellow fog image recovery model based on a three-primary-color superposition principle, a road information recovery model based on a color migration method, obtaining clear road information recovery images aiming at different fog day types in real time, realizing a visual enhancement effect, constructing a vehicle position detection model in a lane, and judging whether to provide visual and auditory early warning for a driver by utilizing the direction parameters of the vehicle in the lane and the position of the vehicle in the lane. The method can recover the road environment visual information under the condition of low visibility in the foggy days, and solves the problems that the existing automobile fog lamp has limited irradiation range and blind areas in the foggy days, and the driver has inaccurate judgment on the driving environment.

title_en: System for providing location alerts relating to emergencies
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for generating alerts communicated to emergency responders and/or contacts indicating a location of an incident. The system comprises a housing, one or more light sources, and a computing processor. A switch is located in the housing and configured to be accessible to a user. When the switch is actuated by a user indicating an incident, the processor provides power to the at least one light source to output light from the housing thereby indicating the location of the system. The system may also control a speaker to output an audible signal and a transmitter to transmit an emergency signal with location information to a device of an emergency responder and/or an emergency contact. The present invention may also be embodied in a software application that is implemented on a mobile device to thereby leverage the components of the mobile device to send alerts.

title_en: Rubber spare cutter
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rubber spare cutter belongs to rubber spare processing field. Rubber spare cutter is used for carrying out cutting process to rubber spare, and it includes the supporting seat, including supporting plane and supporting leg, the supporting leg supports the supporting plane and with supporting plane fixed connection, rubber spare mould is located supporting plane department for place rubber spare, activity Board, activity Board through first pivot connect in supporting plane department, monitoring devices, monitoring devices is located activity Board department for the monitoring from the activity Board downside extremely foreign matter in the vertical plane in rubber spare mould upper surface place, and alarm device, be located activity Board department, alarm device with monitoring devices signal connection for the warning staff. The utility model discloses not only can effectively cut rubber spare, can also avoid the potential safety hazards such as cut wound finger that lead to because of staff attention deficit, effectively improve its work safety performance.

title_en: Outer broken early warning device of power transmission line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an outer broken early warning device of transmission line, including monitoring facilities, early warning equipment and host computer, monitoring facilities includes the camera, and the camera is connected with host computer signal, and monitoring facilities and early warning equipment all install on the transmission line truss, and early warning equipment includes audible-visual annunciator, and monitoring facilities still includes laser intrusion detector and electronic cloud platform, and laser intrusion detector and electronic cloud platform all communicate with the host computer signal, and the camera is installed on electronic cloud platform; wherein laser intrusion detector is used for surveying whether there is the foreign object invasion, and audible-visual annunciator is connected with laser intrusion detector, and audible-visual annunciator is used for sending audible-visual annunciator when laser intrusion detector detects the foreign object invasion, and electronic cloud platform is by host computer remote control, and electronic cloud platform is used for driving the camera rotation when laser intrusion detector detects the foreign object invasion and in order to adjust the shooting angle of camera. Use the utility model discloses can in time discover outer broken hidden danger and in time send out the warning suggestion simultaneously.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WENZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Substation live equipment overhauls regional safety device
abstract_en: A safety protection device for an overhaul area of a transformer substation live equipment comprises four supporting structures distributed in a quadrilateral manner and isolation belts arranged between two adjacent supporting structures; an audible and visual alarm is arranged at the top of the supporting structure; the upper part of the supporting structure and the lower part of the audible and visual alarm are provided with detection radars, and the detection radars on each supporting structure face to a middle area surrounded by the four supporting structures along the horizontal direction, so that the detection radars form a radar detection area which is horizontally unfolded at the top of the supporting structure; this radar detection area keeps 2 meters apart from electrified equipment of transformer substation, when the staff examine the maintenance activity, touches the safe distance of 2 meters distance, and audible and visual alarm at accessible bearing structure top sends the warning to the staff, reminds the staff to need keep 2 meters safe distances apart from electrified equipment to play safety protection's effect.
assignees: STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NINGDONG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent anti-collision early warning protection system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent anti-collision early warning protection system, and relates to a man-vehicle anti-collision terminal applied to an operation area. Comprising the following steps: the system comprises a plurality of mobile tags, an intelligent anti-collision terminal and an engine server. The intelligent anti-collision terminal provided by the utility model integrates all functional modules, supports various communication modes, is convenient to install and is plug and play; the anti-collision early warning device realizes anti-collision early warning between the working vehicle and the working personnel, and avoids unnecessary loss caused by factors such as blind areas of the working vehicle, blocked sight of the driving personnel and the like.

title_en: Power system load power protection control method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load power protection control method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for a power system. The power system load power protection control method comprises the following steps: establishing an element model of the power system; determining risk indexes of various fault states in the power system according to the element models and the operation reliability indexes; and determining a load power protection control strategy of the power system by combining the operation reliability index, the risk index and the risk degree of the cascading failure. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention relieves the technical problems that the technical support means cannot meet the service requirement and the adaptability of the solution scheme is not strong and the like caused by the fact that most power distribution network scheduling depends on experience scheduling or blind scheduling in the prior art, improves the reliability and lowers the economic cost brought by comprehensively considering various factors, is beneficial to establishing an optimal control decision scheme and forms a whole set of real-time monitoring, evaluation, early warning and control system.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD CHAOZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Electrical complete equipment state monitoring and early warning system based on multi-parameter intelligent sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrical complete equipment state monitoring and early warning system based on multi-parameter intelligent sensing, belongs to the technical field of electrical equipment state monitoring, and can clearly indicate a specific fault mode (such as 'contact resistance increasing overheat') and a possible position (such as 'A-phase bus connection point'). Through multi-parameter time sequence feature fusion and intelligent diagnosis model, the deep excavation of the fault source is realized, the operation and maintenance efficiency is greatly improved, and the overhaul work is changed from 'blind investigation' to 'accurate treatment'. By extracting deep time sequence characteristics (such as temperature rise rate and main frequency offset rate) which are strongly related to a fault evolution mechanism, weak precursor signals of early and slow faults can be captured. The complex mode of the precursors is learned by using the AI model, early warning can be sent out before the equipment performance is obviously deteriorated, predictive maintenance for preventing the equipment from being happened is realized, and unplanned shutdown and major accidents are effectively avoided.
assignees: HAINING HUAKONG ELECTRIC COMPLETE SET CO LTD

title_en: A pedestrian crossing indicator
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A pedestrian crossing indicator is provided to safely guide a disabled person, especially a blind person, and to reduce unnecessary power consumption. CONSTITUTION: A pedestrian crossing indicator comprises advertising banners(12b), indicating lamps(10c), human body sensors(17a,17b), speakers(16), a signal lamp, and solar panels(13a,13b). Photo-luminescent print parts(19) are formed in the advertising banners. The indicating lamps are installed in the top ends of first posts, and are protected by acryl transparent panels(10d). The human body sensors and the speakers are installed on the side surface of the first posts. The signal lamp is installed in the side of one first post. The solar panels are installed in the top ends of second posts(16).

title_en: Voice fingerprinting system for detecting hoax emergency reports
abstract_en: The data capture system, coupled to the emergency response system, captures speech utterances from incoming callers and uses those utterances to construct embeddings representing the captured speech utterances, the embeddings collectively representing a latent vector space and being stored in a data store within computer readable media. The query system communicates with the data store and provides an interface accessible to the call center operators that alerts a call center operator—substantially while an incoming emergency call is being received—the number of times a voice print substantially matching that of the incoming caller has been heard by the emergency response system before, or other useful metadata such as dispositions of past calls with substantial matches of the caller's voice.

title_en: Underground garage vehicle passageway reminding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a traffic water conservancy diversion control technical field specifically is an underground garage vehicle passageway reminding device. Wherein including setting up radar detection ware and the display alarm device at the road corner, radar detection ware includes first radar detection ware, second radar detection ware and third radar detection ware, display alarm device includes first display alarm device, second display alarm device and third display alarm device, radar detection ware and display alarm device are equallyd divide and are set up respectively on being close to the main road at turning, and early warning and suggestion are carried out to the driver that can be fine, have avoided having sheltered from because of road turn or trees to have the field of vision blind area and lead to the driver to avoid dodging the risk that can not reach, wherein third display alarm device includes box and case lid, the box is upper and lower layered structure, and the upper strata is equipped with the main control unit, and the lower floor is equipped with power and alarm, the case lid surface is equipped with display screen, first pilot lamp and second pilot lamp.

title_en: Construction machinery safety warning device capable of being adsorbed and installed
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adsorbable installation-free construction machinery safety warning device which comprises a triangular base, a spring column, a reflective sticker, a bell and a ribbon, wherein a powerful magnet is arranged below the triangular base through a bolt, the spring column is arranged above the triangular base, a fixed pipe is arranged above the spring column, a first inner pipe is arranged above the inner part of the fixed pipe in a threaded manner, a second inner pipe is arranged above the inner part of the first inner pipe in a threaded manner, and the reflective sticker is adhered to the outer surfaces of the second inner pipe, the fixed pipe and the first inner pipe. The adsorbable installation-free construction machinery safety warning device is small in equipment weight, convenient to move, simple in installation and unloading operation, capable of effectively isolating hidden danger such as blind area collision and the like, and capable of properly adjusting specifications according to using machinery, and is more striking in night environments.
assignees: CCCC GUANGZHOU DREDGING CO LTD;CCCC SOUTH CHINA TRAFFIC CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: A kind of method and device for detecting road barrier
abstract_en: A kind of method and device for detecting road barrier, is related to communication technical field, can solve the problems, such as potential safety hazard be present using mobile terminal when pedestrian walks.This method includes：Pavement image (101) is gathered by camera；Processing is identified to the pavement image collected, determines barrier (102)；It is determined that the spacing distance between barrier, determines that mobile terminal holder touches the very first time (103) needed for barrier by the translational speed of spacing distance and mobile terminal holder；When the very first time being less than safety time, mobile terminal sends warning against danger (104).

title_en: Automobile surrounding early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile periphery early warning device, which comprises an infrared sensing device and an ultrasonic generation receiving device, wherein the infrared sensing device and the ultrasonic generation receiving device are arranged on an automobile; the infrared sensing device and the ultrasonic generating and receiving device are electrically connected with an alarm installed in the automobile, and the infrared sensing device is used for automatically sensing people or objects around the automobile for 5 meters and feeding back to the alarm to give an alarm when sensing short objects around the automobile or young children squat in a blind area of the automobile to remind a driver or passengers to get off the automobile to observe and eliminate potential safety hazards; the ultrasonic generation receiving device is used for sending ultrasonic waves towards the direction far away from the vehicle at intervals, the ultrasonic waves automatically return to be received and fed back by the receiving device on the vehicle after encountering a shelter and an obstacle, an ultrasonic detection result is transmitted to the alarm, the alarm reminds a driver, an early warning scheme is made in advance according to surrounding road conditions, and traffic accidents are avoided. The safety of vehicle driving is improved, traffic accidents are effectively avoided, and casualties and property loss are avoided.

title_en: Early warning system and device for shield tunnel battery truck
abstract_en: The application provides an early warning system and a device for a shield tunnel battery truck, wherein the early warning system comprises a monitoring sensor subsystem, a data transmission subsystem, a data processing subsystem, a safety early warning subsystem and an auxiliary support subsystem; the monitoring sensor subsystem is used for resolving the real-time position of the battery car, measuring the real-time speed and mileage of the battery car and acquiring the real-time image of the driving environment; and the data processing subsystem is used for determining the real-time distance between the battery car and the opening based on the data acquired by the monitoring sensor subsystem, identifying whether obstacles and/or pedestrians exist around the battery car based on the real-time image, and controlling the safety early warning subsystem to display and early warn the driving state of the battery car. The application can realize the positioning of the storage battery car, the identification of obstacles and pedestrians in the running environment of the storage battery car, prompt and early warn the running state of the storage battery car, reduce the hidden danger of overspeed and vision blind areas of the storage battery car, and improve the efficiency and the safety of tunnel operation.
assignees: SHANGHAI LIXIN MEASUREMENT SYSTEM CO LTD;RAISING MEASUREMENT SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting floor drain device for underground smoke exhaust water and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent fire-fighting floor drain device for underground smoke exhaust and a use method thereof, which belong to the technical field of underground construction engineering, floor drain smoke exhaust modules are nested in grooves, and smoke exhaust pipelines are built at the bottoms of the floor drain smoke exhaust modules. The invention carries out structural transformation on the warning top plate and the filter plate in the floor drain smoke-discharging water module through the two groups of supporting ring frames and the matched hydraulic telescopic shafts, under normal conditions, the device is in a closed state, and under fire conditions, the device is in a starting state, the service life of the device is prolonged, the effect of quickly and conveniently dispersing smoke in a fire region is realized through the arrangement of a smoke-discharging water pipeline, the safety of a factory is improved, whether the smoke sensor/smoke flow sensor intelligent monitoring device is blocked or not is realized, the foreign matters on the upper part of the filter plate are cleaned by means of a foreign matter cleaning conveyor belt and a foreign matter discharging frame, and meanwhile, the foreign matters in the filter plate are cleaned through the through frame, so that the aim of automatically cleaning the device is fulfilled.

title_en: Localized distribution of emergency mass notification alerts
abstract_en: In an example, a notification system includes: a first notification server that is programmed to originate emergency messages; a second notification server connected to the first notification server, the second network server being programmed to identify the target endpoints associated with the emergency messages; and a virtual personal assistant-enabled device programmed to receive the emergency messages from the second notification server, translate the emergency messages into a format suitable for issuance by the virtual personal assistant-enable device, and issue the emergency message.

title_en: Time division multiple access technology-based communication system for transmitting air situation and disaster situation early warning information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time division multiple access (TDMA) technology-based communication system for transmitting air situation and disaster situation early warning information. In the system, early warning information of various types of alarms such as air defense, disaster prevention and the like is transmitted by using the TDMA technology and a distributed network topological structure; meanwhile, message communication, data communication and acoustic code word communication are performed; and alarm information covers areas such as buildings, pits, tunnels, underground stores and the like by using various alarm information transmission technologies. The aims of quickly and reliably transmitting and returning various types of early warning information, reporting the various types of alarm information and transmitting various types of service are fulfilled. The system has the function of quickly transmitting and distributing the various types of early warning information such as air defense, flood defense, shock resistance, fire prevention, flood discharge and the like, and can realize quick and accurate information transmission and all-around coverage of the alarm information, so that the alarms are reported without miss points or blind points, and real-time property, accuracy, high efficiency and all-around property of a civil air defense alarm are improved.

title_en: Method for rapidly matching limited fracture templates based on seismic P-wave characteristic parameters
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of earthquake early warning, in particular to a method for rapidly matching a limited fracture template based on an earthquake P wave characteristic parameter, which comprises data collection and pretreatment, optimal vibration prediction model construction, limited fracture template library generation, limited fracture template matching mode and software system inspection, compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the result obtained at the same time after earthquake is about 3 seconds faster than the FinDer algorithm result, and the individual earthquake result is about 5 seconds faster, so that the result is more rapidly approaching to a standard reference value; multiple-report early warning information and a release strategy from inside to outside can be adopted, and the number of times of report is gradually increased along with the increase of the fracture length, so that the blind area range is reduced as much as possible, and the effective early warning time is increased.

title_en: System and method for universal emergency notification and management
abstract_en: Systems and methods for triggering emergency mass notifications include an EMNS activation service, a plurality of activation premises devices, a plurality of EMNS provider services, and a plurality of event personnel devices. The EMNS activation service includes a universal translator module that receives an event trigger signal relating to an emergency event from one of the activation premises devices. The universal translator module translates the event trigger signal to event-specific EMNS protocols of the EMNS providers. The EMNS activation service communicates the event-specific EMNS protocols to the EMNS providers, and communicates event data to event personnel devices based on a list of event personnel devices to be notified of an emergency event. An activation premises device includes a housing event with trigger controls for creating the event trigger signal, wherein these event trigger controls are inaccessible to users in the absence of an authorized access or an emergency access.

title_en: Distributed healthcare communication system
abstract_en: A graphical audio station of a nurse call system is operable to permit a user to perform one or more of the following functions: establish a two-way voice communication link with another computer device in another patient and/or with a another computer device located in another staff work area and/or with a wireless communication device carried by caregiver and/or with a telephone of the healthcare facility; broadcast a voice page to a group of other selected computer devices; compose and send a text message to a portable device that is carried by a caregiver and that has wireless communication capability; browse web pages and/or view multimedia content, such as videos, hosted on servers of the healthcare facility and/or that are accessible via the Internet; view and/or acknowledge and/or answer and/or cancel alerts or nurse calls originating in a plurality of patient rooms.

title_en: System for providing location alerts relating to emergencies
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for generating alerts communicated to emergency responders and/or contacts indicating a location of an incident. The system comprises a housing, one or more light sources, and a computing processor. A switch is located in the housing and configured to be accessible to a user. When the switch is actuated by a user indicating an incident, the processor provides power to the at least one light source to output light from the housing thereby indicating the location of the system. The system may also control a speaker to output an audible signal and a transmitter to transmit an emergency signal with location information to a device of an emergency responder and/or an emergency contact. The present invention may also be embodied in a software application that is implemented on a mobile device to thereby leverage the components of the mobile device to send alerts.

title_en: Multifunctional intellectual kitchen
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of multifunctional intellectual kitchens, it includes vegetable processing unit, raw material storage element, raw material dispatching and finished product output unit, vegetable processing unit includes more than two hearths, and auto dish frying is both provided on each hearth and is cooked machine；The raw material storage element includes raw material frame, and compartment is arranged at intervals in the raw material frame, food materials or condiment are placed in the compartment；The raw material dispatching and finished product output unit include translation track and pedestal, and turntable, arm and finger are provided on the pedestal, pressure sensor and video camera are provided on the finger；It is provided with exhaust gas treatment unit above the hearth, is provided with treatment unit for waste water below the hearth, fire-fighting early warning processing unit is provided in kitchen.The utility model solves the transportation problem of the distribution and finished product of the material in automatic kitchen, realizes scale processing, meets the demand that the food in large-scale dining room is processed automatically well, accomplishes manless production, become unmanned kitchen.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU QIANZHENG AUTOMATION SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Antitheft monitoring device with smoke alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-theft monitoring device with a smoke alarm, which comprises a fixing mechanism, a main body mechanism and a monitoring mechanism, wherein the main body mechanism is arranged on one side of the fixing mechanism, and the monitoring mechanism is arranged in the main body mechanism. This fixed establishment can make monitoring devices stabilize the multipoint mode installation, reduce the possibility that drops, can carry out outside protection to monitoring devices through main part mechanism, can effectively avoid outside physical touching, thereby guarantee the stability of detection, can make this monitoring devices in use effectively dustproof simultaneously, can strengthen the warning suggestion to the abnormal conditions, the rethread monitoring devices can detect discernment to smog in the carriage, and carry out the warning and remind, adopt light to assist simultaneously, strengthen the warning effect, still can be used for this monitoring devices and discern detection environment, can avoid this monitoring devices to receive the foreign object to shelter from and seal the separation, thereby influence monitoring devices to smog detection's condition.

title_en: Railway special line pushing shunting safety early warning method, device and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of push shunting, and discloses a safety early warning method, a device and a system for pushing shunting of a railway special line, wherein the method comprises the steps of converting point cloud data acquired by an area array laser radar in real time into a two-dimensional image, then leading the two-dimensional image into a pre-trained recognition model of an object in front of a locomotive based on a target detection algorithm, outputting to obtain a recognition result of the object in front of the locomotive, judging whether an obstacle exists in front of the driving direction of a pushed train set according to the recognition result of the object in front of the locomotive by combining positioning information acquired by a positioner in real time with push shunting operation plan content, and if so, performing early warning or alarming and controlling parking, thereby not only completing the acquisition of road condition information in a blind area of a driver, but also enhancing the recognition capability of the push train set on the obstacle in front by an intelligent means, the potential safety hazard caused by the careless observation of the shunting personnel or the unsmooth communication between the shunting personnel and the driver is avoided, and the pushing shunting operation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Transformer substation unmanned aerial vehicle inspection image foreign matter suspension real-time identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation unmanned aerial vehicle inspection image foreign matter suspension real-time identification method, and relates to the technical field of transformer substation detection. Compressing data volume from the source and simultaneously keeping characteristic information in the image to the maximum extent by a patrol image compression coding technology so that a data stream acquired by an unmanned aerial vehicle is matched with edge computing power; s2: and carrying out lightweight clipping on the backbone network of the YOLOv3 detection network model. Aiming at the application scene of the suspension detection of the foreign bodies in the unmanned aerial vehicle inspection of the transformer substation, the lightweight identification model can analyze the inspection image of the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time, and can accurately and quickly identify and position the suspension of the foreign bodies such as small-size plastic bags, kites and the like in the complex background of the inspection image of the transformer substation, so that a foreign body suspension algorithm can run on equipment such as a ground station control panel of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the warning can be given in real time at the ground station or a monitoring terminal when a foreign body suspension target is found, and the detection efficiency of the hidden defects and the hidden dangers is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY EHV POWER COMPANY;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Method for flood reduction, manhole cover device, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, electronic equipment, a storage medium and well lid equipment for flood and disaster reduction.A built convolutional neural network model is utilized to analyze field image information after an obtained field image, so that whether the risk disaster conditions such as a drainage port blocking, an overhigh ground water level, an overlarge rainfall, an underground water level and the like exist can be judged, and when a certain risk disaster condition or a plurality of risk disaster conditions exist, the well lid component is controlled to drain water, so that the well lid does not need to be turned over manually to drain water in heavy water, the labor cost is reduced, and the drainage is accelerated; meanwhile, the system can send risk signals to an upper-level organ for early warning and timely manual treatment of the problem of water channel blockage, can be applied to disaster conditions, can also perform real-time detection on a daily basis, and reduces blind spots to provide convenience for water conservancy workers.

title_en: Keeping device with information function for the blind
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an item storage device with an information providing function for a visually impaired person, which is connected to a computer storing information to alert sounds to a visually impaired person with necessary information on weather and schedule and which discharges items including a clock or a braille writing pen selected by the visually impaired person. The item storage device comprises: a main body part (100); an item injection opening (200); and an item selection part (500). The main body part (100) discharges the items selected by the visually impaired person (9000). The item injection opening (200) allows the items, including the clock (8000) and the braille writing pen to be discharged to the main body part (100), to be inserted and stored thereinto. The item selection part (500) allows the visually impaired person to select an item desired to be discharged through the main body part (100).

title_en: Switchgear system with Consecutive peak current control function
title_ko: 지속성 피크전류 감시제어 기능을 구비한 수배전반 시스템
abstract_en: A switchgear system(100) including a power opening and closing unit(110) inputted to a power load comprises a control unit(101) monitoring and controlling a load current, a current detection unit(120) detecting the load current, a current conversion unit(130) converting the detected current into a digital signal, a current feature detection unit(140) detecting a persistent peak current by receiving the converted current signal, a translation unit(160) converting detected feature data into a display unit segment signal, a display unit(170) displaying a current feature result, an alarm, a cut off output unit(173), and a power supply unit(180) for operating power of the control unit. The present invention has effects of preventing biased overload loss of electric equipment, preventing biased heating accidents, optimizing device capacity reduction, and improving the utilization efficiency of equipment by the convenience of monitoring the angular unbalanced load and the unbalanced load balance adjustment simplicity by a three-phase unbalanced persistence peak current simultaneous indication function.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 과전류 지속으로 인해 발열사고를 유발하는 불평형 지속성 피크전류에 의한 편중 위험 상태를 효과적으로 파악하고, 불평형 부하 재분배와 사고 예방조치를 취할 수 있도록 하는 수배전반 시스템을 제공하는 것으로, 전력부하에 입력되는 전원 개폐부(110)를 구비한 수배전반 시스템(100)에 있어서, 수배전반 시스템은 제어부(101)와, 부하전류를 검출하는 전류검출부(120), 검출된 전류를 디지털신호로 변환하는 전류 변환부(130) 상기 변환된 전류신호를 받아 지속성 피크전류를 검출하는 전류 특징 검출부(140), 검출된 특징데이터를 표시부 시그먼트 신호로 변환하는 번역부(160), 전류 특징 결과를 표시하는 표시부(170) 및 설정치에서 경보를 하고 전로를 차단하는 경보, 차단 출력부(173), 감시제어부의 조작전원용 전원부(180)를 포함하고, 상기 제어부(101)는 부하특성에 따라 탐색대역시간(T)을 설정하고, 상기 탐색대역시간(T)을 전류 특징분석을 위해 N등분하되, 등분한 1개의 미분대역시간( )에 상기 수배전반 시스템의 1사이클 (1주기) 이상의 전류 변화가 적용되도록 하고, 상기 등분된 미분대역시간( ) 동안 나타나는 전류값으로 부터 대표전류값를 산출하여 지속성 피크전류로 산정하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이로인해 불시정전사고예방, 과전류 발열사고와 불평형에 의한 편중과부하사고, 전로손실 및 설비이용 효율을 향상시킬수 있다.
assignees: WONBANG ENG CO LTD;SON MYOUNG HEE

title_en: Emergency mobile notification handling
abstract_en: Systems and methods for handling emergency notification messages such as Commercial Mobile Alert System (CMAS) alerts. In an example scenario, a call center maintains personal profiles of a number of clients, including contact information for persons or other entities designated by the clients to receive information about the clients. The call center receives from a device associated with a particular client of the call center that the client's device has received a text-based emergency notification message. The call center notifies one or more of the designated entities. The notification may include the content of the emergency notification message, and may include an audio version of the notification message. An indication or the notification message may also be placed in a database accessible to one or more of the designated persons or entities.

title_en: But ready-package wire connector of electric leakage alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a but ready-package wire connecting piece of electric leakage alarm, settle mechanism, swift installation mechanism and electric leakage early warning mechanism including the main part, the both ends distribution of main part settling mechanism has swift installation mechanism, and the inside that the mechanism was settled to the main part is provided with electric leakage early warning mechanism. This but ready-package wire connecting piece of electric leakage alarm, the electric wire accessible that needs to connect sets up the wiring ring, the wiring ring laminating of will needing the wiring is detained around the connection terminal, the fixed block of lid of rethread is fixed, and the link all is connected to leakage sensor, in this connecting piece's use, accessible leakage sensor realizes to connecting stable and leakage detection of connection between the present end, when appearing unusual, then can realize the testing process through the singlechip, the bee calling organ of intercommunication this moment then can sound, the suggestion user of service restores and detects, with this reach the effect of leakage detection and discharge hidden danger, let the safe in utilization promotion of this connecting piece.

title_en: Automatic switching from primary to secondary audio during emergency broadcast
abstract_en: The invention relates to automatic switching from primary to secondary audio during emergency broadcast. An audio video display device (AVDD) includes a display, a processor controlling the display and a computer readable storage medium that is accessible to the processor. The computer readable storage medium bears instructions which when executed by the processor cause the processor to present, on the AVDD, AV content that is not associated with information pertaining to an emergency. The instructions cause the processor to receive, at the AVDD, data associated with an emergency alert and, responsive to receiving the data associated with the emergency alert, change audio presented on the AVDD from first audio presented on the AVDD and associated with the AV content to second audio associated the data to present the second audio. The second audio is presented on the AVDD automatically without receiving user input to change from the first audio to the second audio subsequent to receiving the data associated with the emergency alert.

title_en: Railway foreign matter invasion safety sensing and identification system based on distributed optical fiber sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway foreign matter invasion safety sensing and identifying system based on distributed optical fiber sensing, which is based on two distributed optical fiber sensing technologies and a video linkage technology: monitoring a vibration invasion signal generated when illegal personnel, vehicles and construction invade a high-speed railway by utilizing a phase optical time domain analysis technology, and giving information such as the position, the event and the like of the invasion signal; monitoring a fence deformation signal of the high-speed railway generated when large-scale rockfall and debris flow invade the high-speed railway by utilizing a Brillouin optical time domain analysis technology, and giving information such as the position of the invasion signal; when any one or two of the two optical fiber sensing systems gives an alarm, the optical fiber sensing systems can be linked with cameras arranged on a high-speed railway tower pole to call monitoring pictures of the intrusion event. The three subsystems work synchronously, study mutually, monitor invasion layer by layer, and realize early warning and identification of foreign matter invasion of the high-speed railway together.
assignees: NINGBO ZHENGYE AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid foreign matter detection method and device based on satellite image deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid foreign matter detection method and device based on satellite image deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring satellite images of a power transmission corridor and/or a transformer substation and peripheral areas thereof; marking foreign matters in the satellite image to generate a marked sample set; dividing the marked samples in the marked sample set to generate a training set and a test set; inputting the training set into a machine learning training model for training; and inputting the satellite image to be detected into the trained training model, and sending early warning information if a foreign body is detected. The method comprises the following steps: the system comprises an acquisition module, a marking module, a dividing module, a training module and an early warning module. The method and the system can find the potential risk of the foreign matters possibly existing in the power grid in time, improve the efficiency of power grid operation and maintenance personnel, perform defense and treatment on corresponding disasters in time, and reduce economic loss caused by untimely hidden trouble investigation.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: AI intelligent image recognition method based on road disaster early warning
abstract_en: The invention provides an AI intelligent image recognition method based on road disaster early warning, which comprises the following steps: real-time monitoring is carried out on the road through monitoring equipment of the far-end point location, and a road video is obtained; AI analysis is carried out on the road video through the local side centralized equipment, and a road invasion image with foreign matter invasion is output; and displaying the road invasion image invaded by the foreign matters through the upper computer cloud platform, and storing monitoring operation data. The road disaster monitoring and early warning centralized processor transmits the monitoring and processing result of the AI intelligent image recognition algorithm to the upper computer server cloud platform through the 4G/5G network, alarms abnormal conditions in time, intervenes and processes in advance after manual confirmation, avoids the occurrence of driving accidents, and improves the safety of road operation.

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of a system according to an embodiment is to realize quick and accurate information sharing at the time of a disaster, prevent diffusion of erroneous information, and enable multilingual support.SOLUTION: A system includes a reception part, an analysis part, an identification part, a warning part, a translation part, an acquisition part, a grasping part, and a distribution part. The reception unit receives a post from a user. The analysis unit analyzes and summarizes the posting received by the reception unit. The identification unit identifies the posted content analyzed by the analysis unit. The warning unit warns of the error information identified by the identification unit. The translation unit translates the posts in different languages. The acquisition unit acquires position information. The grasping unit grasps the safety information for each area based on the position information acquired by the acquisition unit. The distribution unit distributes the support needs based on the information grasped by the grasping unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vehicular Safety System for Children School Bus
abstract_en: The present invention provides a safety system for a school bus which can sense blind spots within a range of vision outside the vehicle to let a driver effectively recognize the positions of people or things in a risk area and to warn the driver of dangers, and which can sense whether passengers sit on seats and fasten their seat belts by each seat to effectively prevent accidents inside the vehicle. The safety system for the school bus includes: a plurality of external sensing units which are mounted on the top of the outside of the vehicle in different directions to sense risk areas of blind spots around the vehicle; internal sensing units each of which has an access sensor mounted on each seat inside the vehicle to sense whether or not a passenger sits on the seat, and a fastening sensor mounted on each seat belt of each seat to sense whether or not the passenger fastens the seat belt; an output unit which has a speaker mounted on the external sensing unit to output a warning sound in accordance to a voice signal and a display mounted on one side of a driver′s seat to output image information in accordance to an image signal; and a control unit to provide the output unit with a control signal in accordance to the sensing signals inputted from the external sensing unit and the internal sensing unit. The control unit controls to output images onto the display of the output unit from the sensing signals in accordance to the seating information and the seat belt fastening information of the internal sensing unit separately by each seat.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 차량 외부의 사정거리 내 사각지대를 감지하여 주변 위험영역의 사람이나 사물에 대한 위치를 효율적으로 인식함은 물론 위험 여부를 경고가능하고, 차량 내부의 착석 여부 및 안전벨트의 착용 여부를 좌석별로 감지하여 차량 내 안전사고를 효과적으로 방지함을 제공하도록, 차량의 외부 상단에 복수 개가 서로 다른 방향을 향하도록 장착되고 차량의 주변 사각지대에 대한 위험영역을 감지하는 외부감지부와; 차량의 내부에 위치한 좌석마다 설치되고 탑승자로부터 개개의 좌석에 착석 여부를 감지하는 접근감지센서와, 차량의 좌석마다 구비된 안전벨트마다 구비되고 탑승자에 대한 안전벨트의 착용 유무를 감지하도록 착용감지센서가 구성되는 내부감지부와; 상기 외부감지부 상에 설치되고 음성신호에 따른 경보음을 출력하는 스피커와, 차량의 운전석 한쪽에 장착되고 영상신호에 따른 영상정보를 출력할 수 있도록 디스플레이가 구성되는 출력부와; 상기 외부감지부 및 상기 내부감지부로부터 입력된 감지신호에 따라 상기 출력부에 제어신호를 인가하는 제어부;를 포함하고, 상기 제어부에서는 상기 내부감지부의 좌석 착석정보 및 안전벨트 착용정보에 따른 감지신호로부터 상기 출력부의 디스플레이 상에 좌석별로 각각 구분하여 영상 출력하도록 제어하는 어린이 통학차량용 안전시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Touch -sensitive screen system that can be used to alarm instruction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a touch -sensitive screen system that can be used to alarm instruction, including the controller, be connected with button input module, smog detection module, infrared detection module and humidity detection module in the input group of this controller be connected with display module and acousto -optic warning module on the output of controller, the controller still disposes wireless communication module, this wireless communication module of controller accessible and mobile terminal realize communications internet, still be connected with air quality control module on the controller, be provided with signal amplification circuit between the input of smog detection module and controller, this signal amplification circuit includes constant -current source circuit, amplifier circuit and AD converting circuit.
