title_en: A kind of electronic lock with warning function
abstract_en: A kind of electronic lock with warning function, it is related to a kind of electronic lock, including lock body, motor is equipped in lock body, motor is connect with face gear, face gear is engaged with power gear, power gear is engaged with transmission gear, transmission gear is connect with locking device, power gear is connect with lifting device, power gear is connect with guiding device, guiding device is equipped with driving gear, driving gear is connect with shiftable gear, shiftable gear is engaged with translating rack, translating rack is connect with shifting chute A, translating rack is equipped with contact B, contact B is corresponding with the position of contact A, contact A is connect by conducting wire with alarm.The device is when alarm phenomenon in need occurs, and contact A is contacted with contact B, and circuit communication carries out automatic alarm, the user of electron lock warns, user can cope with emergency situations in time, reduce the economy and damage to person of user, improve the safety coefficient that lock body uses.
assignees: GUANGDONG ANKE HENGTAI LOCK IND CO LTD

title_en: Right turn blind area warning device for large-sized vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a right-turning blind area warning device for a large vehicle, which comprises a warning belt and a mounting assembly, wherein two ends of the warning belt are connected with connecting rods, the mounting assembly comprises a mounting seat, one end of the mounting seat is provided with a mounting groove which is in sliding fit with the connecting rods, the other end of the mounting seat is connected with a fixed plate, the connecting rods are sleeved with springs which elastically support the connecting rods, one end of each connecting rod, which is opposite to the wall of the bottom of the mounting groove, is provided with a moving contact, the wall of the bottom of the mounting groove is provided with a fixed contact, and the moving contact and the fixed contact are connected with a warning module through signal lines. According to the utility model, the dead zone on the right side of the vehicle is isolated through the warning belt, when pedestrians are contacted with the warning belt, the moving contact in the connecting rod is contacted with the fixed contact, so that the warning module gives an alarm to warn drivers and pedestrians to pay attention to safety, and the potential safety hazard in the process of turning right of the large-sized vehicle is effectively reduced.

title_en: Runway safety monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a runway safety monitoring system, which comprises: the control device and the unsafe factor identification device and the early warning device which are in communication connection with the control device; the unsafe factor identification device is used for identifying unsafe factors on the target runway to obtain corresponding identification information and sending the identification information to the controller; the unsafe factors comprise a first type of unsafe factors and a second type of unsafe factors, the first type of unsafe factors comprise airplanes and vehicles, and the second type of unsafe factors comprise personnel, animals or runway foreign bodies; and the control device is used for generating a corresponding early warning control instruction based on the received identification information. The invention also provides a runway safety monitoring method. The invention can effectively reduce runway accidents.
assignees: 2ND RES INST CIVIL AVIATION ADMINISTRATION CHINA

title_en: Method for rapidly matching limited fracture templates based on seismic P-wave characteristic parameters
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of earthquake early warning, in particular to a method for rapidly matching a limited fracture template based on an earthquake P wave characteristic parameter, which comprises data collection and pretreatment, optimal vibration prediction model construction, limited fracture template library generation, limited fracture template matching mode and software system inspection, compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the result obtained at the same time after earthquake is about 3 seconds faster than the FinDer algorithm result, and the individual earthquake result is about 5 seconds faster, so that the result is more rapidly approaching to a standard reference value; multiple-report early warning information and a release strategy from inside to outside can be adopted, and the number of times of report is gradually increased along with the increase of the fracture length, so that the blind area range is reduced as much as possible, and the effective early warning time is increased.

title_en: Building fire safety precaution equipment
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a building fire-fighting safety early warning device, which comprises a base, wherein a barrel is rotationally arranged on the end surface of the bottom of the base, a camera is rotationally arranged on one side of the barrel, a plurality of water spray heads are arranged on the end surface of the bottom of the barrel, a plurality of water storage rings are arranged outside the water spray heads, a water supply assembly is arranged on one side of the water storage rings, a throwing barrel is rotationally arranged on one side of the water supply assembly, a fire extinguishing ball is filled in the throwing barrel, an arc surface seat capable of falling outwards is arranged in the arc surface of the fire extinguishing ball, and an induction alarm is arranged in the arc surface seat: through throwing in section of thick bamboo and fire ball and sprinkler bead and water storage ring setting for equipment accessible sprinkler bead is accomplished the processing of putting out a fire of local position, when the condition of a fire lasts seriously, not only can throw in inductive alarm to the position that has put out a fire, makes outside personnel can know fast, ensures the alarm effect, still can protect the processing to the equipment body, the condition that the effectual inside primordial qi piece of reduction equipment damaged appears.

title_en: Train operation line environment early warning system and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a train operation line environment early warning system and application thereof, wherein the early warning system comprises: the line environment early warning ground equipment is used for meteorological monitoring, earthquake monitoring, landslide collapse monitoring, flooding monitoring, bridge displacement monitoring and foreign matter intrusion monitoring; the line early warning vehicle-mounted equipment receives basic information of the whole operation line environment, weather information of a line to be operated in front, geological disaster early warning, train operation plan information, train control information and vehicle state, comprehensively analyzes danger early warning or warning in front of a train, the state of the train and train control vehicle-mounted ATP protection operation curve information, and gives an optimal mode for assisting train driving through expert system analysis. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of greatly reducing potential safety hazards of train operation caused by dangerous factors such as severe weather, geological disasters and the like.

title_en: Text and Voice guide service system and method for guiding public interest information of government office using mobile terminal
title_ko: 모바일 단말을 이용한 관공서의 공익정보 문자 및 음성 안내 서비스 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for providing public interest information of a public office by using a text and voice message service of a mobile terminal. The system comprises: a public office management system (100) in which an air environment information server (110), a disaster safety information server (120), a public office information server (130), and a sector-specific information server (140) are built to provide air environment information and manage required information, for each sector, including disaster safety information, public office information, and job economy/agriculture and livestock industry/environmental forestry/maritime affairs and fisheries/welfare information; a text and voice guide service system (200) which receives the air environment information, the disaster safety information, the public office information, and the required information for each sector from the public office management system (110), creates a corresponding text message and voice message text linked to the text message, and transmits the text message and a voice message linked thereto to a mobile terminal (300) of a corresponding information receiver; and a text and voice guide service application (310) of the mobile terminal which is installed to interwork with a main controller (301) of the mobile terminal that manages the output and storage of the text and voice messages received in the mobile terminal (300) of a user, outputs a push notification that can identify the text and voice messages received from the text and voice guide service system (200) according to corresponding information, and outputs a voice message combined to a selected text message in a voice. Therefore, a visually impaired person can receive desired information easily and clearly.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 관공서의 공익정보를 모바일 단말의 문자 및 음성 메시지로 서비스하기 위한 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 대기환경정보서버(110), 재난재해안전정보서버(120), 관공서정보서버(130) 및 분야별정보서버(140)가 구축되어 대기환경정보를 제공함과 아울러 재난재해안전정보, 관공서정보 및 일자리 경제 / 농업 축산 / 환경 산림/ 해양수산 / 복지 정보를 포함하는 각 분야별 필요 정보를 관리하는 관공서 관리시스템(100)과; 상기 관공서 관리시스템(110)으로부터 대기환경정보와, 재난재해안전정보, 관공서정보 및 각 분야별 필요 정보를 수신받아 해당되는 문자메시지와 그 문자메시지와 링크되는 음성 메시지 텍스트를 작성하여 각각 해당되는 정보 수신자의 모바일 단말(300)로 문자메시지와 링크된 음성 메시지를 전송하는 문자 및 음성 안내 서비스 시스템(200)과; 사용자의 모바일 단말(300)에 수신된 문자 및 음성 메시지의 출력과 저장을 관리하는 모바일 단말 메인 콘트롤러(301)와 연동되는 앱 어플리케이션으로 설치되고, 상기 문자 및 음성 안내 서비스 시스템(200)으로부터 수신된 문자 메시지 및 음성 메시지를 해당되는 정보에 따라 식별할 수 있는 푸쉬 알림을 출력함과 아울러 선택된 문자 메시지에 결합된 해당 음성 메시지를 음성으로 출력하는 모바일 단말의 문자 및 음성 안내 서비스 앱(310)을 포함한다.

title_en: The apparatus recognition to operate a every conditions
abstract_en: A recognition apparatus for a deaf driver and a driver who has difficulty in hearing is provided to avoid dangerous states by transmitting visual and tactual signals to eyes and a body of the driver. A plurality of sound sensor units(10) are installed at a front side, a rear side, a left side, and a right side of a vehicle in order to recognize alarm sound at a railroad crossing, siren sound of vehicles, sound of collision, and sound of panic brake. A micom(20) receives audio signals from the sound sensor units and controls a display unit(30) and a vibration unit(40) in order to transmit simultaneously a display signal and a vibration signal to a hearing-impaired driver and a driver who has difficulty in hearing. The display unit includes a plurality of LEDs which are installed at front, rear, left, and right sides of a hands-free and an angular panel. The LEDs of the display are operated in a period of 0.5 to 3 seconds according to a control signal of the micom. The vibration unit includes vibration elements installed at front, rear, left, and right sides of a driver seat in order to generate the vibration according to the control signal of the micom. The LEDs of the display unit are used as a first recognition unit for displaying a level 1 of red color, a level 2 of yellow color, and a level three of blue color according the audio signals of the sound sensor units. The vibration unit is used as a second recognition unit generates the vibration in a period of 0.2 to 0l.8 seconds according to the control signal of the micom.

title_en: A kind of smart window
abstract_en: The utility model is related to and discloses a kind of smart window, including：Window frame, retractable on window frame window page and curtain are arranged on, also included：First controller, flame sensor, air mass sensor, light sensor, photoelectric sensor, first motor, second motor, three-motor and shade rollerl blind shaft, flame sensor, flame sensor, air mass sensor, the input port of light sensor and photoelectric sensor respectively with the first controller is connected, first motor, the output port of second motor and three-motor respectively with the first controller is connected, first motor and the second motor are connected with retractable window page respectively, three-motor connects shade rollerl blind shaft, this smart window, can realize that window improves the living environment of interior automatically, carry out inside fire early warning, winter is avoided to there is the potential safety hazard of gas poisoning, make the life of people more comfortable.

title_en: Fire control remote monitering equipment based on thing networking
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting remote monitoring device based on the Internet of things, which comprises a bottom box, a bending piece, a communication chip, a smoke detection chip, an air suction cylinder, an upper box and a barrier plate, the bottom box is a rectangular box-shaped structure with an opening at the upper part, a plurality of groups of vertical connecting columns which are integrated with the side wall of the bottom box are arranged on the outer side wall of the bottom box, the connecting column is of a hollow structure, the inner wall of the inner space of the connecting column is provided with threads, the bottom of the bottom box is provided with a plurality of groups of fixing pieces with flaky outlines, the fixed sheets are all provided with through holes, the upper part of the bottom box is provided with a baffle plate and an upper box, the bottom box is internally provided with a communication chip, a battery and a smoke detection chip, the battery respectively with communication chip and smog detect chip electric connection, the inside piece that bends that sets up of end box, the piece that bends is aluminum plate integral type structure of bending. This fire control remote monitering equipment based on thing networking, accessible smog triggers the warning, is fit for generally using widely.

title_en: Intelligent cap capable of giving safety early warning
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent cap capable of giving a safety early warning, which comprises a cap body, a control unit, a positioning module, a communication module, a visual sensor, an alarm device and a power supply module, wherein the cap body is provided with a control unit; the control unit, the positioning module, the communication module and the power supply module are all arranged in the cap body, the positioning module, the communication module and the power supply module are all connected with the control unit, and the intelligent cap is connected with an external mobile terminal through the communication module; the visual sensor is arranged at the rear side of the cap body, the alarm device is arranged on the outer surface of the cap body, and the visual sensor and the alarm device are both connected with the control unit. This intelligence cap has the function of safety precaution, urgent contact, real-time location, can monitor the user the condition in the blind area behind one's back, and when abnormal conditions, the intelligence cap sends safety precaution signal, reminds the user in time to react.

title_en: Glasses for night driving
abstract_en: The utility model provides glasses for night driving, which belong to the technical field of glasses, and comprise two glasses frames, lenses, glasses legs and vibrators, wherein the two glasses frames are fixedly connected side by side, the lenses are fixed in the two glasses frames, the outer sides of the two glasses frames are respectively provided with the glasses legs, the tail ends of the glasses legs are fixedly provided with vibrators for reminding, the tail ends of the glasses legs are connected with wires, the other ends of the wires are connected with earphone reminding mechanisms which can be worn in ears, and the wires and the earphone reminding mechanisms can be fixed on the outer side walls of the glasses legs; the two mirror frames are provided with clamping mechanisms which are pulled outwards to clamp the corrective lenses placed in the mirror frames. Glasses wear in driving the in-process, and the vibrator on the accessible mirror leg and the earphone of extension remind the mechanism to realize the warning effect to the driver, wear timely musical reminding behind the earphone to can last the on-hearing function of reminding.

title_en: Hyperspectral-based forest disease early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hyperspectral-based forest disease early warning device which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the side end of the unmanned aerial vehicle is fixedly connected with a protective fence, the lower side of the protective fence is fixedly connected with a supporting column, the hyperspectral-based forest disease early warning device further comprises a lifting mechanism and an auxiliary detection mechanism, the lifting mechanism is arranged on the lower side of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the auxiliary detection mechanism is arranged on the lower side of the lifting mechanism, a hyperspectral-based forest disease early warning device stretches a hyperspectral camera into a branch through a balancing weight, a lifting shell, the balancing weight and a disc, information in the branch can be acquired at a short distance, accuracy and timeliness of insect disaster early warning are improved, and the hyperspectral camera is driven to rotate by the aid of an electric turntable, so that shooting and detection can be carried out on the inside the branch from multiple angles, blind areas detected at a single angle are avoided, data are comprehensively collected, and detection results are more comprehensive.

title_en: A kind of electrical fire monitoring system and its monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of electrical fire monitoring system, including at least one detection module, substation processing module and Central Control Module；Each detection module is provided with unique network address；Detection module is used for the electrical safety parameter in acquisition terminal loop, is additionally operable to electrical safety parameter and predetermined threshold value being compared, and when electrical safety parameter exceedes predetermined threshold value, electrical safety parameter and the network address are sent to substation processing module by detection module；Substation processing module and detection module wireless connection, for the network address translation to be transmitted into Central Control Module into physical location, and by security parameter and physical location；Central Control Module is used to receive electrical safety parameter and physical location, and the information that gives a warning.Electrical fire monitoring system disclosed by the invention, it is possible to increase the accuracy of the Monitoring Data of electrical fire monitoring system, realizes quick positioning optical disaster hidden-trouble position, is easy to exclude electric disaster hidden-trouble rapidly.
assignees: HUNAN YIERSAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent traffic early warning system based on guardrail patrol machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic warning control, and provides an intelligent traffic early warning system based on a guardrail patrol machine, which is used for solving the problem that accidents frequently occur due to the fact that a driver cannot react timely when road foreign matters come in current road traffic; the guardrail patrol machine is used for sending preset early warning information to the background server; the background server is used for issuing a corresponding preset early warning instruction to the acousto-optic early warning system according to the received preset early warning information; and the sound and light early warning system is used for carrying out corresponding sound broadcast early warning and light starting early warning according to the received preset early warning instruction. By adopting the system, the existence of foreign matters in the road can be accurately determined, early warning can be carried out through sound and light, and the occurrence rate of traffic accidents is greatly reduced.

title_en: Anti-collision control early warning method and device, micro control chip and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-collision control early warning method, an anti-collision control early warning device, a micro control chip and a storage medium, which are applied to the technical field of automobile anti-collision and are used for solving the technical problem that a larger potential safety hazard exists when an automobile turns. The anti-collision control early warning method provided by the invention comprises the following steps: receiving a radar trigger signal of an inner wheel difference blind area detected by a Doppler radar; receiving an infrared trigger signal of an inner wheel difference blind area detected by an infrared sensor; when the received radar trigger signal and the infrared trigger signal both meet preset conditions, judging that a life object which has relative motion with the automobile exists in the inner wheel difference blind area; and when a life object which has relative motion with the automobile exists in the inner wheel difference blind area, executing a preset emergency braking strategy. The whole emergency braking process is realized without manual intervention, the whole process is operated in an unconscious state of a driver, and the probability of traffic accidents caused by the dead zone of the inner wheel difference is greatly reduced.

title_en: Lifting operation dangerous source identification method and system based on movable device
abstract_en: The invention provides a lifting operation dangerous source identification method and system based on a movable device, which are used for determining the action state of the lifting device in a first space coordinate system based on lifting action characteristic data of the lifting device, so as to determine the interference area distribution characteristic of the lifting device in the working process, determining the space distribution characteristic of the interference area distribution characteristic in the second space coordinate system based on the relation between a second space coordinate system corresponding to visual acquisition of the movable device and the first space coordinate system, so as to determine the visual acquisition blind area characteristic of the movable device, adjust visual acquisition parameters to obtain lifting action images, effectively reduce blind area interference, and also identifying lifting action images to obtain dangerous source dynamic characteristics in the working area of the lifting device, so as to adjust the working state of the lifting device and/or carry out alarm notification, reduce the dependence of lifting operation on manual safety supervision, realize automatic real-time identification of dangerous sources and effectively avoid lifting operation safety accidents.

title_en: IOT security alleyway signal light
abstract_en: The present invention relates to IoT (Internet of Things) security alleyway signal light. The purpose of the present invention is to prevent the fender-bender between vehicles in the blind spot of a road (alleyway) and a back road and to inform a pedestrian of the presence of the vehicles to assist in safe walking. The present invention notifies of the priority of road (alleyway) intersection passage according to directions from which the vehicles are detected and notifies drivers of the presence or absence (direction) of the vehicles, thereby preventing the fender-bender, and allows pedestrian bottom notification lights (21) to flash on sidewalks in the directions from which the vehicles are detected to notify a pedestrian walking on the sidewalks of the vehicle coming, thereby preventing a pedestrian accident. The present invention can prevent the fender-bender between the vehicles by previously notifying the driver of the presence or absence of the vehicles in the blind spot of the road (alleyway) in which the drive does not know whether a vehicle comes and notifying of the priority of passage. In addition, the safety of the pedestrian can be ensured from an invisible vehicle, and the safety can be ensured through an emergency call button (23) when an emergency situation occurs. Vehicle sensors (20) can collect traffic analysis data for each road, and embedded CCTVs (13) can be used for illegal parking and stopping as well as for crime prevention.
abstract_ko:
1.기술분야/해결과제 
본 발명은 도로(골목길) 및 이면도로의 사각지대에서 차량과 차량의 접촉사고를 미리 방지하고, 보행자에게는 차량의 존재를 알려주어 안전한 보행을 돕기 위한 것이다. 
2. 해결수단 
본 발명은 차량이 감지되는 방향에 따라 도로(골목길) 교차로 통과 우선순위를 알려주고, 차량의 존재 유, 무(방향)를 운전자에게 알려주어 접촉사고를 미리 방지할 수 있다. 
또한, 차량이 감지된 방향의 인도 위에는 보행자 바닥 알림등(21)이 깜빡여 그곳을 걸어오는 보행자에게 차량이 오고 있음을 알려주어 보행자 사고도 방지한다. 
3. 기대효과 
본 발명에 따르면 차량의 진입 여부를 알 수 없는 도로(골목길) 사각지대에서 차량의 존재를 운전자에게 미리 알려 줄 뿐 아니라 통과 우선순위를 알려줌으로써 차량의 접촉사고를 방지할 수 있다. 
또한, 보이지 않는 차량으로부터 보행자의 안전을 확보하고, 위급한 상황이 발생시 긴급호출버튼(23)을 통한 안전을 확보할 수 있다.  
차량감지 센스(20)는 도로별 통행량 분석자료를 모을 수 있으며, 내장된 CCTV(13)는 불법 주·정차단속으로도 활용할 수 있을 뿐 아니라 범죄예방으로도 활용될 수 있다.

title_en: "wearable device for collecting physiological health data"
abstract_en: One or more techniques and/or systems are disclosed for collecting vital physiological health data from a user, using a wearable device, such as a watch. The data can comprise heart rate, blood oxygen, body temperature, blood pressure, and fall detection, amongst other. The collected data can be translated to information presented to the user on a local device, such as a smart phone, and/or provided to a remote device or service and integrated into an electronic medical record, be used by the user's clinicians, and can help detect alert situations of the user. Such a wearable device may also be used to detect user activity, and/or fall detection, and provide emergency alerts to medical and emergency personnel.
assignees: N SQUARED TECH LLC;N SQUARED TECH INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED

title_en: Alert system
abstract_en: An alert system includes centrally-located alarm device and a plurality of handheld remote devices, each remote device storing a unique identification code. Upon a primary depression of an externally-accessible actuation button, a mobile device in direct communication with each remote device transmits a predefined distress message to a predefined emergency responder which can be used to provide immediate assistance. Upon a secondary depression of the actuation button, each remote device transmits a wireless distress signal encoded with its unique identification code that in turn causes the alarm to emit an auditory and visual alarm. An alarm monitoring center is in communication with the alarm device and automatically receives historical data relating to activation of the alarm device, the historical data including, for instance, the identification code of the remote unit responsible for activation of the alarm device as well as the time and date of the transmitted distress signal.

title_en: System and method for universal emergency notification and management
abstract_en: Systems and methods for triggering emergency mass notifications include an EMNS activation service, a plurality of activation premises devices, a plurality of EMNS provider services, and a plurality of event personnel devices. The EMNS activation service includes a universal translator module that receives an event trigger signal relating to an emergency event from one of the activation premises devices. The universal translator module translates the event trigger signal to event-specific EMNS protocols of the EMNS providers. The EMNS activation service communicates the event-specific EMNS protocols to the EMNS providers, and communicates event data to event personnel devices based on a list of event personnel devices to be notified of an emergency event. An activation premises device includes a housing event with trigger controls for creating the event trigger signal, wherein these event trigger controls are inaccessible to users in the absence of an authorized access or an emergency access.

title_en: Intelligent warning device that forest fire prevention was used
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent warning device that forest fire prevention was used, including the loop bar, the bottom of loop bar is provided with supports locating component, the inboard activity of loop bar is pegged graft and is had the extension rod, be provided with transmission lifting unit between extension rod and the loop bar, the top fixed mounting of extension rod has the protecting crust, the inside fixed mounting of protecting crust has the riser. This intelligent warning device that forest fire prevention was used, accessible flue gas measuring apparatu and temperature measurement appearance carry out real-time detection to flue gas concentration and temperature in the forest, when flue gas concentration and temperature surpassed the warning value of settlement, accessible chain start alarm sounds and reports to the police in real time, thereby in time remind relevant forest caregiver in time to take measures, avoid causing the conflagration to enlarge and stretch, simultaneously through the setting of protecting crust and dust screen, can make the inside can switch on with the external world in real time of protecting crust, and play effectual guard action to the device, avoid the device directly to expose and receive the erosion damage in the external world.

title_en: Building falling object intelligent detection and interception system based on CPU
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building falling body intelligent detection and interception system based on a CPU (central processing unit), which comprises a line sensor array, an interception net, a monitoring camera, an audible and visual alarm, a control system and an intelligent terminal, wherein the line sensor array is connected with the interception net; on sensor array, interception net and surveillance camera head located building window outdoor wall, control system connected sensor array, interception net, surveillance camera head and audible-visual annunciator respectively, through sensor array and surveillance camera head with building fall object or invasion foreign matter information transmission to control system, control system control interception net interception is connected the audible-visual annunciator and is reported to the police, accurately detects the object type on mobile terminal, intelligent terminal carries out building fall object and handles. Accurately realize the tracing of falling source. The intelligent detection system can provide real-time and effective intelligent detection, positioning and interception of falling objects for a high-rise system, guarantee the existence of the falling objects and accurate detection and early warning of the positions, and can effectively prevent thieves from invading and throwing objects from high altitude.

title_en: Early warning device for traffic blind area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an early warning device for traffic blind areas, which comprises a mounting disc, wherein a loudspeaker is fixedly arranged on the rear side of the mounting disc, a wide-angle lens is fixedly arranged on the front side of the mounting disc, an early warning lamp belt is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the wide-angle lens, a bottom plate is arranged below the mounting disc, a plurality of threaded sleeves are arranged at the top of the bottom plate, and screw rods are fixedly arranged below the mounting disc and at the bottoms of the threaded sleeves; the utility model carries out early warning on passing vehicles and pedestrians in aspects of vision, hearing and the like through the wide-angle lens, the loudspeaker and the early warning lamp belt, and compared with the traditional passive vision early warning, the striking early warning lamp belt and the loudspeaker can play a better role, and the humidity sensor detects the humidity of the external environment and then the controller controls the electric heating plate to be opened to heat the mirror surface to remove water mist.
assignees: XINJIANG BEIDOU TONGCHUANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster identification and evolution intelligent perception early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster identification and evolution intelligent perception early warning system and a method, belonging to the field of geological disaster monitoring early warning, wherein the intelligent perception early warning system comprises a monitoring perception subsystem, a disaster discrimination subsystem, an intelligent early warning subsystem and an AI disaster relief subsystem, and can realize data information acquisition, preprocessing, storage and transmission of three levels of sky-ground, perform intelligent simulation analysis on data to obtain a risk assessment quantitative index system and risk grade, construct a real-time early warning model according to the risk assessment quantitative index system and the risk grade to obtain a corresponding early warning threshold value, and divide early warning risk grades to perform early warning information push of different grades; and carrying out disaster condition blind estimation intelligent pre-judgment, emergency life line intelligent optimization and intelligent driving robot assisted evacuation according to the early warning information. The intelligent sensing and monitoring system can realize intelligent sensing and monitoring of the geological disaster, and carry out intelligent judgment, identification and early warning on the formation and evolution mechanism of the geological disaster, and carry out intelligent evacuation and rescue in the technical modes of AI artificial intelligence, internet of things and the like.

title_en: Notice system for individual common knowledge of school
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A school announcing system device is provided to enable a simple message which is displayed as a letter and transmission of a learning video material using a display device to be read by being displayed. CONSTITUTION: A class terminal unit(200) is prepared in biographical information, teacher information and a discrete class corresponding to a plurality of multiple class. A DB(110) includes location information of the class terminal unit. A main terminal(120) transmits notifying information including event and schedule to corresponding class terminal by referring DB. A multimedia server(130) transmits result data about a connector request of the class terminal. The multimedia server includes data for transmitting image and voice data among message information. An administration unit consists of the multimedia server.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 학교 또는 학원 등의  공지사항을 학생과 교사에게 효과적으로 전달하기 위한 전달시스템 장치에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 관리자에 의해 다수의 학급 각각에 전달 사항을 효과적으로 제공하고, 개별 학급별, 교사별 또는 학생에 따른 전달 사항을 제공하되 그 형태를 웹사이트, 영상 그리고 문자표시로 분류하여 제공할 수 있으며 특히 개인별 알림 사항을 휴대전화의 단문메세지서비스로 발송할 수 있는 학교 공지시스템 장치에 관한 것이다. 
이에, 다수 학급에 각각에 대응되는 인명정보 및 교사정보 그리고 개별 학급에 마련되는 학급단말부의 위치정보를 포함하는 DB(데이터베이스)와, 상기 DB를 참조하여 해당 학급단말부에 학교의 행사나 일정을 포함하는 공지사항 정보를 전송하며 상기 학급단말부의 접속자 요청에 대한 결과 데이터를 전송하는 메인단말기와, 상기 공지사항 정보 중 영상과 음성 데이터의 전송을 위한 데이터를 포함하는 멀티미디어서버로 이루어지는 관리부와; 상기 관리부로 공지사항 정보를 전송받아 출력형태에 따라 웹(web) 데이터, 영상 및 음성 데이터, 문자 데이터로 분류하는 단말관리기와, 상기 웹 데이터를 전송받아 포함된 웹 브라우저(web browser)로 번역하여 표시하는 교사단말기 및 학생단말기와, 상기 영상 및 음성 데이터를 전송받아 표시하는 디스플레이장치와, 상기 문자 데이터를 전송받아 문자열로 표시하는 문자표시장치로 이루어지며, 유무선 통신망으로 상기 관리부와 연결되는 다수의 학급단말부와; 상기 관리부의 공지사항 정보 중 상기 문자 데이터를 전송받아 휴대전화에 단문메세지서비스(SMS;short message service)를 발송하되, 상기 휴대전화의 정보는 상기 DB를 참조하는 단문메세지서비스(SMS) 발송서버;를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 학교 공지시스템 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Ship fire monitoring system using drones
title_ko: 드론을 활용한 선박 화재 감시 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a ship fire surveillance system using a drone. A ship fire surveillance system using a drone includes: an access point; a plurality of drones that fly over blind spots of multiple CCTV cameras in an autonomous ship and perform filming to create images of the blind spots; an alarm generator that generates audible and visual fire alarms; and a controller that performs communication with multiple drones through the access point, sets flight paths of multiple drones so that multiple drones fly over blind spots and perform filming to acquire images of the blind spots, determines whether a fire has occurred through image analysis of the acquired images of the blind spots, and controls the alarm generator to generate a fire alarm if it is determined that a fire has occurred.
abstract_ko: 드론을 활용한 선박 화재 감시 시스템이 개시된다. 드론을 활용한 선박 화재 감시 시스템은, 액세스 포인트, 자율운항선박 내에서 복수의 CCTV 카메라의 사각지역을 비행하면서 촬영을 수행하여 사각지역 영상을 생성하는 복수의 드론, 화재경보를 청각적 및 시각적으로 발생시키는 경보 발생기 및 액세스 포인트를 통해 복수의 드론과 통신을 수행하고, 복수의 드론이 사각지역을 비행하면서 촬영을 수행하도록 복수의 드론의 비행경로를 설정하여 사각지역 영상을 획득하고, 획득된 사각지역 영상에 대한 영상분석을 통해 화재발생 여부를 판단하고, 판단 결과, 화재가 발생한 것으로 판단한 경우, 경보 발생기가 화재경보를 발생시키도록 제어하는 제어기를 포함한다.

title_en: Alert broadcasting to a plurality of diverse communications devices
abstract_en: A system for the broadcast of alert messages to selected groups of recipients and their communications devices of a plurality of different types and communicating through a plurality of different communications means. Recipient profiles or characteristics are received variously from databases, directories, and communications nodes accessible by the system. These sources are queried for the identification of selectable groups which are then presented to a dispatcher for choosing the recipients. The alert message is then provided to delivery means which employ a plurality of included means each of which is particularly configured to communicate the alert message to a corresponding target device type. A response handler module then receives responses from the target devices for later reporting.

title_en: Emergency notification, access control, and monitoring systems and methods
abstract_en: The present invention is related to systems and methods for identifying and reporting a crisis status. In at least one embodiment, the system comprises a central server; an administrative work station communicably coupled to the central server, wherein the administrative work station is accessible only by an authorized administrator; a database communicably coupled to the central server, the database including a floor plan of the area, wherein the database is accessible and modifiable by the authorized administrator at the administrative work station; and a remote device at a particular location in the area, the remote device communicably coupled to the central server, the remote device capable of communicating securely to the database the particular location of the remote device and the crisis status of the particular location.

title_en: Emergency notification, activity notification, and suspicious movement detection for mobile devices
abstract_en: Foreign emergency notification, activity notification, and suspicious movement detection for mobile devices are disclosed. An application running on a mobile device of a user may be used to automatically detect when a call is made to emergency services in a foreign country, when an issue or unpermitted behavior may be occurring, when the mobile device has moved to an anomalous or unpermitted location and/or is moving with an unexpected speed, etc. The application then notifies family members and/or other contacts in the user's home country via a domestic carrier network. An over-the-top Internet Protocol (IP) message can be sent by the application on the mobile device back to the home network core.

title_en: Distributed healthcare communication system
abstract_en: A graphical audio station of a nurse call system is operable to permit a user to perform one or more of the following functions: establish a two-way voice communication link with another computer device in another patient and/or with a another computer device located in another staff work area and/or with a wireless communication device carried by caregiver and/or with a telephone of the healthcare facility; broadcast a voice page to a group of other selected computer devices; compose and send a text message to a portable device that is carried by a caregiver and that has wireless communication capability; browse web pages and/or view multimedia content, such as videos, hosted on servers of the healthcare facility and/or that are accessible via the Internet; view and/or acknowledge and/or answer and/or cancel alerts or nurse calls originating in a plurality of patient rooms.

title_en: Detecting Apparatus Capable of Detecting Foreign Materials for Extruder
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an extruder comprising: an extruding unit, a kneading block and a screw, a resin discharging unit, and a seal box. The extruding unit includes a hopper in an upper part of one side and is horizontally combined with a plurality of feed barrels. The kneading block and the screw are mounted inside the extruding unit, are driven and rotated by a motor (not shown), and mix and extrude resin. The resin discharging unit is formed in one side of the extruding unit. The seal box is formed in the other side of the extruding unit. According to the present invention, a foreign substance sensing device for an extruder is provided with a vibration sensing sensor mounted on a lower part of a body of a feed barrel with a screw embedded therein adjacent to a feed barrel with the kneading block embedded therein. The foreign substance sensing device for an extruder informs an alarm to a worker with light and sounds by a control unit, and stops driving of the extruder when a vibration frequency measured from the vibration sensing sensor is higher than a vibration frequency of an extruder normal driving state which is set in advance. The present invention extrudes the resin by using the extruder, and rapidly finds and removes foreign substances inside the extruder with a simple structure, which are wrongly received with the resin. Therefore, the present invention can prevent damage of the extruder, minimize downtime, and be manufactured with relative low costs.

title_en: Surveillance and Security Communications Platform
abstract_en: A surveillance and security communications platform for detecting and responding to potential emergencies is provided. The platform may be utilized to automatically open communications channels via multiple media streams based on predefined settings for detecting a potential emergency situation. The platform may further be utilized to automatically send video and audio streams to an emergency responder upon detecting the potential emergency situation. The platform may further be utilized to detect the potential emergency situation while it is occurring and automatically initiate escalated emergency notifications to multiple parties. The platform may further be utilized to receive computing device sensor data for detecting the potential emergency for a potential victim in a business or home setting and immediately send an emergency notification, which may include a predefined text-to-speech announcement, to emergency responders in order to mitigate the potential emergency.

title_en: Boiler tube leakage monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a boiler pipe leakage monitoring device. The boiler comprises a boiler body, the boiler body is including being located the cold ash bucket of boiler body lower part, be located the dog-ear flame angle of upper portion and being located the big package of furnace top at boiler body top in the boiler body, install a plurality of monitoring points that are used for monitoring the boiler tube and leak on the boiler body, the monitoring point is installed including the symmetry monitoring point A and the monitoring point B of cold ash bucket department install the monitoring point C in dog-ear flame angular position, and install monitoring point E and the monitoring point F of big package department of furnace top. The monitoring point is a sound wave sensor, and a probe of the monitoring point penetrates through the furnace wall shell to be fixed on the furnace wall and is in sealing fit with the furnace wall. An object of the utility model is to provide a boiler pipe leakage monitoring device for the monitoring point effectively covers the hidden danger position of easily neglecting, and the early warning eliminates the monitoring blind area in advance.

title_en: Indoor fire cellphone warning system and method based on GNSS (global navigation satellite system)
abstract_en: The invention designs and develops an indoor fire cellphone warning method based on GNSS (global navigation satellite system); as a cellphone is used as a warning information receiving table and is universal, the problem that no fire warning system is provided in some old buildings is solved, 119 firefighting command center is used as a warning information transmitting platform which is uniform and convenient to maintain, long-term normal operation of the platform can be guaranteed, and the problem that an existing disperse fire warning system is unable to normally run due to improper management; a specific location of a fire can be disclosed to people, and unnecessary blind escape due to is avoided.

title_en: Solvent recovery appratus with auto fire fighting safety device
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An organic solvent collecting device with an automatic fire safety equipment is provided to fundamentally prevent a fire by injecting inert gas before reaching temperature and concentration causing the fire. CONSTITUTION: A case(10) supplies a sealed inner space. A drying drum(12) rotates while storing laundry in the case. A filter unit(14) removes foreign substances included in air discharged from the drying drum. A condensing unit(18) condenses volatile organic solvent included in the air passing through the filter unit. A temperature sensor(20) is installed in the case to measure temperature. abstract_ko:
본 발명이 해결하려는 과제는 유기용제 회수장치 내의 온도와 휘발성 유기화합물의 농도값을 측정하고, 화재가 발생할 수 있는 온도 및 농도에 도달하기 전에 불활성가스를 주입하여 화재를 원천적으로 예방할 수 있는 자동소화 안전장비를 구비한 유기용제 회수장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 주요구성은 밀폐된 내부공간을 제공하는 케이스(10)와, 케이스(10)의 내부에서 세탁물을 수용하며 회전하는 건조드럼(12)과, 건조드럼(12)에서 배출된 공기에 포함된 이물질을 제거하는 필터부(14)와, 필터부(14)를 통과한 공기에 함유된 휘발성 유기용제를 응축시키는 응축부(18)를 구비하며, 케이스(10) 내부에 설치되어 온도를 측정하는 온도센서(20) 및 휘발성 유기화합물의 농도를 측정하는 농도센서(22)와, 온도센서(20), 농도센서(22)에서 측정된 온도정보와 농도정보를 제공받아 기 저장된 화재예방기준값에 해당되는 지를 비교하여 화재예방신호를 발생시키는 제어부(26)와, 제어부(26)에서 발생된 화재예방신호에 따라 불활성 기체를 케이스(10) 내부에 공급하는 화재예방부(27)로 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A notification equipment for the blind
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A notification device for a road reflector for the blind is provided to enable the blind to recognize the approach of a vehicle by an auditory signal and to notify a driver of the walk of the blind by a warning light. CONSTITUTION: A notification device for a road reflector for the blind comprises a sensing unit(11), a control unit(12), an acoustic unit(13), and a light emitting unit(14). The sensing unit recognizes an RFID(Radio Frequency Identification) tag for the blind(20) for sensing the walk of the blind and produces a sensing signal by sensing the approach of a vehicle(30). The acoustic unit produces an auditory warning signal. The light emitting unit operates a warning lamp. [Reference numerals] (11) Sensing unit; (12) Control unit; (13) Acoustic unit; (14) Light emitting unit; (20) Disabled person(Wireless identification tag); (30) Vehicle;

title_en: Network-Based System for Predicting Landslides and Providing Early Warnings
abstract_en: A wireless node for monitoring landslide conditions has at least one tubular probe body deployed in a borehole in a landslide prone area and anchored to rock below soil, multiple sensors carried by and deployed within and or outside of the tubular probe body for measuring geologic motion and hydrologic saturation and pressure at three or more distinct levels of soil above the rock, a power source, a data acquisition board in communication with the sensors carried by and or deployed within or outside of the probe body, and a wireless transceiver in communication with the data acquisition board and accessible to a local area wireless network (LAWN), which is in turn accessible to a wide area wireless network (WAWN). Geologic and hydrologic data of at least three separate layers of soil above the anchor rock is collected in real time from the sensors deployed on or near the probe body, the data qualified against threshold readings in three or more stages to provide graduating levels of alerts culminating in a warning of an impending landslide.

title_en: Service decision device and method based on environment elements
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a service decision device and method based on environmental elements, wherein the service decision device includes: the terminal support subsystem is configured to perform data interaction with the server-side equipment, acquire environment monitoring information, send the analyzed environment monitoring information to the server-side equipment, enable the server-side equipment to determine influence factors of a strategy pool corresponding to a service scene, corresponding to the environment monitoring information, and determine service decision information according to the environment monitoring information and the influence factors; and receiving service decision information fed back by the server side equipment. Through the embodiment of the disclosure, the pertinence and the reliability of the meteorological service of remote areas are improved, the method is widely applied to the work of guaranteeing local major activities by meteorological service organizations in various areas, the problem of blind areas of meteorological observation data of areas without meteorological observation stations is solved, and powerful support is provided for natural disaster early warning decision.

title_en: Universal configuration, control and monitoring of disparate devices via an SAAS interface and mobile application
abstract_en: A monitoring, control and configuration system that includes a local system, a mobile device application, and a server that is accessible by users via the mobile device application and a Software as a Service (SaaS) interface via a browser is disclosed. The local system contains a microprocessor, communications components and related software all of which enable communications with the server and external components coupled with the local system. The local system software and server software combine with the mobile application and website interface to enable a user to monitor, configure, and control external devices coupled with the local system and the local system itself via the server. The system replaces multiple disparate control devices with a single, configurable device and system. The system integrates multiple disparate devices and systems from multiple manufacturers. title_en: Wireless power system with foreign object detection

The wireless power transmitting device may be a wireless charging mat or other device with a charging surface. The wireless power receiving device may be a portable electronic device receiving transmitted wireless power signals from the wireless power transmitting device while resting on the charging surface. During digital ping operations, low-power wireless power signals may be transmitted from the wireless power transmitting device. title_en: Methods and systems for expanding language set for wireless emergency alerting
abstract_en: Methods and systems for expanding language set for wireless emergency alerting are described herein. The computer system may determine a target area that the alert is to be broadcasted. Based on a penetration of speakers with first language other than English and Spanish, the computer system may determine a third language to broadcast the alert. In some examples, the computer system may include a link to the translation of the alert in the third language in the English and Spanish language alerts. In some other examples, the computer system may send a separate alert to the English and Spanish language alerts. The separate alert may include a link to a resource that allows the alert recipient to obtain a translation of the alert.

title_en: Security related systems and methods

To assist in the detection of emergencies, security camera output is assessed using AI based methods. If an emergency is detected, the security camera output is forwarded to a human assessor for confirmation. Once the emergency is confirmed, access to the security cameras is forwarded to emergency services to provide them with a live feed at the emergency location. To alert the public of such emergencies, a mobile app can provide notifications of such emergencies. The app uses a server that acquires data from multiple sources and analyzes the data to detect emergencies. 본 고안은 청각장애인용 알림 장치에 관한 것으로서, 특히, 초인종, 팩스, 화재경보 신호 및 보일러 이상유무를 감지하여 각각의 알림신호가 발생되는 신호발생유닛과, 신호발생유닛에서 인식된 알림신호를 송신하는 송신유닛과, 송신유닛에서 송신된 알림신호를 수신하는 수신유닛과, 실내의 청각장애인이 인식하도록 수신된 신호를 표시하는 디스플레이유닛 및, 신호발생유닛, 송신유닛, 수신유닛 및 디스플레이유닛을 제어하기 위한 제어유닛을 포함하고, 디스플레이유닛은 "초인종" 글자를 표시하는 램프가 구비되는 초인종알림표시부와, "팩스" 글자를 표시하는 램프가 구비되는 팩스표시부와, "보일러 이상" 글자를 표시하는 램프가 구비되는 보일러고장표시부 및, "화재경보" 글자를 표시하는 램프가 구비되는 화재경보표시부를 포함하는 구성으로, 실내에 거주하던 청각장애인들이 이들 신호를 신속하게 인지하여 상황에 맞는 대처를 효과적으로 할 수 있는 특징이 있다.

title_en: Blind area early warning braking system based on inertial device perception vehicle right turn motion characteristic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blind area early warning braking system for sensing the motion characteristic of the right turn of a vehicle based on an inertial device, which is characterized in that the motion characteristic of the right turn of the vehicle is collected based on a vehicle attitude sensor, and the traveling attitude of the vehicle is calculated to distinguish the radius of the right turn and the range of related blind areas; meanwhile, monitoring pedestrians/vehicles near the vehicle head and on the right side of the vehicle body based on the intelligent optical + radar; measuring and calculating the relative distance and azimuth angle between the pedestrian and the vehicle from the vehicle body in real time; the core control unit calculates and calculates the intersection point of the direction of the target and the vehicle body and the vehicle running track so as to make early warning braking operation; the invention can avoid the occurrence of a malignant safety accident when a large carrying vehicle has a large right-turning blind area, can actively identify and actively prevent the generation of danger, and warns the final early warning brake operation at the dangerous moment.
assignees: RACO ZHITU BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Early warning system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based early warning system which comprises a central processing system, wherein the output end of the central processing system is electrically connected with the input end of a marking unit through a lead, the output end of the marking unit is electrically connected with the input end of a gas leakage sensor through a lead, the gas leakage sensor is in bidirectional connection with a real-time monitoring module through wireless, and the output end of the real-time monitoring module is electrically connected with the input end of a mark reading module through a lead. This early warning system based on artificial intelligence can realize carrying out the serial number mark to a plurality of gas leakage sensors to place and carry out gas monitoring in the different junctions of pipeline, avoid appearing the problem of gas leakage, register the storage to the concrete position that every sensor was placed simultaneously, when gas leakage appears, accessible time early warning and help the maintenance personal in time inquire concrete position, greatly reduced the potential safety hazard.

title_en: Laser external damage prevention method and device for power transmission channel
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for preventing external damage of a power transmission channel by laser, wherein the method comprises the following steps: scanning a power transmission line and the surrounding environment by using a laser radar to obtain a comparison three-dimensional point cloud, and storing the comparison three-dimensional point cloud; acquiring a first image of the power transmission line and a surrounding environment by using a camera; detecting whether a foreign object exists in the first image; determining a first distance between the foreign object and the power transmission line according to the comparison three-dimensional point cloud and the first image; and when the first distance is smaller than a preset threshold value, sending out alarm information. The invention effectively improves the running reliability of the power grid, overcomes the defects of the traditional external damage prevention measures, truly improves the external damage prevention working quality effect of the power line, suppresses external damage accidents caused by human factors and ensures the safe running of the power grid. The method for real-time monitoring and early warning can effectively prevent and reduce the occurrence of accidents on hidden danger of the power transmission line, and further improves the safety and stability of the power system.
assignees: YANGZHOU JIANGDU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Binary all-solid-state navigation radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of radar systems, and discloses a double-system all-solid-state navigation radar. The invention comprises an antenna base turntable, a low-profile waveguide slot antenna, a servo unit, a power supply unit, a radio frequency switching unit, a pulse receiving and transmitting unit, a continuous wave receiving and transmitting unit, a main control unit and a display control terminal. The invention utilizes the design of an all-solid-state and all-phase-coherent dual-system radar system, overcomes the inherent technical defects of the traditional magnetron monopulse system and the single-solid-system marine radar, integrates the technical advantages of a pulse compression system and a linear frequency modulation continuous wave system, improves the radar performance, integrates more abundant functions, and can meet the use requirements of modern ships in application scenes such as open sea navigation, narrow water passage, port entry and exit, search and rescue, collision early warning, panoramic blind compensation and the like.

title_en: System for providing location alerts relating to emergencies
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for generating alerts communicated to emergency responders and/or contacts indicating a location of an incident. The system comprises a housing, one or more light sources, and a computing processor. A switch is located in the housing and configured to be accessible to a user. When the switch is actuated by a user indicating an incident, the processor provides power to the at least one light source to output light from the housing thereby indicating the location of the system. The system may also control a speaker to output an audible signal and a transmitter to transmit an emergency signal with location information to a device of an emergency responder and/or an emergency contact. The present invention may also be embodied in a software application that is implemented on a mobile device to thereby leverage the components of the mobile device to send alerts.

title_en: Testing apparatus for fire warning
abstract_en: A fire detector checking device is provided to check the performance and defect of a fire detector without using a ladder by installing a device for injecting smoke or setting operation temperature conditions of the fire detector, on the front end of a multiple-stage foldable pipe. A fire detector checking device(100) is composed of a support pipe(160) fixed and connected to the tip of an insulating cover(110) and inserted with a power line(122) supplying operating power to a heater(120); a foldable pipe(170) connected to the support pipe and extended or contracted; a power socket(180) disposed at the lower end of the foldable pipe and connected to an external commercial power source; an operating unit(190) installed at the lower side of the foldable pipe to control the operation of the heater; a burned material support plate(125) formed at the upper part of the heater adjacent to an opening of the insulating cover to prevent the inflow of foreign materials; a suction pipe(145) disposed at the outside of the insulating cover and connected to the inside of the insulating cover; a suction fan(140) sucking in the inner smoke of the insulating cover through the suction pipe; and a discharge pipe(150) discharging the sucked smoke to the outside. The fire detector checking device is engaged with the support pipe in an uneven form to adjust the inclination angle of the foldable pipe and rotated about a fixing bolt(165) to easily regulate the angle of the opening of the insulating cover.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재감지기 점검장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 천장 등에 장착되어 있는 화재감지기의 성능 및 고장여부를 용이하게 점검할 수 있도록 하여 화재발생시 신뢰적으로 경보를 하여 인명피해를 미연에 방지할 수 있는 화재감지기 점검장치에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 화재감지기가 장착되는 장착면에 밀착되어 상기 화재감지기를 수용하기 위한 종형상의 절연커버와, 상기 절연커버 내부에 코일상으로 장착되는 히터와, 상기 히터의 온도를 감지하게 위한 온도센서를 포함하는 화재감지기 점검장치에 있어서,  상기 절연커버(110)의 첨두에 고정되어 연결되고 내부에 상기 히터(120)에 동작전원을 공급하기 위한 전원선(122)이 삽입되는 지지파이프(160)와, 상기 지지파이프(160)와 연결되어 신장 또는 수축이 가능한 접이식파이프(170)와, 상기 접이식파이프(170)의 하단부에 외부의 상용전원과 연결되기 위한 전원소켓(180)과, 상기 히터(120)의 동작을 제어하기 위해 상기 접이식파이프(170)의 하부에 장착되는 조작부(190)를 포함하여 구성되되, 상기 지지파이프(160)에 상기 접이식파이프(170)와의 기울기를 조절하기 위해 요철(凹凸)형상으로 맞물려 고정볼트(165)를 축으로 회전되어 상기 절연커버(110)의 개구부의 각도를 용이하게 조절하도록 구성되고, 상기 절연커버(110)의 개구부에 인접된 히터(120)의 상부에는 외부의 이물질이 투입을 방지하도록 연소물받침판(125)이 형성되며, 상기 절연커버(110)의 외측에 상기 절연커버(110)의 내부와 관통되게 연결되는 흡입관(145)과, 상기 흡입관(145)를 통해 절연커버(110)의 내측의 연기를 흡입하기 위한 흡입팬(140)과, 상기 흡입된 연기를 외부로 배출하기 위한 배출관(150)을 더 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Evacuation information guide system and method with impartation function of fire located and evacuation
title_ko: 화재발생위치 및 대피방향 알림기능을 갖는 대피정보안내시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: Evacuation information guide system and method are provided to enable users to safely and rapidly evacuate. CONSTITUTION: An evacuation information guide system(200) comprises a detection sensor(210), a detected signal input module(220), a detected signal determining module(230), an output control module(240), and an evacuation data guide module(250). The detection sensor senses smoke or fire and outputs a sensing signal. The detected signal input module receives the sensing signal outputted in the detection sensor. The detected signal determining module receives the sensing signal received to the detected signal input module, analyzes the sensing signal, and determines originating site and scale of the corresponding fire. The output control module generates an inter-layer evacuation control signal. The evacuation data guide module outputs evacuation information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재발생위치 및 대피방향 알림기능을 갖는 대피정보안내시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 대피정보안내장치를 통해 건물의 각 층별 또는 층간별 현재 위치에 대하여 해당 화재가 발생한 위치의 상대정보를 알려주도록 함으로써, 화재가 발생한 위치로부터 안전하고 신속하게 벗어날 수 있도록 하기 위한 것이다.  또한, 본 발명은 해당 건축물의 구조적 특징에 따라 설정된 대피로에 대응하여 각 층별 또는 층간별 이동방향을 알려줌으로써, 보다 안전하고 신속한 대피가 이루어질 수 있도록 한다.  더불어, 시각장애인에게도 정확한 상대정보를 제공할 수 있음은 물론, 해당 상대정보를 단문 또는 단어 중 적어도 하나의 문자형태로 제공함으로써, 대피자들의 신속하고 정확한 판단이 가능하도록 할 수 있다. 따라서, 위급상황시 대피를 유도하는 시스템, 방법 및 장치를 제공하는 분야에서 신뢰성 및 경쟁력을 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of warning sign of the municipal construction with safety prompting function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of warning sign of the municipal construction of technical field of municipal construction with safety prompting function, including supporting shaft, the upper end of support shaft is socketed with sliding sleeve, the outer wall of sliding sleeve is symmetrically welded with rectangle card slot about its axle center, the inner cavity of rectangle card slot is fixed with fixed frame by screw, the inner cavity of fixed frame is inlaid with warning panel, the lower end of sliding sleeve is socketed with stop sleeve, the outer wall of stop sleeve is equipped with positioning screw, the utility model passes through the eccentric axial symmetric design by warning panel about sliding sleeve, the warning alert mark of multiple angles is provided, reduce because warning blind area and caused by safety accident, sliding sleeve can be in the outer wall rotation of support shaft simultaneously, when external wind blows to warning panel, windage can be reduced by rotation, reduction causes to warn because of brushing for wind Showing device topples over phenomenon.

title_en: Radar and video fusion intelligent warning system based on structured light blind compensation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a radar and video fusion intelligence warning system based on structural light mends blind, including the target detection unit, the control unit and the alarm unit who connect gradually, the target detection unit includes video acquisition module, radar module and the blind module of structural light mends, and the blind module of structural light mends the blind module to blind area transmission structural light and gathers the reflected structural light, and the blind area is the region that video acquisition module, radar module can not cover in the target warning region. The utility model discloses simple structure, can realize that no blind area intelligence is alert, and advantage such as with low costs, adaptability and scalability are good.

title_en: Height limiting frame early warning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses height-limiting frame early warning equipment, which comprises a steel frame; an early warning mechanism is installed on one side inside the steel frame, and a recording mechanism is installed on the other side inside the steel frame; the early warning mechanism includes infrared smart light range finding radar, voice broadcast ware and warning sign, infrared smart light range finding radar is installed in the positive both sides of steelframe. The utility model discloses a set up early warning mechanism, in later use, when infrared highlight range radar in the early warning mechanism detects the vehicle superelevation that the place ahead was gone, can send the signal of telecommunication to the control box, the control box can control voice broadcast ware and scintillation lamp ring and carry out work simultaneously this moment, the driver's of can attracting of scintillation lamp ring sight, make the driver discover the limit for height sign on the warning sign more easily, voice broadcast ware accessible sound's form simultaneously, more direct warning driver, make the driver can in time discover the limit for height sign, and then in time re-course and go, consequently, can make the early warning effect of this device more ideal.

title_en: Circuit low-voltage early warning protection device
abstract_en: A kind of circuit low-voltage early warning protective device, in the field of low-voltage system technology, in order to solve the traditional mode to rely on the megger detection mode to examine the insulation when the apparatus of the low-voltage system has power failure, there is detection blind area that the low-voltage electric equipment is aged, can't monitor and discern the question of the hidden danger of insulating aging dynamically on line, preassemble the drain pan as the external support, in order to connect to the electricity distribution cabinet steadily, assemble protective housing and monitoring device through preassembling the drain pan, the insulating board of the hard plastic material set up outside plays a protective effect to the monitoring device; the detected data is compared with threshold information set in the chip U1, and when the detected data exceeds the threshold range, the chip U1 controls an alarm to give an alarm for prompting.
assignees: NAT ENERGY CHENGDU JINTANG POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: House construction safety alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a house construction safety alarm device, including the warning case, controller and smoke sensor, be provided with the roof directly over the warning case, the last fixed surface of roof is connected with solar panel, the last fixed surface of warning case is connected with the light, and be the light-operated lamp at the light, the front side of warning case is connected with temperature sensor and control panel, the inside rear side of warning case is by last fixedly connected with controller in proper order down, smoke sensor and battery, the inside front side fixedly connected with bee calling organ of warning case, the inside bottom fixedly connected with header tank of warning case. The utility model discloses a solar panel can convert solar radiation into the electric energy to can practice thrift the electric energy, can collect the rainwater through the water catch bowl, thereby make rainwater accessible siphunculus flow in the header tank and use, make the water more environmental protection, can spout the water in the header tank through the shower nozzle, thereby reach the effect of cooling, through temperature sensor detectable actual temperature.
