title_en: Gas leakage monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of gas leakage monitoring, in particular to a gas leakage monitoring and early warning device, which comprises a charging base, wherein a monitor shell is clamped on the charging base, buzzers are arranged at the bottoms of the left side and the right side of the monitor shell, coherent alarm lamps are arranged at the front end of the top of the monitor shell and the top positions of the left side and the right side of the monitor shell, and a self-priming pump, a gas sensor and a storage battery are sequentially arranged in the monitor shell from top to bottom; this gas leakage monitoring early warning device inhales through the self priming pump, it is gaseous discernment through gas sensor, detect and leak then bee calling organ and warning light start and carry out the early warning, the battery can provide the condition of wireless operation for equipment, insert back charging base accessible charging plug with equipment and continuously supply power to equipment, this design has changed traditional gas monitoring equipment and has needed the switch on use and can't place the shortcoming of use alone, it is convenient for continuously switch over between the monitoring at the removal monitoring and the fixed point.

title_en: Fireproof partition board of air conditioner heat pump
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fireproof partition board of an air conditioner heat pump, which belongs to the technical field of fireproof partition boards and mainly aims at the problem of lower safety of the traditional fireproof partition boards, and the fireproof partition board comprises a partition board main body, wherein a first fireproof board is arranged at one end of the partition board main body, an audible and visual alarm is arranged at one side of the partition board main body, a fireproof box is arranged on the inner side surface of the bottom of the partition board main body, a control module is arranged in the fireproof box, a wireless communication module is arranged at one side of the control module, a digital infrared temperature sensor and a smoke sensor are arranged at one side of the wireless communication module, and a buffer assembly is arranged at one side of the partition board main body; through the setting of digital infrared temperature sensor and smoke transducer, can detect the temperature of air conditioner heat pump and whether fire produces smog to among the accessible signal of telecommunication's the mode sent control module, control module can handle it and judge, and when the fire, audible and visual alarm can carry out closely warning and remind, and wireless communication module can carry out the long-range warning to the user.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN ZHONGWANG HARDWARE ELECTRIC APPLIANCE CO LTD

title_en: Geological calamity rainfall monitoring prealarmer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a geological disaster rainfall monitoring early-warning instrument which is applied to the weather early-warning of geological disaster and can prevent dust and blocking with simple operation. The invention is characterized in that the geological disaster rainfall monitoring and the early-warning are organically combined together, and the early-warning of geological disaster is carried through according to the actual measured rainfall monitoring value. The value of the rainfall is observed via the reading of the liquid surface, and the rainfall intension is monitored via a triangular weir. Foreign matters are prevented to enter a rain bearing mouth to block the pipeline via a steel mesh, and the dust remnant can be prevented via a water discharging device. The instrument has the advantages of simple structure and easy maintenance, the invention is flexible and cheap. The instrument can be used for cluster monitoring and cluster preventing of geological disasters, thereby is suitable for generalization in large scale.

title_en: Time division multiple access technology-based communication system for transmitting air situation and disaster situation early warning information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time division multiple access (TDMA) technology-based communication system for transmitting air situation and disaster situation early warning information. In the system, early warning information of various types of alarms such as air defense, disaster prevention and the like is transmitted by using the TDMA technology and a distributed network topological structure; meanwhile, message communication, data communication and acoustic code word communication are performed; and alarm information covers areas such as buildings, pits, tunnels, underground stores and the like by using various alarm information transmission technologies. The aims of quickly and reliably transmitting and returning various types of early warning information, reporting the various types of alarm information and transmitting various types of service are fulfilled. The system has the function of quickly transmitting and distributing the various types of early warning information such as air defense, flood defense, shock resistance, fire prevention, flood discharge and the like, and can realize quick and accurate information transmission and all-around coverage of the alarm information, so that the alarms are reported without miss points or blind points, and real-time property, accuracy, high efficiency and all-around property of a civil air defense alarm are improved.

title_en: Method for assisting visually impaired people to walk crosswalk line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic signal control, in particular to a method for assisting visually impaired people to walk through a crosswalk line. The data processing terminal is used for receiving real-time motion data acquired by the 360-degree thermal imaging holder and the laser radar. Under the effect of the control signal sent by the data processing terminal, the road warning screen can remind a driver to pay attention to visually impaired people by means of displaying text contents in real time, the voice broadcasting equipment can remind the driver to pay attention to visually impaired people by means of real-time voice broadcasting contents, and the visually impaired people know that the voice broadcasting equipment is located in a pedestrian crosswalk line area according to the voice broadcasting content. Therefore, on one hand, the technology conversion from ' people's air defense ' to ' technical defense ' is realized, the problem that people with vision impairment safely pass through crosswalk lines is solved, the technology can be widely applied to crosswalk line scenes with poor street-crossing vision distance, the visual defect of people is made up by ' technical defense ', and on the other hand, people with vision impairment can be intelligently screened out and tracked in real time.
assignees: CCDI SUZHOU EXPLOR & DESIGN CONSULTANT CO LTD

title_en: Anti-seismic monitoring method and system for server cabinet
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake-proof monitoring method and system for a server cabinet, which relate to the technical field of earthquake-proof monitoring, and are characterized in that an electronic map of the layout of the server cabinet in a data center is obtained in advance, a multi-mode vibration sensor and a noise reference sensor are distributed in key stress nodes and surrounding environments of the cabinet, vibration signals and environmental noise signals are processed through blind source separation and self-adaptive noise reduction algorithms, so that a noise suppression coefficient Nsc and a comparison signal quality threshold Nth are calculated to confirm data effectiveness, effective data are decomposed through multi-scale time-frequency, an image neural network classification model is utilized to output an earthquake-proof event confidence level Cev, a comprehensive earthquake risk index SRI is further calculated, when the comprehensive earthquake risk index SRI reaches a preset risk threshold Tth, early warning and emergency response measures are triggered, the system further uploads data to a cloud database through an edge gateway to support retraining and large data analysis, and the earthquake-proof capacity of the cabinet is optimized, and planning and enhanced.

title_en: Tornado induced high-speed rail foreign matter risk early warning method integrating multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tornado-induced high-speed rail foreign matter risk early warning method integrating multi-source data. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining and preprocessing multi-source data, further carrying out macro-, medium-and micro-scale vortex decomposition based on the cyclone vortex horizontal diameter, adopting a gating fusion mechanism to adaptively weight and extract fusion feature vectors, then calculating five risk factors of public early warning, cyclone probability, track invasion and overhead contact system hanging, introducing a fractional order collision model to accurately describe a nonlinear rebound process after foreign matters collide with the overhead contact system, and finally carrying out optimization solution on the constructed Hamiltonian quantity containing fitting items and space-time smoothing items through a quantum annealing algorithm, and outputting a global early warning grade which is smooth and optimal in time and space. The method solves the problems of low early warning precision and high false alarm rate of the traditional method, and remarkably improves the accuracy and reliability of the high-speed rail operation safety early warning.
assignees: HUAFENG METEOROLOGICAL MEDIA GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Underground parking lot fire prevention and control treatment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire prevention and control treatment method and a fire prevention and control treatment system for an underground parking garage, comprising the following steps: collecting fire disaster characteristic parameters of a parking lot based on a fixed detection network; the method comprises the steps of collecting fire characteristic parameters of a parking lot, identifying fire abnormality based on the collected fire characteristic parameters of the parking lot, generating an early warning signal containing an early warning area, dynamically rechecking the early warning area based on the early warning signal to judge the authenticity of fire and confirm the position of the fire, executing fire extinguishing operation based on the position of the fire, and moving a damaged vehicle to a safe area after the fire extinguishing operation is completed. The method realizes the identification of abnormal fire disaster, effectively solves the problem of blind areas in the traditional detection mode, improves the early warning reliability, can quickly reach a fire source in a complex scene and execute fire extinguishing operation, transfers damaged vehicles after fire extinguishment, and effectively prevents the re-ignition risk.
assignees: ANHUI CAS ZHONGHUAN INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Active safety system for protecting bicycle accidents
title_ko: 자전거 사고 방지를 위한 능동형 안전 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an active safety system for preventing bicycle accidents, which comprises: an integrated sensor module (50) which senses an object at the rear while being installed and fixed to an upper part of a seat post below a saddle; a warning display part showing a sensing state of the integrated sensor module (50) at night; a handle vibration warning part (70) warning at day time while being installed in a handle cover; a rear right side indication lamp (80) showing a right-turn running direction of a bicycle; a rear left side indication lamp (80) showing a left-turn running direction of the bicycle; a front stop warning lamp (90) warning a driver at a blind spot of a crossroad; switches (80a, 80a, 90a) operating the rear right side indication lamp (80), the rear left side indication lamp (80) and the front stop warning lamp (90) while being installed at a handle bar beside a left and right handle; and a control part (90) controlling each part of the system while being fixed to a center lower plane of a top tube. The active safety system of the present invention enables a bicycle driver to check approaching of a bicycle or a vehicle approaching at the rear easily by vibration of the handle at day time and turning-on of a number of LED lamps emitting colorful lights at night using multiple sensors. Also, the active safety system prevents negligible accidents of the bicycle by informing the bicycle driver or the vehicle driver approaching at the rear of the driving direction of the bicycle, and can be used simply by having a simple structure. Also, the active safety system has excellent economic feasibility by minimizing installation costs thereof, and has a long life span to be used for a long time without faults.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자전거 사고 방지를 위한 능동형 안전 시스템에 관한 것으로, 안장 아래 시트포스트 상부에 장착 고정되어 후방의 물체를 감지하는 통합 센서 모듈(50)과; 야간에 상기 통합 센서 모듈(50)의 감지 상태를 나타내는 경고 표시부(60)와; 손잡이 커버 내부에 설치되어 주간에 경고하는 손잡이 진동 경고부(70)와; 자전거의 우회전 주행 방향을 나타내는 후방 우측 지시등(80)과; 자전거의 좌회전 주행 방향을 나타내는 후방 좌측 지시등(80')과; 교차로 사각지대의 운전자에게 경고를 주는 전방 정지 경고등(90)과; 좌우핸들 옆 핸들바에 설치되어 상기 후방 우측 지시등(80)과 후방 좌측 지시등(80') 및 전방 정지 경고등(90)을 작동시키는 스위치(80a, 80a', 90a) 및; 탑튜브의 중앙 하면에 고정되어 시스템의 각부를 제어하는 제어부(90')로 구성되어 다중센서를 활용하여 야간에 색광을 발광하는 다수의 LED 램프의 점등과 주간에 손잡이의 진동으로 후방에서 접근하는 차량이나 자전거의 접근상태를 자전거 운전자가 용이하게 확인할 수 있도록 알려줌과 더불어 후방에서 접근하는 차량이나 자전거 운전자에게 자전거의 운전방향을 알려주어 자전거의 안전사고를 방지하고, 간단한 구조의 능동형 안전 시스템을 구현하여 사용이 간편하고, 시스템의 설치 비용을 최소화하여 경제성이 탁월하면서도 고장 없이 장기간 안정되게 사용할 수 있는 수명이 긴 각별한 장점이 있는 유용한 발명이다.

title_en: Ship automatic broadcasting system
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide an inboard automatic broadcasting system capable of clearly transmitting warning information from a long distance through a communication network without noise, and allowing a sailor to recognize and cope with a dangerous situation and an accident occurrence source when an alarm is generated and to avoid the dangerous situation to make an emergency escape by allowing a converted digital voice signal to include accident occurrence source information, corresponding emergency zone information, corresponding dangerous situation information, countermeasure instruction information, and emergency escape information. The inboard automatic broadcasting system comprises: a sensor unit; a monitoring server; an inboard broadcasting server; a plurality of IP speakers; an inboard network broadcasting unit; and a TCP/IP-based communication network, thereby replacing any one of the IP speaker and the analog speaker in case of an error thereon to propagate an emergency situation. According to the present invention, when an alarm is generated, a sailor can recognize and respond to a dangerous situation and an accident occurrence source and avoid the dangerous situation to make an emergency escape, and a network-based system can enable inboard broadcasting through satellite communication even on land.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 항해정보와 환경정보와 모션정보와 선내상황정보를 계측하는 센서부(110), 계측값을 모니터링하고 분석하여 경고정보를 생성하는 모니터링서버(120), 이벤트신호에 따라 네트워크 제어 음원소스(137)를 추출하여 TTS 프로그램 모듈(138)을 통해 경고정보를 디지털음성신호로 변환하는 디지털음성변환모듈(139)로 구성되어, 스케쥴방송과 마이크방송과 전화방송에 해당하는 디지털음성신호 및 경고정보에 해당하는 디지털음성신호를 비상구역정보에 포함된 해당 방송구역 또는 콜 스테이션(134)에 의해 선택된 해당 방송구역으로 전송하는, 선내 방송 서버(130), 선내 방송 서버(130)에 연결되어 디지털음성신호를 출력하는 다수의 IP 스피커(140), 증폭된 음성신호를 출력하는 다수의 아날로그 스피커(153)로 구성되는, 선내 네트워크 방송부(150), 및 센서부(110)와 모니터링 서버(120) 사이, 모니터링 서버(120)와 선내 방송 서버(130) 사이, 선내 방송 서버(130)와 IP 스피커(140) 사이, 및 선내 방송 서버(130)와 선내 네트워크 방송부(150) 사이를 유무선 네트워크로 연결하는 TCP/IP 기반의 통신망(160);을 포함하여, IP 스피커(140) 또는 아날로그 스피커(153) 중 어느 하나의 오류시에 대체하여 노이즈없이 비상상황을 전파하도록 하는, 선내 자동 방송 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting floor drain device for underground smoke exhaust water and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent fire-fighting floor drain device for underground smoke exhaust and a use method thereof, which belong to the technical field of underground construction engineering, floor drain smoke exhaust modules are nested in grooves, and smoke exhaust pipelines are built at the bottoms of the floor drain smoke exhaust modules. The invention carries out structural transformation on the warning top plate and the filter plate in the floor drain smoke-discharging water module through the two groups of supporting ring frames and the matched hydraulic telescopic shafts, under normal conditions, the device is in a closed state, and under fire conditions, the device is in a starting state, the service life of the device is prolonged, the effect of quickly and conveniently dispersing smoke in a fire region is realized through the arrangement of a smoke-discharging water pipeline, the safety of a factory is improved, whether the smoke sensor/smoke flow sensor intelligent monitoring device is blocked or not is realized, the foreign matters on the upper part of the filter plate are cleaned by means of a foreign matter cleaning conveyor belt and a foreign matter discharging frame, and meanwhile, the foreign matters in the filter plate are cleaned through the through frame, so that the aim of automatically cleaning the device is fulfilled.

title_en: Flash double-voice barrier-free vibration doorbell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a two pronunciation accessible vibrations doorbell that flash of light belongs to household articles technical field, and two pronunciation accessible vibrations doorbell that flash of light includes doorbell assembly, doorbell assembly includes transmitter, receiver and vibrator, the transmitter with the receiver passes through radio connection, the transmitter with the vibrator passes through radio connection, the transmitter includes button, controller, signal transmitter and first power module, the front surface mounting of transmitter has the button, and through adopting two kinds of operation forms, according to the condition of difference, the most suitable application mode can be selected to the user of service to improve the result of use of device greatly, and LED lamp area and the warning light of installing respectively on receiver and the vibrator can further promote device's warning effect, and can all carry out the double voice broadcast through the inside first voice broadcast ware and the second voice broadcast ware that set up respectively of receiver and vibrator to this suitability that can also improve device greatly.

title_en: Embedded blind guiding system platform based on Arduino and Android
abstract_en: The invention relates to an embedded blind guiding system platform based on Arduino and Android, which comprises an Arduino platform 1, wherein the right end of the Arduino platform 1 is connected with an output HIGH level sounding 10, the upper end of the output HIGH level sounding 10 is connected with a buzzer module 6, and the left end of the Arduino platform 1 is connected with an obstacle signal 9; the auxiliary blind guiding box based on the Arduino + Android embedded system platform can realize independent traveling of visually impaired people under the condition of no accompanying person, the data acquisition end comprises an Arduino single chip microcomputer, an HC-06 Bluetooth module, an ultrasonic module, an active buzzer module and the like, and the data processing end adopts app developed by Android. The product has realized concrete functions at present, and the processing end function mainly has a positioning navigation function, a one-key emergency call function, a collision early warning function and the like. The acquisition end uses ultrasonic ranging, image recognition system, provides collision early warning for app through bluetooth module transmission information, and the posture detects, buzzing warning function.

title_en: Subway station monitoring system, method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of monitoring, and provides a subway station monitoring system, a method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the system comprises: the first camera is arranged on a sliding door of the platform door and used for acquiring images within a first set range; the second camera is arranged on a fixed door of the platform door and used for collecting images within a second set range; the third camera is arranged on the top box of the platform door and used for collecting images within a third set range; the processing device is used for identifying whether a person crosses an early warning line of the platform according to images acquired by the first camera, the second camera and the third camera in real time; the first infrared sensing device and the first heat sensing device are arranged in the rail and used for detecting whether foreign matters fall into the rail or not; and the processing device is also used for sending alarm information to the administrator terminal when a person crosses an early warning line of the platform or a foreign body falls into a rail. The embodiment of the application can find the emergency situation of the platform in time.
assignees: PING AN PUHUI ENTERPRISE MAN CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster early warning equipment and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses fire disaster early warning equipment and a system thereof, wherein the fire disaster early warning equipment comprises an early warning equipment bottom plate, plug boxes positioned at the left side and the right side of the early warning equipment bottom plate, and an anti-drop assembly fixed in the plug boxes; the front end of the early warning equipment bottom plate is provided with a connecting base, the inside of the connecting base is provided with a waterproof shell, the inside of the waterproof shell is provided with an explosion-proof lampshade, the inside of the plug box is provided with a sensor main body, the output end of the sensor management module is connected with a control module, and the output end of the control module is respectively connected with an emergency response module and a wireless transmission module. This conflagration early warning equipment and system thereof can install the sensor main part fast through plug box to carry out spacingly to the sensor main part through the inside anticreep subassembly of plug box, avoid the sensor main part slippage plug box, at the in-process of sensor main part plug simultaneously, accessible sensor management module manages the sensor main part.

title_en: Guidance apparatus for visually impaired
abstract_en: Disclosed is a guidance apparatus for a visually impaired person to transmit a location and dangerous situation of a visually impaired person to a smart terminal and a service server. According to the present invention, the guidance apparatus for a visually impaired person comprises: a main body fixed to an upper handle of a cane for a visually impaired person; an operation switch actuating the guidance apparatus; a front detection unit detecting front obstacles; an upper detection unit detecting upper obstacles; a gyro sensor detecting movement of the visually impaired person; a vibration generation unit generating vibration; a warning generation unit outputting a warning sound; and a first control unit detecting the front and upper obstacles through the front and upper detection units according to a selection of the operation switch to generate vibration by operating the vibration generation unit when there are obstacles within a set distance, and outputting an emergency situation signal through the warning generating unit when it is determined through the gyro sensor that the visually impaired person has fallen.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 시각 장애인용 안내 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 시각 장애인용 안내 장치는, 시각장애인 용 지팡이의 상부 손잡이에 고정되는 본체; 안내 장치를 작동시키는 작동 스위치; 전방의 장애물을 감지하는 전방 감지부; 상방의 장애물을 감지하는 상방 감지부; 시각장애인의 움직임을 감지하는 자이로센서; 진동을 발생시키는 진동 발생부; 경고음을 출력하는 경고 발생부; 및 작동 스위치의 선택에 따라 전방 감지부와 상방 감지부를 통해 전방의 장애물과 상방의 장애물을 감지하여 설정거리 이내에 장애물이 존재하는 경우 진동 발생부를 작동시켜 진동을 발생시키고, 자이로센서를 통해 시각장애인이 넘어진 것으로 판단될 경우 경고 발생부를 통해 위급상황을 출력하는 제1 제어부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method for delivering emergency message in multiple languages
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 다국어 긴급 메시지의 전달 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로 긴급 메시지를 사용자의 국적이나 사용자가 선택한 언어로 번역하여 제공함으로써 외국인이라도 긴급 메시지를 정확하게 이해하고 신속 정확하게 긴급 상황에 대응할 수 있는 긴급 메시지의 전달 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: System with a companion device and a primary device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for a companion device to receive current service information from a primary device comprising: (a) said companion device receiving from said primary device an emergency alert message including at least one of: (i) an identifier of said emergency alert message that uniquely identifies said emergency alert message; (ii) a date when said emergency alert message was generated together with a time when said emergency alert message was generated; (iii) a content format defining a content type of an initial said emergency alert message; (iv) a content of said emergency alert message received given by initial content element; (v) a URL which provides initial emergency alert message content for accessibility; (vi) an additional URL which provides additional information about said emergency alert message; (vii) a phone number for obtaining additional information about said emergency alert message; (viii) an e-mail address for obtaining additional information about said emergency alert message; (ix) a received additional emergency alert containing a continuation of another said emergency alert message; (x) a received one of a new or a repeat said emergency alert message; (xi) a received said emergency alert message that is not repeated; (xii) an identifier of said primary device; (xiii) a version of said primary device.

title_en: Dangerous chemical leakage personnel evacuation management method, system, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, in particular to a dangerous chemical leakage personnel evacuation management method, a dangerous chemical leakage personnel evacuation management system, electronic equipment and a dangerous chemical leakage personnel evacuation management medium, wherein the dangerous chemical leakage personnel evacuation management method comprises the steps of dividing areas of a park, and carrying out corresponding numbering and position association on leakage monitoring modules in the divided areas; when monitoring data are obtained to judge leakage of dangerous chemicals, analyzing and obtaining the position of a target leakage area and an evacuation route; the method comprises the steps of sending a protection product scheduling instruction to a protection product scheduling module and early warning and evacuating information in each factory to a broadcast early warning and evacuating module in each internal and external area of each factory, obtaining monitoring data through automatic regional monitoring, planning a route avoiding a leakage area, carrying out path walking voice prompt along the evacuation route, simultaneously carrying out protection product scheduling on the leakage area, and carrying out on-line protection product or rapid evacuation on personnel according to the voice prompt, so that personnel can be prevented from blindly escaping, the optimal rescue and evacuating time can be missed, and the occurrence probability of major safety accidents can be reduced.

title_en: Safety fence for the construction site
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A safety fence for a construction site is provided to effectively prevent accidents by enabling visually-impaired and hearing-impaired persons to easily recognize a danger area even in the night. CONSTITUTION: A safety fence(1) for a construction site comprises a fence body(100) and legs. The legs support the fence body to the ground. The fence body is composed of one or more human body detection sensors(110), speakers(112), a display panel(114), warning lights(116), a control unit, and a power supply unit. The human body detection sensor are formed on the front surface of a case(101) and sense human bodies. When the human bodies are sensed, the speakers output warning sounds. The control unit controls the operation of the speakers, the display panel, and the warning lights. The power supply unit supplies power to the control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건설현장용 안전펜스에 관한 것으로; 펜스본체와 그 펜스본체를 지면에 지지하는 다리로 구성되는 건설현장용 안전펜스에 있어서, 상기 펜스본체는 케이스의 전면에 인체를 감지하는 하나 이상의 인체감지센서와, 상기 인체감지센서를 통해 인체가 감지되면 음성안내방송을 출력하는 스피커와, 경고메시지를 디스플레이하는 표시판넬과, 상기 케이스의 내부에는 상기 인체감지센서에서 감지신호가 입력되면 상기 스피커와 표시판넬의 동작을 제어하는 제어수단과, 상기 제어수단의 구동을 위한 전원을 공급하기 위한 전원공급수단으로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 안전펜스에 사람이 접근하는 경우 스피커로 음성안내방송을 출력하고 경고메시지를 함께 디스플레이하여 시각 또는 청각 장애인 또는 노약자 등이 위험지역인 건설현장임을 쉽게 인지할 수 있어 불의의 사고를 효과적으로 예방할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Method for requesting rescue for a hearing impaired person
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method to request a rescue for a hearing-impaired person. The rescue inducing method for a hearing-impaired person uses: an emergency situation sensing module which is installed in a predetermined building and generates and outputs a preset emergency signal by sensing an emergency situation when an emergency occurs due to a power outage or an earthquake in a building; and at least one emergency exit display which receives an emergency signal by being installed to be separated mutually at a predetermined distance in a building. The present invention comprises: a step of transmitting an emergency signal to at least one emergency exit display in the emergency situation sensing module; a step of broadcasting an alarm signal having preset frequency respectively in the emergency exit display receiving the emergency signal within a predetermined radius; a step in which a user terminal positioned within the radius receives the alarm signal; a step of transmitting a preset rescue signal to the emergency exit display transmitting the alarm signal received in the user terminal; and a step of outputting alarm sound or sound message which notifies the existence of a rescuer within the radius based on the emergency exit display in the emergency exit display receiving the rescue signal. Thus, the present invention has an effect of quickly requesting a rescue by automatically notifying the existence of a hearing-impaired person, who is difficult to properly respond, in the event of a disaster to people around or to a police officer or fire station.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 청각장애인을 위한 구조 요청 방법에 관한 것으로, 소정의 건물 내부에 설치되어 건물에 정전 또는 지진으로 인한 비상 상황 발생 시 이를 감지하여 기설정된 비상신호를 생성 및 출력하는 비상상황 감지모듈과, 건물 내부에서 상호 일정 거리 이격되도록 설치되어 비상신호를 수신하는 적어도 하나 이상의 비상구 표시 장치를 이용한 청각장애인을 위한 피난 유도 방법에 있어서, 비상상황 감지모듈에서 비상신호를 적어도 하나 이상의 비상구 표시 장치로 전송하는 단계와, 비상신호를 수신한 비상구 표시 장치에서 각각에 기설정된 주파수를 갖는 경보 신호를 일정 반경 내에서 브로드캐스트하는 단계와, 반경 내에 위치하는 사용자 단말기가 경보 신호를 수신하는 단계와, 사용자 단말기가 수신한 경보 신호를 전송한 비상구 표시 장치로 기설정된 조난 신호를 전송하는 단계와, 조난 신호를 수신한 비상구 표시 장치에서 비상구 표시 장치를 기준으로 반경 내에 조난자가 있음을 알리는 경보음이나 음성 메시지를 출력하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이에 따라, 재난 상황 발생 시 적절한 대응이 어려운 청각장애인의 존재를 자동으로 주변 사람들에게 알리거나 경찰서나 소방서로 긴급 발신하여 신속하게 구조를 요청할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Alarm apparatus for preventing blind accident
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for preventing an accident caused by a working line (13) of a roller blind (10). The apparatus comprises: a main body (20) including a space part (21) and a hanging part (23) therein and serving as a weight to the working line (13); a sensing means (30) installed on the main body (20) to detect the shaking of the main body (20); a covering means (40) installed on the main body (20) to reduce the exposed length of the working line (13); and a controller (50) issuing an alarm or operating the covering means (40) in response to a signal of the sensing means (30). Accordingly, the apparatus senses a state, in which a child accesses the roller blind installed on the window or the like to shade the light and plays with the roller blind, and issues an alarm. In addition, the apparatus temporally reduces an exposed portion of the working line, thereby increasing the accident prevention rate.

title_en: Intelligent zebra stripes early warning system for visual blind areas of construction channels based on video identification
abstract_en: The intelligent zebra stripes early warning system for the visual blind areas of the construction channels based on video identification comprises a video data acquisition module, a data analysis module and an on-site execution module, wherein the video data acquisition module comprises one or more high-definition cameras, the data analysis module comprises an AI edge calculation box, the on-site execution module comprises an integrated controller and an IP network horn, the integrated controller and the AI edge calculation box are installed in an office area, the IP network horn is fixed at the top of a gate of the office area, the AI edge calculation box is connected with the high-definition cameras through signal matching, the AI edge calculation box is connected with the integrated controller in a wired mode, and the integrated controller is provided with a wireless transmission module connected with the IP network horn. The system has intelligent sensing and early warning capability, can know the conditions of people and vehicles constructing the visual blind area of the channel in real time according to the video recognition technology, actively prevents collision between people and vehicles, and avoids collision accidents caused by the response delay of the visual blind area or a driver.

title_en: Multi-source fusion real-time traffic perception and emergency early warning system and method based on vehicle Lu Yun cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multisource fusion real-time traffic perception and emergency early warning system and method based on vehicle Lu Yun cooperation, which relate to the technical field of traffic management and are operated cooperatively by a vehicle end, a road end and a cloud system, wherein the vehicle end system comprises an information acquisition and transmission module, a local decision module, a data receiving module, an emergency response module and a data feedback module, and the information acquisition and transmission module acquires vehicle peripheral information through a vehicle-mounted radar and a vehicle-mounted camera. According to the invention, the vehicle end acquires local information such as vehicle surrounding barriers, adjacent vehicle dynamics and the like through the vehicle-mounted radar and the camera, the road end acquires regional information such as road traffic density, road damage, traffic facility states and the like through the road side camera and the sensor, the cloud end integrates the data at the two ends and performs air synchronization through the multi-source fusion technology, the defect of a single vehicle end or road end perception blind area is filled, and the complete perception of the traffic state of the whole road network is realized.
assignees: CHUZHOU SHUANGXIAO LINGLI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and Method for Alerting a User
abstract_en: The alarm monitoring system provides various alerts of events that are not readily discernable to those individuals that are deaf or hard of hearing. The system generates visual, vibratory, and high decibel alerts separately or in combination to alert the user to a wide variety of events in combination with a vibratory illuminating puck shaped device and allows a user to filter out alerts based upon a variety of modifiers.

title_en: Multi-weight public opinion value calculation method and system and computer
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of networks and discloses a multi-weight public opinion value calculating method, a system and a computer, wherein the multi-weight public opinion value calculating method is used for scoring public opinion values by combining five characteristics of media weight, media channel weight, layout position weight, positive and negative emotion and information exposure rate; determining channels and weights of media through breadth-first traversal collection; determining the importance of the reports in the layout through a layout recognition algorithm; determining the emotional intensity of the whole report through emotional tendency calculation; calculating information exposure rate through sorting in the search engine; and unifying the related elements of the public sentiment value together to carry out quantitative calculation of the public sentiment value. The invention provides a value judgment basis for solving the problems of false judgment, misjudgment and misjudgment in the conventional public opinion judgment and the problems of blindness, shrinkage, exaggeration, weakness, delay and the like in public opinion treatment, thereby improving the early warning power, judgment power and handling power based on network emergency public event crisis management.

title_en: Rail line foreign matter intrusion monitoring and risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for monitoring the intrusion of foreign matters on a track line and early warning risk, which belong to the technical field of railway disaster prevention and early warning, and acquire three-dimensional space point cloud data around the track and track plane image data; identifying and extracting the foreign body characteristics in the boundary area according to the point cloud data and the track plane image data; according to the characteristics of the intrusion foreign bodies, calculating risks of different characteristics by adopting an analytic hierarchy process and a risk matrix process, and carrying out fusion calculation on the risks of different characteristics to obtain a comprehensive risk value of the intrusion foreign bodies; and carrying out early warning treatment and evidence obtaining reporting according to the risk classification of the intrusion foreign bodies. The invention realizes the monitoring, identification and analysis of the characteristics of the track line intrusion event and the event occurrence process, further improves the risk prevention and control capability of the track traffic system, and has good application and popularization values.

title_en: A kind of forest fire protection smog identifying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of forest fire protection smog identifying device, belong to fireproof alarming field, including support base, control unit is provided with wherein in the support base, provided with monitoring probe above the support base, camera and Smoke Sensor are respectively equipped with the monitoring probe, the camera and Smoke Sensor are connected with described control unit, restraining is equipped with the two ends of the support base, the end of the restraining is by snapping connection, the Smoke Sensor set first can carry out good early warning to fire, the collection of image/video can also be carried out to scene by camera simultaneously, accurate judgement is made to the serious conditions of fire, the monitoring probe of rotation then can be to carrying out comprehensive monitoring around monitoring point, avoid the occurrence of the situation of monitoring blind area.

title_en: A kind of electrical fire monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of electrical fire monitoring system, including at least one detection module, substation processing module and Central Control Module；Each detection module is provided with unique network address；Detection module is used for the electrical safety parameter in acquisition terminal loop, is additionally operable to be sent to substation processing module by network address and more than the electrical safety parameter of predetermined threshold value；Substation processing module and detection module wireless connection, for network address translation to be transmitted into Central Control Module into physical location, and by security parameter and physical location；Central Control Module is used to receive electrical safety parameter and physical location, and the information that gives a warning.Electrical fire monitoring system disclosed in the utility model, it is possible to increase the accuracy of the Monitoring Data of electrical fire monitoring system, realize fast positioning electric disaster hidden-trouble position, be easy to exclude electric disaster hidden-trouble rapidly.
assignees: HUNAN YIERSAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Early warning arresting equipment for dealing with geological disasters along highway
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reply highway geological disasters 'along line's early warning arresting equipment, be equipped with the mounting bracket of a plurality of supporting legs including the lower surface, the bottom of one of them supporting leg is equipped with vibrations discernment appearance, and the inside one end of mounting bracket articulates there is the arresting plate, is connected with jointly between the dorsal part of arresting plate and the mounting bracket inner wall and pops out the subassembly. According to the early warning and blocking equipment provided by the scheme, under the mutual matching of all parts, due to the arrangement of the contraction assembly, the pop-up assembly and the blocking plate, after a geological disaster occurs on a road, personnel can timely early warn and block a rear vehicle without going to the site; and accessible shrink subassembly makes the rotor plate erect and spill two warning lights to make the vehicle alright receive the early warning at a distance through the warning light, avoided the vehicle promptly and in time the phenomenon of braking when seeing the arresting barrier, and be favorable to distinguishing in time at night.
assignees: GUIZHOU RONGYUAN ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban drainage pipe network waterlogging early warning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of waterlogging early warning, and discloses an urban drainage pipe network waterlogging early warning system which comprises a support, wherein a connecting arm is fixedly connected to the right side of the support, a shell is fixedly connected to the right side of the connecting arm, a fixing sleeve is fixedly connected to the lower end of the shell, a sleeve is arranged inside the shell, and rotating teeth are sleeved at the upper end of the sleeve. According to the invention, the water level in the tunnel is monitored by the floating piece and the water level monitor, the distance between the floating piece and the measured water level and the elastic collision ball timely transmits data to the early warning system, so that early warning of waterlogging is rapidly sent, the problem of automobile damage caused by blind driving of a driver into unknown water depth is remarkably reduced, meanwhile, the elastic collision ball is precisely attached to the ground by the matched arrangement of the first spring, the second spring and the telescopic rod, the water level survey precision of various complex road surfaces is calibrated, and the problem of early warning errors caused by different ground flatness in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Intelligent action prediction and helmet lighting lamp linkage method and system for electric vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of data processing, and discloses a method and a system for intelligent motion prediction of an electric vehicle and helmet lighting lamp linkage. The method comprises the steps of monitoring the working state of the electric vehicle and the running data of the electric vehicle in real time by a vehicle machine system of the electric vehicle, wherein the working state comprises a left steering lamp state, a right steering lamp state, a double-flashing signal state and a braking state, and packaging the state information into a Bluetooth broadcasting frame, continuously monitoring Bluetooth broadcasting information from the electric vehicle by a helmet Bluetooth device, analyzing the state information when the broadcasting frame is received, controlling an LED lamp on the helmet to display correspondingly according to the analyzed state information, predicting the action of the electric vehicle and monitoring blind areas based on the running data of the electric vehicle, controlling the earphone on the helmet to send corresponding prompt tones according to a prediction result and a monitoring result, and automatically triggering a warning light effect to remind a driver of the rear vehicle. Not only improves the safety and convenience of riding, but also enhances the interactive experience of the user and other traffic participants.

title_en: Addressable voice guidance fire alarm control panel and emergency alarm method
title_ko: 주소형 음성안내 수신기 및 비상 경보 방법
abstract_en: An addressable voice guidance receiver including an emergency broadcast unit and a voice guidance function based on fire location provision and an emergency alarm method are disclosed. The addressable voice guidance receiver comprises: an addressable receiving unit receiving an address signal according to fire detection or non-fire alarm occurrence from a plurality of addressable detectors or transmitters distributed and arranged by watching section of a floor or area unit of a building, and analyzing the address signal to output location information; a voice conversion unit to convert the location information received from the addressable voice guidance receiver into a voice in real time and output an emergency broadcast announcement mapped to the converted voice; a voice guidance unit to guide an important event of the addressable voice guidance receiver by a voice; and an emergency broadcast unit connected to a broadcast speaker installed in each watching section and outputting the emergency broadcast announcement outputted from the voice conversion unit to each emergency broadcast speaker.
abstract_ko: 주소형 음성안내 수신기 및 비상 경보 방법이 개시된다. 여기서, 주소형 음성안내 수신기는 건축물의 층 단위 또는 면적 단위의 경계 구역 별로 분산 배치된 복수개의 주소형 감지기 또는 복수개의 주소형 발신기로부터 화재 감지 또는 비화재보 발생에 따른 주소 신호를 수신하고, 상기 주소 신호를 분석하여 위치 정보를 출력하는 주소형 수신부, 상기 주소형 음성안내 수신기로부터 수신한 상기 위치 정보를 음성으로 실시간 변환하고, 변환된 음성이 맵핑된 비상 방송 멘트를 출력하는 음성 변환부, 주소형 음성안내 수신기의 중요 이벤트를 음성으로 안내해 주는 음성 안내부 그리고 상기 경계 구역 별로 설치된 각각의 방송 스피커와 연결되고, 상기 음성 변환부가 출력하는 비상 방송 멘트를 상기 각각의 비상 방송 스피커로 출력하는 비상 방송 유닛을 포함한다.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for a companion device to receive current service information from a primary device comprising: (a) said companion device receiving from said primary device an emergency alert message including at least one of: (i) an identifier of said emergency alert message that uniquely identifies said emergency alert message; (ii) a date when said emergency alert message was generated together with a time when said emergency alert message was generated; (iii) a content format defining a content type of an initial said emergency alert message; (iv) a content of said emergency alert message received given by initial content element; (v) a URL which provides initial emergency alert message content for accessibility; (vi) an additional URL which provides additional information about said emergency alert message; (vii) a phone number for obtaining additional information about said emergency alert message; (viii) an e-mail address for obtaining additional information about said emergency alert message; (ix) a received additional emergency alert containing a continuation of another said emergency alert message; (x) a received one of a new or a repeat said emergency alert message; (xi) a received said emergency alert message that is not repeated; (xii) an identifier of said primary device; (xiii) a version of said primary device.

abstract_en: The utility model relates to an early warning device technical field provides a vehicle anticollision early warning device, including base, automobile body information acquisition module, collision risk calculation module, execution module and mounting box, automobile body information acquisition module, collision risk calculation module and execution module all set up the inside at the mounting box, the two-way electric connection of automobile body information acquisition module and collision risk calculation module, the two-way electric connection of collision risk calculation module and execution module, the mounting box joint is in the inside of base, and the collision risk calculation module outside is provided with data input port. title_en: The sense warning device use led indication device
Intelligent traffic early warning system and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic warning control, and provides an intelligent traffic early warning system which comprises a guardrail patrol machine, a tunnel patrol machine, a gateway robot, an acousto-optic early warning system and a background server, wherein the guardrail patrol machine is connected with the tunnel patrol machine through a network; the guardrail patrol machine is arranged on a road guardrail and used for sending preset early warning information to the background server; the tunnel patrol machine is arranged at a preset position of the tunnel and used for acquiring the illegal information of preset vehicles, the information of preset tunnel foreign matters, the air quality concentration and the preset traffic image information in the current tunnel and uploading the information to the background server; the gateway crossing robot is arranged at a preset position of a gateway crossing and used for acquiring preset vehicle information of the current gateway crossing and uploading the acquired preset vehicle information to the background server, and the sound and light early warning system is used for receiving preset alarm signals and carrying out corresponding sound and light early warning according to the received preset alarm signals. The system has the advantages of intelligent monitoring on high-speed traffic, high safety and strong convenience.

title_en: Image recognition-based method, system and medium for early warning falling objects at lane opening
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a system and a medium for early warning falling objects at a roadway opening based on image recognition, wherein the method comprises the steps of monitoring an unattended railway opening by using an industrial camera and collecting data for image recognition; obtaining a gray picture as a base picture, which is an image S; obtaining an image B, and performing contour finding operation on the image B to obtain a final image C; recording the actual coordinates of all detected targets into a target coordinate information queue with a fixed length of N; obtaining a final difference value operation result image K, and storing the operation result K into an edge image queue with a fixed length N; and obtaining targets which stay in place and possibly influence railway operation according to the target coordinate information queue and the edge image queue, and pushing the targets to an administrator. The application utilizes the image recognition technology to detect the railway crossing which is easy to fall off, prevents foreign matters from interfering the running of the train, reduces the hidden danger of railway running, lightens the workload of security personnel and assists the safe and intelligent production.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for life safety monitoring and rescue
abstract_en: The application discloses a life safety monitoring and rescuing method, system, equipment and medium, which are based on a wireless ad hoc network technology, form a network topology structure by a dynamic ad hoc network protocol, divide the area where a neighbor terminal node is located into a first area, a second area, a third area and a fourth area which extend towards four directions based on traffic distribution of the place where the target terminal node is located, avoid rescuing personnel from being delayed due to congestion, ensure the timeliness of rescuing, divide the neighbor terminal node of each area into a first ladder, a second ladder and a third ladder, and participate in batches by the rescuing personnel so as to save manpower resources. The on-site environment is subjected to environment safety early warning and the life body is subjected to life body health early warning, so that rescue personnel are prevented from blindly performing rescue, and further, the environment data and the life body sign data are combined to judge the living state of the life body in the current environment, so that a more targeted rescue plan is formulated, and the rescue success rate is improved.

title_en: Forest fire early warning method, system and equipment based on satellite Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of satellite Internet of things, in particular to a forest fire early warning method, a forest fire early warning system and forest fire early warning equipment based on the satellite Internet of things, wherein the method specifically comprises the following steps: according to a data fusion algorithm, carrying out fusion processing on the monitoring data of different monitoring devices in each target overlapping area to generate a data fusion model; deducing to obtain the monitoring data of the potential monitoring blind area by analyzing the monitoring data of the adjacent area of the potential monitoring blind area, and predicting the long-term change trend of the monitoring data of the potential monitoring blind area by a time sequence prediction algorithm; and transmitting the monitoring data of each monitoring device, the analysis result of the target overlapping area and the prediction result of the potential monitoring blind area to a data center through the satellite Internet of things. The invention obviously improves the coverage and the data accuracy of the forest monitoring system and effectively reduces the problems caused by monitoring blind areas and data overlapping.

title_en: Non-open water area management and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a non-open water area management and control method, after a ship enters an early warning area, judging whether the ship is foreign and the navigational speed reaches a set threshold value, if the conditions are met, monitoring the ship in real time, and when a certain detention time is reached in the early warning area and the displacement distance is smaller than the maximum detention range, carrying out early warning. The invention can realize the real-time monitoring and analysis of the ship dynamics and timely identify potential illegal behaviors and potential safety hazards, thereby helping law enforcement departments to quickly respond and process decisions.

title_en: Space Sterilization Machine
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a space sterilization device which is attached to a wall surface of a building, is configured to detect whether a person exists in a space, and is configured to generate, when it is determined that there is a person, a warning sound to evacuate people in the space or to automatically carry out disinfection when it is determined that there is no persons. The space sterilization device comprises: a nozzle unit which sprays a sterilization solution; an operation unit which includes a UV unit that emits UV rays and is attached to one side of a wall surface of a building; a pump unit connected to the operation unit and configured to transmit the sterilization solution to the nozzle unit; a control unit which controls the operation unit and the pump unit; and a filter unit configured to filter out foreign substances between the nozzle unit and the pump unit. The pump unit includes: a storage tank in which the sterilization solution is stored; a pump configured to transmit the sterilization solution from the storage tank to the nozzle unit; and a compressor which transmits high-pressure air into the pump so that the sterilization solution is sprayed in the form of mist from the nozzle unit. In this case, the control unit includes: a detection sensor provided in the operation unit and configured to detect the presence of a person in the space; and a pressure sensor which detects leakage of a pipe connected from the pump unit to the nozzle unit. In addition, the present invention further comprises an alarm unit which generates a warning sound when the presence of a person in the space is detected by the detection sensor, and the alarm unit is provided on one side of the operation unit.

title_en: Dynamic Public Warning System for In-Vehicle eNodeB
abstract_en: A method is disclosed, comprising: sending position information reflecting a current position of a base station to a coordinating server; receiving a warning request message from an operator core network containing an emergency area; calculating a geographic area corresponding to an emergency tracking area by translating the emergency area from a set of base stations to the geographic area; determining whether the base station may be outside of a threshold distance from the geographic boundary of the emergency tracking area; and sending the warning request message when the base station may be within the threshold distance from the geographic boundary of the emergency tracking area.

title_en: System and method for monitoring a dwelling
abstract_en: Provided herein is a system for monitoring dwellings. The system includes a server; a plurality of sensors located at one or more dwellings, the plurality of sensors configured to generate sensor data and communicate the sensor data to the server; and monitoring software configured to run on the server. The monitoring software is configured to process the sensor data and generate at least one user interface. Additionally, the at least one user interface is accessible through a remote compute device and is configured to display at least one of the sensor data and one or more alerts. Also provided are a method of monitoring a multi-unit dwelling using the system and a non-transitory, processor-readable medium storing instructions for executing the method.

title_en: Moving robot and control method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates a moving robot and a method for controlling thereof, and specifically, the moving robot and the method are configured to monitor a cleaning area by taking images while moving a plurality of areas based on a map of the cleaning area, and monitor in a plurality of areas or a dedicated specific area, and monitor overall areas by taking images while rotating at a monitoring location by dedicating the monitoring location in the area, and set a specific location in an area as a monitoring location, and cause taking of images to be performed at a specific angle by dedicating a monitoring direction in the monitoring location, and perform monitoring of a plurality of areas with minimal movement, and perform an effective monitoring because taking images in a blind spot may be performed by changing the monitoring location or adding a monitoring location based on information on an obstacle, and set a schedule to perform monitoring at a dedicated time, and detect invasion by recognizing the obstacle through analyzing of the images, and output an alert message or signal if the invasion is detected, and transmit a signal or message associated with the invasion detection, and thus a security function can be strengthened.

title_en: A kind of multi-functional emergency situation warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of multi-functional emergency situation warning device, comprise the main equipment arranged from equipment and disengaging wrist strap be arranged in wrist strap; Main equipment comprises main micro control unit, sensor assembly, wireless transmitter module, voice module, loudspeaker, sound and light alarm module and main power source module; Described sensor assembly comprises the smoke transducer module, Temperature Humidity Sensor module and the shock sensor module that connect described main micro control unit respectively; Comprise from micro control unit, wireless receiving module, shock module, LED flashing module and from power module from equipment; When there is the situations such as earthquake, fire, gas leakage, corresponding sensor detects signal, and control module control LED flashing module starts, and shock module starts, and sound and light alarm module starts.This device can solve when there is the situations such as earthquake, fire, gas leakage, can not wake up in time and the problem of reporting to the police of cannot sounding when deaf-mute and non-sensitive crowd are in sleep.

title_en: Indoor anti-theft device with acoustooptic alarm

title_en: pedestrian crosses safety warning system in street
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pedestrian crosses safety warning system in street, including treater, pressure sensor, loop inductor and acousto-optic suggestion device. When a vehicle is parked to avoid pedestrians, the sight lines of adjacent lanes are easily blocked, the pedestrians and the vehicles coming from the rear have vision blind areas, the pedestrians and the vehicles coming from the rear cannot observe each other in time, and potential safety hazards exist. When a pedestrian is ready to pass through the zebra crossing, the pressure sensor arranged at the edge of the road senses the pressure transmitted by the pedestrian, receives a signal that the pedestrian is about to pass through a pedestrian crosswalk and then transmits the signal to the processor, and controls the light emitting surface of the signal indicating lamp in the driving direction to become a flashing yellow lamp to prompt the vehicle to decelerate and stop to give way to the pedestrian; when the vehicle is approaching the pedestrian crossing line, the loop sensor arranged on the road surface receives the signal, and the signal lamp is controlled to generate flashing yellow light on the light emitting surface in the pedestrian passing direction, so as to prompt pedestrians to carefully pass through the pedestrian crossing. In other cases, the signal lamp does not emit light.

title_en: Durable geological disaster early warning device with multiple installation modes
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a durable geological disaster early warning device with multiple mounting modes, which comprises a limiting disc, wherein the bottom of the limiting disc is provided with an integrated fixing frame, the top of the limiting disc is fixedly and rotatably provided with a shell, the shell is provided with an integrated fixing disc, the top of the inner side of the shell is provided with a water inlet groove, the bottom of the water inlet groove is provided with a preheating base, and the preheating base is provided with a water inlet; the built-in base that preheats that is equipped with of intake chamber at the device, inside the water inlet access device of rainwater offered through preheating the base, it can produce certain temperature to preheat the heating device on the base, prevent that water inlet department from appearing freezing, influence the measurement of rainwater, a flip has been installed at this early warning device's top, when the device when placing, accessible flip closes the intake chamber lid, prevent that impurity such as dust from falling inside the device, influence the volume of rainfall to get, the practicality of the device has been improved, avoid the measurement error to appear.

title_en: Warning prompt device for radiotherapy department

The utility model has convenient installation and use operation, can shift positions according to the needs and has good warning and prompting effects.

title_en: Vehicle right turn alarm and early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicle right turning alarm and early warning device, which relates to the technical field of transportation vehicle safety alarm equipment, the infrared probe comprises a transport vehicle, a mounting seat and an infrared probe, wherein the middle part of the bottom end of the transport vehicle is in butt joint with the mounting seat, and a sliding cylinder is welded on one side of the outer wall of the mounting seat. When the vehicle right-turning alarming and early warning device is used, when the transportation vehicle turns right, the electromagnetic valve is started to enable the air cylinder to stretch out and draw back, the baffle plate is made to rotate to a specified angle, pedestrians are prevented from entering a driving blind area, and when the infrared probe senses that the pedestrians are in the blind area, a signal is sent to remind the drivers of driving safely, and then the pedestrians are prevented not only through a voice prompt mode, but also through a mode of unfolding the baffle plate, the probability of safety accidents caused by the vision blind area is reduced, and accordingly the effect of conveniently blocking the pedestrians is achieved when the vehicle right-turning alarming and early warning device is used.
assignees: SHANDONG RIHUI CABLE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Rail-mounted area foreign matter intrusion monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a track area foreign matter intrusion monitoring and early warning system which comprises a plurality of monitoring points arranged along a track at intervals, wherein the monitoring points are provided with vibration sensing modules used for collecting vibration signals in a target track section, image collecting modules used for collecting image signals in the target track section, a data processing module, a track section with a slope, a landslide detection device arranged on the slope corresponding to the track area, a signal input end connected with the signal output end of the landslide detection device, and a dispatching center connected with the signal output end of the landslide detection device in a communication mode. The monitoring and early warning system for the invasion limit of the foreign matters in the track area can monitor whether the foreign matters fall or invade the track area, also monitor landslide conditions and early warn the invasion limit possibly faced by the track area in advance.

title_en: High-pressure weeding protection system
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-voltage weeding protection system, and relates to the technical field of weeding equipment. The high-voltage weeding protection system comprises four functional modules, namely a grating monitoring module, a signal processing module, an execution control module and an acousto-optic warning module, wherein the grating monitoring module comprises a plurality of groups of grating transmitters and receivers, a high-voltage copper rod is used as a center along a high-voltage dangerous area, the edges of the range with the radius not smaller than 15000V of safe discharge distance are arranged in a ring shape or a rectangle shape, a three-dimensional protection net is formed, the grating distance is not more than 30cm, and no detection blind area is ensured. According to the invention, the safety fence is formed in the area near the high-voltage rod at an extremely high speed, and the high-voltage main circuit is rapidly turned off by the intrusion of people and animals, so that the safety of people and animals is increased, the safety accident is reduced, and the electric shock prevention is required to be met at the edge of the high-voltage 15000V discharge area in the discharge process, so that the influence of electromagnetic radiation is prevented.
assignees: YUANSHI ZHEJIANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Road turning blind area early warning device based on deceleration strip capable of judging coming vehicle direction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of pavement facilities, in particular to a road turning blind zone early warning device based on a deceleration strip capable of judging the direction of an incoming vehicle. The warning device comprises a deceleration strip and a warning device linked with the deceleration strip, wherein the deceleration strip is of a combined structure and comprises a base, a front pedal and a rear pedal, and a plurality of pedal linkage assemblies; the rear pedal is lapped above the front pedal; the bottoms of the front pedal and the rear pedal are supported on the base by spring telescopic rods or hydraulic springs; the pedal linkage assembly comprises a first sliding block, a second sliding block, two vertical sliding blocks, a horizontal sliding block, a first push rod and a second push rod; the first sliding block and the second sliding block are respectively provided with a guide rail, and can be pushed by the first push rod and the second push rod. The slide block, the push rod and the base are respectively provided with a driving gear, a driving rack, an energy storage gear and an energy storage rack. Through the linkage of the sliding block and the push rod, when a vehicle entering the intersection presses the deceleration strip, the warning device is started through the driving gear, and the vehicle is charged through the energy storage gear.

title_en: It is sealed to clean fault alarm monitoring system automatically from block clearing belt conveyer
abstract_en: The application belongs to belt conveyer field, it discloses and a kind of sealed cleans fault alarm monitoring system automatically from block clearing belt conveyer, solve the problems, such as that all-sealed belt conveyer internal operation observation difficult problem and camera shooting instrument camera lens are easily covered by dust in the prior art, comprising: independent sealed infrared eye, visor automatic cleaning apparatus and PLC controller.PLC controller monitors that foreign substance pollution signal, control visor automatic cleaning apparatus clean endoscopy glass by receiving independent sealed infrared eye.The sealed automatic cleaning fault alarm monitoring system from block clearing belt conveyer of the application can not be monitored fortuitous event by dark, the influence of high dirt environment, the convenient belt conveyer internal unit operating status for intuitively observing sealing.It gives warning in advance, reduces the generation of major accident.
assignees: GTS POWER TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Building security monitoring intelligent early warning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a building security monitoring intelligent early warning device, which relates to the technical field of building security equipment and comprises a connector, wherein the bottom of the connector is provided with a mounting groove, the mounting groove is a blind groove, one side in the mounting groove is provided with a cylinder, the cylinder is connected with one side in the mounting groove through a bolt, the working end of the cylinder is provided with a reinforcing plate, the reinforcing plate is fixed with the working end of the cylinder, the middle part of the bottom surface of the reinforcing plate is provided with a support rod, the support rod is welded with the middle part of the bottom surface of the reinforcing plate and is vertical to the bottom surface of the reinforcing plate, one end of the support rod is fixed with a head cover, the surface of the head cover is fixed with a protective ring, and the fireproof ring is matched with one end of the connector, the cylinder and the fireproof ring are adopted, thereby realizing effective protection of the detection device when fire disaster occurs, reducing the damage to the device after the disaster, and saving financial resources, the operation of workers is not needed, and the structure is simple and convenient.
assignees: WUHAN WINSSE SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of fire disaster of power transmission line monitoring method and system based on video analysis
abstract_en: The fire disaster of power transmission line monitoring method based on video analysis that the invention discloses a kind of, step are：1) image information, is obtained by video image acquisition device, and is sent to fire information acquisition module；2), fire information acquisition module judges fire the condition of a disaster information, and is sent to fire alarm processing module；3), fire alarm processing module is sent to fire size class alarm module by fire information divided rank, and by the grade；4) fire size class alarm module issues the user with FIRE WARNING.The fire disaster of power transmission line monitoring method of the present invention solves the problems, such as the discovery that fire cannot be promptly and accurately caused by satellite monitoring blind area, improves the efficiency of disaster alarm, and technical guarantee is provided for the processing of further calamity emergency.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for monitoring and distinguishing backward propagation thunderstorm based on wind cloud satellite No. four
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical fields of meteorological information technology and disaster weather monitoring and early warning, in particular to a method and a system for monitoring and distinguishing backward propagation thunderstorm based on a wind cloud satellite No. four. The method comprises the steps of obtaining and preprocessing ground precipitation, satellite bright temperature and numerical mode environment field data, generating a spatially aligned multi-source grid data set, estimating cloud advection displacement vectors based on a 850hPa wind field of a numerical mode, carrying out translation correction on the satellite bright temperature field, identifying and communicating a cold cloud area based on the corrected bright temperature field, carrying out target tracking, obtaining cloud mass center tracks and area change sequences, judging consistency of a cloud rear side enhancement feature and a motion direction and the environment wind field by combining short-time strong precipitation events, screening a backward propagation thunderstorm positive sample, and taking a trigger station as a center to extract multidimensional features to construct a standardized multi-source feature sample data set. The application realizes the accurate identification and monitoring of backward propagation thunderstorm, and effectively improves the early warning accuracy and timeliness.
assignees: LIAONING METEOROLOGICAL OBSERVATORY;Liaoning Meteorological Disaster Monitoring and Warning Center

title_en: Strobe light alarm detection and alert system
abstract_en: An alert system includes a detection device (14) that detects an optical alarm signal, such as a light pattern generated by a strobe light (12) of a building alarm system. Upon detecting the optical alarm signal, the alert system generates a supplemental alert signal capable of alerting an individual who might not otherwise respond to the alarm condition, such as an individual who is asleep, hearing impaired, and/or sight impaired. For example, the system may activate a tactile vibrator (22), a low frequency audio generator (26), and/or a liquid sprayer (28). The system may, for example, be implemented as a patient-worn device, a bedside unit, or a personal computer coupled to a light-sensing peripheral device.

title_en: Fire alarm system for hearing-impaired person
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire alarm system for the hearing impaired is provided to immediately find fire occurrence and location, regardless of where people with hearing impairment are present indoors. CONSTITUTION: A fire alarm system for the hearing impaired includes a plurality of wireless alarm devices(100). The wireless alarm device is installed in the vicinity of a fire detector(50) installed in the ceiling of each room. The wireless alarm device includes a fire detection reception unit(110), a control unit(130), and a wireless transception unit(140). The control unit lights a light-emitting unit if a fire detection signal is received from the fire detection reception unit or the wireless transception unit. The control unit transmits the fire detection signal and a unique ID to the other wireless alarm devices when a fire detection signal is received from the fire detection reception unit. The other wireless alarm devices display a location corresponding to the unique ID based on the unique ID received from the wireless transception unit on a display unit. [Reference numerals] (50) Smoke detector;
