title_en: Medical alert and monitoring for the hearing impaired
abstract_en: An illustrative method includes receiving, by a processor of a computing device, a request to initiate a call from a portable electronic device. The call is a communication across a communication network. The method also includes initiating, by the processor of the computing device, the call. The call connects the portable electronic device to an emergency response service. The call also utilizes a relay service.

title_en: Environment monitoring GPS and communication pre-warning system based on forest fire prevention
abstract_en: The utility model is applicable to the environment monitoring field, and provides an environment monitoring GPS and communication pre-warning system based on forest fire prevention. The environment monitoring GPS and communication pre-warning system comprises a wireless communication module, a satellite communication module, a satellite positioning module, a video monitoring module, a sensor module, a power supply module and a central processor, wherein the output ends of the satellite positioning module, the video monitoring module and the sensor module are respectively connected with the input terminal of the central processor, the central processor is respectively connected with the wireless communication module and the satellite communication module, and the wireless communication module, the satellite communication module, the satellite positioning module, the video monitoring module, the sensor module and thee central processor are electrically connected with the power supply module respectively. Through satellite positioning and satellite communication, the environment monitoring GPS and communication pre-warning system realizes complementation of communication blind areas of 2G and 3G networks and covers a wider scope. Solar power supply, resource conservation and environment protection are achieved. The pre-warning system is simple in structure, convenient for use, easy for operation and low in cost.

title_en: Intelligent security inspection alarm system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent security inspection alarm system, which comprises a portrait snapshot device, an X-ray detector, a security inspection analysis device, an alarm device and a security inspection platform server; the utility model discloses can carry out comprehensive automatic upgrading to transportation system passenger safety inspection link, realize passenger luggage parcel safety inspection intelligence auxiliary function, make things convenient for the security check personnel to promote parcel safety inspection efficiency to but real-time early warning, accessible portrait snapshot device when unusual warning, the passenger of unusual parcel is placed in quick location, and the potential safety hazard is got rid of to the at utmost, has promoted the security for transportation system's operation.
assignees: SICHUAN RUIYUN XINTONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Belt detection device and belt conveying equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses belt detection device and belt conveying equipment relates to belt conveying equipment technical field. The belt detection device comprises a rack, and at least one detection module and a processor which are arranged on the rack, wherein the at least one detection module comprises a fixed adjusting frame, a movable adjusting frame and a visual detection mechanism, the fixed adjusting frame is vertically arranged on the rack, the movable adjusting frame is arranged on the fixed adjusting frame in a lifting and adjusting manner along the vertical direction, the visual detection mechanism is hinged on the movable adjusting frame, and the visual detection mechanism is used for acquiring image information of a preset area on the surface of a belt; the processor is electrically connected with the visual inspection mechanism, the processor is used for acquiring image information and identifying the image information, and when a foreign body or a crack is identified, the processor sends out a warning signal to prompt an operator to timely process or maintain, so that the normal and stable operation of the belt is ensured, accidents are avoided, the production safety is improved, and the economic loss is reduced.
assignees: BEIJING WATTMAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Server cabinet with early warning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a server cabinet with an early warning function, which comprises a cabinet body and a cabinet door, wherein the top end of the cabinet body is fixedly connected with a top seat, one end of the cabinet body is fixedly connected with a fixed shell, one end of the cabinet body is provided with a first reserved groove, one end of the cabinet body is movably hinged with the cabinet door, and a placing plate is arranged inside the cabinet body. The utility model provides a server rack with early warning function is through being provided with parts such as smoke sensor, alarm lamp, self-triggering ware, fixed case, the pump body, utilizes the smoke sensor that sets up, when the inside smog that has is perceived, the accessible alarm lamp carries out the early warning, simultaneously through self-triggering ware, trigger the valve and open automatically, the pump body can be with the inside carbon dioxide of fixed case through exhaust tube and connecting pipe row into rack body, can carry out fire prevention protection in advance for reduce certain potential safety hazard, solved the problem of carrying out fire prevention protection in advance when inconvenient early warning.
assignees: WEIQIXING JIANGSU TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A kind of construction warning signs device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of construction warning signs device, including pillar, it is fixedly installed on the plug body of the lower rod end and is fixedly mounted on the warning sign on the pillar top, cavity is provided with the plug body, slide slot is symmetrically set with the cavity sidewalls, the slide slot medial extremity is provided with the connectivity slot for connecting the cavity, the slide slot outboard end is installed with baffle plate, and it is slidably fitted with sliding block in the slide slot, the sliding block outboard end is provided with the plate of flat, the slot for allowing the plate to stretch out is provided with the baffle plate, the cannelure extended up and down is provided with the pillar；Apparatus of the present invention are simple in construction, easy to use, in the presence of plate, pillar is not easy to translate into and is rotated, so as to reduce potential safety hazard.
assignees: GUANGZHOU LINGZHAO TRAFFIC EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method for eliminating false alarm of distress call device by assisting in detecting motion of distress call device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for assisting in measuring motion and eliminating false alarm of a call-for-help device, which relates to the technical field of safety protection equipment and comprises a call-for-help device main body and a bracelet; the bracelet acquires motion signals of the wrist of a firefighter in real time through the first acceleration sensor, and sends control signals to the main body of the distress call device through the first wireless processor chip under the condition that the motion signals are acquired; the calling-for-help device main part passes through the motion signal of second acceleration sensor real-time acquisition firefighter health position, under the motion signal's of not gathering firefighter health position the condition, carry out the counter count, reach under the condition of predetermineeing the numerical value at count data, the control alarm sends alarm instruction, and under the condition of receiving control signal through the second wireless processor chip, reset count data, combine bracelet detection firefighter motion state, the alert operation of accessible motion signal cancellation wrong report, and then play the effect of accurate warning, provide the guarantee to firefighter's security.
assignees: TIANJIN TIANAN BORUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electronic escorting system and escorting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic escort system which comprises a vehicle end and a server end, wherein the vehicle end and the server end are in communication connection through a 4G wireless network, the vehicle end comprises an AEBS emergency braking system, a blind area detection system, a backward anti-collision warning system, a central control processor and a video terminal system, and the AEBS emergency braking system, the blind area detection system, the backward anti-collision warning system and the video terminal system are in communication connection with the central control processor. According to the invention, manual escort is replaced by electronic real-time supervision escort, so that the operation efficiency in the escort workflow is improved, the safety control on the transported goods is effectively enhanced, the automation and the intellectualization of the handover process are realized, the accuracy of the handover process is improved, the labor cost in the goods handover process is greatly reduced, the electronic escort has a function greater than that of manual operation, is more manual than manual operation, is not emotional, and is not fatigued, easy to manage, has been adopted in the trade, and has been complained by the workers and is faithful to the guard.

title_en: Health data monitoring and analyzing system for aged people
abstract_en: The application discloses a health data monitoring and analyzing system for pension people, which relates to the technical field of intelligent pension service and comprises the following steps: the system comprises an information input module, a health index acquisition module, a health index analysis module, a health early warning module and a health service module. The application can intelligently arrange and track the rehabilitation training or treatment process of rehabilitation personnel, ensure the comprehensiveness and reliability of the health monitoring of the old, avoid neglecting hidden danger in front of the focus, ensure the timeliness of the diagnosis of medical institutions, avoid neglecting or deteriorating the illness state and avoid blindness of the visit, thereby improving the efficiency of the visit of the medical institutions.
assignees: HEFEI SHENGDONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A fire alarm method and a fire alarm apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention provides a fire alarming method and a fire alarming apparatus, the method capable of clearly delivering a fire alarm even to hearing-impaired persons with presbycusis. According to the present invention, the method comprises the following steps of: (a) repeating, three to five times, a fire alarm sound which has a maximum frequency of 2,700 to 4,400 Hz, a minimum frequency of with 450 to 550 Hz, and a length of 900 to 1,100 ms and includes a sweep sound section of 450 to 550 ms or longer where the frequency falls from the maximum frequency to the minimum frequency; and (b) repeating a fire alarm message twice or three times. The apparatus comprises: a detection unit to detect smoke or heat; a speaker unit; and a control unit to transmit the fire alarm sound and message to the speaker unit when the smoke or heat of a predetermined reference level or more is detected by the detection unit, wherein the fire alarm sound and message are transmitted according to the fire alarming method.

title_en: Event Communication System for Providing User Alerts
abstract_en: An event communication system involves facilitating entry by a user of one or more device addresses via a network accessible user interface of the event communication system. The device addresses are associated with alerts provided by the event communication system. Test alert messages targeted for the device addresses are sent via the user interface. The system sends alerts user devices corresponding to the one or more tested device addresses in response to predetermined events. The system may provide user access to historical copies of data relating to the alerts. Registration on the system involves storing a personal identity data of a student on a database and comparing the personal identity data to registration data entered via the user interface. Authentication is automatically provided based on the comparison.

title_en: Signal processing system and methods for reliably detecting audible alarms
abstract_en: A signal processing system and associated methods are disclosed for reliably detecting audible alert signals, such as Temporal-3 and Temporal-4 alert signals generated by commercially available smoke, fire, and carbon monoxide detectors. The system and methods are capable of detecting audible alert signals of different intensities in the presence of dynamic background environment (e.g., television programming, music, noise, and the like). The signal processing system and methods may, in some embodiments, be incorporated into a bedside or other unit that generates a supplemental alert signal capable of alerting individuals who might not otherwise respond to the audible alert signal, such as individuals who are asleep, hearing impaired, or intoxicated.
assignees: HOY LESLIE D;ALBERT DAVID E;SMITH LANDGRAVE T;LEWIS JAMES J;INNOVALARM CORP

title_en: Dyke monitoring analysis method and system based on superconducting magnetic quantum sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam monitoring analysis method and a dam monitoring analysis system based on a superconducting magnetic quantum sensor, which relate to the technical field of dam safety monitoring and intelligent analysis and comprise the steps of constructing by combining FOC-DFT signal processing with DPD cost function, realizing high-resolution positioning of an abnormal source, enhancing weak signal extraction and noise immunity, realizing independent extraction of stress, seepage and crack characteristics by combining spatial clustering with PICA blind source decomposition, and improving the resolution capability of multiple physical coupling effects; the inversion calculation of parameters such as stress, seepage and magnetic permeability is realized by combining the sparse Bayesian inversion and the compressed sensing through the multi-physical field coupling model, the accuracy of analysis of an abnormal mechanism is improved, the trend prediction and the risk assessment of hidden danger of the dykes are realized by combining the LSTM time sequence modeling and the comprehensive abnormal scoring mechanism, and the prospective and intelligent level of early warning are improved.

title_en: Solar towers hangs collision avoidance system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a solar towers hangs collision avoidance system, including setting up the anti -collision early warning control cabinet on the tower crane jib loading boom, anti -collision early warning control cabinet includes electric connection's shot -light inductor, controller and alarm in proper order, the shot -light inductor is connected with ultraviolet shot -light, the ultraviolet ray shot -light light irradiation direction perpendicularly towards tower crane jack -up object space to, controller radio communication is connected with tower crane control center, prevent that impact system has still included solar power unit, ultraviolet ray shot -light, controller and alarm all with solar power unit connects. The utility model provides a solar towers hangs collision avoidance system, intelligent monitoring report to the police make tower crane operating personnel the operation tower crane occasionally the scientific basis, lift by crane the vision blind area and has carried out effective judgement, artificially go through the potential safety hazard that sensitization or artifical suggestion led to the fact when having avoided the jack -up.

title_en: Optical fiber ring temperature monitoring device with warning function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of optical fiber ring temperature monitoring and discloses an optical fiber ring temperature monitoring device with a warning function, which comprises a base, wherein a ceramic support used for bearing an optical fiber ring is fixedly arranged on the base, an inner ring, a middle ring and an outer ring are coaxially arranged on the ceramic support from top to bottom, an FBG temperature sensor I is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the inner ring, an FBG temperature sensor II is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the middle ring, an FBG temperature sensor III is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the outer ring, and the FBG temperature sensor I, the FBG temperature sensor II and the FBG temperature sensor III are connected with an optical coupler through transmission optical fibers in a signal mode. Through setting up FBG temperature sensor one, two, three respectively at ceramic support's inner ring, zhong, outer loop, realize the synchronous monitoring to the different regional temperatures of optic fibre ring, solved traditional single-point monitoring and can't catch the problem of local temperature difference, ensure no temperature monitoring blind area, accurately reflect the whole temperature distribution state of optic fibre ring.

title_en: Method and device for obtaining forest fire monitoring blind area based on stationary meteorological satellite
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for obtaining a forest fire monitoring blind area by a stationary meteorological satellite, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining DEM data, observation point longitude and latitude, stationary meteorological satellite orbit height and stationary meteorological satellite orbit longitude and latitude of an observation area; calculating a slope limit minimum angle theta according to DEM data and the orbit height of the stationary meteorological satellite to obtain a slope limit range [ theta, 90 DEG ]; calculating the distance between the static meteorological satellite and the observation point and the distance between the observation point and the equator according to the longitude and latitude of the observation point and the longitude and latitude of the orbit of the static meteorological satellite to obtain a slope direction limiting initial angle beta and obtain a slope direction limiting range [ beta, beta +180 degrees ]; and if the slope angle of the observation pixel is within the slope limiting range, and the elevation value of the observation pixel is greater than 0, judging that the observation pixel is a forest fire monitoring blind area of the observation area. The application can realize the extraction of the forest fire monitoring blind area of the observation area and reduce the warning of the forest fire leakage.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Risk monitoring and early warning system based on industrial enterprise safety production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk early warning, in particular to a risk monitoring early warning system based on industrial enterprise safety production, which comprises a fixed guide rail fixed at the upper end of a side wall of a workshop, a movable frame is slidably arranged on the fixed guide rail, the upper end and the lower end of the movable frame are installed together with a fixed guide rail through two fixing mechanisms, a translation motor is fixed on the inner side of the upper end of the fixed guide rail, a driving gear is fixed on the translation motor, and a rack meshed with the driving gear is fixed on the fixed guide rail. The dust removal system has the advantages that the environment, the temperature and the air quality in a factory can be monitored through the camera, the infrared temperature sensor and the air analyzer, potential safety hazards in a workshop can be found in time conveniently, the safety production of enterprises is guaranteed, the dust removal system can be used for cleaning floating dust on the surface of the camera, meanwhile, the cleaned floating dust can be processed to prevent the floating dust from drifting into the factory again, the air quality is guaranteed, and the cleaned dust is prevented from drifting onto the camera again.
assignees: JUNENG XIANKONG HANGZHOU DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Alerting method and alerting system
title_ko: 경보 발령 방법 및 경보 발령 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are an alerting method and an alerting system. The alerting method according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a step of determining an altering region in a radius selected based on an alerting generation position, according to the generation of an alert, a step of writing an alert message related to the alerting region, and a step of transmitting the written alert message to a user terminal, in consideration of language setting in the user terminal located in the alerting region. So, both Koreans and foreigners can quickly cope with a disaster.
abstract_ko: 경보 발령 방법 및 경보 발령 시스템이 개시된다.  본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 경보 발령 방법은, 경보 발생에 따라, 경보 발생 위치를 기준으로 하는 선정된 반경 이내를 경보 발령 지역으로 결정하는 단계와, 상기 경보 발령 지역과 연관된 경보 메시지를 작성하는 단계, 및 상기 경보 발령 지역에 위치하는 사용자 단말에서의 언어 설정을 고려하여, 상기 작성된 경보 메시지를 상기 사용자 단말로 전달하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Heat and humidity detection plant pot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a heat and humidity detection plant pot, which is to detect changes in temperature and humidity through a plant pot body, and allows enough sound to be heard indoors through a speaker so as to solve the problem of difficulty in management by beginners and the visually impaired, such that the existing simple preservation function allows subjective observation of soil and plant conditions during cultivation, thereby solving the problem of difficulty in management by the beginners and the visually impaired. According to the present invention, the heat and humidity detection plant pot comprises: a pot body which is formed to turn red in the temperature and humidity environment set through LED lights to indicate changes in temperature and humidity detection in the plant pot; a soil temperature and humidity sensor designed to display real-time temperature and humidity values so that soil humidity and temperature can be measured; and a speaker configured to sound a notification at a set time and frequency intervals in a temperature and humidity environment in which the sound is set to be sufficiently audible indoors. Therefore, the present invention displays the detected changes in temperature and humidity by the pot body, and allows enough sound to be audible indoors through the speaker, thereby solving the problem of difficulty in management by the beginners and the visually impaired. Therefore, the existing simple preservation function allows subjective observation of soil and plant conditions during cultivation, thereby solving the problem of difficulty in management by the beginners and the visually impaired.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 온습도 감지 화분에 관한 것으로서 화분 본체에 의하여 온습도 감지 변화를 나타낼 수 있게 하고, 스피커에 의하여 실내에서 충분히 소리가 들릴 수 있게 함으로써 초보자 및 시각장애인이 관리하기에 어려운 문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 단순히 보존하는 기능으로 재배 시 토양 및 식물 상태를 주관적으로 관찰하여 초보자 및 시각장애인이 관리하기에 어려운 문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 화분에 있어서 온습도 감지 변화를 나타낼 수 있게 LED등을 통해 설정된 온도, 습도 환경에서 붉은색을 띄도록 형성한 화분 본체, 토양의 습도와 온도 측정을 할 수 있게 실시간 온도와 습도 값이 보여질 수 있도록 형성한 토양온습도센서, 실내에서 충분히 소리가 들릴 수 있게 설정된 온도, 습도 환경에서 알림이 설정한 시간과 횟수 간격으로 울리도록 구성한 스피커로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 화분 본체에 의하여 온습도 감지 변화를 나타낼 수 있게 하고, 스피커에 의하여 실내에서 충분히 소리가 들릴 수 있게 함으로써 초보자 및 시각장애인이 관리하기에 어려운 문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 단순히 보존하는 기능으로 재배 시 토양 및 식물 상태를 주관적으로 관찰하여 초보자 및 시각장애인이 관리하기에 어려운 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Outdoor motion safety early warning and track tracking protection method based on hearing impaired people
abstract_en: The invention provides an outdoor sports safety early warning and track tracking protection method based on hearing impaired people, which relates to the technical field of safety and comprises the steps of acquiring the positions of the hearing impaired people and the dynamic elements of the environment, and evaluating collision risk through a track prediction algorithm, screening and adapting non-acoustic sensing signals according to the risk level, and sending a dynamically adjusted direction indication to the wearable equipment. The invention can identify the dangerous source in real time, accurately forecast the collision risk, and personally present non-acoustic warning signals, thereby effectively improving the safety of outdoor activities of hearing impaired people and reducing the incidence rate of safety accidents.

title_en: System for providing location alerts relating to emergencies
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for generating alerts communicated to emergency responders and/or contacts indicating a location of an incident. The system comprises a housing, one or more light sources, and a computing processor. A switch is located in the housing and configured to be accessible to a user. When the switch is actuated by a user indicating an incident, the processor provides power to the at least one light source to output light from the housing thereby indicating the location of the system. The system may also control a speaker to output an audible signal and a transmitter to transmit an emergency signal with location information to a device of an emergency responder and/or an emergency contact. The present invention may also be embodied in a software application that is implemented on a mobile device to thereby leverage the components of the mobile device to send alerts.

title_en: A kind of fire exit door circuit control device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire exit door circuit control devices, including warning device, circuit controller and the fire-fighting door gear being sequentially connected.Warning device includes alarm parallel circuit, and alarm parallel circuit includes concatenated normal open switch and alarm buzzer, in parallel between parallel circuit of respectively alarming, and is connect with DC power supply；Circuit controller includes the signal input wires interface being sequentially connected, microcontroller, photo-coupler, relay normally open contact and signal output connection interface；Fire-fighting door gear includes fire exit door, and fire exit door is equipped with fire-fighting lock, and fire-fighting lock includes door bolt and the motor of driving door bolt movement；Fire exit door circuit control device further includes the control computer being connected with circuit controller.The utility model fire exit door circuit control device can be opened all fire exit doors while pressing alarm, it is ensured that escape way is accessible, and people can at the first time escape from the fire scene after fire, and the apparatus structure is simple, easy for installation when fire occurs.

title_en: A safe numerical control lathe for teaching
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safe numerical control lathe for teaching, including control box, end cabinet and control subassembly, the welding of positive one side of control box has first storage plate, the welding of the positive opposite side of control box has the second storage plate, the positive top fixed mounting of second storage plate has the sound siren, the control subassembly is installed through the bolt in the inside top of control box. The utility model discloses an install light siren and sound alarm respectively at the positive top of first storage plate and second storage plate, accessible control panel transmits the signal of telecommunication for sound siren and light siren when the device is moving, sound siren and light alarm can send the acousto-optic warning when receiving the signal of telecommunication of control panel transmission, the warning staff device is about to move, effectively avoid the staff to operate at the device maloperation of time, staff's operational safety has been guaranteed, the security performance of device has been improved.
assignees: JINAN WANTIAN NUMERICAL CONTROL MACHINERY CO LTD

title_en: Drainage bag with induction function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drainage bag with induction function, which is characterized in that the drainage bag comprises a drainage bag body, a first inductor and a second inductor are arranged on the drainage bag body, the first inductor comprises a first shell, a first circuit board and a luminous bulb, a light control circuit is arranged on the first circuit board, a light transmission window is arranged on the first shell, the second inductor comprises a second shell, a second circuit board, a processing module connected with the second circuit board, a flash bulb, a distance measuring module and a voice broadcasting module, the distance measuring module is provided with a first distance threshold value and a second distance threshold value, the processing module controls the flash bulb to carry out flash warning operation when the distance between a foreign object and the drainage bag body reaches the first distance threshold value, the processing module controls the voice broadcasting module to carry out voice warning operation when the distance between the foreign object and the drainage bag body reaches the second distance threshold value, this drainage bag can play luminous suggestion effect and warn the effect to the people that will be close to the drainage bag night.

title_en: Motorcycle doubling auxiliary system and motorcycle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a motorcycle doubling auxiliary system, which comprises a host, a detection radar and a prompting device, wherein the host is in communication connection with the detection radar and the prompting device; the detection radar is arranged at the rear part of the motorcycle and is used for detecting obstacles in a preset diameter range behind the motorcycle; the host computer is connected with the detection radar and the prompting device in a communicating mode, and the host computer is used for controlling the prompting device to trigger corresponding warning according to the position of the obstacle detected by the detection radar. The utility model can prompt the motorcycle driver in time through the prompting device when the obstacle influencing lane changing exists behind the motorcycle, thereby assisting the motorcycle driver to monitor the blind area, improving the driving safety and eliminating the potential safety hazard of the road. The utility model also discloses a motorcycle.

title_en: Wireless fire sensing system of apartment house for the deaf
title_ko: 청각 장애인을 위한 공동 주택 무선 화재 감지 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 소리를 듣지 못하는 청각 장애인을 위한 공동 주택 무선 화재 감지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 아파트 등 공동주택에서는 화재가 발생하였을 때 현관 밖의 소화전에서 소리로 화재에 대한 위험 경고를 큰 경종 소리로 알려 주게 된다. 그러나 소리를 듣지 못하는 청각 장애인의 경우 밖에서 들리는 경고 소리를 듣지 못해 집안에서 화재 경보 대응을 하지 못하게 되어 위험에 처할 수 있는 가능성이 있다. 소방법에 의거, 이미 설비인증 받은 소화 시설은 어떠한 형태로든 변경, 변형이 안되기 때문에 기존의 화재 경보기에는 일체 손을 댈 수가 없다. 하여 기존의 화재 경보기 부근에 근접 부착할 수 있는 무선 경보 소리 감지 발신기를 통해 빛이나 진동으로 경보를 집안의 청각 장애인에게 확실하게 알려 주어 화재경보시 안전하게 대응할 수 있게 한 청각장애인을 위한 공동 주택 무선 화재 감지 시스템으로 매우 유용한 고안인 것이다.

title_en: Driving safety early warning method, system, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a driving safety early warning method, a driving safety early warning system, a storage medium and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring vehicle state data of a vehicle in a current driving environment, wherein the vehicle state data comprises vehicle driving data and road surface state data; combining a pre-trained deep learning model, performing data fusion and feature data extraction on vehicle driving data and road surface state data, and performing dimensionality reduction processing on the data subjected to feature extraction to obtain driving early warning information; and acquiring and responding to the driving early warning information, and sending the driving early warning information to the vehicle-mounted unit so that the vehicle-mounted unit provides driving safety early warning for the driving of the vehicle. According to the driving safety early warning method, the driving safety early warning system, the storage medium and the driving safety early warning device, the vehicle-mounted unit and the road side unit are arranged and used for acquiring data in the driving process of the vehicle, so that data assistance is provided for the driving of the vehicle conveniently, and the situation that a driver cannot take safe driving operation in time due to a vision blind area to cause a safety accident is avoided.

title_en: Intelligent early warning cable of integrated detection module
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent early warning cables and discloses an intelligent early warning cable integrated with a detection module, which comprises a cable conductor, wherein a cable core is fixedly connected inside the cable conductor, a connecting terminal is fixedly connected to the left side of the surface of the cable core, a monitoring optical fiber module is fixedly connected inside the cable conductor, an early warning fire extinguishing piece is arranged at the top of the cable conductor and used for early warning and extinguishing fire when the temperature of the cable core is abnormal, and the early warning fire extinguishing piece comprises a guide sleeve. According to the invention, through the transmission structure of the double-shaft motor linkage speed reducer, the sliding sleeve, the sliding rod and the concave plate, the powder spraying pipe, the temperature sensor and the flame sensor are driven to swing in a reciprocating manner, each cable core and the connecting terminal can be scanned, a monitoring blind area is avoided, the controller opens the miniature electromagnetic valve, so that fire extinguishing powder in the fire extinguishing tank is rapidly injected into the powder spraying pipe in a swinging state, the spraying range covers a plurality of installation positions, and the comprehensiveness of hidden danger detection is improved.

title_en: VANET Warning Message Propagation Method for Electric Wave Blind Area
title_ko: 전파 음영지역에서의 vanet 경고 메시지 전달 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vehicular ad-hoc network (VANET) warning message transmission method which can be used in a radio wave shadow area. More specifically, the present invention relates to a VANET warning message transmission technology using routing information and dividing the state of a node into a direct mode and a redirect mode to execute an operation. According to the present invention, the VANET warning message transmission method, which can be used in a radio wave shadow area, includes the steps of: receiving an initial warning message from an emergency occurrence node; checking whether a node is in an intersection area by checking whether the weight of the intersection is one or not; operating in redirect- mode when the weight of the intersection is not one; checking whether there is only a single node when the weight of the intersection is one; transmitting a warning message when there is only one node; checking which node has higher transmission priority when there is more than one node; and executing a warning message transmission process upon checking the node with the higher transmission priority and making other nodes with lower transmission priority wait.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전파 음영지역에서의 VANET 경고 메시지 전달 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 라우팅 정보를 이용하면서 노드의 상태를 다이렉트 모드와 리다이렉트 모드로 이원화하여 동작하게 하는 VANET 경고 메세지 전달 기술에 관한 것이다. 

본 발명에 따른 전파 음영지역에서의 VANET 경고 메시지 전달 방법은 긴급 상황 발생 노드로부터 최초 경고 메시지를 수신하는 단계; 교차로 가중치가 1인지 확인하여 상기 노드가 교차로 영역에 있는지 확인하는 단계; 교차로 가중치가 1이 아닐 경우 리다이렉트 모드로 진행하는 단계; 교차로 가중치가 1인 경우에 한 개의 노드만 존재하는지 확인하는 단계; 노드가 한 개만 존재하는 경우, 경고 메시지를 전달하는 단계; 노드가 한 개만 존재하지 않는 경우, 높은 전달 우선순위인지 확인하는 단계; 높은 전달 순위로 확인되면 경고 메시지 전달 과정을 수행하고 높은 전달 순위가 아니면 대기하는 단계;로 진행되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: YOUNGSAN UNIV IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Emergency mobile notification handling
abstract_en: Systems and methods for handling emergency notification messages such as Commercial Mobile Alert System (CMAS) alerts. In an example scenario, a call center maintains personal profiles of a number of clients, including contact information for persons or other entities designated by the clients to receive information about the clients. The call center receives from a device associated with a particular client of the call center that the client's device has received a text-based emergency notification message. The call center notifies one or more of the designated entities. The notification may include the content of the emergency notification message, and may include an audio version of the notification message. An indication or the notification message may also be placed in a database accessible to one or more of the designated persons or entities.

title_en: Standard text-based sign language translation system, disaster/emergency broadcasting system, sign language translation transmission method and system, and disaster text message sending system utilizing the translation system
title_ko: 표준문안 기반 수어번역시스템과 이를 이용한 재난/응급방송시스템, 수어번역 전송방법과 시스템 및 재난문자 발송시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a standard draft based sign language translation system that can be suitably used in a disaster/emergency broadcasting system of high-speed trains such as SRT and KTX, subways, and light rails, and can be useful for other disaster text message transmission systems. The standard draft based sign language translation system comprises: an original text analysis module that automatically analyzes approved text information and extracts information on a standard draft identifier and characters in a variable text part; and an animation data generation module that retrieves the information output from the original text analysis module in a database, extracts fixed text part animation data and finger language animation data, and generates animation data corresponding to combined and approved standard draft.
abstract_ko: SRT, KTX 등의 고속열차, 지하철, 경전철 등 열차의 재난/응급방송시스템에 적합하게 활용할 수 있고, 여타 재난문자 발송시스템 등에도 유용하게 활용될 수 있는 표준문안기반 수어번역시스템이 개시된다. 상기 표준문안 기반 수어번역시스템은 인가되는 문자정보를 자동으로 분석하여 표준문안에 대한 식별자와 가변문자부의 문자에 대한 정보를 추출하는 원문분석모듈, 원문분석모듈에서 출력되는 정보를 데이터베이스에 조회하여 고정문자부 애니메이션 데이터와 지화 애니메이션 데이터를 추출하고 조합하여 인가되는 표준문안에 대응하는 애니메이션 데이터를 생성하는 애니메이션 데이터 생성모듈을 포함하는 구성을 한다.

title_en: Gas detector acoustic-optic alarm
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of rational in infrastructure, the gas detector acoustic-optic alarm of safety anti-explosive, comprise light shield (1), housing (2), bilateral (3), nut (4), bilateral inner chamber (5), cable (6), plug (7), cushion rubber (8), acoustic shell (9), large cushion rubber (10), screw (11), hummer (12), hold-down ring (13), ventail (14), annulus frame (15), main circuit board (16), epoxy resin encapsulation (17), luminous circuit board (18) and screw (19).Gas detector acoustic-optic alarm of the present utility model, rational in infrastructure, safety anti-explosive, warning effect is without blind spot; Adopt dual channel structure, the position that nut (4) can pass through setting nut (4) with plug (7) is connected arbitrarily with cabinet or detector, realizes detector and the general function of cabinet, saving man-hour cost; Annulus frame realizes the general equipment arrangement that vertical installation and hanging installation neither affect warning effect; Realize chimes of doom decibel adjustable.
assignees: BEIJING YANSHAN TIMES INSTR CO LTD

title_en: intelligent blind guiding crutch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a blind walking stick is led to intelligence, include: the device comprises a control module, a power supply module, an ultrasonic transduction module, a voice broadcasting module, a clock module, an alarm lamp and a photosensitive resistor; the power supply module, the ultrasonic transduction module, the voice broadcasting module, the clock module and the warning lamp are all connected with the control module; the photosensitive resistor is connected with the warning lamp; the ultrasonic transduction module detects obstacles by using ultrasonic waves, detected echoes are processed by the control module, and if the obstacles exist, the obstacles are broadcasted by the voice broadcasting module; the voice broadcasting module is also used for broadcasting time; when the light becomes dark at night, the photosensitive resistor controls the warning lamp to flash according to the brightness of the surrounding environment. The utility model provides a blind walking stick is led to intelligence can in time discern barrier and send the suggestion on every side, very big life that has made things convenient for the blind person, has effectively alleviateed the inconvenient potential safety hazard that brings of blind person's walking.

title_en: Novel fire control smoke exhaust fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel fire-fighting smoke exhaust fan which is connected with an air duct through a cylinder body, wherein a motor fixing cylinder is fixed inside the cylinder body, a plurality of locking bolts penetrate through the outer wall of the motor fixing cylinder, an internal motor is fixed through the locking bolts, and a driving seat is fixed at the front end of the internal motor to fix a plurality of fan blades; the driving seat is of a U-shaped structure, a plurality of outer U-shaped grooves are formed in the inner wall of the driving seat, fireproof materials are arranged in the outer U-shaped grooves, and fire prevention is achieved through the matching of the inner U-shaped grooves and the outer U-shaped grooves; through setting up the fixing base in luring the wind downthehole and being used for realizing sound generating mechanism's fixed, can realize the warning effect after this device starts, moreover, its fixed protection network of tip through outside ventilation pipe realizes the protection, prevents that foreign matter from getting into under the state that the device portion used, influences its normal work.
assignees: TEXAS ASIA TAITAO GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Hazard-sensitive headset
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hazard-sensitive headset for predicting and alerting the possibility of collision with a surrounding object, which comprises: an object recognition unit for recognizing one or more surrounding objects approaching a headset wearer; a parameter calculating unit for calculating a distance and an approach speed with respect to the one or more recognized objects; an alarm control unit for controlling an alarm by determining a collision risk in a manner of real-time tracking the accessibility of the object with the highest probability of collision based on the calculated distance to and approach speed of each object; and an alarm unit for outputting an alarm under the control of the alarm control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 주변 사물과의 충돌 가능성을 예측하여 경보하는 위험감지 헤드셋에 관한 것으로, 헤드셋 착용자로 접근중인 하나 이상의 주변 사물을 인식하기 위한 사물 인식부와; 하나 이상 인식된 각 사물과의 거리 및 접근 속도를 산출하기 위한 파라미터 산출부와; 산출된 각 사물과의 거리 및 접근 속도로부터 충돌 가능성이 가장 높게 예측되는 사물의 접근성을 일정 시간 동안 실시간 추적하는 방식으로 충돌위험 판단하여 경보 제어하는 경보 제어부와; 상기 경보 제어부의 제어에 따라 경보 출력하는 경보부;를 포함함을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KUMOH NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF TECH INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION;YOU WON BIN;JANG EUN YEONG;PARK SANG GEUN

title_en: Smart natural disaster alert system
abstract_en: A smart natural disaster alert system comprising a central controller and alert machine units. The central controller is placed either at a Bureau of Agriculture, a meteorological observatory or other places and collects early warning information such as weather and geological disasters via a dedicated data channel or a network. The alert machine units carry out data communication via a GPRS channel at places where GPRS signals are widespread and communicate via a satellite datalink at blind spots of GPRS coverage. The central controller collects, collates, organizes, and distributes the early warning information and, after processing, transmits by means of short messages to any alert machine unit in need of such. When the early warning information is received by the alert machine unit, same alerts the public in the corresponding area by means of GPRS short message forwarding or loudspeaker broadcast. The smart natural disaster alert system fully utilizes complementary characteristics between GPRS and satellite communication technologies, provides comprehensive communication coverage, ensures that the alert information has no blind spot, and allows the smart alert machine units to be flexibly distributed and free from effects of terrain.

title_en: Yellow Fellow Safety Signs
abstract_en: This is a unique wet floor safety sign that has the ability that no other wet floor signs has. It has the ability to give aid in early warning to the seeing impaired and to caution the unexpected person of a potential hazard by sounding a loud beeping sound or speaking a pre-recorded message. This wet floor sign also has flashing LED lights to help aid the hearing impaired when navigating their way around schools, stores, airports, shopping malls, and hospitals. By using an early warning system this will help in reducing the second leading cause of accidental deaths, the terrible slips, trips and falls.

title_en: System and Method for Locating, Supporting, and Ensuring the Safety of Local Vendors through a Mobile Application Platform
abstract_en: System disclosed herein aims to provide users with an easy way to locate and support local vendors like taco trucks and tamale vendors. For a monthly fee, vendors can register and list their locations on an interactive map, making them easily accessible to users. The app includes a distress button that vendors and users can activate in emergencies to alert nearby app users and authorities. Core features include user registration with email verification, vendor registration with detailed business information, a searchable map interface for locating vendors, and an emergency alert system. Additionally, the app offers a sponsorship section where users can support their favorite vendors through yearly subscriptions and donations via a secure payment gateway. The professional and business-oriented homepage prominently displays the app's logo and name, enhancing brand recognition. Overall, Vendor Finder improves local vendor visibility, community safety, and user engagement.

title_en: Development machine early warning linkage system and method based on thermal imaging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a development machine early warning linkage system and a development machine early warning linkage method based on thermal imaging, which relate to the technical field of underground intelligent monitoring of coal mines and comprise a data acquisition module, an edge calculation gateway module, an audible and visual alarm module and a terminal monitoring module; the system comprises a data acquisition module, an edge computing gateway module, an audible and visual alarm module, a terminal monitoring module and a monitoring interface, wherein the data acquisition module is used for monitoring thermal imaging video streams and temperature data around the underground development machine in real time, the edge computing gateway module is used for identifying potential safety hazards, and once an abnormal situation is found, the edge computing gateway module immediately sends an instruction to the audible and visual alarm module to enable the audible and visual alarm module to send an audible and visual alarm signal and simultaneously control the running state of the development machine, and the terminal monitoring module is used for receiving early warning information sent by the edge computing gateway module and displaying monitoring information around the development machine on the monitoring interface in real time. The invention effectively solves the problem of sensing the working condition of the area near the heading machine, effectively reduces the visual field blind area of the staff when the heading operation is carried out, and ensures the safe and efficient production of the underground coal mine.

title_en: Emergency disaster warning system using TTS
title_ko: 문자음성 변환을 이용한 재난 경보 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 문자음성 변환을 이용한 재난 경보 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 재난 경보 시스템은, 재난 관리 센터에서 사용자 단말기로 문자를 전송하여 재난정보를 알리는 재난 경보 시스템에 있어서, 상기 재난 관리 센터로부터 재난정보를 문자로 수신하는 재난정보 수신부, 재난정보가 수신되는 상기 사용자 단말기에서 사용자가 사용하는 언어를 분석하는 사용자 언어 분석부, 상기 사용자 단말기에 수신된 재난정보의 문자를 상기 사용자 단말기에서 분석된 언어를 포함하는 음성으로 변환하는 문자음성 변환부, 및, 상기 문자음성 변환부에서 변환된 재난정보 음성을 외부로 송출하는 재난정보 송출부를 포함하여, 상기 사용자 단말기를 사용하는 사용자 언어를 포함하는 음성 신호로 재난정보를 알리도록 구성된다.

title_en: Multitone reputation audio alert ware
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the safety protection field provides a multitone reputation audio alert ware, including the alarm body, the alarm body is by colour lamp pole and the base bottom threaded connection colour lamp pole, the colour lamp pole embeds there is the LED lamp, the base front end is equipped with and is equipped with the speaker in recess and the recess, inside storage device, programmable logic controler and the MOS pipe of being equipped with of base, base backend is equipped with control panel, be equipped with volume buttons, shift knob, RAM card socket and USB interface among the control panel. The utility model discloses a sound can be fit for using in various environment for multiple, LED lamp in the alarm body can send the lamp of five kinds of colours, and the different testing results of representative enable the staff and in time know where go wrong to the lamp shade is diffusion type reflection lampshade, has eliminated the mistaken ideas of vision blind spot, improves remote visual ability, can in time let the staff in time know the position of alarm.

title_en: Fire-fighting equipment placement cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire-fighting equipment placement cabinets, including bottom plate, frame and alarm, the frame is installed on bottom plate, frame surrounds the rest area for placing fire-fighting equipment, and bottom plate is equipped with several groups mounting groove and fixing belt, and one end of fixing belt is installed on bottom plate, the other end is equipped with mounting blocks compatible with mounting groove, the bottom of mounting groove is equipped with first pressure sensor, and infrared detector is installed on frame, and alarm is equipped with trigger control circuit etc..The utility model does not use the design of traditional glass cabinet door, is additionally arranged foreign body intrusion and the setting of fixation kit anti-theft warning function, good anti-theft effect, and when fire occurs can network alarm, easy to use, security performance is high.

title_en: Crossing direction board
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for traffic control equipment technical field, provides a kind of crossing direction board, including frame, upright bar, radar, display device, warning device, lighting device and processor；The side of one end connection framework of upright bar, radar, lighting device and warning device are installed in the side of frame, and display device is mounted on the inside of frame, and display device is surrounded by frame；Radar, display device, lighting device and warning device are all connected with processor, radar is used to acquire the information of vehicles on main road, display device is for showing information of vehicles, lighting device is illuminated for night road conditions, processor receives information of vehicles, when there is the hidden danger that traffic accident occurs, processor control warning device is alarmed；Crossing direction board is mounted on the intersection of main road and branch.This device guarantees that branch road vehicles are not influenced to enter main road safely by intersection blind area, reduces traffic accident, and lighting device night opens, facilitates vehicle safety and pass through intersection.
assignees: HEBEI JITONG HUIDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Curve meeting early warning feedback system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bend meeting early warning feedback system relates to traffic safety facility technical field, and when solving current vehicle meeting at the bend, the driver has the sight blind area, and convex surface wide-angle mirror can not play fine early warning effect in overcast and weather such as haze, takes place the problem of traffic accident easily. The utility model discloses a warning device, including warning feedback device main part, one side fixed mounting of warning feedback device main part has the base, fixed mounting has LED warning screen on the preceding terminal surface of warning feedback device main part, the upper end of LED warning screen is provided with LED speed of a motor vehicle screen, one side fixed mounting of LED speed of a motor vehicle screen has the microwave speed probe, the upper end of LED speed of a motor vehicle screen is provided with the speed limit sign, and the speed limit sign passes through screw and warning feedback device main part threaded connection, the upper end of speed limit sign is provided with the bend sign, the upper end fixed mounting of warning feedback device main part has the flashing light.
assignees: NANJING WANYUE INTELLIGENT SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Railway line foreign matter intrusion monitoring information uploading device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a railway line foreign matter intrusion monitoring information uploading device, which belongs to the technical field of railway disaster prevention and early warning, and comprises a radar module, a camera module, a clock timing module, a core board module and a monitoring information uploading module; the radar module, the camera module and the clock timing module are all connected with the core board module; the core board module is connected with the monitoring information uploading module. The utility model solves the problem that the position and time information of the road barrier in the railway line monitoring information are missing or inaccurate by arranging the radar module, the camera module, the clock timing module, the core board module and the monitoring information uploading module.
assignees: SHAANXI JINGSHEN RAILWAY CO LTD;RESEARCH AND TECH SUPERVISION INSTITUTE CHINA RAILWAY LANZHOU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane shotfiring safety warning dispatch control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of unmanned plane shotfiring safeties to guard against dispatch control method, the method includes：Utilize no-manned machine distant control commander and aerial spiral camera shooting, camera function, the global or local image document of quick-fried area and its surrounding enviroment is acquired in real time, carry out quick-fried preceding warning purposes analyze in real time, quick-fried area's state of alert monitoring, blasting process record, it is quick-fried after environment influence check, blind big gun investigation with identification and blind big gun information remote control acquire, to realize shotfiring safety warning dispatch control.The dispatch control that the present invention carries out shotfiring safety warning using unmanned air vehicle technique works, check in blast warning, quick-fried area, the links such as blind big gun investigation improve the promptness of shotfiring safety warning and hidden troubles removing disposition, safety and reliability, finally realize safe and efficient detonation and exclude it is quick-fried after leave the purpose of hidden danger.
assignees: DACHANG CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD;GUANGDONG HONGDA BLASTING CO

title_en: Warning and driving device for protection area of power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a warning and driving device for a protection area of a power transmission line, relates to the technical field of accident prevention facilities of the power transmission line, and particularly relates to a warning device for preventing fishing along the power transmission line from electric shock, which comprises: the control unit analyzes the command, controls the sound wave dispersing device to disperse people fishing along the power transmission line, and a worker managing the power transmission line does not need to arrive at the site, remotely operates the sound wave dispersing device and has good timeliness. The directionality of the sound wave dispeller is less than 30 degrees, so the influence on a non-dispelling area is small, the dispeller does not form physiological damage such as blindness, deafness, hearing loss, vision loss and the like, and the work is stopped when the sound wave dispeller is turned off, and the environment is not damaged. The device still is equipped with the warning light module, and it is used for shining warning region, and circulation warning does not produce the noise when driving away night, and is little to peripheral resident's influence.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;XINGTAI POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Emergency alarm method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency alert method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the emergency alert method comprises the steps of receiving emergency information; and sending the notification message through the vehicle-mounted Bluetooth chip so that other devices with Bluetooth chips within the preset range of the current vehicle receive the notification message. The application realizes the reutilization of the low-power-consumption Bluetooth chip in the vehicle, improves the utilization rate of the low-power-consumption Bluetooth chip and the emergency warning effect, and particularly in the scene of blind areas such as intersections, compared with the traditional emergency warning method of whistling and flashing lights, the application obviously improves the emergency warning effect by sending the emergency warning notice to the outside through the low-power-consumption Bluetooth chip in the vehicle.
assignees: CHONGQING SAILISI FENGHUANG ZHICHUANG TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Communication tower risk monitoring method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a communication tower risk monitoring method and system based on deep learning, which relate to the technical field of environmental monitoring and disaster early warning, and the method and system provided by the invention have the advantages that a voiceprint signal is used for replacing a failure vibration sensor, so that the continuous monitoring capability of an ice coating period is ensured, a monitoring blind area of a traditional system under extreme weather is avoided, 1D-CNN time sequence separation operation is combined with framing windowing and a Mel cepstrum coefficient, raindrop impact noise and ice layer falling sound are effectively stripped, the unique low-frequency resonance characteristics of metal cracks are accurately extracted, LSTM-Autoencoder reconstructs a theoretical vibration value based on historical data, the false judgment of tower body deformation caused by ice coating weight is eliminated, the similar signal characteristics of structural damage and environmental load are distinguished, a dynamic weighting fusion strategy is used for giving the main weight of voiceprint evidence, the decision ratio is adjusted to be high only when vibration deviation is obvious abnormality, and the false triggering risk of single-mode detection is avoided.
assignees: HENAN ZHONGCHENG COMMUNICATION ENG SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Outdoor motion safety early warning and track tracking protection method based on hearing impaired people
abstract_en: The invention provides an outdoor sports safety early warning and track tracking protection method based on hearing impaired people, which relates to the technical field of safety and comprises the steps of acquiring the positions of the hearing impaired people and the dynamic elements of the environment, and evaluating collision risk through a track prediction algorithm, screening and adapting non-acoustic sensing signals according to the risk level, and sending a dynamically adjusted direction indication to the wearable equipment. The invention can identify the dangerous source in real time, accurately forecast the collision risk, and personally present non-acoustic warning signals, thereby effectively improving the safety of outdoor activities of hearing impaired people and reducing the incidence rate of safety accidents.
assignees: BEIJING TIANDI LIXIN HUMAN RESOURCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bicycle internet of things system based on intelligent glasses and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bicycle internet of things system based on intelligent glasses and a working method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of bicycle intelligent safety. The system comprises a millimeter wave radar, a front and rear lamp assembly, a vehicle controller, a vibration handle sleeve and intelligent glasses, wherein the millimeter wave radar is arranged behind a bicycle, distance, relative speed and movement direction information of a rear vehicle are collected in real time, a vehicle approaching signal is generated and transmitted to the vehicle controller through a CAN bus, the vehicle controller analyzes the signal, then judges the three-level danger level of early warning, danger and emergency danger, sends corresponding instructions to the intelligent glasses, the vibration handle sleeve and the front and rear lamp assembly according to the level, the vibration handle sleeve transmits touch reminding through vibration of different intensities, and the front and rear lamp assembly outputs visual warning to the periphery through adjusting the light state. The invention solves the problems of blind areas of the traditional riding field, low warning efficiency and interference in riding, obviously improves the riding safety, and is suitable for various riding scenes.

title_en: Alarm system for a hearing-impaired person
abstract_en: An alarm system for a hearing-impaired person is provided to allow a user to detect a signal pattern at a place where a sensor is not installed by using a mobile terminal receiving a signal pattern. In an alarm system for a hearing-impaired person, a plurality of first sensors are installed at a plurality of spaces, and sense signal patterns generated in a plurality of spaces. A unified processing unit(200) stores a signal pattern for a user and a standard signal pattern which are generated in the plurality of spaces in advance. If the sensed signal detected by a plurality of sensors is concord with the stored signal pattern, the unified processing unit transmits the sensed signal. A mobile terminal converts signal pattern received from the unified processing unit to an alarm signal.
abstract_ko: 청각장애인 등을 위한 알림 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 알림 시스템은, 복수개의 공간들에 각각 설치되고, 상기 복수개의 공간들에서 발생하는 신호 패턴들을 센싱하는 복수개의 제1센서들; 상기 복수개의 공간들에서 발생할 가능성이 있는 사용자에게 특화된 신호 패턴들 또는 규격화된 신호 패턴들을 사전에 입력받아 저장하고, 상기 복수개의 제1센서들이 센싱한 신호 패턴들이 상기 저장된 신호 패턴들과 일치하는 경우 상기 복수개의 제1센서들이 센싱한 신호 패턴들을 송신하는 통합 처리기; 및 상기 통합 처리기로부터 수신된 신호 패턴들을 알림 신호로 변환하여 사용자에게 제공하거나, 또는 상기 복수개의 공간들에서 발생하는 신호 패턴들을 수신하여 알림 신호로 변환하여 사용자에게 제공하는 휴대용 단말기를 구비한다.

title_en: Functional fire safety management reminder signs
abstract_en: The present invention relates to firefighting management notification sign board which comprises: a main body unit formed to be attached and fixed to a building, provided in the form of a plate, and configured to transmit information such specifications, locations, etc. of firefighting equipment in the form of letters, numbers, symbols, etc. displayed on a front surface thereof; an information checking means formed on a front side of the main body and capable of communicating with a fire station server management center (C) while double-checking accurate information such as firefighting-related equipment, located the inside and outside of the building, and operation states thereof through a terminal (B) such as a tablet PC during management performed by a firefighting equipment inspector (A) so as to allow for improvement of operational failure and operational malfunction in real-time; and a coating unit which protects the main body unit while preventing external foreign substances from entering the main body unit and the information checking means. According to the present invention, the firefighting management notification sign board enables a firefighting equipment inspector to recognize all kinds of information such as firefighting-related equipment of a building and a status of firefighting equipment (building drawing, emergency escape information, previously-conducted firefighting inspection items, etc.) at once and to identify whether initially-stored firefighting equipment details match information of a present view point which inspects modification information, thereby increasing convenience of firefighting management. In addition, the firefighting management notification sign board enables the firefighting equipment inspector to exchange various kinds of firefighting equipment information of a modified view point in real-time with the firefighting server management center through a terminal so that the firefighting equipment inspector may take precautions to cause the corresponding firefighting equipment to be properly functioning, and may also set up an emergency call available. Therefore, when an emergency situation occurs at night, it is possible to make an emergency call to a police station of a fire station.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방관리 알림표지판을 형성함에 있어서: 건물 등에 부착 고정이 가능하도록 구성되고, 플레이트 판 형태로 형성되어 전면에 글자 · 숫자 · 기호 등의 형태로 소방 설비 제원 · 위치 등의 정보를 전달하는 본체부; 본체 전면부에 형성되어 소방시설점검자(A)의 관리 시 태블렛 PC 등의 단말기(B)를 통해 건물 내·외부의 소방관련 장비와 작동상태 등의 정확한 정보를 재차 확인하면서 소방서버관리처(C)와의 교류가 가능하여 실시간 형태로 기기의 작동불능 및 오류의 개선 등이 가능하게끔 구비하는 정보확인수단; 및 본체부와 정보확인수단에 외부의 이물질 유입 등을 방지하면서 본체부의 보호가 가능하게끔 코팅부를 구비함을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System for providing location alerts relating to emergencies
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for generating alerts communicated to emergency responders and/or contacts indicating a location of an incident. The system comprises a housing, one or more light sources, and a computing processor. A switch is located in the housing and configured to be accessible to a user. When the switch is actuated by a user indicating an incident, the processor provides power to the at least one light source to output light from the housing thereby indicating the location of the system. The system may also control a speaker to output an audible signal and a transmitter to transmit an emergency signal with location information to a device of an emergency responder and/or an emergency contact. The present invention may also be embodied in a software application that is implemented on a mobile device to thereby leverage the components of the mobile device to send alerts.

title_en: Manhole cover missing caution and intelligent radio alarm system
abstract_en: A manhole cover missing caution and intelligent radio alarm system comprises a computer monitoring terminal, a plurality of wireless repeaters and a plurality of manhole cover missing alarm devices. The computer monitoring terminal carries out data transmission with the wireless repeaters through a wireless interface mode, receives information of each manhole cover missing alarm device and displays a manhole cover state on a computer screen. The wireless repeaters are responsible for receiving and sending the information of the nearby manhole cover missing alarm devices to the computer monitoring terminal so that a blind area which can not be monitored by the manhole cover missing alarm devices is avoided. Each manhole cover missing alarm device comprises a cell, a voltage control switch, a central processor plate, a wireless alarm conveyer, a caution system and a sound and light alarm device. By using the system, when the manhole cover is missing, warning marks can be popped around the manhole cover and sound-light alarm can be emitted so that pedestrians and vehicles are timely warned and an accident of falling into a well is avoided as far as possible. Simultaneously, through an electronic detection technology and radio communication, manhole cover missing information is sent to a municipal administrative center.

title_en: Built on stilts high -voltage line intelligence warning device and system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a built on stilts high -voltage line intelligence warning device and system. The device includes: light intensity's optical line sensors in the detection ring border, detect the distance sensor of foreign matter distance, the foreign matter distance is the distance of the built on stilts high -voltage line of arbitrary object distance of built on stilts high -voltage line below, warning module, warning module include warning light and megaphone, and be connected respectively with optical line sensors, distance sensor and warning module, if light intensity is lighter than and presets the light intensity, trigger the warning light and glisten according to a vinyl ester resin, if the foreign matter distance is lighter than a default distance, triggers the warning light and glisten according to the 2nd vinyl ester resin, warning tone's singlechip is preset in the megaphone broadcast, and the 2nd vinyl ester resin is greater than a vinyl ester resin. The utility model provides a technical scheme, even people do not watch from a height or a distance the high -voltage line owing to neglecting, through the utility model discloses an initiative is reported to the police, also can learn current situation to effective condition of destroying the high -voltage line that reduces takes place.
assignees: FENGHUA POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;NINGBO POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Railway line foreign matter intrusion monitoring alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a foreign matter intrusion monitoring alarm device along a railway, which belongs to the technical field of railway alarm devices and aims at the problem of railway operation safety, and the device comprises a data acquisition and processing device and a core control unit, wherein the data acquisition and processing device is electrically connected with the core control unit, the data acquisition and processing device is electrically connected with a control center and a monitoring center through the core control unit, the data acquisition and processing device is electrically connected with alarm equipment and drives the alarm equipment after data analysis, and the alarm equipment is reserved to be electrically connected with a driving warning and a working warning; the method mainly aims at sudden dangerous situations such as collapse of tunnel openings, landslide, falling rocks, entrance and exit of wild animals and the like, realizes an advanced forecasting function through corresponding data processing of an early warning platform by means of technologies such as online monitoring and early warning, ensures railway operation safety, has the characteristics of high alarm accuracy, zero missing report and the like, and provides technical guarantee for driving safety of high-risk road sections.
assignees: SHANXI DAQIN TIANCHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of debris flow early-warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of debris flow early-warning systems, to solve the problems such as being difficult to realize high-precision early warning and cumbersome control logic of the existing technology, the present apparatus includes bottom plate, motor and retarder are provided on the upside of the bottom plate, the power output end of motor is provided with output shaft, the power output end of retarder is provided with the second axis, the end of second axis is provided with the first round, the first round is with the second wheel directly by bearing V belt translation, the two sides of second wheel are provided with bracket, the bottom of the bracket is provided with pressure sensor and then realizes effective early warning to mud-rock flow, the cost of realization is also reduced while the popularization and application for being conducive to the present apparatus.
assignees: GUIZHOU TIANLUE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional garage door control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of garage door control, in particular to a multifunctional garage door control system which comprises a monitoring module, a safety early warning module, a data transmission module, a driving control module and an identification module. Monitoring module utilizes smoke transducer and temperature sensor's monitoring data to synthesize the judgement whether the condition of a fire appears, after monitoring the condition of a fire when monitoring module, convey control command to the automatic garage door of opening of machine controller, the condition that people were stranded after having avoided the condition of a fire to appear, and monitoring module utilizes the data judgement garage door that prevents pressing from both sides the sensor whether open and shut normally, when preventing pressing from both sides the sensor and sensing the garage door and receive unusual resistance in the motion of garage door, then convey control command to machine controller stop drive motor's operation, dangerous emergence has been avoided, the garage door that opens and shuts of user's accessible infrared remote controller, and the garage door passes through WIFI module and wireless router wireless connection, thereby user's accessible mobile client remote control garage opens and shuts, the system practicality has been increased.

title_en: Real-Time Position Tracking and Alerting
abstract_en: A wearable device is described that is configured to alert a subject prior to encountering an obstacle. The subject may be visually-impaired. The device includes: a mobile transceiver tag adapted to be worn by a subject within a designated area (e.g., a swimming pool); three or more stationary transceiver beacons in spaced apart, fixed positions; a wearable signal output device (e.g., headset); and a processor with software that can calculate the subject's position relative to one or more obstacles (e.g., end of swimming lane) and sends a left, right, or reverse signal to the signal output device.

title_en: Warning light speaker
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a warning light speaker configured to facilitate communication with workers, especially people with developmental disabilities and to cope with safety accidents during work, and more specifically, to a warning light speaker comprising: a body; a communication unit installed on the body and communicating with a user terminal; a processing unit installed on the body, receiving an intention expression signal from the user terminal through the communication unit, and generating and transmitting a voice conversion signal for converting a lamp operation signal corresponding to the intention expression signal and a message corresponding to the intention expression signal into sound; a lighting unit installed on the body and emitting light according to the lamp operation signal transmitted from the processing unit; a speaker installed on the body and outputting the message as sound according to the voice conversion signal received from the processing unit; and a power supply unit installed on the body and supplying power to the communication unit, the processing unit, the lighting unit, and the speaker.

title_en: Double-layer glove and portable child wind-shielding quilt
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-deck gloves and portability children keep out wind by, including fixed band and connecting band, the outside one end of fixed band is connected with the layer that keeps out the wind, and the bottom on the layer that keeps out the wind installs the main part, the inside middle part of main part is provided with supplementary headgear, and the inside mid-mounting of supplementary headgear has the window, be provided with the zip fastener between supplementary headgear and the main part, double-deck gloves are all installed at the outside both ends of main part lower extreme, and the inside of double-deck gloves is provided with the wiring groove. This double-deck gloves and portability children keep out the wind by carrying children according to individual use needs in the use, and can not produce great phenomenon of leaking out carrying the in-process, and meanwhile children's accessible window sees the outside scene, can not too be oppressed, and is more comfortable, also has good cold-proof effect, when using under comparatively dark condition, the setting of usable reflection of light strip is to warning of other people, reduces the potential safety hazard.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring sensor device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disasters monitoring sensor device, including surveying the casing, the top of surveying the casing is provided with sealed locking Assembly, the inside fixed mounting who surveys the casing has wireless transmission module, the inside fixed mounting of casing is surveyed to one side of wireless transmission module has data acquisition module, the inside fixed mounting of casing is surveyed to one side of data acquisition module has the detection sensor. This geological disaster monitoring sensor device, accessible GPRS/CDMA network is connected with wireless transmission module, and send control command, data acquisition module carries out real-time collection dynamic display to the data that survey the sensor acquireed, the software will be can show the network state information that comes from wireless sensor network transmission and the information that the node gathered on graphical interface dynamically, simultaneously under the C/S mode, can forward other customer ends with the data of gathering, when surveying sensor data and reaching the warning upper limit of system setting, accessible terminal and cell-phone control alarm instrument and sound real-time warning.
