title_en: Active safety early warning system facing intersection visual field blind area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an initiative safety precaution system towards crossing field of vision blind area to solve the pedestrian and detain in road central authorities and form the conflict with the vehicle and the driver's sight is blockked by the place ahead vehicle and is produced the problem of blind area. The utility model comprises a detection module for infrared detection of pedestrians on zebra crossing; the signal processing module converts the infrared heat change of the human body into a voltage signal to be output and generates a warning signal; and the warning module is used for making sound and light early warning based on the warning signal of the signal processing module. The utility model discloses accessible pyroelectric infrared sensor detects the pedestrian to turn into sound, light early warning with the measuring condition, thereby inform that there is the pedestrian current in the driver the place ahead field of vision blind area, make vehicle driver initiatively slow down, park and dodge, reach the purpose that reduces the traffic accident rate.

title_en: Visual field blind area early warning method and device, vehicle and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a visual field blind area early warning method, a visual field blind area early warning device, a vehicle and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps of identifying a vision blind area of a vehicle on a running road, and projecting a warning signal into a warning area corresponding to the vision blind area. Therefore, the warning signal is directionally projected in the warning area corresponding to the visual field blind area, the moving obstacle in the visual field blind area is warned in a targeted manner, pedestrians or vehicles in the visual field blind area are effectively reminded to take countermeasures in advance, the warning efficiency and the warning effect are improved, the occurrence of collision accidents is avoided, and the driving safety is further improved.

title_en: Intelligent visual early warning system and method for ghost probe
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent visual early warning system and method for a ghost probe, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent auxiliary driving. The technical problem of leading to the driver sight to be obstructed because of the vision blind area to bring the potential safety hazard is solved. The technical proposal is as follows: the method comprises the following steps: s1, detecting the situation on a crosswalk and two sides of a bus in real time by a camera, and acquiring the positions of pedestrians around the bus and the distance between the pedestrians and the vehicle in real time by a radar; s2, processing the image, the position and the distance data acquired in real time; s3, sharing the current road condition information of the bus to other vehicles; s4, displaying the captured detection result of the road conditions around the current bus in real time; s5, a visual early warning prompt and a voice alarm are sent out through analysis of the detection result. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the bidirectional early warning of vehicles and pedestrians can be realized, and the occurrence of ghost probe accidents can be effectively prevented.

title_en: Storm Avoiding Buildings and Structures
abstract_en: A building sheltering structure is configured to facilitate the shielding of domicile or building into an underground foundation before an emergency environmental condition arises. The foundation includes a cover plate and/or a second plate that translate horizontally to occlude the at least one domicile upon retraction into a secure cavity of the foundation by a lift assembly in the foundation cavity. The cover plate and second plate offer optimal protection to the domicile thereunder for various extreme conditions. Mounted atop the lift assembly, the at least one domicile can be fully retracted into the foundation cavity and completely shielded. The operation of the lift assembly is commanded and powered by a supply system, of which a processor facilitates emergency warnings and panic transmissions to signal for help. Further, a plurality of solar panels mounted atop the at least one domicile keeps the system charged for the use in emergency.

title_en: Induction blind road brick, trigger type blind stick and blind road cooperative system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic equipment, in particular to an induction blind road brick, a trigger type blind stick and a blind road cooperative system. The induction blind road brick comprises a blind road brick body, a triggering device, an induction device and a signal connection device, wherein a cavity is formed in the blind road brick body, the triggering device is arranged on the blind road brick body and used for receiving a triggering signal triggered by short-distance wireless induction, the induction device is arranged in the cavity and connected with the triggering device in a signal connection mode, the induction device sends out a warning signal after receiving the triggering signal, the triggering device is a blind stick triggering device, and the triggering signal triggered by the short-distance wireless induction is sent out by the blind stick. In the invention, a point-to-point identification relationship is established by using short-distance induction (magnetic, metal and radio frequency), so that 'only a visually impaired person carrying a blind crutch arrives, the brick responds', and broadcasting inundation caused by scene noise (raindrops, steps, baby carriages and the like) is restrained by the selective triggering, thereby avoiding information fatigue and urban noise pollution.

title_en: Listening system comprising an alerting device and a listening device
abstract_en: A listening system that eases the acknowledgement of ‘alarm signals’, as e.g. issued by alarm indicators, in the environment of a user in difficult listening situations. The listening system is adapted to issue specific ALARM mode signals to the user corresponding to said external alarm signals, when said listening system is in an ALARM mode. An advantage of the present system is that a user is able to take notice of alarms from normal indicators even in case of a hearing impairment and/or when located in a noisy environment. The system may e.g. be used for the hearing instruments, ear protection devices, earphones, headsets or combinations thereof.
assignees: PETERSEN SVEND OSCAR;PEDERSEN METTE BOEL;ALDAZ GABRIEL;OTICON AS

title_en: A kind of Hearing Impaired's special intelligent fire-alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Hearing Impaired's special intelligent fire-alarm.Comprise acoustic-optic alarm, base, power bin and smell alarm.Acoustic-optic alarm is arranged on base by screw, and power bin is arranged on base by plastics clip, and smell alarm and base integrated make shaping.Alarm receives automatic fire alarm signal or visitor's intercommunication signal, start micro motor by the interlock of parallel connection power supply line simultaneously, micro motor controls the airtight cover plate of smell alarm by motor shaft and rotates, be provided with barrier plate and control airtight cover plate maintenance 90 degree of maximum unlatchings, smell warning solution can volatilize fast, reminds Hearing Impaired or old man to withdraw in time.The utility model is with low cost, and install simple, alarm security is effective, is easy to promote.After the utility model is installed, effectively can promote the alarm rate to Hearing Impaired.Meet every national regulation requirement, make up the defect of domestic existing conventional fire warning device.

title_en: Fixed protection point early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fixed protection point early warning device belongs to railway protection technical field. Wherein, this fixed guard point early warning device includes: the system comprises a main control board, a network communication unit and a radio station communication unit; the network communication unit and the radio station communication unit are electrically connected with the main control board; and an alarm interface unit is arranged on the main control board. The utility model provides a fixed protection point early warning device, through network communication unit and radio station communication unit, the locomotive that is close is given to the alarm information propelling movement that will acquire, adopt the bimodulus mode to send alarm information, compensate the blind area problem of radio station communication through wireless communication network, can in time inform the locomotive that is close the trouble place of online operation, the very first time sends disaster information for relevant operation train, can avoid the railway operation safety problem that the channel is not unblocked to lead to after the circuit geological disasters takes place, can ensure driving safety, can carry out the early warning to train and train driver more effectively.

abstract_ko: 본 고안에 따른 터널 막장 안전관리 시스템은 터널 막장 내부에 설치되어 막정면의 변위를 측정하는 레이저 거리계, 상기 레이저 거리계의 측정 데이터를 수신하여 변화를 분석하는 계측수단, 상기 계측수단의 정보를 수신하여 막장을 모니터링하는 관리수단, 상기 계측수단에서 계측한 데이터의 변화가 설정치를 초과하는 경우 경보음과 경고 조명을 발생하는 경보수단 및 상기 레이저 거리계의 전원을 공급하고 상기 복수의 레이저 거리계와 결합하며, 레이저 거리계를 소정 위치에 고정시키는 고정수단을 포함한다.

title_en: Emergency integrated information service platform system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of emergency integrated information service platform systems, are related to public place security protection and evacuation technical field.The present invention includes emergency integrated information service platform, emergency information acquiring unit, emergency situation from analytical unit, information issue unit, network decision acquiring unit, emergency scheduling unit, information service data library and emergency information Cloud Server.The present invention is sent to emergency integrated information service platform after receiving emergency information by emergency information acquiring unit, situation of meeting an urgent need carries out early warning analysis according to emergency information from analytical unit, emergency scheduling unit obtains emergency preplan from information service data library according to early warning analysis result and emergency information, and emergency preplan is sent to information issue unit, it is effectively guaranteed the treatment effeciency to emergency event, improve the accessibility and validity of emergency evacuation information service, market application value with higher.

title_en: Vehicle rearview mirror blind area detection method and detection device
abstract_en: The application discloses vehicle rearview mirror blind area detection method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting whether the vehicle has a lane changing intention; when the intention of changing the lane is detected, acquiring barrier data of a blind area of a rearview mirror of the vehicle; and recognizing lane change risks of the vehicle according to the barrier data, and controlling the vehicle to stop lane change while performing lane change danger warning on the driver when determining the lane change risks based on the lane change risks. Therefore, the problems that the detection mode of the related technology for the obstacles in the blind area of the rearview mirror is too rough, the early warning cannot be accurately carried out on a driver, the active intervention cannot be carried out on the vehicle when the potential safety hazard exists, the driving safety cannot be effectively guaranteed and the like are solved.

title_en: Dangerous area construction progress management system
abstract_en: The invention designs a construction progress management system for a dangerous area, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a data display module and an auxiliary function module; the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a data display module and an auxiliary functional module, wherein the data acquisition module comprises an environment data acquisition sub-module, an equipment operation data acquisition sub-module, a personnel working data acquisition sub-module and a safety monitoring sub-module, the data processing module comprises a data analysis sub-module and an early warning sub-module, the data display module comprises a monitoring interface module and a progress management interface module, the auxiliary functional module comprises a personnel management module, a material management module, a system control module, a data storage and backup module, a training and guiding module, a multilingual support module and an emergency response module, and the system can effectively integrate information resources of different departments and links, break information island phenomenon and improve the efficiency and accuracy of information transmission and sharing.
assignees: SICHUAN MINGXING NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake early warning method of emergency early warning broadcasting system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster early warning, in particular to an earthquake early warning method of an emergency early warning broadcasting system, which comprises the steps of obtaining the longitude and latitude coordinates of a seismic source and earthquake monitoring data, determining the distribution area range of broadcasting sites according to the longitude and latitude coordinates of the seismic source, wherein the range is represented by longitude and latitude, constructing an earthquake risk topological space based on historical earthquake data, dividing earthquake risk grades in the topological space, determining corresponding broadcasting emergency degree parameters according to the earthquake risk grades, generating broadcasting message codes, transmitting the broadcasting message codes to broadcasting sites in the distribution area of the broadcasting sites through a power line carrier and a wireless communication network to trigger earthquake early warning broadcasting, combining geological structure data through a topological space mapping technology, accurately determining an early warning range, obviously reducing early warning blind areas and avoiding excessive early warning.

title_en: Manufacturing method of inorganic insulating material using waste shells
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing an inorganic insulating material using waste shells is provided to produce the lightweight insulating material which has an improved heat-insulating effect and does not emit harmful materials upon firing. A method for manufacturing an inorganic insulating material using waste shells includes: a pre-treatment step(S110) of removing seawater and foreign substances from the waste shells; a grinding step(S120) of pulverizing the pre-treated waste shells into fine powder; a mixing step(S130) of adding a blowing agent which is an azo di-carbide amide and a dispersing agent to the fine powder, mixing the admixture to obtain an intermediate material, and adding a binder to the intermediate material to obtain a final material; and a molding step(S140) of putting the final material into a mold, and heating the mold to predetermined temperature to obtain a molded material.

abstract_en: In an integrated emergency bell enclosure, camera sets consisting of a high-focal distance camera and a low-focal distance camera are installed to and monitor 90 degrees in all directions on all four sides on top of the enclosure, such that a total of eight emergency bell cameras are installed with a fixed camera function for 360-degree surveillance without blind spots. The integrated emergency bell enclosure consists of a switch hub, a power supply, a broadcasting device, a video storage memory, and an Eve SERVER, wherein the Eve SERVER and a Bob SERVER communicate through an unlicensed frequency wireless communication device, videos from crime prevention surveillance cameras are transmitted to an integrated crime prevention center through the switch hub for real-time monitoring, and videos from emergency bell cameras are stored in the video storage memory. In a wireless integrated enclosure, four wireless cameras with a low focus distance are installed to monitor each 90 degrees in all directions on top of the enclosure, and the Eve SERVER and Bob SERVER communicate through the unlicensed frequency wireless communication device. When an emergency bell button is inserted in a front surface of the integrated wireless enclosure and the emergency bell button is activated, the Eve SERVER connects to a network with the Bob SERVER through an unlicensed frequency wireless private network and then establishes a two-way call with an Alice SERVER inside the integrated crime prevention center. Accordingly, performance is improved for surveillance without blind spots and distortion and effective dissemination of civil defense warnings.

title_en: Early warning method and system for wind-induced foreign matter short-circuit fault of transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for early warning of a wind-induced foreign matter short circuit fault of a power transmission line, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1: collecting historical wind-induced fault foreign matter short-circuit image information, and distinguishing and marking according to faults and non-faults; step 2: performing image processing on the historical image, extracting the short circuit characteristics of the foreign matters of the power grid from the processed historical image, and establishing a typical wire foreign matter comparison chart library aiming at the short circuit characteristics of the foreign matters of the power grid; step 3: establishing a channel hidden danger distribution geographic map according to the importance degree of the line, the geographic characteristics and the wind area distribution map of the power grid, and dividing hidden danger area types; step 4: acquiring real-time visual channel image information of a power transmission line, and identifying foreign matters on the real-time visual channel image; step 5: and early warning is carried out on the foreign matters of the power transmission line, and early warning information is pushed to the responsible person to whom the power transmission line belongs. The invention realizes early warning and real-time warning of the short circuit of the wind-induced foreign matter.

title_en: Image equipment displacement abnormity early warning system and method based on feature point detection
abstract_en: The invention provides an image equipment displacement abnormity early warning system and method based on feature point detection, which belong to the technical field of abnormity early warning and specifically comprise the steps of carrying out feature point detection and descriptor calculation on a reference image and a current acquisition image, utilizing feature descriptors of the reference image and the current image to match to obtain image comparison image feature points, utilizing a distance function to determine feature point similarity coefficients of different comparison image feature points, utilizing the feature point similarity coefficients to carry out different comparison image feature points to match the feature points, constructing a homography matrix based on the matching feature points, extracting geometric transformation information based on the homography matrix to obtain a rotation angle, a scaling and a translation amount, and combining a preset threshold to determine whether the image equipment is deviated and send out early warning signals, thereby improving the reliability of monitoring processing.

title_en: Wearable Haptic Apparatus and method of providing walking guidance information using the same
title_ko: 착용형 햅틱 장치 및 그것을 이용한 보행 안내 정보 제공 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wearable haptic device and a method for providing walking guidance information using the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the wearable haptic device includes: a movement detection unit which detects the position and movement information of a user; a communication unit which transmits the position and movement information of the user to a user terminal and receives a haptic signal from the user terminal; and a guidance information notification unit which provides the user with walking guidance information by outputting the received haptic signal as vibration, light, or sound. A walking guidance providing server detects the position, speed, and moving direction of neighboring vehicles using at least one among recorded video on the road, fixed sensor(s) on the road, and loop(s), generates neighboring information, and transmits the neighboring information to the user terminal. The user terminal determines if there is any danger using the received neighboring information and the position and movement information of the user, and in case of a danger, generates the haptic signal showing a danger situation and transmits the signal to the wearable haptic device. According to the present invention described above, the wearable haptic device and the method for providing walking guidance information using the same enable effective provision of the walking guidance information to the senior citizens or the hearing-impaired and helps users walk safely by notifying the users of unexpected danger(s).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 착용형 햅틱 장치 및 그것을 이용한 보행 안내 정보 제공 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 착용형 햅틱 장치는 사용자의 위치 및 이동 정보를 감지하는 이동 감지부, 사용자 단말기로 상기 감지한 위치 및 이동 정보를 전송하고, 상기 사용자 단말기로부터 햅틱 신호를 수신하는 통신부, 그리고 수신한 상기 햅틱 신호를 진동, 빛 또는 소리 형태로 출력하여 사용자에게 보행 안내 정보를 제공하는 보행정보 알림부를 포함하고, 보행 안내 제공 서버는, 도로 상의 촬영 영상, 도로에 설치된 고정 센서, 루프 중에서 적어도 하나를 이용하여 주변 차량의 위치, 속도, 이동 방향을 감지하여 주변 정보를 생성하며, 상기 사용자 단말기로 상기 주변 정보를 전송하고, 상기 사용자 단말기는, 수신된 상기 주변 정보와 상기 사용자의 위치 및 이동 정보를 이용하여 위험 상황 여부를 판단하고, 위험 상황으로 판단된 경우 위험 상황임을 알리는 상기 햅틱 신호를 생성하여 상기 착용형 햅틱 장치로 전송한다.  
이와 같이 본 발명에 의하면, 착용형 햅틱 장치 및 그것을 이용한 보행 안내 정보 제공 방법을 이용함으로써, 고령자나 청각 장애인들에게 효과적으로 보행 안내 정보를 제공할 수 있으며, 사용자가 예측하지 못한 위험을 경고하여 사용자가 안전하게 보행할 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Road blind area early warning method, device, equipment and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a road blind area early warning method, a device, equipment and a computer storage medium, wherein for any adjacent lane group in a target area, a cloud platform calculates the average speed of vehicles of a first lane and a second lane in the adjacent lane group and the relative speed difference between the first lane and the second lane according to the acquired accurate positioning information, the vehicle basic information and the vehicle driving information of all vehicles and the lane information of all lanes in the target area. And marking a static blind area lane and a ghost probe risk lane under the condition that the relative speed difference is larger than a preset speed threshold value. And then carrying out position risk assessment, determining a risk early warning position, further calculating to obtain a dynamic risk monitoring coefficient, and finally sending the road ghost probe early warning reminding information to the target vehicle according to the dynamic risk monitoring coefficient so as to enable the target vehicle to output the early warning reminding information. Therefore, the visual field blind area is dynamically monitored, speed limit warning and reminding are generated, and potential safety hazards of a 'ghost probe' scene in urban traffic can be reduced.

abstract_en: A mobile terminal for sending an emergency situation message corresponding to each country for an emergency call is provided to enable the user of a mobile terminal, who is in an accident in a foreign country, to make a call to an emergency phone number of the country and transmit an emergency situation, expressed in language of the country, together with a terminal location message so that the other side, who receives the emergency call, can quickly confirm the current location of the user and take swift action. A mobile terminal comprises a storage part(26), a country code acquisition part(2722), an emergency situation message reading part(2724), and an emergency situation processing part(272). The storage part(26) comprises a mapping table(262), in which a plurality of country codes are respectively mapped to emergency call numbers, and an emergency situation message DB(263), which contains emergency situation messages corresponding to various countries. The country code acquisition part(2722) analyzes system information transmitted from a base station according to an emergency call request signal and acquires country code information. The emergency situation message reading part(2724) reads the emergency situation message of an associated country from the emergency situation message DB(263) by using the acquired country code. The emergency situation processing part(272) extracts an emergency call number of the associated country from the mapping table by using the acquired country code, makes a call to the extracted emergency phone number, and transmits the read emergency situation message if the call is connected.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 이동통신 단말기에 관한 것으로,  복수의 국가코드들과 그에 대응되는 국가별 긴급호출번호가 맵핑된 맵핑 테이블과 국가별 긴급상황메시지들을 포함하는 긴급상황메시지 데이터베이스를 포함하는 저장부와,  긴급 콜(Call) 요청 신호에 따라 기지국으로부터 송신되는 시스템 정보를 분석하여 국가코드정보를 획득하는 국가코드 획득부와, 국가코드 획득부로부터 획득된 국가코드정보를 이용하여 긴급상황메시지 데이터베이스로부터 해당 국가의 긴급상황메시지를 읽어 들이는 긴급상황메시지 리드부와,  국가코드 획득부로부터 읽어 들인 국가코드정보를 사용하여 맵핑 테이블로부터 해당 국가의 긴급호출번호를 읽어 들이고, 읽어 들인 긴급호출번호로 호출하여 호가 연결되면 읽어 들인 긴급상황메시지를 호 연결된 상대방에게 전송하는 긴급상황 처리부를 포함한다. 
       
     이동통신 단말기, 긴급, 긴급상황메시지, 국가코드

title_en: Non-electric automatic control water door
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A non-motorized automatic control water gate using a water level is provided to prevent foreign materials from piling up inside a drainpipe by automatically controlling the opening and closing of the water gate in real time. CONSTITUTION: A non-motorized automatic control water gate using a water level comprises a drainpipe, a water gate frame(70), a water gate(10), a rotating unit(20), and an opening and closing unit(40). The drainpipe drains branch river water to a main river. The water gate frame has an incline fixed to the front end of the drainpipe. The water gate is installed at the front of the water gate frame and controls the flow of water. The rotating unit rotates the water gate. The opening and closing unit is connected to the front of the water gate and opens and closes the water gate depending on the water level of the main river.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 제방을 횡단하여  본류하천으로 유입되는 지류하천이나 수로에 설치된 암거 및 배수관로 내부를 흐르는 하천수의 역류발생 방지를 위한 무동력 자동조절수문으로 홍수 발생 시 제방 내·외부의 수위차를 이용하여 암거 입구에 설치된 수문을 자동 조절하여 본류하천의 수위 상승에 따른 지류하천 범람과 배후지 침수를 방지하기 위한 것으로, 하천의 수위 변동에 능동적으로 대처하여 자연재해 발생을 예방하고, 배수관로 내부의 원활한 유속을 확보하여 퇴적물 발생을 방지하는 등 효율적인 배수시설 유지관리가 가능하도록 하였으며, 동시에 동물이동통로 기능을 겸할 수 있도록 함으로서 생태환경보존에 기여할 수 있도록 하는 수위를 이용한 무동력 자동조절 수문을 제공하는 것이다.

title_en: Atsc 3.0-delivered alerts for people with accessibility needs
abstract_en: Techniques are described for expanding and/or improving the Advanced Television Systems Committee (ATSC) 3.0 television protocol in robustly delivering the next generation broadcast television services. Advanced Emergency Alerts (AEA) are received via ATSC 3.0 and filtered according to end user desire. Signaling commences between the ATSC 3.0 receiver and nearby consumer electronic (CE) devices to cause the CE devices to activate to indicate to a person that he should access the ATSC 3.0 receiver to discern what AEA is being broadcast.

title_en: Emergency exit guide and guidance broadcast speaker
abstract_en: A speaker with an emergency exit guidance function is provided to enable deaf people to follow an emergency flash by turning on an emergency lamp in an emergency situation. A speaker with an emergency exit guidance function includes a front case(10) and an emergency lamp(40). A speaker unit(20), a transformer(30), a circuit board, and plural voice holes are formed in the front case. The emergency lamp is mounted on an outer surface of the front case and turned on/off under the control of the circuit board. The emergency lamp uses a flash as an optical source. The flash is attached to a reflective mirror and inserted in a transparent cover(46). A coupling member(42) made of a rubber or silicon is coupled with an opening of the transparent cover. A through-hole(45) and a connecting hole(44) are formed in the coupling member. A cable(C) from the flash is extracted through the connecting hole and connected to the circuit board. A screw hole is formed on the transparent cover. An inner through-hole(15) is formed on an inner surface of the front case. A fixing screw is coupled with the inner surface of the front case through the through-holes and the screw hole.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건물의 실내와 복도에서 측벽 또는 천정에 설치되어 방송실 또는 관리실로부터 안내 방송을 하는데 사용하는 것으로, 보다 상세히는 스피커의 전면케이스 외부면에 비상조명이 구비되어 화재와 같은 비상사태 발생시, 비상조명의 점멸 작동에 의해 시인성을 높혀주어 신속한 대피를 유도할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 스피커를 통하여 안내 및 대피 방송을 함으로써 대피를 하는데 효과적으로 대처할 수 있도록 하는 비상시 유도를 안내하는 스피커에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 건물의 실내와 복도에서 측벽 또는 천정에 설치되는 비상시 유도를 안내하는 스피커에 있어서, 스피커 유닛과 변압기 및 회로기판이 내부에 장착되고, 다수의 소리방출공이 형성된 전면케이스; 상기 전면케이스의 외부면에 장착되어 비상사태 발생시 상기 회로기판의 제어에 의해 점멸 작동되는 비상조명을 포함하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     상기와 같은 구성으로 이루어진 본 발명에 의하면, 화재 등으로 인한 비상사태 발생시, 비상조명의 점멸 작동에 의해 시인성을 높혀주어 신속한 대피를 유도할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 스피커를 통하여 안내 및 대피 방송을 함으로써 대피를 하는데 효과적으로 대처할 수 있다. 특히, 화재경보기의 경보음을 듣지 못하는 청각장애자들이 비상조명으로 사용한 섬광등의 섬광에 의해 비상상황을 인지할 수 있으므로 용이하게 대피할 수 있다. 
       
     건물, 안내방송, 스피커, 전면케이스, 비상조명, 섬광등.
assignees: DCN MEDIA CO LTD;JUNGANGI & TINDUSTRYCO LTD

title_en: Quick cooling and energy-conserving industry cold water machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rapid cooling and energy-conserving industry cold water machine, including the frame, the fixed radiator fan that is equipped with in middle part on frame top, one side fixed mounting on frame bottom plate top has the water tank evaporimeter, and water tank evaporimeter's water inlet port department is through pipeline fixedly connected with water pump, the output fixedly connected with outlet pipe of water pump, and two port departments of fin condenser are connected with compressor and water tank evaporimeter respectively through the connecting pipe, and one side of water tank evaporimeter is fixed respectively and is equipped with wet return, moisturizing pipe and warning pipe, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that through first shrouding and the second blind plate that is equipped with, and second blind plate and first shrouding sliding connection pass through the mode of magnetism connection simultaneously for second blind plate and frame attach avoids adopting the mode of screw thread, conveniently dismantles the maintenance, saves time, through the radiator fan that is equipped with, The heat dissipation hole positions and the heat dissipation plates improve heat dissipation performance, cool equipment in the frame and reduce potential safety hazards.
assignees: GUANGZHOU AOXIN EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Railway thunder and lightning early warning service system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a railway thunder and lightning early warning service system, which comprises a railway meteorological service center, a thunder and lightning early warning device, an early warning starting device, an information storage device and an information display device; the lightning early warning device comprises a lightning early warning information acquisition server and a lightning early warning information processing server; the early warning starting device comprises a thunder early warning starting program and a train control device, and the train control device comprises a train dispatching control system; the information storage device comprises a railway meteorological information database; the information display device comprises an early warning information release server and an early warning information display device; the output end of the railway weather service center is respectively connected with the lightning early warning device, the early warning starting device, the information storage device and the information display device through a 485 bus. The utility model adopts a plurality of observation data to warn thunder and lightning, thus improving the accuracy of the thunder and lightning early warning; and simultaneously, the utility model discloses accessible mobile terminal device masters railway thunder and lightning early warning information along the line at any time.

title_en: Method for accurately early warning forest fire of power transmission line
abstract_en: A method for accurately early warning the forest fire of the power transmission line comprises 4 steps of collecting fire point information, decomposing a wind speed signal, denoising the signal and early warning the forest fire of the power transmission line. The method changes the backward and old manual monitoring and early warning modes, has the characteristics of convenient calculation, obvious effect and the like, and is suitable for the forest fire prediction and warning of the power transmission lines at different altitudes and different areas; the method provides help for scientifically and accurately early warning the mountain fire information of the power transmission line, can be purposefully used when the mountain fire information is in the initial stage, and avoids line loss caused by blind prediction and warning.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST YUNNAN POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Volunteer matching service system for the visually impaired
title_ko: 시각장애인을 위한 자원봉사자 매칭 서비스 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a volunteer matching service system for the visually impaired, and more specifically, to a service system that allows a visually impaired person in a situation requiring assistance, such as providing directions, to receive assistance from a nearby volunteer who is one-on-one matched based on location information. The system comprises: a user terminal (100) that has an application exclusively for the visually impaired installed and transmits a phone number and real-time location information to a management server (110) when an emergency call input from a user occurs; a management server (110) that searches for nearby registered volunteer terminals (120) when a phone number and location information of a user terminal (100) are received by an emergency call, selects one or more of the searched volunteer terminals (120) and performs one-on-one matching with the user, and performs monitoring based on location information; and a volunteer terminal (120) in which a volunteer-only application is installed so that real-time location information is transmitted to the management server (110), and a notification message transmitted from the management server (110) is displayed on the screen to enable one-on-one matching with the user, thereby providing information for the matched user. According to the present invention, not only is there a basic effect of enabling a visually impaired person in need of help to provide and receive help by one-on-one matching with a volunteer located nearby, but there is also an additional effect of enabling detailed monitoring of the situation after matching to improve the service for ensuring the safety of the disabled person and providing more efficient services.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 길 안내 등 도움이 필요한 상황에 처한 시각장애인이 위치 정보를 기반으로 일대일 매칭된 주변의 자원봉사자로부터 도움을 받을 수 있도록 하는 서비스 시스템에 관한 것이며, 
시각장애인 전용의 앱이 설치되어, 앱을 구동한 사용자의 비상 호출을 위한 입력이 발생할 때 전화번호와 실시간의 위치 정보를 관리 서버로 전송하는 사용자 단말기, 비상 호출에 의한 사용자 단말기의 전화번호와 위치 정보가 수신될 때, 수신된 사용자 단말기의 위치 정보를 기준으로 하는 주변의 등록된 봉사자 단말기를 탐색하고, 탐색된 하나 이상의 봉사자 단말기 중 어느 하나 이상을 선택하여 자원봉사자의 동의에 의한 사용자와의 일대일 매칭을 실시하며, 위치 정보 기반의 모니터링을 실시하는 관리 서버 및, 자원봉사자 전용의 앱이 설치되어, 실시간의 위치 정보를 관리 서버로 전송하고, 관리 서버로부터 전송되는 알림 메시지를 화면에 표시하여 자원봉사자의 동의에 의한 사용자와의 일대일 매칭이 되게 하며, 매칭된 사용자를 위한 정보 제공이 발생하는 봉사자 단말기를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: An alert device, system and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an alert device (10), system and method for alerting a hearing-impaired person through a sensory means of a sound event and the location of such sound event. The invention extends further to the tracking of an object within a predefined perimeter, outside of which an alert is triggerable. The alert device (10) includes a wearable unit (12) having a plurality of differently colored LEDs (16.1, 16.2, 16.3, 16.4, 16.5) and a plurality of differently colored sound-detecting units (20.1, 20.2, 20.3, 20.4, 20.5), with each of the differently colored sound-detecting units (20.1, 20.2, 20.3, 20.4, 20.5) corresponding to the same colored LED (16.1, 16.2, 16.3, 16.4, 16.5) on the wearable unit thereby to color code the wearable unit to the sound-detecting units (20.1, 20.2, 20.3, 20.4, 20.5). In use, and in the event of a sound detected by one or more of the sound-detecting units (20.1, 20.2, 20.3, 20.4, 20.5) being higher than a predetermined threshold sound, a sound event signal is triggered on the wearable unit (12) activating a vibration thereof and the blinking of the LED (16.1, 16.2, 16.3, 16.4, 16.5) corresponding with the respective sound- detecting unit (20.1, 20.2, 20.3, 20.4, 20.5), consequentially alerting a user of the location at which that sound-detecting unit (20.1, 20.2, 20.3, 20.4, 20.5) was previously positioned within an environment.

title_en: Ferry ship early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a ferry ship early warning system, which has the technical scheme that: the method comprises the following steps: the system comprises a monitoring device for monitoring two sides of a ferry, a control host for generating an alarm file, a file-to-speech conversion module for converting the alarm file into voice information, a digital annunciator for adjusting the voice information into digital signals and sending the digital signals, an analog annunciator for adjusting the voice information into analog signals and sending the analog signals, a ferry ship hand table for receiving the voice information and a main control box; the monitoring device is electrically connected with the control host; the control host is electrically connected with the text-to-speech conversion module; the text-to-speech conversion module is electrically connected with the digital annunciator and the analog annunciator respectively; the digital signal machine and the analog signal machine are in communication connection with the ferry ship hand platform; the control host, the text-to-speech conversion module, the digital annunciator and the analog annunciator are all arranged in the main control box; this application has the advantage of reminding the ferry boats and ships when social boats and ships are close to the ferry.
assignees: GUANGZHOU MARITIME SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Railway beam field equipment operation monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a railway beam field equipment operation monitoring and early warning device, which belongs to the technical field of equipment operation monitoring and comprises a base, wherein the base is fixedly arranged on the ground, an ear plate is arranged on the base, one end of a swinging rod is hinged on the ear plate through a rotating shaft and swings along the rotating shaft, a touch rod is fixedly arranged on the rotating shaft, a buzzer is arranged on the ear plate and is used for extruding a touch switch of the buzzer after the touch rod swings along the swinging rod for a certain angle, the touch rod is arched, the touch rod is arranged on one side of the swinging rod far away from the rotating shaft, the direction of the arched part of the touch rod is perpendicular to the translation direction of a frame of a gantry crane, the arched part of the touch rod is abutted or tangent with the frame of the gantry crane, and an adjusting piece is used for resetting to a vertical state after the swinging rod swings for a certain angle. The utility model can timely monitor and feed back the running state of the frame equipment of the gantry crane, and avoid potential safety hazards caused by manual inspection omission.
assignees: WUHAN ENG CO LTD CHINA RAILWAY 7TH BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Centralized management and control system and method for railway natural disasters and foreign matter invasion
abstract_en: The invention provides a centralized management and control system and method for railway natural disasters and foreign matter invasion. Monitoring, management and control are conducted on the high-speed railway natural disasters and foreign matter invasion. The core part of the centralized management and control system is a railway bureau central system. The railway bureau central system is arranged in a railway bureau and used for collecting, analyzing and processing disaster monitoring data in the jurisdiction scope, has an alarming function, an early warning function and other functions, and achieves information interaction between the railway bureau central system and related system inside and outside of a railway. The monitoring objects of the centralized management and control system is wind, rain, snow, earthquake and overcrossing railway road and bridge foreign matter invasion, and distributing and acquiring, centralized management, centralized alarming determining disposal and comprehensive application of monitored information on all lines within the domain of the railway bureau are achieved. The centralized management and control system provides alarming and early warning information for dispatching, commanding and maintenance management, automatically gives corresponding disposal measures according to the severity of the disasters and effectively prevents or reduces the effect of the disasters on the high-speed railway train operation safety.
assignees: INST COMPUTING TECH CHINA ACAD RAILWAY SCIENCES;Beijing jingwei information technology co ltd;CHINA ACAD RAILWAY SCIENCES

title_en: Automatic switching from primary to secondary audio during emergency broadcast
title_ko: 비상 방송중 주 오디오로부터 보조 오디오로의 자동 전환
abstract_en: An audio video display device (AVDD) includes: a display, a processor controlling the display, and a computer readable storage medium that is accessible to the processor. The computer readable storage medium includes instructions which, when executed by the processor, cause the processor to present, on the AVDD, AV content that is not associated with information pertaining to an emergency. The instructions cause the processor to receive, at the AVDD, data associated with an emergency alert and, to be responsive to receiving the data associated with the emergency alert, to change audio presented on the AVDD from a first audio presented on the AVDD and associated with the AV content to a second audio associated with the data to present the second audio. The second audio is presented on the AVDD automatically without receiving user input to change from the first audio to the second audio subsequent to receiving the data associated with the emergency alert.
abstract_ko: 오디오 비디오 디스플레이 디바이스(audio video display device: AVDD)는 디스플레이, 디스플레이를 제어하는 프로세서, 및 프로세서에 액세스될 수 있는 컴퓨터 판독가능 저장 매체를 포함한다.  컴퓨터 판독가능 저장 매체는 프로세서에 의해 실행될 때, 프로세서가, AVDD 상에 비상 사태에 관련된 정보와 연관되지 않은 AV 콘텐츠를 제시하도록 하는 명령어들을 포함한다.  명령어들은 프로세서가, AVDD에서 비상 경계와 연관된 데이터를 수신하도록 하고, 비상 경계와 연관된 데이터를 수신하는 것에 응답하여, AVDD 상에 제시되는 오디오를, AVDD 상에 제시되고 AV 콘텐츠와 연관된 제1 오디오로부터 그 데이터와 연관된 제2 오디오로 변경하여 제2 오디오를 제시하도록 한다.  제2 오디오는, 비상 경계와 연관된 데이터를 수신하는 것에 후속하여 제1 오디오로부터 제2 오디오로 변경하기 위한 유저 입력을 수신하지 않고 자동으로 AVDD 상에 제시된다.

title_en: Battery Interconnected Alert Device System With Vibrational Alert
abstract_en: Disclosed is a battery interconnected detection and alert device system with building structure vibrational alert. The system includes of one or more alert devices wired into a dedicated circuit with a single location housing a DC power backup source, such as a rechargeable DC battery. The DC power backup source may be replaceable or rechargeable with DC current from an AC-DC transformer-rectifier, a photovoltaic cell, or other means. An electrical relay within the system provides a current to the dedicated circuit by selecting between the line-voltage alternating current source and the DC power backup. When activated, the detection and alert device generates a distinctive pulsed vibrational alert transmitted through the building structure to beds and other furniture resting on the floor, and additionally transmitted through the air as pressure waves which are perceived by hearing-impaired and other persons alerting them to a possible emergency situation.

title_en: Cast-in-place bridge pterygoid lamina bottom lifts by crane anticollision early warning hoist
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cast-in-place bridge wing plate bottom hoisting anti-collision early warning lifting appliance, which comprises a lifting appliance and an early warning device; the lifting appliance comprises a bone plate consisting of three vertically arranged U-shaped frames, a U-shaped outer sealing plate and a U-shaped inner sealing plate, wherein the cross sections of the outer sealing plate and the inner sealing plate are both U-shaped; two U-shaped frame positioning plates are further arranged at the centers of the U-shaped bottoms of the cross sections of the outer closing plate and the inner closing plate, and lifting lugs with lifting holes are further fixed on two end faces of the bone plate respectively; the early warning device comprises a horizontal and vertical distance detection device arranged on the outer side of the lower end of the bone plate and a hanger deformation distance receiving target arranged on the outer side of the upper end of the bone plate; the deformation condition of the lifting appliance is monitored in real time, unsafe phenomena such as collision, intermittent pulling, unprotected translation and the like are prevented, potential safety hazards such as falling of lifting objects caused by deformation of the lifting appliance are prevented, the construction process is accelerated, and the construction period is shortened obviously.

title_en: Convertor station valve hall anticollision stake that possesses early warning function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an anticollision stake technical field especially relates to a current conversion station valve room anticollision stake that possesses early warning function, including the anticollision stake body, the inner groovy has all been seted up, every to the circumference surface of anticollision stake body hypomere and upper segment the equal fixed mounting in bottom of inner groovy inside wall has outer arc hook, is located between two inner groovies the circumference surface winding of anticollision stake body installs two sets of annular lamp areas. title_en: Crack detection device for geological disaster early warning
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of crack detection devices, in particular to a crack detection device for geological disaster early warning; the utility model provides a crack detection device for geological disaster early warning, which comprises a translation sliding rail, an early warning controller, a translation assembly, a measurement assembly, a guide assembly and an adjusting assembly, wherein compared with the traditional crack detection device, when a graduated scale is aligned with a crack in the use process, the graduated scale is easy to incline and deviate, so that the time consumption for aligning the graduated scale with the crack is required, the problem of inconvenient realization of quick measurement is caused, and when the crack detection device is in the use process, firstly, the translation assembly is started to drive the measurement assembly to transversely move, the transverse dimension of the crack can be measured through the measurement assembly, and in addition, the guide assembly is started to drive the adjusting assembly to adjust and rotate, and the longitudinal dimension of the crack can be measured through the adjusting assembly, so that the quick measurement effect can be realized.

title_en: Blind area intelligent warning device and algorithm for meeting scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic facilities, in particular to a blind area intelligent warning device and an algorithm for a meeting scene, wherein the device mainly comprises: the vehicle state monitoring system comprises a vehicle state detecting unit, an instruction broadcasting unit and a processing unit, wherein the processing unit is provided with an input port and an output port for transmitting data information, the input port is electrically connected with the vehicle state detecting unit, the output port is electrically connected with the instruction broadcasting unit, in the working process, vehicle moving data collected by the vehicle state detecting unit are sent to the processing unit for calculation and analysis, and the processing unit calls the instruction broadcasting unit to perform sound and light prompt or route guidance according to a calculation result, so that traffic accidents caused by blind areas are avoided.
assignees: CHENGDU JIRUIDI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device for preventing transmission line cable from being broken outside
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for preventing an external damage of a power transmission line cable, which can timely and reliably discover an abnormality along the cable erection direction, can perform evidence collection, warning and periodic line inspection on external damage, reduces the probability of unintentional damage of external equipment, and increases the warning effect on artificial damage. In the invention, monitoring components for monitoring foreign matters approaching to the cables are arranged on two adjacent telegraph poles, warning components are hung on the cables on the two adjacent telegraph poles, and detection components for detecting whether the cables are damaged are also arranged on the cables on the two adjacent telegraph poles; the monitoring assembly comprises a laser monitoring assembly and a vision monitoring assembly; the laser monitoring assembly comprises a lower box body, a laser receiving assembly used for receiving a laser signal of the laser monitoring assembly on a previous telegraph pole is mounted on one side face of the lower box body, and a laser emitting assembly used for emitting laser to the next telegraph pole along the cable erection direction is mounted on the side face of the lower box body.

title_en: Video security monitoring method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of security monitoring, in particular to a video security monitoring method and system based on artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of firstly identifying the face shielding state of a target through a face key point detection and object detection model, marking the shielding target as the target to be tracked, then extracting the skeleton, gait and other steady-state physical characteristics of the target, constructing a three-dimensional space-time consistency identity fingerprint model, screening candidate targets by combining space-time accessibility constraints among monitoring nodes in a cross-node tracking process, comparing transient apparent characteristics to calculate a characteristic offset vector, judging that the target is suspected to be avoided if the vector exceeds a threshold value, automatically intercepting key frame images before and after mutation, marking an attribute change area by utilizing a thermodynamic diagram, finally generating a structured space-time track record, and executing hierarchical acousto-optic reminding. The invention effectively solves the problem of avoiding monitoring by shielding the face or changing the device halfway, and realizes automatic evidence chain locking and accurate early warning of suspected targets.
assignees: LONGYAN TIANBO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Smart fire notification system
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to solve the problem that a fire alarm system for the hearing and visually impaired does not exist. A fire alarm system comprises: an elastic band (1) which is composed of a length-adjustable elastic band to be conveniently worn regardless of the thickness of a wrist; a vibration module (2)which can be detected by the hearing and visually impaired and has wide usability through vibration signal education such as a Morse code; a display (3) which can be used by people other than the hearing and visually impaired and indicates a fire occurrence location; an AA battery (4) which can be easily obtained at a low price to be economically used in a place with a large floating population such as a hospital; and a Wi-Fi communication module (5) which can perform Wi-Fi communication. The present invention provides effects of enabling the hearing and visually impaired to be promptly notified of a fire and being efficiently used at a low price in a place with a large floating population such as a hospital as well as the disabled.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 화재 알림 시스템에 관한 것으로서 시청각 장애인에게 신속한 화재 알림이 가능하고, 장애인 뿐만 아니라 병원 등의 유동 인구가 많은 장소에서 저렴한 가격에 효율적으로 이용가능하도록 함으로써 기존의 시,청각 장애인을 위한 화재 알림 시스템이 존재하지 않는 문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 화재 알림 시스템에 있어서 손목 두께에 상관없이 편리한 착용이 가능할 수 있게 길이 조절 가능한 탄력 밴드로 구성한 탄력 밴드, 시청각 장애인이 감지 가능하고, 모스 부호 등의 진동 신호 교육을 통해 넓은 활용성을 가질 수 있게 진동 모듈을 장착하여 구성한 진동 모듈, 시청각 장애인 이외의 사람들도 이용이 가능하고, 이 때 화재 발생 위치를 나타낼 수 있게 디스플레이를 장착하여 구성한 디스플레이, 병원 등 유동인구가 많은 장소에서 보다 경제적인 활용이 가능할 수 있게 저렴한 가격에 쉽게 구할 수 있는 AA배터리를 활용하여 구성한 AA배터리, 각각의 건물에서 사용하는 Wi-Fi에 접속하여 해당 건물의 화재 감지 센서와 연동할 수 있게 Wi-Fi 송수신이 가능한 통신 모듈을 장착하여 구성한 Wi-Fi 통신모듈으로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 시청각 장애인에게 신속한 화재 알림이 가능하고, 장애인 뿐만 아니라 병원 등의 유동 인구가 많은 장소에서 저렴한 가격에 효율적으로 이용가능하도록 함으로써 기존의 시,청각 장애인을 위한 화재 알림 시스템이 존재하지 않는 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Method, system and non-transitory computer-readable recording medium for providing multimodal services for the hearing impaired
title_ko: 청각 장애인을 위한 멀티모달 서비스를 제공하기 위한 방법, 시스템 및 비일시성의 컴퓨터 판독 가능 기록 매체
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 태양에 따르면, 청각 장애인을 위한 멀티모달 알림 서비스를 제공하기 위한 방법으로서, MFCC(Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients) 기법에 기초하여 외부에서 입력되는 소리에 관한 특징(feature) 정보를 추출하고, 복수의 마이크에서 획득되는 상기 소리의 수신 시각(time)을 참조하여 상기 소리의 위치를 결정하는 단계, 상기 특징 정보를, CNN(Convolutional Neural Network) 기반의 공간적 특성 분석 모델과 LSTM(Long Short-Term Memory) 기반의 시간적 특성 분석 모델에 입력하여 출력되는 결과를 참조하여 위치별 상기 소리의 종류 및 경고 대상 이벤트 발생 여부를 분류하는 단계, 및 상기 경고 대상 이벤트 발생 여부에 관한 확률이 소정 수준인 것에 대응하여 경고 알림을 생성하는 단계를 포함하는 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Movable warning device and method for airport foreign matter removal
abstract_en: The application relates to a movable warning device and a warning method for airport foreign matter removal, and belongs to the technical field of civil aviation monitoring. According to the movable warning device and the warning method for airport foreign matter removal, airport foreign matter detection is carried out through the movable warning device, relevant data information is uploaded to the mobile terminal ipad to obtain the foreign matter coordinates after the airport foreign matter is detected, the movable warning device moves to the position of the foreign matter according to the foreign matter coordinates and sends out voice prompts, and the coordinates for foreign matter removal are returned to the ipad for display, so that the foreign matter is removed manually, the time consumed by searching by naked eyes of a person can be greatly shortened, and the foreign matter removal efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Storm avoiding buildings and structures
abstract_en: A building sheltering structure is configured to facilitate the shielding of at least one domicile or building into an underground foundation before an emergency environmental condition arises. The foundation includes a cover plate that translates horizontally to occlude the at least one domicile upon retraction into a secure cavity of the foundation by a lift assembly positioned at the bottom of the foundation cavity. Mounted atop the lift assembly, the at least one domicile can be fully retracted into the foundation cavity and completely shielded by the cover plate. The operation of the lift assembly is commanded and powered by a supply system. A processor of the supply system facilitates emergency warnings and panic transmissions to signal for help. Further, the supply system accommodates a plurality of solar panels mounted atop the at least one domicile to keep the system charged for the use in emergency.

title_en: Fire early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire early warning, in particular to a fire early warning device, which comprises a base, a temperature sensor, a smoke sensor, a buzzer, an alarm lamp and a protective component; the protective assembly comprises a protective housing, an electric push rod, a mounting plate, a closed door, a directional component and a rotating component, the protective housing is fixedly connected with a base, the electric push rod is fixedly connected with the base, the mounting plate is fixedly connected with the electric push rod, the closed door is connected with the protective housing through the rotating component, the directional component is arranged on the protective housing and is connected with the mounting plate, the rotating component is arranged on the protective housing and is connected with the closed door, the alarm lamp is protected through the protective housing, damage to the alarm lamp caused by contact of foreign objects is avoided, and economic loss is reduced.

title_en: Scenic spot safety monitoring equipment capable of achieving intelligent tour guide and electronic equipment power supply
abstract_en: The invention provides scenic spot safety monitoring equipment taking account of intelligent tour guide and electronic equipment power supply, which belongs to the technical field of scenic spot safety monitoring and comprises a portable monitoring main body, a background management system and an auxiliary equipment system, wherein the monitoring main body comprises a plurality of sensors and chip integrated units, a communication module, a positioning module, a power module and an intelligent tour guide module, the sensors acquire a plurality of information, the communication module flexibly switches signal transmission data, the power module has a large capacity for supplying power for the intelligent tour guide module and other equipment, the intelligent tour guide module provides multilingual explanation based on a digital twin technology, the background management system carries out safety monitoring and early warning, tour guide service management, equipment management and maintenance, and the auxiliary equipment system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle nest and an emergency unmanned aerial vehicle for tour inspection and emergency.
assignees: GUANGZHOU BEIDOU ANPING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent notification confirmation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent notification confirmation method, which optimizes a system-level notification flow of intelligent equipment and aims to improve the delivery reliability and trackability of notifications. In order to solve the inaccurate assumption that the prompt is closed, namely reading is indicated in the prior art, the invention introduces a double-stage interaction flow, and explicitly separates prompt triggering and response confirmation and notification content display and confirmation. In the prompt triggering stage, the system prompts the user in various modes, and the user can quickly close the prompt. The system optionally records the closing operation and/or sends a receipt. In the content display stage, the system displays or plays the complete notification content, and the user needs to manually close to complete confirmation. The system optionally records reading confirmation operations and/or sends a receipt. The invention effectively avoids information omission and security risk, and improves interaction efficiency, content accessibility and audit capability of a notification mechanism. The invention is suitable for important scenes such as alarm clocks, medical medication reminding, public safety early warning and the like.

abstract_en: The invention discloses one kind to invade limit intelligent monitor system and monitoring center database, and this, which invades limit intelligent monitor system, includes：Data collecting system, for gathering the Condition Monitoring Data in monitored area；Surveillance center, communicated to connect with the data collecting system, for analyzing the state of monitoring objective in the monitored area in real time according to the Condition Monitoring Data and determining alarm target and its danger classes, and the alarm signal according to corresponding to danger classes triggering；Comprehensive management platform, it is connected with the data collecting system and the Surveillance center, for Centralized Monitoring management and monitoring region on-site monitoring equipment；Intelligent alarm device, communicated to connect with the Surveillance center and realize linkage, for carrying out early warning or alarm according to the alarm signal.Therefore, implement the monitoring and warning that the foreign body intrusion events such as natural calamity, burst accident and forcible entry that the present invention can be to jeopardizing safe railway operation are carried out accurately and timely to alarm.

title_en: Wireless power system with foreign object detection
abstract_en: The wireless power system has a wireless power transmitting device and a wireless power receiving device. The wireless power transfer device may be a wireless charging pad or other device having a charging surface. The wireless power receiving device may be a portable electronic device that receives a transmitted wireless power signal from a wireless power transmitting device while resting on a charging surface. During a digital ping operation, a low power wireless power signal may be transmitted from the wireless power transfer device. Information collected during the digital ping, such as wireless power transfer efficiency information, coupling coefficient information, Q factor information, and coil inductance information, may be used to determine whether a foreign object is present. Control circuitry in the transmitting device may cause the receiving device to present an alert to a user indicating that a wireless power transfer operation is beginning in response to determining that no foreign object is present.

title_en: Intelligent electric control cabinet
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power control cabinets, and relates to an intelligent power control cabinet. The invention is beneficial to operators to timely process faults of the target power control cabinet by acquiring and displaying basic information of corresponding circuits, protection devices and loads of the target power control cabinet, avoids the expansion of the faults, improves the efficiency and accuracy of maintenance work, provides convenience for the maintenance and management of the target power control cabinet by analyzing the safety coefficients of the corresponding circuits and the protection devices of the target power control cabinet and the safety coefficients and the matching coefficients of the loads, reduces blindness and complexity of the maintenance work, improves the maintenance efficiency and quality, and is beneficial to taking protective measures in a targeted manner by acquiring the dust concentration and the fire source existence of the environment of the target power control cabinet and carrying out early warning, thereby avoiding the damage or the safety accidents of the target power control cabinet caused by environmental factors.

title_en: Weak current engineering safety alarm device
